jobs.description:
In partnership with the Director of Assisted Living and Memory Care Director, Med Aides are responsible for assisting with resident medication delivery and management, providing activities of daily living, and observing, documenting, and reporting resident conditions.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

• Preparing and assisting with medications as prescribed by Healthcare Providers to residents in Assisted Living and Memory Care.

jobs.title: Shipping & Receiving Associate
jobs.description:
The role of the Shipping & Receiving Associate will be responsible for handling shipping and receiving of materials, ensuring verification and recording of all records for incoming and outgoing shipments.

First Shift: Monday - Friday 8:00am - 4:00pm

jobs.title: Chemical Operator I (3p-11p or 11p-7a)
jobs.description:
Position Summary

Operate or tend equipment to control chemical changes or reactions in the processing of industrial products. Clean and load Chemsure trailers in the Point of Feed (POF) room; stage materials for production areas; wash totes; receive materials; put materials into storage locations; consolidate inventory; and perform general housekeeping.

Essential Functions & Responsibilities:

• Support all Environmental, Health, and Safety programs, policies, and regulations
• Move control settings to make necessary adjustments on equipment units affecting speeds of chemical reactions, quality, and yields
• Monitor recording instruments, flow meters, panel lights, and other indicators, and listen for warning signals, to verify conformity of process conditions
• Control or operate chemical processes or systems of machines, using panel boards, control boards, or semi-automatic equipment
• Record operating data such as process conditions, test results, and instrument readings
• Confer with technical and supervisory personnel to report or resolve conditions affecting safety, efficiency, and product quality
• Draw samples of products and conduct quality control tests to monitor processing and to ensure that standards are met
• Regulate or shut down equipment during emergencies, as directed by supervisory personnel
• Start pumps to wash and rinse reactor vessels, to exhaust gases and vapors, to regulate the flow of oil, steam, air, and to add products to blending vessels
• Interpret chemical reactions visible through sight glasses or on television monitors, and review laboratory test reports for process adjustments
• Patrol work areas to ensure that solutions in tanks and troughs are not in danger of overflowing
• Notify maintenance and other auxiliary personnel to correct equipment malfunctions and to adjust power, steam, water, or air supplies
• Turn valves to regulate flow of products or byproducts through agitator tanks, storage drums, or neutralizer tanks
• Calculate material requirements or yields according to formulas
• Gauge tank levels using calibrated rods
• Defrost frozen valves using steam hoses

Who You Are:

• Team player, individual thinker
• Customer-focused; positive attitude
• Attention to detail

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

• Working knowledge of SAP
• Excellent communication and documentation skills
• Strong math skills
• Strong computer skills, including Google

Education & Experience:

Required

• High school diploma or GED
• Minimum of six (6) months' experience working in a chemical manufacturing environment with hazardous materials.
• Minimum of 2 years’ related batch chemical blending/ formulation experience with hazardous materials
• Minimum of 1 year of analytical testing experience
• Experience driving a forklift

Preferred

• Associate degree from an accredited university, college, or technical school

Working Conditions:

• Ability to wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) (Safety Boots, Safety Clothing, Safety Helmet, Safety Goggle/Glasses, Respirator, Gloves)

jobs.title: Apartment Maintenance Technician - Perimeter Circle
jobs.description:
We are hiring a Maintenance Technician to work onsite at our Perimeter Circle apartment community in Sandy Springs, GA.

AIR Communities uses industry leading technology for a modern approach to maintenance so our Maintenance Technicians can help as many residents as possible each day. Whether you are turning an apartment to create the perfect move-in experience for new residents or resolving service requests to ensure that our current residents feel at home, every day is filled with new challenges.

What We Offer

AIR offers attractive compensation packages that reward hard work and excellent customer service including:

• Expected hourly rate of $22.00 - $25.00 per hour. You will be provided a pay rate that is in line with your skills and experience as they relate to the requirements of the job.
• Monthly Customer Service Satisfaction Bonuses. Technicians who excel at consistently providing positive resident experiences can earn up to $250 per month.
• 50% Rent Discount available at any AIR Community! Option to live onsite with zero commute or at a nearby AIR Community.
• Career Growth Opportunities. AIR prefers to promote our own teammates whenever possible and provides training and development programs to help prepare you for what’s next.
• Additional Benefits listed below.

How We Support You

• Innovative technology helping you prioritize tasks and assist residents efficiently
• Fully stocked and organized shops reducing the time it takes to resolve issues (tools may be available onsite, varies by community)
• Supportive leadership and teammates
• Ascend: AIR’s newest maintenance development program customized to your individual career path to help you realize your potential and achieve your goals.

What You Will Do

• Provide excellent service to residents and assistance to team members.
• Follow AIR’s process for completion of basic apartment turns to make the apartment ready for the next resident’s perfect move-in experience
• With general direction, complete resident requested repairs and routine maintenance (i.e. troubleshoot and repair/replace plumbing, basic electrical components, HVAC equipment, and appliances, etc.)
• May provide functional/technical direction and training to other Maintenance Technicians and support the development of technical skills.
• May assist with managing vendor quality and may perform move-in/move-out inspections.
• Responsibilities vary based on team member skillset and community needs, mechanical systems, and season.

Who You Are

• Detail-oriented problem solver that takes pride in fixing things right the first time
• Dedicated to customer satisfaction in each interaction
• Eager to use technology to assist as many residents as possible each day
• Demonstrates a strong work ethic and thrives in a fast-paced environment
• A reliable team player who contributes to their team’s success

What You Have

• At least 2 years of maintenance experience, preferably in some form of facilities or building environment
• Proficient skills in at least two technical trades (plumbing, electrical, appliance repair, HVAC, carpentry, etc.)
• Ability to work a flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, 7-day work weeks (depending on community needs and seasonality), and on-call shifts (at least one week a month).
• A reliable mode of transportation to respond to emergency service requests while on-call after hours.
• Comfort with physical activity as you must be able and willing to move heavy equipment and machinery.
• Ability to read, write, and speak English.

Benefits

• Paid time off including vacation, sick time, and 14 holidays.
• Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance options, HSA/FSA plans, short and long-term disability paid by the company.
• 50% rent discount available at any AIR Community (a rental application is required, and certain exclusions apply).
• 401(k) plan with up to 6% employer match.
• Paid parental leave of up to 16 weeks.
• Tuition assistance program and up to 100% reimbursement for job-related certifications and licenses.
• 15 hours of paid time annually for community service.
• Commuter benefits and pet insurance.
• Consumer discounts on various products and services.
• Opportunities for ongoing professional development, leadership training, and career growth.

What You Need to Know

jobs.title: Associate Director, Market Research and Analytics - Eye Care
jobs.description:
The Associate Director of Marketing Research & Analytics for Eye Care will be an indispensable business partner, focused on increasing market place success – by designing, implementing, managing, analyzing, and effectively communicating marketing research and analytics initiatives for Eye Care on behalf of APEX. The individual will derive high-impact learnings from qualitative and quantitative primary and secondary research, behavioral analytics, market insights, and partner with Brand partners, APEX internal teams and external agencies to inform strategic and tactical decision-making. The ability to influence decisions based upon careful and strategic thinking and understanding of the business is critical to success.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Act as an intelligence partner focused on providing strategic insights, forming a trusted relationship, and staying abreast of commercial issues and trends within the Eye Care space.
• Proactively identify primary research and analytics opportunities to ensure that decision-making is based on the most current, objective and comprehensive insights across consumers, HCPs and trade channels.
• Be conversant with custom research methods, adept at supplier and stakeholder management, and able to independently lead custom research projects that deliver compelling and actionable learnings.
• Perform thought-provoking and sophisticated syntheses of learning across primary research, analytics, and market intelligence sources to develop actionable insights and recommendations that shape strategies and tactics.
• Maintain organizational knowledge of the market, competitive trends, and industry developments and effectively communicate this knowledge to internal stakeholders.
• Design and execute against measurement plans, inclusive of selected operational and performance indicators, to ensure the organization’s understanding of execution, engagement, and impact of Eye Care brand programs and tactics.

jobs.title: Operatore Esperto Macchine da Taglio (Slitter) - Contratto 2 Anni
jobs.description:
Stiamo cercando un/una operatore/trice esperto/a addetto al taglio che entri a far parte del nostro team di produzione a Cadorago, in Italia. L'operatore lavora in piena autonomia, senza la necessità di una particolare supervisione. Adatta con successo procedure, utensili e attrezzature per soddisfare i requisiti di produzione, assumendo il ruolo di operatore principale sulle macchine da taglio (slitter) e sulla linea di imballaggio. In questa mansione, ha la completa responsabilità del setup delle macchine, dell'ottimizzazione della velocità e dell'esecuzione del piano di produzione rispetto agli obiettivi previsti.

Lavoro in sede - Contratto a tempo determinato 2 anni

• Eseguire il setup completo delle macchine da taglio (slitter) e della linea di imballaggio, ottimizzandone la velocità in base al piano di produzione.
• Svolgere la manutenzione autonoma di 1° livello (TPM) per garantire l'affidabilità dei macchinari e la stabilità del processo.
• Rispettare rigorosamente le linee guida EHS (Salute, Sicurezza e Ambiente), le procedure operative standard (SOP) e gli standard 5S.
• Condurre in totale sicurezza le attrezzature per la movimentazione delle merci, tra cui carrelli elevatori, transpallet manuali e carrelli retrattili.
• Partecipare al sistema di lavoro collaborativo, fungendo da esempio comportamentale per l'intero team attraverso un'elevata consapevolezza e orientamento al miglioramento continuo.

Requisiti:

• Diploma di scuola secondaria di secondo grado o titolo equivalente, con almeno 5 anni di comprovata esperienza in ambito produttivo o manifatturiero.
• Buona padronanza nell'utilizzo di software e sistemi gestionali per la produzione, unita a un livello di inglese comunicativo/operativo.
• Costituisce un forte vantaggio una precedente esperienza lavorativa diretta su macchine da taglio/taglierine, linee di imballaggio, nel settore della stampa o in contesti manifatturieri ad alto contenuto tecnologico
• Il possesso del patentino per il muletto sarà considerato un plus.

Competenze necessarie per avere successo:

• Eccellente attitudine a lavorare in ambienti dinamici e veloci, dimostrando buone capacità di problem solving logico e un'attitudine matematica e meccanico/tecnica.
• Ottime doti interpersonali, di comunicazione e di lavoro in squadra, con la capacità di operare in autonomia, in sicurezza e nel rispetto delle tempistiche.

Cosa Offriamo

Ecco una panoramica dei principali vantaggi e opportunità che ti aspettano:

*Assicurazione Infortuni: Copertura per infortuni sul lavoro e nella vita privata (professionali ed extra-professionali). Possibilità di aderire al Piano pensionistico con contributi aziendali aggiuntivi versati a Fon.te (fondo di riferimento nel settore).

- Equilibrio Vita-Lavoro e Flessibilità: *Orario Flessibile: Orario settimanale ordinario di 38,5 ore. *Congedo Parentale: Pienamente conforme alle leggi locali.

- Benessere e Supporto: *Programma di Assistenza ai Dipendenti: Programma LYRA per supporto emotivo e psicologico. *Osteopata in Sede: Disponibilità di un osteopata in sede (1 volta al mese).

- Sviluppo Continuo e Vantaggi in Sede: *Buoni Pasto (del valore netto di 7€ per giorno lavorato di almeno 4 ore). *Piani di sviluppo individuali.

Offriamo, inoltre, le seguenti opportunità formative:

• Corso di Primo Soccorso e Antincendio
• Formazione EHS (Salute, Sicurezza e Ambiente)
• Formazione per la conduzione di carrelli elevatori o macchine per la movimentazione
• Formazione sull'uso di transpallet manuali e carrelli retrattili
• Formazione su YC, BC e processi di escalation
• Formazione sul metodo 5S
• Formazione sulle procedure operative standard (SOP)
• Formazione su Magma
• Utilizzo e compilazione STA
• Corso per Front Line Leader (opzionale)

Siamo un'azienda globale specializzata nella scienza dei materiali e nelle soluzioni di identificazione digitale con sedi in oltre 50 paesi e circa 35.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo. Come azienda orientata alla scienza e all'innovazione, crediamo che i team diversificati siano i più forti. Ci impegniamo a promuovere una cultura basata sulla curiosità e sul coraggio, dove puoi far crescere la tua carriera all'interno di un'azienda che ha l'innovazione nel proprio DNA. Fondati sull'idea di creare un impatto reale per garantire un futuro migliore, ci impegniamo a offrire un ambiente di lavoro aperto e collaborativo in cui la diversità di pensiero è incoraggiata e rispettata. Scopri cosa pensano i nostri dipendenti dell'esperienza di lavoro in Avery Dennison. Maggiori informazioni su www.averydennison.com. In Avery Dennison, collaboriamo con i più grandi marchi nei settori FMCG (Beni di consumo in rapido movimento), Abbigliamento, Automotive e Farmaceutico. Il nostro Centro di Distribuzione di Cadorago, fondato nel 1964, offre un ambiente collaborativo e dinamico che supporta le nostre divisioni LPM e Graphics e impiega circa 87 professionisti di talento. Le funzioni chiave in questa sede includono le Operations,Vendite e il Servizio Clienti, offrendo percorsi di carriera diversificati e opportunità di crescita.

Ti invitiamo a visitare la nostra pagina DE&I per saperne di più sul nostro approccio a Diversità, Equità e Inclusione.

Dichiarazione sulla Trasparenza Retributiva

La fascia di retribuzione base indicata sopra rappresenta ciò che Avery Dennison prevede ragionevolmente di pagare per questa posizione alla data di pubblicazione. jobs.title: AI Product Manager, Agents & Orchestration
jobs.description:
AI PRODUCT MANAGER, AGENTS & ORCHESTRATION

This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.




ABOUT US

1mind is building the next generation of revenue teams.

We are creating a new category of enterprise software: Autonomous Customer Experience. Our platform deploys Superhumans, go-to-market teammates with a face, a voice, and a GTM brain that serve the buyer across the entire journey with one continuous memory. They engage, demo, onboard, and support in the moments no company could ever staff, so the handoffs disappear and growth stops leaking.

Join us as we define the category and build the platform that powers the next generation of revenue teams. When the buyer wins, the company wins. Every1 Wins.




ABOUT THE ROLE

1mind is building the AI-led GTM workforce: Superhumans that run SDR, SE, onboarding, account management and customer success work end to end, on top of a shared context graph that compounds with every customer conversation. Today each Superhuman mostly runs as a single agent on a single surface. The next product leap is orchestration: teams of agents that hand work to each other, run packaged GTM plays, and bring in humans only when the trust ladder says so.



You'll own that leap. This is the first PM seat dedicated to the agent runtime and orchestration layer. You'll work directly with the GenAI team, report to the Chief Product Officer, and decide how agents plan, call tools, share memory, hand off, and get evaluated. Then you'll turn that into a platform that other PMs, forward-deployed engineers and customers build on.



The window is short. Large platforms are consolidating the two ends of the funnel, and the live-conversation middle is still open. Expect to ship a v1 that isn't clean, then make it better every week.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the agent runtime every Superhuman runs on: planning, tool calling, memory reads and writes against the context graph, guardrails, and the Assist, Co-pilot and Autonomous trust ladder. One runtime, many roles.

 - Design multi-agent orchestration: handoffs between Superhumans across the customer journey (inbound SDR to SE Ride-Along to onboarding to CSM), shared state across a deal or account, and conflict resolution when two agents want to act on the same contact.

 - Turn GTM orchestrations into a product. Packaged plays by funnel-stage outcome, like qualification and activation or retention and expansion, that customers configure instead of build. You define the primitives: triggers, steps, agent assignments and human checkpoints.

 - Build and own the eval harness for agent behavior, including task-level success, objection-to-advance rate, escalation precision, and hallucination and tool-error rates. Set the bar that gates every release and own the dashboard that tracks it.

 - Define the platform surface: the APIs, configuration and admin experiences that app-layer PMs, forward-deployed engineers and enterprise admins use to compose and tune agents, including per-enterprise adapters and fine-tuning hooks.

 - Run a weekly ship cadence with GenAI and engineering, with enablement and customer success looped in before every release.

 - Write the specs engineers want to build from (data models, state machines, API shapes and the tradeoffs between them), and prototype in code or no-code tools before you write the doc.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

Required

 - 5+ years of product management, including at least 2 years shipping LLM-based agents to production users. You've owned a product where the model's behavior was the product.

 - Hands-on with the agent stack: tool calling, planning loops, memory and retrieval, multi-agent handoff patterns, and the ways each one fails. You can read a trace and tell us what went wrong.

 - You've built or owned an eval harness and used it to gate releases. You think in task success rates, not vibes.

 - Experience at an AI-native company, or on a large platform team paired with founder or early-stage startup experience, preferred. We're not looking for SaaS feature PMs.

 - Technical enough to spec data models, state machines and API shapes, and to explain the tradeoffs between them.

 - Comfortable deciding with incomplete data and shipping weekly. You'd rather fix a v1 in production than polish a v2 in a doc.

 - Clear writing. Your PRDs are short, your eval reports have numbers, and your Slack messages make sense to sales.

Preferred

 - Fine-tuning or RL exposure: SFT, DPO or reward-based training on outcome-labeled data, or per-tenant adapters.

 - Voice or real-time conversational agents, where latency and interruption handling shape the product.

 - GTM domain depth: you've carried a quota, run a CS book, or built for people who did.

 - Workflow or orchestration products at the platform level.

 - Enterprise platform experience: admin surfaces, permissions, audit, and the customers who ask for them.



The salary range for this position is $185,000 to $260,000. The compensation package for this position also includes stock options and company-paid benefits.

1mind's total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks. Final compensation will depend on factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, and will be determined during the interview process. The hiring manager will share more details about the full compensation package and benefits as you move through the process.

We believe in providing interesting and meaningful work in a supportive and inclusive environment - free from discrimination for everyone without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. If you are passionate about learning and excited about what we are doing, then we want to hear from you!

jobs.title: Product Manager, Retention
jobs.description:
About OneSkin

#BeLimitless with OneSkin

Come redefine the future of aging with us. We're a longevity company. Everything we do, we do to help people age at the best version of themselves.

Our founding team is made up of 4 PhDs and entrepreneurial minds on a mission to transform the way we think about skin and aging. As the pioneers of skin health and longevity, we create science-based, clinically effective products to optimize skin and body health and provide support for people at every step of their “growing limitless” journey. Our longevity approach targets the root causes of aging using a proprietary peptide designed to decrease the accumulation of aged (senescent cells) in the skin -- and is the first product proven to reduce skin biological age in humans.

We never settle and continually challenge existing treatments and methodologies to advance the frontier of skin science. As we help our customers grow limitless, we grow too -- by embracing individuality and differences, leading by example, and empowering ourselves and others with our passion for science, optimal health, and innovation.

We are limitless. It's our mantra. Our commitment to helping anybody and everybody committed to live life to the fullest regardless of their age.

About the Role

This Product Manager will take full ownership of retention: the subscriber experience, the platforms it runs on, and the roadmap that keeps both improving. You'll define the strategy, turn it into a roadmap you can execute against, and work across growth, data, product design, and our development agency to improve the overall customer experience including engagement, lifetime value, cancellation prevention, and renewal flows — all driving growth in Lifetime Value.

How we work

• We define the problem before we define the solution. We resist the urge to rush into execution. When handed a goal, we map out uncertainties, leverage first-principle thinking to uncover the root cause, and design a plan tailored to solve the true problem.

• We own both the outcome and the inputs. We thoroughly scope initiatives, ensuring work is properly sequenced to eliminate bottlenecks. Ownership doesn’t end at launch, we see every project through to rigorous monitoring and performance reporting.

• We collaborate proactively, and often. We prioritize alignment. Cross-functional partners & stakeholders engage in active working sessions, not passive status meetings. We choose to solve complex problems together rather than go back and forth in Slack.

• We document for transparency. We keep stakeholders and partners informed asynchronously by centralizing progress, context and key decisions to make it easy to track project momentum and business impact.

• We value data over opinion: We analyze metrics and leverage the best available information to resolve debates, ground our strategies, and make confident calls

• We match rigor to the stakes. We make swift decisions with the best insights at hand, recognizing information is not always perfect. We balance our evaluation depth with the importance of the outcome and keep moving.

• We build systems for scale and success. We actively architect the foundations we need to succeed. When an important process, framework, or piece of documentation doesn't exist or is broken, we build it, and we build to scale.

How you make an impact

• Own the post-purchase product experience: drive the retention program lifecycle and core operating systems including onboarding, subscription management, post-purchase education, and loyalty programs

• Optimize early user experiences so new customers hit their "aha!" moment and realize core product value quickly.

• Build features & experiences —like streaks, reminders, triggers, loyalty programs, or personalized re-engagement campaigns—that turn daily usage into a key part of the customer longevity routine.

• Manage the subscriber account experience end to end: direct the digital product touchpoints that impact user LTV, mapping customer journeys to eliminate friction point and proactively mitigate churn

• Lead subscription platform strategy: utilize deep, data-driven decision making and cohort-based analytical frameworks to evaluate, select and optimize our subscription systems

• Apply product systems thinking to experiments: formulate clear, testable hypotheses to isolate retention bottlenecks. Structure disciplined A/B tests and experiments to validate assumptions, extract insights and rapidly iterate on findings to fully own the business outcome.

• Proactively own data health to catch, diagnose and resolve breakages before they impact business reporting and/or outcomes.

• Leverage existing AI tools and evaluate emerging technologies to automate repetitive work, analyze large sets of data to increase and improve outcomes without sacrificing critical thinking and domain expertise.

We’re excited about you because

• You’re driven by analytical curiosity and need to understand the “why”.

• You use AI tools daily to analyze customer data and automate repetitive work, but not to replace critical thinking skills. Experience with MCPs and agents is a must have.

• You're possess administrator-level fluency in Shopify and subscription management platforms (SKIO or comparable)

• You’re a proactive optimizer. You routinely go looking for what's underperforming before someone asks you.

• You close the loop: you QA your own work and rigorously test your own implementation until any issues are fully resolved

• You can comfortably navigate ambiguity, create a structured execution plan to validate your hypotheses, and align cross-functional partners in the process

• You translate technical complexities and details for non-technical partners clearly

• You hold yourself and your collaborators around you to a high bar, believing that a rigorous, and scalable solution is more valuable than a rushed deployment.

Compensation Range: $150,000–$170,000

Our total compensation package includes a competitive base salary, strong quarterly bonus potential, and equity/stock options designed to support long-term alignment and shared success.

Perks & Benefits

• Fully remote work experience, including a one-time allowance for home office setup

• Comprehensive medical, dental, vision package, and FSA.

• 401K with 100% match up to 5% of your salary

• Flexible PTO

• Monthly wellness package (Gympass) including free meditation app membership (Headspace, Calm)

• Free OneSkin subscription for full-sized products

jobs.title: Mid-Market Account Executive
jobs.description:
At Poka, we're changing how the world's industrial teams work — capturing the knowledge of their best people and putting it in every operator's hands.

Our connected worker platform is purpose-built for manufacturing and the wider industrial world, with industrial AI inside the shift, not on top of it. The result: frontline performance that becomes compounding knowledge and measurable impact — every shift, every site, every region.

We're proud to support global leaders like Nestlé, Bosch, Mars, and Danone across 3,000+ sites in 70+ countries. And as a fast-growing part of the IFS family, you'll join a team whose daily work directly shapes the platform behind how modern manufacturing gets done.

If you like a full pipeline, a fast sales cycle, and the satisfaction of closing deal after deal rather than waiting months on one, this is your kind of role.

Role overview

As a Commercial Account Executive, you'll bring Poka's connected worker platform to growing manufacturers across North America - running a high volume of deals end-to-end, from the first conversation through to close. You'll work smaller, faster-moving accounts than our Enterprise team, which means more at-bats, quicker cycles, and a real chance to build a track record fast.

You'll own your pipeline and your number: prospecting into the right accounts, running sharp discovery, building the business case, and closing with confidence. You'll do it alongside Sales Development, Solutions Consulting, Customer Success, and our IFS partners, with plenty of room to grow into larger patches as you prove yourself.

This is a great fit for someone with a couple of years of new business closing experience who wants to sharpen their craft in a fast-paced environment, with a real path to Enterprise or Strategic as they grow.

What you'll be doing

• Build and manage a high-volume pipeline through outbound prospecting, market research, and close collaboration with the Sales Development team

• Own the full sales cycle - discovery and needs analysis, product demonstrations, proposals, negotiation and close - moving deals at pace

• Build clear, tailored business cases that connect Poka's platform to each prospect's operational priorities

• Partner closely with Customer Success and cross-functional teams so customers move smoothly from signature to long-term value

• Keep opportunity tracking, forecasting, and account activity accurate and current in Salesforce

• Put AI to work in your day-to-day, research and account planning, conversation intelligence, drafting and CRM copilots, to sell smarter and spend more time with customers

• Bring customer insights and market feedback to leadership to help shape go-to-market strategy and product direction

• Contribute to lead generation initiatives and campaigns, drawing on your customer knowledge and industry trends

• Represent Poka at trade shows, industry events, networking opportunities, and virtual conferences

What you bring

• 3+ years of experience in B2B sales or a comparable Account Executive/closing role, with a track record of hitting or beating targets

• Experience selling SaaS, or strong transferable sales skills and a genuine interest in manufacturing or industrial technology

• Confidence running a full sales cycle independently and managing a busy pipeline

• Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills

• A results-driven mindset and real hustle - you're motivated by volume and velocity, not just one big deal

• A hands-on, curious approach to AI and modern sales tooling - you already use it to work smarter and are keen to keep learning

• Excellent written and spoken communication and presentation skills in English

• Based in the central or southern US, ideally near a major hub such as Dallas, Houston, Denver or Atlanta with great transport links and the ability and willingness to travel

We know great sellers come from varied paths. If you don't tick every box but you've got the drive and the numbers to back it up, we'd love to hear from you.

Why Poka

Manufacturers are under pressure to capture the knowledge of a retiring workforce, onboard new people faster, and get AI onto the floor in a way operators actually use, and Poka is one of very few platforms that does all three, already trusted at 3,000+ sites. You'll sell with the reach of IFS behind you and the pace and ownership of a growth-stage company, with a clear runway to grow your career as Poka grows across North America.

#LI-TK

What we offer:

• Generous vacation policy, additional paid days, and charity day.

• A truly flexible schedule that allows you to adapt your work hours.

• Group insurance from day one (dental, medication, disability, travel, etc.) with employer contributions, including access to telemedicine and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

• A rewarding employee referral program for successful hires.

• Tasty snacks available at all times in our offices (fresh fruits, snacks, pastries, coffee, tea, etc.)

*Certain benefits are exclusively accessible to employees in Canada.

Want to learn more about our culture? Click HERE.

Please note: An understanding of English is essential at Poka, as it is the language used during company-wide meetings and many internal communications, ensuring effective collaboration and decision-making. In addition, as Poka operates in an international environment, English is the primary language for communicating with our clients and partners, enabling us to better serve them and represent Poka in a professional manner.

We’re an AI-first global tech company with 25+ years of engineering leadership, 2,000+ team members, and 500+ active projects powering Fortune 500 clients, including HBO, Microsoft, Google, and Starbucks.

From AI platforms to digital transformation, we partner with enterprise leaders to build what’s next.

You will focus on partnering with the Development, DevSecOps, and Cyber teams to create, implement, and apply Microsoft best practices, principles, processes, and culture regarding DevOps within an Azure-hosted environment. You will provide subject matter expertise on application design, infrastructure, monitoring, and GitHub pipeline development, leading our engineering teams in building secure software and development and implementing security controls in an Agile environment.

What You Bring

• Working with Secure CI/CD pipelines (mainly GitHub Actions & Flows) and ALM tools to automate security requirements validation tasks

• Programming skills in one or more of the following programming and markup languages: Java, .Net, Terraform, Python, Visual Basic, PowerShell, Bash, C++, C#, Django, JavaScript, YAML, HTML, CSS, etc.

• Expertise in Azure cloud services (Azure SQL, Azure ServiceBus, Azure Redis, KeyVaults, Azure Storage, etc) is a requirement

• Understanding of network architectures and services (e.g., VPN, routing, firewall, NSGs, etc.)

• Knowledge of Source Code Management concepts (e.g., code lines, branching, merging, integration, versioning). Proficiency in using Git for version control is a must

• Ability to translate traditional SDLC approach (plan, code, build, test, release, deploy, and monitor) to the phases of agile development when writing software to automate security-related tasks

Nice to Have

• Knowledge of CI/CD Pipeline creation in Azure DevOps

• Azure certifications (e.g., Azure DevOps engineer expert and Azure Administrator Associate)

English level

Intermediate

jobs.title: Underwriting & Funding Manager
jobs.description:
Underwriting & Funding Manager

About the role

inKind is looking for an Underwriting & Funding Manager to evaluate restaurant funding opportunities and make disciplined, timely funding decisions. You’ll own the review process from initial diligence through final recommendation or approval, helping inKind fund strong restaurant partners while managing risk.

This role requires financial judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to understand the business behind the numbers. You should be comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, asking thoughtful questions, and explaining your conclusions clearly.

What you’ll do

• Review new funding opportunities. Assess applications, financial statements, sales trends, bank activity, existing obligations, and other supporting materials for completeness and accuracy.

• Underwrite restaurant businesses. Evaluate operating performance, cash flow, liquidity, ownership experience, and the restaurant’s ability to support the proposed funding structure.

• Determine appropriate funding terms. Recommend funding amounts, structures, conditions, and risk mitigants based on your analysis and inKind’s underwriting guidelines.

• Make funding decisions. Approve or decline requests within your delegated authority and present exceptions or larger transactions to the appropriate decision-makers.

• Document your judgment. Prepare concise underwriting summaries that explain the opportunity, key risks, assumptions, and rationale for each decision.

• Lead diligence. Work with restaurant owners and internal teams to resolve questions, verify information, and identify material discrepancies or potential fraud.

• Coordinate funding readiness. Confirm that required approvals, documentation, and funding conditions are complete before funds are released.

• Improve the process. Help refine underwriting standards, approval workflows, and reporting to make decisions more consistent and efficient.

• Learn from performance. Partner with the team monitoring funded restaurants to compare actual results with underwriting assumptions and improve future decisions.

Minimum Experience

• 4+ years of experience in commercial underwriting, small business financing, fintech lending, credit analysis, investment analysis, or a related field.

• Strong financial statement analysis and modeling skills, including the ability to evaluate cash flow, liquidity, leverage, repayment capacity, and unit-level economics.

• Experience independently evaluating transactions, assessing financial and operational risks, and making or recommending funding decisions.

• Experience building, implementing, or improving underwriting processes, with a focus on automation, operational efficiency, and scalable decision-making.

• Ability to translate underwriting policies, financial thresholds, risk indicators, and approval requirements into structured business rules and automated workflows.

• Strong analytical and technical aptitude, with the ability to work with financial datasets, identify patterns, validate information, and support data-driven underwriting decisions.

• Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including financial modeling, scenario analysis, and working with transaction-level data.

• Familiarity with underwriting systems, financial data platforms, automated decisioning tools, or workflow automation technologies.

• Ability to partner effectively with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to define requirements, test solutions, and implement improvements to underwriting systems and processes.

• Sound commercial judgment and the ability to balance funding opportunities, speed of execution, and disciplined risk management.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex financial findings, underwriting decisions, and technical requirements to financial and nonfinancial stakeholders.

• Strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple funding reviews and process improvement initiatives without sacrificing quality.

Preferred Experience

• Restaurant, hospitality, or multiunit business underwriting experience.

• Familiarity with restaurant point-of-sale (POS) data, payment processing systems, seasonality, food and labor costs, and location-level profitability.

• Experience with alternative financing structures, including revenue-based financing or merchant cash advances.

• Hands-on experience implementing automated underwriting workflows, rules-based decision engines, risk-scoring models, or automated approval processes.

• Experience integrating or analyzing financial data from banking platforms, POS systems, payment processors, or third-party data providers.

• Working knowledge of SQL and experience with Snowflake, Sigma, Tableau, or similar data and business intelligence platforms.

• Experience using AI, machine learning, or automation tools to improve financial analysis, document processing, risk assessment, or underwriting efficiency.

• A track record of building or refining underwriting policies, approval frameworks, and risk management processes in a high-growth fintech or lending environment.

What success looks like

You deliver timely, well-supported funding decisions; identify material risks before funding; maintain clear and complete approval records; and help inKind grow a healthy portfolio of restaurant partners.

Compensation and benefits: $120,000 - 155,000 base salary + Benefits

Who we are:

inKind connects passionate diners with exceptional restaurants across the country. inKind partners with thousands of restaurants and has millions of users who want to discover great places, dine confidently, and earn meaningful rewards.

Through the inKind app, guests earn 20% back every time they dine, turning everyday meals into something more rewarding. From celebrated restaurant groups like José Andres and Michael Mina to beloved neighborhood favorites, inKind helps diners explore the best restaurants in town while supporting the restaurants and chefs who shape how their cities eat.

Rooted in hospitality and built on a win-win philosophy, inKind exists to help great restaurants thrive while inspiring guests to dine out more often. Every meal creates value on both sides of the table, empowering diners to savor more while strengthening the restaurant community.

inKind is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that diversity is vital to inKind's ability to provide our clients with the best recommendations and are committed to fostering a varied and inclusive work environment. Your race, color, ancestry, religion, gender, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, veteran status, or any other protected category have no bearing on our hiring decisions.

For California residents and others with applicable rights, please review our privacy notice for information about your rights regarding your personal data.

jobs.title: Control Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, Seattle, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

Role Overview:

CHAOS is seeking a skilled Control Systems Engineer to join our hardware engineering team. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain HIL simulation environments that enable full system integration testing of our Effector platforms — bridging the gap between software development and flight hardware. You will work closely with GNC, software, and systems engineers to ensure our vehicles are thoroughly validated before ever leaving the ground.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience building and operating HIL or SIL simulation environments for embedded or autonomous systems.

This is a full-time, on-site position in El Segundo, CA.

Responsibilities:

• Design and develop HIL test benches for full effector system integration, including flight controllers, ESCs, sensors, and ground control systems

• Integrate high-fidelity simulation models (flight dynamics, actuator, and sensor models) that accurately replicate real-world behavior

• Integrate hardware components - including autopilot boards, communication links, power systems, and peripherals - into HIL systems

• Develop automated test suites and regression frameworks to validate software and firmware changes against HIL environments

• Collaborate with software and integration/test engineers to define test plans and acceptance criteria for new features and hardware releases

• Debug complex hardware-software interactions by analyzing HIL test data, logs, and telemetry

• Maintain and improve test infrastructure, including simulation software, real-time targets, and data acquisition systems

• Document test methodologies, procedures, and results clearly for cross-functional team use

• Support transition of HIL-validated systems to integration and flight test phases

Minimum Requirements:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

• 3+ years of experience in hardware-in-the-loop testing, embedded systems integration, or a closely related discipline

• Hands-on experience building and operating HIL or SIL simulation environments for embedded or autonomous systems

• Proficiency in real-time simulation platforms (e.g., dSPACE, NI VeriStand, or similar)

• Strong programming skills in Python and/or C/C++ for test automation and system scripting

• Familiarity with flight controller software such as PX4, ArduPilot, or equivalent

• Experience with communication protocols common in drone systems (MAVLink, CAN, UART, SPI, I2C)

• Solid understanding of effector system architecture, including propulsion, navigation, and control loops

• Experience with version control systems and CI/CD pipelines for automated testing

• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across hardware and software domains

• Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance

Preferred Requirements:

• Master’s degree in Engineering

• Experience with ROS or ROS 2 for simulation and integration testing

• Familiarity with MATLAB/Simulink for flight dynamics or control system modeling

• Exposure to flight test operations and transitioning systems from HIL to field testing

• Experience with FPGA firmware development or embedded Linux environments

• Knowledge of RF systems, GPS signal simulation, or sensor fusion techniques

• FAA Part 107 certification or equivalent UAV operational credentials

Why CHAOS?

• Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company

• Additional benefits: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more

• Our Perks: Free daily lunch, ‘No meeting Fridays’, unlimited PTO, casual dress code

• Compensation Components: Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses

• Team Growth: 250 employees and counting across 5 global offices

$130k-190k

The stated compensation range reflects only the targeted base compensation range and excludes additional earnings such as bonus, equity, and benefits. If your compensation requirements fall outside of the range, we still encourage you to apply. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations.

jobs.title: Manager of Ops Excellence and Growth
jobs.description:
Manager of Operations Excellence and Growth

Department: Training
Reports to: Director of Ops Excellence

Position Overview

The Manager of Operations Excellence is responsible for driving operational consistency, supporting restaurant performance, and executing initiatives that strengthen the guest and team member experience across Naked Farmer. This role focuses on translating company standards into practical tools, training programs, and processes that help restaurant teams operate efficiently and consistently.

Working closely with Operations, Culinary, People, and Finance, this role supports new restaurant openings (NROs), field training, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and the implementation of operational initiatives across new and existing restaurants.

The Manager of Operations Excellence serves as a key connection between field operations and the support center, helping identify opportunities for improvement, develop scalable solutions, and ensure restaurant teams have the resources, training, and guidance needed to succeed.

As Naked Farmer continues to grow, this role will help strengthen the operational systems, training resources, and processes that support expansion while maintaining the quality, culture, and guest experience that define the brand.

Key Responsibilities

New Restaurant Openings (NROs)

• Support the planning and execution of operational readiness and training for all new restaurant openings.

• Coordinate NRO training agendas, schedules, and execution timelines in partnership with Operations and cross-functional teams.

• Organize and support NRO training teams, deployment plans, and on-site training activities.

• Partner with Operations, Culinary, People, and Finance to ensure restaurants are prepared for opening.

• Maintain and improve NRO playbooks, checklists, training materials, and operational tools.

• Support pre-opening preparation, opening week execution, and post-opening stabilization.

• Track opening readiness, identify gaps, and communicate opportunities for improvement to leadership.

• Support consistent opening standards across markets as the company expands.

Training & Development

• Execute and support scalable training programs for hourly team members and restaurant leaders.

• Develop and maintain onboarding materials, training guides, and operational learning resources.

• Support leadership development and skill-building initiatives in partnership with Operations and People.

• Ensure training materials reflect Naked Farmer's brand standards, operational expectations, food quality, and guest experience.

• Partner with field leaders to identify training gaps and implement targeted solutions.

• Evaluate training effectiveness through field observations, feedback, and performance metrics.

• Support the rollout of new menu items, systems, technologies, and operational procedures through effective training and communication.

Operational Excellence

• Support the execution of the Operations Excellence strategy across new and existing restaurants.

• Identify operational gaps and opportunities to improve consistency, productivity, accountability, and restaurant performance.

• Develop, document, and maintain SOPs, operational playbooks, checklists, and other restaurant resources.

• Partner with Operations leadership to support restaurant execution and reinforce brand standards.

• Coordinate the implementation of operational initiatives and process improvements across the restaurant portfolio.

• Collaborate with Operations Services and other support center teams to resolve operational challenges and improve restaurant support.

• Gather feedback from field teams to identify recurring challenges and recommend practical solutions.

• Monitor implementation progress and communicate results, risks, and opportunities to relevant stakeholders.

• Help ensure operational tools and processes remain current, accessible, and easy for restaurant teams to use.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Field Support

• Serve as a resource for restaurant leaders and field operations teams on operational standards, processes, and training.

• Build strong relationships with restaurant teams to understand challenges and support consistent execution.

• Communicate operational updates, process changes, and new initiatives clearly and effectively.

• Coordinate with cross-functional partners to ensure initiatives are implemented consistently and on schedule.

• Travel to restaurants to support training, operational assessments, new openings, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Share field insights and recommendations with leadership to strengthen operational effectiveness.

Qualifications

• 5+ years of restaurant or hospitality operations, training, or field leadership experience.

• Experience supporting restaurant openings, field training, operational initiatives, or multi-unit restaurant operations.

• Strong understanding of restaurant operations, food quality, service standards, and guest experience.

• Experience developing and maintaining SOPs, training materials, checklists, and operational tools.

• Proven ability to organize projects, manage timelines, and execute initiatives across multiple locations.

• Strong communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

• Ability to work cross-functionally with Operations, Culinary, People, Finance, and other support center teams.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, growing restaurant organization.

• Ability to travel approximately 50–70%, with additional travel as needed to support new restaurant openings and field priorities.

What Success Looks Like

• New restaurants are operationally prepared, trained, and positioned for a successful opening.

• NRO training and opening processes are consistent, organized, and repeatable across markets.

• Restaurant teams have access to clear, current SOPs and practical training resources.

• Operational initiatives are implemented consistently and effectively across new and existing restaurants.

• Field leaders feel supported and equipped to execute brand standards and deliver exceptional guest experiences.

• Training gaps and operational challenges are identified and addressed proactively.

• Processes become more efficient, repeatable, and scalable as Naked Farmer grows.

• Cross-functional communication improves alignment between restaurant teams and the support center.

What This Role Builds

As Naked Farmer continues to expand, the Manager of Operations Excellence will help build and maintain the training resources, operational playbooks, and systems that support consistent restaurant execution. Through strong field partnerships, effective implementation, and continuous improvement, this role will help ensure that growth does not come at the expense of food quality, team culture, or the guest experience.

ABOUT NAKED FARMER

Naked Farmer is built on a mission to build a better food system for all by connecting farmers to the community. We build seasonal recipes based on what’s growing in our region and know farmers on a first-name basis.

We were born in the global pandemic, pivoting the entire company to get fresh food from farm to door at a time when real food was flying off the shelves at the grocery store. Since then, we’ve built a culture of resilience and transparency through our open book management, profit-sharing plans, and dedication to telling the story behind the farmers who grow our local food supply.

Our mission is to build a better food system for everyone by becoming 100% locally sourced. We’re entering a period of expansion, opening in new cities and using the platform we’ve built to create more transparency around sourcing, cooking, and investing in regional food systems that support farmers, communities, and chefs.

We currently operate restaurants in Florida and North Carolina and are entering a period of rapid growth and expansion across multiple states.

And did we mention free Naked Farmer for all employees? We recommend the sweet potatoes.

Come build the future of food with us.

jobs.title: Executive Recruiter
jobs.description:
Built different

We believe there's a better way to build. One that moves faster, thinks bigger, and gives people the ownership to challenge what's been done before. We're not here to follow the standard. We're here to set a new one. We don't believe the best work happens inside rigid boxes. People are given real ownership, real responsibility, and the space to operate beyond a title. Scope grows with impact. Responsibility grows with trust. And the people who step up help shape what comes next. We're building an organization around ownership, not hierarchy, where your influence is defined by what you take on, not what's written on your email signature.

About the role

Are you passionate about executive search and crafting searches that land specialized talent? We’re looking for an Executive Recruiter to focus on one of our most critical growth functions. Your value starts before a hiring need ever reaches your desk.

This is not a queue of reqs to clear. You will map the market, build a talent network proactively and design each search strategy from the ground up.

You will be a trusted partner to leadership, translating business priorities into hiring plans and flagging market constraints early. We expect you to bring a point of view on how Hut 8 competes for niche talent across energy, power, and infrastructure, and to earn the credibility to be heard at the executive table.

What You'll Own

• Partner with leadership to turn business priorities into hiring plans, flag talent constraints early, and challenge assumptions on scope, timing, and compensation when the market says otherwise.

• Build and maintain a live network of specialized energy talent through strategic and proactive engagements, not only when a role is open.

• Run multiple niche searches at once, with the rigor, quality and urgency required. Find the people who don't apply, engage them, and lead them through every stage of the process to a successful close.

• Develop working knowledge of energy, power, and infrastructure markets deep enough to hold credible conversations with candidates and hiring managers about the work itself.

• Track and share talent availability, compensation benchmarks and competitor hiring activity to inform how Hut 8 positions itself.

• Own candidate experience end-to-end, ensuring an exceptional experience from first contact through offer.

What We're Looking For

You've recruited specialized talent and you understand the difference between posting a job and actually finding the people who don't apply. You've worked directly with senior stakeholders and know how to push back, not just execute. You're comfortable building from scratch in a company that moves fast.

• You have executive search experience recruiting specialized roles, at a search firm or in-house, and you can speak credibly about the market, not just source from it.

• You are a hunter. Ideally, you know where top energy talent lives, what motivates them, and how to engage them before they’re looking.

• Ideally, you are familiar with the energy and power industry, with real curiosity to go deeper.

• You communicate with precision regardless of audience, and you’ve advised senior leaders, pushed back on unrealistic requirements, and kept their trust.

• You thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and you’re energized by ambiguity rather than slowed by it.

Work setting

This role is based onsite five days a week at our corporate headquarters in the Brickell area of Miami, Florida. Candidates must be Miami-based or willing to relocate. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
About ShiftKey

ShiftKey is a platform that is disrupting the way healthcare facilities find licensed and certified professionals to fill available shifts. Leveraging marketplace dynamics and deep industry knowledge, the company is playing a vital role in mitigating America’s healthcare staffing shortages, enabling direct connections between facilities and healthcare professionals. By offering the opportunity to work as much or as little as they choose and putting the power back into the hands of healthcare workers, ShiftKey is bringing more licensed professionals back into the workforce, a solution that is solving a major crisis in healthcare. For more information, visit www.ShiftKey.com http://www.ShiftKey.com.



The role

We’re a healthcare technology company running two products: a SaaS platform and a two-sided marketplace platform, both operating under strict regulatory requirements. This role focuses on the SaaS side, the product our customers rely on to run their day. When it’s down, they feel it. You’d own its reliability: keeping it available, keeping the infrastructure underneath it stable and secure, and building the guardrails that let other engineering teams ship without breaking things.

This is a senior seat on a small team, and the team is still being built out. You won’t be handed a finished reliability practice or a long runbook. You’ll make real calls, and some of them will be ambiguous. In return you get a lot of autonomy, a lot of influence over how we do things, and a chance to leave a visible mark on a regulated platform that matters.

Where you’ll work

This is a fully remote position based in the United States. You should be comfortable working asynchronously and partnering with teammates in different time zones.

 

What you’ll be doing

 - Owning reliability, availability and incident response for our SaaS platform, from detection through postmortem.

 - Maintaining and extending our cloud infrastructure across AWS and Azure, managed as code.

 - Running and improving our Kubernetes-based production environment.

 - Writing production automation. Scripting is a daily part of this job.

 - Working closely with software engineering teams so that deploying safely is the easy path, and becoming the person they trust on infrastructure risk.

 - Mentoring teammates toward independence and helping shape how the reliability function grows.
   
    

What you’ll need

 - 5+ years running production infrastructure on AWS and Azure at real scale, ideally for a SaaS product.

 - Production Kubernetes and Terraform experience, with real incidents behind you, not only deployments.

 - Hands-on incident ownership: you can walk us through one you handled from detection to postmortem.

 - Strong automation skills, ideally in Python and Bash, plus experience with observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana or CloudWatch.

 - Comfort making and defending judgment calls without a manager in the room, and experience mentoring other engineers.

 - Comfort in a mixed-language environment, and a habit of using AI tools in your daily work.
   
    

Perks of working for ShiftKey

 - Inclusive and collaborative work environment where all voices are valued.

 - Hybrid-friendly office spaces designed to be fun and engaging.

 - Comprehensive health, vision, and dental coverage.

 - Benefits begin on your first day.

 - Generous PTO and company-paid holidays, including flexible floating holidays.

 - 100% 401(k) employer match up to 6%.

 - Paid parental leave.

 - Wellness support, including access to mental health resources.

#LI-Remote



Our Commitment to Diversity

ShiftKey is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to embracing diverse and individual perspectives shaping our culture and contributing to the solutions that transform the world. We actively work to create an inclusive environment for employees to thrive. 



EEO Statement

ShiftKey does not discriminate based on race, religion, color, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable law. All employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.  ShiftKey is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with a mental or physical disability, please contact: accommodations@shiftkey.com

jobs.title: Director, Cabinet Alumni Leadership & Engagement - JFNA
jobs.description:
Director, Cabinet Alumni Leadership & Engagement

DEPARTMENT:  Lay Leadership Development

REPORTS TO:  Associate Vice President, National Young Leadership Cabinet

LOCATION:  New York, NY (currently hybrid) strongly preferred

STATUS:  Full time, exempt

About JFNA

The Jewish Federations of North America (“JFNA”) represents 141 Jewish Federations and over 300 Network Communities, which raise and distribute more than $3 billion annually for social, humanitarian, and educational needs. The Federation movement, collectively among the top 10 charities in North America, protects and enhances the well-being of Jews worldwide through meaningful contributions to community, Israel, and civil society. JFNA’s mission is to build flourishing Jewish communities around the world.

Department Overview

JFNA’s Lay Leadership Development department builds the pipeline of volunteer leaders who guide Jewish Federations and the broader Jewish community. Working across JFNA and the Federation system, the department helps communities develop prepared, connected, confident leaders while strengthening governance, lay/professional partnership, and leadership continuity.

This position sits within the Cabinet and Cabinet Alumni portfolio within the Lay Leadership Department.

About National Young Leadership Cabinet and Cabinet Alumni

National Young Leadership Cabinet is JFNA’s flagship investment in Jewish volunteer leadership development, with more than 500 active members and 4,300 alumni. Its alumni chair Federation campaigns, serve on national boards, and lead across business, government, philanthropy, and civic life. JFNA is now building the structures to turn this powerful network into a lifelong leadership movement—connected to one another, their local Federations, and the broader Jewish community.

Position Summary

The Director will lead implementation of JFNA’s Cabinet Alumni Strategy, building the structures and partnerships that turn Cabinet participation into lifelong leadership across the Federation system and beyond. Working with national lay leaders, local Federation professionals, and JFNA colleagues, the Director will establish an alumni leadership structure, strengthen recruitment and transition practices, track alumni engagement and progression, connect alumni to meaningful leadership roles, and design compelling gatherings and immersive experiences.

This is a leadership development and engagement role—not a fundraising position—and carries no solicitation portfolio or revenue target. The ideal candidate is both a relationship-builder and a builder of systems to support leadership planning and continuity. They will be someone who can earn the trust of accomplished volunteer leaders, create buy-in across a complex network, and translate long-term vision into measurable progress.

Primary Job Responsibilities

Alumni Volunteer Leadership Structure (20%)

• Establish a Cabinet Alumni Leadership Group with the National Cabinet Alumni Co-Chairs, defining portfolio roles, onboarding members, and setting annual work plans and accountability measures.

• Partner with the Alumni Co-Chairs to set, monitor, and report on key performance indicators, and develop alumni volunteer leaders, so the network is increasingly alumni-led.

Federation Partnership, Recruitment, and Leadership Pathways (35%)

• Build sustained relationships with local Federation professionals and develop best practices spanning Cabinet recruitment, nomination, onboarding, transition, and alumni engagement.

• Advise JFNA colleagues and Federations on identifying candidates with long-term leadership potential and addressing gaps across communities and leadership profiles.

• Equip Federations to connect Cabinet members and alumni to meaningful local and national leadership pathways.

Leadership Continuity, Tracking, and Placement (25%)

• Work with JFNA’s Data and Growth team to track alumni engagement, placements, and progression across 141 Federations and JFNA, and apply the learnings.

• Cultivate key alumni to identify candidates for board, committee, task force, and chair roles across JFNA, Federations, and the Jewish community.

• Create a mentorship pathway linking Cabinet alumni with senior leaders and other JFNA leadership cohorts.

Alumni Engagement, Immersive Experiences, and Representation (20%)

• Design an annual alumni engagement portfolio of gatherings, affinity groups, briefings, and immersive experience, including missions to and beyond Israel.

• Integrate alumni into the General Assembly, International Lion of Judah Conference, advocacy fly-ins, and select missions, owning participation targets.

• Ensure departing Cabinet members leave with a named local contact and defined next step, coordinating with Changemakers, National Women’s Philanthropy, Atid, and other cohorts.

• Represent Cabinet Alumni at JFNA and Federation forums, present strategy and outcomes to senior audiences, and contribute to planning, budgeting, and evaluation.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree required; master’s degree preferred. Progressively responsible professional experience in volunteer leadership, governance, alumni or constituent networks, or leadership development, within or outside the Jewish communal field.

• Genuine enthusiasm for Jewish lay leadership development and for building the leadership pipelines on which Federations depend.

• Confidence driving change through sustained engagement and navigating competing priorities.

• High emotional intelligence, discretion, and sound judgment, with the ability to navigate complex relationships and offer candid feedback constructively.

• Demonstrated record of building trusted, strong partnerships with highly experienced volunteers and senior leaders.

• Experience growing new programs, networks, or initiatives, and establishing new infrastructure.

• Able to hold a long-term vision while building momentum, accountability, and measurable progress along the way.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present to senior lay and professional audiences.

• Highly organized and detail-oriented; a strategic thinker , comfortable with a collaborating team and owning independent responsibilities.

• Knowledge of the Jewish communal landscape and the Federation system preferred.

• Willingness and ability to travel and to staff key events, including international.

Compensation and Benefits

Salary - $110,000 -$130,000 (Commensurate with experience)

Strong preference for this position is based in the New York metropolitan area and works a hybrid schedule from JFNA’s New York office.

Benefits - JFNA offers a comprehensive benefits package (medical, dental, vision, FSA), including a defined contribution plan, generous vacation policy, paid legal and Jewish holidays, life insurance, and generous parental leave policies. Our compensation philosophy strives to be externally competitive and internally fair. Additionally, we offer voluntary learning programs throughout the year in subjects of interest to our staff.

JFNA is committed to supporting local Jewish Federations and to identifying the best talent for the system. If a current Federation employee is hired, we will work with their Federation on an appropriate timeline and communications strategy. We welcome confidential inquiries; current Federation employees who reach a final round will be asked to inform their Federations of their candidacy.

The Jewish Federations of North America is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics
