Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

Overview

Scout Studios is looking for a Producer to help turn ambitious creative ideas into organized, executable productions.

As an integral function on the Scout Studios team, this role will serve as a critical bridge between creative ambition and production execution, bringing structure, foresight, communication, and accountability to a growing pipeline of original storytelling, product and lifestyle content, and films.

The right person is equal parts organizer, problem solver, collaborator, and producer. You understand creative vision, how the work gets made, can anticipate what a production needs before it becomes a problem, and can confidently move between creative teams, internal stakeholders, agencies, vendors, talent, locations, and crews.

This isn't simply a coordination role. We’re looking for someone who has both a creative and organizational eye and can take ownership of productions to allow Scout Studios to operate at a high creative and operational level as the team's output continues to grow.

Why Scout Studios

Scout Studios is building more than a content team.

We’re creating an internal storytelling studio designed to document the return of an iconic American brand, from the people designing and building our vehicles to the communities, places, and culture surrounding them.

You'll help build the production engine behind that work and shape how Scout Studios operates for years to come.

What you’ll do

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

• Produce Scout Studios projects from initial brief through production, post-production, and final delivery.

• Partner closely with the creative team of directors, cinematographers, editors, and content creators to translate creative concepts into executable production plans.

• Build and manage production schedules, timelines, call sheets, budgets, crew plans, equipment needs, travel, locations, permitting, talent, releases, insurance, and logistics.

• Coordinate internal stakeholders, external production partners, agencies, freelancers, vendors, and talent.

• Own production communication and ensure teams understand deliverables, deadlines, responsibilities, and changing priorities.

• Identify potential production challenges early and proactively develop solutions.

• Manage multiple productions and workstreams simultaneously without losing sight of details.

• Support location scouting, casting, vehicle coordination, travel planning, and field-production logistics.

• Track project budgets, purchase orders, invoices, vendor agreements, and production expenses.

• Help maintain visibility into the overall Scout Studios production pipeline and resource requirements.

• Partner with post-production teams to ensure assets, schedules, feedback, and deliverables move cleanly from production through completion.

• Help establish scalable production processes, templates, workflows, and standards as Scout Studios grows.

• Build trusted relationships across Brand, Communications, Social, CRM, Events, Product, Design, and other internal teams.

• Be comfortable jumping into the unexpected. Production rarely goes exactly according to plan, and solving those moments is part of the job.

Location & Travel Expectations:

• This role will be based out of the Scout Motors corporate headquarters in Charlotte, NC.

• This role requires 4-5 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events.

• This role will involve regular travel to productions, events, locations, and Scout facilities. Candidates should be comfortable working in active production environments, including outdoor locations and occasionally weekends, and long days.

• This role will be embedded in the ongoing development of the Scout Motors company, brand, and vehicles. As such, travel will be a meaningful and necessary part of this role, with expected travel expected to average 30%.

• Scout vehicles are being developed for rugged adventure, worksite use, daily-living, and everything in-between, and candidates for this role should expect that travel will take them to a variety of climates and environments, including potentially harsher cold-weather, hot-weather, mountainous, and remote locations.

• Candidates for this position should carry an active drivers’ license, and be comfortable driving on urban, highway, and country roads, gravel roads, and some light off-road trails when needed.

What you’ll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

• 8+ years of experience in production, creative production, integrated production, or related field.

• Experience producing commercial, branded, documentary, automotive, lifestyle, editorial, or entertainment content.

• Strong understanding of production workflows from pre-production through post-production.

• Demonstrated experience managing budgets, schedules, vendors, crews, travel, locations, and deliverables.

• Exceptional organizational and project management skills.

• Strong written and verbal communication.

• Ability to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines.

• Confidence working directly with senior creative leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.

• A collaborative mindset and willingness to jump in wherever needed.

• Strong judgment and the ability to make decisions quickly in changing production environments.

• Minimum of High School Diploma, GED or equivalent required for all roles at Scout Motors, Inc.

Preferred / Bonus Qualifications

• Automotive or mobility experience.

• Experience producing documentary or unscripted storytelling.

• Experience with experiential, events, or live production.

• Familiarity with automotive shoots involving picture vehicles, tracking vehicles, specialty rigs, and remote locations.

• Experience helping build or scale an internal creative studio.

• Existing relationships with production companies, crews, vendors, and freelance talent.

Who You Are

You’re someone who has an eye for how to bring creative visions to life through planning and organization.

You enjoy being the person who knows what needs to happen next, who owns the details others may overlook, and who can keep a team moving even when priorities shift quickly.

You communicate clearly, stay calm under pressure, and understand that great production isn't simply logistics, it creates the environment in which great creative work can happen.

You’re equally comfortable planning months ahead and solving a problem from the side of the road during a shoot.

What you'll gain

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up.  This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation.  In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights:

• Competitive insurance including: Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans

• 401(k) program with: An employer match and immediate vesting

• Generous Paid Time Off including: 20 days planned PTO, as accrued 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave

Pay Transparency

This is a full-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent.

Initial base salary range = $85,000.00 - $105,000.00

Internal leveling code: IC9

Notice to applicants:

• To be considered for career opportunities at Scout Motors, applicants must be 18 years of age or older.

• Residing in San Francisco: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

• Residing in Los Angeles: Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.

• Residing in New York City: This role is not eligible for remote work in New York City.

Equal Opportunity

Scout Motors is committed to employing a diverse workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected by law. Scout Motors is committed to compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact ScoutAccommodations@scoutmotors.com.

jobs.title: Chief People Officer
jobs.description:
AccuWeather is seeking its first dedicated Chief People Officer to serve as a senior executive partner to CEO and the broader leadership team. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role created to elevate AccuWeather’s HR function from capable execution to genuine strategic leadership. The CPO will inherit a small but functional HR team and will be expected to build the infrastructure, programs, and culture strategy that will define AccuWeather’s workforce for its next chapter. Given the pace of organizational change anticipated over the next 12–18 months — including AI-driven restructuring, evolving skill requirements, and significant workforce transitions — the CPO will play a pivotal role in shaping how AccuWeather communicates, grows, and evolves as an employer.

The position is located on-site at AccuWeather's Headquarters in State College, PA

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Serve as a strategic advisor to the CEO and executive leadership team on all aspects of human capital strategy, organizational effectiveness, leadership development, and workforce planning.

• Develop and execute an enterprise-wide people strategy that aligns with AccuWeather's business objectives, technology investments, and long-term growth plans.

• Lead organizational design, change management, and workforce transformation initiatives that position the company to successfully navigate evolving business priorities and emerging technologies.

• Design and implement scalable people programs and organizational frameworks across talent acquisition, total rewards, employee relations, learning and development, organizational design, and performance management.

• Champion and strengthen AccuWeather's culture of innovation, accountability, transparency, and continuous learning while fostering employee engagement and organizational effectiveness. Partner with executive and functional leaders to anticipate future talent needs, assess organizational capabilities, and develop workforce strategies that support business objectives.

• Build, mentor, and develop the HR organization, strengthening its capabilities and positioning the function as a trusted strategic partner across the enterprise

• Serve as a visible, approachable leader across the organization, building trust and credibility with employees, managers, and senior leadership while representing the people function with confidence before the executive team and Board of Directors.

QUALIFICATIONS

Ideal Candidate Profile is a senior HR executive who combines strategic vision with hands-on execution capability. The right candidate will be energized — not deterred — by an environment that is rapidly evolving, technically demanding, and operationally intense.

• 10+ years of progressive HR leadership, with at least 3–5 years in a CHRO, CPO, or equivalent executive role

• Proven track record building HR functions within technology, science, data, or engineering-led organizations

• Deep expertise in organizational design, change management, and workforce transformation

• Exceptional executive presence and communication skills — able to engage confidently at the board level, in all-hands settings, and one-on-one with employees

• Technically curious and AI-literate; ability to model the mindset AccuWeather expects of all its leaders

• A genuine business partner orientation — someone who understands the business deeply, not just HR process

• Comfort and experience in 24/7 or operationally complex environments

• Strong stakeholder management skills; ability to build trust and alignment across diverse leadership styles

• Self-starter with high initiative — someone who sees the gap and builds toward it without being directed

ABOUT ACCUWEATHER

AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making. Billions of people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™ across our consumer digital platforms. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to tens of millions of smartphones. AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 225 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Samsung, Vizio, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, LG, and Amazon Freevee. AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.

ABOUT DR. MYERS

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chairman, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers is a visionary entrepreneur and has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times. He has been recognized in Entrepreneur Magazine’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs as one of the greatest entrepreneurs in American history. Myers received the American Meteorological Society’s 2018 Award for Outstanding Contributions to the Advancement of Applied Meteorology and the National Weather Association’s 2017 Lifetime Achievement Award, in addition to numerous other accolades. Most recently, on September 29, 2026, Dr. Myers was inducted into the Broadcasting & Cable Hall of Fame.

COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY & INCLUSION

AccuWeather is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity to all applicants and existing employees and we evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity/expression), sexual orientation, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability, marital status, political affiliation, religion, citizenship status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

AccuWeather is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process, please send an e-mail to human.resources@accuweather.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

jobs.title: Vice President, Learning & Development
jobs.description:
POWER A WORLD OF TRUST

Incode is the leading provider of world-class identity solutions that is reinventing the way humans authenticate and verify their identities online to power a world of digital trust.

Through our revolutionary identity solutions, we are unleashing the business potential of universal industries including finance, government, retail, hospitality, gaming, and more, by reducing fraud and transforming human interactions with data, products, and services.

We’re in the process of rapidly scaling our diverse global team and we’re looking for entrepreneurial individuals and leaders who are curious, driven, and excited by ownership to join a Unicorn-status scale-up!

About Incode

Incode is a Series B unicorn ($2 B valuation) rewriting how the world proves identity. Our AI-powered platform lets leading banks, fintechs, marketplaces, and governments deliver friction-free experiences while defeating fraud and safeguarding privacy. Customers such as Citi, AirBnB, Block, Chime, Sixt, and TikTok rely on Incode to power their identity verification and security. Recently named a leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Identity Verification, we’re scaling fast.

The Impact You’ll Make

This is not a conventional L&D leadership role. As Vice President of Learning & Development you will sit at the intersection of strategy, culture and execution, partnering directly with our CEO and leadership team to build the human capabilities that keep Incode at the front of the identity and fraud-intelligence industry.

You will own all learning and performance development across the company: onboarding, manager and leadership development, career frameworks and the performance cycle, and company-wide AI fluency. Today these programs are run piecemeal by People Partners and regional partners and tracked in our LMS. You will bring them under one strategy, build what is missing from the ground up, and make Incode a place where people visibly grow. You will be both the architect and a hands-on builder: designing programs, facilitating rooms, challenging the status quo, and using AI to turn this function into a genuine advantage for Incode.

What You’ll Own & Drive

• L&D Strategy & Vision — Design and lead a global learning strategy aligned with Incode’s growth ambitions, business priorities and high-performance culture, and iterate on it with data and executive input.

• Executive & Leadership Partnership — Work directly with the CEO, executive team and senior leaders to identify capability gaps, co-create development strategies and make sure every program delivers measurable organizational impact. This is a seat-at-the-table role.

• Performance & Career Development — Own the design and execution of Incode’s performance cycle (goal setting, reviews, calibration and manager enablement) with People Partners and Total Rewards so that performance drives pay and promotion. Build career-progression frameworks that reinforce a merit-based culture.

• Onboarding — Create a culturally immersive onboarding journey that makes every new Incoder feel the energy, ambition and values of Incode from day one and accelerates time-to-impact, with role-specific paths for go-to-market, engineering and customer teams.

• Leadership & Manager Development — Take over and scale our manager-training program and build leadership development from first-time managers to senior leaders. Launch mentoring and coaching at scale.

• AI Adoption Champion — Be Incode’s leading voice on AI literacy and adoption. Design and deliver company-wide programs that give every Incoder the skills, mindset and methods to make AI a core part of how they work, and measure adoption.

• Content & Tailored Learning — Create high-quality, engaging learning for diverse audiences and partner with leaders and People Partners on team-specific needs, including equity and compensation education with Total Rewards and required training with Legal and People Operations.

• Culture & Internal Communication — Weave Incode’s values and identity into every program, and partner on internal communications and engagement so that every learning experience feels unmistakably Incode.

• Global Execution — Deliver with consistency, quality and local relevance across the US, Mexico, Serbia and the rest of EMEA, working with Centers of Excellence, People Partners and regional partners, in local languages where it matters.

• Systems & Measurement — Own the LMS and learning data. Define and report the metrics that matter: adoption, time-to-productivity, manager effectiveness, internal mobility and performance distribution.

The Qualities That Set You Apart

• A builder’s mindset — You want to build from the ground up again, and you are comfortable with ambiguity and a lean budget.

• Executive presence — You earn credibility and trust with performance-driven executives, including the CEO.

• Architect and facilitator — You can run the room and build the material, from executive offsites to leadership programs and manager curricula.

• AI-first practice — You have built AI-fluency or AI-adoption programs, or have a strong personal AI practice you can teach.

• Global and culturally fluent — You work across regions and cultures with ease. Spanish is a strong advantage; Mexico is our largest hub outside the US.

Your Background

• 12+ years in learning, talent or leadership development, including 5+ years leading the function.

• Led people development through hyper growth (scaling a company from hundreds to thousands of employees) and at scale inside a large, mature organization.

• Owned performance-management design and execution, not only training delivery.

• Hands-on experience designing and facilitating executive offsites, leadership programs and manager curricula.

• Experience building AI-fluency or AI-adoption programs, or a strong personal AI practice you can teach.

• Global experience across regions and cultures; Spanish is a strong advantage.

• Based in the United States, with ability for regular travel to Mexico City and Belgrade.

Why Incode?

• Mission with Meaning — Shape how billions of people prove identity—safely, simply, and ethically.

• Rocket-Ship Growth — Join at an inflection point where your strategies will compound in value for years.

• Elite Team & Backing — Work a truly global with top engineers, designers, and investors who share your ambition to dominate a category.

• Ownership & Autonomy — Operate like a founder with the resources of a unicorn.

• Global Impact — Every program you launch will reverberate across industries and continents.

Ready to ignite the future of trust?

Lead the narrative. Empower the field. Join Incode and turn innovation into unstoppable market momentum.

Aspects of our Culture:

• High performance

• Freedom & responsibility

• Context, not control

• Highly aligned, loosely coupled

• Continuous Feedback

• Promotions & Development

• Learn more about Life at Incode!

Benefits & Perks:

• Flexible Working Hours & Workplace

• Open Vacation Policy

Equal Opportunities:

Incode is an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment. We take great pride in having an inclusive, diverse, and global team, and we are always looking for talented and passionate individuals from all backgrounds and walks of life. As part of our commitment to inclusion, we ensure that reasonable accommodations are available throughout the hiring process. If you require any accommodation due to a disability or specific need, please let our Talent Acquisition team know—we’ll do our best to support you.

Applicant Data Privacy:

We will only use your personal information concerning Incode’s application, recruitment, and hiring processes.

jobs.title: Lead Licensed Veterinary Technician
jobs.description:
Who is VetEvolve?

VetEvolve is a network of veterinary practices built to support the people delivering care and the practices they lead. We combine clinical insight with operational strength to give our teams the support, tools, and structure they need to thrive, without losing what makes each practice unique. We are intentionally focused on growth, not as an end in itself, but as a way to strengthen our practices, expand access to care, and create more opportunities for our teams.

Guided by our values: Care First. Better Together. Grow Forward. Own It. We create an environment where veterinary professionals can do their best work, build meaningful careers, and deliver exceptional care. Growth with intention. Care without compromise.

Lead Licensed Veterinary Technician | Colonial Gateway Veterinary Center | Boynton Beach, Florida

Compensation: $26–$29/hour, commensurate with licensure and experience

Position Summary:

The Lead Licensed Veterinary Technician plays a key leadership role in supporting veterinarians and the medical support team to ensure the delivery of high-quality, compassionate patient care. This position provides advanced technical expertise while also mentoring and developing team members, ensuring consistency in medical standards, safety protocols, and operational efficiency.

Primary Responsibilities:

• Provide coaching, mentorship, and training to veterinary technicians and assistants to promote skill growth, efficiency, and engagement.

• Assist with hiring, onboarding, training, and mentoring new team members.

• Partner with leadership to schedule staff appropriately based on case load and skills.

• Serve as a clinical resource and role model for best practices in patient care, anesthesia monitoring, and client communication.

• Assist veterinarians during examinations, treatments, and surgical procedures, ensuring proper restraint, preparation, and patient monitoring.

• Perform advanced technical procedures including venipuncture, intubation, anesthesia induction and monitoring, dental prophylaxis, and laboratory diagnostics.

• Administer medications, vaccines, and treatments as prescribed by the veterinarian, following all DEA and OSHA regulations.

• Operate and maintain diagnostic equipment such as radiology and ultrasound systems, adhering to safety and quality control protocols.

• Support accurate and thorough medical recordkeeping, charge capture, and client education documentation.

• Partner with the Practice Manager to oversee inventory control, ordering, and vendor relations.

• Monitor equipment maintenance and ensure readiness for medical and surgical use.

• Identify workflow improvement opportunities to enhance efficiency and client experience.

• Assist with implementing hospital policies and procedures to maintain compliance and quality standards.

• Lead by example in maintaining a clean, organized, and safe hospital environment.

• Provide compassionate and professional client education regarding treatment plans, preventative care, medications, and products.

• Model effective communication and problem-solving when handling client questions or concerns.

• Foster trust and collaboration among clients, doctors, and the care team to ensure continuity of care.

• Participate in staff meetings, hospital initiatives, and continuing education opportunities.

• Promote a positive, collaborative, and inclusive culture aligned with hospital and VetEvolve values.

• Perform other duties as assigned to support hospital operations and patient care.

Qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalent required.

• Licensed/Certified/Registered Veterinary Technician credential required.

• Minimum of 3 years of clinical veterinary experience.

• Prior leadership or mentorship experience preferred.

• Demonstrated proficiency in anesthesia monitoring, dentistry, laboratory procedures, and radiology.

• Basic computer literacy and ability to use practice management software and Microsoft Office applications.

• Excellent communication, organization, and interpersonal skills.

• Demonstrated ability to lead, train, and motivate team members while maintaining professionalism and accountability.

• Able to multitask in a fast-paced setting while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.

• Compassionate and committed to delivering exceptional patient care and client service.

• Comfortable working with exposure to cleaning chemicals, anesthetic gases, radiation, zoonotic diseases, and animal bodily fluids.

• Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds and safely handle animals up to 150 pounds.

• Comfortable sitting, standing, walking, bending, and kneeling for extended periods throughout the workday.

• Professional, neat appearance consistent with hospital standards.

Hours:

• Must be able to work a flexible schedule and be available for scheduling during all hours the practice is open to support hospital operations

Compensation and Benefits:

• We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage. In addition, employees are eligible to participate in our 401(k) retirement plan. Other benefits include paid time off, paid holidays and access to employee assistance program.

Ready to Learn More?

We look forward to learning about your unique priorities and goals and working together with our local hospital teams to support you.

jobs.title: Events and Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
🌐 WHO WE ARE

Bankjoy is a Y Combinator and Bessemer Venture Partner backed FinTech startup. We are changing the way community banks and credit unions do business, enabling them to become tech-driven and digital first. Bankjoy provides modern digital banking products including mobile banking, online banking, online account opening, loan origination, and conversational AI. Our mission is to revolutionize banking tech infrastructure by leading digital transformation at financial institutions — big and small.



💼 The Role

We're looking for an experienced, highly organized Event and Marketing Manager to own Bankjoy's event program and help keep a busy marketing calendar running smoothly. You'll lead the strategy, planning, and execution of our annual client conference, Elevate, along with regional networking events, trade shows, industry conferences, league events, and executive dinners. You'll also be a hands-on partner across webinars, social media, and content.

This role is ideal for someone with a strong background in corporate event planning, vendor management, budgeting, and stakeholder collaboration, who thrives on details, takes ownership from start to finish, and knows how to tie every event back to business results. If you know the credit union or fintech world, even better.




🧠 WHAT YOU'LL DO

Event strategy and execution 

 - Develop event strategies aligned with business goals to maximize brand impact, client engagement, and pipeline

 - Lead the planning and execution of Elevate, our annual client conference, alongside the Head of Marketing and our event consultant: venue and hotel contracts, vendors, AV, agenda logistics, attendee communications, sponsors, and on-site management

 - Plan, organize, and execute regional networking events, trade shows, and our calendar of 15 to 20 industry events a year, including core user conferences, state credit union league conventions, and national industry shows

 - Plan small executive dinners and client gatherings in priority markets

 - Manage event timelines across multiple events at once

 - Work with sales to set meeting goals, book meetings, and follow up with leads after every event

Logistics and vendor management

 - Secure venues, catering, audiovisual, and other event-related services

 - Negotiate and manage vendor contracts, and oversee vendor performance to ensure high-quality execution

 - Coordinate booths, sponsorships, shipping, swag, travel, and staffing for each event

Budget and ROI tracking

 - Develop and manage event budgets, track expenditures, and optimize cost efficiency

 - Measure results for every event, including leads, meetings, pipeline created, and attendee satisfaction

 - Analyze post-event feedback and ROI metrics, and recommend improvements for future events

On-site event management

 - Ensure smooth event execution, including logistics, troubleshooting, and coordinating on-site staff

 - Serve as the primary point of contact for internal teams, vendors, and attendees

Marketing and attendee engagement

 - Work closely with the marketing team to promote events through email, social media, and other channels

 - Develop creative strategies to increase attendee engagement and event participation

 - Coordinate prospect and client webinars, including those co-hosted with core and league partners, and manage speakers, run-of-show, registration pages, promotion, and follow-up sequences

Social media and content

 - Create and schedule posts for Bankjoy's LinkedIn and other channels, especially around events

 - Help executives and staff share event and thought leadership content from their personal accounts

 - Support blog posts, event recaps, case studies, and email campaigns

 - Track and report on social engagement and event results

Marketing operations

 - Keep the marketing calendar, project timelines, and budgets organized and up to date

 - Manage event and campaign lists, invitations in HubSpot

 - Coordinate with designers, agencies, and vendors to keep projects on schedule
   
   


🎯 WHAT YOU BRING

 - Bachelor's degree in Event Management, Hospitality, Marketing, or a related field

 - 5 years of experience in corporate event planning, conference management, or event marketing, ideally in B2B

 - A track record of leading events from strategy through execution, including large multi-day conferences

 - Strong vendor negotiation and contract management skills

 - Experience developing and managing event budgets and reporting on ROI

 - The ability to manage multiple events at once with exceptional attention to detail and follow-through

 - Experience with event management and marketing software, such as Cvent, Eventbrite, HubSpot, Asana, or Trello, plus webinar platforms

 - Excellent written and verbal communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills

 - A positive, roll-up-your-sleeves attitude and the ability to work independently

 - Flexibility to travel and manage evening and weekend events as needed
   

Salary Range

$85,000 to $100,000 CAD




🎁 WHAT YOU GET

 - A fast-paced and collaborative environment 

 - Competitive compensation

 - Stock options at a well-funded startup

 - We cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for individuals on our base plan, with significant contributions toward all other plan options (USA). 

 - We cover 100% of extended medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your family under our single, comprehensive plan (Canada).

 - Retirement plan with 4% company matching 

 - 8 weeks paid parental leave for birthing parents, 4 weeks for non-birthing

 - 3-5 weeks PTO depending on tenure

 - 5 health days

 - 15 holidays

 - End of year shutdown

 - Performance-based bonuses 

 - Remote first culture
   
    


⚖️ EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITIES AT BANKJOY

Bankjoy is committed to hiring talented and qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds for all of its tech, non-tech, and leadership roles. Bankjoy provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability.

jobs.title: Lead, Sustainability & Stewardships Programs
jobs.description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

Overview

The Lead, Sustainability & Stewardship Programs will drive the execution of key initiatives that align with Scout Motors’ sustainability and corporate responsibility goals. This role will be instrumental in supporting business units to translate sustainability strategies—including topics such as, but not limited to, circular economy, carbon reduction, biodiversity, and sustainable materials —into actionable programs. The successful candidate will ensure measurable environmental and social impact, alignment with organizational values, compliance with regulatory requirements, and adherence to voluntary commitments.  This role emphasizes program management, strategic alignment, stakeholder engagement, risk management, measurement, and reporting.

What you’ll do

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

Program Management

• Coordinate the cross-functional development and execution of sustainability and corporate responsibility programs, ensuring alignment and integration for robust sustainable business practices.

• Develop and manage project plans, timelines, and milestones across focus areas.

• Coordinate with internal teams to ensure consistent implementation of strategies.

Strategic Alignment

• Collaborate with leadership to ensure alignment between program execution and the company’s overarching business strategy.

• Identify opportunities for program integration with departmental planning and processes to enhance efficiency and impact.

• Partner effectively across teams, functions, and levels to drive alignment and shared ownership.

Stakeholder Engagement

• Engage with internal departments to gather insights, align goals, and ensure programmatic success.

• Align with external stakeholders, including industry groups, suppliers, and community partners, to support broader stewardship efforts.

Measurement & Reporting

• Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs).

• Support data collection, analysis, and reporting to monitor progress toward program goals.

• Contribute to transparent reporting for internal stakeholders, customers, and the public.

Risk Mitigation

• Identify and mitigate potential risks to project timelines, dependencies, and program deliverables, ensuring robust planning to avoid delays and bottlenecks.

• Ensure adherence to compliance requirements, regulations, voluntary commitments, and evolving industry standards.

Process Optimization

• Continuously review the implementation processes to identify opportunities for improvement, enhance efficiency, scalability, and long-term value.

• Ability to own end to end processes and drive initiatives to completion.

Training and Advocacy

• Assist in creating communication materials to raise awareness of program goals and outcomes.

• Develop and deliver training programs to ensure broad engagement and understanding of stewardship initiatives.

Other tasks or projects as directed by the Director, Sustainability and Stewardship.

Location & Travel Expectations:

• This role will be based out of the Scout Motors corporate headquarters in Charlotte, NC.

• This role requires 4-5 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events.

• Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.

What you’ll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

• Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Business Administration, Public Policy, or a related field. Advanced degree in a relevant discipline preferred.

• 12+ years of relevant experience with at least 5 years of experience in program management, corporate responsibility, or sustainability-focused roles.

jobs.title: Junior Campaign Manager
jobs.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for.

Job Description:

The New York Times' Advertising team is looking for a Junior Campaign Manager to join our Campaign Management team. You will support the daily operations of the Ad Ops department and the execution and optimization of digital advertising campaigns across several platforms.
This is a hybrid role based in our New York headquarters, reporting to the Senior Manager, Ad Operation. You can typically expect to be in the office 3 days per week.

About the Role:

Working with Campaign Managers, you will ensure the success of campaigns by maintaining quality, accuracy, and customer service. The Junior Campaign Manager role offers an excellent opportunity for individuals interested in developing a career in digital advertising.

Responsibilities:

• Support the setup and launch of digital advertising campaigns across multiple platforms, including desktop, mobile, video, audio and newsletters.

• Ensure accurate implementation of campaign elements such as ad creatives, targeting parameters, and tracking tags.

• Monitor campaign performance metrics on a daily basis to identify trends, anomalies, and areas for optimization.

• Collaborate with team members to implement optimization strategies to improve campaign performance and achieve client goals.

• Create wrap reports detailing campaign performance metrics, including impressions, clicks, interactions, and other measurements.

• Conduct data analysis to obtain insights and make data-driven recommendations for campaign optimization.

• Help communicate with clients to provide campaign updates and address inquiries.

• Collaborate with the sales and client success teams to ensure client satisfaction and retention.

• Provide support for ad operations tasks, including billing, ad trafficking, troubleshooting technical issues, and resolving discrepancies.

• Help maintain documentation and standard operating procedures related to campaign management processes.

• Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business, or related field.

• Experience with the ability to interpret data and draw applicable insights.

• Experience with complex, multi-faceted and multi-discipline projects including varying partners within an organization

• Experience with diverse ways of working

REQ-020801

$60,000—$70,000 USD

jobs.title: Director, Tax
jobs.description:
Zenas is a clinical-stage global biopharmaceutical company committed to becoming a leader in the development and commercialization of transformative therapies for patients with autoimmune diseases. Our core business strategy combines our experienced leadership team with a disciplined product candidate acquisition approach to identify, acquire and develop product candidates globally that we believe can provide superior clinical benefits to patients living with autoimmune diseases. Zenas is advancing two late-stage, potential franchise molecules, obexelimab and orelabrutinib. Obexelimab, Zenas’ lead product candidate, is a bifunctional monoclonal antibody designed to bind both CD19 and FcγRIIb, which are broadly present across B cell lineage, to inhibit the activity of cells that are implicated in many autoimmune diseases without depleting them. We believe that obexelimab’s unique mechanism of action and self-administered, subcutaneous injection regimen may broadly and effectively address the pathogenic role of B cell lineage in chronic autoimmune disease. Orelabrutinib is a potentially best-in-class, highly selective CNS-penetrant, oral, small molecule Bruton’s Tyrosine Kinase (BTK) inhibitor with the potential to address compartmentalized inflammation and disease progression in Multiple Sclerosis (MS). Zenas’ earlier stage programs include ZB021, a clinical-stage, potentially best-in-class, oral, IL-17AA/AF inhibitor; ZB022, a preclinical, potentially best-in-class, oral, brain-penetrant, TYK2 inhibitor; and ZB014, a preclinical half-life extended anti-CD-19 and FcγRIIb monoclonal antibody.

We are seeking top talent who share our commitment to patients and have a track record of success in acquiring, developing and commercializing products across the globe. Our colleagues have an opportunity to engage in a fast-paced learning environment and experience individual and organizational success as we work towards becoming a global immunology and autoimmune disease leader, while living our values of Transparency, Relationships, Urgency, Excellence and Innovation – TRUE Innovation!

Position Summary:

The Director, Tax is a highly visible individual contributor and the Company’s subject matter expert for tax and treasury. The Director owns the global tax function, including provision, compliance, transfer pricing, indirect tax, and planning, working with external tax advisors. The Director, Tax will initially manage day-to-day treasury responsibilities, including cash, investments, and the Company’s debt and royalty financing arrangements. The Director is hands-on and accountable for establishing and executing tax and treasury policies and procedures, directing the work of external advisors and service providers.  The Director will partner with Finance, Legal, executive leadership, external advisors, auditors, and lenders to manage risk and support the Company’s growth from clinical to commercial stage.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop and execute global tax planning strategy aligned with company objectives, including effective tax rate and cash tax forecasting and tracking of NOLs and other tax attributes.

• Oversee preparation and review of the quarterly and annual income tax provision under ASC 740, including uncertain tax positions, valuation allowances, and Form 10-K and 10-Q disclosures.

• Oversee preparation and timely filing of federal, state, and international income tax returns including review and approval of returns and payments, and lead tax audits.

• Manage, and hold accountable the external tax advisors, including definition of scope of work, oversight of deliverables, budgets, deadlines, and quality of work.

• Own transfer pricing and intercompany policies, oversee the related documentation, and support international expansion, entity formation, and cross-border licensing structures.

• Manage the R&D tax credit and Section 174 analyses with R&D, Finance, and external advisors.

• Oversee indirect tax compliance (VAT, sales and use) and coordinate property and employment tax compliance with external providers and Payroll.

• Monitor tax law changes and advise on the tax implications of business development, licensing, and financing transactions, including the term loan, convertible notes, and synthetic royalty obligation.

• Administer the term loan, convertible notes, and synthetic royalty obligation, including payment calculations, covenant compliance, lender reporting, and related accounting and disclosures.

• Initially manage day-to-day treasury operations, including cash management, forecasting, liquidity planning, banking relationships, and foreign currency exposure.

• Manage the investment portfolio in accordance with the investment policy, emphasizing capital preservation and liquidity.

• Maintain SOX 404 controls and documentation for tax and treasury, drive automation and process improvements, and escalate significant issues to the VP Finance & Corporate Controller.

Qualifications:

Required:

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, and a CPA or advanced degree in taxation.

• Minimum of 10 years of progressive corporate tax experience in public accounting and/or industry, including at least 5 years of public company ASC 740 provision experience and the ability to review and challenge advisor-prepared provisions and returns.

• Strong knowledge of U.S. federal, state, and international income tax, including transfer pricing, R&D credits, and the tax treatment of debt, convertible, and royalty financing instruments.

• Working knowledge of treasury operations, including cash forecasting, investment management, and debt administration.

• Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP, SEC reporting, and SOX controls, plus proficiency with an ERP system (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, or Oracle) and advanced Excel.

• Proven ability to work independently as an individual contributor, managing external advisors and multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment and adapting quickly as the Company moves from clinical to commercial stage.

• Excellent communication skills, including the ability to influence without authority and to explain complex tax positions to senior leaders and auditors.

Preferred:

• Biotech, pharma, or life sciences experience, particularly the transition from clinical to commercial stage.

• Big 4 or national firm experience with life sciences clients.

• Experience with convertible notes, term loans, royalty financings, or cross-border licensing.

• Experience building tax and treasury processes at an emerging company, including automation and analytics.

The position is eligible for a competitive compensation and benefits package.

Zenas is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The base salary pay range for this role is $188,000 to $235,000. Actual compensation packages will depend on various factors, including, but not limited to depth of experience, education, skillset, overall performance and/or location.

Zenas believes in providing a competitive compensation and benefits package to all employees. Our base salary is just one component of Zenas’ competitive total rewards strategy that also includes annual performance bonus, equity, full range of benefits and other incentive compensation plans.

Zenas BioPharma is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an environment where diversity is valued.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on merit, qualifications and the needs of the business.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, Booking.com http://Booking.com, H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank. 

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.




THE ROLE

We're looking for a Growth Marketing Lead to grow new cardholder accounts across Imprint's partner credit card programs. The Growth Marketing Lead owns credit card acquisition across prescreen and invitation-to-apply (ITA) direct mail, card marketplaces and affiliates, paid search, paid social, and third-party email. The role is responsible for building these channels from an early stage, establishing operating infrastructure, vendor and bureau relationships, measurement frameworks, and repeatable execution processes, while delivering against approved account, cost per account, and credit quality targets.

The role works closely with Risk and Credit. Targeting, offer, and channel decisions affect approval rates, credit performance, and program economics, and the Growth Marketing Lead is accountable for balancing acquisition volume with account quality.

This is a senior individual contributor role. The Growth Marketing Lead operates through a combination of direct hands-on execution and external agency and vendor management. Budget recommendations are developed by this role and presented to General Managers and Finance for approval. Approved budgets are then managed and allocated by this role across channels and partners.

This role reports to the VP of Marketing.


RESPONSIBILITIES


ACQUISITION STRATEGY & PLANNING

 - Own credit card acquisition strategy across prescreen and ITA direct mail, card marketplaces, affiliates, paid search, paid social, and third-party email

 - Translate GTM and partner objectives into acquisition plans covering target segments, channel mix, offers, flighting, budget recommendations, creative requirements, and KPIs

 - Develop budget recommendations for GM and Finance review, with expected approved accounts, cost per approved account, and payback by channel

 - Allocate approved budgets across channels and partners to maximize approved account volume within cost and credit quality targets

 - Partner with GMs and Product to test welcome offers and partner reward structures by segment and channel

 - Run the channel layer of Imprint's acquisition engine, which combines partner, Imprint, and bureau data to decide which prospect receives which partner offer, through which channel, and when

 - Build and maintain acquisition playbooks and operating standards so new partner programs launch with owned acquisition channels ready

 - Establish an operating cadence across partners: intake, planning, launch, optimization, and reporting, with defined roles, SLAs, and measurement standards


PRESCREEN & ITA DIRECT MAIL

 - Own Imprint's prescreen and ITA direct mail programs, including strategy, audience selection, offers, creative direction, vendor management, and performance measurement

 - Define prescreen criteria with Risk to balance response rate, approval rate, and early credit performance

 - Manage relationships with credit bureaus, list vendors, and print and mail production partners

 - Ensure all prescreen campaigns comply with FCRA firm offer and opt-out notice requirements, coordinating with Legal, Compliance, and our issuing bank partners

 - Build and maintain the measurement framework for direct mail, including holdout testing and tracking each campaign through response, approval, activation, and early delinquency


CARD MARKETPLACES & AFFILIATES

 - Own Imprint's presence on card marketplaces and comparison sites such as Credit Karma, NerdWallet, and Experian, including pre-qualified offer integrations

 - Manage affiliate platform operations, publisher onboarding, commission structures tied to approved accounts, and fraud and quality controls

 - Identify and develop new marketplace and affiliate partnerships aligned with Imprint's target cardholder profile

 - Ensure publisher creative and offer claims comply with partner brand standards, TILA/Reg Z disclosure requirements, and UDAAP


PAID DIGITAL & THIRD-PARTY EMAIL

 - Manage day-to-day execution across paid search, paid social, and third-party email through a mix of direct hands-on work and agency management

 - Optimize channels to approved accounts, including audience targeting, bid strategy, creative iteration, suppression and eligibility logic, and landing page coordination

 - Use partner first-party data, such as loyalty members and app users, for targeting, lookalikes, and suppression within each partner's data-sharing terms

 - Partner with Product and Design to reduce drop-off across the application funnel, from landing page to submitted application to approval

 - Ensure all channel activity meets Imprint's compliance, issuing bank, and partner brand standards


MEASUREMENT & REPORTING

 - Partner with Analytics to define attribution and incrementality measurement that separates owned channel acquisition from partner channel and organic volume

 - Build and maintain acquisition dashboards and weekly reporting by channel and partner, tracking spend through approved accounts, activation, early spend, and early credit performance, with clear insights and recommended actions

 - Design and execute a structured creative and offer testing program in partnership with Creative, including brief development, variant design, readout cadence, and iteration

 - Partner with Lifecycle to coordinate suppression of existing cardholders and open applicants, frequency management, and the handoff from acquisition into onboarding programs


KPIS

 - Approved accounts by channel and partner

 - Cost per approved account by channel and partner

 - Cost per acquired, activated cardholder (CAC)

 - Approval rate and first-transaction activation rate by channel

 - Early spend and early delinquency by channel

 - Cost per application and application volume as funnel diagnostics

 - Direct mail response rate and cost per response

 - Marketplace and affiliate contribution to approved accounts

 - Channel incrementality where measurable


QUALIFICATIONS

Required

 - 7 to 10+ years of performance or direct marketing experience with direct ownership of credit card or consumer lending acquisition channels and budgets

 - Hands-on experience running prescreen or ITA direct mail programs, including credit bureau and list vendor relationships

 - Demonstrated track record of growing approved account volume while improving cost per account and maintaining credit quality, working directly with Credit and Risk teams

 - Working knowledge of credit card marketing regulation, including FCRA, TILA/Reg Z, UDAAP, and ECOA/Reg B, and experience moving creative through Legal, Compliance, and bank review

 - Hands-on expertise across at least two of: paid search, paid social, affiliates and card marketplaces, direct mail. Working knowledge across all four preferred

 - Experience managing a combination of direct execution and agency or vendor relationships

 - Strong analytical capability: card acquisition economics, attribution modeling, funnel diagnostics, cohort analysis, and holdout testing

 - Experience building operating processes, including cadences, SLAs, and playbooks, in addition to running campaigns

 - Ability to operate effectively in a multi-partner environment where acquisition programs must balance partner-specific requirements with scalable infrastructure

 - Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to present budget recommendations and performance results to senior commercial stakeholders

Nice to Have

 - Co-branded credit card experience at an issuer, program manager, or brand partner

 - Experience with pre-qualified offer programs on card marketplaces such as Credit Karma Lightbox or Experian Activate

 - Experience building response and approval models in partnership with Data Science

 - Familiarity with incrementality testing or media mix modeling

 - Experience coordinating with CRM and lifecycle teams on suppression and frequency management




PERKS & BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation and equity packages

 - Leading configured work computers of your choice

 - Flexible paid time off

 - Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage

 - Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the  option to enroll in an FSA

 - 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents

 - Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity
   
   

Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.

jobs.title: Start Up Project Manager
Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Healthcare is in crisis and the people behind the results deserve better. With more and more data coming from wearables, lab tests, and patient–doctor interactions, we’re entering an era where data is abundant.

Junction is building the infrastructure layer for diagnostic healthcare, making patient data accessible, actionable, and automated across labs and devices. Our mission is simple but ambitious: use health data to unlock unprecedented insight into human health and disease.

If you're passionate about how technology can supercharge healthcare, you’ll fit right in.

Backed by Creandum, Point Nine, 20VC, YC, and leading angels, we’re working to solve one of the biggest challenges of our time: making healthcare personalized, proactive, and affordable. We’re already connecting millions and scaling fast.


Short on time? TL;DR

 - You: Can define what should be measured, how it should be modeled, and how those insights should shape product and company decisions.

 - Ownership: You’ll own Junction’s highest-leverage statistical, modeling, and evaluation work across diagnostics, clinical workflows, and AI-enabled product development.

 - Scope: This is not a pure IC modeling role and not a reporting role. You’ll set the methodology, research roadmap, and decision framework for how Junction uses data to drive product, clinical, and business outcomes.

 - Salary: $180,000 – $200,000 + equity

 - Location: Fully remote (EST timezone only)



Why we need you

Junction sits in the flow of high-value diagnostics and clinical data. As the company grows, our advantage moves beyond just having data to having the ability to turn it into reliable intelligence improving product decisions, customer outcomes, and the performance of the business.

Some of that work exists today, but it is not yet owned as a coherent function. Models get built. Analyses get done. Experiments answer local questions. But we need someone who can define the broader scientific and analytical system: what we should measure, what methods we trust, where modeling creates real leverage, and how that work translates into products and decisions that hold up outside a demo.

We’re hiring our first Data Scientist to take ownership of, and establish that standard.

This role will lead Junction’s most important modeling, experimentation, and evaluation work. You’ll partner closely with data, product engineering and leadership teams to drive the analytical roadmap by which Junction can leverage differentiated value from data.



What you’ll be doing day to day

 - Own the research and modeling work underlying Junction’s highest-priority data science opportunities across diagnostics, clinical workflows, and AI-enabled product features

 - Define rigorous frameworks for measurement, experimentation, and causal evaluation so we can distinguish signal from noise and make decisions we can defend

 - Lead development of predictive models, segmentation approaches, risk or routing logic, and other statistical systems that directly inform product and business strategy

 - Build the analytical foundation behind customer-facing features — from model development through to validation and performance tracking

 - Partner with engineering and data engineering to ensure models and analytical systems can be put in production, are reliable, and useful in real workflows

 - Establish how Junction evaluates data-driven and AI-enabled features, including methodology, quality thresholds, monitoring, and performance review

 - Communicate complex technical findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including tradeoffs, limitations, and implications for action



Requirements

 - Strong track record of leading high-stakes analytical work that influenced product, operational, or business decisions

 - Deep foundation in statistical inference, experimental design, observational analysis, and model evaluation

 - Strong Python and/or R skills, with experience working on large, messy real-world datasets

 - Experience building predictive or decision-support models in production or near-production environments

 - Experience partnering closely with engineering to move work from analysis or prototype into deployed systems

 - Ability to operate at both strategic and hands-on levels: defining the roadmap while also getting into the details when needed

 - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; able to explain methods, findings, and tradeoffs to executives as well as technical peers

 - Comfort operating in a startup environment with ambiguity, limited structure, and high ownership



Nice to have

 - Experience designing, executing, and publishing research studies

 - Experience with HIPAA, PHI, or other regulatory clinical frameworks

 - Deep familiarity with modern data tooling and production workflows across warehouses, orchestration, and transformation layers

 - Experience developing, deploying, and designing evaluation frameworks for LLM or AI-powered features in customer-facing products

 - Expertise directly working with healthcare, diagnostics, lab data, wearable data, and other clinical data

 - Experience applying causal inference methods, such as diff-in-diff, propensity scoring, or instrumental variables in practice



What this role isn’t

 - Not an analytics role focused on dashboards, reporting, or one-off analysis

 - Not an ML platform role — you won’t own infrastructure or tooling

 - Not a good fit if you mainly want to experiment with models or AI ideas without being accountable for how they perform in production

 - Not a good fit if you struggle with ambiguity. Knowing what to work on is part of the job



How you'll be compensated

 - Salary: $180,000 – $220,000 + equity

 - Your salary is dependent on your location and experience level

 - Equity (extended exercise post 2 years of employment) 

 - Company and team offsites

 - Monthly learning budget of $150 for personal development and productivity

 - $100 monthly wellness budget

 - Flexible, remote-first working, including $1K for home office equipment

 - Coworking budget

 - 36 days paid time off (including bank holidays)

 - Premium healthcare coverage 

 - 4% monthly contribution to pension/401k

 - Yearly blood test on us

 - Enhanced parental, foster, and adoption leave
   
   

Important details before applying:

 - We only hire folks physically based in GMT and EST timezones 

 - We do not sponsor visas right now given our stage

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer | Token Spend Management
jobs.description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Ramp’s Token Spend Management team helps finance and technical teams understand and manage what they spend across AI providers and subscriptions. We are building the third pillar https://ramp.com/blog/ramp-at-44-billion-the-third-pillar of finance. The product brings provider usage and billing information together so customers can see where costs come from, attribute spend, and act on it with greater confidence.



We’re looking for a senior backend engineer to build the systems behind that experience. You’ll own substantial projects from design through production, turn data from different providers into dependable product experiences, and work with product, design, data, and engineering partners to make complex spend information useful to customers. You will be involved in key company initiatives such as inference accounting, and figuring out new and novel ways to help companies not just manage, but think about their AI Spend.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design and build backend services and APIs that support AI spend visibility, attribution, insights, and controls

 - Build and improve integrations that ingest usage and billing information from supported providers

 - Taking the data from those integrations and converting it into helpful structures for external customers, and internal product consumers

 - Create reliable data models and processing workflows that make spend information accurate, traceable, and useful across the product

 - Own projects from technical design through launch, monitoring, and iteration

 - Improve the reliability, performance, and observability of systems as customer usage and provider coverage grow

 - Partner with product, design, data, and engineering teammates to turn customer needs into practical solutions

 - Raise the engineering bar through thoughtful design reviews, code reviews, and mentorship




WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - Experience designing, building, and operating production backend systems, including APIs, data models, and asynchronous workflows

 - Strong judgment about system design, data correctness, reliability, and when to keep a solution simple

 - A track record of independently owning complex projects and shipping high-quality software

 - Experience working with external data sources or integrations where data quality and changing interfaces matter

 - Comfort working through ambiguous product problems with cross-functional partners

 - Clear communication and a collaborative approach to technical decisions and feedback




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience with usage metering, billing, spend management, or financial data products

 - Experience integrating with AI providers or other third-party usage and billing APIs

 - Experience building attribution, alerts, limits, or other systems that help customers understand and manage spend




BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

 - Flexible PTO

 - Centralized home-office equipment ordering

 - Health and wellness stipend

 - Budget for intra-office travel

 - Weekly coffee stipend




UNITED STATES

 - 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

 - One Medical annual membership

 - 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

 - Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)
