jobs.title: Senior Manager, Backend
jobs.description:
Weight Watchers is the global leader in science-backed weight management, offering an integrated support system built for the GLP-1 era that combines scientific expertise, medication, cutting-edge technology, and human connection. With more than 60 years of experience, Weight Watchers is the most studied commercial weight management program in the world, delivered through its No. 1 U.S. doctor-recommended weight-loss program. Its holistic, personalized approach also includes U.S.-based clinical interventions and access to GLP-1 medications when clinically appropriate, and a global network of coaches and community support. Since 1963, the company has led with science to deliver its members the personalized support they need to reach and sustain their goals. Members can access these solutions directly, or through Weight Watchers for Business’ full-spectrum platform for employers, health plans, and payers. In a landscape crowded with contradictory advice, isolating apps, and one-size-fits-all solutions, Weight Watchers offers a proven path forward that is rooted in research, grounded in empathy and designed to help every member feel better in their body and live a longer, healthier life.

ABOUT THE TEAM

At WeightWatchers, our Engineering Team drives transformative change by leveraging technology to redefine how millions approach weight health and wellness. The team builds digital solutions that establish personalized connections and foster inclusive virtual communities, empowering members to adopt healthier habits and achieve lasting lifestyle changes. From pioneering a comprehensive telehealth platform, optimizing medication access, diving headfirst into exciting AI integrations we lead with data-driven innovations that revolutionize healthcare outcomes. Our culture thrives on urgency, collaboration, and a passion for impactful work that directly improves the lives of our members.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a Senior Manager of Backend Engineering, you will lead the teams responsible for the core systems that power the WeightWatchers member experience. Your mission is to build, scale, and mentor high-performing engineering teams that deliver a member platform that is simple, fast, safe, and scalable.

You will be responsible for the health, growth, and delivery of multiple backend squads. You will partner closely with Infra, Product, Data, and Design to turn technical strategy into a reliable reality for millions of members worldwide

Role Overview:

1) People Leadership and Team Growth

• Talent Development: Recruit, manage, and mentor a diverse team of backend engineers, from entry-level to Principal level.

• Culture of Excellence: Foster an engineering culture focused on operational readiness, documentation, incident learning, and continuous improvement.

• Empowerment: Create an environment where teams have clear ownership boundaries and the autonomy to ship quickly without fragmenting the ecosystem.

2) Delivery and Operational Excellence

• Execution Roadmap: Drive the execution of multi-quarter technical strategies for the member platform, aligning your teams on the "why," "what," and "how".

• SLO-Driven Management: Ensure teams define and meet SLIs/SLOs that reflect member happiness, prioritizing reliability and performance in "moments that matter".

• Process Optimization: Identify and remove structural bottlenecks - such as brittle integrations or duplicated micro-services - to accelerate delivery across product squads.

3) Backend Platform and Data Integrity

• Strategic Oversight: Oversee the backend services powering member identity, food databases, and tracking foundations to ensure they are trustworthy and scalable.

• Data Stewardship: Partner with Data and ML teams to ensure backend systems provide reliable, well-modeled data for journey personalization and experimentation.

• Modernization: Lead your teams through the transition to modern cloud architectures and event-driven patterns that support a global digital health platform.

4) Strategic Partnership and Communication

• Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as a key partner to Product and Design to ensure backend systems are built for iteration and measurable outcomes.

• Technical Advocacy: Translate technical debt, risks, and architectural needs into crisp options and consequences for executive and cross-functional forums.

• Trust Building: Build trust through clarity, predictable follow-through, and calm leadership under pressure.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage the end-to-end delivery of backend features and platform components across multiple squads.

• Lead performance reviews, career development discussions, and workforce planning for your organization.

• Review technical designs and drive decision-making on hard tradeoffs between speed, quality, and cost.

• Embed security and compliance (HIPAA-adjacent workflows) into standard team practices.

• Drive a "FinOps" mindset, ensuring backend systems scale sustainably while balancing cloud costs.

WHO YOU ARE

• Leader of Leaders: You have a proven track record of managing and scaling engineering teams at a system-wide level.

• Pragmatic Manager: You anchor team priorities in member outcomes and business impact, avoiding unnecessary complexity.

• Effective Communicator: You produce clear documentation and can influence stakeholders across competing priorities.

• Systems Thinker: You can zoom from high-level roadmap planning to deep-diving into execution details when necessary.

Preferred Requirements

• Experience: 8+ years in backend engineering with 3+ years in a formal management or leadership role for large-scale consumer systems.

• Technical Depth: Strong understanding of modern distributed systems (AWS), APIs, and data modeling for high-scale environments.

• Execution Track Record: Proven ability to lead cross-team initiatives from design through successful production adoption.

• Educational Background: Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Hourly salary may vary depending on, but not limited to: skills, experience, and location.

$185,000—$200,000 USD

jobs.title: Quantum-AI Postdoctoral Fellow
jobs.description:
Location: Full-Time On-Site in Ann Arbor, MI or San Francisco, CA offices

Type: Fixed Term (1 Year) with potential 1-year extension or FTE conversion

About Sygaldry

Sygaldry Technologies is building quantum-accelerated AI servers to exponentially speed up training and inference for AI. By integrating quantum and AI, we're accelerating the path to super intelligence, and engineering the conditions for it to scale efficiently and operate affordably. Sygaldry AI servers combine multiple qubit types within a single, fault-tolerant architecture to deliver the combination of cost, scale, and speed necessary for advanced AI applications. We pioneer new domains in physics, engineering, and AI, tackling the hardest challenges with a grounded, optimistic, and rigorous culture. We're looking for individuals ready to define the intersection of quantum and AI and drive its profound global impact.



What You'll Work On

Exploratory Research in Generative Models

 - Investigate and advance state-of-the-art diffusion and score-based generative models with a focus on mathematical efficiency.

 - Conduct deep theoretical analysis of computational bottlenecks in sampling, denoising, and likelihood estimation.

 - Develop novel solver methods for diffusion ODEs/SDEs that are mathematically compatible with quantum algorithms.

Quantum-Classical Hybridization

 - Identify mathematical structures in generative models (e.g., linear algebra subroutines, probabilistic flows) amenable to quantum speedup.

 - Prototype hybrid workflows where quantum subroutines accelerate classical pipelines, using simulation or hardware access.

 - Rigorously benchmark theoretical versus practical advantages, producing white papers and internal technical reports.

Academic & Industrial Impact

 - Publish your findings in top-tier conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, QIP) and journals.

 - Collaborate with quantum hardware teams to inform future architecture requirements based on algorithmic needs.

 - Translate research insights into scalable proof-of-concept implementations that can be handed off to engineering teams.

You May Be a Good Fit If You

 - Hold a PhD (or are nearing completion) in Computer Science, Physics, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.

 - Have deep expertise in diffusion probabilistic models, score matching, or related generative methods.

 - Understand the mathematical foundations: SDEs, ODEs, Langevin dynamics, and probability flow.

 - Are experienced with ML frameworks (PyTorch, JAX) and writing clean, research-grade code.

 - Possess a strong track record of research excellence (first-author publications).

 - Are excited to work on problems no one has solved before, questioning assumptions with rigor.

Strong Candidates May Have

 - Published research specifically on diffusion models, score-based generation, or neural ODE/SDE methods.

 - Experience optimizing sampling efficiency (e.g., DDIM, DPM-Solver, consistency models).

 - Familiarity with numerical methods for differential equations.

 - An understanding of quantum algorithms and computational complexity (though deep quantum expertise is not required if the ML math is strong).

 - Background in high-dimensional probability or stochastic processes.

Why This Matters

Your work accelerates the path to quantum superintelligence. Each quantum component integrated, each AI model enhanced, each instruction set optimized brings us closer to a future where intelligence and quantum mechanics are inextricably intertwined. We're not building incremental improvements—we're creating exponential transformations that will make AI more affordable, sustainable, personalized, and fundamentally more capable.

How We’re Different

We’re building the infrastructure for quantum superintelligence and pioneering new domains at the intersection of physics, engineering, and AI. At Sygaldry, curiosity and intellectual courage drive our work. We approach ambitious challenges with a grounded, optimistic, and rigorous culture and know that kind people build the strongest teams. We prioritize mission over ego and collaborate openly with a strong sense of shared purpose. We dream big, yet we execute with a love of detail.

Culture & Benefits

 - The Best of Both Worlds: Access to industrial-scale compute and hardware resources while retaining the intellectual freedom of an academic environment.

 - Visa Sponsorship: We know what it takes to make top talent thrive here. We’re open to supporting visas whenever possible.

 - Compensation: We value your high-level expertise. This position offers a salary significantly above standard academic postdoctoral rates.

 - Benefits: Your well-being matters. We provide company-sponsored health coverage to give you and your family peace of mind.

 - Connection: Whether it’s company offsite or casual crew socials, we make time to connect, recharge, and have fun together.

 - Time Off: We trust you to take the time you need. Unlimited PTO so you can rest, recharge, and come back ready to make an impact.

We encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. If you don’t think this role is right for you, but you believe that you would have something meaningful to contribute to our mission, please reach out at letsbuild@sygaldry.com

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer | Accounts Receivable
jobs.description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Getting paid is still one of the most manual parts of running a business. Finance teams chase invoices over email, match payments to invoices by hand in spreadsheets, and close the books late because cash data is scattered across banks, payment processors, and ERPs.

Ramp's Accounts Receivable team is building the system that automates all of it, from the moment an invoice is sent to the moment cash is reconciled in the general ledger. We own the full receivables lifecycle: invoicing, collections, payments, cash application, and accounting sync.

We're looking for a senior backend engineer to own core pieces of that system. The work sits where hard engineering problems meet real money: matching messy payment data to the right invoices, keeping ledgers correct to the cent, and syncing reliably with the accounting systems our customers depend on. You'll own projects end to end, from design through production, and work closely with product and design to turn complex finance workflows into software that just works.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build the payment-matching systems that automatically apply incoming ACH, wire, card, and check payments to the right invoices, even when payment details are incomplete or inconsistent

 - Design accurate data models where every dollar is traceable from invoice to payment to general ledger

 - Build two-way integrations with ERPs like NetSuite and QuickBooks that stay consistent through retries, partial failures, and edits on either side

 - Build collections workflows that help businesses get paid faster without hurting their customer relationships

 - Own projects from problem definition and technical design through launch, monitoring, and iteration

 - Raise the engineering bar through design reviews, code reviews, and mentorship
   


WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - Product sense: you care about the customer problem, not just the ticket, and you push back when the spec is wrong

 - Experience designing and operating production backend systems, including APIs, data models, and asynchronous workflows

 - Strong system design judgment and the ability to balance speed, correctness, reliability, and simplicity

 - A track record of independently owning complex projects and shipping high-quality software

 - Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to technical decisions
   


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience with invoicing, billing, payments, accounting, or other financial workflows

 - Experience building integrations that keep data consistent across systems

 - Experience improving reliability and operational visibility in a growing product




BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

jobs.description:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

The Role

Block is seeking a Compliance Technology Program Lead to ensure our Machine Learning and Heuristic detection models — and the data infrastructure that feeds them — are fit for purpose, for our fiat and virtual currency products. This role sits at the intersection of compliance, machine learning, and AI tooling: you will use modern intelligence tools, including Claude and other LLM-based agents, to automate significant portions of oversight, monitoring, and documentation work — turning a traditionally manual, documentation-heavy function into a scalable, defensible program. You will partner with Machine Learning, Engineering and BSA/AML Policy Teams to provide end-to-end technical oversight, effective challenge and ongoing monitoring throughout the model development lifecycle.

You Will

• Build with Modern AI Tools: Use AI agents (Claude and similar LLM-based tools) to build automation that scales oversight, monitoring, and documentation work — including drafting requirements, exam-ready documentation, data quality monitoring and ongoing model performance reporting.

• Design human-in-the-loop checkpoints so that automated outputs remain defensible to regulators and independent monitors.

• Establish and maintain model and data governance frameworks aligned with SR 11-7, SR 26-2, and OCC 2011-12 so engineering teams can ship defensible models at pace. Provide effective challenge throughout the model development lifecycle and partner with the BSA/AML Policy Team and CAX stakeholders to ensure documentation is exam-ready.

• Lead Ongoing Monitoring: Lead the design and development of real-time dashboards to monitor model health, including input data monitoring and ongoing model performance.

• Set standards for threshold tuning and ongoing Below the Line (BTL) testing controls.

• Establish frameworks and triggers for identifying when model performance is degrading and requires tuning or deprecation. Partner during subsequent tuning exercises and ensure changes are within risk appetite and documented defensibly.

• Provide End-to-End Oversight of Model Development: Oversee Transaction Monitoring models, including heuristic and rules-based detection logic, threshold settings (below the line testing), and the data pipelines that feed alerts.

• Oversee blockchain analytics and screening tools (TRM, Chainalysis), with attention to typology coverage, alert quality, and integration with downstream investigations.

• Oversee Sanctions Screening models (LexisNexis), including list management, fuzzy-match tuning, and false-positive reduction.

• Oversee Customer Risk Scoring models, including segmentation logic, periodic recalibration, and effective challenge of risk drivers.

• Oversee the design and validation of AI-driven case resolution — LLM-based and ML-based models that triage, enrich, or disposition alerts — ensuring decisions are explainable, auditable, and defensible to regulators.

You Have

• 7+ years of experience in compliance technology at regulated financial institutions, or as a consultant working with FIs.

• Hands-on experience building with modern AI tools — including Claude, GPT, or comparable LLM-based agents — and a track record of using them to automate work in production. This includes prompt engineering, designing agentic workflows, and integrating AI into operational processes.

• Experience with both Machine Learning and Heuristic models across Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions Screening, and Customer Risk Scoring.

• Experience with input data quality monitoring.

• Experience with model performance monitoring.

• Experience conducting AML model validations aligned with SR 11-7 and OCC 2011-12.

• Experience responding to examinations and consent orders, and working with regulators and independent monitors.

• Experience with virtual currencies, including the unique transaction monitoring and sanctions screening considerations they present.

• Familiarity with blockchain analytics and screening tools such as Chainalysis and TRM Labs.

• A track record of driving cross-functional initiatives.

• A working understanding of regulated financial services and corresponding compliance obligations.

• Familiarity with statistical concepts related to machine learning

• Expertise in data analytics and visualization

jobs.description:
Ambulatory Clinical Pharmacist

Job Purpose:

The Ambulatory Clinical Pharmacist (ACP) plays a vital role in delivering integrated, patient-centered care within designated clinics. This position focuses on optimizing therapeutic outcomes for individuals with chronic conditions by fostering strong relationships with patients and providers, enhancing medication adherence, and implementing evidence-based treatment strategies. The ACP works on-site and collaborates closely with both hybrid and onsite teams to maximize clinical services and continuity of patient care.

• $10,000 relocation assistance (or sign-on bonus) to Texarkana, TX. Competitive pay + 20% annual bonus.

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance starting day one

• 401(k) with match, 4 weeks PTO, 10 paid holidays

• Paid parental leave, short-term disability, and professional development

Job Responsibilities:

• Identify, resolve, and prevent medication-related problems to ensure safe and effective pharmacotherapy.

• Conduct comprehensive assessments for chronic disease management under collaborative practice agreements or clinic protocols.

• Stratify patients based on clinical risk to prioritize interventions and tailor care plans accordingly.

• Provide individualized counseling on medication use, lifestyle modifications, and disease state education.

• Address barriers to adherence, including cost, access, and health literacy, through targeted interventions.

• Monitor and evaluate medication regimens to ensure clinical criteria are met, including therapeutic goals, adverse effects, and drug interactions.

• Work on-site in close coordination with interdisciplinary teams, including both in-person and hybrid care models.

• Ensure all clinical criteria are in clinical compliance with guidance from FDA, clinical guidelines, and appropriate evidence-based literature.

• Willing to do whatever is necessary for the betterment of the organization.

• Protects organization's value by keeping information confidential.

• Other duties as assigned by Clinical Leadership or Manager of Clinical Services.

Experience/ Education:

• Licensure & Education: Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) and active Texas license required.

• Experience: Minimum 3 years as a clinical pharmacist; PGY1/PGY2 residency preferred.

Skills & Expertise:

• Strong clinical judgment, communication, and process management

• In-depth knowledge of pharmacology, FDA regulations, and chronic disease management.

• Proven ability to ensure legal compliance and deliver high-quality, detail-oriented care

Professional Traits: Organized, dependable, empathetic, and collaborative with a strong focus on integrity and patient-centered care.

Additional Requirements: High energy, team-oriented mindset, and ability to handle sensitive data with discretion and confidentiality.

jobs.description:
GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

General Description

The DevSecOps Presales Solutions Engineer will collaborate with Account Executives and senior AppSec & AI engineering leadership to drive new business within the Mid-Atlantic region, with a focus on Application Security (AppSec) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) security with the ability to grow into Vulnerability Management and Cloud Security. This presales role is designed for an engineer with 1-3 years of presales experience who wants to grow their technical and customer-facing skills alongside experienced practitioners.

The Solutions Engineer will support technical qualification, positioning, and solutioning for AppSec and AI opportunities, partnering with practice leads who retain final decision authority. This position provides the opportunity to build deep expertise in application security, AI security, AI governance, and secure SDLC practices while contributing directly to deal success. The role is intentionally focused on DevSecOps - AppSec and AI - and is not a generalist security role.

Roles and Responsibilities:

• Partner with Account Executives and senior AppSec & AI engineers to drive new and continued business within the territory, focusing on Application Security and AI security opportunities.

• Perform technical qualification, discovery, and positioning for AppSec and AI presales opportunities, escalating complex objections to senior engineers and practice leads.

• Articulate AppSec and AI risks, controls, and architectural tradeoffs to technical and security stakeholders, building technical credibility over time.

• Align customer AI aspirations with foundational AppSec realities across varying levels of buyer maturity.

• Learn new AppSec and AI technologies and articulate their value proposition for adoption across the customer's security landscape.

• Participate in Sales and Marketing events, industry conferences, and technical forums to build awareness of GuidePoint's AppSec and AI offerings.

• Support the development of Statements of Work, proposals, and technical collateral for GuidePoint offerings.

• Embrace emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcomes.

• Report to Engineering leadership within the DevSecOps practice.

Position Requirements:

• Minimum 1-3 years of presales, sales engineering, solutions engineering, or comparable client-facing technical experience that have advanced sales (not strictly engineering).

• Foundational knowledge of Application Security and/or AI security concepts, secure software development, and modern DevSecOps practices.

• Interest in and awareness of AI/ML systems, AI security risks, and emerging governance and regulatory considerations.

• Ability to learn new cyber technologies quickly and articulate value propositions to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Strong discovery skills to understand issues/gaps in customer AppSec and AI programs and collaborate on solutions.

• Willingness to proactively research and engage emerging vendors and technologies relevant to AppSec and AI.

• Excellent soft skills with the ability to translate complex technical content into business-aligned outcomes.

Technical Requirements:

• Working knowledge of Application Security concepts (e.g., secure SDLC, SAST/DAST/SCA, code review, vulnerability management, or web/API security).

• Familiarity with AI/ML systems and emerging AI security risks (e.g., model security, LLM/GenAI risks, AI governance).

• Exposure to modern DevSecOps tooling and practices (CI/CD pipelines, containers, cloud environments).

• Working technical knowledge of foundational security concepts (Zero Trust, defense in depth, etc.).

• Ability to build technical proof points and demonstrate solutions to technical and executive stakeholders with support from senior engineers.

• Strong communication and troubleshooting skills.

Travel Requirements:

• Up to 25% travel required.

Physical Requirements:

• Sedentary work

• Substantial movement of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers for a minimum of 8 hours a day

• Required to have close visual acuity to view computer terminal and/or extensive reading for a minimum of 8 hours a day

GuidePoint Security is a rapidly growing, profitable, privately-held value added reseller that focuses exclusively on Information Security. Since its inception in 2011, GuidePoint has grown to over 1,300 employees, established strategic partnerships with leading security vendors, and serves as a trusted advisor to more than 6,200 customers.

jobs.title: Events & Social Marketing Specialist

ABOUT QUALYTICS

At Qualytics, we help organizations trust the data their business runs on. Our data trust platform brings data quality, master data management, data observability, and data catalog together in one place, with data quality at its core. We go beyond surface-level checks to assess data row by row, deriving expectations directly from the data and surfacing findings from the first scan, so teams catch silent errors, unexpected changes, and anomalies before they cause real-world consequences.

We work with some of the most forward-thinking organizations in the world, where trusted data has a direct impact on performance, compliance, and strategic decisions. Joining Qualytics means you'll help put our story in front of the data leaders who need it, and you'll see the influence of your work firsthand. If you're organized, curious, and ready to grow with a company solving foundational problems, let's talk.




ROLE OVERVIEW

Reporting to the Head of Marketing, you’ll own Qualytics’ events and social channels day to day, from planning through follow-up and reporting. You’ll work closely with marketing, sales, and leadership, and you’ll see directly how events and social drive pipeline at an early-stage software company.

This is a fully remote, hands-on role on a lean team, with your time split roughly evenly between events and social. It’s built for someone with a few years of experience running events and social for a brand, who is highly organized, writes well, and wants to grow a career in marketing.

jobs.title: Commercial Lead
jobs.description:
OXMAN

OXMAN is a nature-based research and design company based in Manhattan. We incubate ventures and technologies that reimagine the relationship between humanity and the natural world. Working across disciplines—from architecture and ecology to computation and materials science—we develop nature-centric solutions to critical environmental challenges.

 


EDEN

EDEN is building a generative ecosystem digital twin. It learns what species do and what sites are like from satellite and geospatial data, simulates how ecosystems develop through coupled models of microclimate, water, vegetation and fauna, and uses decision-making agents to design interventions whose outcomes can be predicted. The core components work today as research prototypes, and the next step is to engineer them into one system.

EDEN operates as both a design and innovation practice and an emerging software product. Our applied technology arm already delivers EDEN’s tools to clients as project work, proving the technology on real sites, while a growing software and product team works to package those tools into a product.

As EDEN moves from projects to product, we are seeking a Commercial Lead to define the market, the price and the plan, and to win EDEN’s first customers.

 


ROLE OVERVIEW

OXMAN is seeking a Commercial Lead to join the EDEN team as its first commercial hire and turn working technology into a product with a market, a price and a repeatable sale.

This role sits at the intersection of market strategy, business modeling and enterprise sales. EDEN has technology that works, live client engagements through its applied technology arm, strong relationships with leaders in several industries, and a growing software and product team. What it does not yet have is a data-backed case for which market comes first, at what price and with what plan. The Commercial Lead will build that case for EDEN’s leadership team and board, then prove it with the first paying customers.

Candidate markets today include developers of residential master-planned communities, logistics and warehousing, mine operators with reclamation obligations, state departments of transportation that maintain rights of way, and hospitality and ecotourism operators. Each has a different buyer, budget, decision cycle and reason to care.

The role is hands-on. The ideal candidate runs the customer interviews, builds the models and writes the documents themselves, working directly with leadership to build EDEN’s commercial function from the ground up. They bring a strategist’s analytical rigor, a seller’s comfort owning a revenue number, and a builder’s appetite for ambiguity.

This role is based in New York City. When you are not traveling to visit clients, prospects, or partners, you are in the EDEN office. Remote work is not available for this role.

Candidate markets include mine operators, state departments of transportation, and logistics operators, whose sites are most often not in New York. Expect regular travel to prospect and customer locations.

 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Market research and segment selection: Size each candidate market from primary and secondary data. Map the buyer, the budget owner, the regulatory drivers and the decision cycle, and find out what each market pays for today and what it would pay for a predicted outcome.

 - Beachhead recommendation: Turn the research into a recommendation to EDEN leadership and the board on where to go first, what to say no to, and what evidence would change the answer.

 - Pricing and business model: Design how EDEN charges (per site, per project, subscription, outcome-linked or a combination), then model and defend the unit economics.

 - Business plan: Write the plan EDEN takes to its board and investors, covering market, product, go-to-market, revenue model, hiring and milestones, and keep it current as evidence comes in.

 - First customers: Once the beachhead is chosen, use EDEN’s existing relationships to source, pitch and, with the leadership team, close the first pilots and paying engagements, then run those accounts until a dedicated account owner is hired.

 - Voice of the customer: Bring market learning back to EDEN’s leadership team as clear, prioritized requirements, so that what EDEN builds next is what the market will buy.

 - Fundraising support: Fold market work into the investor materials and conversations already underway.

 - Playbooks and systems: Set up the discovery, qualification and pipeline practices that future commercial hires will inherit.

 


KEY GOALS & OUTCOMES

 - First 30 days: 
   
   - Learn EDEN’s technology well enough to demo it and explain it to a non-technical buyer.
   
   - Build a market map for each candidate segment covering who buys, who pays, what drives the decision and how big the opportunity is.
   
   - Complete a first round of customer discovery interviews across segments, using EDEN’s network and their own.
   
   - Deliver a first beachhead recommendation with the evidence, the reasoning and the open questions, plus a plan for the pricing model and business plan that follow.

 - At six months:
   
   - Beachhead: You have run structured discovery across the candidate segments, sized each one, and delivered a recommendation that we have acted on. The evidence is written down, including what we said no to and why.
   
   - First Product: The product and engineering teams have built the first version for that segment to a definition you shaped with the CTO, and [two to three] beachhead customers are using it on real sites.
   
   - Pricing: A pricing model and unit economics exist, tested with those first customers rather than built in a spreadsheet alone, and the CEO has signed off.
   
   - Business Plan: The first full draft is done and already carrying investor conversations, not waiting for them.
   
   - Pipeline: Named accounts in the beachhead segment, qualified against criteria you set, with the next two in active conversation behind the first customers.
   
   - Repeatable Process: The interview protocol, the qualification criteria, and the pipeline live somewhere other than your head.

 


REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

 - 4 to 7 years in strategy consulting, investment banking, or growth, go-to-market or operations roles at a high-growth startup.

 - Experience working on real technology: selling or commercializing software, not services alone.

 - Demonstrated ability to size a market, build a pricing model and write a business plan, and to explain the assumptions behind each.

 - Experience owning a revenue number, running commercial conversations with enterprise or public-sector buyers, and closing.

 


PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

 - Experience in the built environment, real estate development, infrastructure, mining, or climate and nature technology.

 - Public-sector or long-cycle enterprise sales experience.

 - Time at a company before product-market fit.

 - An interest in ecology, earth observation or environmental modeling. This isn’t required, but the role is surrounded by it.

 


TECHNICAL SKILLS

 - Market sizing and segmentation from primary and secondary data.

 - Financial modeling, including pricing models and unit economics, with clearly stated assumptions.

 - Pricing and business model design across per-site, per-project, subscription and outcome-linked structures.

 - Business plan and strategy writing for leadership, board and investor audiences.

 - Customer discovery: designing interview protocols, running interviews and synthesizing findings into prioritized product requirements.

 - Sales pipeline management, including discovery, qualification, CRM and pipeline hygiene.

 - Ability to learn complex technology well enough to demo it and explain it to non-technical buyers.

 


ESSENTIAL QUALITIES

 - Analytical rigor: shows the work and can explain the assumptions behind every number.

 - Commercial mindset: comfortable owning a revenue number, running a commercial conversation with an enterprise or public-sector buyer, and closing.

 - Executive presence: writes and speaks clearly, and can lead a meeting with a developer’s executive team or a state agency while holding their own on the details.

 - Builder mentality: high agency, low ego and comfortable in ambiguity; builds the playbook while executing it.

 - Hands-on: runs the interviews, builds the models and writes the documents personally before hiring anyone to help.

 - Evidence-driven: willing to say no to a market, and to change the answer when the evidence changes.

jobs.description:
About Us

AGE Solutions is a premier technology and professional services company, providing in-depth consulting, advanced technology solutions, and essential services throughout the U.S. government, defense, and intelligence sectors. Prioritizing innovation and client-focused solutions, we assist major agencies in addressing intricate issues and ensuring a more secure future.

AGE Solutions is seeking an experienced Information System Security Manager (ISSM) to support a program with our DoD customer.  The ISSM will provide cybersecurity leadership and oversight for assigned information systems, applications, networks, and mission environments. This role is responsible for supporting Risk Management Framework (RMF) implementation, system authorization activities, continuous monitoring, and compliance with Department of Defense (DoD) cybersecurity requirements.

The successful candidate will work closely with Government stakeholders, system owners, engineers, assessors, and Information System Security Officers (ISSOs) to evaluate cybersecurity risks, maintain authorization readiness, and support secure adoption of emerging technologies.

Responsibilities Include:

• Lead cybersecurity governance and risk management activities for assigned information systems, applications, networks, and mission environments.

• Oversee RMF implementation, system authorization activities, and ongoing cybersecurity compliance.

• Manage the development, maintenance, and review of authorization documentation, including System Security Plans (SSPs), Security Assessment Reports (SARs), Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms), and supporting artifacts.

• Provide oversight of continuous monitoring (ConMon), vulnerability management, remediation activities, and security control assessments.

• Evaluate cybersecurity risks and recommend mitigation strategies, compensating controls, and corrective actions.

• Coordinate with ISSOs, system owners, engineers, assessors, Authorizing Officials, and Government stakeholders to support authorization and risk acceptance decisions.

• Ensure alignment with DoDI 8510.01, applicable NIST guidance, DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), and customer-directed cybersecurity requirements.

• Support cybersecurity inspections, audits, assessments, and authorization readiness reviews.

• Develop cybersecurity metrics, risk assessments, executive-level reports, and briefings.

• Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and oversight to ISSOs and supporting cybersecurity personnel.

• Assess security implications associated with emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI), autonomous systems, cloud environments, and experimental capabilities.

• Recommend risk mitigations, compensating controls, and security safeguards for prototypes, pilot programs, and test environments that may not align with traditional authorization approaches.

• Develop and maintain authorization packages and supporting security documentation for emerging technologies, prototypes, and pilot initiatives.

Required Skills, Qualifications, and Experience:

• Citizenship and Clearance: U.S. Citizenship is required. Must have and maintain a minimum of an active DoD Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain a DoD Top Secret clearance. A current Top Secret clearance is preferred.

• Education and Certifications: Bachelor’s degree is required. Must meet applicable qualification requirements and possess at least one current certification recognized for DoD 8140 Work Role 722 – Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM), Intermediate level, such as: CISSP CISM CGRC/CAP SecurityX/CASP+ Security+ CCSP GSEC

• Experience: 5–10 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, information assurance, RMF, risk management, or security compliance. Experience supporting RMF implementation, system authorization activities, and cybersecurity governance. Experience developing, reviewing, or managing authorization packages and supporting security documentation.

• Skills and Knowledge: Strong understanding of cybersecurity risk assessment, vulnerability management, security controls, and remediation processes. Knowledge of DoDI 8510.01, NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-37, applicable CNSSI requirements, and DISA STIGs. Strong analytical, leadership, communication, and technical documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with technical teams, Government stakeholders, and cybersecurity leadership. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic mission environment. Ability to obtain and maintain required customer-specific access and credentials.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Site Alliances and Strategy
jobs.description:
About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

• HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

• HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

• HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

• HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

Overview of Role:

The Associate Director, Site Alliances and Strategy is responsible for developing and maintaining strategic relationships with select clinical trial sites, site networks, and emerging clinical research partners, while contributing to broader Clinical Operations strategy and operational improvement initiatives. This role supports high-quality trial execution, portfolio scalability, and organizational effectiveness by connecting site insights with internal planning, process optimization, performance management, and change implementation. The position serves as a key interface across external sites and internal cross-functional stakeholders, ensuring site engagement and operational strategies align with portfolio priorities, business needs, and inspection-ready trial conduct.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment, brings strong clinical trial operations experience, and has a demonstrated ability to build trusted external relationships, influence across matrixed teams, and translate site insights into strategies that reduce burden, improve enrollment, and strengthen long-term sponsor-site partnerships.

Role and Responsibilities:

• Develops and executes site alliance strategies; Building and maintaining strong strategic relationships with key clinical institutions, investigators, research staff, and site leadership to strengthen sponsor-site collaboration

• Leads start-up optimization with internal and external site Study Start-Up teams, driving faster, simpler execution through early engagement, MSAs, standardized budgets and contracts, and streamlined processes.

• Serves as a primary Clinical Operations interface and escalation point for site alliance matters, partnering with study teams, CROs, vendors, and functional leaders to resolve operational issues, reduce site burden, and identify opportunities to improve external partner performance and value.

• Partners with cross-functional stakeholders, including Clinical Operations, Medical Affairs, Clinical Science, Regulatory, Quality, Data Management, Pharmacovigilance, and external partners, to align site engagement activities with study and Summit priorities.

• Develops approaches to identify, onboard, educate, and cultivate new sites that support current and future portfolio needs.

• Develops and monitors KPIs, dashboards, and relationship health measures to evaluate site engagement effectiveness, support data-driven decisions, and improve operational predictability.

• Contributes site and network insights to portfolio planning, resource forecasting, and operational prioritization to support scalable, predictable study execution.

• Contributes to cross-functional Clinical Operations strategy and transformation initiatives that improve study delivery, scalability, and execution excellence.

• Identifies opportunities to simplify clinical trial processes, improve site and patient experience, and streamline study activities across the clinical trial lifecycle.

• Identifies and advances process efficiencies, vendor optimization opportunities, and operational standardization initiatives; develops recommendations and business cases that improve quality, timelines, and cost effectiveness.

• Champions a culture of collaboration, accountability, learning, and continuous improvement, and may coach or mentor Clinical Operations colleagues supporting site alliance and strategic initiatives.

• All other duties as assigned.

Experience, Education and Specialized Knowledge and Skills:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in life science, nursing, pharmacy, medical laboratory technology, or other health/medical-related area required; advanced degree preferred.

• 10+ years of direct or indirect clinical trial operations experience, including clinical trial execution, site management, site engagement, or sponsor oversight responsibilities.

• 3+ years of experience in a site-facing clinical trial role, such as trial manager, CRA, site engagement lead, or equivalent role strongly preferred.

• Experience hiring, developing, mentoring, or actively managing team members directly or through a matrixed structure preferred.

• Experience building and managing strategic relationships with clinical trial sites, site networks, investigators, and external research partners at both strategic and operational levels.

• Strong working knowledge of ICH-GCP, health authority expectations, clinical trial conduct, sponsor oversight, and inspection readiness requirements.

• Ability to travel domestically and internationally, as required, to support site relationship management, sponsor oversight, and key business needs; anticipated travel up to 25–30%.

Preferred Experience, Education and Specialized Knowledge and Skills:

• Strategic, solutions-oriented professional who creates structure, sets direction, and drives execution in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

• Demonstrates sound judgment and operational leadership, with the ability to anticipate risks, establish priorities, and implement effective mitigation strategies.

• Recognizes when risks to quality or delivery require timely escalation to strategy leadership and communicates the issue, potential impact, and recommended actions.

• Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with senior internal and external stakeholders, escalate key issues, and present concise recommendations to leadership.

• Broad expertise across clinical trial operations, including site start-up, enrollment, site and patient experience, sponsor oversight, and the drug development lifecycle.

• Ability to influence, build alignment, and support accountability across cross-functional, matrixed, and external stakeholder groups.

• Demonstrated ability to translate data, KPIs, and site insights into strategic recommendations and measurable operational improvements.

jobs.title: Head of Online Business, US
jobs.description:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store. 

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko. 

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US. 

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!



This position is based in New York.




🇺🇸 OUR US TEAM

The US is our biggest international priority. We already work with more than 10,000 brands, including Nike, Best Buy, Macy’s, Expedia, and Lululemon, and our ambition is to make the US our largest market within the next three years.

We’re building our local team, led by our Co-founder and CRO, based in New York. You’ll join us at an early stage of our US expansion, with an established product, an existing user base, and a business model that has scaled in our core market.




✨ WHY THIS ROLE IS SPECIAL

As Head of Online Business, US, you will build and lead our US commercial function. Reporting directly to our co-founder and CRO until we hire a US General Manager, you will define our commercial strategy, grow revenue through merchant partnerships, and build the team to scale the business.

Your scope will span winning new partners, growing existing relationships, negotiating compelling offers for our users, and developing our media revenue business. You will work closely with the Product, Marketing, Operations, and Data teams to achieve commercial results.




🎯 WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - US commercial strategy and performance. Set priorities and commercial targets, win the highest-potential partners and categories, and drive revenue growth.

 - US commercial team. Define hiring priorities, recruit and develop a talented team, and establish clear goals and accountability as the team grows.

 - New merchant partnerships. Build relationships with brands, affiliate networks, and agencies. Lead strategic negotiations, expand our access to key affiliate programs, and secure terms that create value for both our users and our partners.

 - Growth of existing accounts. Build commercial relationships with key partners, negotiate more compelling offers for our users and better commission rates, and turn successful campaigns into deeper, longer-term commercial relationships.

 - Media revenue. Develop our paid placement offering with our Marketing team, define packages and pricing, and win advertiser budgets by demonstrating the value of our audience and the results our campaigns deliver.

 - US market presence. Increase Joko’s visibility in the industry by attending key events and meeting with brands, networks, and agencies.

 - Commercial execution. Build a disciplined approach to pipeline management, account planning, forecasting, and performance reviews.




👀 WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience. You have 10+ years of experience in fast-paced environments, ideally in tech or startups, including at least 5 years in commercial roles.

 - Management. You have significant experience hiring, leading, and developing high-performing teams.

 - Entrepreneurial spirit. You enjoy building from scratch, embrace challenges, and take a hands-on approach to solving problems and pursuing ambitious goals.

 - Independence. You manage projects independently from start to finish, set high standards, and take ownership of results.

 - Interpersonal skills. You communicate clearly and persuasively, both verbally and in writing, and build lasting relationships with partners and colleagues.

 - Values. You work collaboratively, act with integrity and transparency, and bring humility and a commitment to continuous learning.

 - Business acumen. You quickly understand partners’ needs, identify commercial opportunities, and close deals that help you exceed your goals.

 - Attention to detail. You pay close attention to detail, spot issues early, and deliver thorough, accurate work.

 - Location. You are based in New York, or ready to relocate.

 - Languages. You are fluent in English. French is not required.




💎 OUR PERKS

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

 - Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

 - Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

 - 💸 Top-market compensation

 - 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

 - 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

 - 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

 - 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

 - 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

 - …and much more, check the full list here https://notion.so/joko/20f4ead2bfc54137b9d805bd9abbb758?pvs=4&v=e2baac50c1844149a219895e0d1c2912!




🤝 OUR HIRING PROCESS

 1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

 2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

 3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments
    
    - For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).
    
    - For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

 4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

 5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

jobs.title: Internal Penetration Tester
jobs.description:
About the Role

The Internal Penetration Tester works to execute offensive security activities for Pathfynder by A-LIGN. In this role, you will be responsible for the delivery of internal network and cloud-based SaaS penetration testing engagements. As the Internal Penetration Tester, you will provide exceptional technical and client-focused testing strategies to help support the continued growth of our fast-paced company. A-LIGN will depend on you as the Internal Penetration Tester to independently identify and validate real-world security risks, manually exploit vulnerabilities, document findings, and communicate practical remediation guidance to clients.

Reports to

Director, Internal Offensive Operations

Pay Classification

Full-Time, Exempt

Responsibilities

• Execute internal network and cloud-based SaaS penetration testing engagements

• Identify, validate, and manually exploit vulnerabilities using public exploits, custom-developed exploits, or a combination of techniques

• Evaluate findings in context, explore realistic attack paths, and accurately assess business and technical risk

• Deliver clear, accurate, client-ready reports that explain findings, evidence, and actionable remediation guidance

• Communicate technical issues, testing results, and remediation recommendations to client stakeholders

• Maintain project quality and timelines while executing assigned engagements with minimal oversight

• Collaborate with the offensive security team to evaluate industry tools, improve delivery methods, and share technical knowledge

• Mentor team members and contribute to the continued development of team capabilities

Minimum Qualifications

EDUCATION

• Degree in cybersecurity, computer information systems, related discipline or equivalent professional

EXPERIENCE

• 5+ years of hands-on offensive security experience, including at least 3 years focused on internal network, Active Directory, red team, or purple team penetration testing

• Experience with network and system exploitation across enterprise environments

• Knowledge of penetration testing methodologies and current offensive security practices

• Experience applying current tactics, techniques, and procedures related to EDR bypass, lateral movement, and privilege escalation

• Preferred red team or purple team penetration testing experience

• Preferred wireless penetration testing experience

• Preferred consulting or client-facing security delivery experience

CERTIFICATIONS

• Preferred OSCP, CEH, or OSEP certification.

• Preferred additional advanced certifications relevant to internal network, Active Directory, red team, or cloud security testing

SKILLS

• Passion for information security and identifying exploitable vulnerabilities before threat actors can take advantage of them.

• Ability to discover and exploit complex vulnerabilities while maintaining a disciplined and repeatable approach to testing.

• Knowledge of Active Directory attack paths, network exploitation, lateral movement, privilege escalation, and defence evasion techniques.

• Proficiency with scripting languages such as Python, Bash, JavaScript, PowerShell, or SQL.

• Proficiency with commonly used offensive security tools such as Nmap, BloodHound, the Impacket suite, Metasploit, Wireshark, and Nessus.

• Knowledge of multiple penetration testing concentrations and the ability to select appropriate methodologies and tools.

• Ability to write clear, concise, client-ready reports with accurate findings and actionable remediation guidance.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical risks to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, remote environment while meeting deadlines.

• Continuous desire to grow technical capabilities, improve delivery efficiency, and share knowledge with team members and clients.

• Cloud architecture knowledge across AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform is preferred.

Benefits

• Healthcare, Dental, and Vision Benefits

• Employer Paid Life Insurance and Disability Insurance

• EAP - Employee Assistance Program

• Pet Insurance

• 401(k) Plan with Employer Matching

• Competitive Bonus Structure

• Technology Allowance

• Certification Reimbursement

• Personalised Career Coaching

• Generous Paid Time Off

• Paid Office Closure December 25-January 1

• Vacation Bonus

• Summer Hours

About Pathfynder by A-LIGN

Pathfynder by A-LIGN is a technology-enabled cybersecurity company providing offensive and defensive cybersecurity services under A-LIGN, a security and compliance partner trusted by more than 2,400 global organisations to help mitigate cybersecurity risks. We work with organisations ranging from small businesses to global enterprises, with services spanning SOC, Penetration Testing, PCI DSS, HITRUST, ISO, and privacy compliance. Our proprietary compliance management platform is transforming the compliance experience by enabling an anytime, anywhere approach to audits. To learn more, visit A-LIGN.com.

Come Work for A-LIGN!

Apply online today at A-LIGN.com and learn about life at A-LIGN by following us on LinkedIn.

A-LIGN is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Minorities, women, disabled individuals, and veterans are encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Senior Accounting Clerk (Contract)
jobs.description:
Liquid Death is a better for you beverage company that will murder your thirst with a wide range of low calorie beverages from water to iced tea to energy drinks. Our goal is to be the funniest beverage brand on earth and to make health and sustainability 50 times more fun.

Location: remote USA anywhere (east coast time zone preferred)
Reports To: Senior Director, Controller

Travel: up to 10% occasional travel for team meetings, as needed

Contract Period: Contract / temporary through December 2026

Liquid Death is a better for you beverage company that will murder your thirst with a wide range of low calorie beverages from water to iced tea to energy drinks. Our goal is to be the funniest beverage brand on earth and to make health and sustainability 50 times more fun.

About the Role

Liquid Death is looking for a Senior Accounting Clerk who knows that getting the details right keeps the business moving.

In this role, you’ll manage day-to-day accounting transactions with a primary focus on accounts payable. From processing vendor invoices and credits to maintaining accurate records and resolving payment discrepancies, you’ll help ensure our accounting operations run accurately and on time. You’ll also support month-end close by preparing reconciliations, maintaining supporting schedules, and organizing documentation for the accounting team.

You’ll partner closely with Finance, Operations, Sales, and Marketing to obtain approvals, resolve transaction questions, and keep information flowing. You bring strong attention to detail, dependable follow-through, and the ability to manage established workflows independently while recognizing when an issue needs additional review.

We’re also an AI-forward company. We use approved tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini to help with recurring, standardized work, then carefully review the outputs. You’ll help identify practical ways to simplify routine tasks while following company requirements for accuracy, confidentiality, and financial controls.

What You’ll Do

Keep accounts payable running smoothly

• Maintain accurate vendor records, including new vendor setup, approved changes, tax forms, and documentation supporting 1099 reporting.

• Process vendor invoices and credits in Tipalti, checking for complete documentation, appropriate coding, required approvals, and duplicate submissions.

• Partner with Operations, Sales, and Marketing to obtain timely invoice reviews, approvals, and supporting information.

• Prepare payment batches and supporting documentation for review and approval in accordance with established controls.

• Respond to vendor inquiries, research invoice and payment discrepancies, and follow through on outstanding credits and balances.

• Prepare AP aging reports and flag overdue items, missing approvals, and other issues requiring follow-up.

• Reconcile vendor statements and assist with AP subledger-to-general-ledger reconciliations, escalating unresolved differences.

Support accounting records and month-end close

• Complete assigned transaction processing and close-support tasks within established deadlines.

• Maintain supporting schedules and documentation for payables, prepaid expenses, and other assigned accounting activities.

• Identify unpaid invoices and gather information to support the accounting team’s preparation of month-end accruals.

• Prepare routine journal entries using established templates and procedures for review and approval by the accounting team.

• Verify account coding and transaction dates against established guidelines, escalating unusual or unclear items.

• Research reconciling differences and help resolve missing, incomplete, or inaccurate transaction records.

Maintain organized records and follow established controls

• Keep invoices, approvals, payment records, reconciliations, and other supporting documents complete and accessible.

• Review transaction reports for missing information, duplicate entries, and other potential errors.

• Retrieve records and prepare supporting documentation for audit, tax, and other accounting requests under the accounting team’s direction.

• Follow established approval procedures and financial controls, promptly flagging exceptions or discrepancies.

• Handle confidential vendor, payment, and business information with discretion.

Improve how the work gets done

• Identify practical ways to improve data accuracy, simplify routine reconciliations, and reduce manual work.

• Assist with testing accounting system updates and changes to established workflows.

• Support responsible use of approved automation and AI tools, verifying outputs before use.

• Maintain clear process documentation and provide backup support for related accounting tasks as needed.

Qualifications Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree preferred with at least 3 years of relatable accounting operations, bookkeeping, or related experience, including at least 2 years of hands-on accounts payable experience

• Working knowledge of accounts payable processes, debits and credits, account coding, reconciliations, and basic accrual concepts required

• Experience using an ERP or accounting system; Netsuite and Tipalti experience preferred

• Proficiency with Excel and Google Sheets, including sorting, filtering, formulas, and lookup functions; familiarity with pivot tables preferred

• Strong attention to detail and the ability to process transactions accurately while managing competing deadlines

• Experience researching invoice, payment, and account discrepancies and following issues through to resolution

• Exceptional organizational and time management experience with adaptability to work in a high change / continuous improvement focused environment with an entrepreneurial mindset

• The ability to work independently within established procedures and recognize when an issue requires escalation

• Clear communication skills and a collaborative approach to working with vendors and internal partners

• Adaptability and a willingness to learn new systems and improve established processes

• Uses discretion and integrity when handling confidential financial and business information

• Willingness to travel up to 10% as needed

The typical salary range for this position is: $30.00 - $35.00 per hour (non exempt)

This range reflects an estimate of the anticipated hourly compensation for this role and does not include potential bonuses, equity, or benefits. The actual hourly rate offer will take into account multiple factors including skills, experience, education, location, and applicable federal, state, and local wage and hour laws. Where state or local minimum hourly/ salary requirements exceed the posted range, the Company will adjust compensation accordingly.

#LI-REMOTE
