jobs.title: Account Manager, US
jobs.description:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store. 

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko. 

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US. 

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!



This position is based in New York.




🇺🇸 OUR US TEAM

The US is our biggest international priority. We already work with more than 10,000 brands, including Nike, Best Buy, Macy’s, Expedia, and Lululemon, and our ambition is to make the US our largest market within the next three years.

We’re building our local team, led by our Co-founder and CRO, based in New York. You’ll join us at an early stage of our US expansion, with an established product, an existing user base, and a business model that has scaled in our core market.




✨ WHY THIS ROLE IS SPECIAL

As Account Manager, US, you will join our founding commercial team in the US and own a portfolio of US merchant partnerships. Working closely with our Co-founder and CRO and our wider Partnerships team, you will build lasting relationships, grow revenue from your accounts, and negotiate compelling offers for our users.

Your role will combine growing existing accounts with developing new partnerships. You will work directly with brands, affiliate networks, and agencies to understand their priorities, identify commercial opportunities, and turn them into successful campaigns and long-term relationships.

As an early member of our US team, you will also help shape how we work: bringing ideas, building practical account management processes, and sharing market feedback with our Product and Marketing teams.




🎯 WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Account ownership and growth. Manage a portfolio of merchant partners, build plans around their goals, and identify opportunities to grow revenue and deepen each relationship.

 - Commercial negotiations. Negotiate commission rates, cash back offers, and campaign terms that deliver value for our users and partners while supporting our commercial goals.

 - New merchant partnerships. Build relationships with brands, affiliate networks, and agencies, secure access to relevant affiliate programs, and turn new opportunities into active partnerships.

 - Performance analysis. Monitor account and campaign performance, identify what is driving results, and recommend improvements. Prepare clear presentations and business reviews that demonstrate the value we deliver to partners.

 - Commercial processes and collaboration. Help improve our account management processes, contribute to commercial priorities, and support new teammates as we grow.

 - US market presence. Represent us in partner meetings and at industry events. Bring merchant feedback and market insights back to our Product and Marketing teams to help shape our US offering.




👀 WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience. You have at least 5 years of experience in account management, partnerships, sales, or a related commercial role, ideally in a fast-paced tech company or startup.

 - Account growth. You have a track record of growing commercial relationships, identifying new opportunities within existing accounts, and delivering against revenue goals.

 - Business acumen. You understand partners’ needs, build compelling proposals, and know how to negotiate agreements that create value for both sides.

 - E-commerce knowledge. You understand how online retail and affiliate marketing work. Experience with affiliate networks is a strong plus.

 - Analytical skills. You use account and campaign data to understand performance, prioritize opportunities, and make clear recommendations to partners.

 - Entrepreneurial spirit. You enjoy building from scratch, take a hands-on approach to solving problems, and bring ideas that help the team improve.

 - Interpersonal skills. You communicate clearly and persuasively, both verbally and in writing, and build trusted relationships with partners and colleagues.

 - Attention to detail. You are thorough in your proposals, commercial terms, campaign coordination, and reporting, and you follow through on your commitments.

 - Location. You are based in New York, or ready to relocate.

 - Languages. You are fluent in English. French is not required.




💎 OUR PERKS

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

 - Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

 - Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

 - 💸 Top-market compensation

 - 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

 - 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

 - 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

 - 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

 - 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

 - …and much more, check the full list here https://notion.so/joko/20f4ead2bfc54137b9d805bd9abbb758?pvs=4&v=e2baac50c1844149a219895e0d1c2912!




🤝 OUR HIRING PROCESS

 1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

 2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

 3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments
    
    - For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).
    
    - For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

 4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

 5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Team

STR’s Intelligence Division researches, develops, and transitions advanced analytics and machine-learning solutions for challenging national-security problems. Our team includes engineers and researchers with advanced backgrounds in engineering, computer science, mathematics, and data science who apply deep technical expertise and creativity to mission-critical challenges.

Our work spans data analysis, deep learning, and statistical methods across networking, communications, social media, text, time series, geospatial, and imagery data. We develop capabilities under constraints not typically encountered in commercial environments. U.S. Government analysts use our tools and technologies to extract, enrich, and act on intelligence information worldwide.

The Role

As a Lead Software Engineer, you will lead the technical execution of mission-relevant software systems that operationalize advanced analytics, machine learning, and data-processing capabilities. You will apply software and systems engineering expertise to develop scalable, secure, maintainable applications that operate in complex customer environments.

You will work with software engineers, systems engineers, researchers, and mission partners to translate customer needs into executable technical plans. You will own technical delivery for an assigned project or major subsystem, guiding architecture, implementation, integration, testing, demonstration, and transition.

What You Will Do:

• Lead project execution: Lead software development from requirements definition through implementation, integration, test, demonstration, deployment, and sustainment

• Translate mission needs into plans: Convert customer objectives into requirements, architectures, development plans, milestones, performance measures, and acceptance criteria

• Lead the technical team: Lead and mentor software engineers and collaborate with systems engineers, researchers, DevSecOps personnel, and mission partners

• Manage technical work: Decompose complex work into actionable tasks; manage dependencies, technical risks, interfaces, and progress toward program objectives

• Own project architecture: Design and oversee architectures spanning services, APIs, data pipelines, databases, ML integrations, user interfaces, and deployment infrastructure

• Drive integration and quality: Lead design reviews, code reviews, integration activities, testing, customer demonstrations, and release readiness; ensure reliability, security, maintainability, and performance

• Support growth and transition: Contribute technical content to proposals, customer engagements, and transition planning while ensuring delivered capabilities are reusable and mission relevant

Who You Are:

• Education and experience: PhD with 2+ years, MS with 6+ years, or BS with 8+ years of relevant experience in computer science, software engineering, computer engineering, or a related technical discipline

• Clearance eligibility: Ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret security clearance, for which U.S citizenship is needed by the U.S government

• Technical delivery leadership: Experience leading software development efforts or major workstreams involving applications, services, distributed systems, data platforms, or related domains

• Systems engineering: Experience translating customer needs into software requirements, designs, development plans, test plans, and integrated capabilities

• Software development: Proficiency in one or more programming languages, such as Python, C++, Java, Go, or similar languages, with experience developing and maintaining production-quality software

• Engineering practices: Experience with Git, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, issue tracking, documentation, and secure software-development practices

• Communication and collaboration: Ability to lead technical discussions, communicate risks and tradeoffs, and work effectively with customers and multidisciplinary teams

Even Better

• Clearance: Active Secret, Top Secret, or TS/SCI security clearance

• Architecture experience: Experience designing system or software architectures for distributed, data-intensive, real-time, cloud, on-premises, or edge systems

• DevSecOps experience: Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure automation, container orchestration, cloud platforms, monitoring, logging, and security tooling

• Large codebase experience: Experience developing software in large, multi-team code bases using collaborative engineering practices

• Decentralized systems: Familiarity with message queues, stream processing, distributed computing, or microservices

• Customer and capture support: Experience supporting technical proposals, customer demonstrations, technical briefings, or capture activities with DoW or IC customers

• Modern development tools: Experience using LLM-enabled development tools, such as Cursor or Codex, in a secure and effective engineering workflow

Pay Information
Full-Time Salary Range: $180,000 - $230,000
The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.

STR is a growing technology company with locations near Boston, MA, Arlington, VA, near Dayton, OH, Melbourne, FL, Carlsbad, CA, Atlanta, GA, and Denver, CO. We specialize in advanced research and development for defense, intelligence, and national security in: cyber; next generation sensors, radar, sonar, communications, and electronic warfare; and artificial intelligence algorithms and analytics to make sense of the complexity that is exploding around us.

STR is committed to creating a collaborative learning environment that supports deep technical understanding and recognizes the contributions and achievements of all team members. Our work is challenging, and we go home at night knowing that we pushed the envelope of technology and made the world safer.

STR is not just any company. Our people, culture, and attitude along with their unique set of skills, experiences, and perspectives put us on a trajectory to change the world. We can't do it alone, though - we need fellow trailblazers. If you are one, join our team and help to keep our society safe! Visit us at www.str.us for more info.

STR is an equal opportunity employer. We are fully dedicated to hiring the most qualified candidate regardless of race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation and pregnancy), marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

If you need a reasonable accommodation for any portion of the employment process, email us at appassist@str.us and provide your contact info.

Pursuant to applicable federal law and regulations, positions at STR require employees to obtain national security clearances and satisfy the requirements for compliance with export control and other applicable laws.

jobs.title: Executive Concierge
jobs.description:
At Bozzuto, every team member shares a deep commitment to doing good for those around us. We live this each day by designing, building, managing and maintaining one-of-a-kind residences. Whether it’s the talent within our communities or the expertise across our property operations teams, we work together to make extraordinary happen for our clients, residents and fellow team members.

Our people are dedicated to delivering exceptional experiences to everyone we serve including each other. This shared purpose drives us to excel in every role and fosters a welcoming, inclusive workplace where teamwork thrives. Guided by our core values of concern, creativity, passion and the pursuit of perfection, we are inspired and empowered to reach higher, unlock our full potential and be truly extraordinary.

Primary Responsibilities:

The role of Executive Concierge is one of both doing and leading. You and each of your team members are empowered to make first and lasting impressions with all prospects and residents. You take ownership and pride in creating stellar first impressions and building ongoing positive relationships and you are a role model for others who need to do the same. Your natural ability to strike up a conversation and make people feel “at home” is what drives excellence in resident services. You enjoy personalizing every interaction and consider it a challenge to learn the names and favorite things of all of your customers (that goes for four-legged residents too).

As an Executive Concierge, your primary responsibilities include:

• Schedule: Wednesday-Sunday 7:00 AM- 3:00 PM

• Leading by example, living the standards and behaviors consistent with the core values and culture of Bozzuto

• Coaching, mentoring and providing training to other members of the resident services team

• Solving problems and providing timely assistance to residents and prospects with care

• Planning and executing meaningful events and activities that engage residents and foster a sense of community

• Building brand loyalty and achieving resident retention goals by ensuring a consistently positive experience and a meticulously cared for community

• Generating awareness, interest and excitement via social media

• Encouraging happy customers to share the love by writing reviews on social networking sites

• Obsessively organizing front desk logs, package rooms, club room reservations and freight elevators

• Working weekends or evenings depending on the shift

You Create Value by:

• Building a motivating environment that encourages your team to give their very best

• Stepping in and taking responsibility for leading when the PM/APM is not present

• Engaging people in meaningful conversations that demonstrate your concern and genuine desire to make them feel at home

• Solving problems for your customers and treating them like you would your best friend

• Meticulously following up with everyone

• Playing an active role in making certain the community is impeccable

• Jumping in and covering for team members when needed

• Seeking out opportunities to enhance the customer’s experience

What You Bring to Us:

• 2+ years’ experience in a hospitality, retail, travel or hotel environment

• Proficient in leveraging social media platforms such as Facebook and Instagram, and a passion to create and deliver engaging and distinctive content.

• Outstanding communication skills, both written and verbal

• A sharp professional appearance

• Competent with various software, apps and computer programs

• An eye for detail and a knack for anticipating a customer’s needs

• A customer-focused mentality

• Ability to lift up to 25 pounds (we deliver a lot of packages during the holidays!)

This position is eligible for additional bonus opportunities.

Salary Range

$22—$23 USD

When you join Bozzuto, you're not just accepting a job; you are becoming part of a community that cares about your overall well-being and professional growth. We recognize that our team members are the core of our business, and we are committed to taking care of them so they can deliver outstanding experiences to our residents. In addition to an award-winning culture, our benefits take into consideration everything from career development, retirement, family matters and health and wellness.

Working on our team and in this position, you can expect:

• Competitive compensation.

• Health & wellness benefits. We offer coverage for medical, dental, and vision, including access to the best doctors at an affordable price.

• Paid leave. We provide 20 days of paid time off plus holidays.

• Retirement planning. We offer a 401k program with a company match.

• Tuition reimbursement. Plus, many other programs to support career development and growth.

• A place you belong. We proudly offer a diverse range of employee resource groups, providing opportunities for our employees to connect over shared experiences, backgrounds, and cultures.

Bozzuto is proudly an Equal Opportunity Employer.

California Consumer Privacy Act (“CCPA”) Notice to Applicants:

Please read the California Employee Privacy Notice (“CA Privacy Notice”) regarding Sunnyside* and its affiliate Cresco Labs’ policies pertaining to the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information. jobs.title: Head of Sales Strategy and Operations
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Courier Health is on a mission to solve one of the biggest and most meaningful opportunities in healthcare: reinvent how people living with chronic and rare diseases are supported.

We are building the future of patient engagement for life sciences companies. Our software is leveraged by biopharma companies to support patients in their complex journey from diagnosis to initiating and remaining on therapy to achieve optimal health outcomes.

Come Build with Us

We’re a NYC-based team that believes culture, craft, and customer obsession go hand in hand. We show up for each other the same way we show up for the people we serve. We’re an office-first company that values in-person collaboration 4 days per week because we believe the best work happens when you can collaborate and brainstorm together in the same room. If that sounds like your kind of place, we think you’ll love it here.

The Opportunity

Courier Health is signing faster than the function around our sales team can currently support. We exist to get patients faster, better access to life-saving therapies, and every program we win is another population we reach. What determines how fast that happens is no longer just how well we sell. I’s how we price, where we point the team, how the hard deals get structured, and whether leadership can see what’s actually working. This role owns that.

As Head of Sales Strategy & Operations, you’ll report to the Chief Commercial Officer and own everything that sits around the sales organization: pricing and packaging, deal desk, territory and coverage, commercial analytics, planning cadence, enablement, and the systems underneath all of it. You’ll also be the connection point between Sales and Product, Product Marketing, and Finance.

Most of this is still being written. The pricing frameworks, the approval model, the metrics leadership runs the business on, you’ll build them and then run them. If you’ve spent your career tuning someone else’s commercial engine, this is the seat where you design it. The calls you make in your first year become how Courier Health goes to market for the next five.

What You’ll Build

Pricing, packaging, and how deals get done. You’ll own what we charge, what’s bundled, and what a new capability is worth to a customer and keep evolving it as the product moves. Underneath that, you’ll build the deal desk: structure, terms, approvals, and real partnership with sellers on the opportunities that matter most. Done right, the framework makes deals move faster, not slower.

A coverage model that scales ahead of the pipeline. Segmentation, territory design, account prioritization, and the capacity math that tells us when to hire and where to aim. You’ll work with the CCO and executive team on where we play (which segments, which use cases, which commercial models) and turn those calls into plans the sales team can actually run. Then you’ll set the operating rhythm that keeps it honest: pipeline reviews, forecasting, target setting, business reviews.

A commercial picture leadership can act on. Pipeline health, conversion, cycle length, win/loss, segment performance, productivity - defined once, measured consistently, and reported in a form that changes decisions instead of describing them. You’ll own the systems and data underneath it too: CRM strategy, sales workflows, data standards, and the tooling that gives sellers their time back. You’ll partner with Finance on the forecast and own the read on why the numbers look the way they do.

A sales team that gets better every quarter. Onboarding, playbooks, methodology, and competitive resources built so sellers understand the customer’s problem, not just our product. You’ll also be the channel back: deal patterns, loss reasons, unmet needs, and market intelligence reaching Product and Product Marketing on a schedule rather than by accident. ICPs, positioning, and launch readiness should reflect what’s actually happening in live deals.

What Makes You Successful

• 10+ years in sales strategy, revenue operations, commercial strategy, or management consulting, including 3+ years leading the function at a high-growth B2B software company.

• Hands-on depth in pricing and packaging, deal structuring, territory design, and commercial analytics. You’ve built these, not inherited them.

• Exceptional analytical ability. You can get to the insight yourself and make it legible to an executive audience in one page.

• A track record of building process a team actually adopted and kept without adding drag to the sale.

• Strong command of enterprise sales dynamics: long cycles, multiple stakeholders, real procurement.

• Credibility with executives, including the willingness to disagree with one when the data says to.

• Comfortable moving between the framework and the spreadsheet. You’d rather build the model than wait for one.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, especially turning commercial data into a recommendation someone can act on.

• Comfortable with autonomy and ambiguity at an early-stage company.

Bonus points if you have:

• Experience in life sciences, healthcare, or health tech.

• Built a deal desk from scratch.

• Worked closely with Product and Product Marketing on positioning, launches, and competitive intelligence.

• Depth in Salesforce and the modern commercial stack - CPQ, forecasting, and enablement tooling.

Benefits

• 100% paid employee health benefit options (including medical, dental, and vision)

• 401(k) with employer funded match

• Unlimited Vacation

• Commuter Benefits

• Paid parental leave

• Catered lunch on Fridays

• Wellness stipend

Compensation

The annual salary range for the target level for this role is $245,000-$275,000 + equity + benefits, including medical, dental, and vision. Final compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors including relevant experience, interview performance, and internal equity.

Courier Health is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

AI is changing what security teams can do. Claude can find and help fix vulnerabilities in code at a pace that wasn't possible a year ago, and we want defenders to have that advantage first.

As Manager, Cybersecurity Sales Specialists, you'll build and lead the team of cybersecurity specialists who sell to security teams across our Americas business units, including financial services, healthcare and life sciences, and technology. Your team partners with the Account Executives in each industry to lead the security strategy and the security deal with CISOs.

You'll help shape how Anthropic sells security: how your team covers the business units, how it works with the Account Executive and Applied AI organizations, and how what we learn from customers shapes what we build. The work matters to our mission: a safe transition through transformative AI depends on the people who defend critical systems being able to use it well, and this team is how we get it into their hands.

Responsibilities

• Hire, onboard and develop a high-performing team of cybersecurity sales specialists

• Own your team's forecast, pipeline health and results across the business units you cover

• Set your team's coverage model, and agree on clear rules of engagement with the sales leaders who own each industry and with Applied AI leadership on discovery, proofs of concept and architecture

• Build a pipeline engine with the Account Executives, across their existing accounts and through outbound to security leaders, events and partners

• Coach your team through complex deals that lead with the customer's problem (finding and fixing vulnerabilities, application security, security operations, and deploying AI agents securely), and act as executive sponsor with CISOs on the most important ones

• Make security reviews, verification for security use cases, and procurement a repeatable path rather than a deal-by-deal effort

• Scale enablement so Account Executives across every business unit can spot and qualify security opportunities

• Bring what your team hears from security customers to sales leadership and to our product, safeguards and marketing teams, and turn it into input on the roadmap

• Run a healthy team: clear expectations, regular feedback, and performance and development conversations

Minimum Qualifications

• Experience building and leading a cybersecurity sales team that carried a number, whether direct, specialist or overlay, including hiring, coaching and managing performance

• Track record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals where the security organization was the buyer or the deciding approver, and of coaching others to do the same

• Fluency in how security teams work, built by selling directly to CISOs, application security leads and security engineers

• Depth in at least one security domain, such as application security, vulnerability management, security operations, cloud, data, identity or endpoint security

• History of building a business before there was an established approach, through outbound and partners rather than inherited accounts

• Ability to lead through influence as well as authority, so that Account Executives and their leaders bring your team in because it helps them win

• Consultative approach to selling and coaching: understanding the problem before proposing anything, and being honest about what a product can't do

• Commitment to making AI systems safe and beneficial

Preferred Qualifications

• Background selling security in one of the industries we cover, and an understanding of how security is bought and regulated there

• Experience managing managers and individual contributors, or scaling a sales team through fast growth

• Experience leading teams selling AI, developer or data platform products to technical buyers

• Time spent as a security practitioner or sales engineer before moving into sales leadership

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$450,000—$550,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Lead Network Systems Researcher
jobs.description:
About the Team

STR’s Intelligence Division researches, develops, and transitions advanced analytics and machine-learning solutions for challenging national-security problems. Our team includes engineers and researchers with advanced backgrounds in engineering, computer science, mathematics, and data science who apply deep technical expertise and creativity to mission-critical challenges.

Our work spans data analysis, deep learning, and statistical methods across networking, communications, social media, text, time series, geospatial, and imagery data. We develop capabilities under constraints not typically encountered in commercial environments. U.S. Government analysts use our tools and technologies to extract, enrich, and act on intelligence information worldwide.

The Role

As a Lead Network Systems Researcher, you will lead the technical execution of advanced networking, communications, and ML-enabled systems. You will apply state-of-the-art machine-learning methods, networking expertise, and systems-engineering skills to challenges involving disparate and unlabeled data sources, real-time data communications, and networked systems.

You will work with software engineers, systems engineers, algorithm developers, researchers, and academic collaborators to develop, integrate, test, and transition mission-relevant capabilities. You will guide project technical direction, translate customer needs into executable plans, and ensure delivered systems meet high standards for quality, performance, maintainability, testability, reuse, and security.

What You Will Do:

• Lead project execution: Lead technical execution of networking, communications, and ML-enabled systems projects from requirements definition through development, integration, test, demonstration, and transition

• Translate mission needs into plans: Convert customer needs and mission objectives into system requirements, technical architectures, development and test plans, milestones, performance metrics, and acceptance criteria

• Lead the technical team: Lead and mentor multidisciplinary teams of software engineers, systems engineers, researchers, and algorithm developers

• Manage technical work: Decompose technical problems into actionable tasks; assign work, manage dependencies and risks, and track execution against program objectives

• Own project architecture: Design and oversee implementation of architectures spanning network protocols, data pipelines, ML models, edge and network-core compute, and external interfaces

• Drive integration and quality: Lead design reviews, code reviews, integration activities, technical demonstrations, and customer engagements; ensure delivered systems meet quality, performance, maintainability, testability, security, and reuse standards

• Apply advanced methods: Apply state-of-the-art ML and statistical methods to networking, communications, and real-time data challenges in collaboration with customers, mission partners, academic collaborators, and industry partners

Who You Are:

• Education and experience: PhD with 2+ years, MS with 6+ years, or BS with 8+ years of relevant experience in computer science, machine learning, computer/electrical engineering, or a related technical discipline

• Clearance eligibility: Ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret security clearance for which U.S Citizenship is needed by the U.S government

• Technical delivery leadership: Experience leading technical development efforts or major workstreams involving software, systems, networking, communications, machine learning, or related domains

• Systems engineering: Experience translating customer or mission needs into technical requirements, system designs, development and test plans, and integrated software and/or hardware systems

• ML expertise: Experience applying state-of-the-art ML methods, including unsupervised and semi-supervised learning techniques, to real-world problems across resource-constrained edge and resource-rich network-core environments

• Networking expertise: Strong understanding of networking and communications theory across the OSI model

• Engineering and communication practices: Working knowledge of software design patterns and engineering best practices, including integration, testing, version control, and collaboration tools such as Git, JIRA, and Confluence; strong written and verbal communication skills

Even Better:

• Clearance: Active Top Secret security clearance

• Collaborative software development: Experience developing software in large, multi-party code bases using collaborative engineering practices and modern developer tools, including LLM-enabled coding tools such as Cursor or Codex.

• Protocol-layer development: Experience developing, integrating, testing, or evaluating software at the PHY, MAC, Network, or Application layers

• Communications domain expertise: Experience with 5G system development, testing, evaluation, network management, network security, and/or protocol analysis

• Customer and capture support: Experience supporting technical proposals, customer demonstrations, or capture activities with DoW or IC customers

Pay Information
Full-Time Salary Range: $180,000 - $230,000.
The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.

STR is a growing technology company with locations near Boston, MA, Arlington, VA, near Dayton, OH, Melbourne, FL, Carlsbad, CA, Atlanta, GA, and Denver, CO. We specialize in advanced research and development for defense, intelligence, and national security in: cyber; next generation sensors, radar, sonar, communications, and electronic warfare; and artificial intelligence algorithms and analytics to make sense of the complexity that is exploding around us.

jobs.description:
About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

• HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

• HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

• HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

• HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

Overview of Role:

The Manager of QA reports to the Director of QA and will provide quality oversight for the Product Complaint program. This will include investigation resolution for complaints associated with clinical and commercial material. The Manager will also be responsible for ensuring Summit departments and systems are inspection ready by way of conducting internal and external audits,  supporting inspection readiness activities, and authoring and updating internal procedures and Quality Technical Agreements (QTA).

Role and Responsibilities:

• Serve as the liaison for our commercial product complaint call center and also manage clinical product complaints.

• Ensure product complaints are investigated and resolved, in accordance with internal requirements and regulatory expectations.

• Support product compliant reconciliation with the call center and Pharmacovigilance.

• Continuously improve the internal product complaint program in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

• Serve as Auditor for internal audits and external audits.

• Ensure internal and external audit responses and appropriate CAPAs are identified and managed through to resolution in a timely manner and deliverables are met.

• Continuously improve internal and external audit programs to remain current with applicable laws and regulations.

• Provide support for the initial review, periodic review, and revision of Summit QTAs.

• Write, revise, review and/or approve SOPs and other controlled documents.

• Ensure issues are identified and managed through resolution in a timely manner, management is notified, and deliverables are met.

• Participate in developing, reporting, reviewing and trending of quality and performance metrics, including in support of Annual Product Reviews (APRs).

• Support GMP inspection readiness activities.

• All other duties as assigned.

Experience, Education and Specialized Knowledge and Skills:

• Bachelor’s degree in chemistry, biochemistry, biotechnology, or other related life science discipline.

• Minimum of 5+ years of relevant experience.

• Experience managing product complaints.

• Strong knowledge of FDA, EMA, MHRA, ICH, PIC/S and international GMP/ GDP regulations governing clinical and commercial biologics.

• Experience serving as an auditor in both internal and external audits.

• Experience reviewing and approving QTAs.

• Demonstrated ability working within an eQMS to manage and close quality records in accordance with established timelines.

• Experience working with CMOs.

• Excellent communication skills both oral and written.

• Ability to work in a fast paced environment and efficiently manage projects and timelines.

• Experience working individually and within a team while balancing priorities.

• Attention to detail, accuracy, and thoroughness expected in all aspects of work.

About Loenbro

Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries, and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.

At Loenbro, we don’t just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose. Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.

Job Summary

The BIM/VDC Drafter is an entry-level opportunity for an individual looking to build a career in Building Information Modeling (BIM) and Virtual Design & Construction (VDC) within the electrical construction industry. Reporting to the VDC team, this position will support lead coordinators and project teams by developing and updating electrical models, generating shop drawings, and incorporating field redlines using Autodesk Revit and other BIM/VDC software.

Working closely with experienced BIM/VDC professionals, this individual will assist with model development, drawing revisions, and coordination efforts to help ensure electrical systems are accurately represented and ready for field installation. The role provides hands-on exposure to construction documentation, model coordination, and collaboration between design and field teams, with opportunities to develop technical skills and grow within the VDC discipline.

The ideal candidate has foundational experience with Autodesk Revit, a strong attention to detail, and a willingness to learn electrical construction modeling and coordination practices. Success in this role requires strong communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to work effectively as part of a small, team-oriented group. This is an in-office position designed for someone eager to learn from experienced team members, contribute to project success, and develop a long-term career in BIM/VDC.

Essential Job Responsibilities

• Assist lead BIM/VDC Coordinators with developing, modifying, and maintaining electrical models using Autodesk Revit.

• Generate and revise 2D electrical shop drawings from Revit models to support field installation.

• Update models and drawings to reflect field redlines, design revisions, and project changes.

• Support BIM modeling and coordination activities to help ensure electrical systems are accurately represented and properly integrated with other building systems.

• Assist with reviewing construction documents, design drawings, and project specifications to support accurate model development.

• Utilize Autodesk Revit and other BIM/VDC tools, including Navisworks, to support modeling, drawing production, and coordination efforts.

• Collaborate with BIM/VDC team members, project personnel, and field teams to communicate updates, address questions, and support project needs.

• Maintain accurate, organized, and up-to-date models and drawings in accordance with departmental standards and project requirements.

• Learn and apply established BIM/VDC processes, modeling standards, and electrical construction practices under the guidance of experienced team members.

• Perform other duties as assigned to support project execution and business operations.

Minimum Qualifications

Required:

• 0–2 years of experience using Autodesk Revit for drafting, modeling, design, or related applications.

• Foundational understanding of drafting principles, technical drawings, and 3D modeling concepts.

• Basic computer skills and the ability to learn new software, tools, and technical processes.

• Strong attention to detail and the ability to produce accurate, organized work.

• Effective verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with team members and communicate questions or project updates.

• Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment, receive feedback, and apply direction from experienced coordinators.

• Willingness to learn electrical construction modeling, BIM/VDC coordination processes, and applicable department standards.

• Ability to manage assigned tasks, meet deadlines, and stay organized in a project-driven environment.

Preferred:

• Experience with Autodesk Navisworks, AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud/BIM 360, or other related design and coordination software.

• Exposure to electrical, mechanical, plumbing (MEP), architectural, or other construction-related drafting and modeling.

• Familiarity with construction documents, shop drawings, field redlines, or design revisions.

• High school diploma or GED; an associate degree or relevant coursework in drafting, design technology, architecture, engineering technology, or a related field is a plus.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

Every choice in commerce, whether by a shopper, a search engine, a marketplace, or an AI assistant, is made on product data, and our software makes that data complete and trusted and moves it across the industry's largest two-sided commerce network: 15,000+ brands and 3,500+ retailers. Syndigo is hiring a Senior Manager, Procurement to establish and manage procurement practices that support the scale and complexity of the business.  Our spend is overwhelmingly indirect and technology-weighted — cloud infrastructure, software and SaaS, data and content licensing, professional services, contingent labor, marketing, and facilities — and it is currently sourced and contracted across multiple teams with inconsistent process and limited visibility.

This role leads key procurement activities end to end: category strategy, strategic sourcing, negotiation, contract lifecycle management, supplier performance and risk, and the intake-to-pay process that connects them. You will be the single accountable owner for spend under management and for the commercial terms Syndigo signs. Success is measured in hard savings and cost avoidance, cycle time from request to signature, and the degree to which the business stops experiencing procurement as a bottleneck.

You will report to the VP of Engineering – Infrastructure & DevOps and partner daily with Engineering, Technology, Legal, Information Security, Privacy, and the business unit leaders who own the requirements behind the spend.

HOW WE’LL BE WINNING TOGETHER DAY TO DAY

Procurement Strategy & Supplier Management

• Develop and execute Syndigo’s global procurement strategy, driving value, efficiency, and risk management across all third-party spend categories.

• Establish category strategies and supplier partnerships that support business growth and operational goals.

• Provide executive leadership with clear insights into supplier spend, performance, and savings opportunities.

Strategic Sourcing & Negotiation

• Lead sourcing initiatives and negotiations for key enterprise agreements, including software, cloud services, professional services, and strategic vendor partnerships.

• Drive favorable commercial terms, cost savings, and risk mitigation while ensuring long-term business value.

• Build proactive renewal and supplier management practices to maximize leverage and avoid unnecessary spend.

Contract & Risk Management

• Oversee the contract lifecycle in partnership with Legal, from intake and negotiation through execution, compliance, and renewal.

• Lead vendor risk and performance management programs, ensuring suppliers meet security, privacy, regulatory, and business requirements.

• Support governance for AI and emerging technology vendors, balancing innovation with risk management.

Financial & Operational Excellence

• Partner closely with Finance to deliver measurable savings, cost avoidance, and budgeting accuracy.

• Optimize procurement processes, systems, and policies to create a streamlined, scalable experience for stakeholders.

• Drive continuous improvement across procure-to-pay operations and procurement technology.

Leadership & Business Partnership

• Build and lead a high-performing procurement function, developing talent, processes, and capabilities as the organization grows.

• Serve as a trusted advisor to business, technology, and executive leaders on commercial strategy, supplier management, and investment decisions.

• Support M&A integration activities, including supplier consolidation, contract optimization, and synergy realization.

WE SHOULD TALK IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU

• 7+ years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, or vendor management, including 2+ years of people leadership or leading complex cross-functional initiatives.

• Track record of managing indirect spend and delivering measurable savings and cost avoidance.

• Experience negotiating technology agreements, including SaaS, cloud infrastructure, data, professional services, and multi-year contracts.

• Strong understanding of commercial contract terms and supplier negotiations.

• Experience implementing or improving procurement processes, systems, and operating models.

• Knowledge of third-party risk management, security, privacy, and compliance requirements.

• Proficiency with procurement, contract lifecycle, and spend analytics tools.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

• Strong commercial judgment with the ability to prioritize the terms that drive the most value.

• Proven ability to influence stakeholders and build adoption across technical and business teams.

• Data-driven decision maker with strong analytical and financial acumen.

• Hands-on, operational mindset with experience building processes and scaling functions.

• High integrity and sound judgment when navigating policy, compliance, and supplier ethics.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive - Mid-Atlantic
jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role
Elastic, the Search AI company, is looking for a high-energy Enterprise Account Executive to drive net-new revenue and expansion within strategic Enterprise accounts. You’ll be the owner of a defined territory where you’ll build your own pipeline, tell the Elastic Search AI story, and close complex, multi-stakeholder deals in a consumption-based model. This role sits at the intersection of sales execution, technical fluency, and cross-functional collaboration—and is critical to our growth in the Enterprise segment.

What You Will Be Doing

• Deep discovery & qualification: Uncover pain, business impact, budget, and decision criteria using frameworks like MEDDPICC so you chase only the highest-confidence deals.

• Value storytelling & demos: Craft and deliver tailored narratives and live demos that map Elastic’s Search, Observability, and Security capabilities to measurable business outcomes.

• Mutual deal strategy & forecast accuracy: Collaborate with customers to build formal close plans and keep your CRM up-to-date, maintaining ≥90 % forecast accuracy within ±10 %.

• Executive negotiation & closing: Lead high-stakes contract and pricing discussions—defend your value, structure give/get trades, and land multi-year consumption commitments.

• Domain & cloud acumen: Position Elastic as the Search AI platform of choice by speaking fluently about cloud economics, usage-based pricing, and modern data architectures.

• Cross-functional partnership: Work hand-in-glove with Solutions Architects, Customer Success, Marketing, and RevOps to accelerate deals and drive exceptional customer outcomes.

What You Bring

• Proven SaaS quota‐carrying success: 5+ years closing complex Enterprise deals, consistently overachieving targets in a consumption-based or usage-model environment.

• Expert discovery & qualification skills: Demonstrated ability to apply MEDDPICC or equivalent frameworks to drive disciplined pipeline and eliminate low-probability deals.

• Compelling value storytellers: Track record of delivering executive-level presentations and demos that tie product capabilities to real dollars saved, revenue gained, or risk mitigated.

• Strong negotiation chops: History of landing multi-year, high-ACV contracts while protecting margin and securing executive stakeholder buy-in.

• Technical & cloud fluency: Comfortable discussing a broad range of technical topics including observability, security, vector/traditional search, and cloud cost optimization.

• Collaborative mindset & coachability: A learner who partners effectively with internal teams, incorporates feedback, and embodies Elastic’s values of community and openness.

• Open Source enthusiasm: Genuine appreciation for open-source communities and the Elastic model—bonus if you’ve sold or advocated in an OSS context.

Bonus Points

• Prior experience at an open-source or developer‐centric infrastructure company.

• Familiarity with observability (logs, metrics, traces) or security analytics (SIEM/XDR) use cases.

If you’re driven to build your own pipeline, master complex deal cycles, and help customers unlock the power of Search AI, we’d love to talk. Apply today!

jobs.description:
Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery – across AI and traditional search. Yext's API-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit yext.com.

Yext is seeking a dedicated and business-oriented Commercial Counsel to join its Legal team! In this position, you will partner with our Enterprise, Mid-Market and Partner (indirect) sales teams in handling, negotiating and implementing customer deals and work with various business lines in reviewing and negotiating vendor/procurement transactions. This position can be based in the New York (preferred) or Washington D.C. areas with a flexible/hybrid work arrangement.

• Drafting, reviewing and negotiating a variety of commercial agreements – primarily SaaS subscription agreements – across our Enterprise, Mid-Market and Partner (indirect) businesses

• Improving and maintaining our standard commercial agreements, contract negotiation playbooks and legal processes to help us scale globally

• Proactively working with internal clients to improve and scale all aspects of the sales contract negotiation process

• Conducting periodic employee trainings on all of the above

• 3-5 years corporate and/or commercial experience at a leading law firm, in-house, or a combination of the two

• Strong contract drafting and negotiation skills; prior experience with commercial agreements required, experience with SaaS, content distribution and general commercial agreements within the technology industry strongly preferred

• Experience working through data privacy (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, CPRA, etc.) and security issues in SaaS/commercial transactions

• Flexibility and eagerness to work hard in fast-paced environment and meet tight deadlines

jobs.description:

Our breakthrough technology, SCC55®, is unlocking transformational performance for rechargeable batteries that power the world’s most critical innovations, from electric vehicles and AI-enabled electronics to eVTOLs and grid-scale energy storage. By enabling higher-density, faster-charging batteries, we are helping accelerate the global transition to an electrified future.

Over the past year, Group14 reached major milestones that underscore our momentum. We closed a $463 million Series D round, bringing our total equity raised to more than $1 billion, and acquired full ownership of a battery materials factory in South Korea, strengthening global supply chains and scaling production to meet surging demand. Headquartered in Washington state with manufacturing operations worldwide, Group14 is backed by world-class investors and customers, including Porsche, ATL, Microsoft, and SK Inc. As we continue to grow, we are building a team united by passion for shaping the future of energy.

The Process Operator is responsible for the maintenance and operation of equipment and processes in our Woodinville facility.  Some of the processes may involve use of hazardous and volatile materials under high temperature and pressure. Therefore, process operators must follow safe work practices including wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), following detailed procedures and instructions, accurately recording of process conditions and some laboratory testing.
This position offers opportunities for continuous learning and the opportunity for advancement towards production leadership roles.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

• This position will be on 2nd Shift -(Monday to Thursday's 5:30pm - 5:45am)

• Perform job duties in a safe and conscientious manner, following all procedures, programs, and policies established for specific processes.

• Maintaining equipment and following operations’ standard operating procedures.

• Observe machine operations to ensure quality and conformity of manufactured or packaged products and intermediates.

• Isolating systems for maintenance using work permits and lock out tag out process.

• Operating manual and pneumatic valves.

• Operating systems using Distributed Control System.

• Act accordingly to all system and plant alarms and follow standard operating procedures (SOP).

• Maintaining proper and safe process operations of the operating equipment.

• Adjust machine components and machine settings to comply with product protocols.

• Remove finished product from machine and separate rejected items.

• Make periodic checks of process and equipment settings.

• Perform preventative maintenance on equipment as assigned.

• Stop or reset machines when malfunctions occur, and report malfunctions to supervisor.

• Assist in the design and implementation of production techniques and equipment scale-up.

• Follow detailed procedures and instructions.

• Record process conditions.

• Inspect processes and work to assure effective quality control.

• Support continuous quality initiatives.

• Function with the production team effectively.

• Train other employees in proper production techniques, safety and equipment operation as needed.

• Perform other work as assigned.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

• High school diploma or equivalent.

• Previous manufacturing experience.

• Strong analytical and math proficiency.

• High level of mechanical aptitude.

• Ability to systematically troubleshoot and problem solve integrated processes.

• Good communication and interpersonal skills, attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to stand for a minimum of two hours without assistance.

jobs.title: Guest Experience Specialist
jobs.description:
Guest Experience Specialist (Remote, Evenings and Weekends)

Naked Farmer · Remote, US · Part-time or Full-time | Competitive Pay, Bonus & Benefits

About Naked Farmer

Naked Farmer is built on a mission to build a better food system by connecting farmers to community. We craft seasonal recipes based on what's growing nearby and know our farmers on a first-name basis. We were born in the global pandemic and have built a culture of resilience and transparency through our open-book management, profit-sharing plans and dedication to telling the story behind the farmers who grow our local food supply. We're entering a period of expansion as we open in new cities, using the platform we've built for more transparency around sourcing and cooking, and investing in a food supply system that works better for farmers, communities and chefs.

The role

When something goes wrong with a guest's meal on a Friday night or a Sunday afternoon, you're the person who makes it right. You'll be the voice of Naked Farmer across chat, email, phone and social while our restaurants are busiest, with real authority to fix problems on the spot. You'll join our Guest Experience team and report to our Guest Experience (GX) Manager.

What you'll do

• Resolve live order issues fast: missing or wrong items, late orders, quality problems

• Issue refunds and credits through our ordering platform within clear limits, and arrange redeliveries when an order is incomplete

• Answer guests across chat, email, our phone line and social DMs

• Reply to reviews on Google, Yelp, Uber Eats and DoorDash through our platforms, in our voice

• Coordinate with restaurant managers in real time to fix what went wrong

• Escalate urgent or sensitive issues using our playbook, and never leave a guest hanging

• Tag every conversation so we can spot trends and fix root causes

• Write a clean handoff note at the end of every shift

Schedule

Shifts run between 10:00am and 10:30pm Eastern. Weekday evening shifts are 4:30pm-10:30pm; weekend shifts are 10:00am-4:30pm or 4:00-10:30pm. Your exact days depend on which of the two schedules you take. Expect about two weeks of paid training in December, including time in one of our restaurants. Solo shifts start January 1, 2027.

You might be a fit if you

• Have 2+ years in restaurant, hospitality or customer service, ideally both

• Stay calm and kind when a guest is upset, and make it right without needing a script

• Write clearly and warmly, and fast

• Use good judgment with real authority, and know when to escalate

• Are organized and self-directed, and work well remotely with a quiet space and a reliable internet connection

• Can work evenings and weekends consistently

• Bonus: experience with helpdesk, online ordering, POS or social media inbox tools

Pay and work perks

• $25/hour, well above typical pay for this kind of role

• Up to $750 a quarter in bonus, tied to the team's GX scorecard and your own quality reviews

• Profit-sharing and open-book management: each year, 1% of the company's net profit goes back to our team

• Paid vacation

• Parental leave

• Health, dental and vision insurance, with Naked Farmer contributing up to 60% of the cost

• 401(k) with a company match

• Free Naked Farmer meals and culinary development programs whenever you're at one of our restaurants

• Fully remote, with a set schedule published two weeks ahead

jobs.title: Guest Experience Manager
jobs.description:
Guest Experience (GX) Manager

Location: Tampa, FL (in person) · Full-time

Competitive Pay, Bonus & Benefits

About Naked Farmer

Naked Farmer is built on a mission to build a better food system by connecting farmers to the community. We craft seasonal recipes based on what's growing nearby and know our farmers on a first-name basis. We were born in the global pandemic and have built a culture of resilience and transparency through our open-book management, profit-sharing plans and dedication to telling the story behind the farmers who grow our local food supply. We're entering a period of expansion as we open in new cities, using the platform we've built for more transparency around sourcing and cooking, and investing in a food supply system that works better for farmers, communities and chefs.

The role

You'll lead Naked Farmer's Guest Experience team. You own every conversation a guest has with us outside the restaurant: live order issues, email, chat, social, reviews and our phone line. You'll make it right for every guest, fast. Then you'll make sure what went wrong for them gets fixed for the next guest.

You won't do it by hand. AI answers routine questions around the clock, and our tools bring every conversation into one place, so your time goes to the guests and problems that need a person.

How guests reach us, and what they expect when they do, is changing fast. You'll start with a playbook, and your job is to keep it moving: test new ways to serve guests, adapt as our channels and technology change, and shape what guest experience looks like as we grow. You report to our Director of Operations Excellence.

What you'll own

• Guest recovery: resolve issues across chat, email, our phone line and social DMs. Issue refunds and credits through our ordering platform within your authority, and arrange redeliveries when an order is incomplete.

• Reputation: respond to Google, Yelp, Uber Eats and DoorDash reviews, and manage social conversations across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and LinkedIn, through our platforms.

• Escalations: handle sensitive and urgent issues with care and good judgment. Bring in restaurant leaders or the relevant department when needed, and see every case through to resolution.

• The AI agent: own our AI agent, including what it knows, how it sounds, and how well it resolves guest questions.

• The feedback loop: spot opportunities and trends across every channel and our guest feedback surveys. Bring a weekly report and a monthly review to leadership, with owners and proof of what changed.

• The team: hire, train, schedule and coach two remote Specialists to provide our restaurants coverage during operating hours. Review their conversations weekly and help them grow.

• The playbook: keep evolving our GX standards, reply guides, refund rules and escalation paths.

How we'll measure success

Your quarterly bonus is tied to the GX scorecard: Google and delivery-app ratings, issues per 1,000 orders, AI automation rate, response times, guest satisfaction after a fix, and the cost of making things right.

You might be a fit if you

• Have 4+ years in hospitality, restaurant operations or customer experience, including 2+ years leading people

• Have real hospitality instincts. You can turn an upset guest into a regular, in writing and on the phone

• Make good calls fast without waiting for permission, and know when something needs to go up the chain

• Think in systems. When you solve a problem twice, you write the process so nobody has to solve it a third time

• Write clearly and warmly, with no corporate scripts

• Are comfortable with helpdesk, social media and review management tools, and with data in a spreadsheet

• Bonus: experience with online ordering or POS systems, or with setting up AI chat agents

Pay and work perks

• Profit-sharing and open-book management: each year, 1% of the company's net profit goes back to our team

• Paid vacation

• Parental leave

• Health, dental and vision insurance, with Naked Farmer contributing up to 60% of the cost

• 401(k) with a company match

• Free Naked Farmer meals

• Work that matters, plus culinary development programs led by our chefs

Come build the future of food with us.

It’s why we have countless initiatives, clubs & cultural events dedicated to our people and why we have been the top ranked media agency named to Ad Age’s Best Places to Work for the past seven years in a row.

OVERVIEW

We are hiring a Supervisor, Integrated Media Investment with local/regional cross channel media buying experience. The Supervisor brings media strategy to life, leading a team of media professionals in developing and executing thoughtful, effective investment plans that deliver meaningful results for our clients. Combining strong tactical media expertise with hands-on team leadership, the Supervisor oversees campaigns from buying through execution, optimization, and performance analysis, ensuring the work is strategically aligned, well executed, and continually improving.

As a key partner to the Director, the Supervisor provides leadership across a portfolio of accounts, working closely with clients, internal teams, and media partners to keep campaigns moving forward and identify opportunities to make the work stronger. From haping tactical recommendations and guiding campaign development to managing client conversations and building vendor relationships, this role brings together the strategic perspective, practical know-how, and sound judgment needed to deliver great work.

Just as importantly, Supervisors help their teams grow. They are hands-on leaders, trusted mentors, and natural problem-solvers who know how to anticipate what’s next, bring clarity to competing priorities, and help others do their best work. They take pride in getting the details right, fostering strong relationships, and creating an environment where people can learn, collaborate, and deliver the quality and accountability our clients expect.

Experience working across media channels with local media clients is essential, including an understanding of the unique considerations, opportunities, and challenges that shape investment decisions in individual markets. This role connects integrated media strategy with the practical expertise needed to deliver effective campaigns in-market.

This role requires a candidate with proximity to our NYC office. We offer a hybrid work setting with employees working both onsite and from home.

YOUR ROLE

Campaign Tactical Planning & Execution

• Develop tactical media strategies in partnership with Planning teams and the Investment Director, across online and offline media channels - Linear TV, CTV, Digital, Audio, OOH, Social, Programmatic, Influencer, Content, and Experiential (based on campaign needs). A focus on Local /regional media experience.

• Strong understanding of media buying fundamentals, including the role of each channel, the holistic media mix, and the considerations that inform investment.

• Review and approve buys, authorizations, and placements created by junior team members

• Ensure all campaigns are executed on time, within budget, and in accordance with client expectations

• Partner with Planning, Analytics and Biddable teams to ensure investments are aligned with broader strategies, and measurable.

Client Management & Communication

• Serve as a day-to-day junior-level client contact for all campaign-related issues, optimizations, and strategic discussions

• Partner with Planning Teams to align media investment with brand objectives and business KPIs

• Lead relevant client presentations and status meetings, articulating campaign performance, investment decisions, and recommendations

• Troubleshoot any campaign issues and provide timely resolutions and update

Vendor & Partner Relationships

• Build and maintain strong relationships with media vendors and platforms

• Lead negotiations for optimal rates, value-adds, sponsorships, and inventory packages

• Stay updated on market conditions, media trends, and opportunities for innovation or test-and-learn campaigns

• Evaluate vendor proposals and recommend new partners or platforms to test.

Performance & Reporting

• Oversee and guide the creation of reporting deliverables by junior team members

• Analyze campaign performance data and extract actionable insights

• Lead post-campaign analyses and work with analytics teams to measure ROI, efficiency, and engagement

• Present learnings and optimization plans to internal stakeholders

Media Buy Financial Stewardship

• Ensure financial accuracy and timeliness in billing, invoicing, and reconciliation processes

• Track and manage campaign budgets, pacing, and forecasts

• Monitor campaign pacing and investment delivery, identifying and addressing discrepancies or potential issues

• Review financial and campaign documentation prepared by junior team members to maintain accuracy and accountability.

Team Leadership & Development
