jobs.title: Global Total Rewards Lead
jobs.description:
Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.

The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

We're ~1,300 builders across 18 countries. We share context openly, including how pay works. We work across functions and borders, question defaults, and own our outcomes. Our People team runs on Dataiku too, with AI agents and automated workflows.

The role

Location: US, East Coast remote · Reports to: VP, People Foundations

You'll own Dataiku's global compensation, equity and benefits strategy. The goal: programs that win in AI talent markets, are fair inside the company, scale across 18 countries, and stay financially sustainable.

Our People function is lean and decentralized. You'll work directly with executives, Finance, Legal and the Compensation Committee, lead a small Total Rewards team, and have real autonomy. This is a builder role: you'll challenge how things are done today and use AI to reinvent how rewards work.

What you'll do

• Set the strategy. Own and evolve our global compensation philosophy, balancing market competitiveness, internal equity and financial discipline.

• Lead pay transparency. Define our global approach and get the company ready for new rules, including the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

• Build the foundations. Evolve our job architecture, leveling and salary ranges, with rigor but without bureaucracy, and give managers simple tools to make good pay decisions.

• Partner on equity. Design grant guidelines, new-hire and refresh awards, and partner with Finance and Legal on modeling, dilution and international tax.

• Advise the top. Bring clear recommendations to executives and present equity and executive comp to the Compensation Committee and Board.

• Run the cycles. Lead merit, promotion and incentive cycles from modeling to execution, with scalable governance and AI-enabled workflows.

• Own global benefits. Set strategy across entities and EOR countries, and lead the benefits team that runs day-to-day operations.

What we're looking for

• Extensive Total Rewards or compensation experience (typically 10+ years), ideally in a global, high-growth tech or enterprise software company.

• Deep expertise in global comp strategy: salary structures, benchmarking, incentive design and job architecture.

• Strong equity experience across countries; late-stage private company experience is a big plus.

• Hands-on knowledge of pay transparency in Europe and North America.

• A track record of building or transforming rewards programs, not just running them.

• Experience leading teams and influencing senior executives in lean, fast-moving environments.

• Strong analytical and modeling skills, and real curiosity for AI and automation (Workday a plus).

Bonus points: knowledge of UK and French benefits and pension programs.

Why join us

• Real impact: shape Total Rewards for a global AI company helping the world's largest enterprises make AI work.

• Ownership: the autonomy to build, with direct access to executive decision-makers.

• Growth: help reinvent how People programs are delivered, with AI-powered workflows.

#LI-Remote #LI-FR1

Compensation and Benefits

The final compensation package for this role will be determined during the interview process and is based on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, geographic location, internal equity, education, skill set, experience and training. Eligible roles may also be entitled to receive commission or other variable compensation through Dataiku's incentive compensation program.

Dataiku also offers comprehensive benefits, including stock options, medical, dental, and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, pre-tax commuter benefits, a 401k company match, paid vacations and sick leave, paid parental leave, employer paid disability coverage, and additional health and wellbeing perks and benefits. Dataiku reserves the right to amend or modify employee perks and benefits at any time.

US only national base pay ranges

$230—$260 USD

What are you waiting for!

At Dataiku, you'll be part of a journey to shape the ever-evolving world of AI. We're not just building a product; we're crafting the future of AI. If you're ready to make a significant impact in a company that values innovation, collaboration, and your personal growth, we can't wait to welcome you to Dataiku! And if you’d like to learn even more about working here, you can visit our Dataiku LinkedIn page.

Our practices are rooted in the idea that everyone should be treated with dignity, decency and fairness. Dataiku also believes that a diverse identity is a source of strength and allows us to optimize across the many dimensions that are needed for our success. Therefore, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All employment practices are based on business needs, without regard to race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. This applies to all policies and procedures related to recruitment and hiring, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion and termination and all other conditions and terms of employment. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please contact us at: reasonable-accommodations@dataiku.com

Protect yourself from fraudulent recruitment activity

Dataiku will never ask you for payment of any type during the interview or hiring process. jobs.title: Insurance Producer - Farmers Insurance
jobs.description:
INSURANCE PRODUCER – FARMERS INSURANCE


READY TO BUILD A REWARDING CAREER IN SALES WITH ROOM TO GROW?

Farmers Insurance is looking for a motivated, goal-oriented Insurance Producer to join our agency team. If you're driven by results, enjoy building relationships, and want to help customers protect what matters most, this is an opportunity to develop your sales skills and build a long-term career in the insurance industry.

As an Insurance Producer, you'll play an important role in generating new business, recommending personalized insurance solutions, and developing lasting customer relationships while contributing to the agency's continued growth.

Previous sales experience or a demonstrated ability to consistently meet goals is required. Only applicants who meet these criteria will be considered.


ABOUT OUR AGENCY

At Farmers Insurance, we're committed to building brighter futures for our clients and our team. Our agency fosters a collaborative, professional environment where achievements are recognized and career development is encouraged.

Whether you're experienced in insurance or looking to advance your sales career, you'll have access to training, mentorship, and opportunities to grow into additional responsibilities—including potential leadership opportunities and a pathway toward agency ownership.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

As an Insurance Producer, your responsibilities will include:

 - Generate new business by identifying prospects, conducting outreach, and converting leads into policies

 - Consult with customers to assess their insurance needs and recommend appropriate coverage

 - Sell and cross-sell insurance products, including Auto, Home, Life, and Commercial policies

 - Build and maintain strong customer relationships through ongoing communication, service, and policy reviews

 - Work toward and achieve individual sales goals while contributing to agency growth

 - Stay informed about insurance products, services, and applicable compliance requirements

 - Use CRM tools to manage leads, track follow-ups, and monitor policy renewals

 - Participate in team meetings, sales training, and strategy sessions


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're seeking candidates who are proactive, professional, coachable, and motivated to succeed in a sales-driven environment.

The ideal candidate will have:

 - One or more years of sales, customer service, or insurance experience preferred

 - Strong communication and negotiation skills

 - Confidence making outbound calls, conducting sales conversations, and closing deals

 - A goal-oriented mindset and commitment to achieving measurable results

 - Strong organizational and time-management skills

 - A willingness to learn, accept feedback, and apply coaching

 - Bilingual abilities are a plus


WHY JOIN OUR TEAM?

We're committed to providing the support and resources needed to help you succeed. Depending on agency offerings, opportunities may include:

 - Base salary plus uncapped commissions

 - Performance-based bonuses and incentives

 - Paid training and ongoing professional development

 - Career advancement opportunities, including a potential path to agency ownership

 - Flexible scheduling options, with potential hybrid arrangements for some positions

 - A supportive, team-oriented culture that recognizes achievement

 - Health insurance support options, depending on agency offerings

 - Paid time off, holidays, and milestone incentives

 - The backing and reputation of the Farmers Insurance brand


MAKE YOUR NEXT CAREER MOVE COUNT

A position as an Insurance Producer can be the foundation for a rewarding career in insurance sales. If you're motivated by results, enjoy helping people, and want to grow your skills and earning potential, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and take the next step toward building your career with Farmers Insurance.

jobs.title: Sous Chef - New Restaurant Opening Soon!
jobs.location: 1751 Palm Beach Lake Blvd, Suite E121, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
jobs.description:
Naked Farmer is proud to announce the opening of a new location! Coming Soon 2026! West Palm Beach we cannot wait to serve you, Let's get cooking!

As we prepare to expand into this community, we are seeking dedicated and motivated individuals to join our team. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a restaurant from the ground up, helping to establish a strong culture, deliver exceptional hospitality, and grow with us as we continue our mission to build a better food system.

SOUS CHEF

Naked Farmer is a pioneering farm-to-table restaurant group with multiple locations, cooking and serving scratch-made, healthy, and affordable meals. Our restaurants celebrate the seasonality of vegetables and the spirit of innovation, striving to create a sustainable food system that strengthens the connection between farmers and the community.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Sous Chef, you will be instrumental in helping our Restaurant Leaders to foster culinary and hospitality excellence within our scratch-based kitchen. Your passion for cooking delicious food will be a cornerstone as you seek to perfect your craft at every Naked Farmer station. Through consistent execution of recipes, processes, and active training, you will enhance the collective knowledge of our entire restaurant team.

You will stand as a beacon of guidance and leadership, investing in the development of our team, leading through the rush of peak service times, addressing guest concerns, and embodying the best practices of our culinary and system operations. Your initiative as a mentor and leader in the kitchen will shine through as you engage in pre-shift meetings, manage shifts, and train new culinary team members according to Naked Farmer's training protocols. Your oversight will ensure that tasks throughout the restaurant are completed punctually and to our quality standards.

BENEFITS:

• Competitive salary and a vibrant work culture

• Profit-sharing incentives

• Annual paid vacation

• Affordable health, dental, and vision insurance

• Opportunities for career progression within our rapidly growing company

• A complimentary Naked Farmer meal daily

• Flexible work schedule

At Naked Farmer, we are cultivating the next generation chefs. Our scratch-based kitchens are a hub for individuals passionate about real, good food. Your passion for cooking delicious food will be evident as you are a farmer of people who enjoys helping other chefs master various cooking stations, ensuring each recipe is prepared consistently to showcase the best of the season. You will inspire and lead those eager to share their love for cooking and transform others into skilled chefs. If you are driven by a sense of purpose and a craving for shaping the future of food, join us on our mission to build a better food system.

YOU WILL:

• Inspire and uplift our culinary team by showcasing your expertise in the kitchen, providing warm hospitality, and maintaining a positive demeanor.

• Achieve proficiency at all Naked Farmer stations by consistently executing recipes, processes, and procedures, and by actively engaging in training to enhance the team's overall knowledge.

• Exhibit command over all menu items by preparing seasonal dishes according to our established recipes and standards.

• Coordinate prep lists and waste logs, contribute to food inventory, and maintain a well-stocked and orderly walk-in in collaboration with the Chef de Cuisine.

• Acquire knowledge of the restaurant's ordering systems to assist in managing stock levels required for service.

• Effectively open and close the restaurant with the aid of checklists and in-depth communication with the team to ensure a smooth shift.

• Address guest concerns with creative and effective solutions.

• Guarantee that the team upholds the Department of Health and Naked Farmer's food safety protocols.

YOU HAVE:

• A passion for real, good food and a willingness to learn new culinary skills.

• At least one year of leadership experience in a high-volume kitchen.

• Two or more years of experience cooking in a high-volume kitchen environment.

• Strong culinary abilities, while remaining open to learning and coaching.

• Demonstrated strong work ethic and the ability to execute job duties effectively.

• Capable of meeting the physical demands of the role, including lifting up to 50 pounds.

• A team player who is willing to contribute wherever needed.

• Respect and appreciation for your coworkers.

• Excellent communication skills.

• A commitment to mentor chefs and nurture their growth into future restaurant leaders.

• Strong interpersonal skills and the agility to adapt to new challenges.

• A keen eye for detail, ensuring excellence in every task.

• A reliable and optimistic, caring personality.

ABOUT NAKED FARMER:

Born during a global pandemic, Naked Farmer quickly adapted, delivering fresh food directly from farm to doorstep. Our ethos is founded on resilience, transparency, and telling the story of the farmers behind our local food supply. With a commitment to becoming 100% locally-sourced, we are now embarking on an expansion phase, opening new locations and furthering our mission of transparency in sourcing and cooking while supporting local farmers, communities, and chefs. Currently operating 11 restaurants in FL, NC and TN, we are in the process of adding six more across the state.

And yes, all employees enjoy complimentary Naked Farmer meals every day—don't miss out on the sweet potatoes.

Join us as we build the future of food together.

Naked Farmer participates in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility for all newly hired employees.

jobs.title: Senior Public Relations Manager
jobs.description:
About Formlabs:

Do you want to change how the world creates?

At Formlabs, we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we’re helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before.

We’re a team of hands-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you’re ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us.

Your Impact:

Formlabs is hiring a Senior PR Manager to own how the press, analysts and the wider maker community see our company and products. You will plan and run earned media for product launches, company news and executive visibility, working closely with product marketing, brand, social and leadership.

What You’ll Do:

• Lead PR efforts for product launches end to end: messaging, press materials, embargoes, briefings, reviews and launch-day coverage.

• Build and run the always-on, proactive PR strategy, tied to company goals.

• Grow relationships with business, technology, design, manufacturing and trade press, plus key industry analysts.

• Collaborate on the product reviews program, getting printers and materials to reviewers and tracking coverage.

• Raise the profile of Formlabs executives through interviews, bylines, podcasts and speaking opportunities.

• Write and edit press releases, briefing documents, FAQs and Q&A prep.

• Own issues and crisis communications

• Report on share of voice, coverage quality, message pull-through and impact on traffic and pipeline.

About You:

• 8+ years in PR or communications, with at least 3 years leading programs at a tech, hardware or consumer electronics company or agency.

• A track record of top-tier coverage in national business, technology and trade media.

• Strong existing relationships with tech and business journalists.

• Experience running major product launches with embargoes, review units and global timing.

• Excellent writing and editing, with a sharp sense of what makes a story.

• Comfort explaining technical products in plain language. Curiosity about 3D printing and manufacturing is a must; prior experience is a plus.

• Ability to measure PR results and tie them to business goals.

Bonus Skills:

• Experience running influencer and creator programs, especially with YouTube, TikTok and Instagram creators in maker, design, engineering or tech.

• Relationships with creators and an understanding of how they work, from sponsored content and gifting to long-term ambassador partnerships.

• Familiarity with media monitoring and influencer tools.

Our Benefits & Perks:

• Robust equity program to build future wealth through RSUs

• Comprehensive healthcare coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)

• 401K matching and access to financial advisors

• Generous paid Parental Leave (up to 16 weeks)

• Tenure-based paid Sabbatical Leave (up to 6 weeks)

• Flexible Out of Office Plan – Take time when you need it

• Ample on-site parking & pre-tax commuter benefits

• Healthy on-site lunches, snacks, beverages, & treats

• Regular sponsored professional development opportunities

• Many opt-in culture events across our diverse community

• And of course… unlimited 3D prints

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company.  We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Even if you don't check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply. Help us build an inclusive community that will change the face of 3D printing.

Our Candidate AI Guidelines are available here. Please give them a read.

Compensation

Every Formlabs employee receives equity because everyone contributes to building the company. You’ll have the opportunity to share financially in the value we create together, with a shared incentive to build a business that succeeds over the long term. Equity will be a significant portion of your total compensation, and will increase over time in proportion to your impact. The base pay will be determined by your skills, qualifications, experience, location, and expected impact on the organization.

The annual base pay range for this role is:

$125,000—$160,000 USD

jobs.title: SOFTWARE ENGINEER SÊNIOR - B2C TECH IFOOD PAY
jobs.description:
Nosso modo de fazer no time:

Transforme sua carreira com o iFood! Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia referência na América Latina. Por meio de soluções inovadoras, conectamos milhares de restaurantes a milhões de consumidores diariamente com uma média de 100 milhões de pedidos mensais. Além do delivery de comida, também somos Mercado, Farmácia e Pet. Temos também o iFood Pago, nossa Fintech, que engloba o iFood Benefícios, o vale alimentação e refeição do iFood e o próprio iFood Pago, o banco do restaurante. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma equipe que está sempre à frente com tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante

Seu Cardápio Diário:

Liderar a evolução técnica da Digital Wallet do iFood, atuando como referência de arquitetura backend em múltiplos sistemas, squads e camadas da plataforma.
O papel combina arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos, pagamentos, Open Finance, identidade digital, segurança e integração com SDKs nativos para dispositivos móveis. A pessoa será responsável por transformar requisitos complexos de produto, negócio, segurança e regulamentação em plataformas confiáveis, escaláveis e sustentáveis.
É um papel de liderança técnica sem gestão de pessoas: o impacto vem de arquitetura, padrões, decisões de longo prazo, resolução de problemas complexos e desenvolvimento de outros engenheiros. - Definir e evoluir a arquitetura da Digital Wallet, seus serviços, domínios, APIs, eventos e integrações.
- Estabelecer fronteiras claras entre wallet, pagamentos, contas, saldo, transações, identidade, risco, antifraude e demais componentes da plataforma.
- Liderar o desenho de arquiteturas distribuídas e orientadas a eventos, incluindo definição de domínios, contratos entre serviços e comunicação assíncrona.
- Projetar sistemas com garantias de idempotência, rastreabilidade, consistência, ordenação, deduplicação e reprocessamento.
- Endereçar problemas complexos de sistemas distribuídos: consistência eventual, concorrência, duplicidade, transações distribuídas, falhas parciais e recuperação.

Para realçar o sabor:

- Experiência na construção de digital wallets, contas digitais, plataformas de pagamentos ou sistemas financeiros.
- Experiência com ledger, double-entry bookkeeping, conciliação, liquidação, saldo e trilhas de auditoria.
- Experiência com Pix, iniciação de pagamentos ou integrações com arranjos de pagamento.
- Experiência profunda com Open Finance e padrões de segurança aplicáveis a integrações financeiras.
- Experiência com passkeys, WebAuthn, FIDO2, Secure Enclave, Android Keystore ou tecnologias equivalentes.
- Experiência com SDKs nativos distribuídos para múltiplos aplicativos ou consumidores externos.
- Experiência com tokenização, gestão de chaves, HSM, criptografia aplicada ou proteção de dados sensíveis.
- Vivência com padrões avançados de event-driven: CQRS, event sourcing, saga e outbox pattern.
- Experiência com antifraude, prevenção de account takeover, análise de risco e autenticação adaptativa.
- Background poliglota em Go, Java, Kotlin, Swift, Python ou outras linguagens relevantes.
- Experiência em ambientes regulados, fintechs, bancos, meios de pagamento ou empresas de grande escala.

Buscamos uma pessoa apaixonada por tecnologia e inovação, que esteja sempre em busca de novos aprendizados e desafios. Se você se identifica com este perfil, adoraríamos conhecer você!

jobs.title: Commercial Insurance Account Manager - OCIPs / CCIPs / Builder's Risk
jobs.location: 12444 Powerscourt Drive,  Suite 360, St. Louis, MO 63131; 125 S Wacker Dr, Suite 3150, Chicago, IL 60606; 3780 Mansell Road, Ste 370, Alpharetta, GA 30022
jobs.description:
Come join our team!

There are many reasons why EPIC Insurance Brokers & Consultants has become one of the fastest-growing firms in the insurance industry. Fueled and driven by capable, committed people who share common beliefs and values and “bring it” every day, EPIC is always looking for people who have “the right stuff” – people who know what they want and aren’t afraid to make it happen.

Headquartered in New York City and founded in 2007, our company has over 4,000 employees nationwide. With locations spread out across the U.S., our local market knowledge and industry expertise helps support our clients' regional and global needs. We have grown very quickly since our founding, and we continue to see growth and success thanks to our hard-working and growth-minded employees.

Our core values are: Owner mindset, Inspire trust, Think big, and Drive results. If these values and growth align with what you're looking for in your next career? Then consider joining our amazing team!

JOB OVERVIEW:

Within our Construction & Design vertical, we have a team that specializes in providing insurance brokerage and risk consulting services for construction and design professionals, specifically large accounts for architect & engineering firms (A/E). What differentiates us is our construction industry expertise. Our leaders have prior experience as practicing construction lawyers (in-house and outside), engineers, consultants, and underwriters – giving us a unique and unmatched insight into how A/E firms operate, deliver projects, and manage risks. With respect to insurance, we place many of our largest clients who qualify in highly profitable group captive programs that have saved millions, and we do so for more A/E firms than all other insurance brokers combined.

We’ve been so successful, that now we’re looking to grow our team!

The Account Manager - Project Solutions will be the primary client contact and will be expected to actively cultivate, improve and cement positive client relationships and use appropriate company resources in performing these functions. While the Account Manager will work with new clients produced by others, the Account Manager will not be expected to develop new business. The Account Manager’s main function is to: provide day-to-day client service, manage the renewal process for existing clients, and manage the intake and establishment of new clients.

LOCATION: Hybrid required, 3 days a week in-office - in Alpharetta GA, Chicago IL, or St. Louis MO.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

• Candidates with strong, professional communication skills – both written and verbal. Ideal candidates can successfully pivot between providing detailed and accurate written communication, as well as picking up the phone and having a detailed verbal conversation with clients or internal stakeholders.

• High attention to detail, and the ability to learn and understand software systems quickly.

• REQUIRED: At least 5+ years of experience working for an insurance agency, broker or carrier, AND experience working with Controlled Insurance Programs (OCIPs, CCIPs) and Builder's Risk

• Candidates who adapt well to priority changes, deadlines, and who love problem solving and coming up with solutions and answers to client questions.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

A detailed list of job duties includes (but is not limited to):

Critical Job Functions:
The account manager will handle day-to-day client issues and questions, including but not limited to:
• Answer client questions and resolve client problems
• Process and follow up on cancellation notices by insurers to ensure accurate and timely resolution
• Appropriately document customer service transactions
• Handle changes in exposure and manage related endorsement and documentation process
• Forward contract reviews to appropriate resources
• Forward certificate of insurance requests to appropriate resource
• Issue Auto ID Cards as needed
• Create and update account information in the shared database
• Claims reporting
• Assist with processing of invoicing and order financing when appropriate

Proactively manage the insurance renewal and new business process in accordance with EPIC’s timing standards.
• Pre‐complete insurance applications
• Send request for information to clients
• Follow‐up on collecting information
• Submit information to insurers
• Negotiate policy terms
• Obtain options from competing insurers as needed
• Prepare insurance proposal including analysis and comparison of options (if applicable)
• and present to client (mostly via phone or web)
• Prepare documentation including invoicing and confirmation of coverage
• Review and email policies to clients
• Use agency management system (Sagitta) as appropriate throughout the process

Job Accountability Measures:
• Customer satisfaction; retention
• Adherence to established procedures
• Timing and quality of service
• Technical accuracy; attention to detail
• Positive professional attitude; leadership
• Proactive problem‐solving
• Effective communication
• Personal development
• Avoidance of errors and omissions
• Meet or exceed agreed‐upon goals

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

Skills & Qualifications:
• Must have 5+ years of experience in working with commercial insurance, preferably with Builder's Risk and OCIPs / CCIPs.
• Experience in placing insurance for companies in Architect, Engineering & Construction industries is highly desirable.
• Must have advanced working knowledge of a variety of Microsoft Office computer software applications in word processing, spreadsheets, database, and presentation software.
• Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment with demonstrated ability to juggle multiple competing tasks and demands.
• Must have high level of interpersonal skills to handle sensitive and confidential situations. Position continually requires teamwork, demonstrated poise, tact, and diplomacy.

Educational requirement:
• Bachelor’s degree preferred - experience equivalent will be considered

jobs.title: Chef de Cuisine - New Restaurant Opening Soon!
jobs.location: 1751 Palm Beach Lake Blvd, Suite E121, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
jobs.description:
Naked Farmer is proud to announce the opening of a new location! Coming Soon 2026! West Palm Beach, we cannot wait to serve you!  Let's get cooking!

As we prepare to expand into this community, we are seeking dedicated and motivated individuals to join our team. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a restaurant from the ground up, helping to establish a strong culture, deliver exceptional hospitality, and grow with us as we continue our mission to build a better food system.

CHEF DE CUISINE

Naked Farmer is a pioneering farm-to-table restaurant group with multiple locations, cooking and serving scratch-made, healthy, and affordable meals. Our restaurants celebrate the seasonality of vegetables and the spirit of innovation, striving to create a sustainable food system that strengthens the connection between farmers and the community.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As Chef De Cuisine, you will lead the culinary team in our scratch kitchen, acting as the culinary nuts-and-bolts of our restaurant. Your role will be to manage and guide your team of chefs to run an efficient kitchen where chefs love to work. With a talent for balancing culinary excellence with operational savvy, you will lead and inspire others, demonstrating both leadership and culinary skills. Your ability to maintain strong relationships with farmers, partners, and suppliers is essential, as is your oversight of daily kitchen operations, adherence to sanitation standards, and maintenance of kitchen equipment. You will be responsible for supervising food preparation, menu planning, staffing, and ensuring that every kitchen station operates smoothly.

BENEFITS:

• Competitive salary and a vibrant work culture

• Profit-sharing incentives

• 401(k)

• Annual paid vacation

• Affordable health, dental, and vision insurance

• Opportunities for career progression within our rapidly growing company

• A complimentary Naked Farmer meal daily

At Naked Farmer, we are cultivating the next generation chefs. Our scratch-based kitchens are a hub for individuals passionate about real, good food. Your passion for cooking delicious food will be evident as you are a farmer of people who enjoys helping other chefs master various cooking stations, ensuring each recipe is prepared consistently to showcase the best of the season. You will inspire and lead those eager to share their love for cooking and transform others into skilled chefs. If you are driven by a sense of purpose and a craving for shaping the future of food, join us on our mission to build a better food system.

YOU WILL:

• Cultivate a kitchen culture that embodies our best practices and standards, inspiring your team through every service.

• Lead and mentor the chef trainees, setting an example of culinary expertise and positivity to consistently deliver exceptional food.

• Guarantee the quality and presentation of food across all business channels, treating dine-in, pick-up, and delivery orders with equal dedication.

• Act as the go-to resource for the kitchen staff on recipe inquiries, preparation checklists, and food quality, maintaining order and consistency.

• Manage the receipt and quality control of fresh ingredients from our farm partners, and oversee inventory, supplies, and quality assurance processes.

• Organize prep lists and collaborate with the Chef Operator on food inventory and ordering to ensure the kitchen is well-prepared and organized.

• Setup your team for success on each service by managing the deployment board and prep schedules effectively.

• Perform line checks, assess readiness of food, anticipate needs, and manage potential waste to ensure seamless service.

• Set the kitchen up for success, completing all tasks with timeliness and a focus on safety.

• Introduce and test food preparation techniques that enhance kitchen efficiency, and remain open to innovative systems and processes.

• Uphold stringent kitchen operations, including storage, labeling, preparation, and safety protocols, ensuring compliance with health standards and guidelines.

• Lead in placing orders and managing kitchen facilities, and collaborate with the Chef Operator on labor and food costs.

• Grow your kitchen team through active recruitment, training, performance management, mentorship, and disciplinary procedures when necessary.

YOU HAVE:

• A minimum of 2 years' experience leading a culinary team in a high-volume setting.

• A deep passion for quality food and a desire to constantly improve.

• Strong culinary expertise with a willingness to learn and adapt.

• A proven work ethic and the ability to perform the job's physical demands, such as lifting up to 50 pounds.

• A collaborative spirit and readiness to contribute as needed.

• Respect and appreciation for your team and a commitment to fostering a positive work environment.

• Exceptional communication skills.

• A vision for mentoring and developing chefs into future restaurant leaders.

• Reliability and a consistent performance record.

• Adaptable interpersonal skills and the ability to meet new challenges with agility.

• An unwavering attention to detail.

ABOUT NAKED FARMER:

Born during a global pandemic, Naked Farmer quickly adapted, delivering fresh food directly from farm to doorstep. Our ethos is founded on resilience, transparency, and telling the story of the farmers behind our local food supply. With a commitment to becoming 100% locally-sourced, we are now embarking on an expansion phase, opening new locations and furthering our mission of transparency in sourcing and cooking while supporting local farmers, communities, and chefs. We have 11 locations in 3 states, FL, NC and TN.

And yes, all employees enjoy complimentary Naked Farmer meals every day—don't miss out on the sweet potatoes.

Join us as we build the future of food together.

jobs.title: Senior Occupational Safety Professional
jobs.description:
Are you driven to grow, lead, and make a meaningful impact? At Apex, we’re building more than a consulting and engineering firm—we’re creating a place where your career accelerates, your contributions matter, and your potential is fully realized. We believe your growth is our growth, which is why we invest in your development at every stage of your career. Here, you’ll work on projects that shape communities, protect the environment, and create lasting impact, all while being empowered with the autonomy and flexibility to do your best work.

Fueled by high-quality delivery, exceptional client retention, and strategic acquisitions, Apex Companies continues to rank among the fastest-growing firms in the AEC industry, recently recognized by the Zweig Group for our industry-leading growth. Our success is grounded in strong leadership, a collaborative culture, and a shared commitment to delivering exceptional outcomes.

As we continue to expand, we're looking for high-performing professionals who are ready to lead, collaborate, innovate, and create impact. At Apex, you help shape what's next. When we succeed together, we share in that success. All Apex positions are eligible for annual bonus opportunities, reinforcing our commitment to recognizing and rewarding meaningful contributions that drive our collective growth.

Are you a highly motivated self-starter seeking to join a growth-focused Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) consulting firm?  Are you looking for a company that will provide interesting and technically challenging work and will also invest in your development and grow your professional skills?  If so, consider a career with Apex.

Powered by strong sales, extraordinary client retention, multiple career path options, strategic acquisitions, and an entrepreneurial spirit, Apex Companies is one of the fastest growing EHS consulting firms in the USA. We take pride in meeting and exceeding our clients’ expectations and have earned numerous industry awards for project excellence. We continue to grow, and we want you to grow with us.

Role Overview:

This role is all about employee accident prevention.  The incumbent will execute occupational safety projects from start to finish at the client site.  The role will routinely involve a blend of (1) workplace / shop floor employee injury exposure assessments, and (2) safety program management effectiveness evaluations and continuous improvement support.

While the prominent technical area associated with this position is Industrial/Occupational Safety, a general base of knowledge in Ergonomics and Industrial Hygiene is also desirable.

The incumbent will also provide project leadership and project management functions as needed.  Perhaps most importantly, the incumbent will be an energetic self-starter with the ability to work independently and produce results within budget and timeframe.

Your Responsibilities as an Apex Occupational Safety Professional:

• Providing comprehensive occupational safety consulting services to clients, including: Conducting shop floor observations focused on identifying, assessing and risk-ranking employee exposures to injury Devising solution options aimed at mitigating employee injury exposures Providing clients with hands-on assistance with implementation of chosen solutions Monitoring the effectiveness of solutions implemented. Have they stood the test of time? Tracking and analyzing clients’ employee injury experience, looking for trends, common themes, and potential high leverage accident prevention activities

• In collaboration with Apex project managers, coordinates and executes industrial safety projects within set organizational procedures and standards.

• In close routine collaboration with the external customer, designs, implements and executes an agreed-to service plan. Monitors and reports progress on plan completion as directed. Works with numerous internal and external stakeholders in the interest of achieving desired overall project velocity.

• Acts as an advisor to the customer on occupational safety issues.

• Provides input to project managers, client relationship managers, or business development staff on potential new EHS projects. Participates in business development activities as directed.

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor's degree preferred – ideally, in a science or engineering field.

• Minimum 7+ years of experience required, working in the occupational safety / employee accident prevention field.

• Desirable, but not required: Associate Safety Professional (ASP) or Certified Safety Professional (CSP) professional accreditation.

• Active Secret Security clearance highly preferred (or willing to go through process with us to get one)

• Experience in manufacturing-&-assembly industries / heavy industry settings a plus.

• Experience in the aerospace and defense or automotive industry a further plus.

• Possess an extensive knowledge of occupational safety technical subject matter and how to apply it in real-life settings. Highly familiar with standard concepts, practices, and procedures within the occupational safety field. Just a few topics where strong technical knowledge is required: Shop Floor Hazard Identification Surveys Job Safety Analysis / Job Hazard Analysis Employee Injury Data Analysis Machine Guarding Slip/Trip/Fall Prevention Falls from Elevation Lockout/Tagout & Energized Electrical Equipment Safety Confined Space Entry Personal Protective Equipment Safety Committees & Conducting Safety Meetings/Training: for Touch Labor, Supervisory Staff, and Management Powered Industrial Truck Safety Contractor Safety Broad spectrum OSHA Regulations understanding

• Strong interpersonal communication skills.

• A great deal of creativity and self-starter initiative is required. This position entails routine ongoing work and negotiation with numerous customer stakeholders – all of whom need to be ‘satisfied’ with respect to project purpose, scope, and tactics.

• Relies on experience and judgment paired with the overall work statement provided by the customer to plan and accomplish goals.

• Ensures compliance with all EHS regulations and keeps abreast of any changes to laws and regulations that impact the organization.

• Strong technical writing skills, the ability to successfully multi-task, safety awareness, and a good record and understanding of safe work practices

• Experience with data management and report preparation.

• Valid driver's license required.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite.

Job Location:

• Kennedy Space Center: 3rd Shift, 4 day work week in most cases.

Why you'll love working for us:

• Company-subsidized medical and dental.

• Company-paid life, short, and long-term disability.

• 401k match, tuition assistance, and more.

• Cross-training and the ability to work on a variety of projects.

• Performance-based bonuses or other incentives.

• Working with the best and brightest in the industry.

• 2,000+ employee national firm with 70+ locations across the US.

jobs.title: Supplemental Security Income (SSI) Specialist
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Imagine Pediatrics is a tech enabled, pediatrician led medical group reimagining care for children with special health care needs. We deliver 24/7 virtual first and in home medical, behavioral, and social care, working alongside families, providers, and health plans to break down barriers to quality care. We do not replace existing care teams; we enhance them, providing an extra layer of support with compassion, creativity, and an unwavering commitment to children with medical complexity.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will be responsible for assisting individuals in navigating the SSI application process and ensuring that they receive the support they need. Your expertise will play a pivotal role in helping our patient's families secure the benefits they may be entitled to.

• SSI (Supplemental Security Income) Application Assistance: Provide guidance and support to individuals seeking to apply for SSI benefits. Explain the application process, eligibility criteria, and required documentation.

• Document Review: Review and verify all application documents for accuracy and completeness. Ensure that all necessary forms and supporting materials are included.

• Client Consultation: Conduct one-on-one consultations with applicants to gather relevant information, answer questions, and address concerns.

• Application Submission: Prepare SSI applications for caregiver review, ensuring adherence to deadlines and compliance with all relevant regulations.

• Follow-Up: Monitor the progress of applications, follow up with relevant agencies, and have ongoing communication with families during the approval process.

• Record Keeping: Maintain accurate records of client interactions, applications, and outcomes while adhering to data privacy and confidentiality requirements.

• Stay Informed: Stay up to date with changes in SSI regulations, policies, and procedures, and ensure that clients are informed about any relevant updates.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

What You Bring & How You Qualify

First and foremost, you're passionate and committed to reimagining pediatric health care and creating a world where every child with complex medical conditions gets the care and support they deserve. We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented SSI (Supplemental Security Income) Application Specialist to join our team.

• Previous experience in SSI application assistance or a related field

• Strong knowledge of SSI eligibility criteria and application procedures.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

• Compassionate and patient demeanor when working with individuals in need.

• Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.

• Ability to maintain strict confidentiality.

• Bilingual in Spanish strongly preferred

• High School Diploma required

What We Offer (Benefits + Perks)

The role offers an hourly range of $22 - $26 in addition to annual bonus incentive, competitive company benefits package and eligibility to participate in an employee equity purchase program (as applicable). When determining compensation, we analyze and carefully consider several factors including job-related knowledge, skills and experience. These considerations may cause your compensation to vary.

We provide these additional benefits and perks:

• Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance

• Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA; Company-funded HSA

• 401(k) with 4% match, vested 100% from day one

• Employer-paid short and long-term disability

• Life insurance 1x annual salary

• 20 days PTO + 10 Company Holidays & 2 Floating Holidays

• Paid new parent leave

• Additional benefits to be detailed in offer

What We Live By

We’re guided by our five core values:

Our Values:

• Children First. We put the best interests of children above all. We know that the right decision is always the one that creates more safe days at home for the children we serve today and in the future.

• Earn Trust. We listen first, speak second. We build lasting relationships by creating shared understanding and consistently following through on our commitments.

• Innovate Today. We believe that small improvements lead to big impact. We stay curious by asking questions and leveraging new ideas to learn and scale.

• Embrace Humanity. We lead with empathy and authenticity, presuming competence and good intentions. When we stumble, we use the opportunity to grow and understand how we can improve.

• One Team, Diverse Perspectives. We actively seek a range of viewpoints to achieve better outcomes. Even when we see things differently, we stay aligned on our shared mission and support one another to move forward — together.

We Value Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery – across AI and traditional search. Yext's API-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit yext.com.

At Yext, Product Engineering builds and evolves the technology behind our products and services. We’re looking for engineering managers who want to lead strong teams, solve meaningful technical problems, and help shape what we build next.

We work in an agile environment with two-week sprints and regular demos that keep teams aligned and give engineers clear visibility into the impact of their work. As an engineering manager, you’ll partner closely with Product and Engineering leaders to set direction, turn broader priorities into actionable plans, and create an environment where engineers can do their best work and continue to grow.

We are looking for an engineering manager to join the Knowledge Graph team, which builds and maintains the systems that turn customer information into a connected, usable source of truth. The team develops the core infrastructure, APIs, and workflows that help brands model, manage, and connect their knowledge across products and experiences.

The work involves challenging engineering problems, including representing complex real-world entities, processing large volumes of changing data, building reliable distributed systems, and creating interfaces that allow other teams to build confidently on top of the graph. This is an opportunity for engineers who enjoy foundational technology, thoughtful data modeling and system design, and seeing their work enable a wide range of customer experiences.

This role is based in our New York City office in the Chelsea neighborhood of Manhattan, where in-person collaboration plays an important part in how our teams work, learn, and build relationships. We’re looking for people who genuinely value that environment and are comfortable coming into the office at least three days per week. At the same time, we don’t prescribe specific in-office days and want employees to have the flexibility to handle personal needs without disrupting their work or team collaboration.

What You’ll Do

• Lead and develop a team of software engineers, providing regular coaching, actionable feedback, and support for their career growth

• Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to translate product priorities and longer-term goals into clear, achievable plans for the team

• Own the team’s execution and delivery, establishing priorities, breaking larger initiatives into manageable work, and maintaining a sustainable development cadence

• Create clarity for the team by resolving ambiguity, removing blockers, managing competing priorities, and protecting engineers from unnecessary organizational churn and distractions

• Maintain a strong technical understanding of the team’s systems and provide guidance on architecture, design, implementation, and technical tradeoffs

• Foster a high bar for engineering quality through thoughtful design discussions, code reviews, testing, operational readiness, and continuous improvement

• Ensure the team is prepared to respond effectively to production incidents, providing leadership and coordination during incidents and driving meaningful follow-up afterward

• Build an environment where engineers take ownership, collaborate effectively, learn from one another, and feel comfortable raising concerns and challenging assumptions

• Collaborate across Product Engineering and with partners throughout the company to coordinate dependencies, resolve issues, and deliver shared initiatives

• Recruit and hire talented engineers, actively participate in the interview process, and build an effective onboarding experience for new team members

• Identify opportunities to improve the team’s systems, processes, and ways of working, and help turn those opportunities into meaningful change

• Model thoughtful use of AI-assisted development tools and help engineers incorporate AI effectively throughout design, research, implementation, testing, debugging, and code review

• Maintain a high-quality bar for AI-assisted work by ensuring engineers understand and validate generated output and remain accountable for its correctness, security, maintainability, and alignment with engineering standards

• Encourage experimentation with new AI capabilities and workflows, share successful approaches across the team, and help identify opportunities where AI can meaningfully improve engineering effectiveness

What You Have

• A BA/BS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent college-level education

• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience

• 1+ years of team or technical leadership

• Experience coaching engineers, providing direct and constructive feedback, and supporting their professional development

• Experience translating product or business priorities into technical plans and driving a team toward successful delivery

• The ability to stay technically engaged enough to guide design decisions, evaluate tradeoffs, and help engineers work through difficult problems

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to create clarity when priorities or requirements are ambiguous

• A track record of building healthy, effective engineering teams while holding a high bar for quality and accountability

• Experience using AI-assisted development tools and the ability to evaluate their output critically as part of a responsible engineering workflow

• Sound judgment regarding data privacy, intellectual property, security, and the appropriate use of confidential information when working with AI tools

• Strong technical judgment and a foundation in software architecture, design, data structures, and algorithms

• Fluency with Java, Go, C++, Python, or a similar programming language (we code primarily in Java and Go)

• Experience recruiting, interviewing, and onboarding software engineers

• Openness to new technologies, new ways of working, and creative solutions

• Comfort working in a fast-paced environment

#LI-JB2

Pay ranges at Yext are established based on an analysis of salaries for positions with a similar level of accountability and impact in the relevant labor market. Salary levels are expected to change to reflect an employee’s job performance (results and impact) over time. Salaries at the time of hire are typically offered in the lower to middle of the above-referenced range in order to provide the opportunity to reflect performance-based increases over time. In addition to base salaries, employees at Yext are typically eligible for a comprehensive package of benefits including medical, dental and vision benefits; life insurance; short term and long-term disability; 401(k) retirement plan; and vacation and sick leave. Successful candidates may also be eligible for variable pay programs based on performance relative to goals and targets.

Annual Base Pay Range

$148,500—$303,500 USD

Yext is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a results-driven, engaging culture where every employee has the opportunity to contribute to the success of the Company, perform at the highest possible level, and grow their skills and capabilities. Yext welcomes employees and applicants of all backgrounds and demographics, and does not engage in discrimination on the basis of any protected characteristic recognized under applicable law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. The Company believes a broad variety of life experiences across the Yext team is critical to its mission to help every business in the world be visible everywhere customers search. By seeking out fresh perspectives and fostering a positive interview experience and employee experience, Yext can remain at the forefront of innovation, and better serve its customers.

It is Yext’s policy to provide reasonable accommodations to people with disabilities as required by applicable law. If you have a disability that requires an accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, or participating in the employee selection process, please complete this form.

Security Alert

All legitimate Yext communications come from @yext.com email addresses. Messages from other domains (for example, @yext.team) are not authorized and are likely fraudulent. If you receive a message that seems suspicious, do not share personal information, click on links, or provide payment. Instead, please report the communication to security@yext.com.

jobs.title: IT Support Specialist 1
jobs.description:
Build the Future with Us — EquipmentShare is Hiring an IT Support Specialist 1

At EquipmentShare, we’re not just filling a role — we’re assembling the best team on the planet to build something that’s never been built before. We’re on a mission to transform an industry that’s been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

We’re hiring an IT Support Specialist 1 for our Corporate HQ in Columbia, MO and we’re looking for someone who’s ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction.

Primary Responsibilities

• Respond promptly to incoming support requests via phone, email, Slack, or our ITSM platform.

• Troubleshoot and resolve basic to intermediate technical issues with computers, TVs, mobile devices, printers, and network connectivity.

• Assist users with software applications, account access, and password resets.

• Accurately document all support interactions and solutions in the ticketing system.

• Escalate unresolved issues to Tier 2 support with clear and detailed information.

• Assist with onboarding new employees, including setting up user accounts and devices.

• Help with offboarding tasks, such as disabling accounts and reclaiming equipment.

• Collaborate with IT team members to identify and address recurring issues.

• Participate in the on-call rotation for after-hours and weekend support.

Why EquipmentShare?

Because we do things differently — and we think you’ll feel it from day one. We’re a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn’t just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you’re behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports you, and you drive us forward.

We’re a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we’re looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of building something special.

Perks & Benefits

• Competitive compensation

• Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for full-time employees

• Generous PTO + paid holidays

• 401(k) + company match

• Gym membership stipend + wellness programs (earn PTO and prizes!)

• Company events, food truck nights

• 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year — give back to the community you call home

• Career advancement, leadership training, and professional development opportunities

About You

You want to be part of a team that’s not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we’re transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you’re excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

We’re looking for people who:

• See challenges as opportunities

• Embrace change and continuous improvement

• Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day

Skills & Qualifications

• Strong working knowledge of Windows and macOS operating systems.

• Basic knowledge of printer functionality

• Familiarity with mobile devices (iOS, tablets, and Android) and common office applications.

• Familiarity with ITSM, ITIL, and IT best practices are preferred.

• Familiarity with Audio and Visual troubleshooting techniques.

• Excellent customer service skills, including patience, empathy, and strong communication.

• Experience in creating processes and procedure workflows.

• Ability to troubleshoot basic hardware and software problems.

• Attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate notes and records.

• Ability to troubleshoot network setup and configuration issues

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or equivalent.

• An associate degree in computer science or a related field is a plus.

• IT certifications are a plus (A+, ITF, ITIL, NET+, etc.)

• At least 1+ years of experience in a help desk or customer service environment is needed.

Physical Requirements

• Must be able to sit for prolonged periods at a desk and work on a computer.

A Workplace For All

At EquipmentShare, we believe the best solutions come from a team that reflects the world around us. Our initiative — A Workplace For All — is rooted in the belief that we must work together to solve some of the toughest problems in construction. That means attracting, developing, and retaining great people from all walks of life.

We value different backgrounds, talents, and perspectives. We want you to feel like you belong here — because you do.

EquipmentShare is an EOE M/F/D/V.

Apex is currently seeking a Part-Time, Variable Asbestos Abatement Training Instructor to join our team in Portland, Oregon.

Apex Companies is seeking an experienced Asbestos Abatement Training Instructor to lead training for Oregon Asbestos Abatement Workers. This position requires professional bilingual communication skills in both Spanish and English, along with current or prior Oregon Asbestos Supervisor certification and at least three years of experience supervising asbestos abatement projects. • Current or prior Oregon Asbestos Supervisor certification.

• 3 + years of experience supervising asbestos abatement projects.

• Professional bilingual communication skills in both Spanish and English.

• Demonstrated knowledge of current asbestos abatement practices and applicable local, state, and federal regulations, including EPA and OSHA requirements.

• Experience as a classroom instructor, corporate trainer, safety officer, or in a similar training or instructional role.

• Ability to effectively evaluate asbestos abatement skills through hands-on demonstrations and practical exercises.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical and safety information clearly to trainees.

jobs.description:
About Engine

Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.

That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

About the Role

We're looking for a Principal Creative to join our Brand team. This role goes beyond creative direction and executing campaigns. It's about activating the Engine brand across its highest-impact moments and building the creative platforms that define how the brand shows up in the world.

You'll lead integrated brand campaigns, digital experiences, growth campaigns, social content, and beyond. You’ll define the big ideas that anchor each initiative and drive them through to delivery with creative rigor and strategic clarity. This role requires someone who is as comfortable developing a campaign platform as they are rolling up their sleeves on a focused, highly creative project.

This role is critical to how Engine's brand comes to life in the market. You'll partner closely with Brand Strategy to ensure every campaign and experience is rooted in sharp insight and clear positioning—translating strategy into work that is bold, cohesive, and built to perform across every touchpoint.

What You'll Do

• Lead the development of brand and campaign platforms — translating strategy into big, extensible ideas that scale across channels and contexts

• Activate the Engine brand across a wide range of initiatives including integrated campaigns, digital experiences, growth campaigns, product launches, and brand moments

• Own projects from brief through delivery — setting creative direction, driving decisions, and maintaining a high creative bar at every stage

• Partner closely with Brand Strategy to ensure creative work is grounded in sharp insight, clear positioning, and strategic intent

• Lead and inspire multi-disciplinary creative teams and agency partners, providing clear direction and meaningful feedback throughout the creative process

• Oversee smaller, highly creative projects with the same ambition and craft as large-scale campaigns, no project is too small to be exceptional

• Present creative concepts and campaign platforms to senior stakeholders and executive leadership with clarity and conviction

• Identify opportunities to extend and evolve the Engine brand into new channels, formats, and moments

What We're Looking For

• 12+ years of experience in creative direction or integrated marketing, with a portfolio that demonstrates strong conceptual thinking across brand campaigns, digital experiences, and growth creative

• Proven track record of developing brand and campaign platforms from brief through launch, at an exceptionally high creative bar

• Strong project lead, you are organized, decisive, and able to drive complex creative initiatives forward without losing creative momentum

• Deep partnership instincts, you know how to work closely with strategists, designers, copywriters, and producers to get to the best possible work

• Equally comfortable leading large-scale integrated campaigns and highly focused, craft-driven creative projects

• Highly conceptual with a sharp eye for how ideas extend and behave across touchpoints, channels, and formats

• Confident communicator and presenter who can advocate for creative decisions at the executive level

• Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where strategic clarity and creative ambition have to coexist

Applications for this role will be accepted through October 15th or until the role is filled. We encourage you to apply early, as we may begin reviewing applications before the deadline.

Compensation
Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.

Base Pay Range

$204,000—$240,000 USD

The Engine Edge: Perks & Compensation
We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:

• Compensation: Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with equity for all employees. Some roles are also eligible for bonuses or commissions.

• Benefits: Check out our full list at engine.com/culture

• Environments for Success: Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we'll make sure you have what you need to succeed.

Perks and benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and more

jobs.title: Operating Principal, CEO Office
jobs.description:
Why work at Higgsfield AI?

Higgsfield AI is the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $500M in annual revenue run rate, 25M+ users worldwide, 6M+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands. We're building at the absolute frontier of AI-powered video creation and next-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high-impact team shaping the future of AI-native experiences, at a company that isn't just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like.

About the Role

Operating Principals are Higgsfield’s general problem solvers. They work directly with the CEO and senior executives on the company’s key initiatives — owning several projects at a time, with no fixed lane: a new market this month, a broken process or a stalled product launch the next. The job is to take an undefined problem from zero to a working outcome, hand it off, and move to the next one.

What You’ll Be Doing

 - Identifying new growth and revenue opportunities across products, markets, and partners.

 - Building and optimising processes that can scale with a company growing this fast.

 - Leading and executing priority company initiatives end to end — analysis, decision, execution, follow-through.

 - Pulling engineering, product, growth, and partnerships into one plan and unblocking whatever stalls.

 - Preparing the numbers, models, and one-pagers behind leadership, board, and investor decisions.

Scope

 - Based in San Francisco, with regular trips to Almaty and travel to partners and markets as projects require.

 - Direct access to the CEO; high ownership, minimal process — no team underneath, no playbook.

What You’ll Need

 - A degree from a top-tier university — ideally STEM or another highly quantitative field.

 - A track record of outstanding achievement in several different areas — olympiads, case competitions, elite scholarships, building something that worked.

 - 3–5 years of experience, including at least 2 years in a top-tier strategy consultancy, investment bank / PE, Big Tech, or a fast-growing global technology company.

 - Experience working abroad, as an expat, or inside a global organisation as a non-native speaker.

 - A solid track record of taking ownership and leading complex projects end to end.

 - The ability to break complex problems into smaller, actionable ones and enjoy working with data.

 - Writing and presenting at a level that goes straight to the board or a Fortune 500 partner without editing.

 - Natural curiosity, speed, and a will to make an impact.

 - Right to work in the US; based in San Francisco or ready to relocate.

Nice to Have

 - A chief-of-staff, founder’s-office, or BizOps stint after consulting / banking.

 - Hands-on experience with SQL, Python, or Gen AI tooling.

 - Background in AI, consumer tech, or media.

Screening / Interview Topics

 - Hardest Problem Owned – an ambiguous project taken from zero to outcome, and what the candidate personally did

 - Cross-Functional Delivery – moving engineering, product, and business teams without formal authority

 - Analytical Depth – building and defending a model or business case under time pressure

 - Executive Communication – a board deck, investor update, or CEO memo they wrote themselves

 - Pace & Ambiguity – handling a priority flip mid-project

What We Offer

 - Competitive base salary in USD, based on your experience, skills, and the scope of the role.

 - Equity participation through the company’s stock option program, giving you the opportunity to share in Higgsfield’s long-term growth.

 - A highly collaborative, fast-paced environment where you can work directly with experienced leaders and have a meaningful impact on the product and company.

 - Opportunities for professional growth, ownership, and career development as the company scales.

 - Company-provided equipment, meals, transportation, or other office benefits.

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. jobs.title: Head of People Development & Culture
jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Waymo is seeking a Head of People Development and Culture to play a pivotal role in the growth and scale of the company. This organization's charter is to define and design our overall learning roadmap, core skills architecture and functional upskilling initiatives to support Waymo’s business objectives. This includes managing our overall learning technology ecosystem as well as vendor partners to support our curriculum.

The successful candidate will have the ability to toggle between both the strategic and operational nature of the role, with deep understanding of the business and its priority needs to drive a best-in-class learning and development function. This individual is expected to set the vision for the team while hiring and supporting individual team members in their development and career objectives.

The Head of People Development and Culture is a human-centered and empathetic leader who is curious and data-driven, dedicated to team collaboration and cultivating talent to thrive across Waymo.

You will:

• Architect and deliver a multi-year learning and capability strategy that empowers our talent to achieve Waymo’s mission “to be the world’s most trusted driver.”

• Provide a framework for guiding the implementation of our learning strategy to support both the enterprise wide horizontal needs as well as functional and cohort demands. This includes key stakeholder involvement from the business to inform the capabilities needed, both human and agentic to identify and address our evolving needs as a company.

• Build an enduring, scalable leadership pipeline by equipping leaders with stage-specific capability building opportunities and curriculum from first-time manager fundamentals to manager-of-managers and executive leadership.

• Serve as a subject matter expert to cultivate a strong learning culture, driving awareness, education, and shared accountability for the employee experience across cross-functional teams.

• Further integrate Waymo Way values and behaviors directly into everyday operations to recognize, reinforce, and elevate valued capabilities.

• Develop holistic success measures into our learning and culture practices and implement appropriate measurements to track our efforts and better influence decisions related to our curriculum.

• Champion and guide our Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), setting strategic direction and providing programmatic support on all programs and efforts to maximize impact across Waymo.

• Be a trusted advisor to the business, and in partnership with our People Business Partner team, be responsive to the short-term and long-term needs to enable success against business objectives.

• Continuously improve our new hire orientation and onboarding in partnership with People Operations, expert instructors and our business leadership to deliver a magical employee experience grounded in our Waymo values and behaviors.

• Establish governance, mission, budget and oversight for all People Development and Culture work that impacts Waymo's workforce.

You have:

• BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience in Human Resources, Learning & Development or related discipline

• 10+ years of progressively responsible management experience within the leadership and organizational development field overseeing enterprise learning, leadership development and talent systems in a complex organization

• Experience working in a high-growth, tech environment

• Advanced knowledge and applied background in training and organizational development.

• Strong organizational development background, with proven ability to drive enterprise wide change structural and behavioral change efforts

• Advanced business partnering skills to develop and maintain relationships with senior leadership, front-line managers and all levels of the organization in service of delivering against critical business needs

• Track record of scaling and delivering programs and efforts that directly align and support the company’s strategic objectives and our talent strategy priorities, in close partnership with our People team and business stakeholders

• Highly data driven with demonstrated ability to translate analytics into insights and recommendations to drive decisions and measurable organizational impact

• Experiences in identifying critical human capabilities and pathways to ensure learning programs address the critical needs of an AI centered workforce of the future including judgement, discretion and accountability

• Demonstrated experience hiring and developing a high performing, collaborative team

• Passion for an inclusive work environment, seeking to understand diverse viewpoints in the decision-making process

• Track record of strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in a high-paced, fast growing environment

• Detail-oriented and committed to a high degree of accuracy

We prefer:

• Experience in client-facing roles to engage, listen, educate and respond with priority actions in partnership with key stakeholders across various functions and levels

• Experience in interpreting external and internal trends, innovation and thinking and translating them into effective practices

• Comfortable to fail and experiment, conduct retrospectives and harness learnings to shape actions

The expected base salary range for this full-time position across US locations is listed below. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the role location or, if the role can be performed remote, the specific salary range for your preferred location, during the hiring process.

Waymo employees are also eligible to participate in Waymo’s discretionary annual bonus program, equity incentive plan, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements.

Salary Range

$334,000—$411,000 USD
