jobs.title: Senior Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description:
Build the Path Forward

At Path Robotics, we’re attacking a trillion dollar opportunity - doing things that have never been done before to support an industry hurting from a lack of skilled labor. Big, hard problems are what Path tackles every day and our people are our greatest asset to get that job done. Our intelligent, hardworking team of people do the impossible every single day, yet remain incredibly kind, humble, and always ready to support one another.

We're looking for a Senior Manufacturing Engineer to shape how we build our robotic welding cells as we scale. You'll lead lean and continuous improvement work across our build floor, and you'll play a central role in planning the production layout for the new facilities we're moving into over the next few years. This role reports to the Director of Manufacturing Operations.

What You’ll Do

• Lead production layout planning for our new buildings, from initial concept through move-in, including process flow, material flow, workstation design, storage strategy, utilities, equipment placement and traffic patterns for both material and people

• Partner with supply chain and build leadership to develop layouts that support today's volume and planned growth

• Plan and manage the transition of production into new space with minimal disruption to build schedules

• Design intra-factory material flow from receiving and storage through kitting, line-side delivery, WIP movement and shipment of finished cells, so flow is built into the new buildings from the start rather than added later

• Map current-state and future-state value streams across build, kitting and test, and use the data, along with simulation where it helps, to drive prioritized improvements on the floor

• Lead continuous improvement events (kaizen, 5S, standard work) that reduce lead time, WIP, rework and cost; push changes to the floor quickly, measure the impact and iterate

• Build takt time, line balancing and capacity models to size workstations, staffing and floor space

• Identify and resolve flow imbalances caused by inventory processes, layouts, part shortages or staffing constraints, and drive fixes with Supply Chain, Quality and design engineering

• Develop standard work, work instructions and visual management with technicians and supervisors on the floor

• Design fixtures, tooling and material presentation (kanban, point-of-use storage) that improve flow and ergonomics

• Define and track KPIs such as cycle time, throughput, first-pass yield, on-time delivery, line-side material availability, inventory accuracy, WIP dwell time and material-driven downtime, and report progress to operations leadership

• Work with ERP and inventory system owners to keep material movement data accurate and visible in real time

• Work with design engineering on design for manufacturability and assembly as new products and configurations are released to the floor

• Coach engineers and technicians in lean tools and structured problem solving (A3, root cause analysis, PDCA)

Who You Are

• Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing, Industrial or Mechanical Engineering, or a related field

• 7+ years of manufacturing engineering experience in a production environment, ideally low-volume, high-mix assembly of complex electromechanical equipment, machinery or automation systems

• Proven experience leading production facility layout projects, such as a new building, plant expansion or line relocation, from concept through move-in

• Strong understanding of factory design, line layout and intra-factory logistics for hardware manufacturing, including fabricated structures, electromechanical assemblies, wiring and controls

• Experience supporting new products from introduction through production ramp

• Hands-on lean manufacturing practitioner with measurable results from value stream mapping, kaizen, 5S, standard work and pull systems

• Track record of building a continuous improvement culture on the floor, not just running projects

• Proficient in CAD for layout work (AutoCAD and/or SolidWorks) and comfortable reading engineering drawings; experience with plant layout or flow simulation tools is a plus

• Comfortable with data: time studies, capacity models and line balancing analysis in Excel or similar tools

• Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification preferred

• Experience with robotics, welding or industrial automation is a plus

• Clear communicator who can lead cross-functional projects and earn buy-in from technicians through senior leadership

• Self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity and limited resources in a fast-growing company

• Must be local to Columbus, Ohio or willing to relocate

Physical Requirements & Working Conditions

• Work is performed on-site at our Columbus, Ohio facility, split between the office and the production floor

• Regular time on the manufacturing floor, including standing and walking for extended periods

• Ability to lift up to 50 lbs occasionally

• Exposure to typical manufacturing conditions, including noise, welding operations and moving equipment; PPE is required in designated areas

• Occasional travel to new building sites, suppliers and equipment vendors (estimated under 10%)

Who We Are

At Path Robotics we love coming to work to solve interesting and tough challenges but also because our ideas are welcomed and valued. We encourage unique thinking and are dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Regulatory and Compliance Requirements

This position may support work performed under U.S. Government contracts and requires compliance with applicable federal regulations, including FAR and DFARS where applicable.

The role may involve access to export-controlled information subject to ITAR and/or EAR.

Candidates must be able to comply with U.S. export control regulations, which may include meeting the definition of a “U.S. Person” where required.

This position may also involve handling Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and requires adherence to company and federal data protection and confidentiality standards. Employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a background check consistent with applicable requirements

If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application process or any part of the hiring process, please contact HR@path-robotics.com. We are committed to providing equal access and will work with qualified individuals to ensure a fair and accessible hiring experience. We will respond to your request within 48 hours.

jobs.title: FP&A Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT LAWHIVE

Lawhive is a global, AI-native law firm. Operating in the US and UK, we’ve built our own agentic operating system for legal services.

We partner with leading Main Street law firms to give lawyers and back-office teams the AI platform, marketing, and operational support to grow faster than they could alone. Our specialized AI agent for legal work, Lawrence, works alongside lawyers, putting human legal judgment right where it belongs: at the center of every matter. 

We're backed by a $60M Series B at a $685M valuation, from investors including Google Ventures, TQ Ventures, Mitch Rales, Balderton Capital and Premier League footballers Harry Maguire and Reece James. In the last few years we've hit milestone after milestone, raising over $110M in funding. Today, we're on track to exceed $100 million in annual revenue, and we have offices in London, New York, Austin, and Phoenix.

So if you want your work to have real, tangible impact as we redefine an entire industry, Lawhive is where you can make it happen.




FINANCE AT LAWHIVE

We're a lean finance team working across Lawhive's UK and US group, partnering with every part of the business from product and engineering to legal operations and the exec team. Over the next 12 to 18 months we're focused on:

 - Building the systems, controls and reporting for a multi-entity group on the path to audit

 - Creating real-time, decision-grade data on cash flow, margins and unit economics

 - Bringing acquired entities into one unified finance function

 - Automating workflows across payables, payroll, tax, FP&A and revenue accounting

If you want a finance role where the problems are real and the impact is visible across the whole company, this is it.




ROLE OVERVIEW

We're looking for an experienced FP&A Lead to build and own financial planning across Lawhive's fast-scaling, multi-entity UK and US group. As our first dedicated FP&A hire, you'll establish the foundations of the function, owning forecasting, budgeting and financial modelling end to end.

This is a role for someone who has built FP&A foundations before, ideally in a startup or scale-up. You'll bring experience standardising financial planning across multiple entities, creating structure from ambiguity and providing senior stakeholders with clear, commercially relevant insights.

Working closely with finance leadership and teams across product, engineering, operations and commercial functions, you'll combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, building scalable processes and using automation and AI to improve how we plan and make decisions.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


FORECASTING AND MODELLING

 - Lead group-level forecasting across revenue, headcount, costs and cash flow.

 - Build and own financial models that support strategic planning and investment decisions.

 - Analyse performance, identifying key drivers, risks and opportunities.

 - Lead scenario modelling, long-range planning and sensitivity analysis.


BUSINESS PARTNERING

 - Partner with senior leaders to understand performance, risks and future requirements.

 - Translate financial insights into clear, actionable recommendations.

 - Provide commercial and financial guidance on new initiatives and operational decisions.

 - Influence decision-making through strong relationships and high-quality financial analysis.


REPORTING AND INSIGHT

 - Own group-level management reporting, delivering clear analysis and performance insights.

 - Establish consistent reporting across entities, tracking revenue, margins, unit economics and operational KPIs.

 - Improve reporting processes, dashboards and financial data visibility.

 - Ensure accuracy, consistency and audit-ready documentation across financial outputs.


BUILDING THE FUNCTION

 - Establish scalable FP&A processes, tools and reporting frameworks from the ground up.

 - Lead budgeting and standardise planning processes across teams and entities.

 - Partner with Management Accounting on month-end performance, variance analysis and financial insights.

 - Strengthen financial governance and planning discipline across the group.




ABOUT YOU

 - Significant FP&A, commercial finance or strategic finance experience, with proven ownership of financial planning, ideally with exposure to building financial planning processes, models and reporting frameworks from the ground up.

 - Experience building or transforming FP&A processes, ideally in a startup or scale-up environment.

 - Strong multi-entity experience, including standardising planning and reporting at group level.

 - Advanced Excel and Google Sheets skills, with excellent financial modelling capabilities.

 - Confident analysing complex datasets and translating insights into clear recommendations.

 - Experience partnering with senior stakeholders and influencing strategic decisions.

 - Strong understanding of revenue models, costs, margins and operational metrics.

 - Experience improving financial processes through automation, ideally using AI.

 - Highly analytical, commercially minded and intellectually curious.

 - A hands-on self-starter who thrives in ambiguity, builds structure and drives continuous improvement.




INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - Introductory call with our Talent team

 - 1:1 with your hiring team

 - Skills assessment interview

 - Values interview with one of our Founders

 - We offer!



Benefits:

 - 🩺 Healthcare benefits: 'Premium' plan with 100% employee cover and 50% dependent cover

 - ✈️ Vacation: 20 days + 11 Federal holidays + 1 day of Birthday leave

 - 💰 401k: Matching contribution up to 2% of salary

 - 💰 Equity: Options in Lawhive LTD



Diversity at Lawhive

At Lawhive, we know that diversity of thought is critical to delivering outlier outcomes. As such, we’re always working hard to ensure we build a diverse, inclusive team, and as we scale, we’ll only ever increase the focus we apply to this.

jobs.title: Senior Developer Advocate - Volcano
jobs.description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply.  Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.



About the Role

Volcano (volcano.dev http://volcano.dev) is a cloud for apps built with coding agents. You tell Claude Code, Cursor or Codex what you want, and it sets up the database, auth, functions, storage, realtime and deploys on Volcano without a trip through a dashboard. Most platforms were designed around a person in a console and added agent support later. We started from the agent.

We're a small team and launched publicly in September 2026. Volcano is incubated by Kong and runs as its own company with its own brand.

This role sits between engineering and the developers we build for. You'll build on Volcano constantly, show people what it can do, and bring back what you learn so the product gets better.



What you'll do

 - Own the Volcano Cookbook: recipes that build real apps on Volcano with tools developers already use, written up with the code, the decisions and the gotchas.

 - Build templates and examples people can deploy in one step.

 - Make video, including YouTube, streams and short demos.

 - Run Volcano hackathons, show up at others, and decide which sponsorships are worth doing.

 - Work with the companies whose tools appear in our recipes on joint content.

 - Spend time where developers ask questions, in Discord, on X and on GitHub, and bring what you hear back to the team.

 - Build the tooling and workflows that let a small team publish more without the quality slipping.

 - Be customer zero. You'll hit rough edges before users do, and engineers should be able to act on your reports.



Who you'll bring

 - You've built things in public in the last year and can show us what you shipped and how you told people about it.

 - You've done 0-to-1 work: started a company, joined one early, or launched something from nothing.

 - You're technical and fluent with coding agents. You don't need to be a database or infrastructure expert, but you can build a working app with Claude Code or similar, debug it when it breaks, and explain what happened.

 - You write well. You use AI in your own workflow, and you can tell when output reads like slop.

 - You like explaining things, whether to a room, a camera or a thread of skeptical replies.

 - Engineers trust you on technical accuracy.
   
   

Bonus Points

 - An existing developer audience

 - Hackathon organizing experience

 - Experience with developer platforms like Vercel, Supabase, Neon or Cloudflare.





About Kong:

jobs.title: Member Care Lead - New York
jobs.description:
MISSION

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear. 

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.



Role Purpose 

Most companies treat support as a queue to clear. We think it can be the warmest, most memorable part of the whole experience.

Neko Health is building a new kind of healthcare: proactive, human, and built around the member. In the US, that promise is about to meet thousands of new members, and the care behind every call, text, email, and message has to feel like hospitality at its best. Right now, that team is yet to be scaled, and you would help build it.

As a Member Care Lead, you will work with a team of peers to lead a high-performing, hospitality-led support organisation across email, phone, SMS, and social. You will guide frontline Agents, and you will work alongside Workforce Planning, Quality, Training, and Tooling colleagues to make great service consistent. You will partner closely with Clinics, Operations, Product, and Marketing, and stay hands-on where it matters most: complex escalations, high-visibility social moments, and coaching by example. All of it serves one common goal: to reinforce the Neko brand in everything we do and to exceed expectations every time.

You will help build a culture grounded in trust, accountability, and open communication, where every member interaction reflects Neko’s commitment to proactive, human-centred care. You will use data, automation, and AI to make that service faster and sharper, without losing the human touch at its heart.

We are scaling aggressively, and this is the moment to get it right. If you want to build something extraordinary, something members talk about long after the conversation ends, this is the role.


What You’ll Do

 - Work with your peers to scale a high-performing US customer care function, with measurable improvements in SLA, CSAT/NPS, QA scores, and first-contact resolution. (Member-first, always)

 - Work with Workforce Planning to help forecast demand and optimise rotas, so staffing supports clinic operations and demand variability. (Tech-enabled, human-centred)

 - Collaborate on scalable SOPs, escalation frameworks, and service playbooks that simplify operations while protecting trust and speed. (Hard truths, high hopes)

 - Partner with colleagues across the business to reduce avoidable contacts, give members greater clarity, and raise support efficiency. (Chase 10X, not 10%)

 - Strengthen alignment with Clinics, Operations, Product, and Marketing so member communication is consistent and service delivery is seamless. (Impact, not activity)

 - Help build Voice-of-Member feedback loops that inform product development, operational improvements, and training priorities. (Optimistic truth-seeking)

 - Stay selectively hands-on with complex escalations, public-facing social care, and coaching, setting the standard by example.
   

Minimum Requirements

 - 3 to 5+ years’ experience in customer or member support within high-touch or service-intensive environments.

 - 2+ years leading multiple frontline support teams.

 - Proven success improving multi-channel support operations (email, phone, SMS, social), with measurable impact on SLA, QA, CSAT/NPS, and FCR.

 - Strong experience working with workforce planning teams on forecasting, rota design, and intraday operations management.

 - Demonstrated ability to lead people, build team culture, and develop future leaders through coaching and feedback.

 - Strong operational and analytical skills, with the ability to turn performance data into actionable improvements.

 - Excellent judgement in sensitive member situations, public-facing social care, and complex escalations.

 - Deep familiarity with support platforms such as Zendesk (or equivalent), including reporting, tagging, macros, and workflow optimisation.

 - A calm, organised, and decisive approach in fast-paced, high-visibility environments.

Preferred

 - Experience in healthcare, health tech, wellness, or other sensitive service environments.

 - Experience supporting clinic, field, or distributed operational teams.

 - Background in hospitality-led or premium service environments.

 - Experience contributing to QA frameworks, escalation playbooks, or Help Center and self-serve content strategies.

 - Exposure to automation, CX tooling optimisation, or AI-supported customer service.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Core Platform
jobs.description:
CAIS is the pioneer in democratizing access to and education about alternative investments and structured notes for independent advisors, asset managers, and bank issuers, empowering them to engage and transact on a massive scale. We believe that the combination of industry-leading technology and human interaction throughout the pre-trade, trade, and post-trade experience delivers superior operational efficiency and a world-class client experience. CAIS provides advisors with a broad selection of alternative investment strategies, including private equity, private credit, real estate, infrastructure, hedge funds, and structured notes. CAIS serves over 2,500 wealth management firms that support more than 65,000 financial advisors who oversee approximately $8.5 trillion in end-client assets.

Role Overview

We are looking to hire a Senior Product Manager to be a hands-on leader of our Core Platform team. The team owns the shared platform every other product team at CAIS builds on: including identity and access management (IAM), learning management, the homepage, and our public website. In identity, that means enterprise authentication, the tools clients use to manage their firms, users, and permissions, and the regulatory workflows that keep our user base accurate, secure, and auditable. This is foundational, high-leverage product work. When the platform is healthy, every product team moves faster.

You will set product direction for a small, high-surface-area crew, working in close partnership with engineering leadership to sequence our backlog against capacity. You will also serve as the connective tissue between Core and the many squads that depend on its services — Capital Markets, Funds, Marketing, Sales, and Data among them — making clear calls on where a shared mechanism ends and a consuming team's own implementation begins. AI is central to how we work and what we build. We expect this person to experiment with and use AI tools every day to drive product outcomes, from research and requirements to prioritization and measuring results.

Key Responsibilities

• Own product direction for Core Platform: IAM, Access Manager, firm/user/role/team administration, enterprise authentication (SSO, MFA), content & learning management systems, and the shared frameworks and services other squads depend on.

• Drive platform modernization: self-service firm administration, bulk user management, new ways of handling user authentication in the age of AI, and other client needs — updating one of the platform’s most-used interfaces.

• Own the enterprise authentication roadmap: reliable firm-context resolution for multi-firm and dually-registered advisors, SSO migrations, and login/session experience.

• Partner with Compliance and Legal on identity-integrity and regulatory workflows.

• Set direction for CAIS IQ platform modernization (the firm's learning/compliance education product).

• Evaluate emerging initiatives and bring leadership a clear, evidence-based build/no-build recommendation.

• Bring hands-on, consistent product engagement to the crew's day-to-day: standard organization practices, backlog refinement, and prioritization. This is a hands-on role; the PM's presence and judgment set the team's direction day-to-day, not just at the roadmap level.

• Represent the team’s priorities in cross-functional planning, translating infrastructure trade-offs into business-impact language for non-technical stakeholders.

• Partner with engineering leadership on resourcing and sequencing decisions given a rapidly growing business.

Skills & Experience Required

• Demonstrated product management experience, including leading platform or infrastructure product areas (not solely client-facing features), ideally within fintech or another regulated B2B environment.

• Experience leading day-to-day product delivery with engineering teams, including backlog refinement, planning, and release coordination.

• Understanding of compliance-adjacent product work — identity verification, regulatory identifiers, sanctions/KYC-style screening, or audit trail requirements — in a regulated industry.

• Proven ability to operate as a platform PM: defining clear ownership boundaries between a shared-services team and the crews that consume its services, and holding that line with engineering peers.

• Strong stakeholder management skills: able to translate infrastructure and platform work into business-impact language for executive, non-technical audiences while remaining technically credible with engineering counterparts.

Highly Advantageous Skills

• Hands-on experience with Auth0 or a comparable identity provider.

• Experience with identity and access management concepts: authentication (SSO/SAML/OAuth), authorization and permissions models, and multi-tenant firm/user/role hierarchies.

• Familiarity with Team Topologies or other platform/shared-services team operating models.

• Experience in wealth management, alternative investments, or broader capital markets technology.

• Exposure to learning management systems or compliance education platforms.

CAIS is consistently recognized as a Best Place to Work, and our culture is at the heart of our success. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where employees can be their most authentic selves and feel inspired and supported to bring their voice forward to drive community, growth, and innovation. We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law.  Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at https://www.caisgroup.com/our-company/careers.

CAIS’ compensation package includes a market competitive salary, a performance bonus, and exceptional benefits. If you are located in New York, New York, the base salary range for this role is $160,000 – $200,000. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and specific office location.

CAIS offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes generously subsidized healthcare with 100% employer paid dental and vision insurance, an employer matched retirement plan, wellness programs, and generous PTO and parental leave. Additionally, CAIS offers a flexible, hybrid in-office model; for most roles, we require a minimum of 3 days in either our New York City or Austin office per week.  For more information on our benefits and career opportunities, please visit our website: https://www.caisgroup.com/our-company/careers.

We use technology, including AI tools, to support parts of our recruitment process such as application screening, interview scheduling, and candidate communications. These tools are used to improve efficiency and consistency, but they do not replace human judgement. All hiring decisions are made by people, and we are committed to fair and unbiased assessment of every candidate.

jobs.title: Partner Manager
jobs.description:
This role is part of our AddSearch team, one of our growing brands at saas.group.

AddSearch is a ~15-person B2B SaaS company providing enterprise site search solutions to large customers with demanding compliance, custom contract, and SLA requirements. Our core product is mature and stable, while our newest offering - an AI-powered RAG solution - is driving the majority of our current sales growth.

Profile Overview

As our Partner Manager, you will work closely with our Sales and Marketing teams and report to VP Commercial. Sales will keep ownership of closing deals. You will own everything that brings partner-led opportunities to the table.

You will build and run our partner channel. While you inherit existing strategic partners, you will acquire and onboard new ones and turn those relationships into a steady source of leads and revenue.

Your responsibilities

• Win new strategic partners. Find, approach, and sign agencies and other partners that fit our ideal customer profile.

• Build and maintain a strong partner base. Grow our base of active partners. Keep it steady by replacing partners who leave or underperform with new ones.

• Nurture existing relationships. Onboard new partners, enable their teams, and run regular business reviews. As a result, partners will know how to position & implement AddSearch and when to bring us into a project.

• Drive partner-led leads and revenue. Generate qualified opportunities through your partners and hand them to Sales with full context. In addition, track how partner-sourced and partner-influenced deals perform over time.

• Run joint marketing with partners. Plan webinars, co-created content, case studies, and events together with partners and with our Marketing team.

• Set up partner reporting. Define how we attribute partner-sourced pipeline in HubSpot. Then report on partner health, pipeline, and revenue to leadership.

• Share what you learn. Bring partner and market feedback to Sales, Marketing, and Product so we keep improving how we work with partners.

What You bring to the table

• 4+ years of experience in partnerships, channel, alliances, or business development, preferably in B2B SaaS

• A track record of signing partners and getting them to produce leads, not only logos

• AI fluency (must have): You work with AI every day and can explain and sell AI-powered products to agencies and their clients

• A commercial mindset. You are comfortable with pipeline targets, conversion rates, and revenue goals.

• Strong relationship skills. You can earn the trust of agency owners and senior decision makers.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Hands-on experience with a CRM such as HubSpot, and a habit of making decisions with data

• A self-starter attitude. You enjoy building a program from the ground up and you do not wait for a perfect playbook.

• A big plus: experience working with web agencies. Our core partners are agencies, so you will already speak their language, understand how they sell projects, and know what makes them recommend a tool.

• Nice to have: familiarity with CMS or digital experience ecosystems, or site search

What’s in it for You

• Ultimate flexibility: We’re 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like.

• Freedom and autonomy: We’re a high-trust team, and you’ll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way, with plenty of help from the team when you need it.

• Minimum bureaucracy: We don’t like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable.

• Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.

• Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally.

• Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed.

AddSearch is part of saas.group and we have a shared goal of succeeding together.

What is saas.group?

Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 380+ colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.

Also, don’t forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company.

We don’t just simply offer you to “take a job with us” but rather to “join us on this journey” to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.

Sounds like something you’re up for? Feel free to apply even if you don’t check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!

—

saas.group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're passionate about working with a team that values innovation, excellence, and fairness, we encourage you to apply.

We believe in fair and transparent pay. Salary ranges at saas.group are location-adjusted, targeting local market medians for a remote-first environment, and will be shared with our potential future employees in writing before your first interview - so you have everything you need to evaluate the opportunity.

jobs.title: Warehouse Lead
jobs.description:
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1d985516-2a99-43c0-b591-957f5adaceb9/5ac97b31-49cd-4012-8bb0-5caf15e33c69/B25.png]




WE ARE LOOKING FOR A WAREHOUSE LEAD TO JOIN OUR WAREHOUSE TEAM; AS WE SCALE UP AND DRIVE DIGITAL AND FINANCIAL INCLUSION ACROSS OUR MARKETS.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1d985516-2a99-43c0-b591-957f5adaceb9/2c6957b4-39d2-40b3-8eb6-7e380a0c2f9c/B13.png]



THE ROLE

As Warehouse Lead, you are the owner of how devices move through our warehouse, from the moment a delivery arrives to the moment a provisioned phone is ready for a customer. You lead the Warehouse Assistants (the JD also mentions Handlers and the Provisioning Team, so please confirm which to name) and report to the Manager, Warehouse and Logistics Operations. You sit within Supply Chain, working with the Warehouse and Logistics teams. Location to be confirmed.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1d985516-2a99-43c0-b591-957f5adaceb9/5e9f3448-2fed-4b66-b1ee-9474279a7947/B13.png]




ABOUT US

M-KOPA is a pan-African fintech providing asset financing and credit services across Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana and South Africa. We have reached 10 million customers and extended $2B+ in credit, supported by 2,300+ employees and 35,000+ field agents. 86% of our customers are satisfied with us, and 55% are accessing formal financial services for the first time.




[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1d985516-2a99-43c0-b591-957f5adaceb9/ba282a12-7335-4f14-b5d0-85744a5ad867/B7.png]



This is a on-site role, you would be working from our offices in Nigeria, partnering with a diverse group of employees from our different markets and locations across the UK, Europe and Africa. You will be reporting to the Manager, Warehouse and Logistics Operations.




WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT

This is not a stock-keeping role. You own the link between the physical device on the shelf and the systems that finance it: D365, M-KOPANet and the IMEI records behind every customer’s phone. When those match, customers get their devices on time. When they don’t, we feel it straight away.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Receiving and storage: Oversee customs and import clearance, resolve delivery discrepancies, own D365 and M-KOPANet postings, stock control and FIFO policy, and assist with stock takes and material requirement planning.

 - Provisioning and systems: Plan daily allocation, manage SLAs across flashing, enrolment and locking, resolve escalations, and own IMEI upload accuracy across M-KOPANet, AX, KG and HMD Softlock.

 - Quality, reporting and people: Oversee RFS reconciliation and quality standards, deliver weekly and monthly reconciliation with real-time Dynamics transaction accuracy, and supervise the Handlers and Provisioning Team while keeping stakeholders informed.




WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - At least an HND/BSc in a business-related field. A diploma in Store/Warehouse Management or Procurement is an added advantage.

 - Over 3 years’ work experience in a similar position, including hands-on use of ERP and other inventory management systems.

 - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with previous experience managing teams and driving process and performance improvement.





The honest part
Targets like 100% IMEI accuracy and zero discrepancies leave little room for “close enough.” You will work across customs, vendors, systems and a team at once, and escalations will land on your desk when something breaks. If that sounds like the job you already do well, this one gives it far greater reach.




WHY M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.



Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com http://m-kopa.com.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1d985516-2a99-43c0-b591-957f5adaceb9/369018b8-cf9c-49c7-95f1-1d414482ba57/B13.png]

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1d985516-2a99-43c0-b591-957f5adaceb9/481f6724-8375-4f39-b514-fbe00b8fc3b5/B13.png]



Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.



M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships. 



M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.



Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.



If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.

jobs.title: Business Development Specialist
jobs.description:
ABOUT MOTORWAY

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.


ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a consultative B2B sales role focused on driving platform adoption across UK car dealerships and encouraging active daily auction participation.

You’ll manage a varied portfolio of dealer partners across the UK, ranging from onboarding brand-new businesses and winning back lapsed accounts, to optimizing performance for established, regular buyers. Rather than hard-selling from a rigid script, your goal is to ask great questions, understand each dealership’s unique business goals and position the value of Motorway to demonstrate a clear ROI. You will ultimately build high-value, collaborative and long-term relationships.

Whether you’re delivering a powerful first impression to a new account or embedding repeatable, profitable processes into an existing or lapsed partner's daily routine, you'll act as a trusted advisor to help them win. We don't expect you to know everything on day one, but we do look for solid sales foundations, curiosity, and a drive to learn. We’ll back you with structured coaching, dedicated mentorship, and all the tools you need to succeed.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Consult & Position: Conduct high-level business conversations to uncover dealership needs, positioning Motorway as an essential, long-term inventory solution.

 - Drive Network Activity: Onboard new dealership partners, re-engage cold or lapsed accounts, and nurture regular users to drive daily auction participation.

 - Demonstrate Value Fast: Clearly articulate ROI to new or hesitant dealers while building repeatable, sustainable buying habits for mature accounts.

 - Pipeline Ownership: Maintain exceptional CRM hygiene using HubSpot to log activity, manage your pipeline, and report accurately.

 - Overcome Friction: Confidently navigate objections, address dealer pain points, and follow up consistently to keep conversations moving forward.

 - Collaborate for Impact: Work closely with cross-functional teams to resolve dealer challenges and feed market insights back to our product team.

 - Hit Targets: Take ownership of your numbers, proactively seeking coaching and feedback whenever you spot room to grow.


WHO YOU ARE

 - Sales Foundations: You have background experience in B2B or outbound sales, working comfortably against key performance targets.

 - Consultative Mindset: You ask smart questions before pitching, listening intently to tailor your value proposition to each business.

 - Adaptable Communicator: Exceptional telephone manner with the confidence to speak to business owners and decision-makers at all levels.

 - CRM Competent: Comfortable managing a pipeline and staying organised across a busy, diverse portfolio using HubSpot (or a similar CRM).

 - Resilient & Driven: Rejection doesn't derail you; it motivates you to follow up. You’re genuinely energised by hitting and exceeding targets.

 - Relationship Builder: You're motivated by true customer success and prefer doing things right over closing a bad deal fast.

 - Continuous Learner: You’re coachable and take ownership of your development.


LIFE IN THE TEAM

The B2B Sales team at Motorway is a tight-knit, collaborative group who work hard, celebrate wins together, and genuinely look out for one another. You’ll be encouraged to test new approaches, ask questions, and share ideas.

You'll be based in our multi-story, sea-fronted Brighton office located in the heart of the city next to Churchill Square, where vibrant culture and professional growth go hand in hand.


WE OFFER A FANTASTIC RANGE OF BENEFITS TO HELP YOU THRIVE

 - £26,000 starting salary (OTE £48,000)

 - Great work-life balance with standard shifts from 9am to 5:30pm

 - Sea fronted office location with regular social events, office drinks, weekly massages and free snacks to keep you going!

 - Flexibility to work from home 1 day per week to help nail that work life balance

 - Stock options so you can share in Motorway’s growth and future success

 - Pension scheme to plan for your future with our provider NEST

 - Strong commitment to your personal development including budget for books, courses, conferences, etc!

 - Opt-in comprehensive health insurance through BUPA including fitness discounts

 - Cycle to work scheme - save big ££ on a new bike and accessories

 - One paid volunteering day a year for you to use as you wish

 - Generous parental benefits including 6 months full paid maternity leave, 4 weeks paternity leave and and workplace nursery scheme

 - ... and much more!

jobs.description:
ABOUT ALU

At the African Leadership University (ALU), we're more than just an institution—we're a catalyst for transformation. Our mission is to develop a new generation of ethical and entrepreneurial leaders who will shape Africa's future. Through our innovative curriculum, focus on experiential learning, and vibrant pan-African community, we empower students to become changemakers, problem-solvers, and innovators. At ALU, we're not just teaching; we're nurturing the leaders who will drive Africa's progress and prosperity in the 21st century

We are dedicated to fostering an open yet secure environment, balancing the safety of students, staff, and visitors with respect for individual rights, and safeguarding responsibilities.

HOW WE WORK

The ALU Team works in starkly different ways to traditional academic bureaucracies. We approach education from first principles, empower individuals to design, test, and implement creative new ideas, and work closely together to craft transformative learning experiences. We are deeply passionate about our students and excited by the challenge of building something entirely new.

The African Leadership University is committed to ensuring the safety and Well-being of all students under our care. As part of this commitment , we have a comprehensive safeguarding policy in place , which outlines our Zero-tolerance approach to any violation of safeguarding.

Overview

The School of Wildlife Conservation is seeking to recruit a Marketing Operations and Social Media Intern to support the School's digital marketing efforts as well as some day to day operations.

ABOUT THE INTERNSHIP

SOWC Marketing Operations and Social Media Intern will be responsible for managing the SOWC's social media accounts, website and other design related tasks. The ideal candidate will have a passion for social media, has excellent communication skills, is a graphics designer and is willing to learn and grow in the marketing field.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Social Media Support

• Manage the SOWC's social media accounts (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn, etc.) and ensure that all posts are engaging and effective.

• Manage and schedule content across social media platforms (LinkedIn, Instagram, Twitter/X, TikTok,etc.) while ensuring brand consistency.

• Draft engaging posts, captions, newsletters, and short-form articles tailored to target audiences.

• Capture and edit photos/videos from departmental activities, events, or field projects.

• Assist in planning and executing digital campaigns to promote programs, events, and initiatives.

• Conduct trend research and competitor analysis to inform creative strategies.

• Monitor audience engagement, respond to comments/messages, and help grow online communities.

• Track and report on social media analytics, providing recommendations for improvement.

• Support cross-departmental teams with promotional materials and event marketing needs.

• Contribute fresh ideas and creative storytelling approaches to strengthen the department’s digital presence.

Learning & Development Opportunities

As part of this internship, the candidate will:

• Gain exposure to end-to-end digital marketing workflows.

• Learn best practices in social media analytics, campaign management, and brand positioning.

• Build a professional portfolio with real-world content and campaign examples.

• Receive mentorship and guidance from experienced team members.

• Develop transferable skills in communication, project management, and stakeholder engagement.

REQUIREMENTS:

• Currently studying at ALU.

• Experience with social media platforms (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn, etc.) and website content management systems (CMS) especially wordpress.

• Creativity and an eye for design, with familiarity in Canva, Adobe Suite, or similar tools.

• Intermediate or advanced level expertise in Google Suite

• Ability to work independently and in a team environment.

• Basic knowledge of social media platforms, analytics, and trends.

• Familiarity with social media and website analytics tools.

• Enthusiastic, proactive, and eager to learn.

• Excellent time management skills and the ability to meet deadlines.

jobs.title: Product Analyst
jobs.description:
PLEASE NOTE THIS ROLE IS FOR OVERSEAS APPLICATION, NON -U.S. ONLY. NO DOMESTIC (U.S.) APPLICATIONS WILL BE CONSIDERED.

The Senior Product Analyst focuses on a quantitative understanding of what users do within Scentbird, based on digital footprints, surveys and experiments. The aim is to learn what users like or dislike and what leads them to engage, return or churn.

We see the Senior Product Analyst as a two-way driver: they turn business goals into data requests, reports and dashboards, and they proactively explore data to bring insights and drive the right decisions.

The Senior Product Analyst reports to the Product Analytics Lead.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

• Rolling out a ‘data-as-a-service’ approach for the Product team to make data easy to access, understand and use for decisions
• Communicating with Product and cross-functional teams: defining the metrics they track, planning report structures, making reports visually appealing and easy to understand, and automating reporting in our BI system (we use Looker)
• Measuring the impact of existing and new product features and growth experiments on our key metrics (e.g., conversion rate, number of active subscriptions, customer lifetime value)
• Doing ad hoc analysis: if something emerges in the data, like a spike in usage or a drop in conversions, you have to find out “why?”. Reports and research should not come just as numbers and distributions, but as action items (e.g., to increase X, we have to do Y)
• Building and maintaining analytical tools and services, including LLM-powered automation, that let the Product team answer questions without waiting on an analyst

What We’ll Love About You

• You are proactive: you come with a proposed approach, not just the problem, and you finish what you start
• You communicate your opinion simply and back it with numbers
• You like new technologies and actively bring them into your work, from new methods to AI tools
• You are not afraid to make mistakes or admit you don’t know something

What You’ll Need to Have

Experience and product thinking

• 3+ years of data analytics work experience
• Experience delivering analytical solutions for complex product-related tasks (user pattern research, supporting experiments, feature analysis to improve product metrics, use-case analysis, etc.)
• Understanding of overall business value, rather than caring only about numbers and charts

Statistics, experimentation and causal inference

• Strong knowledge of statistical methods and of using quantitative analysis to impact key decisions
• Advanced A/B testing experience: designing, running and analyzing complex experiments, including variance reduction, sequential testing, multiple comparisons, sample ratio mismatch checks and heterogeneous treatment effects
• Solid command of causal inference methods beyond A/B testing, with a clear understanding of when each method’s assumptions hold

Machine learning

• Hands-on experience applying machine learning to product problems, such as churn and propensity models, uplift modeling, segmentation, or recommendations, and taking a model from analysis to a working part of a product or decision process

Data, tools and engineering

• Experience writing SQL queries and working with large data sets
• Experience with product analytics and BI tools (e.g., GA, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Looker, Tableau, or similar)
• Strong engineering habits in Python: building maintainable services and tools rather than one-off scripts (packaged code, version control, tests, APIs, scheduled pipelines), and actively using LLMs to speed up coding and to automate analytical workflows

Communication

• High-level written and verbal communication skills
• English at upper-intermediate level or higher

What You’ll Love About Us

• Competitive base compensation
• Bonus program
• Remote first
• Paid time off
• A fun, creative and energetic work environment

About Scentbird

Scentbird inspires fragrance lovers to go beyond the ordinary and sample scents that evoke passion, confidence, and the unknown. Our mission is to revolutionize the way we perfume by bringing the ultimate fragrance playground right to your fingertips and offering a digital subscription service that lets members choose from over 1000+ designer perfumes each month.

About the Brands:

• Scentbird: The easiest way for fragrance lovers to discover, try, and buy their favorite scented products without a commitment
• Deck of Scarlet: Deck of Scarlet is on a mission to break the clean category, redefining what clean fragrances should smell like. Composed entirely of vegan, cruelty-free ingredients, our fragrances bridge the gap between the clean and luxury categories, using the highest eau de parfum concentrations housed in sculptural, eye-catching bottles. You shouldn’t have to choose between being luxe and refined, or clean and vegan—now, you don’t have to.
• Confessions Of A Rebel: We were born in 2018, holding fast to the idea that the fragrance industry was in dire need of a change. When we looked around, all we saw was a sea of sameness: outdated archetypes of femininity and masculinity paired with unrelatable images of luxury that we had no say in. In truth, we are complex in ways that cannot be contained in the traditional heteronormative stereotypes, existing beyond the binary with raw, unfiltered voices that deserve to be heard.
• Goodhabit: Enriched with a blend of essential oils, Goodhabit’s clean, vegan, cruelty-free fragrances act as bottled intentions you set free with each mist. Our scents are designed to help you align with the good habits you’re building, while working to enhance and boost your mood. Inhale, exhale, and let the good energy flow through you.
• Sanctuary: Created for those who care about the fate of our planets, Sanctuary offers fragrance for a better future. Our clean, community-driven fragrances are inspired by endangered species and their habitats, each aimed at raising money and awareness for the preservation of their namesake.
• Drift: Drift began as an alternative to all of the tacky air care products on the market. Our products are designed to blend in, with amazing scents that stand out. We take pride in our fragrances, keeping them free from the traditional chemicals used in the fragrance industry. We are always phthalate and paraben free. We never skimp on quality of our scents or the products that deliver them. Our design ethos is simple but effective. We love our community, those who won’t settle for ordinary, and we want to deliver a best in class experience.

Scentbird is committed to bringing individuals from different backgrounds and perspectives into the Nest. We strive to uphold an inclusive environment where individuals of all different backgrounds, ages, colors, ethnicities, gender, or gender identities, genetics, physical or mental abilities, protected veteran status, race, religious or sexual orientation, thrive. We respect the laws enforced by the EEOC and are dedicated internally to going above and beyond in fostering diversity. Come as you are - we’re excited to meet you.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Accounting & Finance
jobs.description:
Why Thunderbird?

Thunderbird is one of the world’s most trusted open-source email applications, empowering more than 20 million people globally. At Thunderbird, we build privacy-respecting communication and productivity tools that help people manage their digital lives while staying in control of their data.

We are open source by design. Our products are developed transparently and in collaboration with a global community of contributors, and that same spirit shapes how we work: collaboratively, inclusively, and with a shared commitment to putting users first.

We are a small but growing company of 70+ people distributed across seven countries. As Thunderbird evolves beyond a single desktop application, we are expanding across desktop, mobile, paid services, and new product experiences that help people and organizations work more effectively without giving up control to big tech ecosystems.

Our revenue model combines user donations, which help keep Thunderbird’s apps freely available, with paid services that cover the costs of hosted offerings while supporting long-term sustainability and continued innovation.

A note about Thunderbird and Mozilla: Thunderbird Technologies Corporation is the nonprofit-owned company behind Thunderbird email and a growing portfolio of products. While part of the Mozilla family, Thunderbird is a separate entity from Mozilla Corporation and Mozilla Foundation with its own compensation programs, benefits, and employment policies.

To learn more, visit www.thunderbird.net

The opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Accounting & Finance to serve as Thunderbird’s most senior finance professional. The right person will bring a strong accounting or controllership foundation and the breadth to lead financial planning and analysis, finance operations, and organization-level decision support.

As Thunderbird grows across donations, subscription services, enterprise offerings, and international operations, our financial needs are becoming more complex. We need stronger integration across accounting and FP&A, experienced oversight of emerging revenue models and tax obligations, and clear financial analysis that helps leadership understand performance, risks, tradeoffs, and decisions.

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the Head of Finance will directly manage our Senior Staff Accountant and Senior FP&A Analyst. This is a hands-on functional leadership role for someone who can provide experienced financial judgment, develop an established team, and remain close to the details while helping build the systems, controls, reporting, and finance practices the organization needs for its next stage of growth.

This role requires regular working-hour overlap with the COO, finance team, and other colleagues across North American time zones. Candidates based in Eastern or Central time zones are preferred; candidates elsewhere in the United States should be comfortable maintaining substantial overlap with those working hours. Flexibility for meetings with colleagues, advisers, and affiliated organizations in Europe is also expected.

What you’ll do

• Lead Thunderbird’s finance function, with overall responsibility for accounting, financial planning and analysis, tax, treasury, and finance operations.

• Manage and develop Thunderbird’s finance team, establishing clear priorities, responsibilities, review practices, and accountability.

• Oversee monthly and annual close, financial reporting, reconciliations, accounting policies, and internal controls.

• Oversee accounting and revenue recognition across donations, subscriptions, enterprise arrangements, partnerships, and other revenue streams.

• Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, longer-range financial planning, and scenario analysis.

• Develop clear management reporting and visualizations that highlight important trends, risks, tradeoffs, and decisions.

• Oversee tax, audit, indirect tax, VAT/GST, corporate filings, and related work with external advisers.

• Evaluate the financial, tax, accounting, and operational implications of entering new jurisdictions or establishing additional entities.

• Work with Enterprise Partnerships and Legal to establish financial reporting, reconciliation, and control processes for partner-led commercial arrangements.

• Oversee financial reporting to Thunderbird’s parent organization and affiliated Mozilla organizations.

• Own financial oversight of payroll across multiple providers in partnership with the People team.

• Document and strengthen finance systems and workflows, including accounting, expense management, payment-platform reconciliation, documentation, and automation.

• Oversee cash-flow planning, treasury, banking, and investment activities, working closely with the Senior FP&A Analyst.

• Serve as a trusted finance adviser to organizational leaders, translating complex financial information into clear recommendations.

What you bring

• 15+ years of relevant professional experience, including progressively responsible roles spanning accounting, financial planning and analysis, and finance operations.

• Significant accounting or controllership experience, including responsibility for U.S. GAAP financial reporting, close processes, internal controls, revenue recognition, and complex accounting judgments.

• 5+ years of people management experience in a finance or accounting environment, including coaching, feedback, prioritization, performance support, career development, and team development.

• Demonstrated ability to improve budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, and financial data visualization and translate complex information into clear insights and recommendations for non-finance leaders.

• Substantive experience with subscription, SaaS, digital-product, enterprise, or comparable technology-based revenue models.

• Experience supporting partner-led commercial arrangements, such as reseller, licensing, wholesale, or revenue-sharing models, including evaluating financial terms and developing or overseeing the related reporting, reconciliation, controls, and revenue-recognition processes.

• Working knowledge of merchant-of-record arrangements, payment platforms, indirect tax, and international VAT/GST requirements.

• Experience supporting an internationally distributed organization and coordinating financial obligations across multiple jurisdictions.

• Proven ability to oversee tax, audit, and other external finance requirements and effectively manage outside advisers.

• Experience providing oversight and review of cash management, treasury, banking, and organizational investment activities, including developing recommendations for senior decision-makers.

• A track record of strengthening financial systems, workflows, documentation, and controls.

• Strong judgment and comfort moving between people leadership, detailed financial review, practical hands-on problem-solving, and organization-level decision support.

• Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, including the ability to identify and explain financial risks, implications, and tradeoffs.

Bonus points for

• Experience working within a subsidiary, portfolio, federated, or similarly affiliated organizational structure, including reporting to a parent organization or shareholder.

• Prior work supporting the establishment of a new legal entity or expansion into a new jurisdiction.

• Familiarity with Intacct, Ramp, or comparable finance and expense-management systems.

• Experience in a mission-driven, open-source, nonprofit-affiliated, or similarly values-oriented organization.

About you

You are an experienced finance leader who is equally comfortable reviewing detailed financial work and advising senior leaders. You know that an effective finance function requires accurate reporting, sound controls, integrated planning, clear analysis, and a willingness to surface risks and make recommendations.

You understand the complexity created by multiple revenue models, partner-led commercial arrangements, international operations, and evolving tax and reporting obligations. You can translate those requirements into practical policies, procedures, controls, and operating practices, building them where they do not yet exist and improving them as the organization evolves. You also recognize when external expertise is needed and can provide appropriate rigor without unnecessary complexity.

You are a thoughtful people manager who gives experienced team members direction, oversight, and room to grow. You can distill sophisticated analysis into what matters most for decision-makers and are motivated by building finance capability in a lean, hands-on environment.

Work environment

This is a full-time, fully remote position. You’ll work with colleagues, partners, and customers across multiple countries and time zones, so strong communication and documentation skills are essential.

Availability to participate in required company-wide gatherings and team workweeks, which may involve periodic domestic or international travel.

Compensation & benefits

We benchmark our base salaries to local markets and target the 60th percentile of the peer market. The salary ranges for this role are:

• US: $165,000 - $190,000 USD

We may consider candidates with strong skills but less than the required experience. Title, level and compensation will be determined based on qualifications and experience.

In addition to competitive salaries, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your whole self.

Work & career

Work eligibility

How to apply

Please apply directly through our career page. We carefully review every cover letter and screening question, so take the time to answer each fully. Candidates who submit generic or unoriginal AI-generated responses may be disqualified from further consideration.

Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion

Thunderbird believes in the value of diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge, and knows diversity, equity and inclusion are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. Thunderbird will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. OUR MISSION:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.



Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLpjeHyocsu3ZoDn3sfODjqIR2L_DW3dgb.

The GTM Associate (CA) role is part of our flagship GTM program https://www.omnea.co/commercial-associate-program, designed to build the next generation of enterprise sellers and founders. From day one you own a territory, work live deals, and drive real revenue. Most people are promoted into a closing role within 9–12 months – the fastest in 6.

Selling is building. https://www.omnea.co/blog/selling-is-building Like law, medicine, or finance, great sellers are made through apprenticeship: learning the fundamentals alongside people who've mastered them, while building relationships that compound over a career.
