jobs.title: Senior Intelligence Analyst - Russia & Eurasia Regional Focus
jobs.description:
The R&D team at Chainalysis is inspired by solving the hardest technical challenges and building products that establish trust in cryptocurrencies. We're a global organization that thrives on challenging work and doing it alongside exceptionally talented teammates. Our industry evolves rapidly, and our mission is to build a flexible, AI-driven platform that automates entity resolution, optimizes data labeling pipelines, and creates predictive models that identify illicit patterns before they escalate.

Chainalysis data has helped solve some of the world’s highest-profile criminal and national-security cases and made it safer for people everywhere to access crypto. The Global Intelligence Team produces the attribution at the heart of that data — connecting on-chain activity to the real-world entities behind it, across the global crypto ecosystem. It’s the intelligence data moat beneath every Chainalysis product, and what investigators, sanctions authorities, and national-security agencies rely on to follow the money and disrupt threats.

Few domains demand more sustained depth than Russia and the broader Eurasian sanctions-evasion ecosystem. Since 2022, sweeping sanctions on Russian financial institutions, oligarchs, and the defense-industrial base have pushed a growing share of Russian value flows into cryptocurrency — from no-KYC exchanges and OTC desks operating across the former Soviet bloc, to sanctions-evasion networks exploiting stablecoins and cross-border payment channels, crypto-denominated procurement of restricted goods, and the financial infrastructure supporting Russian cyber and ransomware operations. Understanding how Russian actors adapt to sanctions pressure on-chain is one of the most consequential problems in crypto intelligence today.

As our Russia & Eurasia-focused intelligence analyst — the team’s subject-matter expert on Russian and Eurasian crypto threats — you’ll own that problem end to end. This is a depth role: while our analysts cover the breadth of the crypto-services ecosystem, you’ll go deep on a single, high-stakes domain — becoming the person, inside Chainalysis and increasingly across the industry, who understands how Russian and Eurasian actors use crypto to evade sanctions and can prove it on-chain. You’ll own the attribution for Russia’s crypto footprint, map how these networks operate and adapt under pressure, turn that into finished intelligence customers act on, and be the expert voice representing Chainalysis on Russian crypto threats.

Who you’ll work with

You’ll join a fast-moving, globally distributed team — analysts, threat-domain SMEs, data scientists, and engineers — collaborating across time zones, async and in real time. We move fast, hold each other to a high bar, and back each other up across regions. As the Russia & Eurasia SME, you’ll be the single point of depth for the domain and a force multiplier for everyone working adjacent to it.

In this role, you’ll:

 - Own Russia & Eurasia attribution end to end — the threat-actor entities, their definitions, and the accounts, addresses, and infrastructure they operate: Russian and CIS no-KYC exchanges, OTC networks, and instant swap services, sanctions-evasion infrastructure (stablecoin corridors, cross-border payment channels, nested services), Russian-linked ransomware and cybercrime ecosystem financial flows, procurement networks for restricted and dual-use goods, and the broader financial infrastructure enabling Russian value movement outside the traditional financial system.

 - Lead the attribution response to Russia-related sanctions events — when OFAC or allied authorities designate Russian entities, actors, or infrastructure, drive the rapid, high-visibility on-chain attribution that turns those designations into coverage in our data, often against the clock.

 - Map the networks on-chain — trace how Russian and Eurasian actors raise, move, launder, and cash out value through regional exchanges, no-KYC swaps, OTC desks, stablecoin corridors, mixers, and off-ramps across the former Soviet bloc and beyond, and keep that picture current as they adapt to pressure.

 - Produce finished intelligence — advisory notes, customer and partner briefings, and contributions to flagship publications (the Crypto Crime Report and beyond) that make the Russia & Eurasia crypto threat legible and actionable.

 - Be the named external expert — represent Chainalysis on Russia & Eurasia crypto threats at conferences, on panels, with the press, and in briefings to public- and private-sector partners.

 - Help set the Russia & Eurasia collection agenda — surface what data we need on Russian and Eurasian networks and feed those requirements into our collection process and priority intelligence requirements; you direct collection for the domain, but it runs through the team’s apparatus and prioritization, not you alone.

 - Translate typologies into detection — turn what you learn about Russian methods and sanctions-evasion typologies into guidance that our products and our customers can operationalize.

 - Build with AI — design and tune the automation that scales your analysis and the team’s, and handle the hard cases automation can’t.

 - Level up the team — raise the bar on Russia & Eurasia and sanctions-evasion tradecraft broadly, and partner closely with analysts, other SMEs, data science, and engineering.

We’re looking for candidates who have:

 - Deep, demonstrable Russia & Eurasia expertise — real command of the Russian sanctions landscape, Russian financial infrastructure and how it has adapted to sanctions pressure, the CIS/former Soviet bloc crypto ecosystem, and/or Russian illicit-finance and procurement networks. This is the core of the role, and we’ll expect you to show it.

 - On-chain tracing ability against Russian targets — direct experience following Russian crypto activity on-chain (Russian exchanges, sanctions evasion, ransomware financial flows), or deep Russia threat-finance expertise paired with proven blockchain-tracing skill you can bring to bear here from day one.

 - A national-security or threat-finance background — intelligence, sanctions, counter-threat-finance, or investigations, from the IC, Treasury/OFAC, law enforcement, the military, a think tank or research institution, or private-sector CTF/sanctions work.

 - Regional fluency — a strong grasp of Russian and Eurasian geopolitics, the sanctions landscape, and regional financial flows. Russian language ability is a significant plus.

 - Elite potential and a proven track record — exceptional aptitude, judgment, and work ethic; you’ve led hard problems end to end and you raise everyone around you.

 - Excellent writing and communication — this is an outward-facing expert role; your intelligence has to land with analysts, customers, and senior audiences alike.

 - AI-forward instincts — you build automation to scale your work and others’, not just use it.

 - Comfort working with data; blockchain forensics experience strongly preferred.

 - 5+ years of relevant analytic, intelligence, or threat-finance experience for a Senior hire; 8+ years and recognized domain authority for a Staff hire.

You might also have:

 - Russian language ability.

 - Direct experience with OFAC, EU, or OFSI sanctions, sanctions-evasion investigations, or the designation process.

 - A record of published research or public speaking on Russia, sanctions evasion, or crypto threat finance.

 - Familiarity with Russian and CIS exchange infrastructure, stablecoin-based sanctions evasion, ransomware financial flows, or dual-use procurement networks.

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.



About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.



You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here https://go.chainalysis.com/rs/503-FAP-074/images/Interview%20Accommodations%20Request.pdf. We can’t wait to meet you.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
At a glance

Location: Cambridge

In-office expectation: Usually once every two weeks, when your team is in

Employment type: Paid internship, 10 weeks summer 2027



Why this role exists: To give people heading into their final year of university the chance to spend summer 2027 as a full member of one of our product teams, building software that database professionals around the world rely on.



About Redgate

Redgate brings together people who want to do their best work in an environment built on trust, accountability, and collaboration.

We build solutions that help data professionals securely manage the data and databases that their organisations depend on. It’s a space that’s only becoming more critical as systems scale, data regulations increase, and AI adoption accelerates.



AI at Redgate

By 2028, Redgate will operate as an expert-plus-agent company: domain experts amplified by AI, delivering customer value at a pace our peers can’t match.

AI handles the heavy lifting. Our people control the judgment. Everyone at Redgate works with Claude, giving you access to the best AI tools from day one.



Why join our software engineering team?

· You’ll join a product team as a full member, working on the same things as everyone else, not on a side project in a corner.

· You’ll work in a team that cares about craft, collaboration, and quality.

· There’s real support to grow, with your own intern manager for feedback and a buddy for everything else, plus protected time every week to learn and develop skills.



About the role

For 10 weeks, you’ll work alongside our engineers on real software, shipping features that real customers use. You’ll be part of the day-to-day life of the team, with the support and room to learn what a first role in software deserves.

• Pair with engineers, get your code reviewed (and review theirs), and take part in standups, planning and retros.

• Work on the same things as everyone else, using the same tools, including AI tools like Claude.

• Spend every Friday afternoon (10% of your time) on learning, whether that’s lightning talks, a community of practice or building something of your own.

• Last year’s interns merged code in their first week, shipped a feature customers had been asking for, fixed a customer support issue, ran team standups and retros, gave a talk to the wider company, and learned C# and .NET on the job to build their own project.

“I didn’t feel like an intern, I really felt like part of the team.” Kris Sananpanichkul, past software intern



What makes you a great fit

You don’t need to tick every box. We care more about how you communicate, learn and work with others than how many lines of code you write.

• You expect to graduate in 2028 with a degree in a relevant subject, and you’re available for the full 10 weeks.

• You enjoy software and like figuring out how things work.

• You communicate clearly, ask questions, and share what you learn.

• You enjoy working as part of a team, including giving and receiving feedback.

• You have the right to work in the UK (we can’t offer visa sponsorship for the internship).



How to apply

No cover letter needed. Just send your CV that includes:

• Education: your course and year of graduation

• Work experience: anything relevant, if you have it. It’s fine if you don’t.

• Something you’re proud of: something you’ve built, fixed or figured out. It could be a uni project, a side project, a game mod, a Discord bot or a tricky bug. It all counts.

• What you want from this: what you hope to learn or get out of the internship



What happens next?

Your application will be reviewed by a person. We don’t use AI or automated tools to assess applications. Every profile is read by one of our Talent Partners.

You’ll hear back within a few days. Whether it’s a next step or a no, we aim to respond promptly so you’re not left waiting.



Belonging at Redgate

We believe that people do their best work in an environment built on respect, fairness, and trust, and that diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes. Redgate is an equal opportunity employer, and we make hiring decisions based on skill, potential, and alignment with our values.

You can read more about how we approach belonging and inclusion at Redgate on our Diversity at Redgate Software https://www.red-gate.com/our-company/careers/belonging/ .

jobs.title: Senior Support Engineer
jobs.description:
SENIOR SUPPORT ENGINEER NA




WHO WE ARE

We are a rapidly growing embodied AI company revolutionizing human labor. Leveraging cutting-edge robotics and advanced artificial intelligence, we develop transformative technologies that redefine how work is done across industries—empowering businesses to streamline operations, boost productivity, and unlock new possibilities.




OVERVIEW

As a Senior Support Engineer, you will ensure the reliability and success of our AI-powered robotic systems after deployment. Acting as the primary technical contact for customers, you will diagnose complex hardware and software issues, drive rapid resolution, and continuously improve our support tools and processes.

This is a remote position based in the United States. Most customer support is provided remotely, requiring excellent technical judgment, ownership, and communication. Clear status updates and concise report-outs—particularly during evenings, weekends, and critical customer events—are an essential part of the role.

Initial onboarding includes travel to Germany and customer sites in Europe to become familiar with our systems. Occasional travel within North America may be required to support deployments, critical service events, or customer escalations.




YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES


CUSTOMER SUPPORT & INCIDENT MANAGEMENT

• Serve as the primary technical support contact for customers operating Sereact robotic systems.

• Provide timely remote support, diagnosing hardware, software, networking, and system integration issues using SSH, Docker, Python, logs, and diagnostic tools.

• Own customer incidents from initial report through resolution while providing clear communication, status updates, and executive-ready report-outs.

• Participate in an on-call support rotation for critical customer issues.




TECHNICAL SUPPORT & CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT

• Collaborate with software, robotics, deployment, and hardware teams to resolve complex technical issues.

• Perform root cause analysis and drive improvements to product reliability, support processes, documentation, and knowledge bases.

• Develop and improve internal support tools, customer dashboards, debugging utilities, and ticketing workflows.

• Support software updates, hardware upgrades, and system maintenance activities.




CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION

• Partner with deployment engineers to ensure smooth customer handoffs.

• Provide customer feedback that influences future product development.

• Proactively monitor deployment health and identify issues before they impact operations.

• Support field deployments and help establish best practices for the North American support organization.




QUALIFICATIONS


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Robotics, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).

• 5+ years supporting complex hardware/software systems in customer-facing environments.

• Experience with robotics, automation, or industrial equipment.

• Experience troubleshooting Linux-based systems using SSH, Docker, and command-line tools.

• Willingness to travel internationally for training and periodically throughout North America (approximately 10%).




SKILLS

• Strong Python and Linux troubleshooting skills.

• Experience with Docker, SQL, networking fundamentals, and API-based systems.

• Excellent analytical problem-solving and root cause analysis.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication with strong customer focus.

• Highly organized with an ownership mentality and ability to manage multiple priorities.

• Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced startup environment.




NICE TO HAVE

• Experience with AI, robotics, ROS, or autonomous systems.

• Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, or DevOps tooling.

• Experience in warehouse automation, logistics, or industrial manufacturing




COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary range: USD $180,000 - $210,000(actual pay based on skills, experience, and location).

Location: Remote (United States)

Time Zone:


EASTERN TIME (ET): 2:00 PM – 12:00 AM


CENTRAL TIME (CT): 1:00 PM – 11:00 PM


MOUNTAIN TIME (MT): 12:00 PM – 10:00 PM


PACIFIC TIME (PT): 11:00 AM – 9:00 PM


Benefits:
• Medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents
• 401(k) with 100% company match
• 20 days paid time off
• Paid sick leave
• Parental leave
• Wellness or gym stipend
• Learning and development support
• Equity/Bonus




ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

• Employment may be contingent upon a background check consistent with applicable law.
• This role includes participation in an on-call support rotation, including occasional evening and weekend coverage.
• Initial onboarding requires travel to Germany and Europe. Periodic travel within North America may be required.
• We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate based on protected status.

jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager
jobs.location: Espoo, FI / London, GB / Paris, FR / München, DE
jobs.description:
At IQM, we build world-leading quantum computers for the well-being of humankind. We design systems to tackle computational challenges beyond the practical limits of classical machines. Our work sits at the edge of science and engineering. It's complex, demanding, and deeply collaborative. We turn deep research into reliable, full-stack systems that drive discoveries in fields like medicine, energy, and technology, reshaping how the world computes.

Join the team that gives quantum a heartbeat.

The work

We are looking for an experienced Content Marketing Manager to own and grow IQM's content engine end to end.

This is a hands-on, high-output role for someone who can deliver ell a compelling story, and build the programs that get that story in front of the right audiences at scale. You will be the person who turns complex quantum technology, real customer deployments, and technical breakthroughs into clear, polished, high-impact content, and then amplify that content across multiple channels integrated into campaigns, and directly enabling sales.

This role reports to the Content & Product Marketing Lead. It works in close partnership with subject-matter experts, product and science teams, sales, partners, and our external creative, brand, and events agencies, who handle video, photography, brand and naming systems, and design production, while you own the content itself.

What you’ll actually do

• Write and produce the full range of IQM's marketing content: blogs, thought leadership, web and landing page copy, LinkedIn and social posts, campaign copy, presentations and pitch decks, one-pagers, brochures, datasheets, and newsletters.
• Turn complex technical and scientific input into clear, compelling narratives tailored to the audience, whether that's a commercial director, a quantum researcher, an enterprise buyer, an investor, or a policymaker.
• Own IQM's brand voice: apply it consistently across everything you produce, and act as the guardian of tone and quality for content company-wide.
• Build IQM's library of customer-facing proof: case studies, application and use-case stories, customer spotlights, and testimonials.
• Package real customer deployments and outcomes into sales-ready assets that help the commercial team engage prospects and close deals.
• Partner with the science and product teams to translate technical results into credible, accessible proof points. Sales enablement.
• Work directly with sales to understand what's actually landing with customers, and produce content that closes the gaps. Create and maintain the content sales needs to move deals forward: pitch decks, one-pagers, competitive and vertical narratives, and follow-up materials.
• Build programs that amplify content across channels, don't just publish, engineer reach: repurpose a single piece into blog, social, newsletter, and sales formats; sequence content into campaigns; and maximize the mileage of every asset.
• Own the content calendar and editorial planning, keeping output coordinated, consistent, and proactive rather than reactive.
• Partner with the digital/demand function to make sure content is feeding paid, organic, and lifecycle programs, and use engagement data to sharpen what you produce next.
• Work with the external creative, brand, and events agencies as the content counterpart to their production, supplying the narrative, copy, and messaging that their video, design, and event work is built on.

What we’re looking for

• 5+ years of content marketing experience, with a strong track record in technology and B2B environments.
• Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills, you can make complex, technical subject matter clear and genuinely engaging.
• Proven ability to produce high-quality content in English across a wide range of formats and audiences.
• Experience owning content programs end to end: not just producing pieces, but planning, integrating across channels, and amplifying to drive measurable engagement.
• Demonstrated success creating sales enablement and customer-proof content (case studies, use cases) that commercial teams actually use.
• Highly organized and self-directed, comfortable owning a high volume of deliverables and a content calendar with minimal oversight.
• Familiarity with HPC, quantum, or advanced/high-performance computing environments is seen as a benefit.

Why IQM?

• Full-stack quantum computing: From quantum hardware to software layers and beyond, we build across the full-stack.
• High-performance playground: We aim high, and we know sustainable performance only works when life outside work does too—hybrid setups, flexible hours.
• Never the smartest: You won’t always be the smartest person in the room. Neither will we. Expect to learn constantly - from each other and beyond with IQM’s Learning Hub, LinkedIn Learning, and a team-based L&D budget.
• Approachable leadership: Flat hierarchy, direct access. Feel free to approach any leaders. They're friendlier than they look!
• The sweet spot: Big enough to matter. Small enough to move fast. Growing between a startup and a corporation. We’re in the phase where top performers get noticed.
• Bigger than IQM: Our people build know-how for the entire quantum ecosystem. We publish papers, run hackathons, and help shape a market that's still being defined.

The future of computing won’t build itself. You might be one of the few who do.

• Meet our people and learn more about IQM on our stories page.
• Explore our scientific publications.

We'll start interviews and move forward with hiring as soon as we meet strong candidates. Please submit your application soon.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager – US
jobs.location: Based in Avondale, LA, with up to 40% domestic travel to customer offices, project and manufacturing sites, and industry events; occasional international travel
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Business Development Manager is responsible for growing GWT’s revenue by expanding business with existing customers and developing new customers across the company’s markets. Reporting to the Chief Operations Officer and working closely with division leaders, the role manages customer relationships, builds and manages the sales pipeline, and works with operations, engineering, and finance to convert opportunities into profitable work. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports; it works independently against defined targets, with commercial authority within approved limits.

This is a safety-sensitive position. Candidates should review the Physical Demands and Work Environment section carefully; the requirements described there are essential functions of the job.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The following duties are essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Revenue Growth and New Business

• Achieve annual revenue growth targets set by the Chief Operations Officer across assigned business lines through a combination of new customers and expanded business with existing accounts, at or above approved gross margin thresholds.

• Identify, qualify, and win new customers across GWT’s markets; build and maintain a qualified pipeline in the CRM with sufficient coverage of annual targets.

• Lead preparation of quotes and proposals with operations and engineering so that scope, schedule, pricing, and terms align with GWT’s cost structure and risk tolerance; obtain internal approval before submittal.

• Perform contract review of customer requirements, including scope, technical and quality requirements, schedule, and commercial terms, before quotes and orders are accepted, in accordance with GWT QMS procedures and AS9100 clause 8.2.3.

• Support negotiation of NDAs, MSAs, SOWs, and purchase orders within delegated authority, and hand awarded work to operations with a complete, accurate scope.

• Represent GWT at industry conferences, trade shows, and customer events, and convert contacts into qualified opportunities.

• Maintain accurate CRM records and deliver a monthly sales forecast and pipeline report to the Chief Technology Officer.

Account Management and Customer Engagement

• Meet or speak with each active customer weekly or bi-weekly to review work in progress, upcoming needs, and satisfaction; document every contact in the CRM.

• Develop account plans for key customers that identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities across GWT’s full portfolio of services, manufacturing, and testing capabilities.

• Convert one-off orders into MSAs, framework agreements, and multi-year programs to build recurring revenue.

• Serve as the primary commercial contact for assigned accounts; coordinate with project managers on schedule, change orders, and issue resolution, and escalate quality or delivery concerns promptly.

• Collect customer satisfaction feedback, market intelligence, and competitor activity, and report findings to leadership to support QMS customer satisfaction monitoring and inform pricing and service development.

Cross-Business Line Coordination

• Work with division leaders to align pursuits with available capacity, technical capability, and company priorities before committing GWT to scope or schedule.

• Translate GWT’s technical capabilities into clear customer value propositions, using each customer’s procurement and technical language.

• Hand off opportunities requiring deep technical pursuit to the responsible division lead, and support them through award.

• Handle controlled technical information in accordance with GWT’s export control (ITAR/EAR) and controlled unclassified information (CUI) procedures.

• Track opportunities by business line in the CRM so that they are qualified, followed up, and correctly attributed.

General Duties

• Comply with all GWT, customer, and site environmental, health, and safety (EHS) requirements; stop work when conditions present a risk to safety, quality, or the environment.

• Follow GWT quality management system (QMS) procedures, including work instructions, records, and traceability requirements.

• Maintain a clean and organized work area; in shop and field settings, this includes tool control, housekeeping, and foreign object debris (FOD) control.

• Participate in required safety, quality, and technical training and complete assigned development requirements.

• Protect company proprietary, customer, and confidential information, including export-controlled information where applicable.

• Travel to customer offices, project and manufacturing sites, and industry events, domestic and occasionally international, up to approximately 40% of the time.

• Perform other duties as assigned to support the needs of the business.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

The physical demands and work environment described below are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job.

• Sedentary work – Sit for extended periods and use a computer, keyboard, and monitors for most of the work day.

• Lifting – Occasionally lift and carry objects up to 25 lb (11 kg).

• Communication – Communicate clearly in person, by phone, by email, and through video conferencing.

• Environment – Work primarily in an office environment with moderate noise levels; site visits involve outdoor work with exposure to heat, cold, wind, precipitation, and elevated noise.

• Site visits – Regularly visit customer facilities, project and field sites, and GWT manufacturing areas; complete site safety orientations, follow all site safety rules, and wear required PPE, including hard hat, safety glasses, protective footwear, and high-visibility clothing.

• Driving – Drive personal or company vehicles to customer and project sites, frequently in rural areas and over long distances, as an essential function of the role.

• Travel and schedule – Up to 40% domestic travel, with occasional international travel; occasional work outside normal business hours to accommodate customer schedules and events.

• Medical and screening – Must complete pre-employment and ongoing drug and alcohol screening consistent with GWT’s drug-free workplace program for safety-sensitive positions.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

• 7 or more years of B2B sales or business development experience selling technical services, engineered products, or industrial manufacturing, with a documented record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets.

• Demonstrated success growing revenue within an existing customer base through account management, upselling, and cross-selling.

• Ability to complete customer site-access and safety orientation requirements before visiting customer and project sites.

• Proficiency with CRM platforms and Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams); strong written proposal and presentation skills.

• Ability to read, understand, and follow written procedures and safety instructions in English.

• Authorization to work in the United States.

• Must qualify as a “U.S. Person” as defined in 22 CFR § 120.62 (U.S. citizen, U.S. lawful permanent resident, or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. § 1324b(a)(3)). This role requires access to information and technologies controlled under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and/or Export Administration Regulations (EAR).

• Valid driver’s license and acceptable driving record; ability to obtain a passport for international travel.

Preferred Qualifications

• Sales experience in heavy industrial, energy, or advanced manufacturing markets.

• Familiarity with composite materials, advanced manufacturing, or technical field services.

• Experience selling into government or regulated markets, including familiarity with federal procurement.

• Experience negotiating MSAs and multi-year agreements.

• An established professional network within GWT’s target markets.

Key Competencies

• Safety mindset – Follows safety requirements without exception and speaks up about hazards.

• Quality focus – Follows procedures, does the work right the first time, and documents work accurately.

• Teamwork – Supports colleagues, takes and gives direction constructively, and communicates clearly.

• Customer focus – Keeps consistent, proactive contact with customers, understands their operating and budget cycles, and follows through on commitments.

• Commercial discipline – Qualifies opportunities before committing resources, prices to margin, and keeps the CRM and forecast accurate.

• Learning agility – Quickly learns GWT’s services, manufacturing, and testing capabilities well enough to speak credibly with asset managers, engineers, and program managers.

Key Performance Indicators

• Safety: compliance with EHS requirements and site safety rules during customer and site visits.

• Quality: accuracy and completeness of quotes, proposals, and handoffs to operations, measured by scope changes or rework attributable to sales errors.

• Revenue growth: revenue growth across assigned business lines against annual targets set by the Chief Technology Officer, at or above approved gross margin.

• Customer engagement and satisfaction: weekly or bi-weekly contact maintained with active accounts and documented in the CRM; customer satisfaction feedback and repeat business from key accounts.

• New business: pipeline coverage against target, new customer accounts won against annual goals, and proposal win rate.

Compensation and Benefits

GWT offers a competitive salary commensurate with experience. This position is also eligible for a performance-based incentive plan tied to revenue and margin targets, documented separately. This position is classified as exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act. Benefits include health, dental, and vision insurance, and a 401(k) plan with company match upon eligibility. Additional details are provided during the hiring process.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Gulf Wind Technology LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. GWT is a federal contractor and takes affirmative action to employ and advance in employment qualified protected veterans and individuals with disabilities in accordance with VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.

Reasonable accommodation: In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, GWT will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities during the application process and employment, unless doing so would impose an undue hardship. To request an accommodation, contact Human Resources.

GWT participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with Form I-9 information to confirm authorization to work in the United States.

GWT is a drug-free workplace. This position is designated safety-sensitive; pre-employment, random, post-incident, and reasonable-suspicion drug and alcohol testing apply in accordance with applicable law.

General Disclaimer

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed and is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. GWT reserves the right to add, remove, or modify duties, responsibilities, and reporting relationships, and to reassign the employee, at any time with or without notice, based on business needs. This document does not constitute a contract of employment; employment with GWT is at will.

jobs.title: BSE Learning Assistant Intern
jobs.description:
ABOUT ALU

At the African Leadership University (ALU), we're more than just an institution—we're a catalyst for transformation. Our mission is to develop a new generation of ethical and entrepreneurial leaders who will shape Africa's future. Through our innovative curriculum, focus on experiential learning, and vibrant pan-African community, we empower students to become changemakers, problem-solvers, and innovators. At ALU, we're not just teaching; we're nurturing the leaders who will drive Africa's progress and prosperity in the 21st century

We are dedicated to fostering an open yet secure environment, balancing the safety of students, staff, and visitors with respect for individual rights, and safeguarding responsibilities.

HOW WE WORK

The ALU Team works in starkly different ways to traditional academic bureaucracies. We approach education from first principles, empower individuals to design, test, and implement creative new ideas, and work closely together to craft transformative learning experiences. We are deeply passionate about our students and excited by the challenge of building something entirely new.

The African Leadership University is committed to ensuring the safety and Well-being of all students under our care. As part of this commitment , we have a comprehensive safeguarding policy in place , which outlines our Zero-tolerance approach to any violation of safeguarding.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Department of Software Engineering is seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Learning Assistant Intern to support the ongoing efforts in enhancing academic quality and improving operational efficiency. This part-time role is ideal for students who are passionate about education, technology, and student success, and who are eager to contribute to meaningful projects that bridge administrative systems with learning enhancement projects.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Assist in developing and maintaining internal systems that support academic planning, monitoring and review, and curriculum delivery.

• Support data collection and analysis related to academic performance, including tools for tracking at-risk and retake students.

• Contribute to the design and refinement of dashboards or reporting tools that aid in academic decision-making.

• Assist faculty and academic staff in maintaining course materials, learning resources, and digital workflows.

• Help coordinate and support academic initiatives such as course reviews, teaching evaluations, and learning innovation projects.

• Provide administrative support for departmental meetings, documentation, and student engagement tracking.

• Participate in regular team check-ins and contribute to process improvements related to academic operations and student support.

Ensure the safety and well-being of all young persons and vulnerable adults with whom we deal,  by adhering to ALU’s comprehensive safeguarding policy, maintaining a zero-tolerance approach to any violations of safeguarding standards.

Preferred Qualifications

• Currently enrolled in the Software Engineering programme at ALU

• Strong professional, critical thinking and analytical skills with attention to details

• Proficiency in basic programming or scripting (e.g., Python, JavaScript) and/or working knowledge of spreadsheet and data tools.

• Familiarity with academic systems (e.g., LMS platforms, student tracking tools, version control systems).

• Passionate about education, curriculum development and student support systems.

Desirable Skills

• Experience in data visualization or reporting tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, Tableau).

• Exposure to learning analytics or academic performance tracking tools.

• Understanding of academic processes such as assessments, grading, and feedback workflows.

Eligibility

• Open to all Year-3 students with no current academic backlogs in the BSE programme

• Must be available to work up to 15 hours per week during the internship period.

Conditions

The selected candidate should sign a Non Disclosure Agreement as part of the contracting process and to adhere to institutional regulations tied with the internship responsibilities.

jobs.title: Sales Director - App Developers (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Berlin, Amsterdam or London, flexible / remote
________________________

Hello👋I am Kate, Lead of Performance Sales at Kayzen. I am now looking for a Sales Director - Mobile App Developers  to join our global team and play a pivotal role in scaling our reach to top app developers worldwide  🙌

In this role, you will play a vital role in driving customer satisfaction, fostering long- term relationships and contributing to the overall growth and success of the company. As a growing company and team there is a lot of opportunity for the right candidate to grow and develop with the company.

But wait, you have not heard of Kayzen before?😃

Kayzen is a demand-side platform (DSP) dedicated to democratizing programmatic advertising across CTV and Mobile Apps. We enable leading apps, agencies, media buyers, and brands to run programmatic customer acquisition, retargeting, and brand performance campaigns through its self-serve and managed service options. Built on the core pillars of performance, transparency, control, and empowerment, Kayzen powers the world’s best mobile marketing teams with bespoke solutions that fuel business growth and deliver a competitive advantage. With an unprecedented scale of 160B+ daily ad requests from 1.6B+ unique users worldwide, we serve up to 1B+ ads per day in 180 countries. Kayzen is accessible through our APIs and user interface.

The Team

You will work with a carefully selected, diverse and globally distributed team from customer success, engineering, data science, design, marketing, product and more. We are highly motivated and aligned in our quest to disrupt the multi-billion dollar mobile ad-tech industry. Sounds interesting?

The Role

As our Sales Director - Mobile App Developers, your primary focus will be to drive new business from mobile app developers and advertisers. The leaders in Kayzen’s team who you will closely with are our marketing lead, SDR resources and our customer success lead (onboarding and growing customers you sign and bring on board). Apart from your primary tasks, you are welcome to contribute to multiple areas in the organization such as product, marketing and partnerships. Since our key product and customer success team members are located globally, we are open to a remote setup for this position. For optimal overlap with customers’ time zones and internal teams we prefer candidates based in Berlin, Amsterdam or London who can regularly meet the team in person.

Responsibilities

• Excel at acquiring new app customers (focus: outbound) who generate sticky, sustainable revenue growth

• Actively engage with customers, partners and other market participants to identify and propose new opportunities for revenue growth

• Cooperate with our marketing team to help build our narrative and communication for the target customer profile of App Developers

• Understand customer needs and bring in new ideas to the products teams on how we can expand our offering to add more value for customers

• Continuously identify potential sales and marketing bottlenecks and implement relevant improvements

• Build strong relationships with leaders within the ad-tech industry and key customers and partners. Represent Kayzen at industry events.

• Working closely with the SDR team to build pipeline and create opportunities

• Keep Hubspot up to date and ensure accurate record keeping

Requirements

• At least 4 years of business development experience in ad-tech or mobile app-development industry is a must

• Previous experience in managing B2B sales or partnerships holistically with complex products or services

• Knowledge of the programmatic landscape and understanding of the performance media sector are essential.

• At least a basic understanding of CTV is required although candidates with real CTV sales experience will be prioritised

• Detail-oriented and process driven with a structured problem-solving attitude and a KPI driven approach.

• Great work ethics, results orientation, persuasiveness and high level of initiative and assertiveness

• Good business acumen with an ability to identify and execute on growth opportunities

• Enjoying working in a fast paced and dynamic start-up environment

What do we offer?

• Exceptional career growth and learning opportunity

• A unique opportunity to be part of an experienced team of industry experts and entrepreneurs

• A fun, driven, and multinational team located across Germany, India, Argentina, Israel, Ukraine, Turkey, the UK and more countries

• A flexible work-from-home arrangement

• A 500-dollar home-office setup budget

• A 1000-dollar annual learning and development budget

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1d985516-2a99-43c0-b591-957f5adaceb9/2c6957b4-39d2-40b3-8eb6-7e380a0c2f9c/B13.png]



THE ROLE

As Warehouse Assistant, you receive and process incoming stock and materials, carry out stock counts, oversee provisioning officers and manage their SLAs, and resolve provisioning issues. The role sits in Warehouse & Logistics within Supply Chain, and the preferred candidate should be based in Asaba, Delta State. 



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1d985516-2a99-43c0-b591-957f5adaceb9/5e9f3448-2fed-4b66-b1ee-9474279a7947/B13.png]




ABOUT US


M-KOPA is a pan-African fintech providing asset financing and credit services across Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana and South Africa. We have reached 10 million customers, extended $2B+ in credit, and work with 2,300+ employees and 35,000+ field agents. 86% of our customers are satisfied, and 55% are accessing formal financial services for the first time.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1d985516-2a99-43c0-b591-957f5adaceb9/ba282a12-7335-4f14-b5d0-85744a5ad867/B7.png]



This is a on-site role, you would be working from our offices in Nigeria, partnering with a diverse group of employees from our different markets and locations across the UK, Europe and Africa. You will be reporting to the Warehouse Lead.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Receive OEM deliveries, verify them against the delivery note, and flag damage or shortages.

 - Label and store goods, update bin cards, and maintain FIFO on the floor.

 - Work with IT and the App testing team to run flashing tools (Odin/HMD Toolkit) and app installation (Cygwin) on all provisioning systems for device enrolment.

 - Support serial verification and keep provisioning desktops updated within the 24-hour firmware SLA.

 - Package devices (QSG, casing, screen protector, seal) and complete final QC checks.

 - Oversee provisioning officers, manage their SLAs, and resolve provisioning issues.

 - Produce daily, weekly and monthly throughput and stock count reports.

 - Report to the Warehouse Lead and jointly verify materials with Handlers.

 - Hit the standards: a 24-hour firmware update SLA, 300 devices per operator per day, and zero hand-over discrepancy.




WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - A Diploma in Store/Warehouse Management or Procurement

 - 2 years’ work experience in a similar position

 - Hands-on experience with an inventory management system, and working knowledge of Microsoft Office tools

 - Strong stock management, problem solving, time management and multitasking skills, along with the conflict management, negotiation and collaboration needed to keep a busy floor working together.







The honest part

This role is demanding. The SLAs are tight, the daily targets are real, and there is little room for error between a delivery note and a customer’s device. You will be managing people and pressure at the same time. If you take pride in getting the count right every time, you are probably ready for exactly this.




WHY M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.



Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com http://m-kopa.com.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1d985516-2a99-43c0-b591-957f5adaceb9/369018b8-cf9c-49c7-95f1-1d414482ba57/B13.png]

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

jobs.title: Seasonal Retail Sales Lead (Water Tower Place)
jobs.description:
Squishable is a close-knit team of designers, artists, pop-culture fanatics, and lovers of all things adorable. Together we create the cutest, cuddliest (and sometimes downright unusual) plush and lifestyle products in the world. With the millions-strong Squishable fan community cheering us on (and a lot of cupcakes, coffee, and karaoke) we make people say “awww.” Our offices are in a sunny SoHo loft in NYC and in downtown Washington, DC.

WHO ARE WE?

We are Squishable! At Squishable, products and people are at the core of why we do what we do every day. We strive to create a customer experience built on sharing our love and passion for the brand while building long-lasting relationships with our customers…turning friends into fans. As we experience rapid growth, we are seeking career-driven leaders obsessed with creating a unique, exceptional customer experience. We need great people to represent the brand where it matters most…in front of our customers. These leaders will help shape the voice and character of the Squishable store experience.

The ideal candidate is a natural-born leader who loves the store experience. They are passionate, driven, and highly organized, with a desire to bring happiness to people’s lives. They are confident, creative, bright, friendly, adaptable, and able to perform at the highest level consistently. Candidates must be well-spoken and confident interacting with people at all levels while remaining calm and organized at all times.

What does a Seasonal Squishable Retail Sales Lead do?

The Retail Sales Lead is a key member of the store leadership team, supporting the Store Manager in driving sales, developing the team, and creating an exceptional experience for every Squishable fan. Responsibilities include:

• Supports the Store Manager in delivering a fun, welcoming, and efficient customer experience during the busy holiday season

• Helps lead the sales floor during peak periods, keeping the team focused on customer service and sales goals

• Drives holiday sales through customer engagement, product recommendations, and strong knowledge of Squishable products

• Supports seasonal promotions, merchandising, replenishment, and maintaining an organized, well-stocked sales floor

• Helps manage customer flow and resolves concerns with a positive, solution-oriented approach

• Provides day-to-day direction and support to team members and jumps in wherever needed during busy periods

• Supports opening, closing, and keyholder responsibilities, as assigned

Qualifications

• 1+ year of retail, customer service, or leadership experience in a fast-paced environment preferred

• Passion for people and creating a fun, welcoming customer experience

• Strong communication and organizational skills with the ability to stay positive and flexible during busy periods

• Team player who can motivate others, take initiative, and jump in wherever needed

• Comfortable receiving and providing feedback and helping keep the team focused on shared goals

• Must have flexible availability throughout the holiday season, including evenings, weekends, and holidays

• Able to lift and move cartons weighing up to 25 lbs.

• Must be 18 years of age or older

Compensation

Pay rate is $17.05 per hour

Benefits & Perks:

• A fun, welcoming workplace where creativity and personality are encouraged

• Career growth opportunities (many of our seasonal team members have the opportunity to stay with Squishable in ongoing roles!)

• Employee discounts (yes, even on the giant plushies)

Seasonal Duration: November 2026 through early January 2027

Availability Requirements: Seasonal team members must have flexible availability, including weekends, evenings, and holidays, as these are some of our busiest times of the year.

jobs.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
About ShiftKey

ShiftKey is a platform that is disrupting the way healthcare facilities find licensed and certified professionals to fill available shifts. Leveraging marketplace dynamics and deep industry knowledge, the company is playing a vital role in mitigating America’s healthcare staffing shortages, enabling direct connections between facilities and healthcare professionals. By offering the opportunity to work as much or as little as they choose and putting the power back into the hands of healthcare workers, ShiftKey is bringing more licensed professionals back into the workforce, a solution that is solving a major crisis in healthcare. For more information, visit www.ShiftKey.com http://www.ShiftKey.com.

 

The role

We’re a healthcare technology company with two products: a SaaS platform and a two-sided marketplace. Both operate under strict regulatory requirements. This role focuses on the SaaS product, the one our customers depend on to run their day. When it’s down, they feel it.

As a Staff Site Reliability Engineer, you’ll set technical direction for the infrastructure and core systems behind that product and own the results: availability, stability, and the ability to scale. You’ll work closely with engineering leadership, architects, and operations, serve as the go-to expert across our multi-cloud environment, and raise the operational standard for the engineering organization. That means giving architectural guidance on enterprise infrastructure, evaluating new technologies before we adopt them, and defining the practices other teams follow.

Where you’ll work

This is a fully remote position based in the United States. You should be comfortable working asynchronously and partnering with teammates in different time zones.

 

What you’ll be doing

 - Automate complex infrastructure changes using code-driven provisioning and scripting to keep our cloud environments scalable and resilient.

 - Provide architectural guidance across more than one major public cloud provider, enforce architectural boundaries and approval gates, and lead technical evaluations and proofs-of-concept.

 - Deploy, manage, and optimize production container orchestration clusters on managed cloud services, along with GitOps-style continuous delivery.

 - Own observability across all system components: metrics, dashboards, and proactive alerting. Participate in our company-wide incident response and on-call rotation.

 - Develop, document, and routinely test disaster recovery plans and business continuity procedures.

 - Track cloud spend, set up anomaly detection, automate scaling, and propose architectural changes that reduce cost.

 - Guide cross-functional teams through complex implementation challenges and mentor engineers on infrastructure best practices.

 - Develop technical solutions and operational processes that make engineering teams more effective.
   
    

What you’ll need

 - 8+ years across DevOps, infrastructure engineering, or systems administration, including at least 3 in a dedicated DevOps/SRE role.

 - Production experience operating managed Kubernetes on at least two major cloud providers, with an architecture-level understanding of how those platforms differ.

 - Demonstrated experience managing live production infrastructure through declarative infrastructure-as-code, including remote state management and reusable, modular design.

 - Hands-on experience with GitOps delivery tooling, metrics and dashboarding stacks, and automation in a scripting language.

 - A track record of defining technical roadmaps for multi-phase initiatives and executing major platform migrations or infrastructure rollouts.

 - Experience on on-call rotations, leading incident resolution, and applying cloud cost optimization.
   
    

Perks of working for ShiftKey

 - Inclusive and collaborative work environment where all voices are valued.

 - Hybrid-friendly office spaces designed to be fun and engaging.

 - Comprehensive health, vision, and dental coverage.

 - Benefits begin on your first day.

 - Generous PTO and company-paid holidays, including flexible floating holidays.

 - 100% 401(k) employer match up to 6%.

 - Paid parental leave.

 - Wellness support, including access to mental health resources.

#LI-Remote

 

Our Commitment to Diversity

ShiftKey is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to embracing diverse and individual perspectives shaping our culture and contributing to the solutions that transform the world. We actively work to create an inclusive environment for employees to thrive. 



EEO Statement

ShiftKey does not discriminate based on race, religion, color, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable law. All employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.  ShiftKey is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with a mental or physical disability, please contact: accommodations@shiftkey.com

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive, Digital Native
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Location: Tokyo, Japan

About the Department

At Cloudflare, our Go-To-Market team—comprising Account Executives, Business Development Representatives, Customer Engineers—collaborates seamlessly to empower organizations to modernize their digital infrastructure and build faster, safer Internet experiences.

Our Sales organization plays a pivotal role in delivering impactful, technology-driven solutions to overcome complex business challenges, directly driving the sustainable revenue growth that fuels Cloudflare’s global mission.

About The Role

• You will be responsible for driving new business with fast-growing, cloud-native, VC-backed technology companies across Japan, working closely with founders and senior technical leaders. This is an Outbound, High Touch sales role requiring strong discipline, resilience, and commercial focus. You will own the full sales cycle - from account selection and prospecting through discovery, solution design, proposal, negotiation, and close. We are seeking someone who combines strong sales execution with technical credibility, and who is comfortable engaging across Engineering, DevOps, Security, Network, IT, and Infrastructure teams. Key Responsibilities: Strategic Territory Planning: Formulate and execute tailored sales strategies to systematically maximize market penetration in Japan. Build and manage a portfolio of high-potential Digital Native - Emerging accounts focused on Application Security, Performance & Dev Platform Revenue Generation: Consistently achieve and exceed quarterly revenue targets by closing high-value, complex solutions. Value Proposition & Offerings: Clearly articulate Cloudflare’s unique value, connecting our Cloud/Security platform directly to client business outcomes. Pipeline & Deal Management: Build and maintain a healthy, predictable sales pipeline from lead qualification to contract negotiation and closure. Ecosystem Co-Selling: Identify, enable, and collaborate with strategic partners to scale sales reach and accelerate solution adoption. Client Advocacy: Foster strong, long-term relationships with key customer accounts to drive ongoing retention and customer satisfaction. Field Travel: Travel within Japan as required (up to ~60% dependent on business needs). Key Qualifications & Experience Proven Sales Record: 10+ years of successful Field / Direct Sales experience in the IT, Cloud, or Cyber Security industry. Domain Expertise: Demonstrated success selling Network Infrastructure, SaaS, Enterprise Security, or Cloud Architecture (IaaS/PaaS) directly to enterprise clients. Lead Ownership: Proven ability to manage the complete sales lifecycle as a lead account owner and relationship orchestrator. Language Proficiency: Fluent in Japanese (Native level) and Working proficiency in English (both written and verbal). Technical Aptitude: Core understanding of networking fundamentals, web infrastructure, and internet security. A technical background (Computer Science, Engineering, or MIS) is a strong plus. Executive Presence: Outstanding presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal communication skills with a consultative mindset. Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Terms & Working Conditions

• Term of Employment: Permanent / Indefinite-term (正社員)

• Probationary Period: 6 months

• Location: Tokyo Office (Hybrid Work Model)

• Standard Working Hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM (1-hour lunch break included)

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

jobs.title: Seasonal Retail Sales Lead (Short Pump Town Center)
jobs.description:
Squishable is a close-knit team of designers, artists, pop-culture fanatics, and lovers of all things adorable. Together we create the cutest, cuddliest (and sometimes downright unusual) plush and lifestyle products in the world. With the millions-strong Squishable fan community cheering us on (and a lot of cupcakes, coffee, and karaoke) we make people say “awww.” Our offices are in a sunny SoHo loft in NYC and in downtown Washington, DC.

WHO ARE WE?

We are Squishable! At Squishable, products and people are at the core of why we do what we do every day. We strive to create a customer experience built on sharing our love and passion for the brand while building long-lasting relationships with our customers…turning friends into fans. As we experience rapid growth, we are seeking career-driven leaders obsessed with creating a unique, exceptional customer experience. We need great people to represent the brand where it matters most…in front of our customers. These leaders will help shape the voice and character of the Squishable store experience.

The ideal candidate is a natural-born leader who loves the store experience. They are passionate, driven, and highly organized, with a desire to bring happiness to people’s lives. They are confident, creative, bright, friendly, adaptable, and able to perform at the highest level consistently. Candidates must be well-spoken and confident interacting with people at all levels while remaining calm and organized at all times.

What does a Seasonal Squishable Retail Sales Lead do?

The Retail Sales Lead is a key member of the store leadership team, supporting the Store Manager in driving sales, developing the team, and creating an exceptional experience for every Squishable fan. Responsibilities include:

• Supports the Store Manager in delivering a fun, welcoming, and efficient customer experience during the busy holiday season

• Helps lead the sales floor during peak periods, keeping the team focused on customer service and sales goals

• Drives holiday sales through customer engagement, product recommendations, and strong knowledge of Squishable products

• Supports seasonal promotions, merchandising, replenishment, and maintaining an organized, well-stocked sales floor

• Helps manage customer flow and resolves concerns with a positive, solution-oriented approach

• Provides day-to-day direction and support to team members and jumps in wherever needed during busy periods

• Supports opening, closing, and keyholder responsibilities, as assigned

Qualifications

• 1+ year of retail, customer service, or leadership experience in a fast-paced environment preferred

• Passion for people and creating a fun, welcoming customer experience

• Strong communication and organizational skills with the ability to stay positive and flexible during busy periods

• Team player who can motivate others, take initiative, and jump in wherever needed

• Comfortable receiving and providing feedback and helping keep the team focused on shared goals

• Must have flexible availability throughout the holiday season, including evenings, weekends, and holidays

• Able to lift and move cartons weighing up to 25 lbs.

• Must be 18 years of age or older

Compensation

Pay range is $14.00-$16.00 per hour

Benefits & Perks:

• A fun, welcoming workplace where creativity and personality are encouraged

• Career growth opportunities (many of our seasonal team members have the opportunity to stay with Squishable in ongoing roles!)

• Employee discounts (yes, even on the giant plushies)

Seasonal Duration: November 2026 through early January 2027

Availability Requirements: Seasonal team members must have flexible availability, including weekends, evenings, and holidays, as these are some of our busiest times of the year.
