jobs.title: Full-Time Work Crew Supervisor
jobs.description:
Work Crew Site Supervisor

In Person at our Atlanta, GA office

Atlanta, GA

The Opportunity

Anticipated deadline to submit application: October 26 at 12:00pm EST Position may close early if application limit is met. Apply promptly for full consideration.

We’re looking for a Site Supervisor to help us live our mission to prepare people with recent criminal convictions for securing employment each year.

Site Supervisors support, supervise, and train work crews of 5-10 individuals, creating an uplifting work environment that ensures team member safety, providing on-the-job coaching, encouraging and empowering team members to seize each opportunity for building knowledge and skills, and balancing engagement and accountability across the crew.

This role is perfect for you if you enjoy a non-traditional workspace, like being on your feet, and love being outdoors.  Ideally, you have experience teaching, coaching, mentoring or motivating youth or groups of adults as we know you’ll be able to make a real impact in our participants’ lives.  You’ll help create greater stability for our participants as they get back on their feet.

Please note: Site Supervisor work hours are typically 7:00AM-3:30PM (M-F) with the work conducted outside in all weather conditions.  Weekly overtime is built into the role.

Who We Are

The Center for Employment Opportunities (CEO) provides employment services to people recently released from incarceration. Across the United States, 8,000-9,000 people participate in CEO each year, transitioning to employment that supports themselves, their families, and their communities.

What began as a demonstration project of the Vera Institute of Justice in the 1970s to address employment barriers facing the formerly incarcerated following release in New York City has grown into the leading reentry employment organization in the country, where over 30,000 formerly incarcerated individuals have secured full-time employment since 1996.

Who You Are

• You have strong organizational skills and can delegate, prioritize, and manage your team’s time effectively to meet project deadlines; you operate under pressure with ease

• You pride yourself in your ability to communicate and resolve conflicts effectively with individuals of varying backgrounds and experiences. You recognize the value of continuous communication, looping others into project status and any arising challenges

• You have a proven track record of leading teams to achieve success

• You enjoy supporting others to solve routine challenges; personally you’re mechanically inclined, able to diagnose issues with equipment and propose solutions to solve/address

• You’re deeply passionate about and committed to social justice

• You’re respectful, fair, and patient

• You believe in hard work, efficient and friendly customer service, and teamwork and collaboration to drive results

• You exercise compassion toward the team you’re leading and balance this with a straightforward approach that ensures you meet the needs of your customers

• You foster strong team spirit and enjoy providing 1:1 support to team members who may need a little extra encouragement

The Nitty Gritty Qualifications

• Valid driver’s license with good driving record

• Must be able to: Consistently lift and move objects up to 75 pounds; stand, kneel, bend, and climb in order to complete projects; work outdoors; walk or stand for long periods of time; drive a 12 passenger van with an attached trailer; operate a smartphone

• Previous safety training preferable, though training will be provided to hired candidate

Additional Responsibilities

Key responsibilities of the Site Supervisor include but are not limited to:

• Leading a work crew in public beautification projects: litter abatement, landscaping, and sometimes other projects.

• Comply with company time and attendance (T&A) processes, which includes ensuring that participants accurately record their work time, ensuring that participants receive any required rest breaks and meal periods, and timely reviewing and approving participant time records on a daily basis.

• Ensuring customers’ work orders are completed to a high standard on a daily basis

• Establishing and maintaining positive staff morale through modeling sound leadership and teamwork

• Assigning job duties to crew members and setting reasonable goals for completion

• Monitoring crew members on job performance and productivity, providing appropriate feedback and/or additional training as needed

• Maintaining line of sight of all participants

• Maintaining a safe, secure, and healthy work environment by following and enforcing standards and procedures and complying with legal regulations and by reporting any matters that threaten the smooth operation of the training crew to your supervisor

• Completing any necessary daily reporting tasks

• Special projects and related duties as assigned

Compensation and Benefits

The salary range for this position is $23.24. In an effort to be both equitable and transparent, CEO's compensation philosophy considers a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, experience, internal equity, and home office location in making a final determination on our salary offer.

We recognize that salary is a part of the overall compensation package and also provide a comprehensive benefits package, including medical and dental coverage, as well as professional development opportunities and training, including regular training opportunities in Motivational Interviewing (MI). MI is one evidence-based skill that reentry and human service professionals can utilize when supporting participants to achieve their goals.

We also offer paid parental leave, participation in a retirement plan, sick and vacation leave, paid holidays and more. We are a workplace that promotes continual learning and teamwork, offering lunch and learns, team outings, holiday gatherings and more for our staff.

More About Us

Center for Employment Opportunities believes that everyone deserves the chance to shape a stronger future for themselves, their families, and their communities. People who are justice involved are highly encouraged to apply for vacant positions at all levels. CEO is committed to the CROWN Act, and creating an open space where our employees can present as their true authentic selves.

All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without unlawful discrimination based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, gender, gender identity, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, military status, prior record of arrest or conviction, citizenship status, current employment status, caregiver status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law. We value diverse experiences, including with regard to educational background and justice system contact.

Please note that due to the volume of resumes received, we are unable to contact each applicant regarding the status of each position or reply to candidates' inquiries via phone or email.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (US Cards)
jobs.description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:



 - One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

 - Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

 - Profitable since 2017

 - Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

 - Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)



So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.



We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.




JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

 1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

 2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

 3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting




ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll own customer lifecycle management for US Cards. That covers everything from a customer's first transaction through every part of their relationship with us. You'll join as we prove out the book, then take it into its next phase of growth. This suits someone who wants to shape a product while it's still being defined, not inherit a finished one.


You'll be part of a small team of data-driven problem solvers. Like most teams at Lendable, it's small relative to what it runs, so you'll own decisions and their implementation rather than handing them off. The work sits close to the proprietary AI and decisioning that lets us see people as individuals rather than credit scores. You'll be expected to use AI to build, test and analyse faster than a team our size otherwise could.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Owning the product vision and roadmap: first to market parity, then past it, for our current and expanding target segment, driven by customer understanding and experimentation.

 - Owning the customer lifecycle from first transaction onwards, including credit line management, spend and engagement growth, balance growth, pricing and proposition management, and retention and reactivation.

 - Shaping the mobile app experience to drive activation, spend and engagement.

 - Building new credit propositions alongside the core Cards product.

 - Executing hands-on: writing and resolving tickets, prototyping, and owning implementation and design decisions. You'll use AI tools to build the scrappiest thing that answers the question rather than waiting for engineering capacity.

 - Bringing Credit, Growth, Design, Data Science and Compliance with you, and partnering closely with US Cards Managing Director.

 - Setting clear, measurable goals and judging your work by whether the numbers moved, not by what shipped. You'll champion experimentation and never ship what you can't sense-check.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essential

 - A track record of owning product outcomes end to end. You make tough calls under ambiguity, own them, and course-correct when the evidence turns.

 - Strong analytical instinct:

 - a feel for what the numbers should look like

 - the instinct to notice when something is off

 - the persistence to find the real driver, without taking a confident answer from a dashboard or model at face value

 - Comfort working hands-on: writing and resolving tickets, prototyping, and making implementation and design decisions yourself.

 - Real fluency with AI tools as a working part of how you build, test and analyse.

 - The ability to lead through influence across Credit, Growth, Design, Data Science and Compliance. You change your mind when presented with a good argument, and you expect others to do the same.

Nice to have

 - Experience with consumer credit lifecycle levers such as credit line management, pricing, and retention and reactivation.

 - Experience shaping mobile app journeys for activation and engagement.
   


INTERVIEW PROCESS

 1. A quick chat with someone from our Talent team to see if the role is a good match.

 2. A 15-minute cognitive assessment.

 3. An interview with the Hiring Manager, covering your experience and how you approach the work.

 4. A practical exercise or case study relevant to the role, discussed with the team you'd be working with.

 5. A set of final interviews to assess how you'd thrive within our team and organisation.




LIFE AT LENDABLE

 - Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

 - Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

 - Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

 - Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

 - Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

 - Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

 - Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

 - Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Check out our blog https://blog.lendable.co.uk/!

jobs.title: Principal, Business Development: Insurance
jobs.location: Chicago, Illinois; New York, New York; Santa Clara, California
jobs.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

As the Principal of Business Development for Insurance within Financial Services, you will drive the strategy, financial performance, and growth of our core Insurance sub vertical. Whether focused on Property & Casualty (P&C), Life & Annuities, or Reinsurance, you will serve as the owner for your sub vertical by owning the booking targets and orchestrating strategic vertical alliances. You will accelerate our market momentum by architecting and executing high-impact, joint go-to-market (GTM) strategies with our top-tier resellers and hyperscaler partners.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between technical innovation and market needs. You will determine objectives to address critical industry challenges including claims modernization, actuarial and risk analytics, regulatory reporting (e.g., Solvency II, IFRS 17), and AI-driven underwriting, and act as a principal advisor to both our internal teams and external customers. This role differentiates itself by shifting the traditional partner relationship into a true co-selling engine, directly driving pipeline and bookings for Insurance solutions via Partner-Sourced business.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own the Pipeline & Financial Performance: Own the booking targets and financial performance for the sub vertical by developing and executing a multi-year strategic growth plan. Drive and scale the overarching pipeline and bookings targets across the ecosystem, establishing clear qualification criteria and pipeline visibility.

• Define the Insurance Value Proposition: Define and articulate the value proposition for Insurance to drive growth and establish Everpure as the industry leader.

• Architect & Execute Joint GTM Plans: Author and launch strategic go-to-market plans with priority partners, aligning internal cross-functional teams (Partner Account Teams, Core Sales, Alliances, Marketing) to unlock high-potential Insurance customer accounts and activate new revenue streams.

• Orchestrate Strategic Alliances: Orchestrate strategic vertical alliances and operationalize relationships with key partners to secure reference architectures and joint go-to-market motions.

• Enable and Mobilize the Partner Ecosystem: Equip sales teams and partners with the specialized tools, training, and go to market guides they need to successfully position and sell vertical solutions. Train and align Partner representatives ensuring they can effectively articulate our value proposition, economic differentiation, and technical sizing for insurance regulatory and data compliance (e.g., Solvency II, IFRS 17, GDPR).

• Drive Joint Demand Gen & Thought Leadership: Act as a spokesperson for your sub vertical vision in customer meetings, industry events, analyst briefings, and media opportunities. Build credibility as a principal advisor by shaping the industry narrative around intelligent data foundations and enterprise AI adoption in Insurance.

• We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from any office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

WHAT YOU BRING

• Insurance & Alliance Expertise: Proven success leading strategic business development or alliance management within the technology sector, with a deep understanding of insurance carriers' core systems, actuarial and claims workflows, cloud economics, and the specific regulatory, data, and compliance needs of the Insurance sector (Solvency II, IFRS 17, GDPR, etc).

jobs.title: Head of Customer Experience & Automation
jobs.description:
Ever imagined saying, “I helped launch the future of transportation”?

We’re rewriting the rules of urban mobility. At Vay, customers tap a button and a car arrives - with no one inside - powered by our world-first Remote Driving technology on real public streets.

We’re live in Las Vegas and scaling fast, powered by a strategic investment of up to $410 million from Grab. Our mission is simple: replace private car ownership with a faster, cleaner, door-to-door mobility model. If you want to build something real, visible, and genuinely transformative, you’ll feel right at home here.

What’s happening at Vay

• First to roll out vehicles in both Europe and the USA on public roads without a human being inside & currently the 2nd largest commercial, driverless car fleet in the Western World.

• We've partnered with Kodiak to bring remote-driving technology to autonomous trucks in the US, showcasing our ability to integrate our system into heavy-duty commercial vehicles and expand the applications of our tech across the US.

• We’ve completed over 150,000 trips so far and are busy multiplying our Las Vegas fleet just to meet demand!

• ...And soon we’ll be expanding across the US & Europe 🚀

Why this role is exciting

At Vay, we're rethinking how people access and use cars. Our Remote Driving technology allows customers to have a rental vehicle remotely delivered to them, drive it themselves, and have it picked up when they're done.

As we scale, we're looking for a highly analytical, technical, and entrepreneurial leader to transform how we deliver customer experiences.

This is not a traditional Head of Customer Support role. You’ll build, not just manage. We're looking for someone with a strong Product, Technical Program Management, Engineering, or Technology Consulting background who is excited about using AI, automation, and technology to solve real customer problems.

As Head of CX & Automation, you will own the strategy for creating a highly automated, scalable, and customer-centric experience . You'll identify friction across the customer journey, build and ship AI-powered solutions, and work closely with Product and Engineering to turn customer insights into meaningful product improvements.

You'll lead a Customer Support Manager who runs day-to-day operations, team performance, and dCS Ops metrics, so you can stay focused on the build. You’ll also oversee  a Claims Associate responsible for claims processing and recovering outstanding customer charges.

Your success won't be measured by how many support agents you manage. It will be measured by how effectively you improve the customer experience, eliminate unnecessary manual work, and build systems that scale with the business.

What you'll be driving

AI & Process Automation

• Own and execute the AI and automation roadmap for Customer Support and customer-related operational workflows.

• Identify high-volume, repetitive, or inefficient processes and redesign them using AI, automation, and self-service.

• Evaluate, implement, and optimize AI-powered solutions, including conversational AI, voice agents, automated issue resolution, workflow orchestration, and internal agent-assistance tools.

• Take ownership of automation projects end-to-end, from identifying opportunities and defining requirements to implementation, rollout, and performance measurement.

• Work hands-on with tools, integrations, and prototypes where needed, partnering with Engineering on more complex implementations.

• Continuously measure the impact of automation on customer satisfaction, resolution rates, manual workload, and operating costs.

Customer Product & Experience Improvements

• Own the end-to-end analysis of customer friction points, from onboarding and booking to vehicle delivery, in-trip experience, and post-trip support.

• Establish a structured Voice of Customer program that translates support interactions, complaints, and customer behavior into actionable insights.

• Partner closely with Product and Engineering to prioritize and deliver improvements that eliminate the root causes of customer contacts.

• Develop proactive customer communication and self-service experiences that prevent problems before they require support.

• Measure the impact of product improvements through customer satisfaction, contact rates, and other relevant metrics.

Operational Excellence & Scalability

• Design scalable customer-facing processes that support Vay's growth into new markets without proportional increases in operational headcount.

• Identify operational bottlenecks and implement technology-driven solutions to improve speed, quality, and efficiency.

• Establish clear KPIs and automated reporting to measure customer experience, process performance, and automation impact .

• Develop business cases for automation initiatives, including expected efficiency gains, cost savings, and customer impact.

• Collaborate with Operations, Product, Engineering, Finance, and Legal to solve complex customer-related challenges.

Customer Support Leadership & Oversight

• Lead and develop the Customer Support Manager, who owns day-to-day support operations, workforce management, agent performance, and CS KPIs.

• Set the direction for Customer Support and ensure the team has the right tools, workflows, and automation capabilities to deliver excellent customer experiences.

Claims & Revenue Recovery

• Oversee the Claims Associate responsible for handling customer claims, Terms & Conditions violations, and outstanding customer charges.

• Identify opportunities to automate claims intake, evidence collection, customer communication, payment follow-up, and recovery workflows, with transparent reporting on claims volume processing times, and recovery performance

• Partner with Finance, Legal, and Operations to improve recovery rates while maintaining a fair and transparent customer experience.

This might be a great fit, if

• You come from a Product, Technical Program Management, Software Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, Technology Consulting background and have a track record of shipping internal tooling and workflow improvements

• You can spot where manual work, broken handoffs or pool tooling are slowing a team down, and turn that into a prioritized plan to fix it.

• You have a proven track record of implementing AI-powered solutions, automating workflows, or improving technology-enabled operational processes. You’ve personally taken at least one from problem to production and can show the measured impact.

• You have strong technical fluency and understand how modern AI tools, APIs, integrations, and automation platforms can be applied to real business problems.

• You are highly analytical and comfortable working with operational data, defining KPIs, building business cases, and measuring results.

• You have a strong product mindset and enjoy improving customer journeys by solving root causes rather than treating symptoms.

• You thrive in fast-moving startup environments, take ownership beyond your immediate responsibilities, and enjoy getting your hands dirty.

• You are excited to build hands on while leading a small, high-impact team.

• You are comfortable working onsite in Las Vegas and value close collaboration with the team.

Nice to have

• Experience with AI agents, LLM-powered applications, conversational AI, voice automation, or workflow orchestration.

• Experience in a consumer-facing technology company, mobility, transportation, or another real-time service environment.

• Familiarity with customer support platforms such as Zendesk, Intercom, or Salesforce.

• Experience working with customer-facing operational teams or managing people managers.

• Experience with claims processing, payment recovery, or other operationally complex customer workflows.

• Background at a high-growth startup or in a hands-on technology transformation role.

For more information on Vay’s physical demands, working environments and safety requirements, you can review this link. We’ll also cover anything specific to this role during the first interview.

We’d love to stay connected for future opportunities, so feel free to include your LinkedIn profile when you apply.

We welcome applications from all backgrounds and experiences. If you’re excited about shaping something truly groundbreaking, we’d be happy to hear from you.

Curious to experience Vay yourself? In Las Vegas? Use the code VAYCANDIDATE for $10 off your first trip in Las Vegas! Download the "Vay" app from the Apple or Google Play store & off you go!

jobs.title: Lead Data Scientist, AdTech
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

YOUR ROLE

You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.

Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.

We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

By the end of your first year:

• Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier

• Carrier conversion data running in production models

• Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale

• A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions

• Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives

• Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

• 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact

• Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.

• You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included

• You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift

• You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view

• Expert Python and SQL

NICE TO HAVES

• Real ad budget spent in live auctions

• Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems

• Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms

• Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration

• Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior

• AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker

• CI/CD deployment

TOTAL COMPENSATION

Base salary is set according to market rates for the nearest major metro and varies based on Launch Potato’s Levels Framework. Your compensation package includes a base salary, profit-sharing bonus, and competitive benefits. Launch Potato is a performance-driven company, which means once you are hired, future increases will be based on company and personal performance, not annual cost of living adjustments.

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

Since day one, we've been committed to having a diverse, inclusive team and culture. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity company. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion.

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Fixed Income Associate
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Thndr’s Asset Management team is growing as we take on more managed mandates, and we’re looking for a Fixed Income Associate to support the team’s research and investment decisions.

In this role, you’ll spend most of your time analysing fixed income and money market instruments, following market movements, and understanding how changes in interest rates, inflation, and monetary policy affect investment opportunities.

You’ll work closely with the Head of Fixed Income, portfolio managers, and traders, providing the research and analysis they need to make informed decisions. This includes looking at Treasury Bills and Bonds, Corporate Bonds, Sukuk, and Eurobonds, as well as analysing issuers, reviewing financial statements, and keeping financial models up to date.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys working with numbers, is curious about financial markets, and can turn data and research into clear, useful insights.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Follow developments in fixed income and money markets, including Treasury Bills, Treasury Bonds, Corporate Bonds, Sukuk, and Eurobonds.

 - Research economic indicators, interest rates, inflation, and monetary policy, and assess how they affect the market.

 - Review companies’ financial statements to understand their financial position and assess their creditworthiness.

 - Build and update financial models to analyse yield curves, duration, convexity, and the relative value of different instruments.

 - Track daily yields, prices, auction results, and other market developments, sharing relevant updates with the team.

 - Prepare regular market updates covering yield movements, auctions, and key economic developments.

 - Support portfolio managers and traders with research ahead of auctions, new issuances, and investment decisions.

 - Monitor portfolio liquidity, upcoming maturities, and cash flow requirements across managed mandates.

 - Present your findings and investment views during team discussions and investment committee meetings.

 - Keep research files, financial models, and market databases accurate and up to date.

 - Build relationships with issuers, banks, brokers, rating agencies, and other market participants.

 - Follow internal policies and procedures, ensuring research activities comply with applicable FRA guidelines.

 - Work on ad hoc analysis and research requests from the Fixed Income team.
   
   


WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - 1–4 years of experience in fixed income, money markets, or a related financial analysis role.

 - A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related field.

 - A good understanding of fixed income instruments and money markets.

 - Strong financial analysis skills, including the ability to review financial statements and assess credit risk.

 - Understanding of fixed income valuation and modelling, particularly yield curves, duration, and convexity.

 - An interest in macroeconomic developments and how they affect interest rates and bond markets.

 - Strong analytical skills and attention to detail when working with financial data.

 - Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain findings clearly.

 - The ability to work closely with different stakeholders and manage multiple tasks.
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in asset management or a bank’s Treasury department, particularly ALM or a dealing room.

 - Experience in financial research or investment analysis.

 - Familiarity with the Egyptian fixed income market.

 - Experience using Bloomberg or Refinitiv Eikon.

 - Advanced Excel skills; knowledge of Python or Power BI is a plus.

 - Exposure to bond auctions, new issuances, or corporate credit analysis.

 - Experience preparing market reports or investment research.
   
   


WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

As Thndr’s managed mandates grow, the team needs solid research to understand market movements, assess risks, and make better investment decisions.

As a Fixed Income Associate, your work will help the team evaluate opportunities, understand the impact of economic changes, and make informed decisions across different fixed income instruments.

You’ll have the chance to build your expertise in fixed income markets, work closely with experienced investment professionals, and see how your analysis contributes to real investment decisions.

If you enjoy financial markets, digging into data, and understanding the reasons behind market movements, we’d love to hear from you.




WHO ARE WE?

Thndr was founded on a bold dream to democratize access to investing through smart tech and human-centric design. This is simply our way of saying we give anyone with a smartphone the simple and easy access they need to preserve and grow their wealth. At the same time, we’re shaping the future of investing while actively driving the economies we serve by promoting local investment products.

History has shown that investing is the single greatest way to build long-term wealth, but before Thndr, only a very small percentage of people had access to it due to:

 - High barriers to entry - In the form of excessive minimum account balances, complex, outdated onboarding, and low financial literacy.

 - Irrelevant experience - Catered toward expert traders and financial specialists, therefore alienating the majority of the population.

 - Fragmented offering - Investment products were not gathered in a single, intuitive outlet.

We don't just talk about change, we deliver it. Here's a glimpse into our impact so far:

 - 5.5 million app downloads

 - EGP 1B+ average daily traded value across 2025

 - #1 digital investing platform in Egypt for the third consecutive year

 - 76% of users are first-time investors

 - 40% of our users come from outside of capital cities and have previously had limited access to financial institutions

Building on the success of our core platform, we are continuing to change culture and break down barriers by launching Rumble, the subscription-based investment recommendations platform.

Rumble was born with the vision to empower everyday individuals to build wealth confidently and intelligently through access to timely and in-depth advice from the industry’s top experts.

Going beyond traditional investment advice, it offers long and short-term investment recommendations and financial content through engaging articles and videos that guide users on their financial journey and maximize their returns.

At Thndr, we're looking for people driven by our mission to help us democratize investing across the MENA region.

jobs.title: Operations System Analyst
jobs.description:
We're Scan.com http://Scan.com.  We're building America's national imaging network: the infrastructure that connects patients, providers, and payers to faster, better-value diagnostic imaging.  Thousands of patients move through our platform every day, and each is a real person waiting for an answer to a healthcare concern. We exist to get them that answer faster.



We manage the medical imaging pathway end-to-end.  Providers order through a single point of entry, and from there, we run the entire medical diagnostic pathway.  Managing the full pathway, rather than brokering pieces of it, is what lets us deliver imaging faster, at higher quality, and at a lower cost than the fragmented status quo.



We're looking for an Operations Systems Analyst at an exciting time. We've raised over $200m in funding to date, reached profitability, and are growing 100% year on year.



Millions of people wait too long for a diagnosis. Come help us fix that.




WHAT YOU MIGHT BRING TO THE TABLE

You don't need to tick all the boxes to apply for this role. Whether it's your first role or your fifth role, we believe everyone can add value, learn, and grow. However, these might be some of the ways you are currently adding value:

 - Experience partnering closely with Product teams — you can translate operational pain points into clear requirements, and product changes into operational impact.

 - You're hands-on with AI tools for analysis, scripting, and building automations — not just AI-aware, but someone who's actually shipped something with it.

 - Experience administering CRM, ticketing, or workflow systems (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, Notion, or similar) in an operations context.

 - Experience building reporting and dashboards that non-technical stakeholders can actually use.

 - A track record of designing workflow automations that measurably reduce manual work.

 - Strong analytical skills, comfortable turning messy operational data into a clear point of view.

 - Experience developing training or supporting non-technical users on new systems and tools.

 - Comfortable operating independently in a role that spans systems, data, and process, not just one of the three.

 - A proactive, detail-oriented approach — you notice when something's off in the data before someone has to tell you.




WHAT YOU WILL ACHIEVE IN THIS ROLE

This role sits within Operations, reporting directly to the SVP of Operations. You'll own the administration of systems and tooling that power operations— CRM and workflow implementation, reporting and dashboards, and the automations that keep operational data accurate and usable across teams. This role is a key bridge between Product and Operations—you'll translate operational needs into system and product requirements, and product changes into operational impact, so the two move in lockstep instead of in parallel.

Early on, your priority is collaborating with Product, auditing our current systems and reporting setup, fixing the most urgent data and process gaps, and building a roadmap side by side with Product teams for where automation can remove manual work across Operations. As a scale-up business, you can expect your role to develop over time. Here are some of the types of things you could be getting involved in:

 - Own administration of our core operational systems (CRM, ticketing, workflow tools), including configuration, permissions, and data integrity.

 - Build and maintain reporting and dashboards that give Service Delivery, Implementation, and leadership an accurate, real-time view of operational performance.

 - Design and implement workflow automations that reduce manual work across Service Delivery and Implementation teams.

 - Act as the key bridge between Product and Operations — translating operational needs into system and product requirements, and product changes into operational impact, so the two move in lockstep.

 - Partner with Product and IT to scope, test, and roll out system changes that affect Operations.

 - Troubleshoot system issues raised by ops teams and build a clear process for triaging and resolving them.

 - Maintain clean, well-documented data across our operational systems, and own the standards that keep it that way.

 - Train and support ops users on new systems, tools, and workflows as they roll out.

 - Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to recurring operational and reporting work, and pilot solutions directly.

 - Use AI tools directly to build internal automations, scripts, and reporting logic — treating AI as a core part of how you ship systems work, not an occasional add-on.




AI REQUIREMENTS

At Scan.com http://Scan.com, AI isn't a side project; it's how we work. We expect everyone to use AI to think faster, remove drudgery, and multiply their output. What we care about is judgment: knowing when AI makes you sharper, when it doesn't, and how to use it responsibly around patient data. You don't need to be an engineer. You need to be someone who reaches for the best tool and gets more done as a result.

Tier 1 — AI-Native

For this role, the expectation is that you are AI-Native. You build with AI directly, shipping, automating, or prototyping real work with LLMs and agents, and have clear judgment on where humans must stay in the loop.

 - You build with AI, not just alongside it. You've shipped, automated, or prototyped something real using LLMs, agents, or AI tooling.

 - You can explain a workflow you redesigned so a machine does the boring 80%.

 - You have a view on where agentic systems help and where a human must stay in the loop, especially in regulated, PHI-adjacent work.




A VIEW ON OUR CULTURE

We're building something that matters. Every scan we speed up is a real person waiting on an answer, and that urgency runs through everything we do. We move fast, we own outcomes, and take pride in our output. If you like ambiguity, working with ambitious people, and want your work to visibly move the needle, you'll feel at home here.




HOW WE WILL INTERVIEW YOU

We keep our interview process short and sweet. Here are the stages you can expect, but we might switch up the order depending on team availability:

 1. 30-minute introductory phone call with our Senior Talent Partner.

 2. If it feels like there is an initial fit for all, we will invite you to a 45-minute video call with the hiring manager. This is a more structured interview that will deep-dive into the role and technical needs.

 3. 'Scan Standard' interview, where our panel screens for values alignment and the success factors that matter at Scan.com http://Scan.com. You will also be assessed on your AI fluency at the stage and depth relevant to this role (see AI Requirements above).

 4. Meet the founders and/or other team members. Again, the length varies depending on how many people are involved and whether in person or via video call.

 5. Offer!
    
    


WHAT WE OFFER

We go beyond the basics with our benefits package. We believe great work starts with supporting our people. Here's what you can expect from us:

 - Salary range of $115,000 - $125,000

 - Equity package

 - Flexible remote or hybrid work options

 - Dedicated personal development budget

 - Medical, vision, and dental coverage

 - 28+ days of paid time off across PTO and wellbeing days, so you can show up at your best

 - Inclusive, people-first policies designed by our team, for our team

DIVERSITY AT SCAN.COM http://Scan.com

jobs.title: Head of Service Delivery
jobs.description:
We're Scan.com http://Scan.com.  We're building America's national imaging network: the infrastructure that connects patients, providers, and payers to faster, better-value diagnostic imaging.  Thousands of patients move through our platform every day, and each is a real person waiting for an answer to a healthcare concern. We exist to get them that answer faster.



We manage the medical imaging pathway end-to-end.  Providers order through a single point of entry, and from there, we run the entire medical diagnostic pathway.  Managing the full pathway, rather than brokering pieces of it, is what lets us deliver imaging faster, at higher quality, and at a lower cost than the fragmented status quo.



We're looking for a Head of Service Delivery at an exciting time. We've raised over $200m in funding to date, reached profitability, and are growing 100% year on year.



Millions of people wait too long for a diagnosis. Come help us fix that.




WHAT YOU MIGHT BRING TO THE TABLE

You don't need to tick all the boxes to apply for this role. Whether it's your first role or your fifth role, we believe everyone can add value, learn, and grow. However, these might be some of the ways you are currently adding value:

 - Direct people-management experience leading managers or team leads, not just individual contributors.

 - You are service-obsessed and focused on how we deliver outstanding service to patients, partners, and colleagues alike.

 - A track record managing vendors within a healthcare operations role.

 - Experience managing third-party vendor relationships, including contract negotiation and SLA governance.

 - Experience overseeing Workforce Management (WFM) — forecasting, scheduling, and intraday management.

 - Experience building or overseeing Quality Assurance (QA) programs, including audit frameworks and calibration.

 - A data-first mindset, comfortable building and reading vendor and team scorecards.

 - Comfort operating at high speed without compromising on execution quality.

 - Strong communication skills, able to translate complex, cross-functional work for executives and your own team alike.

 - Experience redesigning operational workflows around automation or AI, with results you can quantify: handle time, cost per order, headcount avoided.

 - Able to build a capacity model that forecasts both human and automated throughput, and shows where the next headcount dollar should go versus the next automation dollar.

 - Experience structuring vendor contracts for shifts in workload: volume flexibility, per-outcome pricing, exit terms, and automation clauses.

 - Comfortable setting quality standards for automated and agentic systems, and holding Product and Engineering to them.

 - A working view on PHI and AI: what data can enter which tools, what a BAA must cover, and how to audit it.

 - Able to judge AI vendor claims. You can tell a demo from a deployed result and ask for the evidence.
   
   


WHAT YOU WILL ACHIEVE IN THIS ROLE

This role sits within Service Delivery, reporting directly to the SVP of Operations. You'll own two core pillars — Workforce Management (WFM) and Quality Assurance (QA) — plus our vendor partnerships, leading a small team of functional leads (a WFM Lead and a QA Lead) who run the day-to-day.

As a scale-up business, you can expect your role to develop over time. Here are some of the types of things you could be getting involved in:

 - Build, lead, and develop a team of functional leads across WFM and QA, growing their capability to run their pillars independently.

 - Own the end-to-end vendor lifecycle — sourcing, onboarding, contract structuring, performance management, and offboarding.

 - Set the strategy for Quality Assurance (QA) — audit frameworks, calibration, scorecards, and coaching feedback loops. You will also be standing up the infrastructure for product testing on behalf of operational functions.

 - Set the strategy for Workforce Management (WFM) — demand forecasting, staffing plans, scheduling, and capacity modeling — across internal and outsourced teams.

 - Standardize reporting across QA and WFM, including SLA/KPI dashboards and vendor and team scorecards.

 - Partner with the SVP of Operations on Service Delivery strategy, headcount planning, and budget for the function.

 - Represent Service Delivery in cross-functional and executive conversations, translating team-level performance into business impact.

 - Lead HIPAA compliance and data security oversight across all outsourced operations. - Own the automation roadmap for Service Delivery.

 - Set and own a target for cost per order, defect rates, and key cost metrics

 - Rebuild WFM to forecast mixed human and automated capacity, so staffing plans and vendor commitments track the real demand curve, in real time.

 - Help set the quality framework for agentic workflows: error tolerance, escalation paths, human-in-the-loop points, and audit coverage.

 - Act as the operational owner for Product and Engineering on Courier automation. Define what good looks like, test it, and sign off before patient-facing release.

 - Make AI-assisted work the default across your team, and measure adoption and output gains at team level.

 - Lead HIPAA and data security oversight across outsourced operations and AI tooling, including vendor due diligence and BAAs.
   
   


AI REQUIREMENTS

At Scan.com http://Scan.com, AI isn't a side project; it's how we work. We expect everyone to use AI to think faster, remove drudgery, and multiply their output. What we care about is judgment: knowing when AI makes you sharper, when it doesn't, and how to use it responsibly around patient data. You don't need to be an engineer. You need to be someone who reaches for the best tool and gets more done as a result.

Tier 1 — AI-Native

For this role, the expectation is that you are AI-native. You build with AI directly, shipping, automating, or prototyping real work with LLMs and agents, and have clear judgment on where humans must stay in the loop.

 - You build with AI, not just alongside it. You've shipped, automated, or prototyped something real using LLMs, agents, or AI tooling.

 - You can explain a workflow you redesigned so a machine does the boring 80%.

 - You have a view on where agentic systems help and where a human must stay in the loop, especially in regulated, PHI-adjacent work.




A VIEW ON OUR CULTURE

We're building something that matters. Every scan we speed up is a real person waiting on an answer, and that urgency runs through everything we do. We move fast, we own outcomes, and take pride in our output. If you like ambiguity, working with ambitious people, and want your work to visibly move the needle, you'll feel at home here.




HOW WE WILL INTERVIEW YOU

We keep our interview process short and sweet. Here are the stages you can expect, but we might switch up the order depending on team availability:

 1. 30-minute introductory phone call with our Senior Talent Partner.

 2. If it feels like there is an initial fit for all, we will invite you to a 45-minute video call with the hiring manager. This is a more structured interview that will deep-dive into the role and technical needs.

 3. 'Scan Standard' interview, where our panel screens for values alignment and the success factors that matter at Scan.com http://Scan.com. You will also be assessed on your AI fluency at the stage and depth relevant to this role (see AI Requirements above).

 4. Meet the founders and/or other team members. Again, the length varies depending on how many people are involved and whether in person or via video call.

 5. Offer!
    
    


WHAT WE OFFER

We go beyond the basics with our benefits package. We believe great work starts with supporting our people. Here's what you can expect from us:

 - Salary range of $150,000 - $180,000

 - Equity package

 - Flexible remote or hybrid work options

 - Dedicated personal development budget

 - Medical, vision, and dental coverage

 - 28+ days of paid time off across PTO and wellbeing days, so you can show up at your best

 - Paid parental leave

 - 401k retirement plan

 - All the equipment you need to do your best work

 - Inclusive, people-first policies designed by our team, for our team




DIVERSITY AT SCAN.COM http://Scan.com

Scan.com http://Scan.com is committed to eliminating discrimination and encouraging diversity within our team. We strive to provide equality and fairness for all job applicants and employees and never discriminate on the basis of gender, marital status, age, race, ethnicity, religion, or physical differences.

We are opposed to all forms of unlawful treatment and discrimination.

Our ambition is for our team to be representative of society's diversity, and for every employee to feel respected and able to bring their best selves to work.

If you need an accommodation to apply or interview, contact us at people@scan.com.

We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.title: Független Értékesítő - Zalaegerszeg
jobs.description:
Helló! Mi vagyunk a Teya. 
A Teya egy fizetési- és szoftverszolgáltatásokat nyújtó vállalat, londoni központtal. Célunk a kis- és közepes méretű, helyi vállalkozások támogatása Európa-szerte. 2019-es alapításunk óta olyan könnyen használható, integrált eszközöket fejlesztünk, amelyek segítik partnereinket a fizetések egyszerű elfogadásában, és hozzájárulnak üzleti teljesítményük javításához.

A Teyánál hiszünk abban, hogy a kisebb, helyi vállalkozások a közösségünk alapjai. 
Azért vagyunk itt, mert úgy látjuk, a jelenlegi játéktér nem ad valódi esélyt a kisebb szereplőknek a nagyvállalatokkal szemben. 
Azért dolgozunk, mert azt tapasztaljuk, hogy a bankok és a hagyományos szolgáltatók gyakran megnehezítik a helyi vállalkozások hatékony működését. Nem hisszük, hogy a legjobb technológia vagy szolgáltatás csak a legnagyobb cégeket illetné meg. 
Egy olyan jövőért dolgozunk, ahol a kisebb vállalkozások is sikeresen működhetnek és ugyanolyan elkötelezettséggel támogatjuk őket, amilyennel ők nap mint nap építik a közösségünket.

Legyél a történetünk része!  
Kivételes tehetségeket keresünk, akik csatlakoznának küldetésünkhöz. Nálunk lehetőséged van valódi hatást gyakorolni egy lendületes, összetartó közösségben. Támogatunk a folyamatos fejlődésben, büszkék vagyunk közös céljainkra, és átfogó juttatási csomagot kínálunk.




Csatlakozz csapatunkhoz, mint független értékesítő!

Proaktív személy vagy, aki szeret emberekkel beszélgetni és sok időt tölteni terepen? Kiváló kommunikációs készségeid vannak és szereted az értékesítést? Széles kapcsolati hálóval rendelkezel a vendéglátásban, kiskereskedelemben és a szépségiparban, vagy egyszerűen csak ismersz valakit szinte bármire?

A Teya-nál folyamatosan keressük azokat a független értékesítőket, akik képviselik szolgáltatásainkat kis- és középvállalkozások számára a fizetési megoldások területén.
A feladat egyszerű: találj egy ügyfelet, küldj neki ajánlatot, vidd fel felhasználóként, és a jutalék hamarosan a számládon landol.

Van saját céged vagy egyéni vállalkozásod? Remek! A vállalkozásod a hónap során általad hozott ügyfelek után számláz a Teya felé, így a bevételed teljes mértékben az általad elért eredményektől függ.



Miért dolgozz velünk:

 - Rugalmasság: Dolgozz a saját feltételeid szerint, kezeld a saját időbeosztásod és határozd meg a prioritásaid

 - Korlátlan kereseti lehetőség: Teljesítményalapú, magas jutalékrendszer, korlátlan potenciállal

 - Függetlenség: Szabadság a saját vállalkozásod vezetésére, miközben igénybe veheted támogatásunkat és erőforrásainkat

 - Kiváló megoldások: Dolgozz a legmodernebb kártyaelfogadó technológiával és POS eszközökkel

 - Képzés és támogatás: Részletes képzést biztosítunk, hogy minél jobban megismerd szolgáltatásainkat, és folyamatos támogatást nyújtunk minden felmerülő kérdésre



Amit tőled várunk:

 - Kiváló kommunikációs és prezentációs készségek

 - Önálló munkavégzés és hatékony időgazdálkodás

 - Ambíció, motiváció és könnyedség másokkal való kapcsolattartásban

 - Ügyfélszerzés, termék- és szolgáltatásbemutatás, valamint sikeres értékesítés

 - Előnyben részesülnek azok a jelöltek, akik terepi vagy személyes értékesítési tapasztalattal rendelkeznek, illetve széles kapcsolati hálóval a kiskereskedelem, vendéglátás és kapcsolódó ágazatok területén



Ha mindez jól hangzik, és szeretnél a saját feltételeid szerint dolgozni korlátlan kereseti lehetőséggel, örömmel várjuk jelentkezésedet!



A Teya elkötelezett az egyenlő esélyek biztosítása mellett.
Elkötelezettek vagyunk egy befogadó munkahelyi környezet kialakítása mellett, ahol mindenki, függetlenül származásától, nemi identitásától, szexuális irányultságától, életkorától, akadályoztatottságától, vallásától vagy hátterétől, kibontakozhat és a legjobbat hozhatja ki magából. Hisszük, hogy a sokszínű csapat kreatívabb ötletekhez, jobb eredményekhez és egy támogatóbb munkahelyhez vezet mindenki számára.

Ha a jelentkezési folyamat bármely szakaszában szükséged lenne bármilyen jellegű támogatásra vagy segítségre, kérjük, hogy jelezd felénk. Elkötelezettek vagyunk amellett, hogy a jelentkezési folyamat mindenki számára elérhető legyen.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Product Manager, Storage
jobs.description:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About the Role:

We are looking for a Product Manager to join the Vercel cloud product team. You will own the Storage product portfolio where applications and agents keep their data on Vercel. That covers Blob for blob storage, Drives for persistent filesystems, and future database and key value storage products. This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, and you’ll report to the Product Lead.

If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. If you're located beyond that distance, the role is fully remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

What You Will Do:

• Own the product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for Vercel’s storage portfolio (blob storage, persistent filesystems, database, and key/value storage).

• Ensure storage products integrate seamlessly with the rest of Vercel’s cloud (Functions, backend services, Sandboxes, Daemons) to enable fully functional applications and agents.

• Set and hold the bar for performance, availability, and durability across the portfolio, and make the call when those goals trade off against speed or cost.

• Shape pricing and packaging for storage so it scales with customers from hobbyist to large Enterprises.

• Partner with Engineering, Design, and DX to ship primitives that other Vercel product teams build on.

• Work directly with Enterprise customers and the field to unblock adoption on scale, compliance, and data locality and encryption requirements.

About You:

• You’ve owned multiple connected product areas and set direction that other product teams built against.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Stockbroking
jobs.description:
ABOUT BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 


THE ROLE

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 - Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 - Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 - Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 - Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 - Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 - Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
   
    


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 - Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 - Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 - Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 - Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 - Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
   
    


NICE TO HAVE

 - Engineering or highly technical product background.

 - Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 - Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
   
    


OUTCOME

 - Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 - Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 - Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 - AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 - Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 - Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
   
    


LOCATION

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 

 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

 


LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 


INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process is designed to move fast:

 1. Online assessment or practical task

 2. Technical interview

 3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Penetration Tester
jobs.description:
About the Role

The Penetration Tester works to execute offensive security activities for Pathfynder by A-LIGN. In this role, you will be responsible for the delivery of external network, web application, and API penetration testing engagements. As the Penetration Tester, you will provide exceptional technical and client-focused testing strategies to help support the continued growth of our fast-paced company. A-LIGN will depend on you as the Penetration Tester to independently identify and validate real-world security risks, manually exploit vulnerabilities, document findings, and communicate practical remediation guidance to clients.

Reports to

Director, Web Application & External Offensive Operations

Pay Classification

Full-Time, Exempt

Responsibilities

• Execute external network, web application, and API penetration testing engagements

• Identify, validate, and manually exploit vulnerabilities using public exploits, custom-developed exploits, or a combination of techniques

• Evaluate findings in context, develop realistic attack paths, and accurately assess business and technical risk

• Deliver clear, accurate, client-ready reports that explain findings, risk ratings, evidence, and actionable remediation guidance

• Communicate technical issues, testing results, and remediation recommendations to client stakeholders

• Maintain project quality and timelines while executing assigned engagements with minimal oversight

• Collaborate with the offensive security team to evaluate tools, improve delivery methods, and share technical knowledge

• Mentor junior testers and contribute to the development of team capabilities and repeatable testing practices

Minimum Qualifications

EDUCATION

• Degree in in cybersecurity, computer science, a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience

EXPERIENCE

• 5+ years of hands-on offensive security experience, including at least 3 years focused on external network, web application, or API penetration testing

• Experience performing web application penetration testing using black-box, grey-box, and white-box approaches

• Experience testing APIs, including REST, GraphQL, SOAP, or gRPC

• Proven ability to manage engagements from scoping and execution through reporting and client debriefs.

• Working knowledge of OWASP WSTG, OWASP ASVS, OWASP API Security Top 10, and PTES

• Consulting or client-facing security delivery experience is preferred

• Mobile application penetration testing experience across iOS or Android is preferred

• White-box or source-code-assisted testing experience is preferred

CERTIFICATIONS

• Required at least one of the following: OSCP/OSCP+, OSWA, eWPT, HTB CWES, TCM PWPP, GWAPT, GPEN, or CREST CRT

• Preferred: OSWE, HTB CWEE, BSCP, eWPTX, CREST CCT APP, TCM PWPE, OSEP, or GXPN

• Published CVEs, conference presentations, or meaningful contributions to open-source security tooling may be considered in place of certifications

SKILLS

• Advanced manual testing skills, including the ability to chain lower-severity findings into high-impact attack paths

• Advanced web exploitation knowledge, including access control and authorisation flaws, OAuth, SAML and JWT abuse, SSRF, deserialisation, request smuggling, race conditions, and business logic abuse

• Knowledge of external attack surfaces, including OSINT, asset discovery, edge-device exploitation, and SSO or MFA attack techniques

• Proficiency with scripting languages such as Python, Bash, JavaScript, PowerShell, or Go, including the ability to build custom tooling and exploits

• Proficiency with offensive security and assessment tools such as Burp Suite, Caido, Nmap, Nuclei, SQLmap, ffuf, Postman, and Nessus

• Familiarity with common application frameworks, including Laravel, Express.js, ASP.NET Core, Spring, and Django

• Ability to write clear, concise, client-ready reports with accurate risk ratings and actionable remediation guidance

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical risks to technical and non-technical audiences

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, remote environment while meeting deadlines.

• Experience assessing AI or LLM-integrated applications for prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, and agent or tool abuse is preferred

• Familiarity with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and cloud attack surfaces across AWS, Azure, or GCP is preferred

Benefits

• Healthcare, Dental, and Vision Benefits

• Employer Paid Life Insurance and Disability Insurance

• EAP - Employee Assistance Program

• Pet Insurance

• 401(k) Plan with Employer Matching

• Competitive Bonus Structure

• Technology Allowance

• Certification Reimbursement

• Personalized Career Coaching

• Generous Paid Time Off

• Paid Office Closure December 25-January 1

• Vacation Bonus

• Summer Hours

About Pathfynder by A-LIGN

Pathfynder by A-LIGN is a technology-enabled cybersecurity company providing offensive and defensive cybersecurity services under A-LIGN, a security and compliance partner trusted by more than 2,400 global organisations to help mitigate cybersecurity risks. We work with organisations ranging from small businesses to global enterprises, with services spanning SOC, Penetration Testing, PCI DSS, HITRUST, ISO, and privacy compliance. Our proprietary compliance management platform is transforming the compliance experience by enabling an anytime, anywhere approach to audits. To learn more, visit A-LIGN.com.

Come Work for A-LIGN!

Apply online today at A-LIGN.com and learn about life at A-LIGN by following us on LinkedIn.

A-LIGN is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Minorities, women, disabled individuals, and veterans are encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Enterprise Solution Engineer - South East / Mid Atlantic
jobs.description:
Sigma’s vision is to create an insight-driven world where people, organizations, and, ultimately, humanity are transformed for the better by data. At Sigma, we are building a cloud-native business intelligence platform that allows users to tap into their biggest databases hosted in the cloud and easily conduct ad hoc analysis to gain business insights in seconds. All without any SQL programming. We are growing the Solution Engineering team and are looking for a Solution Engineer who will help redefine the business intelligence landscape for our customers. You will join a talented team of Solution Engineers with a shared mission to truly make data access easy to drive business results.

The Sigma Solution Engineer believes in the power of analytics to transform organizations and uncover new data insights to increase business agility. The Sigma Solution Engineer will act as the trusted advisor to our prospects and customers working in tandem with Sales, Business Development, Product Management, Engineering, and Support. This individual is ultimately responsible for managing and delivering on all activities related to the technical presales cycle. This includes presentations, demonstrations, and hands on development of prototypes.  You will align closely with our field Regional Sales Managers (Enterprise)  focused on sales in new and existing accounts.

What You Will Be Doing

• Understand and uncover business challenges and issues faced by the customer and be able to run a targeted discovery sessions or workshop

• Engage with business users to define, create, and showcase solution prototypes

• Build and present customized demos for customers, trade shows, and webinars

• Confidently present and articulate the business value of the Sigma platform to all levels within an organization

• Deliver product, technical, and security related responses on RFPs/RFIs

• Participate in product, sales, and relevant technology certifications to acquire, maintain, and grow skill sets

• Work as a team player by contributing, learning, and sharing new knowledge

• Be conversant in integration and data migration approaches to facilitate enterprise-type sales cycles

• Manage multiple customer engagements concurrently

• Attain quarterly and annual objectives assigned by management

• Become a Sigma champion and product expert, prospects and customers will look to you for advice and expertise

Qualifications We Need

• Minimum 5 years of business intelligence experience

• Customer relationship skills

• Strong understanding of database concepts

• Cloud data warehouse experience - Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery

• ETL experience - Fivetran, Matillion or traditional ETL

• Excellent organizational skills and ability to multitask in a fast-paced startup environment

• Experience implementing production business intelligence solutions or proof of concepts

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field or equivalent technical & business experience

• 25% Travel

Qualifications We Want (also, skills you’ll learn!)

• Experience at a SaaS company or with cloud architectures

• Experience with data analytics business use cases

• Business consulting

• AI/Apps development experience

• Startup experience

About Sigma

Sigma is a modern analytics & business intelligence (BI) application built for the cloud. Trusted by data-first companies, Sigma provides live access to cloud data warehouses using an intuitive spreadsheet interface—empowering business experts to ask more of their data without writing a single line of code. With the full power of SQL, the cloud, and a familiar interface, business users have the freedom to analyze data in real time without limits. Sigma is self-service analytics as it was meant to be: a single source of truth that eliminates data extracts, simplifies analysis, and drives BI adoption at every level of business. Sigma is closing the gap between data teams and business experts. To learn more about Sigma, visit www.sigmacomputing.com or join the conversation on Twitter @SigmaComputing.

About us:

Sigma is the AI Apps and agentic analytics platform built on the cloud data warehouse. Business and technical teams use Sigma to explore live data, build intelligent applications, and automate critical workflows all without moving data or breaking governance. Sigma supports a spreadsheet interface, SQL, Python, and native AI in a single governed workspace, giving every team the speed to act and IT the control to scale. Sigma is trusted by more than 2,000 customers, including AMD, Duolingo, Colgate-Palmolive, and JPMorgan Chase.

Sigma announced its $80M in Series E financing in May 2026. The round was led by Princeville Capital, with new strategic investors Databricks Ventures, ServiceNow Ventures, and Workday Ventures participating alongside returning investors Altimeter Capital, Avenir Growth Capital, D1 Capital Partners, K5 Global, NewView Capital, Spark Capital, Sutter Hill Ventures, and XN. This milestone follows Sigma reaching $200M in annual recurring revenue in April 2026, with more than 100% year-over-year growth and 1.1 million new active users added in the latest fiscal year.

Come join us!

• Equity

• Generous health benefits

• Flexible time off policy. Take the time off you need!

• Paid bonding time for all new parents

• Traditional and Roth 401k

• Commuter and FSA benefits

We look forward to learning how your experience can enable all of us to grow.

Note: We have an in-office work environment in all our offices in SF, NYC, London and Sydney. All roles have a 25% travel expectation unless explicitly stated otherwise.

Our Privacy Practices

jobs.title: Digital Designer
