jobs.description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

The Design team at Raisin brings together product designers and brand & marketing designers. We are united by a shared belief in respect, creativity, and our purpose to give people financial peace of mind.

As our Digital Brand Designer, you'll join the Brand & Acquisition team. We shape how Raisin looks, moves, and feels across every market we operate in: paid and organic social, our websites, product launches, and campaigns. You'll report to the Head of Brand and Marketing Design and work integrated with the US Marketing team.

Your main focus is conversion: designing and testing the landing pages, web journeys, and creative that turn interest into sign-ups. You'll also support broader marketing initiatives across paid social, web, and email, so Raisin feels consistent across the funnel.

Your Responsibilities

• Conversion-Driven Web Design: Design, test, and optimize high-converting landing pages, reusable UI components, and end-to-end user journeys that elevate the brand and drive growth, while governing overall website design standards and brand alignment.

• Data-Informed Experimentation & Testing: Partner with Marketing to turn hypotheses into A/B and multivariate tests, from concept to shipped variant, and iterate based on the results, using funnel analytics, heatmaps, test results, and customer insights to find friction and decide what to test next.

• Creative Production: Produce static and animated creative, from hero assets to fast, iterative test variations within our brand design.

• Email & CRM: Design email templates and email campaigns with the CRM team, from lifecycle journeys to product launches.

• Templates & Systems: Build and maintain reusable templates, modules, and patterns for web, ads, and email, working with Product Design and the Raisin Design System so marketing and product feel like one brand.

• End-to-End Ownership: Act as a solution-oriented design partner, independently guiding cross-functional stakeholders from problem to execution, taking projects from brief to launch, including prototypes and leveraging AI for implementation-ready tests.

• Stakeholder Management: Present and explain design decisions with confidence, connecting them to the brand, the customer, and the business result.

• Workflow Innovation: Use AI tools across concepting, variant production, prototyping, test-implementation and analysis to work faster and test more, without compromising visual quality or compliance.

Your Profile

• 4+ years in digital, marketing or web design, ideally in-house at a fintech, DTC or fast-growing tech company, or at an agency with performance clients.

• A portfolio that shows strong visual craft across brand, web, landing pages, paid social and email, and that tells the story behind the work: the problem, the hypothesis, what you tested and what changed.

• Proven experience designing for conversion. You have worked with growth or performance teams and know how to balance brand expression with commercial results.

• A data-informed mindset. You are comfortable reading test results and analytics, and you use them to make better design decisions.

• Excellent typography, layout and hierarchy skills, with attention to spacing, rhythm and detail.

• Expert in Figma, including components, auto layout and prototyping. Solid skills in Adobe Creative Suite.

• Practical use of AI in your design process today, for exploration, variant production or prototyping, not only for generating imagery.

• Hands-on ability to build implementation-ready components and code snippets (HTML/CSS) to deploy tests directly with marketing via Optimizely and Bloomreach.

• Speed without sloppiness. You can manage several projects at once in a fast-moving, feedback-rich environment.

• Clear communication in English, written and spoken. You can present and defend your work to stakeholders.

• Working knowledge of HTML/CSS, or experience with AI-assisted coding tools (for example Cursor, v0 or Claude Code).

• Experience with experimentation tools (for example Optimizely) and analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Hotjar or Looker.

jobs.description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About Agoda

Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodations, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting-edge technology that connects travelers with a global network of hotels and holiday properties worldwide, plus flights, activities, and more.

Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our diverse global team fosters a work environment rich in creativity, collaboration, and innovation. Through technology, experimentation, and ownership, we strive to make travel easy and rewarding for everyone.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Content Marketing Manager to help shape and scale our B2B content marketing efforts.

In this role, you will own the development and execution of a content strategy that strengthens brand awareness, establishes thought leadership, communicates our technology and solutions, and supports business growth across the marketing funnel.

You will work closely with senior leaders and cross-functional teams across Marketing, Product, Sales, and Strategy to uncover compelling stories, translate complex business insights into clear narratives, and develop high-impact content for B2B decision-makers.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who combines strong business acumen, exceptional storytelling, and sharp editorial judgment with the ability to turn strategy into execution. You will play a key role in building a scalable B2B content marketing engine.

Key Responsibilities

• Content Strategy & Planning

• Own and execute a comprehensive B2B content strategy aligned with brand positioning, business priorities, go-to-market plans, and the customer journey.

• Define key content themes, editorial priorities, and annual content roadmaps across awareness, consideration, conversion, and customer engagement.

• Identify content opportunities through industry trends, competitive intelligence, customer insights, and business performance data.

• Establish content performance metrics and continuously optimize the strategy based on audience engagement, lead generation, and pipeline contribution.

• Thought Leadership & Content Development

• Develop compelling, insight-led content that establishes our brand and executives as trusted voices in the B2B travel and technology industry.

• Lead the creation of thought leadership articles, industry reports, whitepapers, case studies, customer success stories, blog posts, and executive LinkedIn content.

• Proactively identify and develop compelling stories by working with internal experts, commercial teams, and external partners.

• Translate complex technology, product capabilities, data, and business insights into clear, differentiated narratives tailored to senior B2B audiences.

• Product Storytelling & Sales Enablement

• Partner with Product, Sales, and Strategy teams to articulate compelling value propositions, product differentiation, and customer benefits.

• Develop high-impact sales and marketing assets, including product one-pagers, solution narratives, case studies, website content, and partner-facing presentations.

• Support go-to-market initiatives and product launches with content that drives awareness, consideration, and commercial engagement.

• Ensure content addresses customer pain points and supports business development and sales conversations.

• Executive Communications & Presentations

• Lead the end-to-end development of high-impact executive presentations for industry conferences, flagship events, partner summits, and strategic engagements.

• Partner directly with senior executives to develop compelling storylines, synthesize complex information, and translate strategic priorities into clear, persuasive narratives.

• Coordinate cross-functional inputs, reconcile stakeholder feedback, and deliver executive-ready content under tight timelines.

• Maintain a high standard of storytelling, message clarity, and visual communication in collaboration with creative teams.

• Content Operations & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Manage end-to-end content production, from ideation, research, and briefing to development, stakeholder approvals, and publication.

• Work collaboratively across Product, Sales, Marketing, Strategy, and other teams to align content with business priorities and audience needs.

• Manage external agencies, freelancers, and creative partners, providing clear briefs and actionable editorial feedback.

• Leverage AI tools and scalable content workflows to improve efficiency, quality, and speed of execution while maintaining strong editorial standards.

• Ensure consistency of messaging, tone of voice, and content quality across channels and formats.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• 6–8 years of relevant experience in B2B content marketing, content strategy, or product marketing, preferably within SaaS, technology, platform, or marketplace businesses.

• Strategic content ownership: Proven experience independently developing and executing content strategies, defining editorial priorities, and connecting content initiatives to business objectives.

• Exceptional storytelling and editorial skills: Strong writing, editing, research, and synthesis capabilities, with a portfolio demonstrating high-quality thought leadership, case studies, and B2B marketing content.

• Strong business acumen: Ability to understand complex business models, commercial strategies, product value propositions, and customer needs, and translate them into compelling content.

• Executive communication: Demonstrated experience developing senior executive presentations, translating complex ideas into impactful narratives, and engaging confidently with senior leadership.

• Stakeholder management: Proven ability to influence and collaborate with cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders, navigate competing priorities, and drive projects forward without direct authority.

• Project management and execution: Strong ownership, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple projects independently in a fast-paced environment.

• Data-driven mindset: Ability to use research, customer insights, and performance data to inform content decisions and measure effectiveness.

• AI fluency: Hands-on experience leveraging generative AI tools to accelerate research, content development, editing, and workflow efficiency while maintaining accuracy and originality.

• Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to communicate effectively with global teams and senior business audiences.

Nice to Have

• Experience in travel technology, e-commerce, digital marketplaces, or B2B partnership ecosystems.

• Experience developing content for industry conferences, executive thought leadership programs, or large-scale B2B events.

• Familiarity with SEO, content distribution, CRM, marketing automation, and content performance analytics.

• Experience building content processes and scalable editorial workflows in a growing organization.

Why Join Us?

You will have the opportunity to shape the B2B content strategy, work directly with senior business leaders, and create compelling narratives that bring our technology, solutions, and partnerships to life.

This role offers a unique combination of strategic ownership, creative storytelling, and hands-on execution, with the opportunity to build meaningful content programs that influence brand perception and business growth.

Join us in shaping the future of B2B travel technology.

jobs.title: Senior Designer
jobs.description:
ABOUT ACTAI 

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. 

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

Define how ActAI is seen by the world.

You'll create the visual identity behind our brand across product launches, website, recruiting, social media, presentations, merchandise, and marketing. You'll play a key role in building a global AI brand from the ground up.

 


WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

 - Develop and evolve ActAI's visual identity.

 - Design launch materials, marketing assets, presentations, and social content.

 - Design graphics for our website, recruiting, events, and merchandise.

 - Create and maintain brand guidelines and design templates.

 - Ensure consistency across all visual communications.

 


WHAT YOU WILL NEED

 - Strong portfolio in visual or brand design.

 - Excellent typography, layout, and visual communication skills.

 - High attention to detail.

 - Proficiency with Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.

 - Ability to turn ideas into polished visual assets.

 


HOW WE WORK

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams. We operate with high talent density, fast execution speed, and strong ownership. We care deeply about product quality, clear thinking, and practical execution.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly, operate independently, and make good decisions under ambiguity. Our goal is to build products that are genuinely useful to billions of people globally.

 


INTERVIEW PROCESS

For design roles, we expect candidates to submit a portfolio as part of the application process.

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2 rounds of interviews and a design challenge.

Applications are evaluated by our team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

jobs.description:
Company Overview 

Promise modernizes how government agencies and utilities support people in financial difficulty. We build technology that makes it simple for residents to receive benefits, engage with assistance programs, set up flexible payment plans, and stay on track—while helping agencies increase efficiency, recover revenue, and deliver services with dignity. Our mission is to transform public systems so they work better for everyone, especially the most vulnerable.



Our team includes experts from companies like Palantir, Google, Stripe , and esteemed government leaders. We work hard and believe deeply in what we do. We're looking for excellent people to build innovative, resilient technology.



Backed by over $50 million in funding from top investors – such as Reid Hoffman, Howard Schultz, Michael Seibel, Y Combinator, 8VC, The General Partnership, First Round Capital, Kapor Capital, XYZ Ventures, and Bronze Investments – Promise has been recognized as one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies of 2022,” “Forbes Next Billion-Dollar Startups 2024,” and Y Combinator’s #1 GovTech startup.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Promise is looking for a Platform & Infrastructure Engineer to help shape how we deliver and run software — with automation at the center of everything you do.

You'll build the systems that let us ship faster, smarter, safer, and better. Working closely with our Product and Forward Deployed Engineers, you'll give them the foundation they need to solve real customer problems — so they can stay focused on exactly that.

The through line of this role: fewer humans in the loop for the things that don't need them. That means owning deployments, environment setup, security, on-call triage, policy checks, cost reviews, and compliance evidence — and systematically taking humans out of those flows wherever it makes sense.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

jobs.title: Post Sales Solutions Engineer, US-East
jobs.description:
Please note: applications will close automatically on October 26th at 12:00 am Pacific. You do not need to be in the first 100 applications to be hired at LucidLink. A human will review all applications so please use this time to read the job description in full and craft a thoughtful application. Incomplete submissions or those from popular auto-applier services may be rejected. 

Contacting LucidLink employees or recruiters directly will not improve your odds of being selected for interview. Please help us focus our attention on reviewing resumes and responding to applicants in a timely manner. 




ABOUT THE ROLE: 

The mission of the Post Sales Solutions Engineer is to be the technical partner our customers trust from signature to renewal. In this role, you will get every account onboarded and upgraded cleanly, resolve hard issues before they escalate, and spot renewal risk and expansion opportunity early, so LucidLink customers stay, grow, and become raving fans.

We are advertising this role for hire in either the UK or the East Coast of the United States. Candidates must be willing to support customers across a range of time zones and geographies. 


KEY OBJECTIVES FOR SUCCESS: 

 - Ensure customers are upgraded to the most recent version of LucidLink's products

 - New, assigned customers are taken through an onboarding call within 30 days of signing and verified in internal monitoring tools

 - Own and maintain renewal and expansion tracking for assigned accounts

 - Reduce/minimize avoidable escalations of technical support tickets 


REQUIRED COMPETENCIES FOR THIS ROLE: 

 - APIs, SDKs and integrations - Guides technical customers to the integration approach that actually fits their environment.

 - Distributed storage and cloud architecture - Reasons through metadata vs. data separation, caching, and encryption trade-offs well enough to defend them under scrutiny.

 - Identity and access fluency - Leads conversations on SSO, 2FA, and role-based permissions in practice, not just from a script.

 - Methodical troubleshooting - Diagnoses complex or sensitive technical issues under pressure and knows when, and how, to pull in help before they escalate.

 - Clear technical teaching - Explains technical material equally well to engineers and executives, and adapts pacing and depth live while running training.

 - Relationship ownership - Acts as the trusted technical point of contact on strategic accounts, from routine check-ins to high-stakes escalations.

 - Commercial awareness - Spots renewal risk and expansion potential without being asked and manages their own book of renewals.

 - Migration and continuity planning - Scopes migration and business-continuity plans sized to a customer's infrastructure and risk tolerance.


COMPANY OVERVIEW

LucidLink is the file streaming platform for large-file workflows. We give teams and tools instant access to data in the cloud, so work starts right away, anywhere. No downloads, no syncing, no VPNs. What began as a faster way to open huge media files is now a platform spanning streaming from existing storage, on-site acceleration, web and mobile access, and a developer layer that connects agents to the filespace, all with zero-knowledge security and enterprise governance built in. More than 4,000 companies and 100,000 users in over 150 countries stream more than 100 petabytes with LucidLink, and the Television Academy has recognized us with an Engineering, Science & Technology Emmy Award. Founded in 2016 by storage industry veterans, we are headquartered in San Francisco with an engineering office in Sofia, Bulgaria, and remote employees across North America, Europe and Australia. 

Reasons to join LucidLink:

 - Tackle big challenges: You’ll have the chance to solve complex, high-stakes problems that redefine how teams collaborate globally. By starting with the Media & Entertainment industry and expanding into data-intensive sectors, you’ll gain deep insight into cutting-edge technologies and play a role in shaping the future of global workflows.

 - Values-led culture: Our values don’t just exist on paper—they guide every decision and interaction. You’ll thrive in an environment where integrity, innovation, and empathy are at the core of how we operate, empowering you to grow personally and professionally.

 - Immediate impact: At LucidLink, your work will matter—immediately. You’ll be part of a tight-knit team of 230+ builders working at startup speed, where your ideas and actions will create tangible, exponential results that contribute to our collective success.

 - Comprehensive benefits: We believe in investing in our people. With flexible PTO, a competitive salary, stock options, and full health coverage, you’ll feel supported both professionally and personally while enjoying a strong work-life balance.

At LucidLink, AI fluency is a core professional competency. As part of our interview process, we'll explore how you currently use AI tools in your work and how you think about using them responsibly.

jobs.title: Stock Supervisor - Parental Leave cover
jobs.description:
About TOTEME

TOTEME is a fashion house rooted in Swedish sensibilities, modern aspirations, and the notion of style.

With an appreciation for how pieces are worn in practice, we create emblematic designs with an emphasis on materiality and shape. Archetype pieces are realized in authentic materials, rich textures and graphic silhouettes. Representing a direct and decisive way of dressing, the collections are contextualized in curated edits, visuals, and spaces.

TOTEME was founded in 2014 by Elin Kling and Karl Lindman. From the atelier in Stockholm, we create women’s and men’s collections spanning ready-to-wear, shoes, bags, accessories, and jewelry.

The Role

TOTEME is looking for a full-time Stock Supervisor to join the team at our Melrose Avenue in Los Angeles. The role is a parent leave cover starting as soon as possible, and continuing through May 2027. In this role, you will be responsible for managing back-of-house operations, including stockroom organization and inventory control, while also supporting the store team in delivering an exceptional client experience on the shop floor. You will collaborate closely with the Retail, Buying, Planning, and Client Services teams, and report directly to the Store Manager.

Responsibilities

• Oversee and maintain accurate inventory levels and ensure the stockroom is always organized.
• Receive, process and organize incoming stock.
• Prepare and dispatch outgoing stock, including transfers and returns.
• Support the team in daily store operations and ensure smooth back-of-house functionality.
• Monitor and contribute to achieving Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and business targets.
• Execute and improve workflows to optimize store efficiency, both independently and as part of a team.
• Serve as a point of contact between the store and cross-functional departments.
• Participate in and contribute to TOTEME's social and environmental sustainability strategy.

Your Profile

• Previous experience in stock management, ideally within the luxury sector.
• Able to work a flexible schedule, including evenings and weekends as required.
• Fluent in both spoken and written English.

About You

• Highly organized with a natural ability to create efficient workflows.
• Proactive, results-driven, and detail-oriented.
• Capable of multitasking and resolving challenges with a calm, solution-focused approach.
• Adaptable and open-minded, with a collaborative and positive attitude.

This is a full-time position based at TOTEME's store at Melrose Avenue in Los Angeles starting as soon as possible. This is fixed-term parental leave cover, expected to run through May 2027.

The salary for this role ranges between $22-$25 per hour USD before tax and will be set according to the applicant's profile, skills and previous experience.

TOTEME has teams in Stockholm, London, New York, and Shanghai, as well as retail spaces across Europe, North America, and Asia.

TOTEME has an internal career development and title framework and the job title used in the recruitment ad may differ from the title used internally at TOTEME.

Sustainability is an important part of how we operate at TOTEME. As a certified B Corporation, we are committed to continuously improving our social and environmental impact. We expect all employees to understand our sustainability commitments and contribute to responsible business practices within their respective roles.

Candidates progress through application, screening, interviews or case assessments, followed by final pre-employment checks and a formal offer before joining our team. We anonymize names and personal details in applications during the screening stage to support fair and skills-based hiring.

By applying to this position, I agree with TOTEME’s privacy policy and to be contacted about future job opportunities for up to two years from the submission date. Find out more about our privacy policy here.

jobs.title: Hardware Fleet Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Hardware Fleet Operations Specialist

Location: Aliso Viejo, CA - Hybrid

Contract role: 12 months

As a part of Sony Interactive Entertainment, GDFT is leading the cloud gaming revolution, putting console-quality video games on any device, from TVs to consoles to mobile devices and beyond.

The Hardware Fleet Operations team is a critical component of our support structure that enables GDFT to successfully operate a global footprint at scale. This role focuses on Linux terminal-based troubleshooting beyond documented workflows, investigating recurring issues, managing the hardware lifecycle, and improving documentation and runbooks. You will partner with various engineering groups to transition operational support work to the Hardware Fleet Operations team. The role also includes building lightweight scripts or basic automation to reduce manual effort and enable other support teams to handle repeatable tasks more efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

• Respond to operational support requests in a 24/5 environment, meeting SLAs and prioritizing work across internal customers and cross-functional teams.

• Troubleshoot and support Linux-based hardware systems using terminal-based tools, addressing issues that require investigation beyond existing documentation.

• Identify recurring operational issues and work with engineering teams to stabilize and operationalize support workflows.

• Create, update, and maintain runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and internal documentation based on real-world support findings.

• Develop and maintain lightweight scripts or simple automation to reduce manual tasks and improve operational consistency.

• Support the transition of operational workloads from engineering teams into the Hardware Fleet Operations team.

Who We Are Looking For

• 2-3 years of hands-on experience supporting or troubleshooting Linux-based systems.

• Prior experience in a technical support, operations, or IT service delivery role.

• Comfortable in working primarily in Linux terminal environments.

• Experience following and improving runbooks, documentation, and operational processes.

• Familiarity with ticketing systems such as Jira or ServiceNow in an operations context.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly document issues and solutions for technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

• Linux terminal-based troubleshooting

• Basic scripting or automation (e.g., Bash, Python, or similar)

• IT support fundamentals, including systems and basic networking concepts (Network+ level or equivalent)

jobs.title: Staff+ Software Engineer, VectorDB
jobs.location: New York City, NY | Seattle, WA; San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is looking for a Staff+ Software Engineer to work on the vector search infrastructure behind Claude. Retrieval is how Claude learns about the world. Web search across claude.ai, the API and agentic surfaces, memory across conversations, and the reinforcement learning workloads that train our next models all depend on fast, cheap, high-recall nearest-neighbor search over billions of vectors.

You'll join a small team responsible for the vector database layer that serves Claude's retrieval workloads: its architecture, performance, scalability and cost. This is a foundational role. The team is small, core architectural decisions are still open, and the engineers who join now will shape how the system evolves.

The role sits in our Databases organization and works day to day with the Search Platform team, which owns web search indexing, retrieval and serving, and the Memory & Search team, which owns search and memory inside claude.ai.

We're looking for someone who has built vector or search systems that ran in production, at scale, with real users and a real on-call. You'll be hands-on in the code, and you'll also be the person deciding how the pieces fit together.

Key responsibilities

• Own the core of Anthropic's vector database layer: index structures, storage layout, query execution and the serving layer

• Own production readiness - benchmarking against exact search, capacity planning, onboarding new workloads, and the operational tooling to run it at scale

• Drive the recall, latency and cost trade-offs - quantization, filtered search, index build and refresh strategy, and how compute and storage are separated and scaled

• Scale throughput by an order of magnitude as research and training demand grows, and work out whether the bottleneck is architecture, hardware or engineering bandwidth

• Extend the retrieval stack toward hybrid retrieval - lexical search and fused ranking alongside vector search

• Set the evaluation methodology for the system - recall targets, latency objectives, cost per query, and the regression detection that keeps them honest

• Set technical direction for a growing team - lead design reviews, make architectural decisions others build on, and mentor the engineers joining the effort

• Share the on-call for the systems you own

Minimum qualifications

• Direct experience building a vector database or approximate nearest-neighbor search system that ran in production at scale

• Deep knowledge of ANN index structures (graph-based, clustering-based or disk-resident approaches), vector quantization and filtered search

• Experience with search relevance and ranking

• Strong systems programming skills in a language such as Rust, C++ or Go, including performance-critical and memory-intensive code

• Experience designing and operating large-scale distributed storage or serving systems with strict latency and reliability requirements

• A track record of independently scoping and delivering ambiguous, multi-quarter technical projects

• Strong written and verbal communication, with experience driving alignment across teams with different priorities

• Interest in AI safety and Anthropic's mission

Preferred qualifications

• Experience with object-storage-backed or disaggregated compute and storage database designs

• Experience building or operating full-text search engines (inverted indexes, BM25) or hybrid retrieval systems

• Familiarity with embedding models and the retrieval demands of LLM training and inference

• Experience using GPUs or other accelerators for index build or search

• Prior experience as a technical lead on a database or search infrastructure team

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$320,000—$485,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Account Director
jobs.description:
About Bunkerhill

Our mission is to give American healthcare infinite capacity. We're doing that with our long-horizon AI agent that does clinical, operational, and administrative work across the entire health system. 

We're at eight figures in revenue, growing 8x year over year. We work with two dozen health systems, and our contracts are typically multimillion-dollar. We've raised $55M from Khosla, Sequoia and Y Combinator. 

Health systems have spent the last several years piloting point solutions for every problem. Each new solution requires a long procurement cycle, is expensive, and ends up existing in a silo. We're the first platform that can attack every problem - 6-8 weeks per new use case.

Our work has real human impact - catching the patients who slip through the cracks, solving access issues, and making sure clinicians can focus on the care that matters.

The role

We're hiring our first Strategic Account Directors - the people who'll build how Bunkerhill sells.

You'll own a book of some of the largest health systems in the country and drive each deal to signature: the strategy, the buying process and the close. You'll work closely with our VP of GTM, co-founder and CEO, Chief Clinical Officer and forward deployed engineering team, who build custom demos and deploy alongside customers.

This is as strategic as enterprise selling gets. Every deal is a top-down, multi-use-case platform sale with a true land and expand - one of our customers is stepping up from $2M to $8M a year. There's no playbook to inherit. You'll write it, and set the bar for everyone who joins after you.

What you'll do

 - Own your book. Decide where to focus, who to reach and how to get in the door - through intros, advisors, events and our network.

 - Run the deal. Lead discovery and the key meetings with use-case owners and service-line leaders, partner closely with our co-founder and CEO on executive conversations, and turn interest into a real buying process.

 - Stay in the driver's seat. Work with customers and our forward deployed team to land on the use cases that will win the account - and push back when a customer is heading somewhere that won't.

jobs.title: VP of Finance
jobs.description:
About Teleport

Don't wait for the future of infrastructure. Be part of it.

Teleport is the AI Infrastructure Identity Company. We're solving one of the hardest problems in security: giving every human, machine, workload, and AI agent a cryptographically secured identity, improving engineering velocity while maintaining security. We make trusted computing simple. This gives you the freedom, power, and autonomy to build and innovate with confidence.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we work with companies like Nasdaq, DoorDash, and Elastic to secure infrastructure for an AI world.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Reporting to the COO, the VP of Finance will serve as the senior financial executive responsible for the full spectrum of corporate finance, including FP&A, accounting, strategic planning, board reporting, and IPO-readiness. You will manage a high-performing finance team, build the systems and processes that support a scaling infrastructure as a service business, and act as a trusted advisor to leaders across the organization.

This is a high-ownership role for a builder who is equally comfortable in the boardroom and in the details. A successful hire will be able to turn complex business data into clear strategic guidance and scale a lean finance function without losing rigor by leveraging the latest technology available.

There is not currently a CFO in place, so there is also potential room for growth into that role for high performers.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Financial Planning & Strategy

 - Serve as a strategic thought partner to the COO and CEO — bringing a financial lens to company-level decisions on market positioning, competitive strategy, pricing, geographic expansion, and capital allocation

 - Co-own the company’s long-range strategic plan alongside executive leadership, shaping not just the financial expression of strategy but the strategy itself

 - Identify the financial and operational levers that drive sustainable growth, and advocate for resource allocation decisions that reflect Teleport’s most important strategic bets

 - Own the annual planning and quarterly forecasting cycles, delivering accurate, driver-based financial models across revenue, cost, and headcount

 - Lead scenario analysis and sensitivity modeling to pressure-test strategic options and support key investment decisions

 - Translate financial data into clear, actionable insights for the COO, CEO, and Board of Directors by connecting day-to-day performance to long-term strategic goals

Accounting & Controls

 - Oversee all accounting operations including monthly close, revenue recognition (ASC 606), and financial statement preparation

 - Maintain and strengthen internal controls, ensuring compliance with US GAAP and audit readiness

 - Manage relationships with external auditors and tax advisors

Board & Investor Reporting

 - Prepare board-level financial packages, investor updates, and management reporting with clarity and precision

 - Support fundraising, debt financing, and M&A diligence processes as needed

 - Develop the financial narrative for investors and analysts, underpinned by robust SaaS metrics

Business Partnering

 - Partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and People leaders to drive financial accountability across the business

 - Own financial metrics and provide regular performance analyses

 - Support revenue operations, pricing strategy, and go-to-market financial planning

Team & Systems Leadership

 - Lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing finance team including FP&A, accounting, and revenue operations

 - Drive the selection, implementation, and optimization of financial systems and tools (ERP, FP&A platforms, billing infrastructure)

 - Build scalable, automated financial processes that support rapid growth and eventual public-company readiness

 - Champion and model the use of AI and modern technology tools — actively embedding automation, AI-assisted analysis, and intelligent workflows into finance operations to move faster, reduce manual work, and raise the quality of output

 - Set the standard for technology fluency on the finance team: encourage experimentation with tools like Claude and other AI systems for modeling, reporting, and documentation, and create space for the team to share what works




WORKING AT TELEPORT IN THE AGE OF MODERN TECHNOLOGY

At Teleport, using the best available tools and systems isn’t a nice-to-have — it’s part of how we work. We expect every Teleporter to actively adopt modern technology to do their job better: move faster, think harder, and produce work they’re proud of. That means embracing automation, better documentation systems, analytics, and tools like Claude regularly, bringing technology into your problem-solving, and sharing what works with your team.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 18+ years of progressive financial leadership experience, with significant time as VP of Finance, CFO, or equivalent senior finance executive

 - Proven record of success at a high-growth B2B Cybersecurity, SaaS or infrastructure technology company in Series D/E/F stages with over $200mln in ARR

 - Strong command of GAAP accounting, SaaS financial metrics, financial controls, and audit processes

 - Demonstrated experience supporting a company through key inflection points — Series C+, late-stage private, or IPO preparation

 - Outstanding communication skills — able to present complex financial matters to executive teams, boards, and investors with confidence and clarity

 - Proven ability to build and lead high-performing, geographically distributed finance teams

 - Hands-on experience evaluating, selecting, and scaling financial systems (NetSuite, Workday, Adaptive Insights, or comparable platforms)

 - Collaborative, data-driven decision-maker who thrives in a fast-moving, distributed environment

 - Ability to be in-person in our HQ in Oakland, CA, a few times a week for in-person collaboration with the executive team.




NICE TO HAVE

 - CPA, CFA, or MBA from a leading program

 - Experience taking a company through late stage private funding stages and IPO

 - Open-source or developer-tools experience.





Why Teleport

You're joining a company where the problem is real, the team is small, and your work shows up directly in the product. We're not a big company, you won't get lost in a crowd. You'll have the freedom and autonomy to do what you're great at, alongside teammates who care about doing it right and want to see you succeed. The work is collaborative, there's real room to grow, and the mission is one worth showing up for.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we're genuinely passionate about what we're building.



The Benefits

At Teleport, we believe your career is more important than a list of perks. That's why we focus on making your day-to-day the best it can be — giving you the autonomy, access, and support to do the best work of your career.

- Extensive health coverage

- Annual expense budget

- Rest and recovery policies that maximize your ability to recharge

- Investment in your future with retirement savings plans

- Professional development opportunities

QA REVIEWER, DATA ANNOTATION


ABOUT MIND:

Mind Robotics is building Physical AI for real-world industrial deployment, starting with the factory floor. We believe the hardest problems in AI are solved when researchers and engineers are hands-on with the physical world every day - and we're looking for people who are passionate about robotics, value ownership, and are excited to tackle difficult problems. ABOUT THE TEAM AND THE ROLE:

We are looking for a QA Reviewer & Calibration Lead to ensure our data annotation pipeline operates at high throughput without sacrificing quality. In this role, you will be the backbone of quality control for our continuous data flywheel. You will lead regular alignment sessions, identify systematic labeling inconsistencies, and work hands-on with internal reviewers and partner teams to resolve ambiguous edge cases.



Responsibilities:

 - Run calibration sessions: Lead weekly alignment meetings with internal reviewers and vendor partners to ensure everyone grades and labels data with high consistency.

 - Track and fix quality issues: Spot common reviewer errors, conduct root-cause analysis on labeling discrepancies, and build feedback loops to eliminate systemic mistakes.

 - Update guidelines and documentation: Keep labeling instructions, edge-case taxonomies, and SOPs clear, crisp, and up-to-date as project requirements evolve.

 - Monitor quality metrics: Track quality scores, accuracy rates, and inter-annotator agreement metrics across dashboards to ensure production targets are met.

 - Provide feedback and guidance: Deliver direct feedback and targeted training to reviewers navigating complex guidelines or multi-sensor data edge cases.



 - Coordinate cross-functionally: Work closely with technical leads, operations, and annotation teams to resolve taxonomy questions quickly and keep the data flywheel moving smoothly.




REQUIREMENTS:

 - 2–4 years of experience in quality assurance, data annotation QA, or data review in high-velocity tech or AI environments.

 - Meticulous attention to detail: A sharp eye for subtle edge cases and a practical, logical approach to resolving ambiguous data scenarios.

 - Clear communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex labeling rules clearly and facilitate alignment discussions.

 - Data fluency: Comfortable navigating dashboards, spreadsheets, and basic reports to track accuracy metrics and spot trends.

 - Collaborative mindset: A proactive, team-oriented attitude focused on coaching reviewers and continually driving quality across the organization.

jobs.title: Lead Quality Systems Engineer - Maritime
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Maritime Division operates across multiple sites and business lines, producing advanced undersea systems for national defense. As the division scales from a single-product facility to a multi-site, multi-business-line operation, maintaining a unified and audit-ready quality management system is critical. This role sits within the Corporate Quality organization but is fully dedicated to the Maritime Division, serving as the connective tissue that keeps quality systems aligned across every site, product line, and certification boundary.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Lead Quality Systems Engineer, Maritime to join our team and own the end-to-end AS9100 quality management system across the Maritime Division. In the near term, you will support ongoing AS9100 certification and surveillance activities. Looking ahead, your primary mission is solving a much harder problem: as new product lines and manufacturing sites come online, the AS9100 certification scope expands to cover multiple sites, multiple product lines, and multiple business lines operating under shared facilities. You will be responsible for designing and maintaining a QMS architecture that keeps all of these threads audit-ready, ensuring that growth in one area does not create certification risk in another. This role requires deep expertise in AS9100 and aerospace quality systems, experience managing multi-site certification scopes, and the ability to work across organizational boundaries. If you are someone who can see the big picture of a quality system while managing the granular documentation and process discipline required to pass rigorous third-party audits, this role is for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• AS9100 Certification Ownership: Own the Maritime Division's AS9100 QMS, including all documentation, internal audit programs, corrective action tracking, and management review processes. Ensure the system remains audit-ready at all times across all sites.

• Multi-Site QMS Architecture: Design and implement a quality management system structure that accommodates multiple manufacturing sites operating under a single or coordinated AS9100 certification scope. Address the complexity that arises when product lines span multiple facilities and when multiple business lines share a single site.

• Audit Preparation and Liaison: Serve as the primary point of contact for third-party certification body audits, customer audits, and regulatory reviews. Manage audit schedules, coordinate site readiness, and ensure findings are closed on time. Guide the organization through the evolution from a single-site audit scope to a multi-site, multi-product scope.

• Cross-Site Process Harmonization: Establish standardized quality processes, procedures, and documentation practices that work across all division manufacturing sites. Ensure that shared processes meet AS9100 requirements regardless of which site or business line is being audited, while allowing for site-specific procedures where necessary.

• Risk and Gap Analysis: Continuously assess QMS gaps and certification risks as new product lines and sites are brought online. Proactively identify where the expansion of audit scope creates exposure and develop mitigation plans before issues surface in formal audits.

• Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA): Own the division-wide CAPA process. Track nonconformances, drive root cause analysis, and ensure corrective actions are implemented and verified across all sites. Monitor trends to identify systemic issues before they become repeat audit findings.

• Training and Culture: Build quality awareness across the Maritime Division. Develop and deliver training programs that ensure personnel at all sites understand AS9100 requirements, their role in maintaining certification, and the implications of nonconformance in a multi-site environment.

• Stakeholder Coordination: Work across Corporate Quality, site leadership, production teams, and business line leads to ensure QMS requirements are integrated into operational planning. Participate in site battle rhythm meetings and provide regular quality status updates to division leadership.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 5+ years of experience in quality management within aerospace, defense, or government-contract manufacturing

• Direct experience managing or significantly contributing to AS9100 certification and surveillance audits

• Demonstrated experience with multi-site or multi-scope quality management systems

• Strong knowledge of CAPA processes, internal auditing, and management review requirements under AS9100

• Effective communicator who can work across organizational boundaries and present to leadership

• Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• AS9100 Lead Auditor certification (e.g., through Exemplar Global, RABQSA, or equivalent)

• Experience in a scaling or startup manufacturing environment where QMS processes were being built or significantly expanded

• Familiarity with other aerospace/defense quality standards (e.g., AS13100, NADCAP, ISO 9001, ITAR/EAR compliance as it relates to quality documentation)

• Experience managing AS9100 scope expansions, including adding new sites or product lines to an existing certificate

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field

• Experience with ERP/MES systems and their integration with quality management processes

• Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement certification or experience

US Salary Range

$129,000—$171,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

jobs.description:
About Snorkel

Snorkel AI is the frontier AI data lab, helping teams build the data and environments behind high-performing frontier and agentic AI. We combine technology with research-driven AI data development to create datasets, benchmarks, evals, and custom solutions for real-world AI systems. Founded out of the Stanford AI Lab in 2019, Snorkel works with leading AI labs and enterprises to move from better data to better outcomes.

Excited to help us redefine how AI is built? Apply to be the newest Snorkeler!

About the Role

This team brings our DaaS (Data-as-a-Service) platform to government and regulated enterprise customers. You’ll lead the engineering team that takes the services behind DaaS and makes them run securely in regulated, high-assurance infrastructure, without forking the product. The goal is to keep the same capabilities we use today for generating data, evals, and benchmarks, now built to meet the security, auditability, and compliance demands of regulated data and the subject-matter experts who work with it.

This is a zero-to-one role. You’ll start by understanding the technical requirements of our regulated customers in depth. Then you’ll work with your team and our platform team to make the architecture changes, move services, and deploy into regulated environments end to end. Your team won’t be building data. You’ll build the infrastructure and deployment foundation that makes these environments possible, and you’ll partner closely with our Applied AI team, who work directly with customers to develop data and evals, so they can deploy and deliver inside them.

You’ll make autonomous technical, execution, and people decisions, and you’ll know the systems well enough to challenge designs and propose better ones alongside your technical leadership team.

Main Responsibilities

• Lead a team of engineers through a zero-to-one build: define the technical requirements of regulated customers, make the architecture changes needed, and deploy and operate our services in regulated environments end to end

• Partner with the platform team to decide where we adapt for regulated infrastructure and where we stay identical to our commercial platform, so one product keeps moving forward across every environment

• Build repeatable environment provisioning: infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD that promote releases from our commercial environments into regulated ones, with security scanning and change control built into the workflow

• Partner with Security, Compliance, Product, and Applied AI to turn requirements (FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, CMMC, and customer-specific) into engineering work, with design decisions documented and audit-ready by default

• Own operational outcomes for regulated environments: continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, incident response, and the evidence trail behind them

• Work through the gaps between commercial and regulated infrastructure, and design alternatives where services or capabilities differ

• Drive hiring in hypergrowth: build a strong bench and keep the bar high as the team scales

• Coach and develop engineers and tech leads into owners who see problems beyond their own projects

• Set clear priorities, plans, and delivery commitments, and rebalance quickly as company needs shift

• Establish engineering standards for design reviews, testing, observability, and root cause analysis

What We're Looking For

• 6+ years of experience in software engineering, with strong hands-on technical depth

• 2+ years in an engineering management role, leading a team of engineers

• 2+ years experience hands-on experience deploying into government or other regulated cloud environments with isolated, air-gapped, or otherwise restricted networks

• Experience designing, building, and operating scaled systems in production in the cloud, including infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, and containerized services

• Deep technical fluency: you can go deep in architecture and design reviews and propose meaningful changes, not just manage from a distance

• Experience with security-sensitive or regulated environment compliance (FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, CMMC, SOC 2, HIPAA, or similar). You don’t need to be a compliance expert, but you value rigorous, documented, auditable engineering

• Experience hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers, ideally through rapid growth

New York; San Francisco Bay Area; Remote - US

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Streaming Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

Airbnb's Data Infrastructure organization builds the systems that store, move, and transform data across the company. Our Data Movement & Transformation (DMT) group is building a single, unified platform for moving data between Airbnb's storage systems, replacing dozens of one-off tools with one reliable, well-supported way to get data where it needs to go. This platform is the foundation for Data as a Service, a top-level infrastructure initiative at Airbnb.

The Community You Will Join:

The Ingestion team is the front door to DMT. We build and operate two managed, multi-tenant platforms that move data out of Airbnb's online databases for offline processing:

• SpinalTap: near real-time change data capture (CDC) streaming to Kafka for every Aurora and UDS table at Airbnb.

• DBExports: periodic full-table snapshots and mutation exports.

Teams across Airbnb depend on these systems, including payments, fraud detection, financial reporting, search, messaging, notifications, and machine learning. Reliability, performance, and scale are the product. You'll work closely with DMT's other teams, which own real-time streaming infrastructure, pipeline orchestration, and schema management, and you'll have the chance to work across the broader platform

The Difference You Will Make:

• Be hands-on (code, design, test) and work with partner teams, internal customers, and leadership to deliver multi-month projects on time.

• Design, build, and operate large-scale CDC and batch export systems that run across every online database at Airbnb.

• Help shape the architecture of DMT's unified data movement platform while it's being built.

• Improve the reliability, performance, and efficiency of systems that critical business functions depend on.

• Make it easier for engineers at Airbnb to get their data into offline systems without needing to be database or pipeline experts.

• Take part in on-call and raise the operational bar for a platform that other teams build on.

Your Expertise:

• 5+ years of experience building and operating large-scale backend distributed systems, such as data ingestion, streaming, CDC, storage, or data platforms.

• Hands-on experience with streaming systems like Kafka, and with how databases capture and publish changes (binlogs, Debezium, or similar).

• Ability to own and go deep in a complex codebase.

• Experience maintaining, analyzing, and debugging production systems at scale.

• Clean, readable, testable, and maintainable code.

• Strong collaboration and communication skills in a remote-working environment.

• Strong ownership and a track record of delivering on time.

Nice to Have:

• Experience building managed or multi-tenant platforms used by other engineering teams.

• Familiarity with MySQL/Aurora, schema evolution, or large-scale batch data processing.

Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Location: Sydney, Australia

The Services Sales Manager (SSM) is a dynamic sales professional, passionate about technology evangelism and developing custom services solutions to drive business growth. This role owns sizing the service component of a Cloudflare opportunity. The SSM takes the technical solution and the customer requirements to deliver a Professional Services commercial proposition presenting customers with a clear line of sight from the solution to measurable business value, and giving sales teams the technical credibility to close.

A core objective of the SSM is to grow the Cloudflare professional services business. This involves direct engagement with customers to define the specific service requirements needed to maximize the value of their technology investment and achieve their desired technical and business outcomes.

The SSM works in a fast-paced environment and is instrumental in enabling Cloudflare customers to securely achieve their goals. This is accomplished by creating and proposing  a comprehensive services wrapper tailored to meet each customer's unique needs.

The SSM maintains close working relationships across the organisation, partnering directly with the Account Teams, Specialist Sales, as well as establishing strong connections with Delivery teams, Global Delivery Practices, and other subject matter experts within Cloudflare Professional Services.

The successful candidate will recommend the appropriate blend of Cloudflare services to assist customers in planning and executing large-scale transformations, ensuring they leverage maximum value from the portfolio.

Your Impact

• Collaborate with sales teams to clearly define Cloudflare's differentiated approach to Go-to-Market (GTM) services. Showcase our delivery capabilities, IP, and expertise through compelling success stories that demonstrate how we solve customer needs.

• Gathering, understanding and defining customer specific requirements and expectations for value based outcomes in workshop based scenarios

• Collaborating with Sales, Delivery and Global Practices to construct solution proposals and Statements of Work to satisfy customer specific scope requirements and outcome based services.

• Collaborating with the Sales team to drive business growth for Cloudflare Services in your aligned territory.

Your Experience

• Proven track record in service sales preferably with delivery experience, working within an IT or Cyber Security services organization

• Self–motivated and detail–oriented

• Strong written, verbal and presentation skills

• Demonstrated experience in discovery/scope definition workshops with cross–functional internal and customer resources to prepare current state/future state roadmaps and services proposals.

• Experience of working across multiple regions.

• Cybersecurity experience preferred.

• Experience and familiarity with using SFDC or similar CRM tools

• Cloudflare Platform experience will be an extra asset

The Team

Our sales team members work hand-in-hand with large organisations around the world to keep their digital environments protected. We educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients in their journey to security.

As part of our sales team, you are empowered with systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won't find someone at Cloudflare that isn't committed to your success - with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development.

As a member of our sales team, you are motivated by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

jobs.description:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

Every Zipline market grows differently. Customer behavior, commercial priorities, competition, partnerships, and local opportunities vary from city to city. We're looking for a Marketing Manager to own the strategy that turns those local realities into measurable market growth.

You'll own marketing strategy and performance for the Atlanta market, determining where marketing can have the greatest business impact and aligning the organization around those priorities. Success means driving measurable growth across awareness, customer acquisition, referrals, merchant launches, and overall market performance.

You'll serve as the marketing leader for Atlanta, partnering closely with Commercial, Operations, Community Engagement, Communications, and the broader Marketing organization. While each team owns its area of expertise, you'll define the market strategy, set priorities, and ensure our collective efforts drive measurable business results.

• Own the marketing strategy, priorities, and performance for Atlanta, from launch through ongoing growth.

• Build and execute integrated campaigns across paid and owned channels, lifecycle, partner marketing, community engagement, and local activations.

• Coordinate across Commercial, Operations, Community Engagement, and Marketing to align campaign plans, timing and responsibilities

• Bring customer and market insights back to the broader Marketing team to improve our work in Atlanta and inform future market launches.

• Set clear goals, measure results, and adjust the plan as the market grows.

What You'll Bring

• 6–8 years of experience in integrated marketing, growth marketing, local market marketing, or a related field. Experience in product or partner marketing is a plus.

• Experience building campaigns that bring multiple channels together to drive measurable growth.

• Strong business judgment and the ability to prioritize opportunities based on business impact.

• Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives and aligning stakeholders without direct authority.

• Clear communication skills, including the ability to write creative briefs and work effectively with partners and stakeholders.

• The ability to set campaign goals, assess performance, and use data to recommend where to invest.
