jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Network Observability
jobs.description:
At NetBox Labs, our mission is to make it easier to build and manage complex networks. As a product company, we do that by developing innovative software for network professionals delivered on-premises and in the cloud.



We are seeking a Staff Product Manager to own our Network Observability features and products, reporting to the Director of Product. You will take products from definition through GA and beyond, partnering closely with Engineering, Customer Success, and GTM to build a product operators rely on to understand how their network is behaving.



You like going deep on the protocols, the data, and the edge cases that only show up in production. You can prototype, hold your own with engineering, and act as the subject matter expert. You also know how to turn that depth into clear value for customers and the business.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own NetBox Labs Observability features and products, turning product strategy into a scoped, sequenced roadmap and driving it from definition through GA and iteration across Cloud and Enterprise deployments.

 - Be a subject matter expert in network observability and how telemetry is collected, modelled, and used by operators to detect, troubleshoot, and resolve real problems in production networks.

 - Translate deep technical capability into business value for customers, sales, customer success, and leadership, and equip GTM teams with the positioning, demos, and technical enablement to sell it.

 - Prototype to answer product questions fast and validate ideas with engineering and customers.

 - Engage directly with customers and prospects in discovery, technical pre-sales conversations, and design partner programs.

 - Partner across our Discovery and Assurance teams to ensure Observability, Discovery, and Assurance fit together as coherent platform offerings.

 - Define and own Observability success metrics and use them to drive roadmap decisions.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 7-10+ years of product management leadership in B2B software, including 3+ years on technically complex products such as networking & infrastructure, observability, security, or developer platforms.

 - Product experience in network observability, monitoring, or telemetry.

 - Fluent across observability technologies. SNMP, streaming telemetry (gNMI), flow data (NetFlow, sFlow, IPFIX), OpenTelemetry and clear on the strengths and limits of each.

 - A builder. Comfortable in a codebase, able to script against APIs, stand up a prototype, read a pull request, and hold your own in a room full of engineers.

 - Able to translate deep technical detail into business value, in writing and in the room, for audiences from engineers to executives

 - Strong track record of owning products across the full lifecycle, and the autonomy to run a product line without being managed into it

 - Strong cross-functional influence, with the ability to drive alignment across engineering, CS, and GTM.

 - Comfortable operating in ambiguity and building structure where none exists


BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience with open source products and communities.

 - Familiarity with network automation or source-of-truth tooling.

 - Experience shipping products delivered both on-prem and as SaaS.

 - Exposure to device discovery or inventory ingestion pipelines.


ABOUT NETBOX LABS:

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.




OUR CULTURE AND VALUES: 

 - We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

 - Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win.

 - We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity

 - Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly.



NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About the role

As the Lifecycle Growth Marketing Senior Manager - Onboarding, you will set the global strategy using data to turn new subscribers into active, engaged fans. You’ll design and scale personalized journeys that meet fans where they are—using recommendations, messaging, and contextual experiences to drive immersion, strengthen viewing habits, and build lasting connections with Crunchyroll. Operating at the intersection of Lifecycle Strategy, Analytics, Product, Engineering, User Acquisition, Go-To-Market, SVOD Strategy, Creative, Brand, and Marketing Operations, you will translate high-value actions, viewership, and behavioral patterns into customized experiences. You’ll pair quant-focused analysis with AI and LLM-enabled query workflows to evaluate performance, identify growth opportunities, and recommend precise, scalable optimizations.

In the role of Lifecycle Growth Marketing Senior Manager - Onboarding, you will report to the Director, Lifecycle Growth Marketing - Global VOD.

We are considering applicants for the location of Los Angeles, CA.

Core Areas of Responsibility

Set the Onboarding Agenda

• Define and lead the end-to-end onboarding and early-tenure strategy, using retention from initial sign-up as a primary measure of success and a driver of long-term customer value.

• Create a proactive, signal-based operating model that continuously advances the strategy through quantitative analysis, experimentation, fan insights, and business priorities.

Orchestrate Personalized Fan Journeys.

• Design and scale personalized lifecycle journeys that adapt to each fan’s stage, interests, viewing activity, engagement level, and behavioral patterns.

• Use recommendations, messaging, and contextual experiences to meet fans where they are, drive immersion, deepen content discovery, and strengthen repeat viewing and fandom habits.

• Identify and prioritize high-value actions across fans and subscribers—including viewership and behavioral signals—and translate them into customized experiences that are relevant, timely, and designed to move measurable business outcomes.

Scale Personalization Through Braze & Orchestration

• Own the strategic development of sophisticated journeys in Braze across push, email, SMS, in-app messages, Content Cards, WhatsApp, and MMS.

• Establish operating standards for segmentation, personalization, real-time triggers, orchestration, testing, and quality assurance, partnering with Lifecycle Operations and Automations teams to scale execution with discipline.

Turn Data, AI & LLMs Into Growth Decisions

• Define a rigorous, quant-focused measurement and optimization framework across retention, engagement, viewership, high-value actions, habituality, show diversity, and other business-critical outcomes.

• Partner with Analytics and Data Science to use AI- and LLM-enabled analytics and query tools to explore journey and campaign performance, identify trends and opportunities, validate insights and incrementality, and translate learnings into scalable lifecycle optimization strategies that improve targeting and timing.

Lead End-to-End Growth Initiatives & OKR Delivery

• Own growth initiatives end-to-end—from framing the business problem and opportunity, through strategy, execution, measurement, and iteration.

• Identify and prioritize growth opportunities that increase the speed, quality, and effectiveness of lifecycle execution, helping the organization meet and exceed OKRs.

• Bring a decisive bias for action to ambiguous, cross-functional challenges while maintaining rigor in prioritization, analysis, decision-making, and delivery.

Align Global Strategy Across the Organization

• Lead alignment across Product, Engineering, User Acquisition, Go-To-Market, SVOD Strategy, Creative, Brand, Analytics, Marketing Operations, Content & Programming, and regional teams to deliver a unified subscriber experience.

• Shape global and regional strategies with stakeholders across markets, improving performance through culturally relevant messaging, recommendations, and journey customization.

• Represent lifecycle strategy in matrixed initiatives, connecting customer behavior, business priorities, and execution across the organization with clarity and influence.

Build Capability Through Team & Agency Leadership

• Develop and lead a high-performing early-tenure lifecycle team, creating clarity of ownership, high standards, and a culture of continuous improvement.

• Direct external agency partners supporting design, copy, operations, and QA workflows, with clear expectations for creative quality, operational rigor, and efficiency.

About You

We get excited about candidates, like you, because...

• 8+ years of progressive experience in Lifecycle Marketing, Retention Marketing, Growth Marketing, or a related discipline, with deep exposure to onboarding and early-tenure engagement strategies.

• 5+ years leading and developing globally distributed teams.

• Demonstrated record of using data, experimentation, and customer behavior to improve retention, engagement, viewership, and personalized experiences.

• Deep expertise with Braze or comparable orchestration platforms, including journey design, real-time triggers, segmentation, personalization, and multi-channel execution.

• Highly quantitative and analytical, with the ability to turn behavioral, cohort, viewership, and lifecycle data into strategic direction and rigorous decisions.

• Experience applying AI and LLMs to query performance data, accelerate analysis, surface insights, and deliver actionable optimization recommendations.

• Proven ability to lead complex, end-to-end initiatives; identify business growth opportunities; and deliver against ambitious OKRs in a matrixed organization.

• Executive-level communicator and critical thinker who creates clarity, influences stakeholders, and moves teams from insight to action.

• High-ownership operator with a strong bias for action, sound judgment, and the operating discipline to prioritize effectively, execute with urgency, and learn quickly.

• Experience overseeing multiple global lifecycle programs and external agencies with a focus on creative and operational excellence.

• A genuine interest in anime, entertainment, or fan-focused brands and an ability to build an authentic connection with our content and audience.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.

About the Team

The Lifecycle Marketing team curates personalized journeys that engage, delight, and build long-term loyalty—from onboarding to retention and beyond. Through data-driven insights, we create strategies that connect users to the right experience, at the right time, on the right platform. Whether for our core streaming service or flywheel businesses, our mission is to promote growth, foster a membership mindset, and maximize lifetime value.

Why you will love working at Crunchyroll

In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:

• Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.

• Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self.

• Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance

• Health Saving Account HSA program

• Health care and dependent care FSA

• 401(k) plan, with employer match

• Employer paid commuter benefit

• Support program for new parents

• Pet insurance and some of our offices are pet friendly!

#LifeAtCrunchyroll #LI-Hybrid

The range listed is just one component of Crunchyroll’s Total Rewards offerings for employees. Other rewards may include performance bonuses, employer matched retirement savings, time-off programs, and progressive health benefits and perks.

About our Values

We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value

• Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves.

• Curiosity. We are curious, which is the gateway to empathy, inclusion, and understanding.

• Kaizen. We have a growth mindset committed to constant forward progress.

• Service. We serve our community with humility, enabling joy and belonging for others.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion

Our mission of helping people belong reflects our commitment to diversity & inclusion. It's just the way we do business.

jobs.title: Security Administrative Assistant
jobs.description:
Stratolaunch is a technology accelerator that engineers operationally realistic testing at Mach 5+. Our air-launched, Talon testbeds are reusable, cost-effective platforms that enable routine access to the hypersonic environment. We deliver flight data critical to validating system performance and achieving rapid technology deployment. Together with our customers, we drive innovations that are imperative to advancing national security.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Security Administrative Assistant will report to the Facility Security Officer. The Security Administrative Assistant will assist Stratolaunch guests and remote employees as they visit the site. This role will require superb customer service and a positive attitude.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Monitor visitor access in conjunction with the Facility Security Officer.

• Maintain Master Visitor Control Calendar

• Maintain accurate records within SwipedOn

• Manage Tour Requests

• Receive and verifies guests, vendors, suppliers and coordinates documents for their visits

• Conducts screening programs such as Denied Party Screenings

• Issues and tracks visitor badges, new hire badges and temporary badges

• Conduct daily badge audits and follows-up with any missing badges

• Greet and welcome guests as soon as they arrive. Notifies company personnel of visitor arrival and logs their entry/departure into a visitor control database

• Place maintenance requests as needed

• Assist with shipping items to remote employees, as needed

• Distribute mail

• Perform lobby hosting duties, as needed

• Demonstrate honesty, responsibility, integrity and fulfillment of commitments

• Become familiar with the Access Control System

• Manage Non-Employee Badge Agreements, tracking Temp Hires, Contractors, Long Term Visitors

• Run & Review After Hour Badge Records

• Run monthly badge audits

• Route all corporate phone calls/check voicemails on main line

• Assist the Security Department with tracking Security Education & Training

• Perform additional duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Knowledge, experience, skill, and/or ability

• Daily attendance at our Mojave, CA site

• Knowledge of general office practices, procedures and equipment

• Ability to read, write and comprehend simple instructions, short correspondence, and memos

• Team-oriented individual who can work well and communicate with various people

• Excellent follow-through and attention to detail

• Well organized self-starter who can grasp and complete tasks with little supervision

• Experience interacting with senior level management and prior customer service experience a plus

• Must be able to remain calm, cool, and have a positive attitude under pressure

• Must be physically able to lift or push (on a cart) up to 30 lbs.

• Demonstrate the highest level of integrity and have a commitment to maintain confidentiality

• Demonstrate the willingness to take on more responsibilities and projects as time progresses

Required computer skills

• MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)

Education/experience/certifications

• High school diploma or General Education Degree (GED); and 1 plus years relevant experience, OR equivalent combination of education and experience

• $25.00-$28/hr.

Special remarks regarding work environment

• This position is located in Mojave, CA

• 9/80 schedule, Mon-Fri 7:00am – 4:30pm

• May support Flight Tests as needed

Base salary and leveling are established on a case-by-case basis. We consider several factors to ensure a competitive offer, including your location, educational background, and a comprehensive assessment of the skills and experience demonstrated during your interviews.

Benefits and our location(s):

• Healthcare (medical, dental, vision, prescription drugs)

• Paid Maternity and Parental Leave

• 50% company match per contributed dollar into 401(k) savings plan, up to $11,500

• Tuition reimbursement

This position may involve the operation of company vehicles as part of assigned duties.

Mojave Air & Spaceport is located just outside of Lancaster/Palmdale and is only 95 miles north of Los Angeles.  The area offers both affordability and central access to a variety of California's best attractions and landmarks.

jobs.title: Controller
jobs.description:
About Ossium

Ossium’s mission is to improve the health, vitality, and longevity of human beings through bioengineering. We develop, manufacture, and bank cell therapy products that apply the power of stem cell science to revolutionize treatment for patients with blood, immune, and orthopedic diseases.  At Ossium, we empower our employees, maintain the highest standards of operational excellence, and are a force for good.

About the Job

We are hiring a Controller to lead and strengthen Ossium’s accounting function as we scale. Reporting to our VP, Finance, you’ll lead a small team to start and own our accounting function so that our financial reporting keeps pace with our operations.

This role centers on raising the quality, speed, and reliability of our accounting operations. Responsibilities include leading the month-end close and preparing monthly flux analyses. You'll drive the annual financial statement audit under AICPA standards, managing the auditor relationship and working closely with our technical accounting team on complex areas such as revenue recognition, stock-based compensation, and new transactions. The role also involves strengthening our internal control environment, refining policies and procedures, and supporting accounting for R&D and clinical expense accruals, government grant/contract funding, and equity. Finally, you'll partner with the VP, Finance on budgeting and forecasting and prepare clear written analyses and memos for auditors, leadership, and investors.

Our ideal candidate is a hands-on leader who enjoys both rolling up their sleeves and setting direction. You’re detail-obsessed, energized by improving processes and systems, comfortable coaching a small team, and confident communicating with internal partners and external stakeholders alike.

Required Qualifications

• 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including 3+ years in public accounting and 3+ years in a Controller/Assistant Controller role

• 3+ years of direct people management; hiring, coaching, and developing staff

• Proven track record of owning the full month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close process, including preparing financial statements and flux/variance analyses

• Experience leading financial statement audits end to end; preparing audit schedules, managing PBC requests, and serving as the primary point of contact

• Strong technical knowledge of US GAAP; the ability to research accounting issues and prepare technical memos

• Experience with inventory and cost accounting

• Hands-on experience with Netsuite and Bill.com

• Proven ability to work cross-functionally with internal teams

• Advanced Excel and analytical skills

• Excellent verbal and written communication, including the ability to explain financial results clearly to non-finance stakeholders

• This position is based in our San Francisco office; we maintain a hybrid schedule of Monday through Thursday in the office, with Friday as a remote work day

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in a biotech, pharmaceutical, or FDA-regulated life sciences company

• Experience with cost accounting in a manufacturing, GMP, or lab-processing environment, including standard costing and inventory valuation for biological or perishable products

• Implementation of an inventory module/integration of an inventory management system with NetSuite

• Experience with clinical trial/R&D expense accruals, including CRO & CDMO arrangements

• Experience accounting for government grants or contracts

Key Responsibilities

• Lead, mentor, and develop the accounting team; set priorities/review work; help plan future growth

• Oversee all corporate accounting functions, including AP/AR, revenue, payroll accounting, fixed assets, and financial reporting

• Own the monthly, quarterly, and year-end close; prepare financial statements in accordance with US GAAP within management’s timelines

• Prepare monthly flux analyses and report on variances and trends to the VP, Finance and leadership

• Lead the annual financial statement audit, manage the auditor relationship, and coordinate with our technical accounting team on complex accounting matters

• Partner with Supply Chain and Ops to bring inventory accounting fully into NetSuite

• Design, document, and maintain internal controls to reduce financial risk and ensure the accuracy of company records

• Identify/implement improvements to accounting processes, policies, & procedures

• Work with leaders across Ossium to optimize our accounting and finance systems and scale processes that support business growth

• Manage external relationships for audit, banking, compliance, insurance, and tax

• Prepare polished written documents, such as technical memos, auditor responses, and answers to investor questions

In your first six months some projects you’ll work on include:

• Completing our 2025 financial statement audit

• Planning, kicking off, and completing our 2026 financial statement audit

• Kicking off the project to bring inventory accounting fully into NetSuite

• Getting to know the month-end close and identifying early opportunities to tighten the timeline, improve flux reporting, and strengthen controls

This position has a salary range of $195,000 - $240,000 annually. Ossium Health takes a market-based approach to pay. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on, but not limited to, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, and market conditions. This range may be modified in the future.

Ossium Health provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or any other protected characteristic. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact our People Team at careers@ossiumhealth.com or 650-285-0603. Ossium Health complies with federal and state disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and candidates with disabilities.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Banking
jobs.description:
ABOUT ONEPAY

OnePay is the consumer fintech trusted by millions of Americans to make money better.

Our financial system is broken. High fees, low rates, and too few ways to actually grow your money. We’re fixing it. And we’re moving fast.

We’re an all-in-one financial services platform that brings together banking, high-yield savings, credit cards, point-of-sale lending, investing, and crypto in one place. We also partner with employers, HCM providers, gig platforms, and others to deliver embedded financial services to millions of employees and frontline workers.

We’re backed by Walmart, the world’s largest retailer, and Ribbit Capital, one of fintech’s most respected investors, giving us rare scale, distribution, and the opportunity to build something truly category-defining.

But what really sets OnePay apart is how we move. Our customers don’t have time to wait… and neither do we. This place moves fast, and we’re looking for people who are:

 - Ready to run

 - Hungry and driven by urgency

 - Exceptional at what they do, with low ego

 - Comfortable operating in motion




THE ROLE

As a Software Engineer on the Banking team at OnePay, your work will have a direct impact on how people access, move, and manage their money, driving everything from the design of scalable banking services to the reliability of real-time money movement that help our customers trust us with their finances. You will:

 - Lead technical design and delivery of banking features that scale with our growing customer base and support a seamless mobile experience

 - Set architectural standards and best practices for code quality, performance, security, and reliability across our banking services

 - Own the technical approach to complex challenges at scale, including sensitive financial data and real-time money movement

 - Mentor and grow engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on collaboration on tough problems

 - Partner closely with product, design, risk, and compliance to shape the roadmap and turn it into high-quality, shipped software

 - Create and maintain clear documentation, a must-have for a growing, remote organization


YOU BRING

 - 7+ years of professional experience in backend or full-stack software engineering, including technical leadership of projects or teams

 - Proven success designing, building, and scaling production-grade APIs and distributed systems, ideally in banking, payments, or other regulated financial services

 - Experience with sensitive financial data and money movement systems, such as ledgers, account management, ACH, or card processing

 - Proficiency in Node.js and TypeScript or similar modern backend frameworks, and familiarity with microservices, Kubernetes, and AWS

 - Experience with mobile or user-facing applications, ideally React Native, is a plus

 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a track record of mentoring engineers and driving technical decisions across teams

 - Drive and proactivity - everyone here is a builder and executor




TOOLS WE USE

We use Typescript front to back, with node and NestJS frameworks for server code and React Native for our iOS, Android, and Web clients. We run on a highly distributed cloud-native stack with Kubernetes and AWS, and scale and resiliency are at the heart of everything we build. We also embrace agentic development, so engineers have their choice of a variety of models and agent harnesses, including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and more to fit their workflow. While you don't need experience with our exact stack, familiarity with modern software engineering practices will help you ramp up quickly.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive base salary, stock options, and health benefits from Day 1

 - 401(k) plan with company match

 - Remote-friendly (US), flexible time off (FTO), and opportunities for growth

 - A high-growth, mission-driven, inclusive culture where your work has real impact




STANDARD INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process varies by role. Most candidates go through:

 - AI-assisted initial screen

 - Interview with Talent Partner

 - Technical or Hiring Manager Interview

 - Team Interview

 - Executive Interview

 - Offer!




EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us at talent@onepay.com.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Participant Recruitment Strategy & Transformation
jobs.description:
At Headlands Research, we are dedicated to enhancing clinical trial delivery within our communities. As a leading network of advanced clinical trial sites, we leverage cutting-edge technology and exceptional support services to broaden outreach and participation. Founded in 2018, our rapidly growing company currently operates 20+ sites across the US and Canada, with plans for further expansion.

📍 Location: Remote | 🏥 Site Name: Headlands Research Inc | 🕒 Full-Time |

The Company

At Headlands Research, we are working to improve lives by advancing innovative medical therapies. We are a family of next-generation clinical trial sites integrating technology and high-quality support services to make clinical research accessible to participants. Headlands operates clinical research sites across the U.S. and Canada and continues to grow its network and centralized capabilities.

The Role

The Senior Manager, Participant Recruitment Strategy & Transformation, is responsible for developing and leading enterprise-wide participant recruitment strategies designed to improve enrollment performance, accelerate study timelines, and enhance participant engagement across a multi-site clinical research network.

This role serves as a strategic partner to Clinical Operations, Business Development, Marketing, Feasibility, and Site Leadership teams by translating protocol requirements, operational capacity, and market intelligence into scalable recruitment and enrollment strategies.

The ideal candidate brings strong operational expertise in clinical research, combined with data-driven recruitment planning, participant funnel optimization, forecasting, and cross-functional leadership. This individual will focus heavily on enrollment predictability, participant access, recruitment scalability, and enterprise performance improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Recruitment Strategy & Enrollment Planning

• Develop and implement study-specific participant recruitment strategies across multiple therapeutic areas and research sites.

• Create enrollment forecasting models, recruitment pacing assumptions, and risk mitigation plans to support study startup and ongoing enrollment performance.

• Partner with Feasibility, Clinical Operations, and Business Development teams to support proposal development and enrollment projections.

• Analyze protocol inclusion/exclusion criteria, competitive landscape, and Participant population availability to determine recruitment feasibility and operational risk.

• Identify enrollment barriers and implement strategic interventions to improve recruitment outcomes.

Participant Funnel Optimization

• Analyze network-wide participant recruitment funnel performance from inquiry through enrollment and retention to identify strategic risks, recurring barriers, and cross-functional improvement opportunities.

• Define recruitment business KPI requirements and strategic performance review frameworks in partnership with Systems & Analytics and functional leaders; Systems & Analytics owns technical metric implementation and reporting infrastructure.

• Evaluate trends in lead demand, contact and qualification performance, screening conversion, enrollment velocity, retention, and cost efficiency to refine recruitment forecasts, prioritize strategic interventions, and assess enterprise outcomes.

• Utilize data analytics to improve recruitment efficiency, enrollment predictability, and study-level decision making.

Enterprise Transformation & Program Delivery

• Own cross-functional recruitment transformation roadmaps, project plans, milestones, dependencies, decisions, risks, and delivery status across network initiatives.

• Lead business-side platform rollout planning, including requirements prioritization, operational readiness, workflow validation, user acceptance testing coordination, communications, and adoption measurement.

• Partner with Systems & Analytics on technical solution design and releases; retain business accountability for process definition, readiness, training coordination, and measurable operational adoption.

• Establish standardized study launch recruitment readiness criteria covering lead demand, prescreen workflows, site capacity, referral pathways, participant communications, and internal/vendor handoffs.

• Facilitate cross-functional governance meetings, escalate material delivery risks, and provide executive-level updates on milestones, dependencies, and benefits realization.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with Marketing and Digital Engagement teams to align participant acquisition priorities, audience needs, and lead-quality feedback with study recruitment strategy; Marketing retains campaign execution and spend ownership.

• Collaborate with Site Operations and Recruitment teams to ensure alignment between recruitment strategy and site execution capacity.

• Work closely with investigators and site leadership to optimize local recruitment approaches, referral pathways, and community engagement efforts.

• Lead business requirements, operational readiness, workflow validation, and adoption for participant engagement technologies and recruitment platforms in partnership with Systems & Analytics, which owns technical implementation.

Strategic Innovation & Process Improvement

• Drive development of scalable recruitment infrastructure, workflows, and best practices across the organization.

• Identify opportunities for innovation in decentralized recruitment, digital outreach, participant engagement, segmentation, and predictive analytics.

• Support enterprise initiatives focused on improving participant access, diversity, retention, and study participation experience.

• Lead enterprise-wide recruitment process improvement initiatives focused on standardized workflows, cross-functional handoffs, enrollment predictability, and measurable business impact; functional managers own daily execution.

Leadership & Team Development

• Lead change management with site and central teams by clarifying process ownership, communicating upcoming changes, and coordinating role-based training and reinforcement.

• Coach stakeholders on interpreting recruitment performance, translating data into action plans, and sustaining standardized practices across sites.

• Provide strategic guidance and mentorship on recruitment planning and enterprise improvement initiatives without assuming line management, individual productivity management, or call coaching responsibilities.

• Coordinate role-based training for recruitment strategy, planning, standardized processes, performance interpretation, and change adoption; Contact Center Operations owns recruiter coaching and call-quality training.

• Promote a collaborative, participant-centered culture focused on operational excellence, accountability, and performance improvement.

Role Accountability & Collaboration

jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Strategy & Monetization
jobs.description:
Cyberhaven is building Flow, a unified data security platform spanning Human Data Security, Agentic Data Security, and Data Security Posture Management. Our data lineage technology traces the full lifecycle of enterprise data across endpoints, browsers, SaaS, cloud, and now AI agents. That foundation has made us a leader in DLP and DSPM, and it is the launch pad for the next generation of products we are bringing to market.

We are looking for a Director of Product Management, Strategy & Monetization to own how that platform goes to market. You will own pricing, packaging, positioning, field enablement, and partnerships for the complete product platform, and you will define the go-to-market strategy that wins: the sales plays we run, how we position against every competitor, how analysts understand us, and how the market understands what Cyberhaven is. This is the outbound half of product management, the commercial counterpart to the module product managers who own what we build.

You will report to the Chief Product Officer and work across the company every day: with Sales and Sales Engineering on plays and deals, with Marketing on messaging and analyst relations, with Customer Experience on the installed base, with Finance and Deal Desk on price realization, and with product and engineering leaders on what the roadmap needs to make the strategy true. This is a hands-on, high-visibility role. You will build the models, write the plays, present to the executive team and the board, and be accountable for whether the platform is priced, packaged, and positioned to win.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own platform pricing and packaging. Define the SKU architecture for Flow and its modules: what is in the platform, what is in each module, the tiers, bundles, and add-ons, and the pricing model behind each, from per-endpoint licensing to consumption-based metering for data and AI workloads. Set list prices, discount structures, and approval thresholds, and keep the price book coherent as the product grows.

 - Run the monetization lifecycle. Lead new-customer and installed-base transitions when packaging changes, including migration rules, promotions, and true-up policy. Run quarterly pricing reviews, and partner with Finance and Deal Desk on price realization, discounting, and the deal guidance the field works from.

 - Define the platform go-to-market strategy. Decide which segments, buyers, and use cases we lead with, where the platform is sold as one product and where a module leads, and how land, cross-sell, and expansion fit together. Own the written strategy and the metrics that show whether it is working.

 - Build the sales plays. Design the plays the field runs, from the first-call narrative and discovery questions to demo paths, proof-of-value criteria, objection handling, and the commercial structure of the offer. Pressure-test them in live deals and retire the ones that do not convert.

 - Own competitive positioning. Maintain the competitive point of view across incumbent DLP suites, SSE and endpoint platforms, DSPM specialists, and AI security entrants: battlecards, win/loss analysis, and the positioning that lets a rep win head-to-head. Feed what you learn back into the roadmap.

 - Lead analyst activity. Own Cyberhaven's relationship with Gartner, Forrester, IDC, KuppingerCole, and the independent analysts who shape data security buying: briefings, inquiries, evaluations, and the category narrative we want them to carry. Partner with Marketing on the program and own the product substance.

 - Set market and product positioning. Define what Cyberhaven is, what category we are creating, and how each module fits that story. Own the product positioning hierarchy, platform-level messaging, and the proof points behind it, and keep them consistent across sales decks, the website, analysts, and partners.

 - Enable the field. Own product enablement for Sales, Sales Engineering, and Customer Experience: launch enablement for every pricing, packaging, or positioning change, certification on the plays, and the reference content the field uses day to day. Measure adoption, not attendance.

 - Drive strategic partnerships. Set the partnership strategy for the platform: which alliance, cloud, and channel partners matter to how we go to market, what we sell with each, and how partner-sourced and partner-influenced deals fit the plays. Work with the ecosystem and integrations product manager on what gets built, and own the commercial and positioning side of each partnership.

 - Measure and report. Define the metrics for the function, including price realization, discount depth, new-SKU mix, attach and cross-sell rates, win rate by competitor, and play adoption, and report against them in business reviews and board materials.


WHO YOU ARE

 - 10+ years in product management, product strategy, or product marketing, including at least 3 in cybersecurity, with time in a role that owned pricing and packaging decisions rather than advised on them.

 - You have priced and packaged a multi-product platform: designed the SKU structure, set the list prices and discount rules, and run a packaging transition across an installed base without breaking renewals.

 - You have built sales plays that reps ran, and you can show the before and after on win rate or deal size.

 - You have owned competitive positioning in a crowded market and won deals head-to-head against larger incumbents.

 - You have briefed industry analysts and shaped how a category was defined, ideally in data security, DLP, DSPM, insider risk, or AI security.

 - You are fluent in the financial side of the job: pricing models, elasticity, ARR and ASP mechanics, consumption metering, and the spreadsheet model behind a pricing decision.

 - Technical enough to position the platform credibly with security architects and to tell the difference between a feature gap and a messaging gap.

 - You influence without authority. You can get Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Engineering to adopt a decision they did not make, and you leave executive meetings with a decision rather than a follow-up.

 - An exceptional writer and presenter: strategy documents, plays, battlecards, and board slides that people read and use.

 - You operate with urgency and judgment in a fast-moving environment, and you are comfortable making a pricing call before every input is in hand.

 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; MBA welcome but not required.

Bonus points if you have:

 - Worked as an outbound product manager or product line manager at a security vendor, or in a pricing and monetization role at a platform company.

 - Priced AI or agentic products, including token- or consumption-based models, and worked out how they sit alongside per-seat licensing.

 - Led the go-to-market side of a platform launch that consolidated several products into one.

 - Run, or been a primary contributor to, an analyst evaluation such as a Magic Quadrant, Wave, or MarketScape in a data security category.

Joining Cyberhaven means joining the team building Data Security for the Agentic Enterprise. Traditional tools fall short. Cyberhaven traces the full lifecycle of your data, adapting protection to changing context, so protection moves with the way people actually work, not against it. AI Changed Work. We Protect It.
Backed by $250M from leading investors like Khosla and Redpoint, our team includes leaders who built industry-defining technologies at CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Meta, Google, and more. This role lets you shape the future of data security, working alongside people driven to protect workflows, not just data, for customers who cannot afford to slow down to stay safe.

AI Tools Disclosure: As part of Cyberhaven's hiring process, we use recruiting tools that include AI-powered features to help with tasks like scheduling, note-taking, workflow automation, and other recruiting activities ("AI Tools"). The AI Tools may process information you provide during the application and interview process. When AI-assisted interview note taking is used, candidates are notified in advance and have the option to opt out of the AI-assisted interview note taking.

Cyberhaven is committed to creating a diverse environment and is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

 - Understanding of third-party LLM integrations, model APIs, agent tools, RAG, and AI application architectures.

 - Knowledge of prompt injection, indirect injection, cross-user data leakage, excessive agent permissions, and vendor data disclosure risks.

 - Able to collaborate with Product, Legal, Compliance, Data, and Engineering on practical controls and risk communication.




LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

Define security architecture across BJAK products, applications, cloud platforms, and infrastructure. Partner with Engineering, Product, Cloud, Compliance, and Security to build secure systems and meet regulatory requirements.




WHAT YOU WILL BUILD

 - Define security architecture, patterns, and standards across products, applications, APIs, cloud environments, and integrations.

 - Own architecture implementation and ongoing alignment with SC TRM and BNM RMiT, including control evidence, reviews, remediation, and audit support.

 - Lead threat modeling and security design reviews for new products, major changes, third-party integrations, and critical systems.

 - Design and review IAM, privileged access, network security, encryption, key management, secrets, logging, and threat detection controls.

 - Review web, API, native mobile, AI-enabled, and data processing architectures for security and privacy risks.

 - Guide secure architecture across TypeScript/Node.js, Python, Swift, and Kotlin applications and services on AWS and GCP.

 - Evaluate security technologies, advise engineering leaders, and track remediation of material architecture risks.




WHAT WE LOOK FOR

 - Degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field, or equivalent experience.

 - 5+ years in security engineering, security architecture, or a related security role.

 - Experience implementing and owning SC TRM and BNM RMiT requirements, including control operation, evidence, and audit remediation.

 - Strong knowledge of cloud and application security, IAM, networking, encryption, secure design, and distributed systems.

 - Hands-on familiarity with AWS and GCP and architectures using TypeScript/Node.js, Python, Swift, and Kotlin.

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

jobs.description:
Scale is at the forefront of powering artificial intelligence. We believe that to build exceptional artificial intelligence, you need exceptional human intelligence. Scale operates the largest global platform of knowledge workers that help deliver the human intelligence needed to build artificial intelligence.

Scale is seeking a Contract Manager to support our commercial and public sector teams. In this role, you will help scale (pun intended!) the legal department by working closely with business and legal teams to review, draft, and negotiate agreements. As an essential member of the legal team, you will also help refine workflows, manage processes, and be a critical cross functional partner. We are looking for someone who is excited about developing processes, getting into the weeds in our contract data, and improving efficiency across the legal team.

You will:

• Develop, maintain, and administer government contracts lifecycle management processes and systems.

• Negotiate and administer agreements between Scale and our customers, subcontractors, and vendors ensuring adherence to company policies and government regulations.

• Respond to inquiries from our customers, subcontractors, and vendors.

• Work closely with public sector legal teams to manage and improve our contracting processes, including contract management systems and contracts signature systems

• Guide stakeholders in self-serve contracting processes as well as directly negotiate NDAs, task orders, modifications, prime contracts, vendor agreements, and other agreements

• Partner with cross functional partners to track ongoing obligations post-signature

• Document fulfillment of contract milestones/deliverables, invoices and cash collection.

• Support the business and legal team members on legal review for customer questionnaires, security questionnaires, and a variety of other customer-driven requests.

• Help build and maintain internal processes, resources, and tools to help scale the legal function.

jobs.title: Enterprise Strategic Accounts Manager
jobs.location: Chicago, IL; Madison, WI; Milwaukee, WI
jobs.description:
Natera is seeking an experienced Enterprise Strategic Account Manager (ESAM) to drive strategic partnerships, enterprise-wide integrations, and contracting initiatives across major hospital systems and Integrated Delivery Networks (IDNs).

This highly collaborative role works across Natera's four business units—Women's Health, Organ Health, Oncology, and Rare Disease—to expand access to Natera's innovative testing solutions, optimize clinical workflows, and strengthen long-term customer relationships.

The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker and proven relationship builder who can navigate complex healthcare organizations, engage executive-level stakeholders, and develop solutions that deliver meaningful value for both Natera and its healthcare partners.

TERRITORY: The territory includes Northern Illinois and Wisconsin. Candidates should ideally reside within the Chicago–Milwaukee–Madison geographic triangle, with a strong preference for those based in or near one of these three major metropolitan areas. This central location provides strategic access to the territory and allows for efficient travel throughout the region.

What You'll Do

• Enterprise Strategy & Growth: Develop and execute strategic account plans that expand Natera's presence across hospital systems and IDNs, increase testing adoption, and drive sustainable revenue growth.

• EMR Integration & Contracting: Lead enterprise-level initiatives focused on electronic medical record (EMR) integrations, strategic contracting, and solutions that streamline workflows and expand access to Natera's testing portfolio.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with commercial and operational teams across Women's Health, Organ Health, Oncology, and Rare Disease to align business priorities, remove barriers, and maximize enterprise-wide opportunities.

• Executive Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers, including physician leaders, key opinion leaders (KOLs), medical directors, hospital administrators, laboratory leadership, and IT stakeholders.

• Workflow Optimization: Collaborate with healthcare system leaders to improve testing workflows, enhance operational efficiencies, and support standardized testing processes across the enterprise.

• Strategic Business Planning: Identify growth opportunities, develop account-specific strategies, and coordinate internal resources to achieve organizational objectives.

• Product & Market Expertise: Maintain a comprehensive understanding of Natera's technology, testing solutions, and competitive landscape to effectively represent the organization at the executive level.

• Travel: Travel up to 70% to support customer relationships, strategic initiatives, and internal collaboration.

What You Bring

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required; MBA preferred.

• Minimum of 3 years of physician-facing sales experience in the diagnostic laboratory industry, preferably molecular diagnostics or genetics.

• Minimum of 3 years of successful strategic account management, key account sales, or consultative selling experience, preferably within diagnostics or healthcare.

• Demonstrated success in expanding strategic accounts, developing new markets, launching products, and driving revenue growth.

• Proven track record of sales achievement, with recognition for exceptional performance preferred.

• Experience navigating complex hospital systems and IDNs, including EMR integrations, enterprise contracting, and healthcare system decision-making processes.

• Established ability to influence senior-level stakeholders, manage complex sales cycles, and build collaborative partnerships across multiple departments.

• Strong strategic thinking and business acumen, with the ability to translate enterprise objectives into actionable plans.

• Exceptional relationship management, negotiation, and executive-level communication skills.

• Ability to influence cross-functional teams and navigate complex organizational structures.

• Results-oriented mindset with a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and urgency.

• Excellent organizational, prioritization, and time management skills.

• Highly collaborative, adaptable, and self-motivated, with the ability to work independently in a dynamic environment.

The total on-target earnings (OTE) package includes a competitive base salary and uncapped quarterly commissions. Additional compensation benefits include a car allowance and Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).

The compensation package listed is for 1st year OTE, which are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. On-target earnings (OTE) represent the total potential income an employee can earn by achieving 100% of their performance goals. It combines a base salary with commissions and serves as an estimated figure rather than a guaranteed amount, providing a guideline based on average performance outcomes.

On-target earnings (OTE)

$230,000—$250,000 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents.

Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/

Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes.

We are looking for a fellow who will bring a mix of machine-learning and journalism experience to newsroom reporting projects. • Participate in training and social programs designed for the fellowship

• Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world

• No more than five years of full-time, professional experience in journalism and/or machine learning

• Technical proficiency and experience analyzing data, developing applications and conducting research with machine-learning models

• Editorial experience, such as interning in a newsroom or working on a college newspaper

• Engineering skills and experience with APIs, front-end web applications and databases

• Recent experience working with LLMs and other machine-learning models

• Interest in the intersection of journalism and artificial intelligence

• Understanding of ethical considerations surrounding the use of A.I. in journalism

Preferred Qualifications:

• Record of multiple news or opinion journalism internships, or equivalent experience

• Work demonstrating experience applying A.I. to real-world problems

• Experience working with large datasets and cloud computing platforms

jobs.title: Reporting Fellow
jobs.location: New York, NY; San Francisco, CA; Washington, DC
jobs.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for.

Join the 2027 New York Times Fellowship class as a reporter.

The Times is looking for fellows who have strong writing and reporting fundamentals, and who are eager to learn and work with others. The program is an opportunity to stretch your journalistic skills alongside the world’s best editors and reporters. You would be assigned to a news or features department, and directly report to editors on your desk.

Many of your stories may take the form of traditional reported articles. But you could also write live updates and explainers, as well as pieces that put visuals first. You should be eager to participate in these different kinds of storytelling and to engage with readers in a variety of ways.

The most competitive candidates will be those who submit a variety of published clips that show excellence — in breaking news, high-impact news stories, features and/or thoughtful, reported analytical pieces.

These are in-office positions and include regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance. You may be required to work some nights, weekends and holidays as needed.

Responsibilities:

• Deliver a mix of breaking news and enterprise assignments

• Participate in training and social programs designed for the fellowship

• Collaborate with colleagues across the newsroom

• Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world

Basic Qualifications:

• No more than five years of full-time, professional journalism experience, excluding internships

• Can demonstrate clear prose, evocative writing, and original and impactful reporting

Preferred Qualifications:

• Record of multiple news internships or equivalent news experience

To apply, upload a résumé, cover letter and five published clips. Include the full text of your clips, not just the links. The application will prompt you when to upload your materials. Applications that fail to include any of these materials or do not follow these instructions will not be considered.

In your cover letter, briefly indicate what desks you are most interested in working on. While we take note of preferences, we determine assignments based on need and skillset.

You may apply to only one fellowship position per year. For instance, if you apply as a reporter, you should not apply for any other positions in the fellowship. Duplicate applications will be discarded.

You must be authorized to work in the United States. We will not sponsor work visas for the fellowship, but we will consider applicants with valid work authorization or a valid student visa that can be extended with Optional Practical Training.

The application deadline is 5 p.m. Eastern Standard Time on Nov. 20.

The Times Fellowship generates a high level of interest, so we cannot acknowledge the status of applications upon receipt or during the vetting process, which can take eight weeks or more. We cannot accept applications that are mailed or emailed to us. We will contact you for interviews as needed.

Reporting fellows may be placed in one of the following areas of coverage. All fellows, including the International reporting fellow, are based in New York unless otherwise noted:

• Business

• Climate

• Culture

• Express (breaking news and trends)

• International

• Investigations

• Metro

• National (one National fellow will focus on disability issues)

• Obituaries

• Politics

• Science

• Technology (based in San Francisco)

• Washington (based in Washington)

• Well

The Business reporter will serve as the David Carr Fellow in honor of the late David Carr, a groundbreaking voice in journalism and media at The Times who was also a passionate advocate for early-career writers.

The Washington reporter will serve as the David E. Rosenbaum Fellow in honor of the late David E. Rosenbaum, a prize-winning Times reporter known for his illuminating coverage of Washington and politics who was a role model for countless journalists.

The fellowship program will begin on or about June 7, 2027, and end on May 26, 2028, subject to satisfactory performance. There is no guarantee of a full-time position upon completion of the program.
