jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Mission Operations
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Copperhead team is responsible for the product development of high speed small diameter undersea autunomous vehicles to support across critical commercial and defense mission sets. You'll operate in a fast-paced environment where small empowered teams move with urgency to deliver cutting-edge maritime capabilities from concept to deployment in months, not years. We bias toward action, embrace ambiguity, and expect technical program managers to drive execution with minimal bureaucracy — because the mission and the warfighter can't wait.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are in search of our next Technical Program Manager, Mission Operations. This Mission Operations (MOps) TPM is responsible for managing the execution, growth, and success of our customer facing deployments. Working across program, engineering, logistics and support system teams, our Mission Operations TPM will be the key interface for customer relationships and develop, plan, and deploy Anduril products in support of their missions. They work side-by- side with customers and deployment site teams to understand their specific problem sets and then shape Anduril's deployment strategy alongside our engineering teams to fit the mission needs. Because the problems we solve are uniquely challenging, our Mission Operations TPM's naturally gravitate toward finding solutions and are adept at navigating organizational hurdles. They are ultimately responsible for customer and mission success and therefore play a critical role in the shaping and future of Anduril Industries.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Stakeholder Engagement: Build and maintain relationships with internal stakeholders, external clients, and industry partners to gather insights, align objectives, and secure buy-in for strategic initiatives. Act as the primary technical liaison for the client, partnering with the account lead to advocate for their needs within the engineering organization and ensuring their feedback directly influences the requirements generation process. Coordinate the intersection between engineering, logistics and external client sites to ensure successful deployment of vehicle and support equipment for critical customer facing demonstrations.

• Technical Ownership: Drive technical outcomes through meticulous understanding of system performance, managing incident response and after-action, using metrics to derive insights into areas for improvement, quantifying the improvements made through investment in those areas, and maintaining a clear understanding of the state of the system that can be communicated to the customer.

• Strategic Deployment and Execution: Translate strategic business goals into actionable project plans, setting clear milestones, and driving initiatives from conception through to successful completion, ensuring they deliver intended outcomes and add value to the business. Oversee to deployment of system hardware to customer sites.

• Execute Autonomously: Autonomously execute on broad and/or ambiguous requirements from external clients. Demonstrate high ownership on all pieces of work. Become a trusted partner to Anduril’s engineers.

• Enable Cross Team Collaboration: Manage, unblock, and accelerate cross-team projects spanning multiple teams and initiatives. Collaborate closely with other partner teams, such as hardware, product, and test operations as needed.

• Regular travel to support customer sites, ranges, and fleet locations (including OCONUS/shipboard) approximately 20%-50% of the time.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 8+ years of robotics and/or complex system experience, specifically in technical project management and/or systems engineering, or related project management and/or systems engineering experience in a relevant industry.

• Bachelor of Science degree in Systems Engineering or related field and a passion for hardware development.

• Hands on experience working with AUV’s and their deployment/operational use in applicable environments.

• Must be able to translate system test, integration and troubleshooting.

• Understanding of government contract structure and reporting.

• Extremely organized and detail oriented.

• Exceptional communication skills.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Mission-first mindset: urgency matters, good enough today beats perfect next quarter.

• Experience interfacing with DoD/USN customers.

• Experience leading or executing product development of any type of system from TRL 3-8.

• Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance.

US Salary Range

$167,000—$222,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager, AI Observability & Evals Platform (New York, NY)
jobs.description:
ABOUT US



At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.






ABOUT THE TEAM

The LangSmith team owns and builds LangChain's core platform for observability, evaluation, and production reliability of AI systems. From tracing and annotation to run rules, evaluations, and beyond, this team owns LangSmith end-to-end. If you want to define what great AI observability looks like at production scale, this is where that work gets done.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the team building LangSmith, our observability and evaluation platform for LLM applications. You’ll define the technical direction, grow and mentor a world-class engineering team, and partner with product and design to deliver features that help developers build and deploy trustworthy AI systems with confidence.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of engineers, fostering collaboration, ownership, and accountability

 - Strengthen LangChain’s engineering culture through mentorship, high-quality code, and technical excellence

 - Shape long-term technical direction and ensure scalability and reliability of LangSmith AI Observability Platform

 - Partner with product and design teams to define scope, sequence, and success criteria for key initiatives

 - Maintain a high bar for technical excellence while making sure the team moves with urgency and focus

 - Lead by example in writing clean, maintainable, and well-tested code in Go/Python and Typescript

 - Engage directly with customers to understand their needs and translate them into actionable product improvements




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Experience managing or tech-leading teams delivering complex full-stack products

 - Strong technical background in Go/Python and React/Typescript

 - Solid understanding of databases (Postgres, Redis and ClickHouse)

 - Proven ability to design high throughput data-intensive systems

 - Bias towards shipping quickly and learning from customers

 - Strong communication skills—able to collaborate with internal stakeholders and engage directly with customers

 - Bonus: Experience building AI/LLM-powered applications, developer tools, or observability platforms



 - Annual salary range: $200,000- $250,000

Compensation Philosophy:

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks. 

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.




BENEFITS

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

We use advanced physics and AI to model catastrophic risk at the asset level, then automate underwriting and mitigation before loss occurs. Insurance is simply the current delivery mechanism. The real product is a scalable risk engine, our Stand World Model https://frontier.standinsurance.com.

We stay when traditional insurers exit. We model what others approximate. And we build systems that change outcomes, not just prices.

Our leadership team https://www.standinsurance.com/vision includes former successful founders and CEOs from Metromile, PolicyGenius, WePay, and HotelTonight, bringing deep experience in building and scaling high-growth companies.

Background: The property insurance industry is built to price loss after it happens. It relies on coarse proxies, backward-looking data, and manual processes, then accepts damage as unavoidable.

Stand takes a different approach. We simulate how real-world catastrophes affect individual properties, translate that into actionable decisions, and automate the business around it. The result is a platform that can underwrite what others can’t and operate with far less friction.

Role Summary:

As the Applied Science DevOps Lead, you’ll lead the platform sub-team within Applied Science that helps build, deploys, and supports Stand’s flagship physics simulations, digital twins, AI/ML models, and spatial intelligence. You’ll own the technical direction, planning, and execution of critical platform initiatives — ensuring they align with Applied Science and companywide stakeholders, ship on schedule, and deliver measurable outcomes. The role spans production AI training and inference, simulation pipelines, infrastructure and CI/CD reliability, geospatial data processing, annotation and QC systems, and new digital-twin capabilities that support Stand’s expansion into new geographies and perils (e.g., hurricane).

This is a player-coach role, combining direct technical work with the leadership around it: people management, project planning, cross-team coordination, and process. Reporting to the Chief Science Officer, you’ll own key projects yourself while ensuring the broader sub-team operates effectively, grows, and delivers real impact. You’re the person who looks around corners, sees what the business needs, and turns “the business needs X” into “the team builds Y.” You’ll partner closely with Physics Simulation Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, and peril-specific SMEs to keep our simulation, AI, and geospatial pipelines reliable, observable, and scalable.

What You'll Do:

 - Lead the platform sub-team: set priorities, coordinate execution, and unblock the team to deliver on critical software and infrastructure initiatives.

 - Manage and grow the team: run 1:1s and growth conversations, give direct and timely feedback, manage performance, and mentor engineers as the team scales.

 - Design, build, and scale core systems spanning physics simulation, AI, digital twins, computer vision, and spatial intelligence, contributing directly to core components.

 - Own production pipelines: debug, monitor, and resolve issues to improve uptime and reliability.

 - Build and support scalable ML infrastructure: data pipelines, training systems, evaluation frameworks, and production monitoring.

 - Design and operate geospatial pipelines that merge heterogeneous spatial datasets into reproducible, production-grade workflows.

 - Strengthen CI/CD and infrastructure reliability across simulation, digital-twin, and ML pipelines.

 - Drive cross-functional alignment and set direction: coordinate across Applied Science and the business, communicate modeling decisions and tradeoffs, and articulate a multi-year vision for how the team’s work moves the business forward.

Core Skills (Must-Haves):

 - Technical leadership and ownership: managing and leading engineers and complex initiatives, delivering through others as well as hands-on, with strong planning, prioritization, and stakeholder coordination from concept through production.

 - 5+ years building production-grade data, simulation, or modeling pipelines with end-to-end automation, monitoring, and alerting.

 - Strong DevOps ownership: cloud infrastructure, infrastructure-as-code, containerization, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and incident response for systems your team runs.

 - Depth in distributed, data-heavy systems: debugging across APIs, preprocessing, modeling, and downstream consumers; cluster compute (SLURM, Kubernetes) and orchestration (Prefect, Airflow).

 - Business judgment and succinct communication: translate SME needs into platform capabilities and balance research depth, timelines, and impact.

Nice to Haves:

 - Startup or zero-to-one technology development experience.

 - Hands-on data and ML infrastructure: ETL over large heterogeneous datasets, dataset construction, GPU training and inference, evaluation frameworks, and production model monitoring.

 - Breadth across backend, AI pipelines, simulations, and digital twins, even if your background leans toward one area.

 - Experience supporting physics-based or simulation-heavy workflows (e.g., CFD, multiphysics, digital twins) in production, with strong physical-simulation intuition.

 - Knowledge of geospatial, remote-sensing, or Earth-observation datasets and systems.

 - Experience working directly with business or product teams on customer-facing technology.

 - Experience collaborating with MLEs on training pipelines and dataset construction for large-scale models.

Compensation:

The annual base salary range for full-time employees in this position is $240,000 to $295,000 + meaningful Equity Grant.

Compensation decisions are dependent on several factors including, but not limited to, an individual’s qualifications, location where the role is to be performed, internal equity, and alignment with market data.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager, Custom Assay Services (Greater Boston)
jobs.description:
Spear Bio, founded in 2021, is a well-funded and rapidly growing biotech start-up headquartered in Woburn, Massachusetts.  Our proprietary technology, Successive Proximity Extension Amplification Reaction (SPEAR), is a novel wash-free immunoassay platform, offering unprecedented sensitivity. We are dedicated to revolutionizing early disease diagnosis and monitoring by providing scalable, ultrasensitive solutions that deliver unparalleled accuracy in measuring low-abundant biomarkers, enabling clinicians and researchers to improve patient outcomes and advance global health.


SUMMARY:

Spear Bio is seeking a top-performing Business Development Manager to introduce and sell our Custom Assay Services clinical business.  You will promote Spear Bio's value proposition, and support the application and adoption of our best-in-class custom assay solutions in the Life Sciences and IVD markets. This includes:

jobs.title: Executive Assistant, Marketing
jobs.description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

Ōura is seeking a highly organized, proactive Executive Assistant to partner with our Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) and support the effectiveness of the broader Marketing leadership team. The marketing team at Oura leads core marketing function, PR / Comms, Creative, Media but also all Consumer revenue across multiple time zones. Reporting to the Chief of Staff, you will provide high-trust executive support while helping the Marketing organization stay focused, prepared, and coordinated. This is a dynamic role for someone who can see beyond the next meeting without losing sight of today’s details. You will build a forward-looking view of the CMO’s priorities, anticipate what is needed to make important moments successful, and bring structure to shifting requests and timelines. By pairing excellent executive support with thoughtful project coordination, you will help the CMO and Marketing team make the best use of their time and follow through on what matters.

• Location: San Francisco, CA

What You Will Do

• Partner with the CMO and senior leadership team: Manage a complex, fast-moving calendar across internal and external commitments and global time zones. Understand business priorities, protect time for focused work, build in preparation and transition time, and make sound scheduling tradeoffs as priorities shift.

• Stay ahead while keeping the day on track: Maintain a rolling view of the coming weeks, including key meetings, campaign and launch milestones, external engagements, deadlines, and decisions needed. Identify conflicts and dependencies early, then keep immediate logistics and follow-through precise.

• Prepare the executive for important moments: Coordinate meeting logistics and create concise briefs, agendas, presentations, and other materials. Capture decisions and commitments, track follow-ups, and make sure owners and next steps are clear.

• Manage communications with judgment: Triage incoming requests, determine what can be handled independently, draft or coordinate responses, and elevate decisions with concise context and a recommended path forward. Represent the CMO with professionalism and discretion in interactions with employees, executives, agencies, creative partners, and other external stakeholders.

• Support Marketing’s operating rhythm: Coordinate leadership and team meetings, planning sessions, offsites, and other gatherings. Organize agendas and pre-reads, capture actions and decisions, and maintain lightweight systems that make priorities, owners, and deadlines visible.

• Coordinate high-priority Marketing work: Drive Marketing team efficiency by balancing strategic initiatives with day-to-day operational support. You’ll connect cross-functional partners, clear project blockers, and align the team on key campaign, event, and launch milestones—tackling everything from core workflows to planning and executing major team offsites.

• Handle executive logistics end to end: Arrange domestic and international travel, accommodations, ground transportation, itineraries, and expense reporting. Anticipate changes and communicate updates quickly.

• Improve how the office of the CMO works: Build trusted relationships, learn working preferences, clarify expectations, and establish repeatable communication and planning practices. Partner with the Administration team and suggest practical improvements as needs evolve.

• Protect sensitive information: Handle confidential business, people, and marketing information with sound judgment and a high degree of discretion.

Who You Are

• You have 8+ years of experience providing executive-level support to a C-suite or senior executive, ideally in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Experience supporting a Marketing, Brand, Communications, or other externally facing leader is a plus.

• You are exceptionally organized and precise, with a track record of managing complex calendars, travel, meetings, expenses, and competing priorities.

• You are proactive and forward-looking. You identify and anticipate what is coming, notice missing context or potential conflicts, and prepare early—while staying responsive to immediate needs.

• You create clarity when priorities or requests are ambiguous: you ask focused questions, confirm decisions and deadlines, communicate tradeoffs early, and use good judgment rather than relying on assumptions.

• You communicate clearly, directly, and diplomatically in writing and in conversation. You can synthesize information, keep stakeholders informed, and handle sensitive conversations with tact.

• You build strong working relationships through trust, discretion, emotional intelligence, and reliable follow-through. You are confident engaging with people at every level, including senior leaders and external partners.

• You are calm and adaptable when plans change, and can prioritize independently while escalating the right issues at the right time.

• You enjoy making teams more effective through lightweight processes, clear ownership, and thoughtful coordination—not process for its own sake.

• You're comfortable using Google Workspace, AI tools, and emerging technologies to streamline daily operations, improve efficiency, and build practical workflows or tools that enhance executive support while maintaining rigorous standards for data, confidentiality and integrity.

• You are willing and able to travel occasionally, domestically and internationally, to support executive meetings, team events, and offsites.

Benefits

At Ōura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

What we offer:

• Competitive salary and equity packages

• Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources

• An Ōura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends & family

While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. Oura is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Individuals seeking employment at Oura are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure Compute
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Roblox’s data platform processes petabytes of data daily, powering analytics, ML, and product decisions. The Data Platform Compute team owns the compute layer underneath it: the Kubernetes (EKS) clusters where all of Roblox’s Spark workloads run, and the software that lets engineers, analysts, and ML practitioners submit and run that work reliably and cost-effectively.

As a Senior Software Engineer on this team, you will build and operate the systems that sit between our users and the cluster. These include the Spark job submission service, our internal Spark libraries, interactive notebook compute, and cluster lifecycle automation. You’ll have real ownership, you’ll work on problems where the design is not yet settled, and you’ll help decide which technologies Roblox adopts next.

You Will:

• Build and own core compute platform services: Design, build, and operate the software behind Spark job submission, including APIs, scheduling integration, and the libraries users depend on.

• Launch interactive Spark at scale: Deliver Spark Connect to support notebook workflows, including provisioning and managing the EKS compute that backs them, with sensible isolation, resource limits, and cost controls.

• Run a safe, automated cluster fleet: Build fleet management automation for EKS, such as blue-green rollouts that validate new AMIs and Kubernetes versions before they reach production workloads, with minimal disruption to running jobs.

• Make jobs run better without user effort: Develop our auto-tuner, which analyzes Spark history and event logs to recommend or apply job configuration changes that improve performance and reduce cost.

• Own batch scheduling on Kubernetes: Operate and upgrade our YuniKorn-based scheduling, including queue design, quotas, fairness across tenants, and version upgrades.

• Shape what we adopt next: Evaluate emerging technology such as native Spark acceleration (e.g., Apache Comet). Run rigorous benchmarks on real Roblox workloads and make a clear recommendation backed by data.

• Be an owner of reliability and cost: Define SLOs and metrics, build observability, and drive down toil, incidents, and compute spend across a multi-tenant platform.

• Partner across the company: Work with data engineering, ML, analytics, and infrastructure teams to understand their needs, communicate changes, and migrate users to better paths.

You Have:

• 5+ years of experience building and operating production-grade distributed systems or infrastructure platforms.

• Spark on Kubernetes: Hands-on experience running Apache Spark on Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, or self-managed) as a platform, including executor and driver behavior, resource tuning, and troubleshooting failed or slow jobs. We are looking for platform builders, not just Spark users.

• Kubernetes depth: Strong experience operating production Kubernetes clusters at scale, such as upgrades, node lifecycle, autoscaling, and operators or controllers.

• Engineering foundations: Strong proficiency in at least one of Go, Java, Scala, or Clojure, with a track record of writing clean, well-tested, maintainable backend code. Python is a plus, since much of our tuning and analysis tooling uses it.

• Cloud fluency: Experience with AWS (EKS, EC2, IAM, S3) or GCP equivalents, and infrastructure-as-code.

• Operational ownership: Experience taking a system from design through production operation, including on-call, incident response, and observability.

• Technical leadership: Ability to influence design decisions across teams, mentor engineers, and drive alignment on cross-cutting changes.

• B.S. in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

• Bonus Points: Experience with YuniKorn, Volcano, Kueue, or other batch schedulers on Kubernetes. Experience with Spark Connect, Livy, Kyuubi, or other interactive and gateway layers for Spark. Experience with the Spark Operator, Karpenter, Helm, Terraform, or Argo. Experience building tooling that uses Spark event logs or metrics for tuning, cost attribution, or anomaly detection. Experience maintaining internal Spark builds or driving Spark version upgrades. Familiarity with native execution engines (Comet, Gluten, Velox) or JVM performance tuning. Experience migrating workloads from YARN/Hadoop to Kubernetes. Contributions to open-source projects in the data or Kubernetes ecosystem. Experience operating at consumer-internet scale (100M+ users).

The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page.

$243,290—$295,250 USD

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative, GTM Leadership
jobs.description:
ABOUT AGENTIO

Agentio enables marketers to buy creator-led ads as easily and scalably as Meta or Google ads—automating sourcing, pricing, contracting, delivery, and measurement—so work that took months now happens in minutes.

We’re on a mission to transform a $800B digital ad ecosystem by shifting digital ad spend into the hands of creators. That means better outcomes for marketers and enabling creators to live off their work—finally being paid in proportion to the value they create. That shift is accelerating: Unilever’s CEO has said the company will move roughly half of its ad budget into social and creators—Unilever is among the world’s largest advertisers, spending around $9–10B annually. As these dollars move, they need performance-grade pipes; Agentio is how those dollars flow to creators with the speed, control, and measurement marketers expect. We enable brands like Uber, DoorDash, and Bombas to run creator campaigns with the same rigor, control, and accountability as their core performance channels.

Our AI-Native platform enables real-time content understanding at scale, simultaneous reasoning across hundreds of thousands of pieces of content, and intelligent allocation of multi-million dollar budgets. Our models apply more cross-platform performance signal than anyone else in the world, compounding with every campaign through a high-trust marketplace with accelerating network effects. The result is a flywheel: brands get the performance they’ve been chasing, creators get the intelligence and income they deserve, and Agentio becomes the infrastructure powering a generational shift in where media dollars flow.

The market agrees. Agentio has raised $56M at a $340M valuation, including a Series B led by Forerunner that followed our Series A within a calendar year. Backed by Benchmark, Craft, and AlleyCorp. Named to Forbes’ Next Billion Dollar Startups, 2025. Named to Inc.’s Best Places to Work 2026, one of 10 companies nationally recognized in the “On the Rise: 0–4 Years in Business” category.

An $800B market. A once-in-a-generation technology shift. This is the moment. This is the team. Come build something generational with us.

About the Role

You’ll start out reporting directly to our CEO, working alongside our sales leaders, with broader scope as the team grows. This is a rare chance to learn how the best people in a fast-growing company think about winning deals, with a clear path into a seller or broader GTM role.

Our CEO and sales leaders are out in the market constantly: at conferences, on customer and investor trips, in rooms full of potential clients we want to meet with. The relationships they start there are some of the best pipeline we have. But leaders get busy, and we need to build a more systematic way of providing leverage to our CEO and GTM leadership.

This is different from a traditional SDR seat. You aren’t working a queue of leads. Your work follows our leaders: where they’re going, who they met, and what’s next. That means the work is less structured, moves faster, and needs real judgment. You’ll write in their voice, manage their threads, and represent them to senior buyers.

You’ll work directly with our CEO and GTM leaders, report into a sales leader, and eventually partner with our SDR Manager as the team grows. It’s a rare chance to learn how the best people in a fast-growing company think about winning deals, with a clear path into a seller or broader GTM role.

What You’ll Do

 - Take over the outbound inboxes and LinkedIn profiles of our CEO and sales leaders, and run outreach on their behalf in their voice

 - After events: build the follow-up list, draft personalized outreach, and run sequences quickly so every conversation gets continued

 - Before trips: use Sales Navigator and HubSpot to find our target prospects in each city, then book meetings so leaders’ calendars are full when they land

 - Build AI-powered workflows for account research, trigger spotting, drafting, and follow-up, and keep improving them

 - Manage replies, handoffs, and scheduling so no warm conversation goes cold

 - Work with leaders to plan ahead: know their travel and event calendar, and set targets for each one

 - Keep HubSpot clean, and report on what’s working and what isn’t

Key Metrics You’ll Own

 - Meetings booked for leaders ahead of trips and events

 - Share of event contacts followed up with, and how quickly

 - Reply and positive response rates

 - Pipeline sourced and influenced by leadership outreach

 - Quality of accounts and contacts reached

What You Need

 - 1-3 years of experience in sales development, BDR work, or a similar outbound role where you owned outreach and pipeline; or 1-2 years in a sales or trading role at a leading investment bank

 - Demonstrated experience using AI to work faster and smarter (we’ll ask you to show us what you’ve built or how you use it day to day)

 - Excellent writing: clear, concise, and able to capture someone else’s voice

 - Strong judgment and discretion, because you’ll have access to senior leaders’ inboxes and relationships

 - Highly organized, with the discipline to keep dozens of threads moving at once

 - Strong data literacy: you know which numbers matter and can work with AI to get to the answer

 - 4-year degree from a leading university

Nice to Have

 - Experience with Sales Navigator and HubSpot

 - Experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup

 - Experience selling into brands, agencies, or the ad tech and media ecosystem

 - Experience supporting executives or founders, or running outbound on their behalf

About You

 - You’re AI-native in how you work: you reach for AI first, and you’re not waiting for permission or a playbook

 - You’re a builder who would rather create the system than follow one

 - You’re comfortable working directly with executives and holding your own

 - You’re fast and follow through: when an event ends, you’re already moving

 - Nimble, hungry, humble, and adaptive to change

 - A true problem-solver and self-starter, with incredible ambition and drive

 - Competitive and highly motivated to exceed expectations

 - Ready to roll up your sleeves, get things done, and work harder than you’ve likely ever worked before, but with far greater reward

 - A fun, honest, empathetic, and curious teammate

 - You understand that Agentio is building in-person, 5 days a week

What You’ll Get

 - Direct access to our CEO and GTM leadership, and a front-row seat to how a high-growth company wins deals

 - The opportunity to build a first-of-its kind business as an early team-member and make a meaningful impact in the way brands share their stories and creators live off their work

 - A clear path to grow into a seller or broader GTM role as the team scales

 - A crash-course in what it takes to scale a start-up, with first-hand exposure to the different foundational business drivers and needs

 - A collaborative, transparent, and engaging work environment

Benefits & Perks

 - Flexible PTO – Take the time you need to recharge

 - Comprehensive Health Coverage – Top medical plan through Aetna

 - Dental & Vision Plans – Protect your smile and your sight with coverage from Guardian

 - 401(k) Retirement Plan – Invest in your future while you build your career

 - $100 Monthly Lifestyle Credit – Use it to shop with our amazing Agentio Brand Partners

 - Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best

 - Dinner provided Monday - Thursday

 - Fully subsidized gold tier access on Wellhub (Includes LifeTime, Barry’s, Solidcore, Headspace, etc)

 - Gym in the building! – Your workout, right downstairs

Associate Maintenance Manager

Shift- Wednesday -Saturday  5:00pm - 5:30am

jobs.title: Support Engineer
jobs.description:
Who is Boulevard?

Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard.

As a Support Engineer at Boulevard, you’ll own complex technical problems, drive cross-functional initiatives, and become a go-to expert for specific domains across our platform. Escalations are part of the job, but you’ll do more than resolve them. You’re the connective tissue between Support and Engineering, embedded in the development cycle to catch supportability issues before they ship and building internal tools that help Product Support scale without pulling in engineering on every issue.

You’ll share this work with a small team of domain owners and Support Engineering leadership. It’s a great fit if you take initiative, own your work, and enjoy balancing hands-on technical problem solving with bigger-picture impact. We’re large enough to transform the industry and small enough that your work is visible every day, from support efficiency to product quality to long-term customer trust.

What you’ll do here:

• Take on top-tier technical escalations and see them through to resolution.

• Respond to developer support requests for help with our API and developer environment.

• Partner with Support, Success, Onboarding, and Engineering in Slack and weekly meetings to improve customer experiences and product quality.

• Join the development cycle and flag supportability issues before features ship.

• Become the go-to expert for specific domains across our platform.

• Set aside time each week for project work, building tools, scripts, and automations that expand what our CX team can solve for customers.

• Create internal tools that help Product Support scale without pulling in engineering on every issue.

What you’ll need to thrive:

• 4+ years in technical support, solutions engineering, or a customer-facing engineering role at a fast-paced SaaS company.

• Deep working knowledge of SQL, APIs (REST, cURL, Postman), logs, and debugging methods, plus comfort building and maintaining internal tools or scripts in Python, JavaScript, or similar. Strong familiarity with POS systems, payments, or hardware-integrated platforms is highly preferred.

• A track record of owning a technical area or system end to end, including escalations, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration.

• Comfort with sprint planning and engineering rituals, and the ability to turn supportability concerns into actionable input for engineers.

• The ability to spot patterns across incidents, anticipate risk, and drive preventative improvements, with sound judgment on high-impact decisions based on customer impact, risk, and business needs.

• Clear, effective communication that makes complex technical concepts easy to understand for customers, support teams, engineering, and stakeholders at every level, plus a trainer’s mindset to mentor and elevate others.

• A growth mindset and a passion for continuous improvement and building scalable support systems in a fast-growing environment.

• A plus: experience with service tools like Jira, Zendesk, and Intercom; low-code and automation platforms like Retool, Zapier, and n8n; development best practices and frameworks (CI/CD pipelines, agile scrum, git/GitHub); and SaaS software architecture, including back-end and front-end development practices.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field preferred. Equivalent professional experience will be considered.

How we’ll take care of you:

At Boulevard, we work hard to structure compensation in a way that balances internal equity with local market competitiveness, and we're happy to share a good-faith estimate of the base salary range for this role. For candidates in NYC, the SF Bay Area, and Seattle, the anticipated base salary range is $122,000 - $165,000 per year. For all other U.S. locations, the anticipated base salary range is $113,000 - $153,000 per year. In addition to this base compensation, this role may be eligible to participate in a variable compensation program. Final compensation will vary based on a variety of factors which include but are not limited to applicable experience, location, and final leveling.

How we take care of our team

Our business is deeply immersed in an industry that’s centered around helping people feel their best, so we know that taking care of yourself isn’t selfish; it’s essential. That’s why our culture pairs high standards with genuine care. We don't glorify burnout or wear ‘always on’ as a badge of honor. Instead, we’ve created benefits designed to support you inside and outside of work, so you can bring your best self to both.

Here’s how we support you:

• Competitive base pay and performance bonus eligibility because you deserve to be rewarded for your impact.

• Equity participation for all full-time employees because we believe the people helping build Boulevard should share in our long-term success.

• Comprehensive medical coverage with up to 100% employee premium coverage and 75% dependent coverage to help take care of you and your loved ones.

• An annual $1,200 HSA employer contribution for eligible plans to help support healthcare costs and future planning.

• 100% covered dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, ensuring you stay healthy, protected, and ready for whatever life brings.

• 12 weeks of fully paid U.S. parental leave supporting all new parents equally as they take the time to bond, adjust, and be present when welcoming a new family member.

• Flexible paid time off, plus 10 U.S. company holidays, where you are encouraged to rest, recharge, and take the time you need, guilt-free.

• Fully remote with support, including a $200 home office setup allowance and a $50 monthly WFH reimbursement so your workspace is set up for success.

• $200 quarterly Boulevard Bucks to prioritize your well-being and stay connected to the industry we serve.

• And other perks like One Medical membership and Employee Assistant Program.

The Cybersecurity Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining secure enterprise architectures, systems, applications, networks, and cloud environments. This role provides technical leadership in cybersecurity strategy, risk management, security engineering, and compliance initiatives while ensuring Apex's information assets are protected against evolving cyber threats.

• Design for scale and security: Apply role-based access control, data masking, and governance so applications are secure, resilient, and compliant from day one.

• Strong SQL and Python skills, with experience in Snowpark.

• Working knowledge of Snowflake Cortex capabilities, or comparable hands-on experience with LLM-based applications and a clear plan to ramp quickly.

• Familiarity with RAG, semantic search, text-to-SQL, and agentic patterns.

• Solid grasp of data modeling, ELT/ETL, and orchestration (dbt, Airflow, or similar).

Final Interview with VP, AI Applied Solutions

jobs.title: Caregiver
jobs.description:
WelbeHealth PACE helps seniors stay in their homes and communities by providing comprehensive medical care and community-based services. We serve the most vulnerable seniors with better quality and compassion in a value-based model.

The Personal Care Assistant is a vital part of our team, providing aid to our participants as well as contributing to the care planning process as a member of our interdisciplinary team (IDT). Reporting to the Day Center Manager, the Personal Care Assistant will provide safe delivery of personal care services to participants at the WelbeHealth day center.

This role is different because Personal Care Assistants at WelbeHealth:

• Collaborate with different departments within our day centers, building strong connections not only with participants, but with team members as well

• Unlike in a traditional assisted living facility, our Personal Care Assistants have the opportunity to care for seniors in a lively day center where our participants receive full-service care ranging from medical appointments, to rehabilitation services, to playing games and participating in activities

We care about our team members. That’s why we offer:

• Medical insurance coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)

• Work/life balance - We mean it!17 days of personal time off (PTO), 12 holidays observed annually, and 6 sick days

• 401K savings + match

• Comprehensive compensation package including base pay and bonus

• And additional benefits!

On the day-to-day, you will:

• Provide hands-on personal care assistance with activities of daily living (ADLs) to WelbeHealth participants, including but not limited to assisting with escorting, toileting, bathing, dressing, grooming, laundry, and physical lifting when transferring participants

• Measure and document participants’ vital signs as instructed

• Act as a medical escort when needed, assisting participants with boarding and exiting WelbeHealth transportation vehicles

• Oversee activity on the day center floor to assure participant safety

• Assist with meal service, ensuring participants receive the correct meals, as well as assist with feeding when needed

• Maintain personal care supplies such as incontinence supplies and grooming items

Job requirements include:

• High school diploma or equivalent required

• Certification of Home Health Aide (HHA) or Certified Nursing Assistant in California (CNA) preferred

• Minimum of one (1) year of experience providing personal care to seniors

• Must be willing and have the ability to safely drive to and from participant escort assignment locations, including but not limited to medical and care appointments in the program service area.

• CA Food Handlers Certification within 30 days of hire

• Must obtain CPR and First Aid certification within 180 days of hire and maintain certification thereafter; CPR and First Aid certification upon hire preferred

We are seeking Personal Care Assistants that are looking to start their career in the healthcare space. If you’re ready to join a holistic care team that values both its participants and providers, we’d love to hear from you!

Compensation consists of base salary plus bonus. WelbeHealth offers a competitive total rewards package that includes a 401(k) match, comprehensive healthcare coverage, and a broad range of additional benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience and relevant qualifications.

Compensation Offering

In this spirit, please note that we have a vaccination policy for all our employees and proof of vaccination, or a vaccine declination form will be required prior to employment. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Orchestration
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Roblox’s data platform powers analytics, ML, and product decisions for a platform serving 200M+ daily active users. As a Principal Software Engineer in the Data Platform Orchestration team, you will be the technical leader for the system that schedules and runs the company’s data workloads. Our team owns Apache Airflow and the Kubernetes (EKS) infrastructure underneath it, running 8,000+ DAGs every day, most of them Spark jobs. You will set the long-term architecture for how Roblox orchestrates data at scale, and you will be hands-on in making it faster, more reliable, and easier for hundreds of engineers to use.

You Will:

• Define the Orchestration Strategy: Own the multi-year architecture for Airflow and the surrounding platform, including scheduler and executor design, multi-tenancy, upgrades and migrations, and where the platform should evolve next.

• Scale and Harden Airflow: Find and remove scaling limits across the scheduler, metadata database, executors, and DAG parsing. Make sure thousands of daily DAGs run with predictable latency and strong SLAs.

• Own Orchestration on Kubernetes: Lead the design and operation of our EKS clusters for orchestration and Spark workloads, including autoscaling, resource isolation, cost efficiency, and deployment automation.

• Build Platform Tooling for Internal Engineers: Design the APIs, custom operators and providers, libraries, and self-service tooling that let data teams build, deploy, and monitor pipelines safely.

• Drive Observability and Reliability: Establish SLOs, alerting, and diagnostics for pipelines and platform components. Lead incident reviews and fix the root causes in code, not just in runbooks.

• Lead Across Teams: Work with data platform, governance, data science, and product engineering teams to align roadmaps, guide technical decisions, and build consensus on complex initiatives.

• Raise the Engineering Bar: Set standards for code quality, design, and operational readiness. Mentor staff, senior, and mid-level engineers.

You Have:

• B.S. equivalent in CS or sufficient experience.

• 10+ years of experience designing, building, and operating production-grade, large-scale distributed systems.

• Workflow Orchestration Depth: Deep, hands-on experience designing, running, and scaling a production data-related workflow orchestrator or job scheduler (thousands of workflows or DAGs a day). Apache Airflow is ideal, but experience with an equivalent system (Dagster, Prefect, Temporal, or a large in-house scheduler) is also welcome. You understand scheduler and executor design, metadata store performance, task isolation, retries and idempotency, and safe upgrades and migrations.

• Kubernetes Expertise: Proven experience managing and scaling production Kubernetes clusters on AWS (EKS), including Helm, autoscaling (Karpenter or Cluster Autoscaler), and GitOps-style deployment.

• Software Engineering Foundations: Strong proficiency in Python, plus Go or Java, with a record of writing clean, well-tested platform and tooling code. You are a software engineer who builds and improves systems, not someone who mainly handles tickets and operations.

• Data Workload Familiarity: Working knowledge of how Spark jobs run on Kubernetes (Spark on K8s, spark-operator, or EMR on EKS) and how orchestration interacts with them.

• Platform Mindset: Experience building platforms used by other engineers, with strong instincts for APIs, observability, reliability, and developer experience.

• Cross-Organizational Technical Leadership: A track record of influencing direction across a large engineering organization and driving multi-quarter projects from concept to production.

• Extreme Ownership: You define the problem when requirements are unclear, unblock dependencies, and see complex work through to stable production.

• Bonus Points: Contributions to Apache Airflow or related open-source projects (Airflow providers, Helm chart, spark-operator, Karpenter, Argo CD). Experience with other orchestration systems (Dagster, Temporal, Argo Workflows, Flyte) and the judgment to know when each fits. Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code, Prometheus/OpenTelemetry, and cost optimization or chargeback for shared platforms. Experience operating infrastructure at consumer-internet scale.

For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page.

Annual Salary Range

$295,250—$345,040 USD

Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

jobs.title: Sales Development Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT AGENTIO

Agentio enables marketers to buy creator led ads as easily and scalably as Meta or Google ads—automating sourcing, pricing, contracting, delivery, and measurement—so work that took months now happens in minutes.

We're on a mission to transform a $800B digital ad ecosystem by shifting digital ad spend into the hands of creators. That means better outcomes for marketers and enabling creators to live off their work—finally being paid in proportion to the value they create. That shift is accelerating: Unilever's CEO has said the company will move roughly half of its ad budget into social and creators—Unilever is among the world's largest advertisers, spending around $9–10B annually. As these dollars move, they need performance-grade pipes; Agentio is how those dollars flow to creators with the speed, control, and measurement marketers expect. We enable brands like Uber, DoorDash, and Bombas to run creator campaigns with the same rigor, control, and accountability as their core performance channels.

Our AI-Native platform enables real-time content understanding at scale, simultaneous reasoning across hundreds of thousands of pieces of content, and intelligent allocation of multi-million dollar budgets. Our models apply more cross-platform performance signal than anyone else in the world, compounding with every campaign through a high-trust marketplace with accelerating network effects. The result is a flywheel: brands get the performance they've been chasing, creators get the intelligence and income they deserve, and Agentio becomes the infrastructure powering a generational shift in where media dollars flow.

The market agrees. Agentio has raised $56M at a $340M valuation, including a Series B led by Forerunner https://techcrunch.com/2025/11/18/agentio-secures-40-million-from-forerunner-as-it-scales-its-creator-marketplace-beyond-youtube/ that followed our Series A within a calendar year. Backed by Benchmark, Craft, and AlleyCorp. Named to Forbes' Next Billion Dollar Startups, 2025 https://www.forbes.com/sites/amyfeldman/2025/08/12/next-billion-dollar-startups-2025/. Named to Inc.'s Best Places to Work 2026 https://www.inc.com/best-workplaces/2026, one of 10 companies nationally recognized in the "On the Rise: 0–4 Years in Business" category.

An $800B market. A once-in-a-generation technology shift. This is the moment. This is the team. Come build something generational with us.



About the Role

We’re looking for an AI-native SDR Manager to build and lead the outbound engine that fills our pipeline with highly qualified leads. You’ve managed a high-output SDR team before, and you’ve used AI to multiply what that team can do. You have the systems and the results to prove it.

This is not a role for someone who runs a legacy sales development playbook with more headcount and a bigger tool stack. We want someone who has rebuilt the SDR motion around AI: research, personalization, sequencing, qualification, and reporting. Your team should do far more with each rep than a traditional team does.

You’ll own how we find, reach, and qualify the brands and agencies that should be buying creator media. You’ll sit close to sales leadership and the founders, so what you learn in the field shapes our targeting, messaging, and strategy quickly.

This is a hands-on, player-coach role at a company that’s scaling fast. If you love raising the floor and the ceiling of a team at the same time, and you’re always looking for the next lever, this is a great fit.

What You’ll Do

 - Lead, coach, and develop a team of SDRs, running 1:1s, call reviews, and live pipeline inspection

 - Build and scale a cold calling outbound machine, responsible for driving the majority of new leads

 - Build and run an AI-native outbound system: automated research, personalized outreach at scale, intelligent prioritization, and tight handoff to Account Executives

 - Keep testing, measuring, and rolling out new AI workflows, and retire the ones that stop working

 - Teach the team to work with AI as a core skill, not a side tool

 - Set clear activity, quality, and conversion standards, and hold the team to them

 - Hire, onboard, and ramp new SDRs quickly, and build the playbooks that make ramp repeatable

 - Partner with sales leadership, Marketing, and RevOps on ICP definition, lead routing, and pipeline goals

 - Report on team performance and pipeline contribution with clarity and candor

Key Metrics You’ll Own

 - Qualified pipeline generated per SDR

 - Meetings booked and held

 - SDR-sourced opportunity conversion

 - Rep ramp time and quota attainment

 - Team retention and promotion rate

What You Need

 - 6-10 years of total experience in sales or sales development, with at least 1-2 years managing an SDR/BDR team, where cold calling was core to outreach efforts

 - A track record of leading a high-output team and hitting pipeline targets

 - Proof that you’ve built AI-powered systems that dramatically increased your team’s productivity (we’ll ask you to walk us through what you built, what changed, and the numbers)

 - Hands-on fluency with modern AI tools and sales tooling (LLMs, CRM, sequencing, enrichment, automation), and a strong point of view on what works

 - Experience coaching reps on outbound craft: prospecting, messaging, objection handling, and qualification

 - Strong data literacy: you know which metrics matter and can work with AI to get to the answer

Nice to Have

 - Experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup

 - Experience selling into brands, agencies, or the ad tech and media ecosystem

 - Experience building an SDR function from scratch

About You

 - You’re AI-native in how you work: you reach for AI first, and you’re not waiting for permission or a vendor roadmap

 - You’ve moved up quickly, you’re hungry for the next level, and you want to grow into a bigger leadership role as Agentio scales

 - You lead from the front: you can jump on the phone or in the inbox and show the team how it’s done

 - You’re allergic to bureaucracy and big-company process, and you’d rather build the system than inherit one

 - Nimble, hungry, humble, and adaptive to change

 - You get energy from developing people and watching them grow

 - Competitive and highly motivated to exceed expectations

 - Ready to roll up your sleeves, get things done, and work harder than you’ve likely ever worked before, but with far greater reward

 - A fun, honest, empathetic, and curious teammate

 - You understand that Agentio is building in-person, 5 days a week

What You’ll Get

 - The opportunity to build a first-of-its kind business as an early team-member and make a meaningful impact in the way brands share their stories and creators live off their work

 - A real path to grow with the team as it scales, with the potential to take on broader sales development leadership

 - A crash-course in what it takes to scale a start-up, with first-hand exposure to the different foundational business drivers and needs

 - The chance to work with an exceptional team and help build our sales culture

 - A collaborative, transparent, and engaging work environment


BENEFITS & PERKS

 - Flexible PTO – Take the time you need to recharge

 - Comprehensive Health Coverage – Top medical plan through Aetna

 - Dental & Vision Plans – Protect your smile and your sight with coverage from Guardian

 - 401(k) Retirement Plan – Invest in your future while you build your career

 - $100 Monthly Lifestyle Credit – Use it to shop with our amazing Agentio Brand Partners

 - Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best

 - Dinner provided Monday - Thursday

 - Fully subsidized gold tier access on Wellhub (Includes LifeTime, Barry's, Solidcore, Headspace, etc)

 - Gym in the building! – Your workout, right downstairs
   
    

Agentio is an equal-opportunity employer. All aspects of employment will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Manager, Security Operations Center
jobs.description:
What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 5M endpoints and 16M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Reports to: Director, Security Operations Center

Location: Remote US

Compensation: $165,000-$185,000  base plus bonus and equity

What You’ll Do:

The Huntress Security Operations Center is a global team of security analysts dedicated to investigating and responding to incidents on our partners’ networks 24/7, 365 days a year. Daily activities consist of providing investigation, containment, and response actions across millions of endpoints.

This role is accountable for defining and streamlining processes, workflows, and playbooks that enable effective day-to-day operations. As Huntress continues to grow, we are laser-focused on scaling our operations and force-multiplying our human analysts by 10X. This position is responsible for enabling analysts to meet our mission and achieve internal Service Level Objectives for response times. The Security Operations Manager will work with their peer regional managers to ensure consistent global operations while providing our analyst team with training opportunities and career growth.

Responsibilities:

• Design, implement, and enforce internal processes to reduce burnout and increase the productivity of the operations center against a global set of expectations and standards

• Manage and enforce local/global shift coverage to ensure 24/7 operations are maintained 365 days a year

• Meet with analysts in a 1:1 setting weekly to socialize focus initiatives, gather feedback, provide feedback, and enable analysts to progress rapidly in their career

• Contribute to the development and implementation of analyst training programs designed to streamline onboarding and advance analyst skill sets in Digital Forensics, Incident Response, Malware Analysis, Detection Engineering, Threat Hunting, and Automation

• Work with the Product organizations to prioritize the creation of new capabilities designed to augment and force multiple analyst capabilities

• Maintain accountability for routine quality assurance for your designated region

• Engage with our Support organization to create streamlined workflows for partner/customer requests that need Security Operations Center analysis

• Strengthen and mature our existing processes and relationships with our Tactical Response, Threat Hunting, and Detection Engineering teams within the Security organization

• Provide one level of technical leadership for analysts of the Security Operations Center analysts

• Ensure team members fully understand the goals and objectives of Huntress’ mission and how their work fits into the bigger picture

• Provide key input and guidance to company stakeholders such as Marketing, Sales, Support, and Product

• Develop, track, and report on Objectives and Key Results linked to Security Operations Center focus initiatives

• Help operationalize new technologies and services that Huntress brings to market

• Participate in public speaking engagements in both webinar and in-person formats

What You Bring To The Team:

• Experience in leading diverse cybersecurity teams with various skills. These teams work in Security Operations, Digital Forensics, Incident Response, Malware Analysis, Threat Hunting, and Detection Engineering

• 5+ years of Security Analyst experience working in a global 24x7 security operations center with a focus on Windows forensics

• 3+ year of team lead or managerial experience in a global operations center or Incident Response role. Preferably within a MSSP, MDR provider, or Incident Response service.

• Actively engaged in the information security community by attending conferences or contributing to conversations/projects in the public domain

• Continually learning and staying up to date on the latest threat actor tradecraft, detection techniques, and security operations concepts

• Ability to identify workflows being performed and create detailed process diagrams and operating procedures

• Effective communicator of highly technical concepts to stakeholders of varying technical backgrounds

• Demonstrated experience leading initiatives or projects that required delegation and accountability to achieve success

• Data-driven approach with experience in Data Science concepts

What We Offer:

• 100% remote work environment - since our founding in 2015

• Generous paid time off policy, including vacation, sick time, and paid holidays

• 12 weeks of paid parental leave

• Highly competitive and comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits plans

• 401(k) with a 5% contribution regardless of employee contribution

• Life and Disability insurance plans

• Stock options for all full-time employees

• One-time $500 reimbursement for building/upgrading home office

• Annual allowance for education and professional development assistance

• $75 USD/month digital reimbursement

• Access to the BetterUp platform for coaching, personal, and professional growth
