jobs.title: Cloud Security Engineer, AWS GovCloud
jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Cloud Security Engineer, AWS GovCloud to design, implement, maintain, and optimize secure cloud environments supporting U.S. government, DoD, and intelligence community missions.

This role plays a critical part in protecting classified and sensitive data in AWS, Azure, and hybrid/multi-cloud infrastructures while ensuring full compliance with federal standards such as NIST 800-53, FedRAMP, RMF, and DoD Impact Levels (IL-4/IL-5). 

The right candidate will bring hands-on experience securing cloud platforms in regulated environments. This role will help the organization meet industry standards such as SOC2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, GDPR/CCPA, or other relevant compliance frameworks.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES: 

 - Design and implement secure cloud architectures and configurations across AWS GovCloud, Azure, and/or Google Cloud, applying best practices for least privilege encryption, network segmentation, and data protection.

 - Implement and maintain cloud security frameworks, ensuring ongoing compliance with NIST 800-53 Rev. 5, FedRAMP, DoD IL-2/4/5, RMF, and Secure Cloud Computing Architecture (SCCA) requirements.

 - Configure and manage Identity and Access Management (IAM), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Just-In-Time (JIT) access, Key Vaults, and Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) principles across cloud environments. 

 - Engineer, deploy, and optimize cloud-native security tools, including Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Sentinel, AWS GovCloud security services, CSPM/CWPP solutions, and SIEM (Elastic) platforms for threat detection, monitoring, and response.

 - Conduct vulnerability assessments, penetration testing simulations, security configuration reviews (against STIGs, CIS benchmarks, and NIST controls), and continuous monitoring of cloud resources.

 - Develop, maintain, and update System Security Plans (SSP), Security Assessment Reports (SAR), Plans of Action & Milestones (POA&M), and risk/compliance reporting for cloud-based operations.

 - Identify, analyze, and respond to Indicators of Compromise (IoCs), threat intelligence, and security incidents within cloud environments; perform root-cause analysis and implement preventive controls. 

 - Perform periodic security reviews and audits of cloud environments (Azure, AWS, hybrid) to ensure sustained compliance, mitigate evolving threats, and update policies/procedures.

 - Collaborate with DevSecOps, infrastructure, and development teams to integrate security into CI/CD pipelines, automate security controls, and support secure cloud migrations or modernization initiatives.

 - Assess current cloud architectures, propose security improvements, review designs through a security lens, and serve as a subject-matter expert on cloud security tools,
   processes, and best practices.

 - Coordinate with configuration management teams to ensure hardware/software changes adhere to security protocols, maintain version control, and support documentation of the cyber terrain.

 - Develop, enforce, and maintain cloud security policies, standards, and automated guardrails to support secure CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) practices (e.g., using Terraform, CloudFormation).

 - Monitor cloud environments for security incidents, investigate alerts, perform root-cause analysis, and coordinate incident response activities. 

 - Identify emerging threats and recommend proactive improvements to cloud security posture, including automation of security controls and processes.

 - Provide guidance and training to engineering teams on secure cloud design patterns and best practices.

 - Ability to be on-site 5 days a week at our office in Playa Vista, CA. 


REQUIREMENTS:

 - Must be a U.S. citizen.

 - Education: Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, Computer Science, or a related field (or 5+ years equivalent professional experience in cloud security engineering)

 - Experience: 5–9+ years in cloud security engineering, with hands-on work in AWS GovCloud, Azure, Google GCP, or multi-cloud environments. 

 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills; ability to work in fast-paced, mission-critical environments. 
   
   
   TECHNICAL SKILLS:
   
   - Deep knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, etc.), IAM/RBAC, encryption, network security, and cloud-native security services.
   
   - Familiarity with SIEM, vulnerability scanners, threat intelligence, and automation tools (e.g., Terraform, Python scripting).
   
   - Experience with compliance frameworks (NIST, FedRAMP, RMF) and tools like Azure Sentinel, NESSUS, BURP SUITE, Microsoft Defender, or AWS equivalents.
   
   - Deep understanding of network security, encryption, logging/monitoring, and container/Kubernetes security.
   
   - Experience with infrastructure-as-code, scripting (Python, PowerShell, etc.), and security automation tools.

 - Additional Certifications: 
   
   - CISSP, AWS Certified Security-Specialty, AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional), Microsoft Certified: Security, Compliance & Identity, Security+, CEH, or CSSP related (e.g., CySA+, GCIH).

#LI-JC1


WHY JOIN APEX?

Apex believes in creating a work environment that you look forward to embracing every day. Our employees love working at Apex, and we want you to love it too. We're a fast-growing startup that has raised more than $500M in funding, and we invest heavily in our people from day one.




WHAT WE OFFER FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES:

 - Shared upside: Receive equity in Apex, letting you benefit from the work you create

 - Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents, plus $100k life insurance at no cost

 - Comprehensive PTO package:  Starting at 15 days vacation, growing to 20+ days annually, plus 10 paid holidays

jobs.description:
Position Objective:

Under general supervision, the Clinical Staff Pharmacist facilitates the safe, high quality, effective and economic use of drugs. This responsibility includes the accurate preparation and dispensing of pharmaceuticals according to established departmental policies and procedures.

Essential Job Duties:

• Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
• Partakes in a rotating staffing schedule, including day and evening shifts, weekend rotations, holidays, and overnight coverage based on departmental needs.
• Verifies the accuracy of order entry by authorized prescribers in computerized patient medication profiles.
• Reviews written medication orders or prescriptions to determine appropriate ingredients, strength, and dosage. Reviews medication orders for: potential allergies, drug/drug and food/drug interactions, route of administration, appropriate dose and potential for adverse drug reactions with other medications ordered.
• Contacts the prescriber, as appropriate, to clarify orders and/or make recommendations concerning alternate therapies.
• Provides drug information to patients, physicians, nurses, and other clinical staff where appropriate and upon request.
• Supervises the daily operational duties in the dispensing area to which assigned, including assisting and assigning, closely monitoring and reviewing the work of Pharmacy Technicians, to assure accurate and timely delivery of medications.
• Participates in patient care rounds and unit based services, which may include: medication reconciliation, promoting medication efficacy/safety/cost improvement initiatives, participation in unit process improvement activities, and patient education & follow-up as appropriate.
• Participates in improvements in interdepartmental policies and procedures which support the Pharmacy Department and Hospitals strategic goals. Maintains accurate records as required by departmental policies and procedures and/or federal and state board regulations.
• Completes all core competencies and documents clinical activities accurately and according to policies and procedures. Supports the Investigational Drug Service in the daily operations of the department.
• Educates and supervises Pharmacy Technician in the preparation of intravenous admixture solutions and chemotherapeutic agents, using aseptic technique.
• Completes formal in-service, formulary addition/deletion, assimilation of evidence-based protocol/order-set, medication safety related activities and/or targeted medication expense reductions.

Educational/Experience Requirements:

The minimum level of education and experience for this position includes:

• Doctor of Pharmacy Degree or Bachelor of Science in Pharmacy with commensurate experience required.
• At least 1 year of experience in an inpatient setting required.
• PGY-1 residency or Board Certification preferred.

Required License/Certifications:

• Current Maryland State License

Working Conditions, Equipment, Physical Demands:

Light work. Exerting up to 20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects. If the use of arm and/or leg controls requires exertion of forces greater than that for sedentary work and the worker sits most of the time, the job is rated for light work.

There is a reasonable expectation that employees in this position will be exposed to blood-borne pathogens.

Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or requirements.

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Procurement and Contract Management
jobs.description:
LA28 does not provide relocation assistance for any positions. If you are based outside the Los Angeles area, we still welcome your application — we value talent from all geographic backgrounds and want to hear from you if you are able to work on-site in LA.

Role Purpose

You will help set up the procurement, contracting, and vendor partnerships that keep LA28 venues clean for the Olympic and Paralympic Games. Reporting to the Manager, Procurement and Contract Management, you will support sourcing activities, administer contracts and Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and lead the accreditation process for janitorial and waste hauling contractors within Cleaning and Waste. In the years leading up to the Games, you will shape accurate records, dependable vendor relationships, and clear accountability from the ground up, and gain cross-functional exposure alongside supportive teammates.

Key Responsibilities

• Support development, administration, and tracking of procurement activities, including requests for proposal (RFPs), requests for information (RFIs), and tenders.

• Coordinate procurement documentation, schedules, and submission requirements, and keep records aligned with project milestones.

• Support development, review, and administration of contracts, scopes of work, and SLAs, including amendments, renewals, and compliance activities.

• Lead the cleaning and waste accreditation process for contractors and vendors in the janitorial and waste hauling industries, supporting onboarding and readiness.

• Track vendor performance, service levels, key performance indicators (KPIs), and contractual requirements, and maintain compliance and performance reporting.

Required Competencies

• 4+ years of experience in procurement, contract management, vendor management, or sourcing, including managing contracts, vendor documentation, and operational deliverables.

• Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail across procurement records, contract obligations, and vendor files.

• Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills, turning operational needs into clear contractual expectations for vendors.

• Proven ability to support cross-functional teams in a dynamic, evolving, multi-stakeholder environment while balancing competing priorities and deadlines.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office and procurement, reporting, or contract management platforms to track obligations and milestones.

Valued Experience

• Experience supporting procurement, contracting, vendor onboarding, or service delivery programs.

• Experience with venue operations, logistics, facilities, hospitality, or major events.

• Olympic, Paralympic, FIFA, World Cup, or other major event experience.

• Familiarity with California and local workforce principles.

• Knowledge of public-sector procurement processes or related contracting environments.

What We Offer

• Real ownership of contractor accreditation for cleaning and waste services across Games venues.

• Career-defining exposure to procurement and vendor management on a global stage.

• Transferable skills in sourcing, contract administration, and vendor performance management for future roles.

• A collaborative team where teammates share success, recognize good work, and support one another.

What This Role Means for the Games

Clean, well-serviced venues shape how athletes, spectators, and partners experience the Games. The contracts you manage and the contractors you help accredit keep cleaning and waste services dependable, so each venue is ready when the Olympic and Paralympic Games arrive in Los Angeles.

Physical Requirements & Working Conditions

• Available to work onsite in our Downtown Los Angeles-based office.

• The majority of work will be conducted in an office setting, requiring extended periods of time using computers, phones, and other office equipment.

• The LA28 office is an open floorplan working environment; employees must be able to work efficiently in an open cubicle environment.

• Hours of work may vary, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, especially during peak event periods.

• Perform other duties as required; the role will evolve over time and may include operational responsibilities during the Olympic and Paralympic Games.

Compensation

The annual base salary range for this position is $73,000.00 - $98,000.00.  The pay scale provided is the range that LA28 reasonably expects to pay as starting base compensation for this role. All LA28 compensation remains subject to final determination based on individual candidate qualifications, experience, or other reasonable criteria consistent with LA28's operational business needs and applicable law.

Accommodation

LA28 is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. If you require an accommodation at any stage, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Equal Opportunity

LA28 is committed to fair and unbiased recruitment procedures allowing all applicants an equal opportunity for employment, free from discrimination on the basis of religion, race, sex, age, sexual orientation, disability, color, ethnic or national origin, or any other classification as may be protected by applicable law. LA28 will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance and all applicable laws. We strive to build a team that is inclusive and encourage qualified candidates of all backgrounds, perspectives, and identities to apply. We assess applications based on relevant skills, education, and experience a candidate can add to our team.

   - Deep knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, etc.), IAM/RBAC, encryption, network security, and cloud-native security services.

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinary Assistant - Seattle,WA
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the best experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

At VEG, we don’t just hire assistants—we grow future emergency rockstars. As an Emergency Veterinary Assistant, you’ll be in the heart of the action from day one, supporting your team, comforting pet parents, and learning the ropes in real time. You’ll be there for everything—the triage, the treatments, and the tail wags. You’re embarking on a path where careers start, grow, and thrive. Whether you’re on your way to becoming a credentialed technician or exploring where your passion can take you, we’ll say yes to your growth every step of the way.

WHAT YOU’LL DO*

• Be the first warm welcome and a steady support, triaging incoming patients and helping guide them toward care

• Assist with treatments, nursing care, and diagnostics, from bloodwork and imaging to catheter placement and oxygen support

• Work alongside our credentialed veterinary technicians and veterinarians to set up and monitor anesthesia and sedation cases

• Set up and manage IV fluids, blood transfusions, and medication administration

• Assist during every moment of care: outpatient or inpatient, exam room to treatment area

• Join patient rounds and stay close to the clinical picture to ensure continuity of care

• Learn how to perform CPR and become a RECOVER Certified Rescuer (training provided!)

• Grow into more advanced responsibilities, such as anesthesia support, ultrasound, and catheterization through guided training pathways

*As permitted by state law

WHAT YOU NEED

• High school diploma or equivalent required

• Enrolled in an AVMA-accredited veterinary technology program a plus

• 1+ years in a veterinary assistant role (emergency or specialty experience is a bonus!)

• Basic computer skills and an understanding of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator when collaborating with pet parents and your team

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital demands

• Ability to work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation, including base and 401K match: Pay range is $20-$49 per hour, and is based on a leveling system and experience

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, QPR training, and access to free therapy or counseling

• Depending on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.

• Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt

• Paid parental leave; up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

VEG celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. You've found the equal opportunity employer you are looking for. We can't wait to meet you!

jobs.title: Senior Director, Digital Games Monetization
jobs.description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Senior Director, Digital Games Monetization
U.S.-based required | West Coast strongly preferred (Bay Area ideal) | Headquarters: San Mateo, CA

Role Summary:

The Senior Director, Digital Games Monetization is responsible for leading the PlayStation Store's global publisher monetization organization and maximizing the value created for publishers, players and PlayStation. As the leader of the Digital Games Monetization team, they will define and execute the strategies, capabilities and partnerships that drive sustainable commercial growth. Combining expertise in publisher strategy, monetization, content lifecycle management and commercial optimization, they will ensure the PlayStation Store remains the industry's most effective platform for digital content monetization.

Reporting to the VP, PlayStation Store, the Senior Director will lead a global organization of monetization specialists and content lifecycle experts, partnering closely with publishers and cross-functional teams including Planning & Proposition, Merchandising & Editorial, Insight & Analytics, Commercial Development, GDPR, Channel Sales and Product. Acting as a trusted advisor to both internal stakeholders and external partners, they will identify the opportunities to accelerate publisher growth, improve commercial performance and develop innovative monetization capabilities that deliver measurable business impact.

As the senior leader of the Digital Games Monetization function, they will unite teams responsible for publisher strategy, content lifecycle optimization and commercial growth under a single vision and operating model. The Senior Director will be responsible for aligning priorities, developing organizational capability, establishing best practices and ensuring monetization expertise is applied consistently across publishers, markets and business models. Through strong leadership and strategic direction, they will build a globally connected organization.

In addition to driving commercial outcomes today, the Senior Director will play a critical role in shaping the future of monetization on the PlayStation Store. Working at the intersection of commercial strategy, publisher partnerships, product innovation and market intelligence, they will help identify emerging opportunities, influence Store capabilities and champion new ways of creating value. The role will be instrumental in establishing the PlayStation Store as the industry's leading partner for publisher growth and monetization excellence.

What You'll Be Doing:

The Senior Director, Digital Games Monetization will lead PlayStation Store's global digital monetization organization, building the strategy, operating model and organizational capability required to maximize the commercial performance of publisher content across the platform. They will lead a global team responsible for publisher monetization and content lifecycle optimization, ensuring clear objectives, performance measures and operating rhythms are in place to drive sustained commercial growth across markets, publishers and business models.

Working closely with publishers, the Senior Director will act as a strategic advisor, helping partners maximize long-term performance through effective monetization, pricing, promotional and lifecycle strategies. They will build and maintain senior relationships across the publishing industry, identify growth opportunities and provide commercially focused recommendations informed by player behavior, market dynamics and content performance. Working across the full spectrum of publishing partners, from global strategic accounts through to independent developers, they will help shape monetization strategies that deliver mutual value for publishers and PlayStation.

The role will be responsible for leading PlayStation Store's monetization strategy and commercial performance expertise, ensuring publisher decisions are supported by high-quality insight, analysis and market intelligence. Through the development of scalable frameworks, analytical approaches and best practices, they will help publishers identify revenue opportunities, improve content performance and optimize long-term lifecycle value.

A key accountability will be driving the adoption and evolution of Intelligent Pricing, expanding the impact of the Targeted Offers program and accelerating the development of future monetization capabilities across the Store. Working closely with Store, D2C and matrix teams, the Senior Director will champion innovative approaches to pricing, promotions, experimentation and commercial optimization. They will also help shape future capabilities that leverage data, automation and AI to improve publisher outcomes and strengthen PlayStation's commercial advantage.

The Senior Director will play a critical leadership role within the combined Partner Team structures (PCT) working in close partnership with GPDR to identify, prioritize and execute monetization opportunities across the PlayStation Store. Together, the teams will influence partner strategy, capability investment and ensure publisher needs, player outcomes and business objectives are reflected in product and platform decision-making. Through this partnership, the role will help connect commercial insight, platform capability and publisher opportunity into a unified strategy for Store and business growth.

As a member of the Store Leadership Team and wider D2C leadership community, the Senior Director will contribute to the strategic direction of PlayStation Store and the D2C business. They will represent publisher and monetization priorities within executive discussions, communicate commercial opportunities and performance to senior stakeholders, and help shape the future direction of digital commerce. Through strong leadership, organizational development and cross-functional collaboration, they will build a high-performing global organization that strengthens PlayStation's position as the industry's leading platform for publisher growth and commercial success.

What We're Looking For:

• Significant commercial leadership experience within the games industry, with a proven track record of leading high-performing global teams and delivering sustainable growth through publisher-focused monetization strategies.

• Deep expertise in digital business models, platform economics, digital monetization, pricing and promotions, lifecycle management and revenue optimization, with a strong understanding of the opportunities and challenges facing publishers across the industry.

• Demonstrable success developing strategic partnerships with publishers ranging from global AAA partners to independent developers, driving commercial growth through data-driven recommendations and impactful monetization programs.

• Strong commercial and analytical capability, with experience translating complex performance data, market trends, publisher and customer insights into actionable business strategies and revenue growth initiatives.

• Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders internally and externally, working effectively across global, matrixed organizations to align teams around common commercial objectives.

• Experience operating against ambitious commercial targets and communicating business performance, opportunities and strategic priorities to a wide range of audiences, from detailed operational reviews to executive leadership presentations.

• A strategic yet hands-on leader, with a track record of delivering change, transformation and innovation in fast-paced environments, whilst maintaining strong operational execution.

• Exceptional communication, relationship management and problem-solving skills, combined with a passion for experimentation, continuous improvement and the future of the games industry.

jobs.description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today’s five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

About AST SpaceMobile

AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today's five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Mechanisms Technician to support the assembly, integration, testing, and validation of satellite deployment systems and mechanical subsystems. This role focuses on building precision mechanisms used within large phased-array satellite structures, including deployment assemblies, hinges, release mechanisms, actuators, and structural hardware. The successful candidate will work closely with Engineering, Production, Quality, and Test teams to ensure flight hardware is built to the highest standards of quality, safety, and reliability.

No aerospace experience is required. Candidates with strong mechanical aptitude and hands-on experience from manufacturing, automotive, aviation, industrial maintenance, heavy equipment, military, or technical trades are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

• Assemble and integrate satellite mechanism subsystems, including deployment systems, hinges, actuators, latches, and structural assemblies.

• Read and interpret engineering drawings, work instructions, assembly procedures, and technical documentation.

• Install and route electrical harnesses, connectors, sensors, and associated hardware.

• Perform precision mechanical assembly using hand tools, power tools, torque tools, and specialized equipment.

• Execute functional and acceptance testing of mechanical systems and assemblies.

• Support environmental testing activities, including vibration, thermal vacuum (TVAC), deployment, and life-cycle testing.

• Troubleshoot hardware issues during assembly and testing and assist with corrective actions and rework activities.

• Handle flight hardware in accordance with ESD, contamination control, and quality requirements.

• Record manufacturing data, inspection results, and work completed in company systems.

• Support tooling, fixtures, test equipment, and production workstations.

• Collaborate with Engineering, Quality, and Production teams to resolve issues and improve manufacturing processes.

• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.

Qualifications

Education

• High School Diploma, GED, technical certification, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Experience

• Minimum of 2 years of experience in manufacturing, mechanical assembly, automotive repair, aviation maintenance, industrial maintenance, production assembly, military technical occupations, or related fields.

• Experience using hand tools, torque tools, measuring equipment, and power tools.

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, schematics, and work instructions.

Preferred Qualifications

• Aerospace, aviation, defense, or other high-reliability manufacturing experience.

• Experience working in cleanroom environments.

• Knowledge of ESD, FOD, and contamination control practices.

• Experience supporting vibration, shock, thermal vacuum (TVAC), or environmental testing.

• Experience with harness fabrication, crimping, soldering, and connector installation.

• Familiarity with deployment mechanisms, actuators, motion control systems, or electromechanical assemblies.

• Military aircraft maintenance, avionics, aerospace maintenance, or related experience.

Soft Skills

• Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting abilities.

• Meticulous attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.

• Ability to follow detailed procedures with a high degree of accuracy.

• Strong organizational and documentation skills.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively within cross-functional teams.

• Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

• Commitment to workplace safety and continuous improvement.

Technology Stack

• Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) and production tracking software.

• Electronic work instruction systems.

• Torque tools and precision measuring equipment.

• Electrical harness installation and testing equipment.

• Microsoft Office Suite (preferred).

• Quality documentation and inspection systems.

Physical Requirements

• Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.

• Ability to perform repetitive hand and finger movements requiring precision and dexterity.

• Ability to lift, push, pull, and/or carry up to 50 pounds.

• Ability to work in various positions, including standing, kneeling, crouching, and reaching.

• Ability to work in and around large structures, equipment, tooling, and confined spaces.

• Ability to work near moving mechanical parts and equipment.

• Ability to communicate effectively, including talking and hearing.

• Ability to work with flight hardware, test setups, and precision instruments.

• Ability to work extended hours and shifts during launch campaigns as required.

• Ability to work in environments that may include exposure to airborne particles, fumes, and hazardous materials such as carbon fiber.

Until recently, he was a Medical Director building specialty care services at Kaiser Permanente. Earlier, he worked at IDEO.

 

Position Summary

The Medical Assistant (MA) is an integral member of Clarity Pediatrics' interdisciplinary care team, collaborating with physicians, advanced practice providers, nurse care coordinators, community health workers, psychologists, and therapists. Under the direction of clinical leadership, the Medical Assistant ensures efficient clinical operations by scheduling patient appointments, gathering and organizing patient data and forms, communicating with referring providers and patients, and supporting seamless care delivery for children with chronic conditions. Note this is a fully remote position.

 

Key Responsibilities

Patient Scheduling & Coordination

 - Schedule and coordinate patient appointments across the care team using EHR and scheduling systems

 - Respond to patient inquiries regarding appointment availability and reschedule as needed

 - Manage scheduling logistics including confirmation calls/messages and appointment preparation

Data Collection & Forms Management

 - Verify patient information is complete and accurate in the EHR system before clinical visits

Provider & Referring Physician Communication

 - Reach out to referring providers to establish care, obtain medical records, and clarify patient history

 - Support care coordination by communicating appointment outcomes and updates to referring providers

 - Track referral status and follow up on outstanding items with external providers


QUALIFICATIONS

Required:

 - High school diploma or GED; Medical Assistant certification (CCMA, AAMA, or equivalent) preferred but not required

 - Proficiency with electronic health record (EHR) systems and multiple technology platforms

 - Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and documentation

 - Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced, remote environment

 - Enthusiasm for joining a growing startup and contributing to innovative care models

 - Reliable internet connection and a dedicated workspace suitable for remote work

jobs.title: Product Deployment Strategist, Summer 2027
jobs.description:
About Persona

Persona https://withpersona.com/ is the configurable identity platform built for businesses in a digital-first world. Verifying individuals and organizations is harder — but more important — than ever, with AI enabling fraudsters to launch sophisticated accounts at scale and regulations evolving rapidly.

We’ve built Persona to support practically every use case and industry — that’s why we’re able to serve a wide range of leading companies. For example, Reddit relies on Persona for age assurance and verification to comply with online safety regulations, protecting younger users while maintaining a seamless experience. Meanwhile, OpenAI relies on Persona to keep bad actors out, protecting one of the world’s most powerful AI platforms from large-scale abuse in a time when AI is reshaping the way we work and live.

We’re growing rapidly and looking for exceptional people to join us!

About the Role

As a Product Deployment Strategist, you'll help customers translate complex identity and fraud challenges into effective solutions using Persona. You'll work alongside customer account teams, Solutions Engineers, and partner across Product/Engineering/Design, and Fraud to support implementations, analyze performance, and help customers get lasting business value from our platform. With mentorship from industry experts and a supportive, collaborative environment, you'll make bold decisions that drive impact at a high-growth startup.

Best fit for

 - Someone with 1-2 years of experience in consulting, professional services, customer success, or an equivalent role.

 - Someone curious to learn the ins and outs of a highly technical product.

 - Someone looking to level up their career alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry.

What you’ll do at Persona

 - Consult with customers: You’ll be staffed on a team that helps executives at leading companies ensure they are driving maximum value from our platform. You will build leadership skills by participating in key customer engagements, including implementations, business reviews, and all recurring touch points.

 - Translate customer goals into solutions: Learn customers’ business objectives, identity and fraud use cases, and operational constraints. Partner with account teams and Solutions Engineers to turn those needs into product recommendations and deployment plans.

 - Support implementations and ongoing optimization: Help customers launch and improve verification experiences and workflows, coordinating requirements, testing, milestones, and follow-through with technical partners.

 - Use data to drive recommendations: Conduct audits and analyze customer performance to identify opportunities for improvement. Translate findings into actionable recommendations tailored to each customers' goals.

What you'll gain at Persona

 - A structured program: You'll join a dedicated cohort with hands-on onboarding to Persona's platform. You'll then be placed on live customer accounts alongside experienced team members.

 - Impactful contributions: You will become an expert in Persona’s platform products and future offerings, and directly inform Persona’s product roadmap and go-to-market strategy. You will be empowered to make changes to our processes, engagements, and product as the ones working most closely with our customers.

 - Holistic support and growth: Alongside 1:1 mentorship from seasoned professionals, you’ll have access to abundant resources to help you be successful.

 - Leadership development: You’ll build relationships with Persona’s executives, made up of former Square, Dropbox, and Coursera alumni. Persona offers an environment heavily focused on learning and development, with opportunities for growth and career advancement.

What you’ll bring to Persona

 - A growth mindset: You have a demonstrated love for learning and adaptability to ambiguity. You are eager to give and receive constructive and positive feedback, fostering a collaborative and supportive environment.

 - Outstanding verbal and written communication skills: You can effectively convey complex concepts to different audiences.

 - Strong interpersonal skills: You have a genuine desire to provide exceptional customer experiences and contribute to a customer’s success.

 - Empathy: You can understand and manage the needs of others, and build an environment where others feel understood.

 - Curiosity: You have a passion for learning and embracing new challenges in an ever changing environment.

 - Technical aptitude: You have a desire and ability to learn complex technical concepts (technical background a plus!)

Location and Travel

This is a full-time position based in our HQ in downtown San Francisco. Our in-office days are Tuesday - Thursday, with the option to work from home on Monday and Friday. This position may also include up to 15% travel.

Benefits and Perks

For full-time US-based employees (excluding internship and contractor opportunities), Persona offers a wide range of benefits, including medical, dental, and vision, 3% 401(k) contribution, unlimited PTO, quarterly mental health days, family planning benefits, professional development stipend, wellness benefits, among others. 


For full-time UK employees, Persona offers a wide range of benefits, including private medical insurance, dental insurance, a 6% employer pension contribution, unlimited PTO, a monthly wellness stipend, professional development stipend, co-working stipend, and more.


As part of our interview process, all candidates will be asked to verify their identity with Persona. This step is used solely to confirm that candidates are who they say they are, and will have no impact on hiring decisions.

jobs.title: Machinist (CNC & Manual)
jobs.description:
MAKING THE METALS POWERING THE WORLD

Solcoa is building the next generation of American metalmaking, starting with rare earths — the metals of power and motion. We've developed a new chemistry that converts rare earth oxides into high-purity metals — the materials inside every EV, fighter jet, wind turbine, and data center — cleaner, cheaper, and faster than any conventional process. Now we're scaling it to thousands of tonnes of annual production.




THE ROLE — MACHINIST (CNC & MANUAL)

Own the machine shop. You'll turn prints and sketches from our engineers into finished parts—same-day when it matters—machining components for reactors, furnaces, fixtures, and prototype hardware that goes straight onto the plant floor. You'll set the standard for precision, throughput, and shop discipline as we scale from pilot plant to production.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Machine parts from prints and CAD models on CNC and manual mills and lathes—stainless, carbon steel, aluminum, copper, graphite, and specialty alloys.

 - Program, set up, and run CNC jobs (Fusion 360 / Mastercam or similar CAM); select tooling, speeds, and feeds for one-offs and small batches.

 - Hold tight tolerances and verify dimensions with calipers, micrometers, gauges, and indicators; document inspection results.

 - Turn around quick-turn prototype and repair work for R&D and plant operations—often same day.

 - Design and build fixtures, jigs, and tooling that make the whole shop faster.

 - Work with engineers on design-for-manufacturability; mark up drawings and feed back improvements.

 - Maintain the shop: machine upkeep, tooling inventory, organization, and safety practices for hot work and rotating equipment.
   
   


WHAT YOU BRING


REQUIRED

 - 3+ years machining experience with proven skill on both CNC and manual mills and lathes.

 - Ability to program CNC toolpaths (conversational or CAM) and to read and interpret GD&T on mechanical drawings.

 - Experience machining stainless and specialty alloys to tight tolerances.

 - Disciplined, reliable execution—on spec, on time, with excellent documentation.

 - Comfort working independently in a fast-paced, hardware-first environment.

 - Availability to start soon.


PREFERRED

 - Experience supporting R&D or prototype shops where requirements change daily.

 - TIG welding and general fabrication ability.

 - Experience with graphite, refractory metals, or vacuum/furnace components.

 - CAD proficiency (SolidWorks, Fusion 360) for simple part and fixture design.
   
   


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Competitive base salary

 - Equity (stock options)

 - Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance

 - Company-provided lunch daily

 - Visa sponsorship available if needed

 - Someone curious to learn the ins and outs of a highly technical product.

 - Someone looking to level up their career alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry.

What you'll do at Persona

 - Partner directly with customers to understand their goals, technical requirements, and operational constraints to design and implement solutions using Persona's platform, guiding customers through technical decisions and trade-offs.

 - Own end-to-end delivery, including solution design, configuration and integration, quality assurance, deployment, and iteration.

 - Support implementations and ongoing optimization including helping customers launch and improve verification experiences and workflows, coordinating requirements, testing, milestones, and follow-through with technical partners.

 - Investigate, explain, and collaborate on complex technical issues with Product and Engineering to resolve customer blockers, clearly explain business impact, and identify actionable product feedback, reusable solutions, and better documentation.

What you’ll gain at Persona

 - A structured program: You'll join a dedicated Field Product Engineer cohort with hands-on onboarding to Persona's platform. You'll then be placed on live customer accounts alongside experienced Solutions, Implementations, or Sales Engineers.

 - Real technical ownership early: You'll take customer solutions from start to finish: scoping, design, building, testing and launch. You'll do this for customers ranging from startups to Fortune 10 companies.

 - Holistic support and growth: Alongside 1:1 mentorship from seasoned professionals, you’ll have access to abundant resources to help you be successful. You'll work closely with Sales, Post-Sales, Product and Engineering. You'll see how deals are won, how customers succeed and how feedback from the field shapes our roadmap and go-to-market strategy.

 - Leadership development: You’ll build relationships with Persona’s executives, made up of former Square, Dropbox, and Coursera alumni. Persona offers an environment heavily focused on learning and development, with opportunities for growth and career advancement.

What you’ll bring to Persona

 - A growth mindset: You have a demonstrated love for learning and adaptability to ambiguity. You are eager to give and receive constructive and positive feedback, fostering a collaborative and supportive environment. You have a passion for learning and embracing new challenges.

 - Outstanding verbal and written communication skills: You can effectively convey complex concepts to different audiences.

 - Strong interpersonal skills: You have a genuine desire to provide exceptional customer experiences and contribute to a customer’s success.

 - Curiosity: You have a passion for learning and embracing new challenges in an ever changing environment.

 - Empathy: You can understand and manage the needs of others, and build an environment where others feel understood.

Location and Travel

This is a full-time position based in our HQ in downtown San Francisco. Our in-office days are Tuesday - Thursday, with the option to work from home on Monday and Friday. This position may also include up to 15% travel.

Benefits and Perks

For full-time US-based employees (excluding internship and contractor opportunities), Persona offers a wide range of benefits, including medical, dental, and vision, 3% 401(k) contribution, unlimited PTO, quarterly mental health days, family planning benefits, professional development stipend, wellness benefits, among others. 


For full-time UK employees, Persona offers a wide range of benefits, including private medical insurance, dental insurance, a 6% employer pension contribution, unlimited PTO, a monthly wellness stipend, professional development stipend, co-working stipend, and more.

jobs.title: Procurement Manager
jobs.description:
MAKING THE METALS POWERING THE WORLD

Solcoa is building the next generation of American metalmaking, starting with rare earths — the metals of power and motion. We've developed a new chemistry that converts rare earth oxides into high-purity metals — the materials inside every EV, fighter jet, wind turbine, and data center — cleaner, cheaper, and faster than any conventional process. Now we're scaling it to thousands of tonnes of annual production.

 


THE ROLE

The Procurement Manager will own the purchasing that keeps Solcoa’s development, equipment builds and plant operations moving. You’ll work closely with engineering, research and operations to get the right equipment, materials and services delivered on time, to specification and at the right cost. This is a hands-on role for someone who can solve urgent sourcing problems while building the supplier relationships and purchasing systems we need as we scale.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own purchasing from request through delivery for process equipment, custom fabricated parts, raw materials, consumables, spare parts and outside services.

 - Partner with engineering, research and operations to turn drawings, bills of materials and production plans into clear sourcing requirements and purchasing schedules.

 - Find, qualify and develop suppliers. Run RFQs, compare technical and commercial proposals, and negotiate pricing, payment terms, lead times and warranties.

 - Stay on top of open orders and long-lead items. Follow up directly with suppliers, resolve delays and coordinate freight and receiving to keep builds and production moving.

 - Build reliable sources for critical materials and components, including alternate suppliers where single-source dependencies threaten cost, quality or delivery.

 - Work with technical teams to resolve supplier quality issues, substitutions and nonconforming deliveries; maintain specifications, certificates and purchasing records.

 - Establish practical purchasing processes, approval workflows and supplier records. Keep purchase orders, delivery dates, inventory needs and spend visible to the team.

 - Track supplier performance and total landed cost, identify savings and standardization opportunities.




WHAT YOU BRING


REQUIRED

 - 2+ years of procurement, purchasing or supply chain experience in manufacturing, industrial equipment, chemicals, metals or a related technical environment.

 - Experience sourcing both custom parts or capital equipment and the materials and consumables needed to keep a facility running.

 - Ability to work with engineering drawings, bills of materials and technical specifications, and clarify requirements with engineers and suppliers.

 - Strong commercial judgment and a track record of negotiating favorable terms while protecting quality and delivery.

 - Highly organized, with the follow-through to manage multiple orders, changing priorities and urgent sourcing needs.

 - Hands-on experience with purchasing or ERP systems and spreadsheets; comfortable building processes in a fast-paced startup.


PREFERRED

 - Experience supporting a pilot plant, new facility buildout or manufacturing scale-up.

 - Familiarity with high-temperature equipment, vacuum systems, refractory materials, specialty metals or chemical feedstocks.

 - Experience with domestic and international sourcing, freight coordination and import documentation.

 - Experience establishing a procurement function or improving purchasing and inventory systems at an early-stage company.




LOCATION

This is a full-time, on-site position in Alameda, California.




COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Competitive base salary.

 - Generous stock options.

 - Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance.

 - Company-provided lunch daily.

 - Visa sponsorship available if needed.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Infrastructure
jobs.description:
About Backblaze

Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we’re helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.

Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $100m in revenue and is the leading specialized storage cloud - managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals.

Want to know what you’ll be doing?

You will work on our data infrastructure platform which supports the B2 Object Storage and Computer Backup products, responsible for the data infrastructure that everything runs on. You will help improve automation, observability and stability for durability, increase throughput, and drive architectural changes to support the long term requirements of our service.

Responsibilities:

• Design and build automation frameworks that let other engineers provision, configure, and repair fleet infrastructure themselves

• Design and extend the observability stack (metrics, logs, traces, alerts) that tells us whether the storage platform is healthy and where it is degrading

• Build reporting, dashboards, and visualizations that give engineering and leadership a clear view into fleet health, capacity, and operational trends

• Build system health tooling that detects failing hardware, drifting configuration, and capacity risk before they turn into incidents

• Lead technical design discussions and produce clear design documents for changes that span multiple services and teams

• Drive the implementation of large features from design through rollout, including the migration and backfill work that real systems require

• Partner with the on-call rotation to turn recurring toil and incident findings into automation and better signal

The Right Fit:

• 7+ years of backend development in an enterprise environment, working in an object-oriented or systems language (Java, Rust, C++, C#, Go, or similar)

• Experience designing automation frameworks or platforms that other engineers build on

• Experience building large scale software systems running on thousands of servers

• Experience building automation or tooling that other engineers depend on daily, whether internal platform services, operational tooling, or a deployment and configuration pipeline

• Working knowledge of an observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK, Datadog, or equivalent), including instrumenting a service and designing alerts people trust

• Strong Linux fundamentals and comfort operating in a bare-metal or hybrid environment rather than a fully managed cloud

• Professional experience incorporating AI-assisted development tools (Gemini, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar)

• Comfortable with all aspects of the software development lifecycle, including design, implementation, testing, and rollout

• Exhibits curiosity and seeks to understand before offering solutions

• Communicates proactively in a remote environment by keeping the team informed, surfacing blockers early, and moving work forward

• Applies analytical thinking to ambiguous problems

Bonus points for:

• Proficiency in Java

• Experience with configuration management or infrastructure-as-code tooling (Ansible, Salt, Puppet, Chef, Terraform)

• Experience designing SLOs and error budgets, or reducing alert noise on a fleet running at scale

• Experience with time-series databases and query languages such as PromQL

• Experience automating hardware lifecycle work: burn-in, failure detection, drive replacement, decommissioning

• Experience with discovering and implementing performance improvements, including CPU and IO

• Understanding of Linux internals and file systems

• Familiarity with hard drive performance and optimization, including host-managed SMR

• Experience building and interpreting models, dashboards, or reports

Required for all Backblaze Employees:

• Good attitude and willingness to do whatever it takes to get the job done

• Strong desire to work for a small, fast-paced company

• Desire to learn and adapt to rapidly changing technologies and work environment

• Rigorous adherence to best practices

• Relentless attention to detail

• Excellent interpersonal skills and good oral/written communication

• Excellent troubleshooting and problem solving skills

Backblaze Perks:

• Healthcare for family, including dental and vision

• Competitive compensation and 401K

• RSU grants for full-time employees

• ESPP program

• Flexible vacation policy

• Maternity & paternity leave

• MacBook Pro to use for work plus a generous stipend to personalize your workstation

• Childcare bonus (human children only)

• Fertility treatment and support

• Learning & development program

• Commuter benefits

• Culture that supports a healthy work-life balance

Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below.

Associate Attorney (Insurance Coverage)

A Rare Seat for a Litigator Who Wants More Variety

If you’re a Washington attorney with 3–5 years of experience and you’ve worked with UIM matters, first-party claims, or coverage issues, this is an opportunity to build a broader litigation practice without giving up the sophistication of insurance work.

Tyson & Mendes’ Seattle office is busy, growing, and intentionally close-knit. The team has the feel of a boutique practice: accessible leadership, real collaboration, and meaningful responsibility; while giving you the resources, technology, training, and infrastructure of a national litigation firm.

This role is especially unique because you won’t be placed into a narrow practice lane.

You’ll work alongside Partner David Heemann, whose practice spans insurance coverage, bad faith, claims management, general liability, auto liability, construction defect, and other complex insurance matters. David brings more than 20 years of experience, including significant in-house coverage counsel experience, and has advised on matters with exposures exceeding $100 million.

For an attorney who wants to become a stronger, more versatile insurance litigator, this is a compelling place to do it.

More Than Routine Auto Defense

Approximately 10% of the practice will involve first-party and coverage-related work, with the remainder consisting of a diverse mix of tort litigation, including:

• Auto and UIM matters

• Premises liability

• Products liability

• Construction-related litigation

• Complex bodily injury claims

• Insurance coverage and first-party bad faith exposure

• High-value and unusual matters involving sophisticated liability issues

The variety is a major differentiator.

You won’t spend your career handling the same type of case over and over. The team regularly works on matters involving complex legal issues, significant injuries, and unique clients; including litigation in which David has been appointed as a Special Assistant Attorney General to defend the State of Washington.

That breadth of work is difficult to find at many traditional insurance defense firms.

Learn From a True Insurance Coverage Resource

David’s background offers something particularly valuable for an attorney interested in developing deeper insurance knowledge.

Before joining Tyson & Mendes, he served as Claims Coverage Counsel for Mutual of Enumclaw and has extensive experience with coverage opinions, claims management, policy drafting, bad faith litigation, regulatory issues, and complex insurance disputes.

You’ll have the opportunity to work closely with an experienced partner while still having room to develop your own judgment, manage cases, and take meaningful ownership of your practice.

This is mentorship without micromanagement.

Boutique Connection. National Resources.

Our Seattle office offers the relationships and visibility of a smaller team without the limitations of a small firm.

You’ll have access to:

• A national network of experienced litigators

• Firmwide training and professional development

• Our Trial Academy and litigation methodologies

• Advanced technology and AI-enabled legal resources

• Sophisticated case-management and billing tools

• Cross-office collaboration and subject-matter expertise

• Opportunities to grow alongside an expanding Seattle practice

You can be known by your team, learn directly from experienced partners, and make a visible impact—while still having a national platform behind you.

Who Will Thrive Here

We’re looking for an attorney who has built a solid litigation foundation and is ready for more variety, responsibility, and growth.

The strongest candidate will have approximately 3–5 years of Washington litigation experience, ideally including Washington UIM matters and some exposure to first-party bad faith or insurance coverage.

You should enjoy managing cases, working through complicated legal issues, communicating with clients, taking depositions, writing and arguing motions, and continuing to develop as a well-rounded litigator.

Most importantly, you should be curious.

If you want to understand why coverage works the way it does, handle meaningful liability matters, and become the attorney clients trust with complicated problems, this team can give you that runway.

Build a Practice, Not Just a Caseload

At Tyson & Mendes, we’re looking for attorneys who want to become exceptional at what they do.

If you’re ready for a role that offers complex work, accessible mentorship, meaningful responsibility, modern resources, and a genuinely connected Seattle team, we’d like to meet you.

Bring your litigation experience. We’ll help you broaden what you can do with it.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop compelling case strategies that cut through emotional arguments and drive results

• Set a higher standard—challenge mediocrity and push for excellence in every aspect of your work

• Independently manage court appearances, depositions, motion practice, and trials

• Collaborate seamlessly with attorneys and staff at all experience levels

• Maintain consistent and professional communication with clients

• Build and nurture relationships with existing and prospective clients

• Mentor and provide guidance to junior attorneys, contributing to team growth and success

REQUIREMENTS

• Juris Doctor (JD) from an ABA-accredited law school

• Active bar license in the state of Washington

• 3+ years of experience in insurance defense

• 3–5 years of litigation experience, including experience handling Washington UIM matters and exposure to first-party bad faith claims.

• 1–8 years of solid litigation experience, including case strategy, depositions, and trial preparation

• Ability to independently manage a full caseload, from discovery through trial

• Familiarity with litigation timekeeping and billing systems

• Proficient in Microsoft Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint

• Self-motivated with strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills

• Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication abilities

• Professional appearance and demeanor

COMPENSATION PACKAGE

• The base salary for this position ranges from $100,000-145,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications

• Attorneys are eligible for an annual billable hours bonus ranging from $10,000 and then aggregating with $7,500 for every additional tier

• Comprehensive benefits coverage offered, including plans available at zero employee cost (average annual employer contribution for health/vision/dental/life coverage is $700-$1,700)

• Employees receive a monthly technology reimbursement of $60

BENEFITS

• Firm Provided CLE Programs and Paid Bar License Renewal Fees

• Flexible vacation policy for attorneys

• Defined pathway to partnership

• Internal diversity and inclusion programs, such as the Women’s Initiative and Young Professionals Initiative

• Firm-wide charitable giving program

• Flexible Work Model: Remote, hybrid, or onsite options available

About Tyson & Mendes

Click here to learn more about the Tyson & Mendes Office!  (944) The Tyson & Mendes Office - YouTube

We’re one of the fastest-growing civil defense firms in the country—known for breaking the mold of the traditional law firm. Our dynamic, diverse team of trial attorneys delivers exceptional results, from landmark cases like Howell v. Hamilton Meats to numerous defense verdicts across the nation.

jobs.title: Medical Director
jobs.description:
Reimagine the infrastructure of cancer care within a community that values integrity, inspires growth, and is uniquely positioned to create a more modern, connected oncology ecosystem. We’re looking for a Medical Director to help us accomplish our mission to improve and extend lives by learning from the experience of every person with cancer. Are you ready to be the next changemaker in cancer care?

A note on level: We're open to candidates at the Associate Medical Director or Medical Director level depending on experience and scope of prior ownership in precision medicine.

What You'll Do

Flatiron Health is looking for a data-and technology-oriented clinician with oncology subject matter expertise who is passionate about real-world evidence (RWE) accelerating progress against cancer. You will be part of the Global Research Oncology team that operates across the US, UK, Germany, and Japan.

In this role you will collaborate with a cross-functional team of oncologists/clinicians, data scientists, epidemiologists, software engineers, product managers, account directors, and clinical data specialists to help develop, commercialize, and deliver our oncology research data and services leveraging a breadth of tools, including artificial intelligence. You will serve as a core medical resource with a particular focus in precision medicine and cancer genomics. You will also help biopharma clients apply clinical and molecular use cases across the full R&D lifecycle—from early pipeline discovery through post-market clinical development. In addition you will:

• Clinical Oncology & Precision Medicine RO Expert: Serve as a core medical expert unblocking high-volume, custom data requests across oncologic diseases including rare tumor types and complex, multi-omic biomarker profiles. Flexibly pivot across oncologic disease areas to scope, design, and clinically validate custom datasets and analyses for our biopharma partners.

• Translational Oncology & Discovery Partner: Partner with clients early in their R&D lifecycle to show how clinical-molecular datasets can fuel target discovery, characterize novel biomarker-defined cohorts, evaluate tumor biology, and guide combination therapy approaches. Help researchers validate preclinical hypotheses in real-world cohorts and explore clinical trial findings via reverse translation.

• Clinical Development Translation: Apply clinical development and trial design principles to help biopharma clients bridge the gap between traditional clinical endpoints and real-world evidence (RWE). Help clients understand how real world data can support external control arms, historic cohorts, or synthetic control designs for niche or rare trial populations.

• Commercial Pre-Sales & Scoping Subject Matter Expert: Proactively provide clinical and molecular data expertise to support teams during pre-sales, client scoping, and solution building utilising internal or off-the-shelf external AI tools. Partner with scientific and commercial leaders to translate a client’s clinical development planning, target validation, or complex inclusion/exclusion criteria into precise data specifications across our various data assets.

• Cross-Functional Solutioning: Partner closely with matrixed project teams to apply established clinical-molecular frameworks to complex dataset deliveries and custom client requests.

• Internal Capability Building: Support the development of internal training resources and clinical documentation to help upskill delivery teams on rare biomarker cohorts and molecular data structures.

• Scientific Contribution: Participate in research study projects requiring physician expertise with support from senior RO leaders, including presenting or speaking at scientific conferences.

Who You Are

You're a kind, passionate, and collaborative problem-solver who values the opportunity to think beyond the way things are. In addition, you are an oncologist with post training experience in clinical, academic or industry settings and direct experience with cancer genomics. This position requires leadership, outstanding problem-solving, analytical and communication skills, and experience multitasking and prioritizing in a fast-paced environment.

• Medical Training: You hold an MD (or equivalent) with foundational training in oncology, hematology, or a related subspecialty.

• Experience: You have post-training clinical, academic, or early industry experience. Qualifying years of experience are following completion of a subspecialty fellowship.

• 1-3 years for the Associate Medical Director level

• 3-5+ years for the Medical Director level

• Clinical Development & Discovery Exposure: You have familiarity with clinical trial design, protocol development, or early-phase (Phase I/II) clinical development. Exposure to laboratory translational oncology, cancer genomics, or biomarker discovery research is highly valued.

• Clinical Agility: You possess deep clinical intuition and are highly comfortable learning and diving into the clinical landscape of diverse, low-incidence rare tumors and complex molecular landscapes.

• Matrix Collaboration: You are adept at working within a matrix-structured environment with multiple stakeholders and product lines, translating highly technical medical and genomic concepts for non-clinical internal teams.

• Operational Execution: You are able to handle multiple tasks concurrently, contribute to intermediate-complexity clinical data projects with guidance and mentorship from senior RO leaders, and meet ongoing deadlines in a fast-paced technology driven environment.

Where You’ll Work

In this remote position, you have the freedom to choose your preferred work location while aligning your working hours with your team's. For further details on our hybrid work approach and remote work type, please visit the how we work website.

Life at Flatiron

At Flatiron Health, we offer a full range of benefits to support you and your loved ones so you can focus your working hours on improving cancer care and accelerating cancer research, and your non-working hours on everything else life has to offer:

• Work/life autonomy via flexible work hours and flexible paid time off

• Comprehensive compensation package

• 401(k) contribution to help you reach your retirement planning goals

• Financial health resources including 1:1 financial advice

• Mental well-being tools and services

• Parental benefits and policies including family-building care and generous leave

• Path to parenthood programs supporting fertility, adoption and surrogacy

• Travel support for safe healthcare services

In addition to our robust benefit offerings, visit our Life at Flatiron page to learn how we support continuous learning and celebrate inclusion and belonging in the workplace.
