jobs.description:
Associate Attorney | Insurance Defense | Orange County

Learn From One of the Best. Build the Litigator You Want to Become.

An active California Bar license and 3+ years of insurance defense experience are required.

Tyson & Mendes is seeking an experienced Associate Attorney to join Partner Margaret “Peggy” Holm’s litigation team in our Orange County office.

This is a unique opportunity for an attorney who already understands insurance defense and is ready to take their skills further.

You’ll work alongside an accomplished trial attorney, handle substantive and sophisticated matters, receive direct feedback and guidance, and have opportunities to develop the judgment and courtroom skills that come from working closely with attorneys who have spent decades trying complex cases.

Learn From an Exceptional Trial Lawyer

Peggy Holm is Chair of the Tyson & Mendes Healthcare Practice and one of the country’s leading trial and appellate litigators for healthcare entities and other organizations facing complex civil litigation.

Her record includes more than 200 civil jury trials and arbitrations and a success rate of more than 95 percent in jury verdict cases. She is a Fellow of the American College of Trial Lawyers and holds the prestigious rank of Diplomate with the American Board of Trial Advocates.

For an associate who wants to become a stronger litigator, this is an opportunity to learn from someone who has spent her career doing exactly that.

Do Substantive Work

This is not a role where you’ll spend your time sitting on the sidelines.

Peggy’s team handles an interesting mix of sophisticated matters, including medical malpractice, catastrophic injury, wrongful death, elder abuse, institutional liability, trucking and automobile matters, and complex claims involving healthcare and entertainment organizations. Some matters involve difficult and sensitive facts and require maturity, sound judgment, and professionalism.

You’ll have the opportunity to work on cases directly, participate in depositions, develop strategy, handle discovery and motions, communicate with clients, prepare for court, and build toward greater courtroom and trial responsibility.

High Expectations. Real Mentorship.

Peggy has high standards, but she also believes strongly in developing attorneys.

Newer attorneys receive a manageable caseload and guidance as they build their skills. Peggy interacts regularly with her team, encourages attorneys to pick up the phone and talk through issues, and holds weekly team meetings focused on both the work and supporting one another.

You will be expected to think independently. Look at the problem. Do the work. Think through possible solutions. Then come to the team with your questions and ideas.

You won’t be expected to know everything, but you will be expected to engage.

The Right Fit

We’re looking for an attorney with 3+ years of insurance defense experience who understands civil litigation, discovery, and case management and is ready for more.

You are proactive, inquisitive, hardworking, and accountable. You communicate openly, treat clients, colleagues, judges, and opposing counsel with respect, and take ownership when something doesn’t go as planned.

Most importantly, you want to become a better litigator and are willing to put in the work to get there.

A Team That Actually Works as a Team

Peggy’s team genuinely enjoys working together. They communicate frequently, help one another, and believe no task is too big or too small when the team needs support.

Peggy plans to spend approximately three days a week in the Costa Mesa office, creating opportunities for in person collaboration and mentorship while maintaining flexibility.

And for attorneys who want courtroom experience, there is room to grow. Peggy is the primary trial lawyer on the team today and is specifically looking for other attorneys who can develop toward taking on that responsibility.

Come Here to Become a Better Litigator.

If you have the insurance defense foundation and are ready to challenge yourself, learn from exceptional attorneys, take meaningful ownership of your work, and build toward the courtroom, we’d love to meet you.

Bring your experience. Bring your initiative. We’ll give you the opportunity to build from there.

Responsibilities

• Develop compelling case strategies that cut through emotional arguments and drive results

• Set a higher standard—challenge mediocrity and push for excellence in every aspect of your work

• Independently manage court appearances, depositions, motion practice, and trials

• Collaborate seamlessly with attorneys and staff at all experience levels

• Maintain consistent and professional communication with clients

• Build and nurture relationships with existing and prospective clients

• Mentor and provide guidance to junior attorneys, contributing to team growth and success

Requirements

• Juris Doctor (JD) from an ABA-accredited law school

• Active bar license in the state of CA

• 3–8 years of solid litigation experience, including case strategy, depositions, and trial preparation

• Ability to independently manage a full caseload, from discovery through trial

• Prior insurance defense experience preferred

• Familiarity with litigation timekeeping and billing systems

• Proficient in Microsoft Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint

• Self-motivated with strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills

• Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication abilities

• Professional appearance and demeanor

Compensation Package

• Attorneys are eligible for an annual billable hours bonus ranging from $10,000 and then aggregating with $7,500 for every additional tier

• Comprehensive benefits coverage offered, including plans available at zero employee cost (average annual employer contribution for health/vision/dental/life coverage is $700-$1,700)

About Tyson & Mendes

Click here to learn more about the Tyson & Mendes Office!  (944) The Tyson & Mendes Office - YouTube

We’re one of the fastest-growing civil defense firms in the country—known for breaking the mold of the traditional law firm. Our dynamic, diverse team of trial attorneys delivers exceptional results, from landmark cases like Howell v. Hamilton Meats to numerous defense verdicts across the nation.

But we don’t stop at great legal work—we invest in our people. With specialized training in our proven defense methods, clear paths to leadership, and robust professional development, we empower attorneys to grow their careers, build their personal brands, and become leaders in the field.

jobs.title: Thermal Engineer, Rack Level
jobs.description:
About Etched
Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on inference. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.



Job Summary
We are seeking a Thermal Engineer, Rack Level to own the thermal design and validation of Etched’s L11 rack system: the liquid-cooled racks that carry our inference hardware into customer datacenters. You will take the rack from design through deployment. That means defining how it is filled, commissioned, and brought online, validating the reference CDU systems it runs on, and serving as the technical voice on facility integration for our go-to-market team and customers.

This role fits someone who has commissioned liquid cooling systems in a real datacenter and knows what goes wrong between the spec sheet and the white space. You will work closely with our tray- and module-level thermal engineers, with the mechanical, electrical, and systems teams, and with CDU and liquid-loop suppliers.



Key Responsibilities

 - Own thermal design and validation of the L11 rack system, including the rack-level liquid loop, manifolds, quick disconnects, and interfaces to facility cooling..

 - Develop and document deployment, fill, and commissioning processes for liquid-cooled racks, from first fill and leak checks through bring-up at customer sites.

 - Validate reference CDU systems. This includes writing and executing test plans in the lab and in the field, and qualifying CDU partners on thermal performance, reliability, and controls.

 - Characterize rack-level thermal and hydraulic performance (flow distribution, pressure drop, supply and return temperatures) and use the results to drive design decisions.

 - Define and validate cooling-loop control strategies and how they interact with datacenter facility control systems.

 - Support GTM and customers as the technical point of contact on facility integration questions, such as facility water requirements, CDU selection and sizing, secondary loop design, and water quality.

 - Partner with tray and module (L6–L10) thermal engineers so that server-level designs meet rack-level and facility constraints.

 - Create and maintain rack thermal specifications, commissioning procedures, validation reports, and customer-facing facility requirements documents.

 - Investigate and resolve thermal and fluid-related issues in the lab and in deployed systems.



You may be a good fit if you have

 - 5–10 years of experience in thermal or mechanical engineering with direct, hands-on CDU and datacenter liquid cooling experience.

 - Experience installing, commissioning, or validating liquid cooling systems at datacenter scale.

 - Experience with CDU validation and commissioning, including flow, pressure, temperature, and controls testing.

 - Strong working knowledge of datacenter cooling loops (facility water and technology cooling system / secondary loops) and the control systems that run them.

 - Comfort working directly with customers, facility teams, and suppliers to resolve integration issues.

 - A Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, or a related field.



Nice to have

 - Experience deploying rack-scale direct-to-chip liquid cooling for AI or HPC systems at a hyperscaler, server OEM, or CDU vendor.

 - Familiarity with industry guidelines for datacenter liquid cooling, such as OCP and ASHRAE TC 9.9.

 - Experience with 1D flow network or system-level thermal/hydraulic modeling tools (e.g., Flownex, MacroFlow).

 - Knowledge of coolant chemistry, filtration, leak detection, and fluid integrity testing.



Benefits

 - Medical, dental, and vision packages with generous premium coverage
   
   - $500 per month credit for waiving medical benefits

 - Housing subsidy of $2k per month for those living within walking distance of the office

 - Relocation support for those moving to San Jose (Santana Row)

 - Various wellness benefits covering fitness, mental health, and more

 - Daily lunch and dinner in our office

 - Unlimited compute budget subject to ROI justification



Compensation Range: $200,000 - $350,000 with significant equity.



How we’re different
Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson http://www.incompleteideas.net/IncIdeas/BitterLesson.html. We are the first inference-focused frontier AI system, betting early on transformer and transformer-like architectures and on increasing model sizes. Our addressable market is the entirety of inference, unlike many of our competitors.



We are a fully in-person team in San Jose (Santana Row), and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both and work across disciplines as needed.

jobs.title: Strategic Real Estate, Execution & Portfolio Management
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Position Summary

Anduril's real estate portfolio covers 10M sq ft of R&D labs, manufacturing hubs, and offices worldwide. As Execution & Portfolio Management Lead, you'll run our LOI and lease negotiations and manage a portion of the existing portfolio.

You'll report to the Director of Strategic Real Estate. When the Investments team reaches LOI on a new site, you'll take over and lead the negotiation through lease execution. You'll also own a set of existing sites, including renewals, in-building expansions, terminations, and the landlord relationships, and you'll work directly with the division teams who use that space.

This is a senior negotiation and portfolio strategy role, not lease administration or space planning. We're looking for someone who has led a large number of office and industrial lease negotiations and can judge which terms matter most for a given site and business need. The role has room to grow as the portfolio does.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead LOI and lease negotiations for new sites, renewals, expansions, and amendments across office, R&D, and industrial/manufacturing space, working with Investments, Legal, outside brokers, and Design & Construction.

• Standardize how Anduril leases space. Build and maintain template LOIs and lease forms, and set our standard positions and acceptable fallbacks on key terms.

• Manage a portion of the existing portfolio. Own renewals, in-building expansions, contractions, terminations, and subleases, and bring a recommendation on each well before the decision date.

• Own landlord relationships for your sites and resolve issues as they come up.

• Serve as the main real estate contact for division stakeholders at your sites. Understand how each team uses its space and what it will need next, and use that to shape renewal and expansion decisions.

• Track expirations, option and notice dates, termination rights, and other portfolio events, and start decisions early enough to keep our leverage with landlords.

• Work with the planning team to make sure lease decisions line up with the demand forecast.

• Hand signed deals off to Design & Construction for delivery, and stay involved where lease terms affect the build.

• Report on portfolio status and present recommendations to leadership.

Qualifications and Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Real Estate, Finance, Business Administration, Urban Planning, or a related field.

• 7+ years of experience in corporate real estate transactions, tenant or landlord representation, or real estate development or asset management.

• A record of leading office and industrial lease negotiations from LOI through execution, including renewals and expansions.

• Detailed knowledge of commercial lease terms, including TI allowances, renewal and expansion options, ROFO/ROFR, termination rights, operating expense provisions, restoration, and holdover.

• Strong financial analysis of lease options, including net effective rent and NPV comparisons, in Excel.

• Experience working with legal counsel on lease drafting and with brokers on market strategy.

• Ability to travel up to 25% for site visits and landlord meetings.

• U.S. citizenship required; eligibility for security clearance preferred.

Preferred Skills

• JD or real estate license.

• Experience leasing manufacturing or R&D space with heavy power, specialized improvements, or build-to-suit components.

• Experience with leases for secure facilities (SCIFs, DCSA requirements).

• Experience building lease templates or standard negotiating positions for a corporate portfolio.

• Comfort using LLMs and data tools to speed up lease review and portfolio reporting.

US Salary Range

$145,000—$195,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Platform
jobs.description:
THE MISSION 💪

Our mission is to ensure that no one in the world has to suffer from a treatable skin disease because of an access issue ever again.




ABOUT HONEYDEW 👋

Honeydew is building a platform for hundreds of millions of people globally to access expertise and science-backed skin treatments, from prescription to retail. Our tech-forward dermatology experience helps people with chronic skin conditions access licensed specialists, FDA-approved treatment, and ongoing support in record time. Honeydew is the future of skin health — digitally native, scientifically rooted, integrated end-to-end, and powered by AI.




THE OPPORTUNITY 📈

Our feature teams can only move as fast as the platform underneath them, and we want to help them move faster. As a Platform Engineer, you’ll contribute to the work that makes our platform stronger, from moving our data layer onto RDS, to tightening security and compliance across our multi-account AWS organization, to building tooling that speeds up every team shipping on top of it. You’ll review and test your teammates’ work, and partner with feature teams and other stakeholders to shape what our platform can do next.




WHAT YOU'LL BUILD (YOUR FIRST 6 MONTHS) 🛠

 - By day 60: Standardize and optimize our logging for AI-supported troubleshooting across the platform.

 - Day 61-180: Implement processes and infrastructure for AI agents to autonomously open PRs to resolve dependency vulnerabilities and other issues

 - And more platform and security-related improvements TBD!




HOW YOU'LL MAKE AN IMPACT

Build the platform. You'll work with the engineering manager to identify and plan projects, then execute them using agentic engineering methods.

Harden data and security. You'll deliver the migration, security, and compliance work that keeps our data stores, APIs, and cloud infrastructure safe and reliable.

Enable the feature teams. You'll assist other teams with data and security requests, and review other engineers' code, so everyone ships faster on a solid foundation.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The Non-Negotiables:

 - Object-oriented programming language with strong data and architecture skills — production experience building backend services and APIs, and current best practices in data modeling and system architecture

 - Platform security — you've secured platform-layer components, including data stores, APIs, and cloud infrastructure, applying current best practices for access control, encryption, and audit logging

 - Infrastructure and automation — hands-on experience building and operating production infrastructure with infrastructure as code (CDK, Terraform, or CloudFormation) and CI/CD pipelines

The Nice-to-Haves:

 - Experience in healthcare setting, or another heavily regulated domain

 - Experience building and using custom agents

 - Experience with Typescript, AWS, serverless functions, PostgreSQL


YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF…

 - You make a plan and execute to that plan and timeline.

 - You identify and report timeline issues early.

 - You identify and champion opportunities to improve the ecosystem you work in.

 - You keep up with current best practices, including AI-assisted engineering.

 - You give direct, useful feedback in code review.

 - You request and give help when needed.

 - You write things down so the next engineer can rely on them.




OUR TECH STACK

 - Languages: TypeScript, Python, SQL

 - Frontend: React, Redux Toolkit, Material UI, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Next.js

 - Backend: Node.js on AWS Lambda, GraphQL (AWS AppSync, Apollo), REST (API Gateway), event-driven architecture (EventBridge, SQS, SNS), authentication (Cognito)

 - Data: PostgreSQL (RDS), DynamoDB, OpenSearch, S3

 - Infrastructure: AWS (multi-account, Control Tower, CloudFormation, IAM, SSM, CloudWatch, CloudTrail), Terraform, Serverless Framework, Docker, LocalStack, Git, CI/CD on Bitbucket Pipelines and GitHub Actions

 - Analytics: Databricks, dbt, Amplitude

 - AI: OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, Cursor

 - Testing: Vitest, Jest, Playwright

jobs.title: Director of Strategic Finance
jobs.description:
The short version

Nift is a profitable, roughly 60-person company with $50M+ in annual revenue, and our finance function hasn't caught up to the business yet. We're hiring our first Director of Strategic Finance to own planning and forecasting end to end, and to rebuild how finance gets its numbers.

That second part matters. Today, too much of our finance work runs through spreadsheets, manual uploads, and vendor-by-vendor cleanup. You'll have an engineering partner, budget for tools, and a Head of Finance who wants to review your model, not build it. If you write your own SQL, think in three statements, and get a kick out of replacing a manual process with one that runs itself, keep reading.

This is a director role on purpose. It's built for a strong senior manager or director who wants full ownership and more headroom, not a large team to delegate to.

About Nift

Nift’s mission is to reshape how people discover and try new brands by introducing them to new products and services through thoughtful "thank-you" gifts. Our customer-first approach ensures businesses acquire new customers efficiently while making customers feel valued and rewarded. We are a data-driven, cash-flow-positive company that has experienced 731% growth over the last three years. Now, we’re scaling to become one of the largest sources for new customer acquisition worldwide.

Backed by Spark Capital & Foundry who also invested in Slack, Snap, SeatGeek, Fitbit, Warby Parker, Wayfair and Twitter, we are poised for exponential growth and ready to demonstrate impact on a global scale. Read more about our growth here.

What you'll own

The job has three parts, in this order of priority.

1. Planning and forecasting, end to end

• Run the annual operating plan. Build the departmental OpEx and headcount templates, walk each leader through them, and turn their inputs into one driver-based plan.

• Own the operating model: revenue, gross profit, OpEx, headcount, EBITDA, working capital, and cash, plus a 3 to 5-year long-range plan.

• Reforecast on a regular cadence and run monthly budget-vs-actual reviews with department heads, so we know where every team is pacing before the quarter ends.

• Own short- and long-term cash flow forecasting, including collections and payment timing.

• Build the monthly reporting package and the Board materials with the Head of Finance. When the Board asks why R&D spend is under plan, you have the answer and the story behind it (for example, hires landing later than planned).

2. Finance systems, automation, and process

• Lead the move from spreadsheet-driven finance operations to automated, system-to-system workflows. Current examples: connecting our database to our invoicing platform via API, and automating partner payout calculations into payables.

• Partner with an engineer on the product team: write the requirements, define the logic, check the numbers, and run user acceptance testing until it works the way finance needs it to.

• Define how the general ledger should be structured so leadership gets the cost visibility it needs (by team, function, and initiative, not just broad class), then work with accounting on the cleanup and on keeping new entries coded correctly.

• Evaluate and select finance tools, such as a planning platform, where they earn their keep.

• Use AI where it actually saves time: variance commentary, data validation, recurring reporting.

3. Analysis that drives decisions

• Measure payback on our sales investment by team (enterprise and mid-market) in months, not adjectives.

• Build advertiser and partner cohort, retention, and spend-distribution analysis by segment.

• Turn open-ended questions into a clear point of view. "Is this campaign working?" "Model this new business line." "Show investors our partners are sticky." You decide the right methodology (for example, when a short pilot should be excluded from retention), document it, and tell the story the data supports.

• Write your own SQL against our production data (read access) and your own finance schema. No waiting on a data team for a pull.

Your first year

First 90 days: take ownership of the operating model and the annual plan, run your first monthly close review with accounting, and deliver your first reporting package and Board pack.

By month 6: a driver-based plan and rolling forecast that leaders actually use to make decisions. A monthly cadence where the books close on a predictable timeline and variances are explained, not just reported. At least one manual workflow (invoicing or partner payouts) running system to system.

By month 12: cash forecasting you trust, a ledger structure that answers "what does this team cost?" without manual rework, sales payback and cohort analysis on a regular rhythm, and a finance function that runs without the Head of Finance doing the day-to-day.

What you bring

Must-haves

• 7+ years in FP&A or strategic finance. Investment banking or transaction advisory works too, as long as you've since owned planning and forecasting in an operating company.

• Strong, hands-on SQL. You query, join, and reconcile messy data yourself. Using AI to write queries is great; it doesn't replace knowing what the query should do.

• Full ownership of a P&L's planning, either at a smaller company or for a division that ran like its own business. You've owned the whole model, not one line of it.

• Mastery of the three statements and how the income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow connect.

• A track record of building something in finance that didn't exist before: a process, a model, a reporting pipeline, or an automation.

• The ability to turn analysis into a clear recommendation for a CEO or a Board.

Nice-to-haves

• Experience in performance marketing, adtech, martech, ecommerce, consumer, SaaS, or another data-heavy, variable-cost business.

• Cohort, retention, LTV, and unit economics work.

• Exposure to finance systems projects: invoicing, payables, planning tools, or an ERP rollout, including working with engineers and running UAT.

• Board reporting or investor materials.

What doesn't matter: your degree or where you went to school. A philosophy major with a decade of great FP&A work is a strong candidate.

Is this for you?

We'd rather be upfront than oversell it.

This role is not:

• Accounting. Our accounting team runs the close, AP/AR, payroll, and the audit relationship. You'll partner with them on close reviews, audit schedules, and data quality, but you won't run the books.

• A deal job. We're profitable and not raising right now, and there's little M&A. You'll support the Board and investors, but if you want a steady diet of transaction modeling, this isn't it.

• A role with a team underneath you on day one. You'll build and run the work yourself. A team may come as the function grows.

You'll love it here if: you see a messy, manual process and want to be the one who fixes it. You'd rather be handed a blank page ("build the business case") than a checklist. And you're excited, not annoyed, that some of the basics still need to be built.

It probably isn't a fit if: you're used to directing a team and want to keep doing that, or you'd see this title as a step sideways.

jobs.title: Strategic Real Estate, Portfolio Planning & Strategy Lead
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Position Summary
Anduril's real estate portfolio covers 10M sq ft of R&D labs, manufacturing hubs, and offices worldwide. As Portfolio Planning & Strategy Lead, you will own the planning process that decides how much space Anduril needs, of what type, where, and when.

You'll report to the Director of Strategic Real Estate. You'll turn headcount plans, program schedules, and portfolio data into forecasts of demand and supply. You'll measure how well we use what we already have, and make the case for what to do next to division leaders and the C-suite.

This is a hands-on senior role. It suits someone who builds their own models and can work from incomplete, inconsistent data. You should already use LLMs and modern data platforms (Palantir Foundry or similar) in your work. The ideal candidate combines real estate and financial judgment with a builder's instinct and a creative, tech-forward approach to problems that have no playbook.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the Real Estate Planning Cycle. Run the quarterly portfolio forecast end to end:

• Gather headcount and program plans from Finance, Corporate Operations, and the business divisions;

• Reconcile competing plans into one view of demand by division, workforce type, and region;

• Publish the 5–10 year outlook that portfolio decisions rest on;

• Track plan vs. actual across forecast versions, and explain why the numbers moved.

• Portfolio Demand & Supply Forecasting. Forecast seat, office, R&D, and production space demand against current and committed supply. Quantify the gaps by market and year. Model scenarios (growth cases, program wins and losses, M&A, relocations, divestitures) and their OpEx and CapEx impact.

• Efficiency & Utilization Measurement. Define and track the metrics that show whether the portfolio is working: SF per head, seat ratios, utilization, cost per seat, and production space relative to output. Benchmark them against peers. Turn the findings into recommendations to consolidate, densify, restructure leases, or expand.

• Workforce Strategy. Work with Talent, People, and division leaders to understand how Anduril grows: hiring velocity, workforce mix (engineering, production, G&A), in-office patterns, and talent markets. Translate that into location strategy, market selection, and site timing.

• Executive Communications. Build and present the decision materials that get C-suite and division-leader decisions made: quarterly business reviews, expansion option analyses, and leadership briefings. Lead with the answer, show the math, and stand behind the numbers.

• Build the Planning System, Not Just the Plan. Maintain and extend our planning data pipeline and models (Palantir Foundry, Python/SQL, version-controlled datasets with automated validation), so forecasts are repeatable, auditable, and refreshable in hours. Use LLM-based agents to automate data extraction, reconciliation, analysis, and presentation production, and set the standard for how the team uses them.

Qualifications and Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Real Estate, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Data / Information Science, Urban Planning, Engineering, or a related field.

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in strategic real estate planning, corporate portfolio strategy, FP&A, capacity or workforce planning, real estate investing (equity or credit), development, or corporate development, including experience leading or mentoring analysts/associates.

• Strong financial and analytical modeling. You build your own models in Excel and Python or SQL, and can defend every number in them.

• Hands-on use of LLMs and modern data platforms (Palantir Foundry or similar, such as Databricks, Snowflake, or dbt) in your current work.

• Excellent communication, with a demonstrated capacity to influence cross-functional teams and senior executives.

• Ability to travel up to 10% for site visits, stakeholder meetings, and industry events.

• U.S. citizenship required; eligibility for security clearance preferred.

Preferred Skills

• Experience forecasting space for manufacturing, R&D, or other capital-intensive operations, not only office.

• A track record of building forecasts from incomplete or conflicting plan data, and explaining to leadership why they changed.

• Experience planning around M&A integration, relocations, or consolidations.

• Background in defense, aerospace, or another fast-growing hardware company.

US Salary Range

$185,000—$240,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

OUR TECH STACK

At Xero, we’re here to supercharge small businesses. By making small business more efficient every day, connecting them with big business technology and empowering a community behind them, their potential is limitless. When that happens, we’re not only helping small business, we’ll be building a stronger economy that can change the world.At Xero, we’re here to supercharge small businesses. By making small business more efficient every day, connecting them with big business technology and empowering a community behind them, their potential is limitless. When that happens, we’re not only helping small business, we’ll be building a stronger economy that can change the world.




THE ROLE & TEAM 

As GM, Legal - Global Employment, you will own how Xero supports its people and manages employment risk across a global technology business. You are the senior strategic legal partner to PX (our people experience organisation) and a trusted adviser to Xero's executive leadership team on workforce strategy, organisational change, and complex employment matters. You bring sound judgement to the highest-impact issues, while setting the global frameworks, standards, and tools that let the wider business manage routine matters with confidence and consistency.



This is a functional leadership role with no direct reports, suited to someone who leads through expertise, influence, and delivery rather than headcount. You will set the direction for global employment legal support, work closely with regional Legal teams and other REAL (Risk, Ethics, Advocacy and Legal) specialists, and personally take on the matters that call for deep experience and judgement. You will also partner with Employee Relations on the legal dimensions of sensitive investigations and employee matters, complementing their operational expertise with strategic legal advice. 

This role reports to the SVP/EGM Legal and can be based in San Mateo, Melbourne or Sydney.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Partner with PX leadership and senior business leaders on workforce strategy, organisational design, restructures, reward, senior employee matters and cross-border initiatives.

 - Provide clear, practical advice on global employment and labour law, including investigations, performance management, discrimination and harassment, contracts, policies, disputes and regulatory matters.

 - Set and own Xero's global employment legal strategy, risk framework, standards, escalation paths, playbooks and self-service resources.

 - Partner with regional Legal GMs on routine employment matters and ensure consistent, coordinated advice across jurisdictions.

 - Lead complex employment disputes, claims, regulatory inquiries and sensitive investigations.

 - Support the employment aspects of M&A, integrations and major business change.

 - Manage external employment counsel and drive proportionate, cost-effective use of external advice.

 - Build training, tools and AI-enabled resources that help PX and leaders manage routine matters confidently.

 - Work collaboratively with other members of the REAL team to bring the right expertise together on global workforce matters.


SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - PX and senior leaders see you as a trusted strategic partner on workforce strategy and change.

 - Xero has clear, scalable and practical global employment frameworks.

 - Complex employment risks are identified early and managed consistently.

 - Legal support is technology-enabled, using AI tools and self-service modalities where appropriate.

 - External counsel is used strategically, with stronger internal capability and better cost control.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Essential

 - Substantial international employment experience and proven experience supporting labour and employment in a global organisation, advising across multiple jurisdictions and operating effectively across regions and time zones. 

 - Experience in New Zealand, Australia, the United States and the United Kingdom is highly desirable.

 - Deep expertise in global employment and labour law, including complex investigations, disputes, restructures and workforce strategy.

 - Experience directing others’ work without direct reports, and influencing without formal authority.

 - A track record of advising senior PX/HR leaders and business executives as a strategic partner.

 - Strong judgement, commercial awareness and the ability to explain complex issues in plain language.

 - Experience managing external employment counsel and building scalable legal processes and resources.

 - The ability to influence without formal authority, and to roll up your sleeves and do the work personally.

Strongly preferred

 - Breadth beyond employment law, such as litigation, transactional work or corporate governance. You are a T-shaped generalist, able to step into work outside your core area.

 - Experience in a mid-market technology company of a similar size to Xero, or another fast-moving global business. 

 - An interest in using data, technology and AI to improve legal support.




WHERE AND HOW YOU CAN WORK

This role  can be based in San Mateo, California,  Melbourne or Sydney. This role is based in Sydney or Melbourne with a flexible hybrid working setup, spending 1 to 2 days per week in the local office to connect and collaborate.

 

Apply even if your experience isn't a perfect match! At Xero, we hire based on your skills, passion, and the unique perspective you can bring to enhance our culture and team.

jobs.title: Manager, Forward Deployed Healthcare Analytics
jobs.description:
Opportunity Overview:

We are looking for a Manager, Forward Deployed Healthcare Analytics to play a key role in delivering value for our Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) customers. Reporting into our Senior Manager you will be part of a small, fast-paced team working directly with clients to strategically design, execute, and maintain a robust prior authorization decisioning automation program. Ultimately, the work you do will have a direct impact on the growth of the company and our ability to assist more patients at a time in their healthcare journey when they need help most.

What you’ll do:

• Consult Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) clients on designing an optimal decision automation program and develop strategic roadmaps

• Manage and mentor a team of direct reports, enabling execution, prioritization, and professional development

• Enhance the scale and efficacy of the Forward Deployed Automation Strategy team through process optimization, streamlined analytics framework, and AI tooling.

• Partner with Product, Development, Design, and Engineering teams in scoping new and enhanced product features to meet client automation needs

• Translate complex client requirements into a detailed technical blueprints for development teams to leverage when implementing new clients

• Analyze authorization and claims data, leverage data visualization softwares to build and maintain analytical reports that inform internal and external stakeholders on platform performance

• Ensure client’s KPIs are met and ensure end-to-end automation success for the portfolio of clients through each stage of customer lifecycle

What you’ll need:

• 8+ years in a data-centric, client-facing role

• Passionate about improving U.S. healthcare and patient outcomes; understanding of healthcare systems, terminology, and regulations strongly preferred

• Comfortable navigating ethical considerations in healthcare data management

• SQL proficiency for complex healthcare datasets; skilled with Tableau/Power BI, Excel, and PowerPoint

• Strong leadership, client management, and communication skills; able to juggle multiple priorities independently in ambiguous, fast-paced settings

• Skilled at cross-functional collaboration and translating problems into product/KPI improvements

• Management Consulting or HealthTech experience preferred

• Bachelor's degree required; MBA/MPH or equivalent preferred

Pay & Perks:

💻 Fully remote opportunity with about 5% travel

🩺 Medical, dental, vision, life, disability insurance, and Employee Assistance Program

📈 401K retirement plan with company match; flexible spending and health savings account

🏝️ Flex Time Off + company holidays

👶 Up to 14 weeks of paid parental leave

🐶 Pet insurance

The salary range for this position is $123,000 to $148,000 annually; as part of a total benefits package which includes health insurance, 401k and bonus. In accordance with state applicable laws, Cohere is required to provide a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. Individual pay decisions are ultimately based on a number of factors, including but not limited to qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and internal alignment.

Interview Process*:

• Connect with Talent Acquisition for a Preliminary Phone Screening

• Meet your Hiring Manager

• Case Study and presentation

• Behavioral Interview

• Leadership Interview

*Subject to change

About Cohere Health:

Cohere Health’s clinical intelligence platform and agentic AI-powered solutions connect health plans’ strategic goals and providers’ needs, optimizing the speed, cost, and quality of care. With an enterprise approach that streamlines payer-provider decision-making across the care continuum–including policy, prior authorization, payment accuracy, and more–the company improves collaboration and reduces burden, resulting in up to 8x ROI and 94% provider satisfaction.

With the acquisition of ZignaAI, we’ve further enhanced our platform by launching our Payment Integrity Suite, anchored by Cohere Validate™, an AI-driven clinical and coding validation solution that operates in near real-time. By unifying pre-service authorization data with post-service claims validation, we’re creating a transparent healthcare ecosystem that reduces waste, improves payer-provider collaboration and patient outcomes, and ensures providers are paid promptly and accurately.

Cohere Health’s innovations continue to receive industry wide recognition. We’ve been named to the 2025 Inc. 5000 list and in the Gartner® Hype Cycle™ for U.S. Healthcare Payers (2022-2025), and ranked as a Top 5 LinkedIn™ Startup for 2023 & 2024. Backed by leading investors such as Deerfield Management, Define Ventures, Flare Capital Partners, Longitude Capital, and Polaris Partners.

The Coherenauts, as we call ourselves, who succeed here are empathetic teammates who are candid, kind, caring, and embody our core values and principles. We believe that diverse, inclusive teams make the most impactful work. Cohere is deeply invested in ensuring that we have a supportive, growth-oriented environment that works for everyone.

We can’t wait to learn more about you and meet you at Cohere Health!

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Cohere Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all.  To us, it’s personal.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Oncology
jobs.description:
A Rare Opportunity to Shape the Future of Genomics

Join a team of brilliant, passionate innovators determined to transform healthcare. At BillionToOne, we've built a category-defining, publicly traded company on Nasdaq where transparency fuels trust, collaboration drives breakthroughs, and every contribution moves the needle on our mission to make life-changing diagnostics accessible to all. We don't just aim for incremental improvements; we build products that are 10x better than anything that exists today.

Our scientists, engineers, sales executives, and visionaries are united by an unwavering commitment to changing the standard of care in prenatal and cancer diagnostics. This is where cutting-edge science meets human compassion, and every innovation you contribute helps remove the fear of the unknown from some of life's most critical medical moments.

If you're driven by purpose, energized by innovation, and ready to help shape the future of precision medicine at scale, this is where you belong.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, Oncology to lead and manage our therapy selection product family, Northstar Select. This role will be working closely with R&D, clinical, engineering, sales, marketing, and company leadership to lead new assay development as well as existing assay enhancements. The ideal candidate has experience launching molecular diagnostic testing assays (including FDA-approved assays), is obsessed with delivering a delightful customer experience, and thrives in a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment. This role is an hybrid (onsite 3 days/week) position and reports directly to the Head of Product, Oncology.

Responsibilities:

• Understand the market and design a winning product concept: As the product owner, you need to be Number 1 expert within the company about the user needs and desires, the market, and how our technology assets can solve their problems.

• Plan and execute product launch: Understand and plan for every element that touches the product launch, including the core clinical assay, the user-facing software apps, the internal workflow, regulatory and legal constraints, and requirements, and support teams focused on marketing and PR activities, etc. Work with a wide range of departments to execute on the product launch.

• End-to-end user experience: Our product is not just the genetic testing panel but the entire experience of ordering a test, sending the blood sample, and receiving the result. You are responsible for designing and delivering the most seamless and delightful user experience for the entire process, together with a UX designer and other stakeholders.

• Program management: You are responsible for getting the product to the finish line by mobilizing relevant internal and external resources. This can involve many elements of general project and program management tasks such as driving timelines, getting stakeholders to agree on a solution, sourcing external vendors, etc.

• Continuous iterations and improvements: As the product owner, you are the biggest advocate for the users. You are responsible for monitoring the users' voice and behaviors, the key metrics, and key market trends for the product-line and identify areas of improvement.

Qualifications:

• 5-10 years of experience in product management (title & compensation commensurate with experience)

• Experience driving product vision, go-to-market strategy, and product requirements

• Experience with launching a product from start to finish

• Experience working with diverse teams to gather requirements and rally them to get a complex product launched

• Experience with IVD product management

• Experience with launching and managing NGS-based diagnostic testing assays is a strong plus

• Experience with launching and managing clinical genetic testing products is a huge plus

Nice-To-Haves:

• Oncology Experience a plus

• Another advanced degree (Masters/PhD) in molecular biology, bioengineering, medicine, chemical biology, or a related field is strongly preferred

Benefits And Perks:

• Working alongside brilliant, kind, passionate and dedicated colleagues, in an empowering environment, toward a global vision, striving for a future in which transformative molecular diagnostics can help millions of patients

• Open, transparent culture that includes weekly Town Hall meetings

• The ability to indirectly or directly change the lives of hundreds of thousands patients

• Multiple medical benefit options; employee premiums paid 100% of select plans, dependents covered up to 80%

• Extremely generous Family Bonding Leave for eligible employees (16 weeks, paid at 100%)

• Supplemental fertility benefits coverage

• Retirement savings program including a 4% Company match

• Increase paid time off with increased tenure

• Latest and greatest hardware (laptop, lab equipment, facilities)

• Free daily on-site lunches provided from top eateries

• A variety of perks on campus (state of the art gym, restaurant)

• Free on-site EV charging (compatible with all EVs, including Tesla)

At BillionToOne, we are proud to offer a combination of a base pay range (actual amount offered is based on experience and salary/equity options split that the candidate chooses), (2) generous equity options offering, (3) corporate bonus program, on top of (4) industry leading company benefits (free healthcare options, 401k match, very generous fully paid parental leave, etc.).

For this position, we offer a total compensation package of $295,200 per year, including a base pay range of $174,068 - $195,826 per year.

BillionToOne is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

For more information about how we protect your information, we encourage you to review our Privacy Policy.

BillionToOne is a next-generation molecular diagnostics company on a mission to make powerful, accurate diagnostic tests accessible to everyone. Our revolutionary QCT molecular counting technology enhances disease detection resolution by over a thousandfold using cell-free DNA,a breakthrough that has already transformed the lives of over half a million patients worldwide.

Our Impact

Unity Complete™ is the only non-invasive prenatal screen capable of assessing fetal risk for both common recessive conditions and aneuploidies from a single maternal blood sample.
Unity Confirm™ enables non-invasive confirmation for high-risk screening results through the capture of intact circulating fetal cells using BillionToOne’s Fetal Cell Capture™ Technology.
Our Northstar® liquid biopsy test uniquely combines treatment selection with real-time monitoring, giving oncologists unprecedented precision in cancer care.

Our Growth

From $0 to $400M+ annualized revenue run-rate in just 6 years. In 2025, we completed one of the most successful IPOs for a medical diagnostics company, building on nearly $400M in private funding,including our $130M Series D in 2024 and backed by world-class investors including Hummingbird, Adams Street Partners, Neuberger Berman, Baillie Gifford, and Premji Invest.

Our Recognition

Forbes named us one of America's Best Startup Employers for 2025 and we're Great Place to Work certified, with 100% of our people willing to go the extra mile, even as we've scaled to over 700 employees.

Our Future

Headquartered in Menlo Park with facilities in Union City, CA, and a new lab opening in Austin, TX in 2027, we're continuing to push the boundaries of what's possible in molecular diagnostics. We're just getting started.

Ready to help us change the world, one molecule at a time? Learn more at billiontoone.com

jobs.title: Lead Infrastructure Security Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Company

We are a renewable energy and ocean technology company committed to rapidly developing and deploying technologies that will ensure a sustainable future for Earth by unlocking the vast energy potential of its oceans. Our focus is on capturing civilizational levels of ultra-low-cost renewable energy for applications including computing and affordable renewable fuels delivered to shore.

The company is a public benefit corporation headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and backed by leading venture capitalists, philanthropic investors, university endowments, and private investment offices. We operate as an idea meritocracy in which the best ideas change the company’s direction on a regular basis.

Our staff have worked at organizations such as SpaceX, Blue Origin, Boeing, Tesla, Apple, Virgin Orbit, Astra, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, New Relic, Bridgewater, Raytheon, Disney Imagineering, and the US Army and Air Force, as well as research universities, startups, and small companies across a range of industries.

About the Job

Our core technology is the node, a device that produces energy in the ocean’s harshest conditions for years at a time without human maintenance or intervention.

As a Lead Infrastructure Security Engineer, you will help scale our security capabilities as we develop technology to harness renewable energy from the ocean. Working closely with the Head of Information Security, you'll strengthen our infrastructure and software security through threat modeling, architecture reviews, automation, and incident response. Candidates should possess broad security infrastructure and engineering skills, as well as professionally useful software engineering skills, and be able to quickly come up to speed with languages and frameworks with which they have not previously worked.

Candidates should have strong interpersonal skills and be able to thrive in a creative, scrappy, and collaborative environment in which the best ideas change the company’s direction on a regular basis.

Responsibilities

• Assist the Head of Information Security with building out the InfraSec and SecEng functions at Panthalassa.

• Conduct infrastructure, code, and service architecture reviews to provide security guidance.

• Lead engineers in threat modelling service and deployments.

• Work with the Head of Information Security to define culturally useful security metrics.

• Assist in interviewing and onboarding of other Security personnel.

• Assist with incident response and handling now while we grow, and provide escalation support for incidents later as we have grown.

• Integrate, maintain, and automate security scanning tools (SAST, DAST, SCA, and secrets management) directly into our CI/CD pipelines.

• Build and integrate agentic security tools for Panthalassa needs.

• Conduct hands-on threat modeling and architectural design reviews for new features and deployments before code is written.

• Perform manual and automated reviews as well as targeted penetration testing on platforms and internal components.

• Help manage the company’s external Vulnerability Disclosure or Bug Bounty programs and translate regulatory compliance requirements into practical engineering tasks.

Required Qualifications

• 6+ years of experience with Infrastructure Security and general Security Engineering processes.

• 2+ years of experience as a Team Lead or Manager of a Security team.

• Both broad in general and deep in places Security foundational knowledge.

• Experience with using AI systems and agents for security outcomes in a professional capacity.

• Deep hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and modern infrastructure tools like Docker, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or equivalent practical experience.

Desired Qualifications

• Experience with software development work related to mechanical engineering environments.

• Hands-on experience with industry-standard security tools (e.g. Snyk, GitHub Advanced Security, Burp Suite, Fortify).

• Familiarity with the OWASP Top 10, CWE Top 25, and secure design patterns.

The above qualifications are desired, not required. We encourage you to apply if you are a strong candidate with only some of the desired skills and experience listed.

Additional Requirements

• Travel to conferences, vendors and test sites as needed.

• Intermittently able to work longer hours and weekends to support critical needs. While we expect a lot of each other, we also offer a high degree of autonomy and work-life balance, including flexible PTO and flexible working hours.

Compensation and Benefits

If hired for this full-time role, you will receive:

• Cash compensation of $180,000 - $250,000.

• Equity in the company. We’re all owners and if we’re successful, this equity should be far and away the most valuable component of your compensation.

• A benefits package that helps you take care of yourself and your family, including: Flexible paid time off Health insurance (the company pays 100% of gold-level PPO plan for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents) Dental insurance (the company pays 100% for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents) Vision insurance (the company pays 100% for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents) Disability insurance (the company pays 100% for a policy to provide long-term financial support if you become disabled) Ability to contribute to tax-advantaged accounts, including 401(k), health FSA, and dependent care FSA

• Relocation assistance to facilitate your move to Portland (if needed).

Location

This is a flexible hybrid position based in Portland, Oregon. You may work remotely most of the time, but are expected to come into the office when in-person collaboration or business needs make it beneficial. The frequency of in-office work is not fixed and may increase as the company grows. For this reason, we encourage candidates to live in or near Portland. We may consider fully remote arrangements for exceptional candidates.

jobs.title: Product Designer (All Levels)
jobs.location: Atlanta, Georgia, United States; New York City
jobs.description:
THE POSITION
Our roster has an opening with your name on it

We are always looking for exceptional Product Designers to join the FanDuel Sportsbook product organization. Rather than hire against a single opening, we keep this role open on a rolling basis so we can meet and bring on outstanding design talent as we find it. We hire across four levels: Product Designer, Senior Product Designer, Lead Product Designer, and Principal UI Designer —and place each person where they will have the greatest impact.

This role sits on our Sportsbook Product Design team - the designers who own everything at the intersection of the FanDuel Sportsbook app and the customers who use it. You'll partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Research, Analytics, and other design disciplines to understand what customers need, define what success looks like, and deliver thoughtful, customer-centered design from discovery through launch and optimization. You won't be tied to a single domain or problem space on day one; as we get to know you, we'll align you to the biggest opportunities on the team and explore the right fit together through the interview process.

Because this role spans levels, we calibrate the right level and compensation at offer - based on the scope, impact, and craft excellence you've demonstrated - and we'll be transparent about the level we're considering you for early on.

Not sure which level fits you best? Apply anyway, and we'll figure it out together.

As a Product Designer, excellence is execution-driven. You own design end to end - translating strategy into thoughtful design solutions and driving delivery across a set of related capabilities. You make sharp prioritization calls, keep your work moving with clarity, apply strong craft judgment, and your impact shows up in the quality and momentum of what you ship.

As a Senior Product Designer, the work broadens from executing a plan to shaping one. You stay close to delivery, but you set the direction for a meaningful part of the Sportsbook experience, frame ambiguous problems clearly, tie your team's work to business outcomes, and begin to lift the people around you - mentoring other designers and raising the bar on how the team operates.

As a Lead Product Designer, excellence becomes strategic and includes cross-team leadership. You set direction across multiple areas of the customer experience, own a broad slice of the Sportsbook product, and are accountable for outcomes well beyond your own hands-on work. You elevate the work of others - you improve design practices, influence product strategy, and help teams consistently deliver exceptional customer experiences.

In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs.

THE GAME PLAN
Everyone on our team has a part to play

Design Execution & Delivery

• Own the delivery of design outcomes - from problem framing through prototyping, implementation support, launch, and post-launch iteration - for your area of the product.

• Create intuitive user flows, wireframes, prototypes, visual designs, interaction details, and implementation documentation.

• Explore multiple directions and make clear recommendations based on evidence, customer insight, trade-offs, and product impact.

• Contribute to and evolve the design system by identifying gaps, proposing improvements, and designing scalable components or patterns when appropriate.

Discovery & Customer Insight

• Represent the voice of the customer through research, user feedback, analytics, and competitive analysis.

• Lead discovery and experimentation - usability testing, A/B tests, and design explorations - to de-risk initiatives and refine solutions.

• Use qualitative and quantitative data to inform design decisions and validate hypotheses.

Strategy & Outcomes

• Define clear product direction and success metrics, connecting your work to team and business priorities.

• Track and report objectively on design impact and outcomes, and recommend pivots grounded in evidence.

Collaboration & Systems Thinking

• Partner proactively with Product Management, Engineering, Research, Analytics, and other design disciplines to define goals, evaluate trade-offs, and align on direction.

• Facilitate workshops, design critiques, and stakeholder conversations that drive clarity and alignment.

• Build and maintain domain expertise on the product, market, and competitive landscape.

• Apply AI-assisted workflows thoughtfully across discovery, ideation, prototyping, synthesis, and documentation, and independently evaluate outputs for accuracy, usability, accessibility, design-system fit, and product relevance.

THE STATS
What we're looking for in our next teammate

What you bring

• A track record of shipping thoughtful, customer-centered products.

• Strong craft skills across interaction design, visual design, systems thinking, prototyping, and accessibility.

• Hands-on fluency with modern design practices, design thinking, and evidence-based decision making.

• Strong analytical skills - comfortable using research, analytics, and feedback to inform and validate design decisions.

• Exceptional communication and collaboration skills; ability to influence without formal authority.

• Deep customer empathy and a commitment to accessibility and inclusive design.

• A strong sense of ownership, a bias toward execution, and comfort operating in ambiguity.

Experience

• 3+ years of experience in product design or a closely related role to start.

• The scope you own, the strategic influence you carry, and the craft leadership we look for grow with the level you're hired into.

Nice to have

• Bachelor's degree preferred.

• Experience in sports betting, iGaming, or another fast-moving, regulated consumer technology domain.

• Familiarity with front-end development concepts (React Native, JavaScript, component-based UI) to support stronger engineering collaboration.

ABOUT FANDUEL

FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America’s #1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry’s unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product.

In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV+, its leading direct-to-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico.

The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company’s affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia.

FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT).

PLAYER BENEFITS
We treat our team right

We offer amazing benefits above and beyond the basics. We have an array of health plans to choose from (some as low as $0 per paycheck) that include programs for fertility and family planning, mental health support, and fitness benefits. We offer generous paid time off (PTO & sick leave), annual bonus and long-term incentive opportunities (based on performance), 401k with up to a 5% match, commuter benefits, pet insurance, and more - check out all our benefits here: FanDuel Total Rewards. *Benefits differ across location, role, and level.

jobs.title: Security Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT ONEPAY

OnePay is the consumer fintech trusted by millions of Americans to make money better.

Our financial system is broken. High fees, low rates, and too few ways to actually grow your money. We’re fixing it. And we’re moving fast.

We’re an all-in-one financial services platform that brings together banking, high-yield savings, credit cards, point-of-sale lending, investing, and crypto in one place. We also partner with employers, HCM providers, gig platforms, and others to deliver embedded financial services to millions of employees and frontline workers.

We’re backed by Walmart, the world’s largest retailer, and Ribbit Capital, one of fintech’s most respected investors, giving us rare scale, distribution, and the opportunity to build something truly category-defining.

But what really sets OnePay apart is how we move. Our customers don’t have time to wait… and neither do we. This place moves fast, and we’re looking for people who are:

 - Ready to run

 - Hungry and driven by urgency

 - Exceptional at what they do, with low ego

 - Comfortable operating in motion




THE ROLE

As a Corporate Security Automation Engineer at OnePay, you will lead the design, implementation, automation, and optimization of our corporate security infrastructure. You will enhance security controls, align goals with business objectives, and drive automation and self-service capabilities to maintain a strong security posture in a rapidly scaling environment.

 - Work with IaC tools like Terraform to ensure enterprise configurations are steady, change-managed and machine-readable.

 - Design and deploy endpoint security measures aligned with industry standards, including vulnerability management.

 - Ensure a strong security posture for corporate SaaS applications by configuring vendor capabilities or building automations to meet OnePay standards.

 - Mature and manage data protection controls, including Data Loss Prevention (DLP) tools and secure data handling processes.

 - Build secure methods for sharing data with internal teams and external partners.

 - Collaborate with IT, Infrastructure, and Security teams to implement security measures, maintain critical corporate systems (ensuring availability and compliance), and drive process improvement through automation.

 - Develop and run incident response and disaster recovery plans, including tabletop exercises.




YOU BRING

 - 5+ years of IT experience, including 3+ years in enterprise security within cloud environments.

 - Expertise in IaC tools like Terraform (preferred), Puppet, Chef or Ansible.

 - Proven ability to lead projects, drive measurable security improvements through automation, leveraging scripting (Python, Go, and/or TypeScript).

 - Solid understanding of networking, authentication standards, and security frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF, CIS benchmarks), with hands-on experience in ZTNA and DLP solutions (e.g., Netskope, Zscaler).

 - Skilled at simplifying technical concepts for non-technical audiences and influencing decisions.

 - Experience with workflow automation tools like n8n is a plus.




TOOLS WE USE

We use Typescript front to back, with node and NestJS frameworks for server code and React Native for our iOS, Android, and Web clients. We run on a highly distributed cloud-native stack with Kubernetes and AWS, and scale and resiliency are at the heart of everything we build. We also embrace agentic development, so engineers have their choice of a variety of models and agent harnesses, including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and more to fit their workflow. While you don't need experience with our exact stack, familiarity with modern software engineering practices will help you ramp up quickly.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive base salary, stock options, and health benefits from Day 1

 - 401(k) plan with company match

 - Remote-friendly (US), flexible time off (FTO), and opportunities for growth

 - A high-growth, mission-driven, inclusive culture where your work has real impact




STANDARD INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process varies by role. Most candidates go through:

 - AI-assisted initial screen

 - Interview with Talent Partner

 - Technical or Hiring Manager Interview

 - Team Interview

 - Executive Interview

 - Offer!




EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us at talent@onepay.com.
