jobs.title: Combo Welder - Memphis
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are seeking an Industrial Welder to support the buildout of SpaceXSI's high-performance data centers. In this hands-on role, you will fit and weld large industrial piping and structural steel to ASME Section IX and keep construction moving on our next-generation AI supercomputing infrastructure.

You will work closely with mechanical, structural, electrical, and operations teams to weld pipe, supports, and structures from construction through turnover. This is a full-time, onsite role with significant travel to SpaceXSI data center sites.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Fit, tack, and weld large-bore industrial piping and/or structural steel (pipe racks, platforms, supports, skids, and related assemblies) per drawings and ASME Section IX welding procedure specifications (WPS).

• Lay out, cut, bevel, grind, and align joints; check fit-up, root opening, and reinforcement before and after the weld.

• Read isometric, spool, and structural drawings; work to weld maps, heat numbers, and rod-control / continuity requirements where used.

• Support hanging of strut, supports, hangers, and structural members; assist with equipment set and bolt-up as needed to complete the weld package.

• Stage, move, and inventory pipe, fittings, structural members, filler metal, and tools; keep laydown yards and work areas orderly.

• Open and close work areas: protection, fire watch and hot-work permits, debris removal, scrap segregation, and end-of-shift reset so the next crew can start immediately.

• Follow LOTO, PPE, hot-work, and site rules; do not weld on live or unpurged systems without authorization.

• Report damaged material, rejected welds, unsafe conditions, and drawing conflicts immediately.

• Support punch-list, repair, and NDE hold-point work through system turnover.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Journey-level industrial construction welding experience: 3+ years welding large industrial piping and/or structural steel, completion of a recognized welding apprenticeship, or equivalent military experience.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Hands-on experience with GTAW (TIG) on stainless steel and/or SMAW (stick) on carbon steel.

• Qualified to ASME Section IX, or ability to pass a pre-employment weld test to ASME Section IX in the process(es) and position(s) used on site.

• Willingness to work at heights, outdoors, and on a changing data center construction site.

• Ability to use welding machines, torches, grinders, and related hand and power tools safely.

• Strong safety mindset and willingness to follow site procedures, including hot-work permits and LOTO.

• Prior experience on data center, industrial, or heavy-civil construction sites.

• Experience welding large-bore process, mechanical, or utility piping and heavy structural members.

• Current ASME Section IX qualification (e.g. 6G) in GTAW on stainless and/or SMAW on carbon.

• Proficiency in both TIG-on-stainless and stick-on-carbon; FCAW a plus.

• AWS D1.1 structural welding qualification or equivalent.

• OSHA 10 or equivalent training.

• Ability to read isometric, spool, and structural drawings.

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to travel extensively to SpaceXSI data center construction sites and remain onsite during peak construction phases.

• Capability to work in industrial environments, climb ladders, lift and position moderate loads, stand and walk for a full shift, and wear PPE (including welding PPE) for extended periods, with or without reasonable accommodation.

SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Director, Medical Communication

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

As a new member of the Revolution Medicines team, the Director, Medical Communications will lead the development and execution of a comprehensive medical communications strategy, ensuring alignment across internal and external stakeholders for select assets across pipeline, with focus on pancreatic cancer, NSCLC, colorectal cancer, and other solid tumors.

This role will oversee scientific communications platforms, publication strategies and operations and contribute to medical content supporting the organization’s medical and scientific engagement efforts.

Publications Strategy & Execution

Scientific Communications Platform

Medical Content Development

Congress Strategy & Scientific Exchange

• Drive scientific congress planning and execution, including coordination of symposia, abstracts/posters and presentations.

• Identify opportunities to amplify Revolution Medicines' scientific presence at major oncology congresses (e.g., ASCO, ESMO, AACR).

Internal Education & Change Management

• Support change management strategies to enhance internal understanding of best practices in publications strategy and execution.

• Educate internal stakeholders on scientific publication standards, compliance requirements, and best-in-class medical communication practices.

• Build trust across the organization in the Medical Communications function, reinforcing its role as the central authority on publication strategy, planning, and execution.

Cross-functional Collaboration & Leadership

• Serve as a key member of the Medical Excellence team, contributing to medical strategy and launch planning.

• Partner with Field Medical (MSLs), Medical Information, Stakeholder Engagement and Medical Education to ensure a cohesive medical communications and engagement strategy.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

• 8+ years of experience in Medical Affairs, Medical Communications and publications planning/execution within the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry.

• Experience leading scientific publication strategy, medical education initiatives, and external stakeholder engagement.

• Deep understanding of industry guidelines, and best practices (ACCME, PhRMA Code, FDA, OIG, AdvaMed, Sunshine Act).

• Proven ability to develop and execute medical communication strategies aligned with company and scientific priorities.

• Expertise in scientific communications planning, data dissemination, and medical writing/publication processes, including authorship guidelines (ICMJE, GPP).

• Familiarity with clinical development and real-world evidence (RWE) and how these influence scientific communication strategies.

• Ability to navigate cross-functional partnerships with Clinical, Research/Translational Science, Biostatistics and executive teams.

• Ability to manage external agency relationships, medical writers, and vendors to ensure quality and compliance in content development.

• Ability to translate complex scientific data into clear, engaging, and compliant communications for different stakeholders.

• Experience managing and mentoring teams of medical writers, communication specialists, or publication planners.

• Ability to work in fast-paced, matrixed environments and lead cross-functional initiatives.

• Proficiency in publication planning software (Datavision, PubStrat, etc.) and scientific engagement tools.

• Strong project management skills to oversee multiple priorities, timelines, and stakeholders effectively.

• Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills to engage internal and external stakeholders effectively.

Preferred Skills:

• Experience in precision oncology and targeted therapies.

jobs.title: School Break Day Camp Site Leader Ages 3–12 (Manhattan & Brooklyn)
jobs.description:
ABOUT NORY

Join NORY, the premier STEM camp provider in NYC and Boston, where we shape the future leaders, innovators, and problem solvers. With over 4,000 campers annually across 10+ locations, our camps offer a magical and transformative experience akin to the Disney World of STEM education. Discover more about our mission and vibrant camp atmosphere:

 - Instagram: bit.ly/noryi http://bit.ly/noryi

 - LinkedIn: bit.ly/norylink http://bit.ly/norylink

 - Summer Camp Video: bit.ly/noryvideo1 http://bit.ly/noryvideo1

 


WE'RE SEEKING A ROCKSTAR SCHOOL BREAK DAY CAMP SITE LEADER

Are you ready to lead a campsite to success? As we prepare for our upcoming School Break Day Camps, we’re looking for passionate and experienced Site Leaders to join our NYC team and share their availability for upcoming camp dates.

In this role, you will inspire and support our educators, ensuring they have a happy and rewarding experience at our School Break Day Camps. You will show love and care to our campers, deliver the highest level of customer support to parents, and guide our staff to shine.

Our School Break Day Camps take place on select days and school breaks when schools are closed throughout the year, making this a great opportunity for experienced educational leaders looking for flexible leadership opportunities that fit their availability.

 


WHY WORKING AS A SCHOOL BREAK DAY CAMP SITE LEADER ROCKS

 - Professional Development in Leadership: Enhance your leadership abilities and build a strong track record for your resume. Our role is designed to prepare you for future leadership positions.

 - Training in Diverse STEM Topics: Develop your skills in a variety of STEM areas, including robotics, coding, and woodworking. No prior STEM experience? No worries. We offer comprehensive training that can be transferable to your future educational career.

 - Build Lasting Professional Relationships: Join a community of dedicated, excellence driven colleagues.

 - Pathway to Continued Opportunities: Access a development pipeline that supports sustainable professional growth and provides additional opportunities to stay involved with NORY throughout the year.

 


SCHOOL BREAK DAY CAMP SITE LEADER RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Teach and Inspire: Lead your assigned group of campers with engaging activities that bring NORY’s core values to life, inspiring curiosity and enthusiasm.

 - Coach and Train Educators: Mentor and develop our teaching staff, ensuring they grasp the purpose behind each activity and properly implement protocols to create a fun and safe camp environment.

 - Nurture and Support Campers and Their Families: Build nurturing and supportive relationships with NORY campers and their families to enhance the camp experience for everyone involved.

 - Resource Management: Efficiently oversee and manage essential resources necessary for the success of our NORY camps, including materials, facilities, and daily schedules.

 - Administrative Oversight: Keep accurate and up to date administrative records for all aspects of camp, ensuring smooth operations and compliance.

 


SCHOOL BREAK DAY CAMP SITE LEADER QUALIFICATIONS

 - You have experience managing and coaching a team of 4+ teachers and fostering a positive team environment.

 - You have a track record of building strong relationships with families in a camp or educational setting.

 - You have more than 4 years of experience, preferred, teaching children ages 3 to 13 in any subject or discipline, preferably with a focus on STEM.

 - You demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to learn and adopt new technology and skills.

 


SCHOOL BREAK DAY CAMP SITE LEADER COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

 - Schedule: 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM

 - Compensation: $200 to $210/day
   
   - Additional $20/hour for extended care until 5:00 PM
   
   - Includes attendance at one lab camp session, ranging from 1 to 5 days.

 - Benefits: 401 (k) plan available to eligible employees.

 


BEYOND DAY CAMPS

At NORY, the opportunity to make an impact continues beyond our School Break Day Camps. We also offer opportunities through afterschool programs, birthday parties, and special events, giving you additional ways to stay involved with NORY, continue developing your leadership skills, and make an impact on our campers and community throughout the year.


TEAM CULTURE

We’re searching for Site Leaders who are not just skilled and experienced but also align deeply with our core values. At NORY, our "Ways of Being" guide everything we do:

 - We are purposeful in our actions, always asking "why" to cultivate inner motivation.

 - We are unifiers, fostering a loving and caring team environment that deeply values empathy and compassion.

 - We ask "how to make it work" before wondering "if it will be possible."

 - Our decisions are grounded in data and logic.

 - We actively seek feedback, embracing different perspectives and effective methods that contribute to our growth.

 - We avoid superficial solutions, opting instead to thoroughly analyze problems to create sustainable, scalable responses.

These aren’t just words. They’re the essence of our DNA. If these values speak to you, see how you align with our complete "Ways of Being" at www.nory.co/value http://www.nory.co/value.

 


APPLICATION PROCESS

Please submit your resume and cover letter, detailing your passion for this position and your approach to leading a successful and joyful site. If you have a special reason for wanting to join our team, please send your application directly to Liza@nory.co.

 

NORY New York is a proud equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
About Pump.co

Gartner predicts that cloud spend will be over $2T/yr by 2030, making it the fastest-growing expense for tech companies. Managing it well demands constant engineering effort—time that could be spent building your product.

At Pump, we're building the fastest way to save ~60% on cloud costs. Our AI-powered platform not only automates savings but also leverages the power of group buying for even deeper discounts. Backed by Y Combinator, we’re on a mission to transform cloud cost optimization through AI.

Our founding team includes experienced entrepreneurs with prior exits, and our culture is fast-paced, collaborative, and flat in structure. If you’re excited about shipping real impact and joining a team at an early, career-defining stage—we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

Skills: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes (nice to have), LLM/AI (bonus)

As a Backend Engineer, you’ll contribute directly to the core of our product and infrastructure. This role is ideal for someone looking to grow within a strong engineering team while delivering meaningful work that touches real customers.

You’ll collaborate closely with engineers, designers, and founders—working across the stack to build, improve, and scale our platform.

We are 5 days a week in office. No remote work will be considered.

What You’ll Do

• Design, build, and maintain backend services that power the Pump platform

• Work with the team to define and scope new product features

• Contribute to a strong engineering culture by participating in code reviews and continuous improvement

• Help extend our internal tools, dev workflows, and CI/CD pipelines

• Ensure system reliability, performance, and maintainability

• Collaborate across functions to solve real customer problems with intuitive engineering solutions

What We’re Looking For

• 3–15 years of professional backend engineering experience

• Ability to work 5 days a week in office

• Proficiency in Python and familiarity with FastAPI or similar frameworks

• Experience with SQL databases—we use PostgreSQL

• Comfort working in a cloud environment (AWS preferred)

• Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes (nice to have)

• Excitement about early-stage startups and the ability to thrive in fast-moving environments

• Clear communication and collaborative instincts

Bonus Points For

• Experience with cloud billing/cost tooling

• Interest in or exposure to LLMs or AI integrations

• Familiarity with NoSQL databases like DynamoDB

Benefits

• Competitive compensation + equity

• Comprehensive healthcare and dental coverage for you

• 401(k) plan

• Generous PTO: 13 accrued days, plus company shutdown December 24–January 1

• Free lunch & dinner at the office

• Annual company-paid retreats

• Developmental bonuses: support for professional development tied to cloud and related fields

En quête d’une première expérience qui fait la différence ? Rejoins Airbus Atlantic et donne une trajectoire unique à ton parcours grâce à ce stage.

Une offre de stage intitulée « STAGE 2027 - Digitalisation des méthodes de fabrication et programmation (ALL GENDER) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein d’Airbus Atlantic sur le site de Méaulte.

Cette mission débutera en janvier 2027 (date sujette à flexibilité) pour une durée de 6 mois.

Découvrez le site en vidéo :

Retrouvez Airbus Atlantic en vidéo

Présentation du site de Méaulte

Vous rejoindrez une équipe de 17 personnes au sein du département « Génie de Fabrication - Pièces Élémentaires » (Manufacturing Engineering PE) en charge de l'industrialisation, des méthodes de fabrication et de la programmation des pièces métalliques et des sous-ensembles.

Encadré par votre tuteur, vous interviendrez sur les activités suivantes :

• Digitaliser les documents de programmation et les dossiers de fabrication.
• Concevoir une base de données digitale centralisée pour sécuriser l'accès aux données techniques et éliminer les risques d'erreurs humaines lors de la saisie ou du transfert
• Harmoniser et standardiser l'ensemble des documentations techniques de programmation du secteur.
• Apporter un soutien technique à la préparation des méthodes pour accompagner les projets de production de l'atelier.

Durant votre stage, vous développerez les compétences suivantes en lien avec votre formation :

• Ingénierie des méthodes et industrialisation : Maîtrise de la chaîne d'industrialisation et de programmation des pièces métalliques élémentaires dans un environnement aéronautique exigeant.
• Transformation digitale & gestion de données techniques : Capacité à modéliser, structurer et sécuriser une base de données métiers pour optimiser des flux d'information industriels.
• Qualité & excellence opérationnelle : Maîtrise des démarches de standardisation, de maîtrise des risques (zéro défaut) et d'harmonisation des procédés de fabrication.
• Gestion de projet industriel en atelier : Action en contexte de forte cadence de production, compréhension des enjeux d'usinage et travail collaboratif pluridisciplinaire.

Parlons de VOUS !

Vous préparez actuellement un diplôme de niveau Bac +5 (ou équivalent) en école d'ingénieurs ou master universitaire dans le domaine du Génie Mécanique, de la Productique, du Génie Industriel ou une discipline apparentée.

Vous avez les connaissances et compétences suivantes :

• Notions de base en CFAO (Conception et Fabrication Assistées par Ordinateur) et procédés de fabrication
• Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et de gestion de données (Excel, Google Sheets, Pack Office)
• Savoir-être : Autonomie, Curiosité, Esprit d'équipe, Force de proposition, Capacité d'adaptation
• Anglais : intermédiaire (niveau B1)
• Français : courant

Vous pourrez être amené(e) à vous déplacer avec votre tuteur.

Parlons de NOUS !

Rejoindre Airbus Atlantic en tant que stagiaire, c'est : Participer à des projets ambitieux, à la pointe de la technologie, visant à construire l’avion de demain tout en répondant aux défis environnementaux, Acquérir des compétences dans un environnement dynamique qui encourage la créativité et l'initiative, avec une approche entrepreneuriale, Évoluer au sein d'une organisation solidaire, qui valorise la proximité et l'humain.

Notre processus de sélection

Toutes les candidatures seront soigneusement examinées par un recruteur. Si votre candidature est présélectionnée, vous serez invité à réaliser un entretien vidéo afin de vous présenter. Après évaluation, les candidats retenus seront contactés pour un entretien avec le manager ou le tuteur qui procédera alors à la sélection finale.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

About the role

We are looking for a detail-oriented, highly analytical Finance Intern to join our team. In this role, you won't just file paperwork—you will gain comprehensive, hands-on experience in financial analysis, core accounting operations, accounts payable, and tax support. You will work closely with senior accountants
and finance manager, directly contributing to day-to-day corporate financial operations and strategic decision-making.

Key Responsibilities:
 Accounts Payable (AP) Processing:
o Review, code, and enter vendor invoices into the accounting system with high accuracy.
o Match purchase orders, receiving reports, and invoices (3-way matching) to resolve discrepancies.
o Assist with the bi-monthly payment run prep and vendor reconciliation regarding payment statuses.

 Tax Compliance & Reporting Support:
o Assist in preparing supporting schedules and documentation for quarterly/annual tax filings.
o Help collect and verify tax forms from new vendors to maintain tax compliance.
o Perform routine tax research on local and BIR regulations as needed.
 Financial Analysis & Reporting:
o Assist in analyzing financial statements (Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) and building basic financial models.
o Track actual performance against budget/forecasts and highlight key drivers and discrepancies (Variance Analysis).
 Data Management & Process Improvement:
o Clean, structure, and analyze financial datasets to support monthly close and KPI reporting.
o Identify opportunities to streamline AP workflows and tax documentation using modern automation tools.

Qualifications and Requirements:
 Education: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
 Technical Skills:
o Solid foundation in core accounting principles (debits/credits, accruals, GL structure) and basic tax concepts.
o Knowledge or Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, basic financial functions).
o Familiarity with accounting/ERP systems (e.g. SAP) is a strong plus.
 Soft Skills:
o High attention to detail (crucial for invoice matching and tax documentation).
o Strong numerical reasoning and organizational skills.
o Eagerness to learn and maintain confidentiality with sensitive financial data.

What You Will Gain
 Full-Cycle Accounting Exposure: Practical, line-item experience with vendor management, cash disbursements, and tax reporting.
 Direct Mentorship: Guidance and feedback from experienced accounting and finance professionals.

Job Description:

Airbus Helicopters is looking for an Aircraft Electrical Technician A to join our H125 Final Assembly Line team based in Columbus, MS.

** These are essential roles so a signing bonus is available for qualified new hires joining Airbus.

You will be part of the team to perform work on assigned aircraft or parts in the avionics function. Configure and conduct operational checks of complete systems to verify proper functioning of components and systems. Diagnose malfunctions or failures and make adjustments, repairs or replacements of parts or components.

Meet the team:

From building to servicing the next generation of aerospace, our team focuses on quality, productivity and efficiency. We ensure the highest quality of care and safety is built into each aircraft we assemble and maintain. Our team members make it happen.

Your working environment:

On the eastern border of Mississippi you’ll find Columbus, home to our Helicopter manufacturing and assembly lines and Center of Excellence for the entire North America region. It’s here that we produce the UH-72A Lakota Helicopters for the U.S. Army in addition to the H-125 aircraft for civil and commercial customers.

How we care for you:

• Financial Rewards: Competitive base salary, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”)
• Work/Life Balance: Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a generous paid parental leave program.
• Health & Welfare: Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical (traditional and high-deductible health plans), prescription, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages.
• Individual Development: Upskilling and development opportunities through our global Leadership University, including unlimited access to 10,000+ e-learning courses focusing on ways to develop your employability, certifications, career path as well as the opportunity to participate in accelerated development programmes and both national and international mobility.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and accessibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

Your challenges:

• Perform configurations of complete systems.
• Conduct operational checks of complete systems to verify proper functioning of components and systems.
• Conduct bonding checks of electrical installations.
• Use a variety of standard and specialized hand tools, power equipment, measuring devices and test equipment in completing work assignments.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

En quête d’une première expérience qui fait la différence ?

Rejoins Airbus Atlantic et donne une trajectoire unique à ton parcours grâce à ce stage.

Nous sommes un leader mondial sur le marché des aérostructures, des sièges pilotes et des fauteuils passagers premium.

Une offre de stage intitulée « STAGE 2027 - Intégration des méthodes Low-Tech en conception industrielle  (ALL GENDER) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein d’Airbus Atlantic sur le site de Méaulte.

Retrouvez Airbus Atlantic en  vidéo

Présentation du site de Méaulte

Dans le cadre de votre formation initiale, vous recherchez un stage obligatoire ou intégré dans une année de césure, vous permettant de valider votre année et pour une durée de 6 mois à compter de début 2027 (date sujette à flexibilité).

Tâches et responsabilités :

Au sein de l'équipe R&T Emerging Industrial Systems (8 personnes), votre mission sera d'explorer, de délimiter et d'expérimenter l'apport de la démarche low-tech à toutes les échelles de notre système industriel.

L’objectif  de cette mission sera le suivant :

Comment, où et pourquoi intégrer la démarche low-tech au cœur de nos processus industriels (objet, usage, organisation) pour assurer la pérennité et la résilience de notre activité face aux enjeux d'un monde en constant changement ?

Pour y répondre, vous interviendrez avec votre tuteur sur les étapes suivantes :

• Cadrage & cartographie multi-échelle : identifier et qualifier les opportunités d'application sur l'ensemble du périmètre (équipements, procédés de fabrication, usages terrain et modes d'organisation).
• Prototypage & Proof of Concept : concevoir et tester rapidement des prototypes sur des cas d'usage pilotes sélectionnés.
• Évaluation & limites : mesurer l'impact (résilience, dépendances, coût, réparabilité) et déterminer le domaine de validité de la démarche.
• Guide méthodologique : formaliser une grille d'analyse et des recommandations pour faciliter le déploiement de la low-tech au sein d'Airbus Atlantic.

Durant votre stage, vous développerez les compétences suivantes en lien avec votre formation:

• Conception frugale & éco-conception : intégration des principes low-tech aux exigences aéronautiques (sobriété matérielle, réparabilité, durabilité).
• Analyse systémique des processus : diagnostic des méthodes existantes et identification des leviers d’amélioration.
• Design de service & conduite du changement : modélisation de solutions et accompagnement à la transformation des méthodes.
• Gestion de projet R&T : pilotage, expérimentation terrain et restitution d'une étude prospective industrielle.

Parlons de VOUS !

Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau Bac+5 en Grande École d’Ingénieurs ou de Design.

Vos atouts pour cette mission :

• Méthodes : compréhension des systèmes industriels et des démarches de conception (design thinking, éco-conception, pensée systémique)
• Appétence low-tech : curiosité marquée pour l'innovation et la démarche low-tech, la durabilité.
• Expérimentation : capacité à aller au contact de parties prenantes, prototyper rapidement et tester vos hypothèses.
• Savoir-être : autonomie, esprit d'analyse, aisance relationnelle et capacité à faire adhérer des profils variés.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer - CIAM XDP
jobs.description:
Job Description

Purpose of the role

To develop, implement and maintain solutions that support the safeguarding of the banks systems and sensitive information.

Accountabilities

• Provision of subject matter expertise on security systems and engineering patterns.
• Development and implementation of protocols, algorithms, and software applications to protect sensitive data and systems.
• Management and protection of secrets, ensuring that they are securely generated, stored, and used.
• Execution of audits to monitor, identify and assess vulnerabilities in the banks infrastructure/software and support the response to potential security breaches.
• Identification of advancements in to support the innovation and adoption of new cryptographic technologies and techniques.
• Collaboration across the bank, including developers and security teams, to ensure that cryptographic solutions align with business objectives, security policies and regulatory requirements.
• Development/ Implementation and maintenance of Identity and Access Management solutions and systems.

Vice President Expectations

• To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
• If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
• If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
• OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
• Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
• Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
• Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
• Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
• Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
• Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
• Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
• Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Join us as a Senior Security Engineer for Identity Services at Barclays, where you will be instrumental in securing our digital identity platform and protecting millions of customer identities across our global banking operations. You'll work at the intersection of security and identity, leveraging AI-assisted development and security tools, while partnering with engineering, product, and compliance teams to embed security-first principles into every aspect of our Identity Services capability and fostering a collaborative and innovative team culture.

To be successful in this role you should have:

• Solid experience in security engineering with deep expertise in Identity and Access Management security, including authentication protocols, authorisation frameworks, and identity federation security
• Strong knowledge of security protocols and standards including OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, PKI, and PSD2 SCA.
• Proven expertise in threat modelling, security architecture reviews, penetration testing, and vulnerability assessments specifically for IAM systems and APIs
• Experience with AWS security services and cloud security best practices, including IAM policies, security groups, encryption, HSMs, and key management
• Solid understanding of secure coding practices, security testing automation, and integration with CI/CD pipelines

Some other highly desirable skills include:

• Hands-on experience securing Ping Identity platforms (PingGateway, PingAM, PingIDM) is a plus
• Experience in using AI-assisted security scanning tools and automated security testing frameworks
• Background in incident response, security monitoring, and building threat detection capabilities for identity-related threats
• Security certifications such as CISSP, CEH, OSCP, or equivalent demonstrating deep security expertise
• Experience in financial services or regulated industries with understanding of compliance frameworks (PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2)
• Strong stakeholder management skills with ability to communicate security risks and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences
• Ideally 70/30 with 70% of hands-on security engineering expertise, with a 30% leadership and managerial mindset or potential.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role will be based out of our London office.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, QC Analytical Development
jobs.description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards, Laboratory Setting, Office

Job Description

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue exceeding $40 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving complex analytical challenges, improving patient diagnostics and therapies or increasing productivity in their laboratories, we are here to support them. Our global team of more than 125,000 colleagues delivers an unrivaled combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and pharmaceutical services through our industry-leading brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services and Patheon. For more information, please visit www.thermofisher.com.

GROUP/DIVISION SUMMARY

The Drug Product Division - North America (DPD-NA) is one of the five divisions that make up the Pharma Services Group. We are made up of approximately 10,000 colleagues across six sites who specialize in taking sterile injectable and oral solid dose drug products from development to commercialization.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Sr. Manager, QC Analytical Development, leads all aspects of the staff and operations of the Analytical Development Laboratory unit, providing strategic direction and leadership. This role establishes and implements quality policies for materials, products, and the production environment, and participates as a key member of the site's Management Team. The Sr. Manager provides technical and operational leadership for laboratory operations and technical assistance to manufacturing facilities.

Key Responsibilities:

· Provide leadership by driving organizational change, empowering staff, cultivating relationships, building effective teams, fostering engagement, and supporting staff in achieving both personal career goals and organizational objectives.

· Lead chemical Analytical Developmental and method transfer activities for New Business Development projects, and enhance analytical methods as required.

· Assess technical responses to regulatory agencies (e.g., FDA and USP), advise Manufacturing/Quality Operations Division and VP of Operations on analytical chemistry, review regulatory submissions while negotiating analytical support for product revisions and new product introductions.

· Develop and monitor capital equipment and operating budgets, and engage in both short-term and long-range planning for the Lab Services Department.

· Maintain an injury-free and incident-free workspace while aligning with all job-related safety and training requirements.

Qualifications:

· BS/BA in Chemistry or related scientific field required. Equivalent combinations of education, training, and relevant work experience may be considered.

· 10+ years of cGMP experience in the pharmaceutical industry, Steriles manufacturing experience required.

· 7+ years in a leadership role, committed to employee engagement and development required.

· Outstanding attention to detail and organizational skills.

· Capable of excelling in a fast-paced environment, adept at multitasking. Demonstrates ability to maintain a high degree of confidentiality. Effective time management and prioritization skills.

· Requires discretion and independent judgment.

· Very high degree of interpersonal skills to establish and maintain effective working relationships with employees and the public, including tact to handle sensitive matters.

· Highly effective verbal and written communication skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

· Superior cGMP experience and leadership required.

· Knowledge of quality control statistics, documentation and adherence to SOP’s.

· Upholds Data Integrity and cGMP standards. High attention to detail.

· Makes safety a priority

· Adaptable to changing product release priorities, flexible and structured communication skills. Ability to delegate.

· Knowledge of Microbial test methods including Bacterial Endotoxin and Sterility testing. Particulate Matter testing a plus.

· Ability to write quality technical reports and give effective oral presentations.

· Ability to effectively collaborate with others to achieve team goals and expectations.

· A genuine interest in researching and implementation of new approaches to analysis.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Position requires ordinary ambulatory skills and physical coordination sufficient to move about office locations; ability to stand, walk, stoop, kneel, crouch periodically for prolonged periods of time; manipulation (lift, carry, move) of light to medium weights of 10-35 pounds; arm, hand and finger dexterity, including ability to grasp and type for prolonged periods of time; visual acuity to use a keyboard, computer monitor, operate equipment, and read materials for prolonged periods of time; ability to sit, reach with hands and arms, talk, and hear for prolonged periods of time.

jobs.description:
Are you ready to bring structure and momentum to high-priority initiatives across the business?

Would you like to help accelerate our AI transformation while turning complex priorities into measurable outcomes?

About our Team

LexisNexis Reed Tech & Intellectual Property Solutions, our mission is to advance humanity by bringing clarity to innovation. Our solutions empower innovation leaders to turn IP into competitive advantage. We help innovators make informed decisions, increase productivity, ensure regulatory compliance, and ultimately achieve superior results. LexisNexis Reed Tech & Intellectual Property Solutions is part of LexisNexis Legal & Professional, a leading global provider of information-based analytics and technology solutions.

About the Role

The Enterprise Programme Manager brings governance, structure, prioritisation, and visibility to business initiatives across the organisation while directly managing priority projects, including the AI First Initiative. You will work across business and technical teams to turn priorities into clear plans, remove obstacles, and deliver measurable outcomes.

Responsibilities

• Establish and maintain a unified framework to track, manage, and report on business initiatives, creating a clear single source of truth and an approach that can be progressively automated, leveraging AI wherever practical.
• Assess initiatives against strategic priorities, business value, urgency, effort, and available capacity, helping leadership decide where to focus and what not to do.
• Define clear ownership, milestones, dependencies, risks, and success measures, and drive rapid implementation of an effective governance approach.
• Own selected priority projects from initial scoping through delivery, coordinating business and technical stakeholders and ensuring tangible outcomes.
• Drive the AI First Initiative: Manage and accelerate our internal AI transformation activity, working with engineers and business stakeholders to assess and prioritise high-value use cases and maintain momentum through the AI Champions group.
• Apply a pragmatic, delivery-focused approach: remove roadblocks, make sensible trade-offs, and step into the detail when needed to keep work moving.
• Develop and automate an integrated, data-driven view of progress, priorities, risks, decisions, and outcomes, giving the Senior Leadership Team the information needed to make faster, better decisions.
• Act as a trusted point of contact for initiative status, distilling complex issues into concise recommendations and ensuring decisions translate into clear actions, owners, and outcomes.

Requirements

• Significant experience in strategic planning and execution, programme management, business operations, project delivery, transformation, consulting, or a comparable role within a complex organisation.
• Experience managing projects in a technical environment, with a solid understanding of AI, data delivery, and automation.
• A proven ability to create structure where none exists, solve complex or ambiguous problems, and personally drive work through to measurable outcomes.
• Strong analytical, and commercial judgement, with experience using metrics to shape plans and knowing when to analyse further, escalate, or simply get something done.
• The candidate should be comfortable working with engineers, contributing to rapid prototyping discussions, and translating technical concepts into practical business outcomes.

Are you ready to build strategic supplier partnerships and deliver measurable value across RELX businesses?

About the Role

The Procurement Manager leads global category strategy, sourcing and supplier management for Editorial Production Operations (EPO), supporting RELX businesses across content services, technology platforms, AI-enabled technologies, SaaS solutions, customer services and translation providers. You will partner across technology, operations, product and business teams to shape sourcing strategies, strengthen supplier partnerships and deliver measurable business value.

Responsibilities:

• Lead commercial negotiations for content production, software, SaaS, managed services, AI platforms and large language model (LLM) services.
• Structure and negotiate agreements including MSA, SOW, SaaS subscriptions and licensing across consumption/usage-based, token-based, transactional and T&M pricing models.

• Leverage AI/GenAI tools and BI platforms to generate data-driven sourcing insights and decisions.
• Serve as the primary relationship owner for strategic content technology suppliers, supporting governance, risk management, supplier optimization and innovation.
• Build consensus and advise Legal, Information Security and business-unit stakeholders during complex negotiations and contract management.
• Operate independently within Global Procurement governance guidelines and Legal and AI governance requirements.

Requirements

• Progressive experience in strategic sourcing/procurement, with a strong focus on academic and professional content/data production and software/SaaS/technology sourcing — ideally across both domains, or demonstrated ability to ramp quickly across categories.
• Proven track record leading and negotiating complex, high-value agreements, delivering benefits to the business.
• Proficiency with AI tools and the Microsoft 365 suite, including Power BI to optimize sourcing processes, drive innovation, strengthen the supplier base, and enhance spend visibility and insight.

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

RELX is a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers. jobs.description:
Job Description:

En quête d’une première expérience qui fait la différence ?

Rejoins Airbus Atlantic et donne une trajectoire unique à ton parcours grâce à ce stage.

Nous sommes un leader mondial sur le marché des aérostructures, des sièges pilotes et des fauteuils passagers premium.

Dans le cadre de votre formation initiale, vous recherchez un stage obligatoire ou intégré dans une année de césure, d’une durée de 4 à 6 mois, vous permettant de valider votre année.

Une offre de stage intitulée « STAGE 2027 - Ingénieur Conception Sièges Pilotes - Développement d’un système de verrouillage angulaire de dossier pour siège pilote (all gender) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein d’Airbus Atlantic sur le site de Rochefort.

Cette mission débutera en Mars 2027 (date sujette à flexibilité) pour une durée de 6 mois.

Découvrez le site en vidéo

Retrouvez Airbus Atlantic en vidéo

Présentation du site de Rochefort

Pour le développement de la solution vous serez en relation avec des métiers de production et de qualité produit.

Encadré par votre tuteur, vous interviendrez sur les activités suivantes :

• Ingénierie de conception mécanique et modélisation CAO : Capacité à concevoir un système mécanique complexe à forte contrainte ergonomique et sécuritaire, de la phase d'esquisse jusqu'au dossier de définition 3D/2D.
• Dimensionnement et justification structurelle : Capacité à appliquer les méthodes de calcul de résistance des matériaux (RDM) et de tolérancement pour garantir la tenue mécanique d'un composant aéronautique.
• Ingénierie simultanée et prise en compte des contraintes de fabrication : Capacité à intégrer les exigences d'assemblage, de répétabilité et de qualité en travaillant en synergie avec le Bureau d'Études, la Production et les Méthodes.
• Méthodologie de validation et qualification produit : Capacité à élaborer un protocole d'essais mécaniques, à définir des critères d'acceptabilité et à analyser des résultats d'essais de qualification.
• Gestion de projet technique et autonomie : Capacité à structurer un planning d'études, à mener des revues de conception et à formaliser un reporting d'avancement technique.

jobs.title: Lead Loan Documentation Processor
jobs.description:
About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Loan Documentation Processor who will be responsible for the preparation, review, and validation of commercial loan documentation for Business Banking, In-Region Markets, Middle Market and Specialized Industries. The role ensures loan documents are accurate, complete, compliant with credit approvals, legal requirements, regulatory standards and internal policies. The Lead Loan Documentation Processor serves as a subject matter expert for documentation-related inquiries, supports complex transactions, assists with issue resolution, and contributes to operations excellence through quality, risk management, and stakeholder partnership.

In this role, you will:

• Support the Loan Documentation team in reviewing, documenting, closing, and disbursing loans
• Review the most complex legal, appraisal, and title information
• Prepare loan documentation, coordinate loan closings, and initiate loan disbursements
• Monitor the loan disbursement process
• Perform or guide others on complex loans that require planning, evaluation, and interpretation
• Ensure compliance with company's policies and procedures
• Identify and mitigate Loan Documentation risks in accomplishing business goals
• Prioritize work and provide day to day work leadership and mentorship to the Loan Documentation team
• Provide guidance and subject matter expertise to the immediate Loan Documentation team on generating loans, as well as technical and legal guidance within matters related to loan documentation

Required Qualifications:

• 4+ years of customer service, loan administration, collections, or sales environment support experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

Desired Qualifications:

• Commercial loan documentation expertise
• Credit approval interpretation
• Knowledge of commercial lending products and structures
• Risk and control awareness
• Regulatory and policy compliance
• Documentation quality review
• Must be flexible to work primarily on night shifts and other schedules based on business needs
• Must be amenable to work at BGC Taguig City

Job Expectations:

Loan Documentation Preparation & Processing

• Prepare, review, and validate loan documentation packages for commercial lending products, including new loans, renewals, modifications, and amendments.
• Interpret credit approvals, legal requirements, and product guidelines to ensure documentation accuracy and completeness
• Ensure all documentation aligns with approved credit structures, collateral requirements, pricing, covenants, and booking instructions.

Quality & Risk Management

• Perform thorough quality reviews to minimize documentation defects, exceptions, and rework.
• Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, bank policies, operational procedures, and risk control standards.
• Identify, assess, and escalate documentation issues, inconsistencies, or potential risks in a timely manner.
• Maintain strong attention to detail and adherence to quality control processes.

Stakeholder Management & Communication

• Partner effectivity with Credit, Relationship Managers, Fulfillment Teams, Legal, Quality Control, and other operational stakeholders.
• Communicate documentation requirements, outstanding items, dependencies, and risks clearly and professionally.
• Provide concise status updates, including pending requirements, critical issues, expected completion timelines, and next steps.
• Set appropriate expectations with stakeholders regarding deliverables, timelines, and resolution plans.

Leadership & Team Support

• Serve as a resource for team members by providing guidance on documentation requirements, processes, and issue resolution.
• Support onboarding and knowledge transfer activities for new hires and less experienced processors.
• Share best practices and lessons learned to improve overall team capability and performance.
• Assist leadership in identifying operational challenges and opportunities for process improvement.

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

• Participate in initiatives focused on improving efficiency, quality, controls, and customer experience.
• Identify recurring issues and contribute to root-cause analysis and corrective action planning.
• Support implementation of process changes, system enhancements, and documentation updates.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. The world is transforming - and so is Intel. Intel is a company of bold and curious inventors and problem solvers who create some of the most astounding technology advancements and experiences in the world. With a legacy of relentless innovation and a commitment to bring smart, connected devices to every person on Earth, our diverse and brilliant teams are continually searching for tomorrow's technology and revel in the challenge that changing the world for the better brings. We work every single day to design and manufacture silicon products that empower people's digital lives. Come join us and do something wonderful.

The Role and Impact
Join Intel's Packaging Module Development team and play a pivotal role in pioneering assembly packaging technologies that drive Intel's future advancements. As a Packaging Module Development Engineer, you will develop innovative processes and refine equipment to enable next-generation packaging solutions and enhance US based manufacturing. Your contributions will directly impact manufacturing efficiency, product reliability, and technological innovation, ensuring Intel remains at the forefront of the global semiconductor industry.

Business group
Intel's Packaging Module Development team focuses on advancing assembly and packaging solutions that enable cutting-edge technologies across Intel's diverse product portfolio. The group collaborates with cross-functional teams to optimize manufacturing processes, enhance product reliability, and support Intel's mission to deliver world-class innovations that transform the way we compute.

• Support integration of new materials and architectures into equipment for manufacturing success for advanced foundry customer product manufacturability
• Innovate new techniques, tools, and quality screens to proactively identify and address equipment health and reliability issues.

jobs.title: Senior Design Manager- Global Experiences
jobs.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.

Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

Warner Bros. has been entertaining audiences for more than 90 years through the world’s most-loved characters and franchises. Warner Bros. employs people all over the world in a wide variety of disciplines. We're always on the lookout for energetic, creative people to join our team.

ㅤ

Please send your portfolio with your CV

Warner Bros. Discovery Global Experiences extends the Studio’s powerful portfolio of entertainment brands and franchises into the lives of fans around the world. WBDGE partners with best-in-class partners globally on an award-winning range of theme parks, studio tours, hotels, LBEs, and dining inspired by franchises and properties such as Harry Potter, DC, Looney Tunes, Scooby-Doo and theatrical properties from historic library to brand new titles.

The division’s Global Experience business includes groundbreaking experiences such as The Wizarding World of Harry Potter, The Making of Harry Potter Studio Tour and Warner Bros. World Abu Dhabi. With innovative and groundbreaking projects, retail initiatives and thoughtful experiences, WBD Global Experiences is one of the leading experience and retail organizations in the world.

To be successful in this team, you must have a willingness to model our guiding principles, champion diversity and inclusion, leverage data and insights to maximize the legacy of our deep brands and franchises while maintaining a commitment to fostering best-in-class projects.

Your New Role

The Sr Design Manager will play an integral role in the creative vision for Global Experiences, reporting to the Vice President for Creative. This role requires expertise in environmental design, site installation, live entertainment, and character design, along with strong graphic layout and presentation skills. The Sr Design Manager will manage high complexity design projects, collaborating with partners to develop themed experiences and live entertainment. Management of categories include, but not limited to: theme parks, studio tours, exhibitions, rides, location-based entertainment, pop-ups, costumes, media, and character art. Candidate should be able to effectively communicate creative concepts in front of clients in a professional manner, while also collaborating with other designers, business leads and interdepartmental teams to help deliver best-in-class products.. Familiarity with Warner Bros brands, pop culture, industry trends, and emerging technologies is essential.

Your Role Accountabilities

•Oversee regional creative direction for themed entertainment, working directly with the department Vice President, business leads and franchise teams to ensure brand consistency and strategic alignment.

•Guide creative execution for regional projects from concept through production, coordinating design partners, licensees and consultants while collaborating closely with US-based creative teams to ensure consistency, quality, accuracy and legal compliance.

•Work with business leads in EMEA and the US to develop innovative ideas and designs aligned with department goals.

•Shape creative development and provide art direction across pop-ups, theme parks, hotels, experiential and retail spaces, exhibitions, location-based entertainment, F&B, graphics and live shows.

•Review and revise scripts for live entertainment and media, and review and approve creative submissions including show set packages, production drawings, graphics and media.

•Communicate creative ideas to partners, senior management and team members, working closely with partners, vendors and brand assurance teams to ensure execution aligns with approved concepts.

•Partner with product managers and internal teams across brand and franchise management, legal, data insights, project management and marketing to deliver compelling designs, share best practices and apply an understanding of construction and design for built environments and components.

Skills and Experience Required

• Must be a car owner and willing to drive to Leavesden for the role

• Extensive experience in themed entertainment or closely related fields
• Site installation experience with a broad knowledge of materials and best practices.
• Skilled in Microsoft, Adobe Creative Suite and Keynote; 3D modelling experience is a plus
• Ability to produce sketches and finished renderings.
• Experience in themed entertainment, film, theatre, or live entertainment
• Familiar with industry trends and guest experience design
• Fluency in Spanish is advantageous but not essential

Onsite Working - This role is advertised as Onsite, meaning all working hours and days (regardless of shift pattern) will be carried out at the place of work. Subject to any applicable laws, Skydance / your Line Manager reserves the right to change this working agreement, where this is essential to business needs and upon reasonable notice to you.

About Skydance

Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

Description

Programmer/Analyst-Senior Summary:

We are seeking a Senior Programmer/Analyst with GCP experience to support the development and ongoing enhancement of the Enterprise Payments platform. This role focuses on implementing cloud-native solutions across a Java backend (including REST API development), supporting event-driven payment processing, and ensuring application stability in production environments.

This role partners closely with IS Tech Specialists, architects, and business analysts to deliver secure, scalable, and highly available payment solutions while following established enterprise standards and best practices. The ideal candidate has strong hands‑on development skills, experience working in agile teams, and the ability to independently deliver features while escalating design decisions and complex issues to senior technical leaders as appropriate.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions.
• Develop and maintain back‑end services using Java (e.g., Spring Boot). Design, build, and version RESTful APIs, including contract-first design, documentation, and integration testing within our payment’s ecosystem.
• Demonstrate knowledge of and can deliver solutions using GCP, CLI, services and integrations.
• Design, develop, test, and maintain cloud‑native applications on GCP. Implement serverless and container‑based solutions using Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, and/or GKE. Build and maintain APIs using Apigee or GCP API Gateway.
• Write clean, maintainable, and well‑documented code following enterprise standards.
• Participate in incidents, problems, and change management processes. Provide production support, including scheduled on‑call rotation.
• Work with offshore/onsite teams to ensure timely and quality delivery of technical and testing artifacts, including code, design documentation, and test deliverables, while ensuring all coding and testing guidelines prescribed by HNB are consistently followed.
• Demonstrate knowledge of and can deliver solutions using DevSecOps tool chains and processes
• Provides assistance in solving hardware or software problems. Diagnoses cause of complex technical problems like performance, availability, internal and external application integrations, databases, middleware, network, etc.
• Possesses an in-depth knowledge of and works with the technical tools available for systems development and support. Maintains and demonstrates knowledge of technical industry trends, particularly as they apply to Huntington.
• May assist with identifying training needs or with training of less experienced staff.
• Performs other duties as assigned.

Basic Qualifications:

• Bachelor's Degree
• 1+ year of related experience or qualified candidates who successfully complete Huntington’s Technical Youth training or a part of the apprenticeship training program, in lieu of related experience

Preferred Qualifications:

• 3+ years of hands‑on experience developing and supporting cloud‑native applications on GCP. Strong proficiency in Java (Spring/Spring Boot) and GCP.
• 3+ years of experience with GCP, AWS, and/or Azure
• 3+ years of experience supporting IaC automation, preferably Terraform
• 3+ years of coding/scripting experience, preferably Java
• Experience building and supporting secure RESTful APIs and asynchronous, event‑driven integrations (OAuth2/OIDC or similar authentication approaches preferred)
• Experience with cloud-based technologies and multiple platform environments, including GCP, AWS, Azure, IaC/Terraform, Agile delivery, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Git, cloud security, IAM, and policy validation using Terraform Validator, OPA, or Rego.Experience supporting enterprise‑scale payment or financial systems. Knowledge of payment processing concepts (ACH, checks, debit/credit/corporate cards, Zelle, bill pay, etc.)
• Experience using monitoring tools like Dynatrace, Zenoss, Splunk, and log files to evaluate the health of mission critical production applications and to identify root causes for performance and functional issues.
• Exposure to AI‑assisted development or automation tools.
• Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred).
• Ability to balance development and support responsibilities while partnering effectively with business segments, IT teams, vendors, and stakeholders to deliver successful outcomes.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, interpersonal, and customer service skills; self-motivated problem solver who thrives in dynamic environments and contributes as a strong team player.

jobs.title: Procurement Enablement - Procurement Capability Lead - Supplier Relationship Management (SRM)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Procurement Enablement - Procurement Capability Lead -

Supplier Relationship Management (SRM)

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships.  Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Opportunity:

This role sits within the Delivery group, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution.

This position is part of the Materials, Manufacturing and Capex (MMC) Procurement Delivery leadership team reporting into the Chapter Lead of Materials, Manufacturing and Capex Procurement Delivery. However, the scope of the role is to be applied to all of Global Procurement with a focus on both Delivery Chapters (Indirects and MMC).

As a Capability Lead  - Supplier Relationship Management (SRM), you will work in a dynamic global environment where you will bring analytical thinking, planning, relationship shaping, execution, and focus to how Global Procurement segments and manages its most impactful supplier relationship and drives value, compliance, risk and innovation from them.

You will be responsible for the end-to-end management and strategic direction of Supplier Relationship Management within Global Procurement, drive alignment with the overarching Procurement strategy, digital initiatives, and customer satisfaction, and ensure consistent application of procurement methodologies. You will utilise your leadership expertise and your specialized knowledge and in-depth expertise to contribute and implement a best-in-class procurement delivery capability in your area. You will apply a data driven approach to measure progress against this plan and ensure champion adoption.

You will collaborate with internal procurement (such as both Delivery Chapters, Business Partnering, Business and Digital Solutions, Analytics, Contracting, Learning and Development, etc.) functional management and business stakeholders to build and implement the capability ensuring balanced team resource utilisation, consistent application of procurement methodologies and contribution to continuous improvement projects.

As a Capability Lead  - SRM, you will play a variety of roles according to your experience, knowledge, and general business requirements, including but not limited to:

• You are a subject matter expert in global SRM, evaluating requests and business needs to develop and execute global SRM process and best practices in alignment with the Procurement strategy, digital initiatives and stakeholder / business needs
• You will own the end-to-end process for the SRM Capability area, from strategic conception to end-user adoption, ensuring seamless integration and a consistent approach to Category Management and Strategic Sourcing within Global Procurement
• You will lead a set of ‘’SRM Champions and Leads’’ from other teams with to embed and adopt the framework. You will develop the next set of key SRM strategic leaders
• You will coach SRM leads for the largest relationships and role model by owning and driving one of our largest Supplier relationships
• You will engage across Senior Stakeholders across Roche to shape needs and drive impact
• You develop a roadmap, improvement KPIs and holistic capabilities direction, leveraging a matrix set of SRM leads and process / tech across GP to drive adoption and content

Who you are:

• You hold a university degree, preferably in business or a related discipline.
• You have 10+ years of procurement experience in strategic sourcing, global category management, complex procurement contracting, and operational category efficiency projects on either the Procurement or the Sales side of a complex business
• You have significant experience in managing resources without direct line responsibilities in a global, fluid and interactive matrix environment
• You have expertise in procurement end-to-end systems and processes
• You demonstrate curiosity, active listening and a willingness to experiment and test new ideas when appropriate, with the focus very much on continuous learning and improvement.
• You are open-minded and inclusive, generously sharing ideas and knowledge, while being receptive to ideas and feedback from others.
• You have experience in project management including change management and process improvement with direct experience in delivering complex business process / organizational change projects
• You are a self motivated and performance driven leader
• You are fluent in English to a Business level

Join our team and enable the strong capability expertise needed to meet the evolving needs of our customers.

Note: Relocation benefits are not available for this posting.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Furthermore, they do not establish a contract for employment and are subject to change at the discretion of Roche Products Ltd. At Roche Products we believe diversity drives innovation and we are committed to building a diverse and flexible working environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion or belief, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, disability or age. We recognise the importance of flexible working and will review all applicants’ requests with care. At Roche difference is valued and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer where you are encouraged to bring your whole self to work.

jobs.description:
About This Role

Wells Fargo is seeking a Treasury Management Consultant to join our Global Payments and Liquidity team within Enterprise Functions. This role is ideal for a client-focused professional who is passionate about helping middle market businesses optimize their treasury operations through innovative payment, liquidity, and cash management solutions.

As a trusted partner to relationship managers, business bankers, and clients, you will leverage your treasury management expertise, consultative approach, and strong relationship-building skills to identify opportunities, drive client engagement, and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

Success in this role requires strategic thinking, effective communication, adaptability, and the ability to collaborate across teams to solve complex client challenges and enhance the overall client experience.

In This Role, You Will

• Partner with Senior Treasury Management Consultants, Relationship Managers, and Business Bankers to deepen existing client relationships and identify opportunities to expand treasury management solutions.
• Consult with middle market clients to understand business needs and recommend treasury management products and services that drive efficiency, growth, and operational effectiveness.
• Analyze client requirements, evaluate potential solutions, and provide thoughtful recommendations that support business objectives and improve client outcomes.
• Build strong partnerships across sales, service, implementation, and product teams to deliver a seamless client experience and support successful solution delivery.
• Navigate complex client situations by applying sound judgment, problem-solving skills, and knowledge of treasury management products, policies, and procedures.
• Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, translating business needs into actionable solutions and fostering trust-based relationships.
• Continuously develop expertise in treasury management offerings, industry trends, and client needs to provide consultative guidance and strategic value.

Required Qualifications

• 2+ years of Treasury Management Consulting experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

Desired Qualifications

• Knowledge of treasury management products and services, including the ability to align solutions with client operational and cash management needs.
• Experience serving as a trusted advisor to clients by identifying opportunities, recommending solutions, and supporting treasury management strategies.
• Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong partnerships with middle market clients, internal stakeholders, and cross-functional business partners.
• Strong consultative, relationship management, and client engagement skills with the ability to influence and drive positive business outcomes.
• Effective communication and presentation skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to diverse audiences and simplify complex concepts.
• Proven ability to collaborate across teams, navigate ambiguity, and adapt to changing business priorities while maintaining a high level of execution.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with attention to detail and a commitment to delivering an exceptional client experience.
