Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world.  Progress starts with you.

Job Description

The Senior Manager of Marketing Strategy, International Travel is responsible for developing insight-led marketing strategies that drive cross-border payment volume growth and build Visa relevance, preference, and usage among international travelers.

This role requires a strong background in brand strategy, brand planning, consumer insights, and campaign development, with a deep understanding of international travel, traveler behavior, and cross-border commerce. The ideal candidate can translate complex inputs — including consumer research, cultural trends, travel behaviors, market dynamics, competitive activity, and payments economics — into clear, actionable strategies, creative briefs, messaging frameworks, and global-to-regional activation plans.

Success in this role depends on strong cross-functional partnership with the Cross-Border Business Unit, regional marketing partners, Corporate Strategy, Insights & Analytics, Global Brand Creative Studio, creative agencies, media partners, and sponsorship teams. This person will influence marketing planning, investment prioritization, campaign development, and execution across priority travel corridors and markets.

Importantly, this role serves as a core contributor to the Cross-Border Marketing Center of Excellence, helping drive thought leadership, strategic rigor, best-practice sharing, and market enablement across Visa’s priority international travel initiatives.

The position reports to the Senior Director, Travel Experiences and will be based in Visa’s San Francisco office.

This is a hybrid position. Visa requires at least 3 days in office; specific expectations will be confirmed by the hiring manager.

Essential Functions

• Manage and execute the marketing strategy for international travel
• Lead the development of marketing strategies for priority international travel corridors aligned to Visa’s cross-border growth objectives.
• Translate consumer insights, travel trends, market dynamics, and business priorities into clear strategic frameworks, creative briefs, campaign platforms, and activation guidance.
• Partners with regional marketing leads to optimizing and evolving corridor-level strategies in response to business priorities, competitive dynamics, macroeconomic shifts, and changing traveler behavior.
• Refine traveler journey stages, trip motivations, audience segments, and consumer spending behaviors as new research, data, and market learnings are developed.
• Develop marketing strategies for both sending and receiving markets, ensuring coordinated planning and execution across regions while reducing unnecessary region-to-region complexity.
• In collaboration with the Global Brand Creative Studio, support strategy development for global cross-border campaigns that are centrally led, studio built and regionally executed.
• Influence annual operating plans to ensure cross-border travel initiatives are appropriately prioritized, funded, and integrated into regional and global marketing plans.
• Support budget planning and management for global marketing workstreams related to international travel and cross-border initiatives.
• Brief and shape cross-border executions within major sponsorship platforms, including FIFA, the Olympics, and Formula 1, to drive stronger business outcomes beyond the sponsorship moment and across the full travel experience.
• Act as the cross-border travel subject matter expert and enable markets to deliver effectively and efficiently
• Serve as a subject matter expert on international travel marketing, traveler behavior, cross-border commerce, and payments usage across priority markets.
• Build and advance cross-border thought leadership through consumer research, market intelligence, competitive analysis, industry trend monitoring, and travel behavior insights.
• Translate research and market intelligence into best practices, strategic recommendations, campaign guidance, and market enablement tools that improve marketing effectiveness.
• Evaluate and develop global channel strategies, including airport, destination, sponsorship, experiential, digital, and Visa-owned channels, to improve engagement with international travelers.
• Assess regionally led sponsorships, partnerships, and market opportunities to identify more effective strategies for reaching non-host and sending-market travelers.
• Develop marketing strategies for Visa-owned properties and experiences, including Visa Live, to increase relevance, preference, and usage among international travelers.
• Develop and implement a global messaging framework that enables regions to activate consistent, compliant, and high-impact brand and product claims across priority corridors.
• Lead global-to-regional enablement and change management through regular regional share-outs, planning forums, toolkits, playbooks, and operating model improvements.
• Partner with Regions and Insights & Analytics to define measurement frameworks, learning agendas, and optimization plans for travel initiatives.
• Ensure campaign learnings and performance insights inform current optimization, future strategy development, and annual planning.
• Support innovation pilots in partnership with the Cross-Border Business Unit, Regions, partners, and clients to drive new growth and acquisition opportunities for Visa.
• Drive innovation sprints using emerging platforms, AI-enabled tools, partner platforms, and new marketing technologies to strengthen Visa’s category leadership and competitive differentiation.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

• 8 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree; or at least 5 years of experience with an Advanced Degree, such as a Master’s, MBA,

Preferred Qualifications

• 9 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree; or 7 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree, such as a Master’s, MBA, JD, or MD; or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD.
• Degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Strategy, or a related field. MBA or advanced degree preferred.
• Progressive experience in brand strategy, brand planning, campaign strategy, marketing strategy, or global brand marketing.
• Agency-side experience as a brand planner, strategist, strategy director, or account planning lead strongly preferred.
• Client-side experience at a global brand with responsibility for brand strategy, campaign development, or global-to-regional marketing activation is also highly relevant.
• Experience in the travel industry is strongly preferred, including online travel agencies, airlines, hospitality, mobility, tourism, travel marketplaces, or destination marketing.
• Demonstrated ability to build brand and campaign strategies from consumer insight through creative brief, campaign development, execution, measurement, and optimization.
• Strong ability to work with research, insights, and analytics teams to identify meaningful consumer, cultural, market, and category trends.
• Experience translating research and data into strategic recommendations, messaging frameworks, campaign platforms, and executive-ready narratives.
• Experience developing multichannel marketing campaigns for global, regional, or local markets, ideally with a focus on international travelers or cross-border consumer behavior.
• Experience working across geographies, regions, or markets, with the ability to balance global brand consistency with local market relevance.
• Experience with sponsorship, experiential, airport, destination, travel, or partnership marketing preferred.

Information for US Applicants

For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $154,000.00 to $ 247,000.00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program.

Job Description:

INTRODUCTION:

An opportunity for an Embedded Software Engineer – Airborne Connectivity has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid).

The selected candidate will join the Airborne Connectivity Team, part of the Engineering function at Airbus Defence and Space.

The team is responsible for designing and developing hardware and software solutions that provide advanced connectivity and communication capabilities for military airborne platforms, including Eurofighter, C295, MRTT, SIRTAP and Eurodrone, as well as Secure Communications programmes.

Working in a multidisciplinary and highly skilled environment, the jobholder will contribute to the development of next-generation, high-integrity airborne real-time systems, supporting innovation in smart connectivity, distributed networking and artificial intelligence.

The role offers the opportunity to participate in the complete embedded software development lifecycle, from requirements definition and software architecture to verification, testing and implementation on target systems.

RESPONSIBILITIES: The main tasks of the jobholder will be:

• Design and develop embedded real-time software solutions, contributing to software architecture, low-level design and implementation in accordance with applicable software development standards.
• Define, analyse and manage software requirements, ensuring traceability, consistency and alignment with system specifications and programme objectives.
• Perform software coding, integration and verification activities, including testing, configuration management, documentation, change management and support to software quality assurance processes.
• Collaborate with product managers, programme managers, system engineers and validation teams to ensure the successful development, integration and delivery of high-quality software solutions.
• Contribute to project planning and technical decision-making, supporting the definition of project scope, development activities and delivery milestones while ensuring compliance with quality and schedule objectives.
• Promote innovation and continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance software development processes, tools and technologies within the department.

SKILLS: Is your profile aligned with the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to getting to know you!

• Education: University degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.
• Experience: At least 3 years of professional experience in real-time and/or embedded software development, including software requirements definition, implementation and verification activities.
• Soft skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams, proactive mindset and good communication skills. Ability to balance different perspectives regarding products, projects and processes.
• Languages: Fluent level of English and Spanish.
• Technical knowledge: Strong knowledge of C/C++ and/or Ada programming languages, low-level software development, software requirements engineering and software verification methodologies.
• Valuable / Nice to have: Knowledge of software airworthiness certification standards (DO-178C, EFA Standards), cybersecurity concepts and accreditation processes (Common Criteria). Experience with system and software design tools (SysML, UML), integrated development environments (GPS, AdaMulti, Eclipse) and verification tools (VectorCAST, AdaTest95) will be valued.
• Other requirements: Eligibility to obtain NATO/National security clearance, compliance with applicable national and US export control regulations, and availability for occasional national and international travel.

jobs.title: Project Toxicologist, Director – Oncology Targeted Delivery (OTD) Safety Science, Clinical Pharmacology and Safety Sciences (Cambridge, MA or Gaithersburg, MD)
jobs.description:
At AstraZeneca, our ambition is to eliminate cancer as a cause of death. Our pioneering oncology pipeline reflects this mission, and our Oncology Targeted Delivery (OTD) Safety team plays a critical role in advancing transformative therapies to patients.

We are seeking a passionate and highly motivated Director, Project Toxicologist to join our OTD Safety group. This role will focus on novel targeted oncology therapies, including radioconjugates, antibody–drug conjugates (ADCs), and small molecules. Experience with radioconjugates is particularly valued; however, candidates with expertise in other relevant modalities are encouraged to apply.

As a Project Toxicologist, you will partner with cross-functional teams across Oncology R&D, bridging discovery and regulatory toxicology. You will develop innovative safety strategies, guide candidate selection, inform regulatory approaches, and help shape the future of oncology safety science.

LOCATIONS: Cambridge, MA (Kendall Square) or Gaithersburg, MD

What you’ll do

• Lead toxicology strategies: Design and oversee regulatory and investigative toxicology programs to predict, assess, and mitigate target- and modality-related safety risks.
• Support development decisions: Apply your toxicology expertise to anticipate clinical safety risks and provide data-driven recommendations across discovery and development programs.
• Advance safety science: Integrate in vitro, in silico, and in vivo approaches with emerging technologies, including organ-on-chip, imaging, and omics, to address complex safety questions.
• Communicate integrated risk assessments: Present scientific conclusions and safety strategies to governance bodies and contribute to regulatory submissions.
• Provide regulatory and scientific leadership: Maintain and expand expertise in regulatory standards, preclinical safety, and modality-specific toxicology while anticipating industry trends and evolving methodologies.
• Support external opportunities: Provide strategic toxicology input for in-licensing evaluations, due diligence activities, and external collaborations.
• Build scientific influence: Advance Oncology Safety science through internal and external collaborations, publications, conference participation, and thought leadership.
• Develop people and partnerships: Contribute to an inclusive, collaborative environment and support the development of colleagues across teams and geographies.

Essential qualifications and experience

• Education: PhD, DABT, or an advanced university degree in toxicology, pharmacology, oncology, or a related scientific discipline, together with a strong scientific track record.
• Professional experience: Typically, at least 10 years of experience in project toxicology, investigative toxicology, regulatory toxicology, or related safety-focused roles within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CRO sector.
• Alternative experience pathway: Candidates with a minimum bachelor’s degree and substantial additional pharmaceutical industry experience may also be considered, including candidates with approximately 15 or more years of relevant experience.
• Oncology expertise: Deep understanding of oncology drug discovery and development, with a demonstrated ability to deliver toxicology programs supporting IND filings and broader development milestones.
• Modality expertise: Experience with radioconjugates or ADCs is preferred. Familiarity with small-molecule oncology therapeutics is also valuable.
• Translational safety skills: Experience applying in vitro, in silico, and in vivo tools to predict and characterize potential clinical safety risks.
• Leadership and collaboration: Ability to coordinate multiple projects across functions and geographies while working effectively in a complex, matrixed environment.
• Communication and influence: Strong scientific communication, interpersonal, and influencing skills, with the ability to inform decisions among scientific, clinical, and regulatory stakeholders.
• Commitment to inclusion: Demonstrated commitment to inclusion, diversity, collaboration, and team development, consistent with AstraZeneca’s Great Place to Work objectives.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $184,538  and $276,808 USD Annual. However, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.  In addition, our positions offer a short-term incentive bonus opportunity; eligibility to participate in our equity-based long-term incentive program (salaried roles) or to receive a retirement contribution (hourly roles). Benefits offered included a qualified retirement program [401(k) plan]; paid vacation and holidays; paid leaves; and, health benefits including medical, prescription drug, dental, and vision coverage in accordance with the terms and conditions of the applicable plans. Additional details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment. If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

AstraZeneca is where science meets innovation to create impactful solutions! We challenge the status quo by leveraging data to drive scientific breakthroughs that make a tangible difference in patients' lives. jobs.description:
Prudential’s purpose is to be partners for every life and protectors for every future. Our purpose encourages everything we do by creating a culture in which diversity is celebrated and inclusion assured, for our people, customers, and partners. Job Responsibilities / Phạm vi công việc

Key responsibilities assigned to this position are:

Financial risk oversight and early risk identification

• Provide second line oversight and independent challenge over key financial risks, including persistency, mortality, morbidity, expense, underwriting, claims, reinsurance, capital, solvency, ALM, market, credit, liquidity, self-funding distribution and emerging risks.
• Identify and escalate early warning signals, material exposures, root causes, potential missed opportunities and required management actions.

Risk appetite, capital and balance sheet management

• Support the review and monitoring of financial risk appetite, limits, indicators and escalation thresholds.
• Review and challenge capital, solvency, liquidity, product, pricing, assumption, reinsurance, investment and ALM matters, including inputs to ORSA, stress testing, capital planning and governance papers.

Insurance, product and portfolio risk oversight

• Assess financial risk implications of new products, product changes, campaigns, underwriting changes, reinsurance arrangements and self-funding distribution initiatives.
• Monitor experience trends, persistency behaviour, claims patterns, mortality and morbidity experience, portfolio quality and risk-adjusted opportunities.

Reporting, governance and stakeholder engagement

• Prepare clear risk reports, dashboards, committee papers and recommendations for management, governance forums and Group stakeholders.
• Partner with Actuarial, Finance, Investment, Product, Reinsurance, Compliance, Internal Audit and Group teams while maintaining clear second line independence.

Model, UDA and process governance support

• Support governance over material models, UDAs, financial risk tools, controls, remediation actions and continuous improvement of financial risk processes.

Skills Set/ Kỹ năng yêu cầu

• Strong financial risk judgement across life insurance, capital, solvency, ALM, market, credit, liquidity, reinsurance, persistency, mortality, morbidity and self-funding distribution risks.
• Ability to identify early warning signals, assess business impact, highlight potential missed opportunities and recommend practical management actions.
• Strong analytical skills, including experience analysis, assumption review, stress testing, product economics, valuation and pricing analysis.
• Clear communication and stakeholder management skills, with ability to provide constructive challenge while maintaining second line independence.
• Good execution discipline, including ability to manage priorities, produce clear papers and follow through on actions.

Job Requirements / Yêu cầu

- Degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Economics, Risk Management or a comparable discipline.

- At least 5 years of relevant life insurance experience, preferably across Financial Risk Management, Actuarial, Finance, Product, Valuation or Pricing.

- Experience in Valuation and Pricing is required, including understanding of product economics, assumptions, profitability, reserves, capital and financial reporting impacts.

- Good understanding of key financial and insurance risks, including persistency, mortality, morbidity, reinsurance, capital, solvency, ALM, market, credit, liquidity and self-funding distribution risks.

- Working knowledge of actuarial models, financial risk tools, spreadsheets and data analysis tools. Prophet, SAS, R, VBA, SQL or similar tools are a plus.

- Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management and execution skills, with ability to provide clear recommendations and constructive challenge.

jobs.title: Associate Scientist
jobs.description:
Build our future together:

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We are seeking an Associate Scientist to join our Protein Development Group within Therapeutic Proteins, supporting therapeutic discovery and development programs by purifying and characterizing antibodies and other protein reagents. You will work in a collaborative, fast-paced laboratory environment, using chromatography, analytical techniques, and automated equipment to deliver high-quality protein reagents and well-documented experimental data.

This position offers the opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing, science-driven organization making a meaningful difference to patients worldwide.

When & where:

• Location: Tarrytown, NY
• Work model: On-site

Discover your role:

• Purifies antibodies and other protein reagents using chromatography platforms and automated laboratory equipment
• Executes and optimizes purification workflows using affinity, ion-exchange, hydrophobic interaction, and size-exclusion chromatography
• Characterizes purified proteins using SDS-PAGE, Western blotting, CE-SDS, analytical SEC, spectrophotometry, and related techniques
• Evaluates protein purity, concentration, recovery, aggregation, and overall sample quality
• Analyzes results and maintains accurate, timely experimental records in ELN and data recording systems
• Summarizes and presents purification and characterization data to managers, project teams, and scientific collaborators
• Troubleshoots technical challenges in collaboration with colleagues
• Manages multiple assignments and priorities while maintaining data quality and sample integrity

This role requires:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, or a related discipline
• 0–2 years of relevant academic, internship, or industry laboratory experience in protein purification or characterization
• Hands-on experience with one or more purification techniques, such as affinity chromatography, IEX, HIC, or SEC
• Experience with one or more protein characterization techniques, such as HPLC, SDS-PAGE, Western blotting, CE-SDS, SEC, or spectrophotometry
• Ability to analyze experimental data and maintain accurate electronic laboratory records
• Strong organizational, written and verbal communication skills

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience purifying monoclonal antibodies, bispecific antibodies, or other complex protein formats
• Experience using ÄKTA chromatography systems
• Familiarity with automated purification or sample-processing equipment and experience working in a high-throughput or project-driven laboratory environment
• Familiarity with basic programming or scripting (e.g., Python or R) and an interest in applying computational tools to scientific data analysis and laboratory workflow improvement
• Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team

jobs.description:
Why Wells Fargo:

Are you looking for more? Find it here. At Wells Fargo, we're more than a financial services leader – we’re a global trailblazer committed to driving innovation, empowering communities, and helping our customers succeed. We believe that a meaningful career is much more than just a job – it’s about finding all of the elements to help you thrive, in one place. Living the Well Life means you’re supported in life, not just work. It means having robust benefits, competitive compensation, and programs designed to help you find work-life balance and well-being. You’ll be rewarded for investing in your community, celebrated for being your authentic self, and empowered to grow. And we’re recognized for it – Wells Fargo once again ranked in the top five on the 2026 LinkedIn Top Companies list of best workplaces “to grow your career” in the U.S. Join us!

About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Branch Premier Banker (SAFE) to play a pivotal role within our National Branch Network.  This role grows, deepens, and manages relationships with affluent customers and those with more complex financial needs, serving as their primary point of contact for banking products and services through scheduled appointments, lobby engagement, and proactive outreach.   This role is designed for growth-oriented professionals who lead with advice to acquire and deepen relationships through meaningful discovery and translate customer goals into comprehensive financial strategies.  You will own and actively grow a defined book of business, leveraging goals based planning, and prudent risk oversight to deliver integrated solutions across deposits, investments, credit, home lending, and business banking. In addition, you’ll help customers with everyday banking needs-opening accounts, handling service requests, and ensuring a seamless experience making it easier for them to manage their banking with confidence. Success in this role is driven by strong relationship acumen, proactive customer engagement, and seamless collaboration with internal partners across Wealth, Home Lending, and Business Banking to deliver a differentiated customer experience.

Wells Fargo rewards behaviors that consistently create long term customer value and support customers in making informed financial decisions. You’ll be supported with digital tools, industry leading training, ongoing coaching, and backed by one of the most recognized brands in banking. This role offers a clear platform for career growth for experienced professionals who excel at building trust, managing a portfolio, and delivering holistic, multi product solutions.

In this role you will:

• Proactively acquire new affluent consumer and business customers while deepening existing relationships through strategic outreach, referrals, and pre-planned customer appointments
• Lead discovery‑driven conversations to understand customer goals and deliver tailored banking and credit strategies that strengthen relationships, increase retention, and drive balanced growth across deposits, lending, and investments
• Serve as the primary financial partner delivering comprehensive, multi‑product guidance and ongoing reviews across life stages and evolving financial needs
• Partner with a team of professionals across Wealth, Home Lending, and Business Banking to deliver integrated solutions by coordinating warm introductions, setting clear expectations, and taking personal ownership to convert qualified opportunities into closed outcomes
• Champion digital adoption by educating customers on self-service and mobile banking options to elevate satisfaction, engagement, and service efficiency
• Serve as an active member of the branch team by advising colleagues on relationship development and the management of complex client needs
• Demonstrate risk excellence through accurate documentation, sound judgment, timely issue escalation, and adherence to policies and regulations to support strong control outcomes
• The Senior Branch Premier Banker LP (license pending) role is a temporary position until employee has successfully completed licensing requirements and SAFE registration. Upon successful completion, employees will transition to the Senior Branch Premier Banker (SAFE) role. Employees hired into the Senior Branch Premier Banker LP role who are not fully licensed will participate in the Branch Network Licensed Banker program.

Required Qualifications:

• 4+ years of customer service experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
• 3+ years of experience building and maintaining effective relationships with customers and partners
• 3+ years of experience recommending products and services

Desired Qualifications:

• Experience recommending financial products and translating customer goals into clear, actionable recommendations
• Demonstrated ability to proactively source, acquire, and deepen relationships through proactive outreach and building strong internal partnership to support the customer experience
• Proven experience managing a book-of-business, documentation of planning conversations, and consistent follow-through to drive retention and growth across deposits, lending, and investments
• Experience coaching or supporting peers to strengthen team performance and customer impact
• Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly and confidently, listen with empathy, and build credibility and trust quickly with others
• Financial services industry experience in one or a combination of the following: consumer, home lending, business banking, or investments
• 3+ years of experience in a licensed financial services position
• Successfully completed Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA)Series 6 and 63 exams (or FINRA recognized equivalents) sufficient to qualify for immediate FINRA registration
• State Insurance license(s)

Job Expectations:

• Ability to work a schedule that will include most Saturdays
• This role requires FINRA Series 6 and Series 63 (or FINRA recognized equivalents), and State Insurance license(s) which must be active or completed within a designated timeframe. For any FINRA qualification exams earned after Sept. 30, 2018, the Securities Industry Essentials (SIE) exam is also required.
• For the following states where hired, FINRA Series 65 (or equivalent) examination will also be required within a specified period of time: AK, AL, CT, DE, HI, IA, ID, IN, KS, MD, MI, MN, MS, NC, ND, NE, NM, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, and WY. jobs.title: #XPLORER 2027 AI-Driven Scenario Generation and Exploration for Aerospace Simulation
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Ready to join one of our Airbus Programs in Spain?
AIRBUS offers an internship (curricular practicum) program aimed at students who are in the last year of their degree with the main objective of acquiring professional skills through the development of a project in the company.

What do we offer?: Internship (curricular practicum) program + Bachelor’s Degree Final Project (TFG).

Mission: You will prepare a final year training project that will allow you to complete your official studies.

About practical training:

• 6 months of curricular practicum at AIRBUS from February to July 2027
• Part time: 5h / day - 25 hours per week (8h-13h)
• Tutor assignment for continuous monitoring

Final project (TFG) to be carried out by the student:

Background:

Simulation is an essential capability for aerospace engineering, system development and verification. However, defining meaningful simulation scenarios often requires substantial manual effort and domain expertise.

Recent advances in generative AI, constraint-based reasoning and automatic search offer new opportunities to support simulation engineers in scenario creation and exploration.

TFG Objetive:

The objetive of this TFG is to desing and implement a proof of concept that uses AI techniques to generate, validate and explore simulation scenarios from high-level requirements.

Main Activities:

- Review state-of-the-art approaches for AI-based scenario generation and simulation testing.

- Define a representative aerospace-inspired simulation use case and a structured scenario model.

- Develop and AI-assisted scenario generator and a deterministic validation mechanism.

- Integrate the prototype with a suitable simulation backend.

- Analyse simulation logs to evaluate scenario outcomes.

- Document the architecture, findings, limitations and opportunities for further research.

Required skills #AirbusDiversity

As a successful candidate, you will be able to demonstrate the following skills and experience:

We are looking for a student pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Aerospace Engineering or a related discipline.

Interest or experience in Python, C++. generative AI, software development, simulation, automated testing, optimisation or data analysis would be valuable

The ideal candidate is curious, analytical and motivated to explore how emerging AI techniques can address real engineering challenges.

A minimum English level of B2 is required, with C1 preferred, as the TFG might involved technical documentation, research and collaboration in an international environment. A minimum Spanish level B1 is also required.

The candidate should demonstrate a strong team spirit, good communication and collaboration skills and ability to work effectively in multicultural and multinational teams

Why should you apply?

- Foster your development with a strong academic background and an in-depth collaboration in AIRBUS projects.

- Expand your network within the aeronautical industry.

- Meet our people working with passion and determination to make the world a more connected, safer and smarter place.

- Be part of our diversity and teamwork culture that propel us to accomplish the extraordinary - on the ground, in the sky and in space.

- Get in touch with the industrial sector at a leading company in Spain

Are you interested? Apply and make it fly!

jobs.title: STAGE 2027 -  Ingénieur HSE/Spécialiste HSE (ALL GENDER)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

En quête d’une première expérience qui fait la différence ?

Rejoins Airbus Atlantic et donne une trajectoire unique à ton parcours grâce à ce stage.

Nous sommes un leader mondial sur le marché des aérostructures, des sièges pilotes et des fauteuils passagers premium.

Dans le cadre de votre formation initiale, vous recherchez un stage obligatoire ou intégré dans une année de césure, d’une durée de 4 à 6 mois, vous permettant de valider votre année.

Une offre de stage intitulée « STAGE 2027 - Ingénieur HSE/Spécialiste HSE     (ALL GENDER) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein d’Airbus Atlantic sur le site de Montoir de Bretagne.

Cette mission débutera en janvier 2027 (date sujette à flexibilité) pour une durée de 6 mois.

Découvrez le site en vidéo :

Retrouvez Airbus Atlantic en vidéo et la présentation du site de Montoir de Bretagne

Tâches et responsabilités :

Vous rejoindrez une équipe de 5 personnes au sein du département  « HSE » en charge de la prévention des risques professionnels, de la gestion des accidents du travail et de la conformité réglementaire (activité principale de l’équipe)

Encadré par votre tuteur, vous interviendrez sur les activités suivantes :

• Maîtrise de l'accidentologie du site : analyse des presqu'îles et accidents du travail, suivi des indicateurs et proposition d'actions correctives.
• Déploiement de la roadmap HSE : participation au suivi des objectifs annuels du site et au déploiement des standards du groupe.
• Maîtrise des risques et conformité réglementaire : réalisation de veilles, audits de terrain et suivi de la mise en conformité des installations.
• Gestion des entreprises extérieures : élaboration des plans de prévention, délivrance des permis de travail et accueil sécurité des intervenants.
• Intégration du HSE dans les projets : évaluation des impacts sécurité et environnementaux sur les projets d'aménagement ou d'industrialisation en cours.

Durant votre stage, vous développerez les compétences suivantes en lien avec votre formation :

• Méthodologies d’analyse des risques : Démarche de mise à jour du DUERP et outils d'investigation d'accidents (Arbre des causes, 5 Pourquoi).
• Droit et conformité HSE : Veille réglementaire (Code du travail/environnement) et gestion juridique de la coactivité (Plans de prévention, permis de travail).
• Systèmes de management (SMI) : Connaissance des normes ISO (45001, 14001), suivi des indicateurs de performance (TF, TG) et réalisation d'audits terrain.
• Intégration HSE en mode projet : Évaluation des impacts sécurité et environnementaux lors de nouveaux aménagements industriels.
• Pédagogie et culture de prévention : Conception de supports de communication, animation de terrain (quarts d'heure sécurité) et accompagnement opérationnel au changement.

Parlons de VOUS !

Vous préparez actuellement un diplôme de niveau Bac +5 (ou équivalent) dans le domaine HSE  ou une discipline apparentée.

Vous avez les connaissances et compétences suivantes :

• Connaissance HSE
• Utilisation logiciel bureautique
• Savoir être : Curiosité, Esprit d'équipe, Bonne communication,Capacité d'adaptation

Langues:

• Anglais : intermédiaire
• Français : courant

Parlons de NOUS !

Rejoindre Airbus Atlantic en tant que stagiaire, c'est :

• Participer à des projets ambitieux, à la pointe de la technologie, visant à construire l’avion de demain tout en répondant aux défis environnementaux,
• Acquérir des compétences dans un environnement dynamique qui encourage la créativité et l'initiative, avec une approche entrepreneuriale,
• Évoluer au sein d'une organisation solidaire, qui valorise la proximité et l'humain.

Notre processus de sélection

Toutes les candidatures seront soigneusement examinées par un recruteur.

Si votre candidature est présélectionnée, vous serez invité à réaliser un entretien vidéo afin de vous présenter.

Après évaluation, les candidats retenus seront contactés pour un entretien avec le manager ou le tuteur qui procédera alors à la sélection finale.

Job Description:

The Company

We build the machines that power industry. We are Hitachi Global Air Power, a leading global industrial compressed air manufacturer driving the innovations that keep the world moving.

From our headquarters in Michigan City, Indiana, our compressed air solutions power manufacturing operations all around the globe; from food and beverage to life-saving pharmaceuticals and cutting-edge semiconductor chips. Our portable compressors provide the air power to build roads and bridges, lay pipelines and aid in oil and gas mining and production.

We are a team of innovators, engineers, and quality experts with a shared vision to create the next generation of efficient, environment-forward compressed air solutions that meet the demands of today, while boldly contributing to a sustainable, circular economy. With more than 58 years of legacy and trusted performance through our brands - Hitachi, Sullair, and Champion (Australia), we are proud of our reputation for reliability, durability, and performance and groundbreaking engineering.

Join us in building a future where your work has an impact. At Hitachi Global Air Power, you’ll be part of a global network that’s shaping the future of industrial power.

Summary of the position:

The Product Manager, Global, Oil-Flooded Compressors is responsible for developing and executing the global product strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle management for the Sullair Oil-Flooded compressor portfolio. This role drives profitable growth through market insight, product innovation, and cross-functional leadership.

Duties and responsibilities:

• Develop and execute the global product strategy, vision, and multi-year roadmap for the Oil-Flooded compressor portfolio.
• Manage the complete product lifecycle, including new product introduction, growth, optimization, rationalization, and end-of-life planning.
• Lead Voice of Customer (VoC) initiatives to identify unmet customer needs, market trends, and product improvement opportunities.
• Develop and govern global pricing, positioning, and portfolio strategies that support revenue growth and margin expansion.
• Partner with Engineering, Operations, and Procurement teams to drive new product development, cost optimization, and Value Analysis/Value Engineering (VAVE) initiatives.
• Support demand forecasting, Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP), and inventory optimization activities to improve business performance.
• Lead global product launch activities, ensuring successful commercialization, market adoption, and achievement of business case objectives.
• Monitor product line financial performance, including revenue, profitability, pricing realization, and return on investment.
• Align global and regional stakeholders around product strategy, roadmap priorities, investment decisions, and market requirements.
• Analyze sales performance, market penetration, and channel effectiveness to identify opportunities for growth and market share expansion.
• Gather and analyze market, customer, competitive, and industry intelligence to identify growth opportunities and support strategic decision-making.
• Conduct competitive benchmarking and product positioning analyses in collaboration with Engineering and commercial teams to maintain market competitiveness.
• Develop and execute aftermarket growth strategies, including service offerings, parts, upgrades, and lifecycle value enhancement opportunities.
• Serve as a product champion and train-the-trainer resource, ensuring organizational readiness and product knowledge across regions.
• Provide technical and commercial support to Sales, Service, Customer Support, Marketing, and Operations teams as required.
• Support customer engagement, channel partner development, industry events, and promotional activities to strengthen product awareness and market presence.
• Lead the development of business cases and investment proposals for new products, product enhancements, and strategic growth initiatives.
• Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure portfolio health, product success, customer satisfaction, and business performance.
• Collaborate with Marketing and Communications teams to develop value propositions, messaging, sales tools, and go-to-market strategies.
• Ensure compliance with applicable product regulations, industry standards, and sustainability initiatives across global markets.

Success Metrics

• Revenue growth +5% to +15% annually
• Gross margin improvement of 1 to 3 points annually
• 1-to-3-point market share gains in targeted segments
• On-time completion of assigned NPD deliverables

Qualifications:

Education:

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business Administration, or Equivalent field
• Product Mgmt. Program and / or Project Mgmt. Certification a plus
• LEAN / 6 SIGMA a plus

Professional experience:

• 5 to 10 years product management experience in industrial or capital equipment markets
• Compressed air product management experience strongly preferred; rotating equipment experience considered
• Strong business and financial acumen.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

• New product development process or stage-gate development process
• Product strategy and product roadmap development
• Product forecasting and S&OP
• Business case development
• Product launch and product lifecycle management
• Product marketing and channel strategy development
• Product value engineering tools and techniques
• Cross functional team experience, matrix management experience

Key behaviors:

• Strategic Planning and Execution Translates business objectives into actionable product strategies, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.
• Influence and Stakeholder Management Builds alignment and drives decisions across a matrixed organization without direct authority.
• Effective Communication Communicates complex technical and business concepts with clarity, adapting messaging to diverse audiences and levels of the organization.
• Collaboration Across Boundaries Fosters strong partnerships across regions, functions, cultures, and organizational levels to achieve shared objectives.
• Customer Insight and Market Curiosity Demonstrates a deep commitment to understanding customer needs, market trends, and emerging opportunities.
• Analytical Thinking and Business Acumen Uses data, market intelligence, and financial analysis to make informed decisions and prioritize investments.
• Continuous Improvement and Innovation Mindset Challenges the status quo, embraces change, and drives innovation to improve products, processes, and customer value.
• Decision Making and Calculated Risk Taking Makes timely, informed decisions while balancing business objectives, customer needs, and organizational risk.
• Results Orientation and Accountability Takes ownership of outcomes, delivers on commitments, and holds self-accountable for business performance.
• Global Perspective Understands the balance between global standardization and regional market requirements, enabling scalable growth across diverse markets.
• Leadership Through Expertise Serves as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert, earning credibility through knowledge, integrity, and collaboration.
• Growth Mindset Continuously seeks opportunities to learn, develop, and expand capabilities while encouraging the same in others.

Direct reports:

• N/A

The Account Manager is a specialized commercial role designed to address market complexity such as low disease awareness, patient identification challenges, or complex referral pathways. Customer Service Consultant | S1 | Mortgage & Savings Servicing | Customer Service Operations | Barnwood, Gloucester | 6 Month FTC

Country: United Kingdom

IT STARTS HERE

Santander is evolving from a global, high-impact brand into a technology-driven organisation, and our people are at the heart of this journey. Together, we are driving a customer-centric transformation that values bold thinking, innovation and the courage to challenge what's possible.

This is more than a strategic shift. It's a chance for driven professionals to grow, learn and make a real difference.

Our mission is to contribute to help more people and businesses prosper. We embrace a strong risk culture and all our professionals at all levels are expected to take a proactive and responsible approach toward risk management.

Retail & Commercial Banking is a global business integrating all our retail and commercial banking activities to better serve our customers, improve efficiency and drive value creation.

Supporting TSB's Mortgage & Savings Servicing teams, you'll play an important role in supporting customers throughout their financial journey. Whether helping a customer with their mortgage account or supporting a savings enquiry, you'll help deliver simple, trusted and personalised service that makes a real difference to their experience.

THE DIFFERENCE YOU MAKE

TSB Mortgage & Savings Servicing are looking for a Customer Service Consultant, based at our Barnwood, Gloucester office.

In this role, you'll support customers across both Mortgage and Savings Servicing, developing a broad range of skills while helping customers with their everyday banking needs. You'll play an important role in delivering great customer outcomes by providing accurate, efficient and personalised support across a variety of servicing activities.

We're shaping the way we work through innovation, collaboration and the use of digital tools to make banking simpler for our customers. To succeed in this role, you will be responsible for:

• Supporting customers with mortgage and savings enquiries through a range of servicing channels
• Completing mortgage and savings account administration activities accurately and efficiently
• Updating and maintaining customer and account records with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail
• Processing customer requests, account maintenance activities and account closures in line with established procedures
• Completing interest calculations and adjustments where required to support customer outcomes
• Building strong customer relationships by understanding individual circumstances and identifying the right solutions
• Providing clear, straightforward information that helps customers feel confident and informed
• Collaborating with colleagues across the wider team to deliver a consistent and high-quality customer experience
• Developing your knowledge and capability to support a wide range of mortgage and savings servicing activities
• Identifying opportunities to improve processes and enhance the service we provide to customers

Our shifts are Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm. Full-time working hours are 35 hours per week.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Our people are our greatest strength. Every individual contributes unique perspectives that make us stronger as a team and as an organisation. We're enabling teams to go beyond by valuing who they are and empowering what they bring.

The following requirements represent the knowledge, skills and abilities essential for success in this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

• Experience delivering excellent customer service and supporting customers with a range of enquiries and requests
• Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to understand customer needs and provide clear, practical solutions
• Excellent attention to detail and the ability to process information accurately in a fast-paced environment
• Experience completing administrative or operational tasks while maintaining high levels of accuracy and quality
• A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively as part of a team
• Confidence learning new processes, systems and products, with a willingness to develop knowledge across multiple servicing activities
• Good problem-solving skills and a focus on achieving positive customer outcomes

WE VALUE YOUR IMPACT

At Santander, your contribution matters. We recognise the difference you make every day, and we make sure you feel valued, supported and rewarded in return.

Here, recognition goes beyond pay. It's about the pride you feel in your work, the impact you have on customers and communities, and the opportunities you have to grow and thrive, personally and professionally.

The starting salary is £25,000 together with a £500 flexible benefit allowance and the opportunity to earn a discretionary performance-related bonus of 8% of salary.

• £500 annual cash allowance to spend on our great range of benefits
• 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays, increasing to 26 days after 5 years' service, with the option to purchase up to 5 additional contractual days per year
• Voluntary healthcare benefits at discounted rates, including medical insurance, dental insurance and health assessments
• We put 8% of salary into your pension, even if you don't contribute yourself. We'll pay in up to 12.5% of salary if you contribute as well, and you can take some of our contribution in cash if you prefer
• Protection for you and your family through company-funded life assurance and income protection insurance, with options to increase cover
• Share in Santander's success through our employee share plans
• Access to staff versions of selected Santander products and a range of colleague discounts
• Competitive rewards that reflect the real impact you make and the value you bring
• Wellbeing support across physical, mental, social and financial wellbeing
• Support for every life stage, including enhanced family leave and tailored wellbeing resources
• Time to give back through volunteering opportunities in the communities we serve
• Global growth opportunities to develop your career and build new skills

Ready to be recognised? It starts with you.

LOCAL COMPLIANCE

At Santander, we're proud to be an inclusive organisation that provides equal opportunities for everyone, regardless of age, gender, disability, civil status, race, religion or sexual orientation.

We're committed to creating a recruitment experience that's accessible, fair and welcoming for all candidates.

We want our people to thrive at work and at home while delivering the best outcomes for our customers and supporting each other to grow.

To make this possible, our roles are site-based with a hybrid working pattern. Colleagues will be expected to attend the office for initial training, followed by a hybrid approach once fully trained.

When applying, please consider the travel distance, time and cost to your chosen office location.

RIGHT TO WORK IN THE UK

• All candidates must have the right to work in the UK to commence employment with Santander.

WHAT TO DO NEXT

If this sounds like a role you are interested in, then please apply.

If there's anything we can do in the recruitment process to help you achieve your best, get in touch. Whether it's a copy of our application form in another format or additional assistance, we're available through email. You can contact us at careers@tsb.co.uk.

GE’s Onshore wind power capacity is growing fast and will continue to rise steadily in the coming years. The Wind Technician position requires local travel within the hub. The Wind Technician is a critical and active role to maintain optimal function and output at the wind site by working daily on turbine operations, safety, quality control and warranty repair(s). The Wind Technician partners and communicates with the Site Lead and Manager to execute on contract requirements and timelines and ensures alignment with GE excellence!

Essential Responsibilities

As the Wind Technician you will:

• Work with site & hub leadership to execute contractual obligations per customer requirements and activities set forth with on a daily basis, which include any portion of the electrical and mechanical equipment used in the GE wind turbine generator;
• Perform maintenance, repair or replacement of parts to correct malfunctions;
• Troubleshoot complex mechanical, hydraulic, and electrical problems on variable pitch & variable speed turbines;
• Help in all areas of site operations as directed by manager with minimal supervision; observing all safety requirements;
• Perform some diagnostic electrical analysis;
• Document all work performed using computer based service reporting procedures and
• Work with and respond to GE’s remote operations center when necessary.

• Effectively prioritize work according to contract obligations
• Ability and willingness to take initiative, and work without direct supervision, and

Job Description Summary

Working on the GE Haliade-X platform, the Service Lead will play a key role operating and maintaining this next generation turbine on what will be the world’s largest offshore project. Responsible for co-ordination of planned and corrective operational activities, providing team leadership and full responsibility for rotation readiness of work for the short-term plan. Working as an integral part of a wider planning team who will help support preparation of work ready for the Service Lead to execute.  The Service Lead will cover the full scope of task execution from preparation of parts/tools, setting people to work to reporting of task progress and turbine status.

Primary location will be offshore, on rotation.
The onshore base location of Dogger Bank O&M Base is at the Port of Tyne.

Job Description

• Exemplify GE Leadership Behaviours - Act with Humility, Lead with Transparency, Deliver with Focus
• Champion for GE Lean program, introducing and implementing LEAN principles.
• Responsibilities:
• Ensure safe turbine maintenance operations are carried out, with high standards of quality, delivered to budget and according to the defined schedule, recording and tracking relevant KPIs and reporting on progress, deviations to plans and mitigations.
• Demonstrate a high safety standard and ensure all working parties comply with Emergency Response Plans according to the local, site and GE policies with the support of required stakeholders.
• Lead the operational team onboard the SOV. Be fully responsible for the execution of all service-related activities with respect to SQDC within your area of responsibility.

Church & Dwight is seeking a Logistics Systems Analyst II. This position will be located in Fort Collins, CO on a hybrid basis.

The Logistics Systems Analyst II will serve as the primary business resource for logistics systems, customer logistics, retail compliance, and related operational processes. This role will provide Oracle systems expertise, user support, training, process documentation, chargeback analysis, and continuous improvement support to strengthen operational efficiency, business continuity, and compliance with customer requirements. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in logistics operations, Oracle enterprise resource planning systems, retail compliance, and process improvement, with a proven ability to analyze issues, document requirements, and guide effective solutions. This role will involve cross-functional collaboration with Logistics, Customer Service, Distribution, Transportation, Information Technology, business users, and external partners.

• Systems Expertise and Support: Serve as the primary business subject matter expert for Oracle and other logistics, transportation, and fulfillment systems; provide user support, troubleshooting, and issue resolution for system, transaction, and process issues.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate with Logistics, Customer Service, Distribution, Transportation, Information Technology, business users, and external partners to resolve complex operational issues and support consistent execution.

• Training and Documentation: Develop and deliver training programs, standard operating procedures, work instructions, and process documentation that support employee development, cross-training, business continuity, and process consistency.
• Data and Analytics: Monitor system performance, process compliance, data accuracy, chargebacks, and fulfillment results; perform root cause analysis and use findings to recommend corrective actions and strengthen system controls.
• Project Management: Contribute to system implementations, enhancements, process improvement initiatives, testing, training, documentation, and adoption activities across multiple priorities.
• Travel: Some domestic travel may be required.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business Administration, Information Systems, or related field.
• 3+ years of experience in logistics, transportation, customer fulfillment, supply chain operations, business systems support, retail compliance, or a related discipline.
• Experience with Oracle enterprise resource planning or similar business systems.
• Experience supporting system implementations, process improvement initiatives, user acceptance testing, training, and documentation.
• Strong knowledge of logistics, transportation, order fulfillment, customer logistics, retail compliance, and chargeback processes.
• Proficiency with logistics systems and customer compliance requirements, including electronic data interchange, advance ship notices, routing, and labeling.
• Demonstrated ability to analyze data, perform root cause analysis, develop recommendations, and support process and system improvements.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, documentation, communication, collaboration, and training skills.

Supports the Sales team clarifying and negotiating with the Customer the Technical/Commercial Offer and Execution Plan. Handover won deals for execution.

Lead the GE Risk Management processes and facilitate internal deal reviews. Support contractual negotiations on Terms and Conditions, value proposition and delivery.

Job Description Summary

The energy transition depends on projects being delivered with precision — on time, on budget, and with complete confidence in the data that drives decisions. As a Project Controls Lead, you will be the regional owner of the processes, tools, and governance that make that possible.

You will serve as the primary administrator for Planisware — GE Vernova's enterprise project portfolio management (PPM) platform — across the North Europe region. Your work directly enables regional leadership to make faster, more informed decisions, and ensures that every project in the portfolio meets the standards required for executive and audit-level reporting.

This is a role for someone who finds clarity in complexity and takes genuine satisfaction in building systems that others can rely on.

Job Description

What You'll Do

• Administer the platform: Maintain the Planisware environment for the North Europe region, including project structures, workflows, templates, and user roles — keeping configuration consistent with global standards.
• Own data quality: Set and enforce data governance standards across the regional portfolio. Conduct regular audits, apply corrective actions, and ensure project data is accurate and audit-ready at all times.
• Support project controls delivery: Work directly with project teams to support Earned Value Management (EVM), schedule management, RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) tracking, and change control processes.
• Manage the reporting rhythm: Oversee the regional reporting cadence, validate data ahead of executive reviews, and ensure outputs are accurate and distributed on schedule.
• Build capability across the region: Act as the first point of contact for platform queries. Lead onboarding and training sessions to improve adoption and reduce recurring errors.
• Drive continuous improvement: Identify workflow inefficiencies, contribute to the global Project Controls community of practice, and participate in the testing and rollout of platform updates.

Who We're Looking For

You are a detail-oriented project controls professional who is as comfortable working with data systems as you are working with people. You build trust through consistency, communicate clearly across technical and non-technical audiences, and take ownership of the processes others depend on.

Required

• Experience in project controls, project administration, or a PMO (Project Management Office) capacity within the energy, engineering, or infrastructure sectors.
• Hands-on experience administering or managing data within an enterprise PPM or project management platform such as Planisware, Oracle Primavera P6, or equivalent.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite — particularly Excel for data manipulation and reporting, and PowerPoint for executive-level dashboards and presentations.
• A formal education and subsequent Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant subject such as Engineering, Project Management, or Business is nice to have, but we are most interested in your total experience and professional achievements.

Preferred

• Certification in Planisware or a comparable platform administration credential; familiarity with EVM and schedule management principles.
• PRINCE2 Foundation, APM PMQ (Project Management Qualification), or equivalent project management certification.
• Demonstrated ability to build consensus and guide adoption of new processes across teams without direct authority over those teams.

Why GE Vernova

GE Vernova employees rise to the challenge of building a world that works. jobs.title: Product Director - Evinova
jobs.description:
About Evinova:

Evinova enables global life sciences to accelerate better health outcomes through innovative digital health solutions for clinical research. We are a distinct business within the AstraZeneca group — advancing digital transformation across the clinical trial, hospital operations, and patient treatment landscape.

Role Overview:

Evinova is seeking an entrepreneurial, AI-fluent Product Director to take ownership of a core product area, building it from the ground up with AI at its foundation. This is a founding product leadership role: you will define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for an AI-native product that fundamentally changes how clinical development and clinical operations teams work—designing for the end user first, enabling seamless, collaborative workflows, and driving connectivity across Evinova’s modules so that the platform works as one.

As Product Director, you will operate with significant autonomy and act as the general manager for your product area at Evinova. This is an individual contributor role: you will not have direct reports, but you will lead and encourage a matrixed, cross-functional team—engineering, design, data science, and commercial—through vision, influence, and clarity. You will identify whitespace, validate opportunities directly with end users and customers, ship V1 products, and iterate relentlessly—embedding AI and machine learning into every layer of the product build, maintenance, and experience, and driving connectivity across Evinova’s modules so workflows flow seamlessly for clinical development and clinical operations teams. This role requires a builder who thrives in ambiguity and brings the conviction to create something new within a world-class life sciences software organization.

What you’ll do

BUILD AN AI-NATIVE PRODUCT FROM ZERO TO ONE

• Define and own the product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for an AI-native product, from first principles through scale.
• Develop a deep, first-hand understanding of our users, their problem spaces, and their day-to-day workflows—pinpointing where the product can deliver step-function impact rather than incremental gains.
• Drive rapid hypothesis validation through prototyping and experimentation.
• Own the full product lifecycle end-to-end: from concept and design through development, launch, go-to-market, and post-launch iteration informed by usage data and customer feedback.

Lead AI-Native product development

• Architect the product with AI and machine learning at its core—for example: intelligent automation, contextual recommendations, predictive insights, and generative AI–powered workflows that reduce effort for end users.
• Collaborate closely with data science and engineering teams to translate ground breaking AI capabilities into practical, regulation-aware product features.
• Design for the end user first—building intuitive, collaborative workflows that reduce burden and enable clinical development and clinical operations teams to work seamlessly together, with connectivity across Evinova’s modules.
• Meet users where they are and guide them through their change management journey—earning adoption by easing the transition to new, AI-enabled ways of working rather than forcing it.
• Maintain a sharp point of view on the evolving clinical trial and AI landscape—proactively finding opportunities to apply emerging capabilities to the challenges faced by clinical development and clinical operations teams.

Drive strategic leadership across Evinova

• Partner with a matrixed product organization to drive connectivity across Evinova’s modules and inform the product roadmap. Partner with commercial to ensure the product does not over-fit to any one customer. Iterate relentlessly in pursuit of product-market fit.
• Serve as the strategic product leader across the organization, aligning engineering, design, data science, and commercial around a unified product vision.
• Communicate product strategy, progress, and trade-offs to Evinova’s executive leadership and key enterprise customers.
• Define and own success metrics—adoption, engagement, revenue contribution, clinical trial cycle-time reduction—and drive data-informed prioritization.

Operate with entrepreneurial ownership

• Treat your product area as your own business—own the P&L outlook, make resource trade-offs, and drive measurable commercial outcomes.
• Navigate the tension between speed-to-market and regulatory compliance (GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, GDPR, HIPAA).
• Cultivate strategic partnerships with data providers and standards bodies (CDISC, HL7 FHIR) to accelerate Evinova’s product capabilities.
• Champion a culture of experimentation, intellectual integrity, and continuous learning within your product area and across the broader Evinova team.

What you bring

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

• 8+ years minimum of experience
• Bachelor's Degree
• Demonstrated experience at a director-level or senior product leadership capacity owning a product area end-to-end.
• Domain experience in clinical trials or life sciences. You bring a deep understanding of the clinical development and clinical operations personas, know the clinical ecosystem (EDC, CDMS, CTMS, eTMF), and can engage credibly with clinical operations leaders, medical directors, biostatisticians, data managers, and regulatory professionals.
• Demonstrated entrepreneurial track record: you have taken at least one product from zero to one—as a founder, early-stage PM, or intrapreneur within a larger organization. You can point to products you conceived, shipped, and scaled.
• Deep, hands-on experience building AI/ML-powered products. You understand model development lifecycles, training data strategies, prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, and the unique UX challenges of AI-driven features. AI fluency is non-negotiable for this role.
• Proven ability to operate in enterprise B2B SaaS environments, including navigating complex customer landscapes, long sales cycles, and platform-level product decisions.
• Strong technical skill: comfortable partnering directly with engineers and data scientists, reviewing technical specifications, and contributing to architectural trade-off decisions.

AI Fluency Expectations

• You use AI tools daily in your own workflow—for research, analysis, writing, prototyping, and decision-making—and can articulate how AI is transforming product development practices.
• You can evaluate AI/ML model outputs, reason about precision/recall trade-offs, and make informed product decisions around model thresholds, confidence scoring, and human-in-the-loop design patterns.
• You maintain a current and informed perspective on the AI landscape—foundation models, agentic AI, retrieval-augmented generation, fine-tuning—and have a point of view on how these capabilities apply to regulated industries like clinical research.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience as a founder or co-founder of a technology company, or as the first product hire at an early-stage startup.
• Working knowledge of clinical trial data standards (CDISC SDTM/ADaM, CDASH) and regulatory submission workflows.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to encourage life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

Are you ready to bring new insights and fresh thinking to the table? Fantastic! We have one seat available, and we hope it’s yours. Apply today.

Why Evinova?

Evinova draws on AstraZeneca’s deep experience developing novel therapeutics, informed by insights from thousands of patients and clinical researchers. Together, we accelerate the delivery of life-changing medicines, improve the design and delivery of clinical trials for better patient experiences and outcomes, and think more holistically about patient care before, during, and after treatment.

Evinova represents a unique opportunity to deliver meaningful outcomes with digital and AI to serve the wider healthcare community and create new standards for the sector. We work a minimum of three days per week from the office to maintain the pace, connection, and creative friction that builds great products, while respecting individual flexibility.

Join us on our journey of building a new kind of health tech business to reset expectations of what a biopharmaceutical company can be. This means opening new ways to work, pioneering latest methods, and bringing unexpected teams together. Interested? Come and join our journey.
