jobs.title: Head of Enterprise Digital Assets & Tokenization
jobs.description:
About the Role:

Grade Level (for internal use):

14

The Team

The Head of Enterprise Digital Assets & Tokenization leads S&P Global's central Digital Assets & Tokenization team, reporting to S&P DJI's Head of Business Acceleration & Special Projects, who oversees the team on behalf of S&P Global's Head of DeFi (Chief Product & Operations Officer, S&P DJI).

S&P Global's position is straightforward: markets execute on trust, and S&P anchors it — on every rail. Our data, identifiers, benchmarks, indices and risk assessments are the infrastructure of trusted workflows, and they must be as authoritative onchain as they are today. This is a small, senior team with an enterprise mandate to make that happen: set direction, prioritize where the firm invests, unblock divisions, and land the external partnerships that de-risk each initiative.

The team is deliberately lean. It is not a shadow product organization and not a research function. Divisions own delivery and revenue; this team sets the agenda, sponsors funding, brings partners to the table and holds the enterprise to a bias for in-production outcomes rather than pilots. Delivery capacity is drawn from divisional execution pods and from Kensho engineering. The role has two direct reports at the outset, with scope to grow as the portfolio warrants.

Responsibilities and Impact

Enterprise Strategy, Prioritization & Capital Allocation

• Own the enterprise digital assets and tokenization strategy day-to-day, translating it into a prioritized, funded and sequenced portfolio of initiatives across divisions.
• Run a single intake for divisional requests and enterprise-originated opportunities; apply and continuously sharpen the "Start Now" screening criteria and stage gates covering division readiness, resourcing, partner commitment and regulatory sensitivity.
• Co-own and sponsor business cases that secure investment at both enterprise and divisional level; make explicit recommendations on what to start, what to hold and what to stop.
• Maintain a defensible, evidence-based view of market direction – tokenization economics, onchain market structure, and the AI × blockchain intersection – and use it to keep the firm's portfolio ahead of, not behind, client demand.

Delivery & Execution with Divisions

• Drive priority initiatives to in-production status with paying customers, augmenting divisional teams that lack capacity, depth or delivery muscle.
• Appoint and hold a single accountable owner for each enterprise or divisional opportunity; empower them to execute and remove the obstacles they cannot clear themselves.
• Build the playbooks, trained people and repeatable processes that divisions own after handover, so central involvement is time-boxed by design.
• Maintain a live enterprise view of initiative milestones, decisions and dependencies; cut duplication and connect complementary work across divisions.

External Partnerships & Commercial Development

• Build and personally hold senior relationships across the institutions that matter most in onchain capital markets — onchain-native platforms, issuers, protocols and infrastructure providers, and the banks, asset managers and market infrastructure firms moving onto these rails.
• Negotiate partnerships in which counterparties co-invest, commit to production use and provide the requirements that ensure fit within their workflows; avoid peripheral collaborations that consume time without producing adoption.
• Shape commercial constructs for onchain distribution — consumption and per-call economics, licensing terms, and pricing models suited to agent- and protocol-mediated consumption — in partnership with divisional commercial and legal teams.
• Represent S&P Global externally with credibility: conferences, standards bodies, working groups, industry consortia, and direct engagement with founders, investors and executives.

Internal Alignment, Governance & Risk

• Convene and run the enterprise governance forum for digital assets, preparing the material and framing the decisions that senior sponsors need to make.
• Align divisions, corporate functions and enterprise leadership behind a shared set of priorities, resolving competing interests and sequencing trade-offs so that initiatives advance on mutual benefit rather than mandate.
• Keep Legal, Risk and Compliance sighted on everything in flight; run a lightweight, fast checkpoint before any initiative moves from exploration to pilot or commitment, protecting the firm from legal, compliance and reputational exposure.
• Escalate cleanly and early: surface new opportunities, emerging risks and stop decisions to the governing council with a clear recommendation.

Leadership & Influence

• Lead a small, high-calibre team and grow it as the portfolio warrants; set a standard of ownership, pace and evidence-based argument.
• Work with talent and engineering leadership to build protocol and AI × blockchain capability across the firm, including through Kensho.
• Act as a trusted advisor to divisional and enterprise leaders: direct about trade-offs, credible on the technology, and grounded in commercial reality.
• Operate almost entirely through influence rather than direct authority, across a global, matrixed organization.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

• 10+ years of experience in capital markets, asset management, financial data and infrastructure, or digital assets, including senior roles with enterprise-wide or firm-building scope.
• Demonstrated hands-on experience in digital assets: tokenized products, digital asset funds or indices, onchain infrastructure, or the operational and control build-out required to bring them to market. Operator experience is valued well above observer experience.
• Proven track record of standing up new businesses, products or functions from zero to production, including vendor, counterparty and partner selection, launch, and the operating processes that sustain them.
• An established external network across onchain-native firms and traditional financial institutions, and the credibility to open and hold senior relationships from a standing start.
• Commercial judgment: experience building business cases, structuring partnerships and commercial terms, and making disciplined calls on where to invest and where to walk away.
• Demonstrated success aligning competing priorities and stakeholder interests across independent business units, and delivering through influence rather than direct authority.
• Executive-level communication: able to brief senior leadership and external principals with equal clarity, and to challenge as well as partner.
• Comfort operating within regulatory, legal and compliance constraints, and partnering with control functions to move quickly without creating exposure.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience launching regulated, index-linked or benchmark-linked products, or working with ratings, reference data, identifiers or index production.
• Sufficient technical fluency in blockchain architecture, smart contracts and onchain data to engage engineering teams and partners substantively; a hands-on engineering background is not required.
• Experience building and scaling small teams, and handing capability over to larger organizations.
• Exposure to board, investment committee or council-level governance.

Compensation/Benefits Information: (This section is only applicable to US candidates)

S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $185,000 to $265,000. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual’s geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses and certifications.

In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan. This role is eligible to receive additional S&P Global benefits. For more information on the benefits we provide to our employees, please click here.

About S&P Global Dow Jones Indices

At S&P Dow Jones Indices, we provide iconic and innovative index solutions backed by unparalleled expertise across the asset-class spectrum. By bringing transparency to the global capital markets, we empower investors everywhere to make decisions with conviction. We’re the largest global resource for index-based concepts, data and research, and home to iconic financial market indicators, such as the S&P 500® and the Dow Jones Industrial Average®. More assets are invested in products based upon our indices than any other index provider in the world. With over USD 7.4 trillion in passively managed assets linked to our indices and over USD 11.3 trillion benchmarked to our indices, our solutions are widely considered indispensable in tracking market performance, evaluating portfolios and developing investment strategies.

S&P Dow Jones Indices is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI). S&P Global is the world’s foremost provider of credit ratings, benchmarks, analytics and workflow solutions in the global capital, commodity and automotive markets. With every one of our offerings, we help many of the world’s leading organizations navigate the economic landscape so they can plan for tomorrow, today. For more information, visit www.spglobal.com/spdji.

What’s In It For You?

Our Mission:

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

Our People:

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.

Our Values:

Integrity, Discovery, Partnership

Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.

Benefits:

We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That’s why we provide everything you—and your career—need to thrive at S&P Global.

Our benefits include:

• Health & Wellness: Health care coverage designed for the mind and body.
• Flexible Downtime: Generous time off helps keep you energized for your time on.
• Continuous Learning: Access a wealth of resources to grow your career and learn valuable new skills.
• Invest in Your Future: Secure your financial future through competitive pay, retirement planning, a continuing education program with a company-matched student loan contribution, and financial wellness programs.
• Family Friendly Perks: It’s not just about you. S&P Global has perks for your partners and little ones, too, with some best-in class benefits for families.
• Beyond the Basics: From retail discounts to referral incentive awards—small perks can make a big difference.

For more information on benefits by country visit: https://spgbenefits.com/benefit-summaries

Global Hiring and Opportunity at S&P Global:

At S&P Global, we are committed to fostering a connected and engaged workplace where all individuals have access to opportunities based on their skills, experience, and contributions. Our hiring practices emphasize fairness, transparency, and merit, ensuring that we attract and retain top talent. By valuing different perspectives and promoting a culture of respect and collaboration, we drive innovation and power global markets.

jobs.title: Junior Global Pharmacovigilance Data Analyst
jobs.description:
This is where your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

Are you curious, analytical and motivated solving complex problems that make a real impact? Join our Global Pharmacovigilance Data Management team and work with colleagues across Europe, Asia-Pacific and the United States. You will combine data analytics, technology and pharmacovigilance in a role where initiative, critical thinking and continuous learning matter.

This is an excellent opportunity for early-career professionals who want to build expertise in data management, reporting and healthcare technology within a highly collaborative international environment.

Start your career in data analytics while contributing to patient safety worldwide.

The Role

As a Junior Global Pharmacovigilance Data Analyst (m/f/d), you will support the generation of reports, perform data analyses and help ensure the quality and integrity of pharmacovigilance data. You will learn from experienced colleagues while gradually taking ownership of increasingly complex reporting and data management activities.

What You'll Do

• Generate accurate periodic and ad-hoc reports from pharmacovigilance database.

• Develop, validate and standardize SQL and PL/SQL queries.

• Support the development of innovative automation solutions using technologies such as VBA and AI.

• Translate business needs into reliable reporting solutions.

• Investigate data-quality issues, identify root causes and coordinate resolution.

• Partner with other PV technology team, Safety Writing, Regulatory, IT and other global functions.

• Support improvements to reporting tools (Cognos based), processes and systems.

Your Profile

What You Bring

• A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Data Analytics, Life Sciences or a related field

• Up to 3 years of relevant experience, including internships, working student positions or entry-level roles

• Curiosity, logical and critical thinking, and a strong learning mindset.

• Self-motivation and ownership of your work and professional development.

• Experience with pharmacovigilance database reporting, SQL and data analysis.

• Ability to interpret complex data and explain findings clearly.

• Strong collaboration, organization and attention to data quality.

Valuable, But Not Essential

• Experience with Cognos reporting tools

• Knowledge of VBA or other reporting automation technologies

• Basic knowledge of Japanese, although this is purely a nice-to-have skill

What we offer:

•  We foster continuous learning: Build expertise in algorithmic thinking, data analysis, pharmacovigilance systems, and global regulations while solving real-world challenges that matter.

•  We challenge you to grow: You drive your career. We provide a stimulating environment, meaningful challenges, and opportunities that help you reach your full potential.

•  We create career opportunities: Explore diverse career paths across PV Technology and the broader organization as your interests and expertise evolve.

•  We support flexible working: Benefit from flexible working hours and home-office opportunities that help you balance professional and personal priorities.

•  We provide global exposure: Collaborate with colleagues across Europe, Asia-Pacific, and the United States, gaining experience in a truly global organization.

We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. jobs.title: Senior Premier Banker - Memphis, TN
jobs.description:
Why Wells Fargo:

Are you looking for more? Find it here. At Wells Fargo, we're more than a financial services leader – we’re a global trailblazer committed to driving innovation, empowering communities, and helping our customers succeed. We believe that a meaningful career is much more than just a job – it’s about finding all of the elements to help you thrive, in one place. Living the Well Life means you’re supported in life, not just work. It means having robust benefits, competitive compensation, and programs designed to help you find work-life balance and well-being. You’ll be rewarded for investing in your community, celebrated for being your authentic self, and empowered to grow. And we’re recognized for it – Wells Fargo once again ranked in the top five on the 2026 LinkedIn Top Companies list of best workplaces “to grow your career” in the U.S. Join us!

About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Branch Premier Banker (SAFE) to play a pivotal role within our National Branch Network.  This role grows, deepens, and manages relationships with affluent customers and those with more complex financial needs, serving as their primary point of contact for banking products and services through scheduled appointments, lobby engagement, and proactive outreach.   This role is designed for growth oriented professionals who lead with advice to acquire and deepen relationships through meaningful discovery and translate customer goals into comprehensive financial strategies.  You will own and actively grow a defined book of business, leveraging goals based planning, and prudent risk oversight to deliver integrated solutions across deposits, investments, credit, home lending, and business banking. In addition, you’ll help customers with everyday banking needs-opening accounts, handling service requests, and ensuring a seamless experience making it easier for them to manage their banking with confidence. Success in this role is driven by strong relationship acumen, proactive customer engagement, and seamless collaboration with internal partners across Wealth, Home Lending, and Business Banking to deliver a differentiated customer experience.

Wells Fargo rewards behaviors that consistently create long term customer value and support customers in making informed financial decisions. You’ll be supported with digital tools, industry leading training, ongoing coaching, and backed by one of the most recognized brands in banking. This role offers a clear platform for career growth for experienced professionals who excel at building trust, managing a portfolio, and delivering holistic, multi product solutions.

In this role you will:

• Proactively acquire new affluent consumer and business customers while deepening existing relationships through strategic outreach, referrals, and pre-planned customer appointments
• Lead discovery‑driven conversations to understand customer goals and deliver tailored banking and credit strategies that strengthen relationships, increase retention, and drive balanced growth across deposits, lending, and investments
• Serve as the primary financial partner delivering comprehensive, multi‑product guidance and ongoing reviews across life stages and evolving financial needs
• Partner with a team of professionals across Wealth, Home Lending, and Business Banking to deliver integrated solutions by coordinating warm introductions, setting clear expectations, and taking personal ownership to convert qualified opportunities into closed outcomes

jobs.title: Engineering Technician
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

GE’s Power Conversion business, part of GE Vernova, provides electrification systems that are critical to customers’ power and energy needs for their high-performance applications. We work with some of the world’s major energy, maritime and industrial organisations, helping to enable a transition to energy efficiency and decarbonisation through our specialist motors, drives and control technologies.

We are looking for a motivated and technically minded Engineering Technician to join our manufacturing team. This role will involve mechanical fitting and sub-assembly preparation, supporting the build and preparation of machines and components for testing.

You will play a key role in ensuring equipment is assembled accurately and safely, working to engineering drawings, specifications and quality standards to support the successful delivery of our products.

Job Description

What You’ll Be Doing

• Carrying out mechanical fitting activities, including preparing and building machines for test and fitting drives and couplings.
• Preparing and assembling sub-assemblies, including mains and neutral terminal boxes, exciter bases and frames.
• Measuring components to tight tolerances using a range of precision measuring equipment, including micrometres, verniers, bore micrometres and DTI gauges.
• Reading and interpreting engineering drawings and specifications, ensuring components are assembled accurately and in accordance with requirements.
• Working to defined instructions, quality standards and engineering procedures.
• Completing quality documentation accurately and ensuring all required records are maintained.
• Maintaining a clean, organised and safe working environment in line with 5S principles.
• Following all Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) procedures and safe working practices.
• Working collaboratively with engineering, manufacturing and quality teams to achieve production targets and deadlines.
• Supporting other manufacturing and assembly activities when required.
• Contributing to a culture of continuous improvement across the manufacturing environment.

What We’re Looking For

Essential Skills & Experience

• Previous experience of mechanical and electrical fitting within a manufacturing or engineering environment.
• Ability to read and work accurately from engineering drawings and schematics.
• Understanding of geometric tolerances and common engineering drawing symbols.
• Experience using precision measuring equipment such as micrometers, verniers, bore micrometers and DTI gauges.
• Strong attention to detail and a commitment to quality.
• Ability to follow work instructions, processes and quality standards accurately.
• Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively as part of a team.
• Ability to use own initiative and work proactively to meet production targets and deadlines.
• Strong commitment to EHS and maintaining a safe working environment.
• Willingness to work shifts, specifically late shift, and provide flexibility to support overtime requirements.
• Right to Work in the UK

Desirable Skills & Knowledge

• Experience working with large rotating electrical machines, motors or generators.
• Experience working within a Lean Manufacturing environment.
• Knowledge of 5S and continuous improvement methodologies.
• Experience working with tight engineering tolerances and precision measurement equipment.
• Previous experience in a high-volume or technically demanding manufacturing environment.

Additional Information

Shift Pattern:

• Monday to Thursday – 7am to 4.30pm, and,
• Friday – 7am to 12.15pm

Why This Role Matters

Engineering Technicians play a vital role in ensuring our products are assembled to the highest standards of quality, accuracy and reliability before reaching our customers.

By carrying out precise mechanical fitting, sub-assembly and measurement activities, you will directly contribute to the successful manufacture and delivery of critical engineering solutions supporting customers across global energy, maritime and industrial markets.

What We Offer

• Opportunity to work within a world-class engineering and manufacturing environment
• Exposure to large-scale electrical machines and advanced testing technologies
• Supportive team culture focused on safety, quality and continuous improvement
• Career development opportunities within engineering and manufacturing
• Competitive salary and benefits package
• Opportunity to contribute to innovative technologies supporting the global energy transition

Inclusion and Diversity

Creating an inclusive work environment is very important to us. By valuing the ideas and contributions of a diverse workforce, we encourage and inspire others to grow and achieve success. Join GE Vernova where you can achieve your goals in an environment where you feel a sense of belonging.

About GE Vernova
GE Vernova Inc. (NYSE: GEV) is a purpose-built global energy company that includes Power, Wind, and Electrification segments and is supported by its accelerator businesses. Building on over 130 years of experience tackling the world’s challenges, GE Vernova is uniquely positioned to help lead the energy transition by continuing to electrify the world while simultaneously working to decarbonize it. GE Vernova helps customers power economies and deliver electricity that is vital to health, safety, security, and improved quality of life. GE Vernova is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, U.S., with approximately 75,000 employees across approximately 100 countries around the world. Supported by the Company’s purpose, The Energy to Change the World, GE Vernova technology helps deliver a more affordable, reliable, sustainable, and secure energy future. Learn more: GE Vernova and LinkedIn.​

About GE Vernova Electrification Segment

GE Vernova’s Electrification segment includes Grid Solutions, Power Conversion, Solar and Storage Solutions, —collectively referred to as Electrification Systems —and digital technologies, referred to as Electrification Software. The solutions offered by this segment are essential for the transmission, distribution, conversion, storage, and orchestration of electricity from point of generation to point of consumption.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist, DDT –Lab Automation, Automation Systems Engineer (Lab & Robotics)
jobs.description:
Job Description

In the Development Sciences and Clinical Supply (DSCS) organization, we believe digital is the force multiplier that enables faster experiments, smarter decisions, more robust supply chains, and is ultimately redefining how we bring medicines to patients.

Within DSCS, the DSCS Digital Technologies (DDT) team is building the next generation of data-rich, connected lab environments—where hardware, software, and AI-driven tools work together to accelerate pharmaceutical development. Our goal is simple but ambitious: embed advanced digital capabilities into the DNA of how we work. We believe this future starts with an effective foundation of laboratory tools: innovative robotics, process analytical technology (PAT), high-throughput technologies, reliable instrumentation, and integrated systems that seamlessly transition data from the physical labs to the digital world. We believe innovation is fueled by diverse teams that come together to build technologies that truly impact how our scientists conduct research. We’re looking for a Senior Scientist to help make this vision real.

In this role, you won’t just support experiments—you’ll transform how they happen. You’ll design and deploy cutting-edge automation solutions that enable scientists to move faster, generate higher-quality data, and focus on what matters most: discovery and innovation. You’ll work to augment the capabilities of our current laboratory systems, creating custom solutions that unlock new potential for our scientists. You’ll collaborate with a diverse network of scientists, engineers, and digital experts to build integrated systems that connect instruments, robotics, and data—turning complex workflows into seamless, intelligent processes. If you’re excited by the idea of combining science, engineering, and digital innovation— If you are a maker, a builder, a tinkerer —this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact and transform pharmaceutical research!

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Design the lab of the future by developing automation systems that integrate robotics, instrumentation, and software into cohesive, high-performing solutions
• Translate science into systems by partnering with researchers to understand experimental needs and convert them into scalable automated workflows
• Work at the intersection of disciplines, collaborating with experts in automation, data science, modeling, IT, and digital engineering
• Lead high-impact projects from concept through deployment, working across teams and stakeholders to deliver meaningful outcomes
• Continuously improve existing automation platforms to enhance performance, usability, and reliability
• Connect the ecosystem by integrating robotic platforms with laboratory equipment and data systems to enable end-to-end digital workflows
• Empower others by providing hands-on support, troubleshooting, and training to scientists using these systems

Education Minimum Requirement:

• A Ph.D. in Engineering (i.e. Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical), Robotics, Mechatronics, Chemistry, Physics, Biology, Pharmaceutical Sciences or a closely related field (Expected graduation in 2026)
• A M.S. in Engineering (i.e. Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical), Robotics, Mechatronics, Chemistry, Physics, Biology, Pharmaceutical Sciences or a closely related field with at least 2 years of relevant experience
• A B.S. in in Engineering (i.e. Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical), Robotics, Mechatronics, Chemistry, Physics, Biology, Pharmaceutical Sciences or a closely related field with at least 4 years of relevant experience

Required Experience and Skills:

• Experience in a lab-based setting, working with lab automation and equipment integration
• Experience with scripting/programming following accepted best practices (version control, design patterns, clean code)
• Understanding of (bio)pharmaceutical process research and development, drug product development, and/ or analytical development
• Demonstrated ability to work in an entrepreneurial and independent manner on cross-functional teams
• Efficient scientific collaboration and communication skills with the ability to navigate conversations with technicians and vendors

Preferred Experience and Skills:

• Experience with scripting/programming in one or more of the following: Python, C#, VBA, JavaScript, R
• Experience with automation edge devices and controllers (PLC, microcontrollers, etc)
• Experience with industrial SCADA or orchestration software (DeltaV, Ignition, WinCC OA, etc)
• Experience with benchtop automated reactor systems such as Sartorius Ambr250
• Experience with laboratory automation software, firmware, hardware, and their integration into end-to-end solutions
• Experience in integrating laboratory instruments with custom or commercial software solutions
• Ability to recognize, design, prototype, and deploy innovative technologies in laboratory automation
• Understanding of data science and AI/ML concepts and their application to laboratory automation
• Wet lab experience in (bio)pharmaceutical drug substance, drug product, and analytical research and development
• Experience with commercial laboratory notebook software like Benchling or Signals
• Motivated to learn new skills, willingness to take on new challenges, and scientific curiosity
• Deep interest and desire to understand how systems work. Self-proclaimed maker, builder, tinkerer

Required Skills:

Automation, Computer Programming, Data Analysis, Hardware Integration, Innovative Thinking, Interpersonal Relationships, Laboratory Automation, Laboratory Documentation, Laboratory Robotics, Laboratory Techniques, Lab Testing Equipment, Mechatronics, Pharmaceutical Research, Scripting Languages

Preferred Skills:

Emerson DeltaV, PLC Programming, SCADA Control Systems

Rejoins Airbus Atlantic et donne une trajectoire unique à ton parcours grâce à ce stage.

Nous sommes un leader mondial sur le marché des aérostructures, des sièges pilotes et des fauteuils passagers premium.

Dans le cadre de votre formation initiale, vous recherchez un stage obligatoire ou intégré dans une année de césure, d’une durée de 4 à 6 mois, vous permettant de valider votre année.

Une offre de stage intitulée « STAGE 2027 - Technicien Qualité  - Structure A350 (ALL GENDER) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein d’Airbus Atlantic sur le site de Montoir de Bretagne.

Cette mission débutera en janvier 2027 (date sujette à flexibilité) pour une durée de 6 mois.

Découvrez le site en vidéo :

Retrouvez Airbus Atlantic en vidéo et la Présentation du site de Montoir de Bretagne

Tâches et responsabilités :

Vous rejoindrez une équipe de 30 personnes au sein du département  « Qualité A350 Structure » en charge de la Qualité Produit de l'unité de production A350 Structure

Encadré par votre tuteur, vous interviendrez sur les activités suivantes :

1. Digitalisation et gestion de l'enregistrement qualité

• Analyser l'ensemble des flux d'information « flash qualité » et diagnostiquer les écarts de transmission vers le terrain.
• Concevoir et déployer une nouvelle procédure de communication ciblée à destination des opérateurs de production.
• Piloter l'intégration de ce nouveau standard au sein du module de formation.
• Restructurer l'archivage des enregistrements qualité selon les besoins opérationnels des postes d'assemblage et digitaliser leur accès.

2. Déploiement de la culture qualité et ingénierie de formation

• Mettre en application les référentiels de certification aéronautique et les exigences applicables aux structures composites A350.
• Participer à la conception de modules de montée en compétences pour les compagnons
• Contribuer à l'animation des démarches d'amélioration continue du Système de Management de la Qualité (SMQ).
• Animer des actions de sensibilisation terrain pour diffuser la culture qualité sur la ligne d'assemblage.

Durant votre stage, vous développerez les compétences suivantes en lien avec votre formation :

• Ingénierie des processus qualité : Analyse critique de la documentation technique, garantie de l'adéquation entre besoins terrain et exigences de certification aéronautique.
• Gestion de projet et conduite du changement : Structuration d'un projet de digitalisation, cadrage du planning, suivi des livrables et mesure des indicateurs d'efficacité opérationnelle (KPI).
• Ingénierie de formation et pédagogie industrielle : Création et déploiement de supports pédagogiques pour la montée en compétences des compagnons.
• Excellence opérationnelle & Data Quality : Exploitation des données de non-conformité et application des outils de résolution de problèmes (PDCA, QRQC) au sein d'un SMQ aéronautique.

Vous préparez actuellement un diplôme de niveau Bac +2/3 (ou équivalent) dans le domaine de la qualité, la formation, l’industrie ou une discipline apparentée.

Vous avez les connaissances et compétences suivantes :

• Capacité d'analyse et de synthèse face à des volumes importants de données techniques.
• Notions de gestion de projet (planification, suivi d'actions, indicateurs).
• Sensibilité aux enjeux de la formation continue et de la gestion des compétences en milieu industriel.

• Savoir être : Curiosité, Esprit d'équipe, Bonne communication, Capacité d'adaptation
• Anglais : notions

Rejoindre Airbus Atlantic en tant que stagiaire, c'est :

jobs.description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.

Position Summary

The Bioprocess Associate uses current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMPs) in the execution of commercial manufacturing processes for the manufacture of therapeutic proteins used in medicines that are revolutionizing the treatment of serious disease.

Key Responsibilities

• Operate production equipment within an assigned functional area adhering to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs) and standard operating procedures (SOPs)
• Revise and create process documents and assist with process related investigations
• Train for proficiency in process automation and supporting business systems and in the operation of primary production equipment within the assigned functional area
• Lead in maintaining material and components inventory level
• Support a safe work environment and contribute to area specific initiatives associated with work safety
• Weigh and check raw materials
• Assemble, clean and autoclave process components
• Assist in maintaining material and component inventory level
• Work on routine manufacturing assignments per written procedures that are moderately complex with minimal instructions
• Assist in revising and creating process documents (i.e., SOPs and Batch Records) and assist with process related investigations

Qualifications & Experience

• Minimum high school diploma required; knowledge of science generally attained through completion of a certificate program or Associates Degree in Biotechnology or a related field desired
• Prior experience with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) regulations and/or prior work experience in a clean room or highly regulated environment desired
• Prior experience successfully participating on work teams where personal accountability, attention to detail, collaboration, and results were expected

Facility Management and Real Estate (FMRE) serves as the backbone of Airbus Defence and Space operations, managing the site infrastructure, buildings, and services. jobs.title: Senior Director, Corporate Finance
jobs.description:
Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. We’re looking for a Senior Director, Corporate Finance to own our consolidated financial forecast and serve as a key partner to executive leadership. Reporting to the VP of Corporate Finance, this role is responsible for the accuracy and reporting of the company’s P&L forecast, finding ways to improve overall profitability, and making the team’s processes more efficient, including through the use of AI. The ideal candidate brings deep experience across these areas and adapts readily to new business models and processes. Apply now!

What you'll be doing:

• Own the consolidated P&L forecast, bringing inputs from across the business into a cohesive company-wide view and surfacing the insights that shape the decisions steering the company.
• Identify and drive cost-saving initiatives, with a specific focus on COGS (from component and BOM costs to manufacturing, supply chain, standard costs, and inventory), and partner with operations, engineering, and product management leaders to turn opportunities into realized savings.
• Lead the automation of existing finance processes and integrate AI into current workflows to improve the speed, accuracy, and scalability of forecasting, reporting, and analysis.
• Own executive reporting, delivering clear, decision-ready materials and insights to the leadership team and Board.
• Serve as a key leader for the quarterly close and earnings process, ensuring forecast and actuals are reconciled and supporting the preparation of earnings materials and guidance.
• Partner across finance, including the revenue forecasting team, and the broader organization to align the consolidated view, surface risks and opportunities, and support strategic decision-making.
• Adapt financial frameworks and forecasting approaches to support new and evolving business models as the company grows.
• Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing team as the function scales.

What we need to see:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; MBA or CPA a plus.
• 15+ overall years of progressive experience in corporate finance, FP&A, or a related field, including experience owning a consolidated P&L or forecast.
• 4+ years of people leadership experience, including building and developing finance teams.
• Proven track record of identifying and delivering margin or cost-savings improvements.
• Experience automating financial processes and applying modern tools, including AI, to finance workflows.
• Strong executive presence, with a history of preparing and presenting materials to senior leadership and the Board.
• Experience supporting quarterly close and earnings processes, ideally at a public company.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Advanced financial modeling and analytical skills; fluency with modern FP&A and BI tooling.
• Comfort operating in a dynamic environment, with the flexibility to adapt financial approaches as new business models and priorities emerge.

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Product Management - Upmarket Aquisitions
jobs.description:
Senior Associate, Product Management - Upmarket Aquisitions

Product Management

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology.

We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

Do you dream of well-designed and intuitive products and customer experiences? Do you want to be the one who introduces change to help tens of millions of customers make smarter financial choices? Do you want to change the way people manage their money? If you answered yes to all of these questions, then product management at Capital One may be a fit for you

About the team

The Upmarket Acquisitions Product team is responsible for the customer experience for all applicants to Upmarket's flagship card products, one of the fastest growing programs at Capital One. This role focuses on removing friction from the application experience and building innovative new user experiences. You will set the product vision and deliver a roadmap of enhancements to delight applicants and drive conversion rate improvement, collaborating with platform and segment partners to shape the end to end customer experience.

In this role, you’ll learn the essentials of being a product manager, and we’ll invest in you to grow in four key areas:

• Human Centered You’ll collaborate with tech teams to build comprehensive acceptance criteria, identifying and elevating any need for additional research to define future feature designYou'll breakdown business epics into features and further into user stories, driving your team towards lowest effort or Minimal Viable Product (MVP) for a valid feature test

• Business Focused Demonstrating a growth mindset, you’ll effectively use hypothesis-driven assessment of data to ensure your product or feature delivers on real business needsYou’ll own and prioritize feature development roadmaps, ensuring all necessary processes and procedures are followed to manage risk

• Technology Driven You’ll work autonomously in an agile environment, to conduct research and develop features that utilize new and evolving technology You’ll collaborate with designers, technologists, data scientists and subject-matter experts to build cutting edge solutions to help customersYou’ll deliver well-managed product platforms for customers by seeking to understand technology trends and architecture strategy

• Transformational Leadership By actively participating in horizontal forums, you’ll harness a network of trusted relationships among tech teams, designers, key internal stakeholders and partner teamsYou’ll articulate a succinct product roadmap to deliver business value and share with with stakeholders, elevating your team’s results and becoming a product matter expert

We want you if you are:

• Intellectually Curious. You ask why, you explore, you're not afraid to blurt out your crazy idea or follow an email chain for weeks to find someone with an answer. Comfortable with ambiguity, a hunger to learn and a seeker of new challenges
• Communicator & Influencer. You can communicate complex ideas clearly regardless of your audience. Our team knows their priorities and why they’re doing what they’re doing. You always can rally associates to work with you
• Do-er. You’re biased toward action, you try things and sometimes you fail. You can get around roadblocks and stay focused on your goals. You’re well organized, able to multitask and able to prioritize your work
• Passionate & Customer Focus. You care about growing others and bringing them together around what’s possible. You get a thrill from the journey of building and shipping products, and you have a desire and ability to connect with our external or internal customers to fully understand their needs
• Learner. You have an appetite to learn new things or new technologies all while exhibiting humbleness when the time comes to ask for help
• Team Player. You enjoy working with diverse people and driving the team toward a common goal. You have the ability to put the team before yourself and establish long-lasting relationships

Basic Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or military experience
• At least 1 year of product management experience or at least 1 year of experience in product design, agile delivery, business analysis, data science, or software engineering

Preferred Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science or engineering
• 1+ years translating business strategy or analysis into consumer facing digital products
• 1+ years of experience working on core product platforms powering digital experiences
• 1+ years working with cross functional teams as a product owner in an agile development process

This role is designated as a hybrid position. You are expected to adhere to Capital One's hybrid policy regarding required on-site presence at your designated office location.

At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization, or offer any immigration related support for this position (e.g. H1B, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, F-1 CPT, J-1, TN, E-3, and O-1, or any other forms of work authorization that require immigration support from an employer).

Meet the Team

• The Cisco Forward Deployed Solutions Engineering (FDSE) team is a high-impact, elite hands-on engineering team that works directly alongside our most strategic global customers based in Americas to lead the AI transformation with an industry or government entity lens.

• The goal is to leverage the power of AI to co-develop, innovate, integrate and show art of the possible solutions exceeding our customers' most critical business outcomes with fast time to value to prototype for future production environments.

• Sitting at the intersection of the most powerful and complete AI solution in the world with the Cisco portfolio powered by the Splunk Data Platform, our team is poised to lead the market and set the standard for AI excellence.

• This team will work closely with Sales, Product and Technology, Software Development, Customer Success and Partners to maximize customer focus, leveraging the power of Cisco team and portfolio to exceed expectations.

• This is a critical team of AI thought leaders operating in a high-velocity, collaborative community of senior software engineers, solution architects, and data platform engineers who thrive in agile, customer-embedded sprint environments.

Your Impact

• Cisco is looking for an accomplished, AI skilled, hands-on, experienced, and visionary Forward Deployed Solution Engineer (FDSE) with post-sales and/or pre-sales experience to leverage AI to build, scale, and lead customer business outcomes.

• Compress customer time-to-value by architecting and proto-typing art of the possible solutions with the customer uniquely leveraging Cisco AI infrastructure and the Splunk portfolio into complex, heterogeneous enterprise environments.

• Singular focus as an embedded engineer is to influence technical decision markers by strategically accelerating customer business outcomes, compressing time to value, and delivering tangible proof to drive durable growth through customer retention and growth.

• Collaborate directly with Cisco product engineering teams to provide field-level insights, helping evolve our AI-integrated portfolio to meet the next generation of infrastructure demands.

• Mentor and collaborate with a world-class team of Forward Deployed Solution Engineers. foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, customer obsession, and high ownership.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical engineering experience.

• 9+ years of professional experience in post-sales and/or pre-sales roles working directly with customers on distributed software and system architecture deployments.

• 3+ years' experience in Generative and Agentic AI, machine learning platforms, container orchestration (Kubernetes), and event-driven architectures across cloud-native + hybrid platforms and large-scale enterprise data architectures.

• AI experience realizing customer business outcomes with fast time to value

Preferred Qualifications

• 7+ year track record of leading technical customer-facing engagements handling ambiguous, high-impact enterprise projects

• 5+ years Cisco and Splunk experience and/or equivalent from a top competitor

• Ability to articulate how AI and automation can be leveraged to solve complex business problems and achieve rapid ROI.

• Narrative skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between deep technical AI implementation and executive-level business requirements.

• AI, Data Science and Enterprise certifications and/or education THIS JOB DESCRIPTION DOES NOT APPLY FOR EMPLOYEES IN AUSTRIA, BELGIUM, FRANCE, GERMANY & NETHERLANDS

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

The starting salary range posted for this position is $266,100.00 to $342,900.00 and reflects the projected salary range for new hires in this position in U.S. and/or Canada locations, not including incentive compensation*, equity, or benefits.

Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks.  Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time.

U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies:

• 10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees
• 1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco
• Non-exempt employees** receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4.92 hours per pay period for full-time employees
• Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations)
• 80 hours of sick time off provided on hire date and each January 1st thereafter, and up to 80 hours of unused sick time carried forward from one calendar year to the next
• Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members
• Optional 10 paid days per full calendar year to volunteer

For non-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies.

Employees on sales plans earn performance-based incentive pay on top of their base salary, which is split between quota and non-quota components, subject to the applicable Cisco plan. For quota-based incentive pay, Cisco typically pays as follows:

• .75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota;
• 1.5% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 50% and 75%;
• 1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and
• Once performance exceeds 100% attainment, incentive rates are at or above 1% for each 1% of attainment with no cap on incentive compensation.

For non-quota-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay 0% up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid.

Manager, Product Management

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology. As a primary point of contact for customers, you represent the branch through strong service, attention to detail, and genuine care.

As a Teller, you will build foundational banking skills while learning about customers’ needs and introducing them to helpful products, services, and digital tools. You will identify opportunities to support customers and connect them to the right banker for more detailed product conversations. You will work closely with branch teammates to keep daily operations running smoothly and deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience. jobs.description:
Job Description:

JOB DESCRIPTION

The jobholder will take over the Functional and System Design Responsibilities for Electronic Warefare System/Subsystem within the department “EBSTYM – Mission System” in AHE, in Getafe.

The mission will consist of system engineering activities and helicopter level integration of the Electronic Warefare System under its responsibility, interfacing with many contributor systems for civil and military helicopters, mainly Tiger helicopter.

• The jobholder will be responsible for Electronic Warefare systems design, development, equipment supplier management, integration, and subsystem requirement management up to the Qualification and Certification steps to provide compliance with customer requests in Tiger MkIII program.

• Acting as the technical reference for Electronic Warefare Systems under its responsibility, how to get the data, process it, present it and use it in the way that the customer needs it.

• Acting as functional and system design responsible for the System, interfacing with other systems in the platform over multiple helicopter platforms, being in charge of the following tasks (for the System under its responsibility):

• End to End Functional chain definition

• Definition of installation documentation: Mechanical, electrical and logical

• Requirements engineering, including Human- Machine Interface definition

• Interfacing with project management, quality and procurement departments and other project stakeholders throughout the organization

• Interfacing with / management of suppliers and customers

• Application of agile development methodology

• Ensuring planning at equipment supplier and helicopter level for development and qualification

• Participating in offer management and contributing to product sourcing policy

• Assessing suppliers offers with other stakeholders

• Proactively controlling and monitoring suppliers during the development phase, with the aim of safeguarding technical requirement

• Gathering and sharing knowledge of the Systems market solutions (current and future)

• Ensuring the qualification / certification of equipment and the according functions

• Prepare and ensure the functional integration of the system into the helicopter avionic architecture and supporting the H/C Software development activities associated to the system.

• Definition of helicopter test procedures: on ground and flight. And analysis of the results.

• Supporting the integration rigs, ground and flight testing of the equipment

• Supporting knowledge exchange within Airbus (all divisions)

• Participate in the Design, refinement and improvement of new projects SW Development Environments

This role may involve some travel for business to Germany (occasionally) and France (mainly); as such you must be able to travel accordingly.

SKILLS

Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to know you:

• Education: Aeronautical or Telecommunication Engineering degree or a related discipline.
• Experience: At least 5 years in system design skills: experience in the design, development, engineering and/or integration of systems for aircraft.
• Technical knowledge: Electronic Warefare System, Mission systems, integration systems...
• Soft skills: High adaptability to work on new topics, new business and in a networking mode. Team Spirit, good communication skills.
• Languages: Advanced level in English.

WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AIRBUS EMPLOYEE?

At Airbus we are focused on our employees and their welfare. Take a look at some of our social benefits:

• Vacation days plus additional days-off along the year (Apróx. 35 days per year in total).
• Attractive salary.

• Collective transport service subject to working calendar/home location.
• Benefits such as life insurance, health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan, or study grants.
• On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office.
• Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility initiatives.

jobs.title: IT Backup Expert (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Zur Unterstützung sucht Airbus Defence and Space einen

IT-Expert Backup (d/m/w)

Dein Standort

Am Airbus-Standort in Immenstaad am Bodensee arbeitest du dort, wo die Zukunft von Connected Intelligence, Space und Air Power entsteht. In einer Umgebung, die Weitblick bietet, gestaltest du technologische Innovationen über Domänen hinweg.

Unser Standort lebt vom Dialog: Auf dem Campus triffst du auf ein einzigartiges Netzwerk aus Experten für Satellitentechnik, militärische Luftfahrt, Cyber-Security, Künstliche Intelligenz sowie Combat Cloud und Ground Support von morgen. Auch unsere Zusammenarbeit ist geprägt von Dynamik – in agilen Teams widmen wir uns den komplexesten Fragestellungen, von KI-gestützter Erdbeobachtung bis zur sicheren Cloud-Architektur. Wer technologische Exzellenz und interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit sucht, findet hier das ideale Umfeld.

Unsere Benefits für dich

• Faire Vergütung & Extras: Attraktive Vergütung und individuelle Zusatzleistungen, z. B. betriebliche Vorsorgemodelle, Mobilitätsangebote (bspw. Fahrradleasing) oder Mitarbeitervorteile bei kooperierenden Unternehmen gemäß unseren jeweils gültigen Richtlinien.
• Zeit für dich (und deine Angehörigen): 30 Tage Jahresurlaub gem. Tarifvertrag (35h/Woche); Vereinbarkeit von Familie & Beruf (Gleitzeit, mobiles Arbeiten, Teilzeit, Jobsharing, Sabbatical)
• Weiterkommen leicht gemacht: Ausgezeichnete Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und internationale, konzernweite Entwicklungsperspektiven
• Wohlfühlen am Arbeitsplatz: Betriebsarzt; umfassendes Gesundheitsangebot (Sportkurse, Präventionsangebote, uvm.), Kantine und Cafeteria, Kindertagesstätte am Standort
• Vielfalt verbindet: Arbeiten in einem diversen Umfeld, mit mehr als 140 Nationalitäten, in dem Austausch, Unterstützung und Vielfalt gelebt wird

Deine Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten

• Verantwortung für den Betrieb der Backup-Umgebung auf Basis von Veeam und NetBackup in einer On-Premises Umgebung
• Eigenständige Planung und Durchführung von Wartungsarbeiten, Firmware Updates, Patches und technischen Optimierungen, auch im laufenden Betrieb
• Analyse und Behebung komplexer Störungen im 1st- und 2nd-Level-Support sowie Abstimmung mit Herstellern und externen Support-Teams bei Bedarf
• Weiterentwicklung bestehender Betriebsprozesse im Incident, Change und Problem Management nach ITIL-Standards unter Einsatz von Tools wie BMC Remedy, Jira und Confluence
• Weiterentwicklung von Monitoring, Automatisierung und Standardisierung im Betrieb sowie bei regelmäßigen Wartungsarbeiten
• Zusammenarbeit mit der IT-Architektur und den Fachbereichen zur Umsetzung technischer Anforderungen sowie aktive Mitarbeit im Lifecycle Management der Systeme
• Erstellung von technischen Dokumentationen, Betriebshandbüchern und Arbeitsanweisungen
• Teilnahme an der Rufbereitschaft und Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit im Rahmen der betrieblichen Tätigkeiten

Gewünschte Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Betrieb und in der Fehleranalyse komplexer Backup-Infrastrukturen mit Veeam und NetBackup
• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Veeam Backup & Replication und NetBackup (Zertifizierungen sind von Vorteil)
• Erfahrung mit ITIL-basierten Betriebsprozessen sowie mit Tools wie BMC Remedy, Jira und Confluence
• Bereitschaft zur Rufbereitschaft und zur Arbeit im Schichtbetrieb
• Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

jobs.title: Simulation & Modelling Engineer (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

In order to Friedrichshafen, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a Simulation & Modelling Engineer (d/f/m).

The Simulation & Modelling division includes departments in the UK, France and Germany and represents a core competence for simulator development for spacecraft platforms, payloads and equipment.

In the area of simulators, the department is responsible for producing the infrastructure that enables successful spacecraft avionics programs. Therefore, the department is looking for an experienced, talented and creative Simulation & Modelling Engineer (d/f/m) who is flexible, self-motivated and hardworking.

Your location

At the Airbus site in Friedrichshafen you will be working on innovation where others spend their holidays. Enjoy panoramic views of Lake Constance while having lunch in our canteen. And after work, join one of our many corporate sports groups to go running, sailing or skiing.

Your benefits

• Attractive salary and special payments
• 30 days holidays and extra days-off for special occasions
• Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects
• Special benefits: employer-funded pension, employee stock options, discounted car leasing, special conditions for insurances, transportation subsidy, employee benefits at cooperating companies
• On-site-facilities: Kindergarten close to the site, medical officer for check-ups and other health-related services, lakeview canteen and cafeteria
• Company sports and leisure activities such as sailing, diving and flight simulation

​Your tasks and responsibilities

• Design and development of simulators and simulation models for satellite systems.
• Creation of test procedures and test plans.
• Implementation and execution of automatic and manual component-tests, integration-tests and system-tests.
• Definition and creation of software releases.
• Provide support to the simulator users

Desired skills and qualifications

• Degree in computer science, software engineering or related discipline.
• Experience in Simulation and Modelling.
• Object Oriented analysis & design using UML (or similar)
• Experience in the development of desktop tools using a client/server architecture.
• Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills in English.
• Knowledge of machine-to-machine communication protocols

Volljurist (m/w/d) / Senior Legal Counsel

Am Standort Donauwörth am Ufer der Donau nahe Augsburg entwickeln wir Hubschrauber von der ersten Idee bis zum flugfähigen Produkt. Erleben Sie mit uns, wie sie auf unserem eigenen Testflugplatz abheben und landen.

Unsere Benefits für Sie

• Faire Vergütung & Extras: Attraktive Vergütung und individuelle Zusatzleistungen, z. B. betriebliche Vorsorgemodelle, Mobilitätsangebote (bspw. Fahrradleasing) oder Mitarbeitervorteile bei kooperierenden Unternehmen gemäß unseren jeweils gültigen Richtlinien.
• Zeit für Sie (und Ihre Angehörigen): 30 Tage Jahresurlaub gem. Tarifvertrag; Vereinbarkeit von Familie & Beruf (Gleitzeit, mobiles Arbeiten, Teilzeit, Jobsharing, Sabbatical)
• Weiterkommen leicht gemacht: Ausgezeichnete Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und internationale, konzernweite Entwicklungsperspektiven
• Wohlfühlen am Arbeitsplatz: Betriebsarzt; umfassendes Gesundheitsangebot (Sportkurse, Präventionsangebote, uvm.), Kantine und Cafeteria, teils standortnaher Kindergarten
• Vielfalt verbindet: Arbeiten in einem diversen Umfeld, mit mehr als 140 Nationalitäten, in dem Austausch, Unterstützung und Vielfalt gelebt wird

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten

Airbus Helicopters sucht eine/n motivierte/n und dynamische/n Senior Legal Counsel (m/w/d) mit einer positiven Denkweise und einem effizienten Ansatz, um Teil der Legal & Compliance-Abteilung zu werden.

In Ihrer Rolle berichten Sie an den Head of Legal Affairs Germany und werden Teil eines Teams aus 4 Juristen und einem Paralegal in Deutschland. Sie tragen zu den Gesamtaktivitäten des Teams in einem Umfeld bei, das Zusammenarbeit, Effizienz, Inklusion und Kollegialität fördert.

Als wesentliches Mitglied des Bereichs Legal & Compliance besteht Ihre Hauptaufgabe darin, die rechtlichen Angelegenheiten von Airbus Helicopters in enger Abstimmung mit dem Geschäftsbereich zu steuern, einschließlich:

• Ein pragmatischer und vertrauenswürdiger Partner beim Management rechtlicher Risiken und Chancen sein
• Proaktive, geschäfts- und operativ orientierte Rechtsberatung zu allen vertraglichen Aktivitäten von Airbus Helicopters sowohl im zivilen als auch im militärischen Markt bieten, einschließlich der Abwicklung komplexer nationaler und internationaler öffentlicher Ausschreibungen
• Entwurf, Verhandlung und Unterstützung bei allen Transaktionen im Zusammenhang mit Beschaffung, Vertrieb, Kundendienst & Support sowie Programmen, was auch die Einbeziehung anderer Mitglieder der Legal & Compliance-Funktion für spezifische Fragen (z. B. Exportkontrolle) erfordert
• Unterstützung interner Kunden durch tägliche Sensibilisierung, Schulungen und die Nutzung digitaler Tools
• Erstellung oder Aktualisierung von rechtlicher Standarddokumentation, Vorbereitung von Rechtsgutachten und formellen Stellungnahmen auf Deutsch und Englisch
• Bei Bedarf Zusammenarbeit mit externen internationalen Anwaltskanzleien
• Rechtliche Beratung zu standortbezogenen Themen (ausgenommen Immobilienrecht)
• Unterstützung anderer Mitglieder der Airbus Legal & Compliance-Abteilung, z. B. des Litigation-Teams beim Management von Rechtsstreitigkeiten und außergerichtlichen Auseinandersetzungen, des Compliance-Teams bei der Bearbeitung von Compliance-Angelegenheiten
• Steuerung von Zahlungsschwierigkeiten und Insolvenzen in Zusammenarbeit mit den relevanten Bereichen (Finanzen, Vertrieb, S&S, Beschaffung)

Erforderliche Kenntnisse und Qualifikationen

• Erfahrung: 8+ Jahre Erfahrung im Wirtschaftsrecht in multinationalen Industriekonzernen oder erstklassigen Kanzleien. Juristisches Studium (in Deutschland beide Staatsexamina bestanden) oder vergleichbarer Abschluss.
• Business Partnering: Kundenorientierte Denkweise und die Fähigkeit, komplexe rechtliche Anforderungen in pragmatische Rechtsberatung für das Geschäft zu übersetzen.
• Kommunikation: Hervorragende zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Stakeholder zu überzeugen.
• Agilität & Umsetzung: Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten zu steuern und enge Fristen einzuhalten. Anpassungsfähigkeit in Ihrer Arbeitsweise, um eine zeitnahe Kundenbetreuung in einem sich ständig verändernden und anspruchsvollen Umfeld zu gewährleisten. Reisebereitschaft, falls erforderlich.
• Eigenverantwortung & Initiative: Autonomie (d. h. ein klares Verantwortungsbewusstsein für Ihre Aufgaben) und Proaktivität (Fragen/Probleme antizipieren und gegebenenfalls informieren).
• Integrität & Zusammenarbeit: Hohe ethische Standards und berufliche Integrität. Teamgeist und kollaborative Arbeitsweise in einem internationalen Umfeld.
• Sprachen: Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich. Eine weitere Sprache, wie z. B. Französisch, ist von Vorteil.
• Digitale Tools: Gute Kenntnisse im Umgang mit digitalen Tools sind unerlässlich, ebenso wie die nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Initiativen zur digitalen Transformation im juristischen Umfeld zu unterstützen und umzusetzen.

Keine 100%ige Übereinstimmung? Kein Grund zur Sorge! Airbus unterstützt Ihre persönliche Entwicklung mit maßgeschneiderten Entwicklungslösungen.

A vacancy for a Product Change Leader (PCL) and CM Industrial Integrator (CMII) on A320 family has arisen within Airbus Defence & Space in Getafe.

The successful applicant will join BSMCM4 department.

RESPONSABILITIES :

The PCL acts as the Project Leader for the Changes he/she is in charge. He/she is accountable to lead the MFT (Product Change Team) and coordinate transnationally all involved stakeholders ( Engineering, Chief Engineering, Customer Services, Airworthiness, Plants, Industrial Planning, Suppliers) all along the Aircraft Change Process (ACP) from CR creation until MOD implementation and MOD Closure

​​He/she is accountable for all ACP deliverables for the dossiers he/she is in charge of in order to enable the best decision making at Decision Board on TCQ.

Then, he/she is accountable for the correct implementation of the change on the aircraft, according to the Decision Board mandate, on time, on cost and on quality.

As CM Industrial Integrator, He/she will coordinate all industrial stakeholders (Engineering, FAL, MCAs, Suppliers) gathering all inputs (Lead-times, risks, opportunities) to deliver the best industrial implementaton planning to define the MOD POE compliance with SA Programme Policy (STEP/iSTEP) and deliver right first time.

He/she also will have the role of Configuration Management Operational Manager (CMOM). In this role, he/she is responsible to Lead and coordinate Configuration Management activities End to End in his/her area of responsibility (at Program or project level, at component level), and with all the parties involved (Programs, Engineering, Quality, Production, Customer Service).

The jobholder will be the point of contact for the central CM aspects and manage the interface between Central Program CM and other functional project stakeholders and will provide CM expertise ensuring the proper application of CM processes and tools.
