jobs.title: #ET20A_Cyber Security Systems Architect (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Um aktuelle und zukünftige Projekte zu steuern, sucht Airbus Helicopters Sie zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt für das Team in Donauwörth als unsere/n neue/n

Cyber Security Systems Architekt (d/m/w)

Als Teil unserer Abteilung für Avioniksysteme im Entwicklungsbüro widmen Sie sich der Entwicklung von Avionikarchitekturen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber. Da bei Hubschraubern das Sicherheitsrisiko und dessen mögliche Auswirkungen auf die Flugsicherheit und die Mission bewältigt werden müssen, muss die Avionikarchitektur Mittel zum Schutz vor und zur Erkennung von potenziellen Cyberangriffen bereitstellen. Ihre Aufgabe als Cyber Security Architekt wird es daher sein, in Abstimmung mit dem Avionik-Architekten des Hubschraubers die Cyber-Security-Komponente der Avionikarchitektur zu definieren und zu entwickeln.

Sie werden diese Tätigkeit in einem zivilen Umfeld mit dem Ziel der EASA-Zertifizierung eines neuen Hubschraubers oder der Zulassung einer Modifikation an einem bestehenden Hubschrauber ausüben, oder in einem militärischen Umfeld mit dem Ziel der Cybersicherheitszertifizierung eines Hubschraubers durch die jeweils zuständige Zulassungsbehörde.

Ihr Standort

Am Standort Donauwörth am Ufer der Donau nahe Augsburg entwickeln wir Hubschrauber von der ersten Idee bis zum flugfähigen Produkt. Erleben Sie mit uns, wie sie auf unserem eigenen Testflugplatz abheben und landen.

Unsere Benefits für Sie

• Faire Vergütung & Extras: Attraktive Vergütung und individuelle Zusatzleistungen, z. B. betriebliche Vorsorgemodelle, Mobilitätsangebote (bspw. Fahrradleasing) oder Mitarbeitervorteile bei kooperierenden Unternehmen gemäß unseren jeweils gültigen Richtlinien.
• Zeit für Sie (und Ihre Angehörigen): 30 Tage Jahresurlaub gem. Tarifvertrag (35h/Woche); Vereinbarkeit von Familie & Beruf (Gleitzeit, mobiles Arbeiten, Teilzeit, Jobsharing, Sabbatical)
• Weiterkommen leicht gemacht: Ausgezeichnete Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und internationale, konzernweite Entwicklungsperspektiven
• Wohlfühlen am Arbeitsplatz: Betriebsarzt; umfassendes Gesundheitsangebot (Sportkurse, Präventionsangebote, uvm.), Kantine und Cafeteria, teils standortnaher Kindergarten
• Vielfalt verbindet: Arbeiten in einem diversen Umfeld, mit mehr als 140 Nationalitäten, in dem Austausch, Unterstützung und Vielfalt gelebt wird

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten

• Formalisierung der Integration der Cyber-Security-Prozesse des Engineerings in die übergreifenden Engineering-Prozesse innerhalb der Airbus Helicopters Prozesslandschaft (Process Landscape Platform) sowie Sicherstellung der Synchronisation mit den Support-Prozessen
• Bewertung der Sicherheitsrisiken der Hubschrauberkonfiguration und Definition der erforderlichen Sicherheitsanforderungen für das eingebettete System, die sowohl funktionale als auch Assurance-Aspekte abdecken
• Überwachung der Entwicklung von Sicherheitsfunktionen gemäß ihrem Design Assurance Level
• Formalisierung der Nachweisführung (Compliance Demonstration) hinsichtlich der Lufttüchtigkeitsanforderungen sowie Beitrag zur Sicherheitsakkreditierung des Hubschraubers

Erforderliche Kenntnisse und Qualifikationen

• Abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium (Luft- und Raumfahrt, Maschinenbau oder Informatik) und zusätzlich umfangreiche Erfahrung und Weiterbildung oder durch eine an das Studium anschließende Promotion Alternativ: Abgeschlossenes Masterstudium (Luft- und Raumfahrt, Maschinenbau oder Informatik) und zusätzlich erweiterte Erfahrung und Weiterbildung oder durch eine an das Studium anschließende Promotion
• Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich eingebettete Systeme (Embedded Systems) oder Cyber Security, einschließlich fundierter Erfahrung im Systems Engineering
• Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch und Englisch – verhandlungssicher, Französisch – wünschenswert
• Kenntnisse der luftfahrttechnischen Standards (z. B. ARP 4754, ARP 4761, ED-202, ED-203)
• Fähigkeit zur sicheren Beherrschung der funktionalen Spezifikation/Ausprägung von Sicherheitsmechanismen (Authentifizierung, Zugriffskontrolle, Rechteverwaltung, Signatur, Firewall, Verschlüsselung, Segregation, Intrusion Detection)

Keine 100%ige Übereinstimmung? Kein Grund zur Sorge! Airbus unterstützt Ihre persönliche Entwicklung mit maßgeschneiderten Entwicklungslösungen.

Bringen Sie Ihre Karriere auf ein neues Level und bewerben Sie sich jetzt online!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

In order to manage current and future projects, Airbus Helicopters is looking for you to join the team in Donauwörth as soon as possible as our new

Cyber Security Systems Architect (d/f/m)

You will join our Avionics Systems Department within the design office! This department is dedicated to the design of avionics architectures for civil and military helicopters. Since helicopters must manage the security risk and its possible impact on flight safety and the mission, the avionics architecture must provide the means of protection and detection against potential cyber attacks. Also, your role as a cyber security architect will consist in defining and developing the cyber security component of the avionics architecture, in coordination with the helicopter avionics architect.
You will be required to exercise this activity in a civilian context with the aim of certification with EASA of a new helicopter or the approval of a modification on an existing helicopter or in a military context with the aim of cyber security certification of a helicopter with the designated certification authority.

Your location

At our Donauwörth site, located on the banks of the river Danube, we develop helicopters from the initial idea to the airworthy product. Watch them take off and touch down on our own on-site test airfield.

Our Benefits for You

• Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
• Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
• Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
• Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
• Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

• Formalise in the Airbus Helicopters process landscape platform the integration of the cyber security processes of the engineering in the overall engineering processes and ensure the synchronisation with the support processes
• Assess the security risks of the helicopter configuration and define the necessary security requirements, covering both functional and assurance aspects, for the embedded system
• Monitor the development of security functions in accordance with their design assurance level
• Formalise the compliance demonstration to airworthiness requirements and contribution to helicopter security accreditation

Desired skills and qualifications

• Completed Degree (Bachelor, Master/Diploma) in Aerospace Engineering or Computer Science, including a specialisation in security either as part of the master or via an additional program
• At least 5 years of experience in the field of embedded systems or in cybersecurity, including strong experience in systems engineering

• Language Skills: German and English - negotiation level, French - desirable
• Knowledge within aeronautical engineering standards (e.g. ARP 4754, ARP 4761, ED-202, ED-203)
• Ability to master the functional expression of security mechanisms (authentication, access control, rights management, signature, firewall, encryption, segregation, intrusion detection)

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply now online with your relevant documents (CV, short cover letter and certification for highest degree)!

jobs.title: Aircraft Performance Engineer - External Performance Models (BADA / ANP)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

An opportunity for an Aircraft Performance Engineer - External Performance Models (BADA / ANP) has arisen within Airbus Operations, Getafe (Madrid).

The selected candidate will join the In-Flight Performance and Operations team within Airbus Engineering Aircraft Performance. Aircraft Performance is at the heart of the aeronautic industry and a key decision criterion for airlines.

Our subdomain is responsible for modeling, evaluating, and simulating aircraft operational performance, acting as the reference for data-driven analysis to optimize flight operations, flight safety, and in-service support for airlines and aeronautical stakeholders.

The jobholder will act as the primary owner and central point of contact for External Aircraft Performance Models (such as BADA and ANP), bridging strategic governance with deep technical validation and driving the long-term improvement roadmap.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The main tasks of the jobholder will be:

• Serve as primary focal point and lead strategic governance for external partners (Eurocontrol, EASA) and internal stakeholders, managing queries, licensing, decision boards, and improvement roadmaps.
• Execute technical validation and risk assessment by designing in-depth studies to compare external model outputs against Airbus reference data and quantify accuracy deviations.
• Develop and maintain internal automation tools using Python and scripting languages to ensure robust model comparison, validation, and assessment processes.
• Manage ANP dataset generation and validation for EASA and internal stakeholders, ensuring all dataset outputs meet required quality standards.
• Monitor the broader ecosystem landscape (TIM, Piano, OpenAP, EU Flight Label, EEA, CO2 calculators) to identify service opportunities, technical risks, and market intelligence.
• Animate the internal community and knowledge management by creating technical notes, defining oriented-usage guidelines, and sharing best practices across Airbus teams.

SKILLS

Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to knowing you:

• Education: Aeronautical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline degree.
• Experience: More than 3 years of professional experience in aircraft performance modeling principles or related engineering environments.
• Technical knowledge: Advanced proficiency in Python or similar scripting languages for tool development, technical autonomy in troubleshooting, and strong analytical rigor in scientific data comparison.
• Languages: Advanced level in English.
• Soft skills: Project management capabilities, proactivity to identify opportunities and escalate technical alerts, and strong communication skills to synthesize complex technical data.
• Valuable / Nice to have: Familiarity with external industry benchmarks and environmental performance models (such as BADA, ANP, OpenAP, or CO2 calculators).

jobs.title: Cabin Module Engineer - Electrical system specialist - Customer Services (M/F)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

FR

Airbus Commercial Aircraft recherche un(e) Cabin Module Engineer (f/h) specialisé(e) dans  le développement de systèmes électriques pour les sièges d'avion et les équipements/modules de cabine pour rejoindre notre  département STC* Solutions Programme / Customer Services  basé à Toulouse, France.

Vous avez une expérience dans le développement et l'intégration d'équipements/modules de cabine et plus précisément dans le développement de système électrique dans les sièges avion et dans les équipements/modules de cabine? Ce poste est fait pour vous !

Nous fournissons des solutions de mise à niveau et de modification de la cabine et des systèmes de cabine (Services bulletins et kits) certifiés par Airbus STC, aux compagnies aériennes et aux bailleurs pour la modification de leurs avions en service, grâce à nos équipes, processus, fournisseurs et moyens dédiés (centre logistique dédié).

Intégré au sein de notre bureau d’études spécialisé dans l'ingénierie cabine, notre ingénieur est responsable de la gestion des tâches liées au développement des équipements cabine et de la validation de tous les éléments livrables relatifs à ses activités.

En fonction de la portée des projets et des demandes opérationnelles, vous pouvez également gérer des activités complémentaires telles que la gestion des projets de rétrofit, la gestion des kits et/ou la gestion des parties prenantes externes impliquées dans les projets (client, MRO, fabricants...).

Si vous êtes intéressé et que vous correspondez à cette présentation du poste, n'hésitez pas à nous contacter !

Nous sommes impatients d'enrichir notre équipe de vos expériences, de votre culture et de votre talent personnel.

En retour, notre équipe se fera un plaisir de partager nos expériences et de vous accompagner dans votre nouveau parcours.

Votre environnement de travail :

Capitale mondiale de l'aéronautique et capitale européenne de la recherche dans le spatial, Toulouse est une ville dynamique du sud-ouest de la France desservie par un aéroport international. Idéalement située entre la mer Méditerranée et l'océan Atlantique et à proximité des Pyrénées, elle offre de nombreuses possibilités d'activités de plein air !

Parce que nous prenons soin de vous :

• Avantages financiers: Salaire attractif, accords d’intéressement et de participation, plan d'épargne salariale abondé par Airbus et plan d’actionnariat salarié avec attribution d'actions gratuites sur la base du volontariat.
• Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle: Des jours de congés supplémentaires pour occasions spéciales et des options de transfert de congés, un comité d'entreprise proposant de nombreuses activités socio-culturelles et sportives et d’autres services.
• Bien-être / santé: couverture complémentaire des frais de santé et de prévoyance (incapacité, invalidité, décès). Selon le site : centre de services de santé, services de conciergerie, salle de sport, application de covoiturage.
• Développement individuel: des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, parcours expert, mobilité nationale et internationale).

Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler, à vous connecter et à collaborer plus facilement et de manière plus flexible. Partout où cela est possible, nous favorisons la flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation.

Vos challenges:

Intégré(e) à des équipes multifonctionnelles traitant des projets d'amélioration des systèmes de cabine sur divers programmes (SA, LR, DD, WB, XWB), Vous êtes responsable des missions suivantes :

Phase d'évaluation des coûts:

• Soutenir l'évaluation des coûts et des prix pour les offres.
• Préparation des RFQ (Request for Quotation).

Phase d'architecture technique du projet :

• Il est responsable du développement des spécifications de l'équipement.
• Aide à la sélection du fournisseur
• Identification de tous les produits livrables relatifs au développement de l'équipement, au calendrier, aux coûts et aux risques.

Phase de développement du projet

• Coordination de toutes les activités de conception et de justification relatives au développement et à la justification de l'équipement.
• Suivi et validation des livrables du fournisseur, du calendrier, des coûts et des risques.
• Suivi et/ou coordination de la phase de fabrication de l'équipement.
• Soutenir l'inspection du premier article.

Phases des Working Parties et Installations sur A/C

• Assurer le support/réponse aux rapports de défauts relatifs à l'installation de l'équipement.

Soutien en service et maintien de la navigabilité

• Si nécessaire, soutien aux questions et/ou demandes en service de l'opérateur de l'A/C

Gestion des kits

• Coordination avec les activités de la chaîne d'approvisionnement pour la recherche et la contractualisation des fournisseurs.
• Suivi des livrables des kits d'équipement, du calendrier, des coûts et des risques.

Votre carte d’embarquement:

Compétences techniques requises:

• Diplômé d'un Master (ou équivalent) en ingénierie ou dans une discipline connexe et au moins 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle.
• Savoir-faire et expérience dans le développement et l'intégration d'équipements/modules de cabine sur A/C
• Savoir-faire et expérience dans le développement de systèmes électriques pour les sièges d'avion et les équipements/modules de cabine.
• Knowledge and experience in Aircraft Electrical system installations rules ( ex: TDD92..) is a plus
• La connaissances et l'expérience des règles d'installation de système Electrique Avion ( ex: TDD92 ) est un plus
• Connaissance générale des avions Airbus
• Excellente pratique de l'anglais, tant à l'écrit qu'à l'oral,
• Savoir-faire et expérience dans le développement et l'intégration d'équipements/modules de cabine sur A/C
• Connaissance de la méthode et de l'outil Airbus (VT3, CATIAV5)
• Connaissance des exigences de la réglementation générale - CS25
• Connaissance et expérience dans la certification et la qualification de systèmes électriques pour les sièges d'avion et les équipements de cabine
• Connaissance de la gestion de projet technique
• Connaissance de base en gestion de configuration
• Fluent in English
• Basic in French

Savoir-être:

• Adaptable,
• proactif,
• Curieux,
• Capacité à organiser, à structurer votre travail quotidien au sein de l'équipe et à gérer plusieurs tâches en parallèle.
• Développer et maintenir un haut niveau de travail collaboratif avec les parties prenantes impliquées,
• Capacité de synthèse,
• Capacité de communication.

Ce rôle peut impliquer des voyages occasionnels dans le monde entier pour affaires. Astreintes possibles les week-ends et/ou jours fériés.

Donnez une nouvelle dimension à votre carrière en candidatant en ligne maintenant!

EN

Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for a Cabin Module Engineer (f/m) specializing in the development of electrical systems for aircraft seats and cabin equipment/module  to join our STC* Solutions Programme / Customer Services based in Toulouse, France.

STC Solutions Programme is an integrated team, human sized and colocalized, with Engineering, Airworthiness, Project Management, Quality, Procurement, Logistics…, which values the One Team, One Goal.

We deliver Cabin and Cabin Systems upgrade solutions (SB*, ICA* and kits) certified through Airbus STC, to airlines and lessors for the modification of their in-service aircrafts, through our dedicated: Team, Processes, Suppliers and Means (dedicated Kit Factory).

Integrated in the STC Solutions Programme cabin engineering  team, our STC Cabin Module  Engineer is responsible and accountable for the management of Cabin equipment Development relevant tasks and the validation of all deliverables relative to his activities.

Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. ntegrated to Multi-Functional Teams addressing Cabin Systems upgrades projects on various programs (SA, LR, DD, WB, XWB), you are responsible for following missions:

Working Party phases / Installations on A/C

In-Service Support & Continuous Airworthiness

Kits Management

• Coordination with Supply Chain activities for sourcing & contracting of suppliers
• Follow-up of Equipment kits deliverables, schedule, cost & risks

Your boarding pass:

Required hard skills

• Educated to Master level (or equivalent) in Engineering or a related discipline and minimum 5 years of professional experience
• Airbus aircrafts general knowledge

• Proactive,

• Develop and maintain a high level of collaborative work with the involved stakeholders,
• Synthesis ability,

This role may involve some occasional worldwide travels for business. Possible on-call duties during week-ends and/or holiday seasons

Innovation is at the core of what we do at Amazon Pharmacy. We are revolutionizing the pharmacy experience by removing barriers to medication access, providing transparent pricing and convenience, and delivering exceptional customer service. As we expand our network to become the world's safest and fastest pharmacy operation, we are seeking a Pharmacy District Manager (PDM) to lead multiple pharmacy locations in delivering this vision.

The Pharmacy District Manager is a strategic pharmacy leader responsible for overseeing multi- site pharmacies, 8-10 locations, ensuring operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and exceptional patient care across their district. This role serves as a crucial bridge between site-level operations and regional leadership, driving standardization, performance improvement, and talent development across their portfolio of sites.

Key job responsibilities
Provide strategic oversight and leadership to 8-10 pharmacy locations, ensuring safety, quality, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence
• Execute standardized site visits and audits across locations, ensuring consistent evaluation of operations
• Develop and implement district-wide action plans to address performance gaps
• Collaborate with co-located SSD facilities to ensure alignment on shared facilities and services
• Manage complex staffing strategies across multiple locations, including workforce planning
• Lead district-level meetings and coordinate communication channels between pharmacy locations
• Ensure compliance with multiple state licensing and regulatory rules and regulations
• Drive standardization of processes while accounting for state-specific regulations
• Create and maintain district-wide quality assurance programs
• Ensure controlled substance management compliance across all sites
• Develop and mentor Pharmacy Managers, building a strong leadership pipeline
• Create cross-site talent sharing programs and career development opportunities
• Implement performance management and succession planning strategies
• Foster collaborative culture across all locations
• Manage organizational goals and operational metrics across multiple sites
• Lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency
• Coordinate capital expenditure planning and budget allocation
• Drive consistent execution of standard operating procedures
• Develop and execute emergency response protocols for multiple locations

Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- 3+ years multi-site or district management experience
- Prior experience in a managerial role, with demonstrated track record of developing leaders and building high-performing teams
- Track record of implementing process improvement initiatives
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make informed business decisions
- Travel Requirements: 60-70% travel within assigned district for regular site visits and regional meetings

We're looking for a Program Manager to join our team!

Are you looking for a new challenge in a fast-paced, innovative company, on a rapidly growing team? If so, come make history with the Last Mile Real Estate Expansions Team.
The Expansions Team increases the speed of delivery for customers in both Urban and Rural areas and is responsible for the acquisition, construction and management of all facilities within the AMZL (Urban) and RSR (Rural) last mile programs. We are looking for a program manager to join our Expansions Team who will develop and manage a cross-functional process to identify and validate perspective new buildings, think big to anticipate and work around potential blockers, and deliver leases for new building launches.

We are looking for an agile Senior Program Manager with a strong capacity management, network planning and proven project management experience to own both strategic and tactical real estate expansion projects and programs. This role requires scoping and creating project plans, developing and scaling processes, coordinating and driving execution, and communicating to cross-functional senior management on status, risks and process/product changes. Cross-team collaboration, project management and executive presentation skills are essential.

Key job responsibilities
Own the full lifecycle of the real estate expansion process, from initial business requirement through lease signing, by leading cross-functional partnerships across Transactions, Legal, Capacity Planning, Operations, and Pre-Construction.

Define and drive overall program strategy, establishing the mission, vision, and tenets while setting objectives, analyzing data, and delivering quantifiable improvements that bring new fulfillment locations online.

Operate autonomously in ambiguous environments, working to understand complex business problems, scaling factors, boundary conditions, and the rationale behind leadership decisions.

Partner with internal teams, external partners, and engineering to prioritize the project roadmap and to source, allocate, and coordinate resources effectively.

Identify gaps across teams, processes, and systems, reducing inefficiencies and proactively mitigating risks before they become roadblocks.

Develop, implement, and govern KPI reporting across a portfolio of programs, providing leadership clear visibility into milestones and performance.

Communicate with program managers, business leaders, and executives to influence critical business initiatives and drive alignment among peers.

Engage Amazon business units globally to share best practices and improve end-to-end outcomes for customers.

Take initiative to build scalable processes and mechanisms that strengthen team efficiency and deliver lasting value to stakeholders.

A day in the life
As an Expansion Manager, you lead the end-to-end development of new last-mile delivery facilities across your regional territory. You own a portfolio of 15 to 40 concurrent real estate and construction projects. You guide each site from early planning and selection through due diligence, design, entitlements, capital funding, and construction mobilization to operational opening. Each site runs on roughly a nine-month lifecycle. Day to day, you coordinate across real estate, design engineering, pre-construction, finance, and operations partners. You manage critical-path schedules, secure multimillion-dollar funding approvals, and proactively resolve permitting and timeline risks. Success means delivering sites on time, on budget, and ready to launch.

About the team
We’re driving the key pillars of increased speed and wider coverage for the future of supply chain and enabling faster customer delivery for a wider range of products across the U.S. If you are seeking a fast-paced environment where you can drive innovation and execute on multi-million-dollar expansion deals, this is your opportunity!

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about Generative AI (GenAI)? Do you want to help define the future of Go to Market (GTM) at AWS using generative AI? In this role, you will help some of our largest customers build and deploy GenAI enabled applications using Amazon Bedrock and SageMaker, fine tune and build Generative AI models, and help enterprise customers leverage these models to power end applications. You will engage with AWS product owners to influence product direction and help our customers tap into new markets by utilizing GenAI along with AWS Services.

At Amazon, we’ve been investing deeply in artificial intelligence for over 20 years, and many of the capabilities customers experience in our products are driven by machine learning. Amazon.com’s recommendations engine is driven by machine learning (ML), as are the paths that optimize robotic picking routes in our fulfillment centers. Our supply chain, forecasting, and capacity planning are also informed by ML algorithms. Alexa is fueled by Natural Language Understanding and Automated Speech Recognition deep learning; as is Prime Air, and the computer vision technology in our new retail experience, Amazon Go. We have thousands of engineers at Amazon committed to machine learning and deep learning, and it’s a big part of our heritage.

AWS is looking for a Generative AI Solutions Architect who will be the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for helping customers in designing solutions that leverage our Generative AI services. You will interact with customers directly to understand the business problem, help and aid them in implementation of generative AI solutions, deliver briefing and deep dive sessions to customers and guide customer on adoption patterns and paths for generative AI. As part of the Generative AI Worldwide Specialist organization, you will work closely with other Solution Architects from various geographies to enable large-scale customer use cases and drive the adoption of Amazon Web Services for GenAI services. You will interact with other Data Scientists and Solution Architects in the field, providing guidance on their customer engagements. You will develop white papers, blogs, reference implementations, and presentations to enable customers and partners to fully leverage Generative AI services on Amazon Web Services. You will also create field enablement materials for the broader technical field population, to help them understand how to integrate AWS Generative AI solutions into customer architectures. You drive effective feedback gathering from customers, and you distill and translate that feedback into clear business and technical requirements for product and engineering teams to review.

You must have deep technical experience working with technologies related to large language models including LLM architectures, model evaluation, and fine-tuning techniques. You should be proficient with design, deployment, and evaluation of LLM-powered agents and tools and orchestration approaches. You must have experience with embedding model fine tuning and retrieval method evaluation approaches. You should understand the security and compliance requirements for ML/GenAI implementations. You must have experience with LangChain, LLAMAIndex, Data Augmentation, Responsible AI, and Performance Evaluation frameworks. Candidates must have great communication skills and be very technical, with the ability to impress Amazon Web Services customers at any level, from executive to developer. jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager, Amazon Quick
jobs.description:
Amazon Quick is the AI companion for work. Today, thousands of enterprises and millions of users rely on Quick to connect their data, understand it quickly, and take action: whether through interactive dashboards, embedded analytics woven into the products their customers use, natural language experiences that let any knowledge worker ask a question and act on the answer immediately, or fully managed tools they build and deploy for their stakeholders. Hundreds of ISVs and SaaS companies have already built Quick into the fabric of their applications, powering experiences for millions of end users. That is the kind of reach we operate at, and we are just getting started.

We are at an inflection point. The way users and businesses manage their commerce workflows is about to change fundamentally. Buying, selling, and operating across Amazon's commerce surfaces still runs on fragmented dashboards, manual reporting, and context scattered across disconnected tools. The convergence of structured data, natural language, and agentic AI collapses that friction: an agent that understands your business, acts across every tool you use, and turns a question into completed work. Quick sits at the center of this shift. We are building the companion where a seller optimizes operations, a buyer streamlines procurement, and a vendor acts on insight, all in plain English, all before the day is over. The same experience, the same governed data, scaling from a single user to an entire organization: not a better dashboard, but a fundamentally new way to run a commerce business.

This role owns a defining frontier: building Quick to be the front door for agentic commerce. Amazon operates the world's largest commerce surfaces, and the next wave of value comes from Quick integrating tightly with Amazon Business, Amazon Sellers, and Vendors so that buyers, sellers, and vendors manage their business inside Quick with full context across every tool they use. Your mandate is to make Quick the agentic workspace where commerce happens: where a seller optimizes operations, a buyer streamlines procurement, and a vendor acts on insight, all through Quick as the connective layer across Amazon's commerce ecosystem. You will work across S-team orgs spanning Amazon Business, Sellers, Vendors, and AWS, aligning priorities and building the partnerships that make this integration real.

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager, Technical to own this journey. You are a deeply technical product leader, equal parts strategist and practitioner: someone who can see the three-year arc of a market, then roll up their sleeves to ship the next release; who works backward from the customer's deployment, not from a requirements document, and measures success by whether the customer succeeded; who sees a nascent, fast-growing business not as a risk but as a canvas.

You will have a direct, visible thumbprint on the companion that is becoming the front door for agentic commerce across Amazon's ecosystem. The decisions you make, about what we build, how we package it, who we build it for, and how we bring it to market, will define how businesses buy, sell, and operate in the age of AI. If you are a builder who gets energy from ambiguity, thinks in systems but ships in increments, and wants to be at the frontier where commerce meets agentic AI, we want to talk to you.

Key job responsibilities
• Define the vision through writing. Author PRFAQs, narratives, and specs that frame the agentic commerce opportunity and align S-team orgs across Amazon Business, Sellers, and Vendors. Make crisp tradeoffs and drive delivery with engineering, applied science, and design, holding a high bar on quality and experience.

• Work backward from customers. Engage directly with buyers, sellers, vendors, and AWS field teams; turn what you hear into product conviction and anticipate what customers will need before they ask.

• Build agentic solutions. Be hands-on with the technology, from how a semantic model resolves a natural language query to how an agent acts across a seller's tools, operating at the level of detail where real product decisions are made.

• Partner with GTM and Sales to design onboarding and growth motions that accelerate time-to-value and turn deployments into enterprise-wide adoption.

• Own business outcomes: adoption, revenue, competitive win rates, and retention. Use data relentlessly to prioritize, make the case for investment, and communicate progress to leadership.

Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of technical product management with internet business experience
- 5+ years of working as a Technical Product Manager experience
- 3+ years of technical (software development, network development, IT, other related) experience
- 7+ years of full product life cycle experience
- 5+ years of P&L management and pricing experience
- 5+ years of creating written docs for development of new products experience
- 5+ years of enterprise security product experience
- 5+ years of product management in the cloud computing technology space experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, finance, or economics
- Experience in taking a product from conception & definition phase through engineering design and taking it to market
- Experience delivering large-scale SaaS, PaaS or LaaS products where you are responsible for the full product lifecycle, from concept through GTM (go to market)

Preferred qualifications:
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience working within teams delivering software products and features using agile methodologies

PwC, cabinet pluridisciplinaire, rassemble 7 000 collaborateurs en France et au Maghreb, au sein d’un réseau mondial de plus de 364 000 personnes dans 136 pays. Dans un monde en constante évolution, nous investissons dans le développement de nos équipes avec une proposition de valeur forte : Grow here. Go further. Un engagement mondial pour accompagner nos talents dans l’évolution de leurs compétences.

Ce que nous recherchons ?  Des expertises, bien sûr. Mais surtout, des personnalités curieuses, passionnées, prêtes à incarner les comportements du PwC Professional, notre référentiel commun qui guide notre manière de travailler ensemble.

Reconnu Top Employer pour la 6ème année consécutive, PwC s’engage à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et handi-accueillant, où chacun peut pleinement collaborer et avoir un impact. Nous aidons nos clients, les grands établissements du secteur financier, en leur offrant une vision innovante de la gestion des risques, des solutions adaptées aux enjeux (macroéconomiques, IA, cybersécurité, durabilité, etc.), ainsi qu'une expertise reconnue pour renforcer leur résilience et soutenir leur croissance, en intégrant le risque dans leur stratégie et leurs décisions.

Nous combinons diverses compétences en comptabilité, réglementation bancaire, gestion des risques et audit interne pour aider nos clients à maîtriser leurs risques. Notre équipe crée, perfectionne et valide les dispositifs de gestion des risques en s'appuyant sur les meilleures technologies et pratiques du secteur. Rejoindre cette activité, c'est renforcer la protection et la résilience des organisations dans un monde en constante évolution.

Vos missions

Au sein de l'équipe Risk & Finance vous intervenez au sein de grands établissements bancaires dans un rôle de conseil auprès des directions financière et des équipes reporting des banques sur l’ensemble des problématiques de reporting financier, à la fois comptables et réglementaires.

Votre rôle couvre un périmètre large, combinant expertise technique, projets de transformation et de sécurisation des processus :

• Projets de transformation (organisation, processus, outils) et de sécurisation des processus de reporting financier au sein des établissements financiers
• Accompagnement stratégique des clients sur leurs problématiques techniques liées au reporting financier, comptable et/ou prudentiel

• Optimisation des impacts financiers dans la structuration d'opérations capitalistiques ou de nouveaux produits et activités
• Mise en œuvre de plans de remédiation dans des contextes de crise liés au reporting financiers (fraude, erreur, situation de crises...)
• Missions de conseil en lien avec la communication financière de nos clients et la remontée d'informations aux organes de gouvernance

Votre profil

• Diplômé.e d’un Master en comptabilité, finance ou audit
• Expérience à partir de 3 ans auprès d'une Direction Financière et/ou d'un cabinet d'audit/conseil
• Une expérience en audit externe de clients bancaires constitue un atout fort pour ce poste
• Maîtrise des fondamentaux comptables ; une exposition aux sujets prudentiels/réglementaires est appréciée
• Fort esprit d’équipe, aisance relationnelle, rigueur, curiosité pour la technologie et la réglementation
• Maîtrise du Pack Office (PPT, Excel)
• Niveau d’anglais professionnel (B2/C1)

Vos avantages

• Un environnement technologique innovant : accès à des outils de pointe comme le Tech Lab, Copilot M365 et l’IA Factory pour façonner le monde de demain
• Des possibilités d’apprentissage et de développement hors normes, grâce à notre plateforme de formation intelligente et notre culture du feedback continu
• Un cycle de performance stimulant, aligné avec le référentiel PwC Professional, pour vous aider à atteindre vos objectifs et viser l’excellence jour après jour
• Un cadre de travail positif et inclusif pour vous permettre d’être pleinement vous-même et de collaborer efficacement au service de nos clients (programmes de parentalité, d’équité femmes-hommes, de santé et bien-être Be Well, Work Well, d’inclusion LGBT+ et de maintien dans l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap)

Pour en savoir plus sur nos avantages, rendez-vous sur notre page dédiée.

Notre processus de recrutement

Pour vous permettre de vivre une expérience fluide et transparente, notre processus de recrutement se déroule en plusieurs étapes :

• Évaluation en ligne avec un test de compétences et/ou un test d’anglais

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer.  As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Business Performance Director

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will build business cases for approval by senior executives, independently develop transformation strategies for key initiatives, and lead initiatives through the transformation process.  This will include developing value realization measures, managing the value realization process, and determining the best use of transformation tools and methods to help initiatives achieve intended outcomes.

Candidate should have experience leading change management for large business transformation programs and initiatives.  They will develop and implement complex change management strategies and plans related to changes to organizational structures, processes, and technologies across multiple timeframes and impact.  This requires expertise in sponsorship development, change communications, capability development, and behavior change.  Must be able to oversee others execution of associated tactics.

This role will lead senior leaders and teams through structured problem solving using Disciplined Approach methodology to drive alignment around critical issues, options, and solutions.  These problems will often be cross functional in nature.  They will be a thought partner for leaders and work across technology, process, and business to support solution implementation.

Will be accountable for independently delivering the following:

• Effective executive level business cases, including financial analysis
• Establishing initiative governance with senior leaders
• Change team management and facilitation
• Interdependency identification and management
• Establish realization measures and targets
• Develop and manage value realization plan
• Assess and mitigate risks to delivery and value realization
• Identify impacted populations and expected level of disruption

Fully Remote with onsite presence required for critical workshops and planning sessions.

Responsibilities:

• Maintain 12 quarter plan for initiatives and programs
• Integrate key activities and milestones across initiatives
• Maintain measures that track progress and can be used in communications with Executives
• Develop and manage “key milestone readiness” and “release readiness” processes for all initiatives
• Lead the end-to-end organizational change management for transformation programs, integrating change strategy, stakeholder engagement, communications, and training to drive adoption and sustained performance.
• Design and execute integrated change management plans spanning process, technology, workforce, risk, and communications to drive clarity and coordinated execution.
• Develop and execute capability frameworks that clarify roles, expectations, and leadership readiness to support successful operating model adoption.
• Establish governance and oversee delivery of role-based learning and training programs, ensuring alignment to transformation priorities and role requirements.
• Manage internal and external partners to deliver scalable, high-quality learning experiences, including oversight of scope, deliverables, quality, and timing.
• Establish structured communications strategies and engagement rhythms to enable transparency, alignment, and stakeholder commitment throughout the transformation lifecycle.
• Monitor and report capability building, training, and change metrics to inform leadership decisions and continuously improve the change approach.
• Standardize and scale capability enablement processes to ensure consistency, efficiency, and sustainability across the organization.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The strategic and transformational leader we seek is an experienced business performance professional with the following qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

Doctorate degree and 4 years of  Business Transformation, Organizational Change Management, Strategic Planning, or Program Management experience

OR

Master’s degree and 7  years Business Transformation, Organizational Change Management, Strategic Planning, or Program Management experience

OR

Bachelor’s degree and 9 years of  Business Transformation, Organizational Change Management, Strategic Planning, or Program Management experience

Preferred Qualifications:

• Strong transformation skillset
• Financial acumen
• Project management skills
• Strong organizational skills, including ability to follow assignments through to completion
• Collaborate and communicate with initiative leadership teams
• Strong communication (both written and oral), facilitation, and presentation skills
• Strong skill in working independently and to effectively interact with various levels
• Demonstrate the Amgen Values and Leadership Characteristics
• Experience operating in regulated, quality-sensitive environments (biopharma preferred) with understanding of transformation delivery and business impact.
• Ability to integrate learning, knowledge, and change management to drive sustained performance.
• Demonstrated ability to influence a global, matrixed organization and lead enterprise change initiatives.
• Experience designing scalable workforce processes, governance frameworks, and/or capability strategies.
• Strong program/project management capability, including navigating ambiguity, driving alignment, and delivering measurable outcomes.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level messaging and organizational storytelling.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

• Provide technical leadership for site electrical infrastructure, including medium-voltage distribution, substations, switchgear, transformers, generators, ATS/paralleling systems, UPS systems, and low-voltage distribution.
• Serve as the subject matter expert for electrical reliability, power quality, emergency power, system protection, and electrical safety.
• Lead complex troubleshooting and root-cause investigations involving electrical failures, voltage disturbances, protection-system operation, generator and transfer system events, and facility outages.
• Develop and maintain electrical system standards, operating procedures, failure-mode analyses, preventive maintenance strategies, and critical-spares recommendations.
• Support the planning, design, execution, commissioning, and turnover of capital projects, facility improvements, equipment installations, and expansion activities.
• Review electrical designs, specifications, studies, and contractor work to ensure compliance with applicable codes, Amgen standards, GMP expectations, and site reliability requirements.
• Lead or support arc-flash, coordination, short-circuit, load-flow, harmonics, and power-quality studies, translating results into practical site improvements.
• Partner with Operations and Maintenance teams to improve equipment reliability, reduce operational risk, and minimize manufacturing downtime.
• Provide technical oversight of electrical contractors, engineering firms, equipment vendors, and service providers.
• Support electrical safety programs, including NFPA 70E compliance, energized-work practices, lockout/tagout considerations, and incident prevention.
• Participate in site shutdown planning, outage coordination, emergency-response planning, and return-to-service activities.
• Mentor engineers and technical staff while strengthening electrical engineering capability across the site.
• Communicate technical risks, reliability priorities, project status, and investment needs clearly to site leadership.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a collaborative leader with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications

• Doctorate degree and 2 years of engineering experience; or
• Master’s degree and 4 years of engineering experience; or
• Bachelor’s degree and 6 years of engineering experience; or
• Associate’s degree and 10 years of engineering experience; or
• High school diploma/GED and 12 years of engineering experience.

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering required; Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering preferred.
• Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred.
• 10+ years of progressively responsible electrical engineering experience supporting complex industrial, manufacturing, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, utility, or other mission-critical facilities.
• Demonstrated technical leadership in medium-voltage and low-voltage power distribution, including substations, switchgear, transformers, generators, automatic transfer switches, paralleling gear, UPS systems, and protective relaying.
• Experience leading electrical reliability initiatives, electrical-system troubleshooting, root-cause investigations, and corrective actions following equipment failures, power-quality events, or utility interruptions.
• Experience developing electrical system studies and strategies, including short-circuit, coordination, arc-flash, load-flow, harmonics, and power-quality assessments.
• Proven experience leading electrical capital projects from early scope development and design through installation, commissioning, and operational turnover.
• Experience working in a regulated GMP, life-sciences, food, semiconductor, or similarly controlled manufacturing environment strongly preferred.
• Strong working knowledge of NFPA 70, NFPA 70E, NEC, OSHA requirements, IEEE standards, and electrical safety practices.
• Ability to translate complex electrical risks and technical recommendations into clear decisions for operations and site leadership.
• Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams, mentor technical staff, and manage external engineering firms, contractors, and equipment vendors.

Additional Information

This role is based onsite at Amgen Ohio in New Albany, Ohio. The position may require occasional support outside of normal business hours for planned shutdowns, emergency response, and critical site events.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

jobs.title: Data Engineer Expérimenté(e) H/F - Clermont-Ferrand
jobs.description:
Rejoignez nos équipes Data Engineering à Clermont-Ferrand et intervenez sur des projets de transformation à forte valeur ajoutée pour un grand industriel mondial.

Notre client est engagé dans une transformation data et IA d’envergure, avec pour ambition de devenir une organisation pleinement data-driven sur l’ensemble de ses métiers. Cette transformation s’appuie sur une plateforme de données commune, déployée progressivement à l’échelle mondiale, qui sert de socle à des cas d’usage IA couvrant aussi bien les opérations industrielles que l’innovation produit.

Deux entités sont au cœur de cette dynamique : le Manufacturing et la R&D. L’enjeu central est d’assurer la continuité numérique entre ces deux domaines — connecter les flux de données de la conception jusqu’à la fabrication, pour éliminer les silos d’information et créer de la valeur à chaque étape du cycle de vie produit.

Vous contribuerez à concevoir, développer et industrialiser des solutions data robustes et performantes. Au cœur des enjeux métiers et technologiques, vous travaillerez sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de traitement de la donnée, de son ingestion à sa mise à disposition pour les usages analytiques.

Votre maîtrise de l’ingénierie des données, votre capacité à comprendre les besoins métiers et votre envie de progresser au sein d’un environnement collaboratif seront essentielles pour réussir dans ce rôle.

Rejoignez-nous

En intégrant nos équipes à Clermont-Ferrand, vous rejoindrez un environnement réunissant les expertises d’Avanade et d’Accenture au service d'une transformation industrielle d'envergure.

Vous collaborerez avec des Data Engineers, architectes, experts cloud et équipes métiers afin de construire des solutions concrètes, fiables et adaptées aux besoins du client. Vous bénéficierez également d’un accompagnement de proximité, de formations et de certifications pour développer progressivement votre expertise et construire votre parcours professionnel.

Ensemble, nous faisons ce qui compte.

Vos missions

• Analyser les besoins du client et questionner les solutions existantes.
• Traduire les besoins métiers en solutions techniques adaptées, en tenant compte de la volumétrie, de l’historisation, de la qualité des données et des fréquences de rafraîchissement.
• Concevoir, développer et optimiser des pipelines de données couvrant l’ingestion, la transformation et le stockage.
• Développer et maintenir des traitements data en Python et SQL.
• Participer à la conception et à la mise en œuvre d’architectures data modernes : data warehouse, datamart et modèles analytiques.
• Analyser la performance des traitements et contribuer à garantir la fiabilité des flux de données.
• Collaborer avec les architectes, les équipes métier et les autres membres de l’équipe projet.
• Appliquer les bonnes pratiques d’ingénierie logicielle : tests, gestion de versions, revue de code et CI/CD.
• Exploiter et intégrer différentes technologies data et cloud, telles qu’Azure, Spark, Kafka, Databricks, Dataiku, Snowflake, les bases de données SQL et NoSQL ou Power BI.
• Participer à l’amélioration continue des méthodes de travail, des composants techniques et des pratiques de l’équipe.

.

Vos compétences

• Bonne maîtrise de Python et SQL.
• Expérience dans la conception et le développement de pipelines de données.
• Connaissance des principales étapes d’une chaîne data : ingestion, transformation, stockage et exposition des données.
• Compréhension des architectures data modernes et des principes de modélisation de données.
• Connaissance d’au moins un environnement cloud, idéalement Microsoft Azure.
• Première expérience avec une ou plusieurs technologies telles que Spark, Databricks, Kafka, Dataiku, Snowflake, Azure Data Factory ou des bases de données SQL et NoSQL.
• Connaissance des pratiques de développement logiciel : tests, CI/CD, gestion de versions et revue de code.
• Sensibilité aux enjeux de performance, de qualité, de sécurité et de gouvernance des données.
• Capacité à analyser un besoin, à identifier les contraintes techniques et à proposer une solution pragmatique.
• Bonnes capacités de communication et goût du travail en équipe.
• Une expérience ou appétence pour la DataViz serait un plus : maîtrise d’un outil de visualisation tel que Power BI, connaissance des bonnes pratiques de modélisation pour l’analyse (modèle en étoile, dimensions et faits).

Votre profil

Pour réussir dans ce rôle :

• Vous êtes titulaire d’un diplôme de niveau Bac+2, Bac+3 ou Bac+5 en informatique, data, systèmes d’information ou dans un domaine technique équivalent.
• Vous disposez d’au moins deux ans d’expérience professionnelle en Data Engineering, développement data ou sur un périmètre technique comparable.
• Vous aimez comprendre les besoins métiers et les traduire en solutions data concrètes.
• Vous savez travailler en équipe et collaborer avec des interlocuteurs aux profils variés.
• Vous êtes curieux, rigoureux et attentif à la qualité des solutions que vous développez.
• Vous êtes capable de questionner l’existant, de proposer des améliorations et de contribuer activement à la résolution de problèmes.
• Vous souhaitez développer vos compétences techniques et évoluer progressivement vers davantage de responsabilités.
• Vous maîtrisez le français et disposez d’un niveau d’anglais vous permettant d’évoluer dans un environnement professionnel international.

Construisez votre carrière :

Chez Avanade, nous accordons une importance particulière au développement et à l’accompagnement de nos talents. En nous rejoignant, vous bénéficierez notamment :

• D’un accompagnement régulier dans la construction de votre parcours professionnel.
• D’un accès à des formations et à des certifications permettant de développer vos compétences data, cloud et consulting.
• De l’appui d’un réseau d’experts Avanade et Accenture.
• De missions vous permettant de progresser techniquement et de développer votre compréhension des enjeux métiers.
• De perspectives d’évolution vers des rôles de Data Engineer confirmé, de référent technique ou de Tech Lead, en fonction de votre expérience et de vos aspirations.
• D’un environnement de travail flexible favorisant la collaboration et l’équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle.
• D’un package complet associant rémunération, avantages sociaux et dispositifs d’accompagnement.

Faites la différence avec nous

Vous souhaitez développer votre expertise en Data Engineering, intervenir dans un environnement client exigeant et contribuer à des projets data concrets à fort impact industriel ?

Rejoignez les équipes Avanade et Accenture à Clermont-Ferrand et participez à la construction de solutions data performantes, durables et utiles aux métiers.

The ideal candidate combines strong operational security experience with modern engineering and automation skills. jobs.title: Cost of Quality Improvement Leader, FCSS
jobs.description:
Cost of Quality Improvement Leader, FCSS

Are you passionate about driving quality excellence and reducing the Cost of Poor Quality through proactive prevention and continuous improvement?

Do you enjoy leading cross-functional teams to solve complex quality challenges, eliminate systemic issues, and deliver measurable business impact?

Partnering with the best

The FCSS Cost of Quality Improvement Leader is responsible and accountable for reducing Cost of Poor Quality across FCSS businesses, sites and functions. The role is execution-led, spending the majority of its time at the point of impact leading strategic improvement, removing systemic causes and resolving significant customer escapes, rather than producing routine reports.

The role establishes clear ownership, measurement and action across the Cost of Quality categories, prevention, appraisal, internal failure and external failure, with a deliberate shift towards prevention: identifying risk early, strengthening controls and eliminating failure modes before they create defects, escapes or customer impact.

A core responsibility is to use Cost of Quality data, risk signals, lessons learned and Management of Change to anticipate where failures may occur and strengthen design, supplier, process and service controls before cost is incurred. Where failures or customer escapes do occur, the role can be deployed across FCSS to lead or facilitate rapid containment, customer protection, rigorous root-cause analysis, effective corrective action, cross-business learning and verified sustainment.

Fueling your passion

As FCSS Cost of Quality Improvement Leader, you will be responsible and accountable for:

Cost of Quality Strategy, Governance & Leadership

• Defining and deploy the FCSS Cost of Quality strategy and multi-year prevention and reduction roadmap, aligned with business priorities, product and process risk, and annual operating plans.
• Establishing common definitions, data standards, ownership and governance for prevention, appraisal, internal failure and external failure costs.
• Creating transparency of the Cost of Quality baseline, trends, emerging risks, systemic failure modes and business impact across FCSS.
• Leading a forward looking operating rhythm that reviews leading indicators, risk exposure, prevention actions and control effectiveness alongside realised failure cost.
• Partnering with Quality, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Services and Finance to assign accountable owners and act before identified risks become defects or escapes.
• Direct ingprevention and appraisal investment towards the controls with the strongest evidence of reducing failure cost and customer risk.

Cost of Poor Quality Reduction Portfolio

• Maintaining a single, prioritised portfolio combining preventive opportunities and realised Cost of Poor Quality, ranked by risk, potential financial exposure, customer impact, recurrence and delivery feasibility.
• Identifying high risk products, processes, suppliers and changes before failure by using risk assessments, weak signals, audit findings, process capability and historical lessons.
• Strengthening preventive controls such as design and process reviews, FMEA, control plans, supplier assurance, error proofing, capability improvement and verification at critical control points.
• Targeting major internal and external failure costs, while requiring actions to address the conditions that allowed the failure to occur and escape.
• Ensuring initiatives have evidence based risk or problem statements, baselines, targets, accountable owners and robust preventive or corrective controls.
• Tracking delivery, control effectiveness and sustainment, with avoided-cost assumptions and realised savings evidenced through agreed Finance governance.

Cost of Quality Data, Analysis & Performance Management

• Using the standard Cost of Quality dashboards and reporting framework developed and maintained by the Industrial Products Cost Leader; do not duplicate routine data preparation or reporting activity.
• Converting dashboard insight rapidly into a small number of prioritised strategic improvements, with clear owners, actions, milestones and expected business outcomes.
• Spending the majority of role capacity leading problem solving, working with teams at the point of impact, implementing preventive and corrective controls, and removing barriers to delivery.
• Using trend, recurrence, capability and risk analysis to identify systemic priorities and direct resources before losses materialise.
• Partnering with the Industrial Products Cost Leader only where data gaps or targeted analysis are required, while retaining accountability for converting insight into measurable improvement.
• Keeping governance concise and decision-focused, using existing operating reviews and QBRs to confirm priorities, remove barriers, secure ownership and evidence results.
• Building leadership capability to interpret Cost of Quality insight and take action without creating additional reporting layers.

Customer Escapes, Structured Problem Solving, Lessons Learned & Management of Change

• Acting as the FCSS expert and escalation point for structured problem solving, with the authority to lead, facilitate or assure the response to any significant customer escape or systemic quality issue.
• Ensuring immediate customer protection and effective containment, with clear ownership, governance, communication and escalation through to verified closure.
• Deploying a common, risk-based problem-solving framework and select the right method for the issue, including 3C, 5 Why, A3, 8D and DMAIC, supported by preventive tools such as FMEA and control plans.
• Coaching and challenge cross-functional teams to define the problem from evidence, verify occurrence and escape root causes, implement systemic countermeasures and complete independent effectiveness checks.
• Coaching teams to identify and mitigate failure modes during design, industrialisation, supplier selection, process change and service planning, not only after a defect occurs.
• Establishing a disciplined lessons-learned process that captures learning from defects, customer escapes, near misses and successful prevention and applies it across relevant products, processes, suppliers and sites.
• Embedding lessons learned at the front end of new product, process, supplier and change activity through updated standards, risk assessments, design reviews, control plans, training and verification.
• Strengthening Management of Change so product, process, supplier, system and organisational changes are risk-assessed early, approved with defined controls, implemented, verified and monitored through stabilisation.
• Using recurrence, repeat escape, near miss and control effectiveness reviews to confirm that preventive and corrective controls remain effective and sustained.

Examples of Key Result Areas and Relevant KPIs:

Cost of Quality Performance

• Cost of Poor Quality reduction versus baseline and operating plan
• Reduction in internal and external failure costs
• High-risk failure modes prevented before customer impact

Reduction Delivery & Financial Benefits

• Priority improvements delivered to target and milestone
• Finance-validated savings delivered and sustained
• Speed from identified issue to verified result

Customer Escape Response, Problem Solving, Lessons Learned & Change Control

• Significant customer escapes contained and closed on time
• Corrective actions independently verified as effective
• Repeat escapes and recurring failure modes reduced
• Lessons learned and change controls implemented across affected areas

Governance & Capability

• Majority of role capacity deployed on improvement delivery
• Actions closed on time with accountable ownership
• Capability built through active coaching and problem solving

To be successful in this role you will:

• Have bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Operations, Business or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience.
• Have minimum 5 years’ experience in Quality, Continuous Improvement, Operational Excellence or related leadership roles.
• Demonstrated experience analysing and reducing Cost of Poor Quality across prevention, appraisal, internal failurPe and external failure categories.
• Have proven record of leading complex, cross functional problem solving for customer escapes and systemic quality issues, delivering verified corrective action, financial benefit and improved customer outcomes.
• Have strong knowledge of quality cost models, structured problem solving, corrective and preventive action, lessons learned and Management of Change.
• Have experience leading in a matrixed, multi-business environment and influencing without direct authority.
• Have strong financial, analytical, facilitation, coaching and stakeholder-management skills.
• Have Clear executive and frontline communication, with the ability to translate quality and cost data into decisions, ownership and action

Desired:

• Have Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or higher.
• Have experience delivering large scale transformation, harmonization or cross business improvement programs.
• Have experience in multi-site or global operations.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too.

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are stronger when our people are developed, engaged, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. We invest in wellbeing, capability development, and leadership growth across all levels.

Working for you

Our innovations have transformed the energy industry for over a century. To continue progressing, we look for individuals who embrace change and contribute to building the future.

What You Can Expect

• Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
• Comprehensive private medical care options
• Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
• Tailored financial programs
• Education assistance
• Generous parental leave
• Mental health resources
• Dependent care support
• Additional elected or voluntary benefits

This position requires valid work authorization in the country of employment. The employer is unable to sponsor work authorization for this role at any time.

You will be eligible to participate in Company-sponsored benefit programs, including health & welfare programs and the Thrift Plan (401k). You will have a choice of coverage options that best suit your needs. Coverage options and contribution amounts are related to your benefit elections, base salary level, and specific requirements of each of these plans.

This position is eligible for our comprehensive and competitive benefits package, which can be found here, and is further eligible for additional forms of compensation such as bonuses subject to the terms of the applicable benefit plans or policies.

jobs.description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.

Our Chemical Process Development group is a team of organic chemists, analytical chemists, and chemical engineers working together to design novel syntheses from raw materials to supply new medicines to patients. Our scientists focus on developing safe, economical, sustainable, and robust processes to support clinical trials and the launch of new medicines across various drug modalities including small molecules, peptides, oligonucleotides, and antibody drug conjugates.

Our work combines innovative science, data-driven decision-making, and cross-functional collaboration to translate laboratory chemistry into reliable manufacturing processes. The scientific and process knowledge generated through development, scale-up, and manufacturing establishes the process understanding, design parameters, and control strategies needed to support regulatory filings and the delivery of new medicines to patients worldwide.

Job Summary:

The Kilo Lab Scientist plays a key role in translating laboratory-developed chemical processes into safe, robust, and executable manufacturing processes within the New Brunswick Kilo Lab and beyond. Working hands-on with multidisciplinary Chemical Process Development teams, the scientist is responsible for the preparation, scale-up, and execution of processes supporting the manufacture of GMP active drug substance for pharmaceutical development.

The scientist leads and coordinates manufacturing campaign activities, including process design and scale-up, equipment selection and setup, materials planning, process safety evaluation review, recipe development, batch execution, equipment cleaning, process documentation, and post-campaign assessment. The role requires a combination of scientific understanding, practical problem-solving, and mechanical aptitude, with a strong commitment to safety, quality, and environmental compliance.

Kilo Lab Scientists execute processes from laboratory scale through 200L and work directly with processing equipment throughout campaign preparation and manufacturing. The Kilo Lab also provides an environment for evaluating and implementing emerging manufacturing technologies and methodologies, giving scientists opportunities to contribute to the advancement of how new novel medicines are scaled and manufactured.

Responsibilities:

• Lead the implementation and scale-up of chemical processes from the development laboratory into the New Brunswick Kilo Lab in support of clinical development and GMP active drug substance manufacturing.
• Work hands-on with chemists, engineers, analytical scientists, and other cross-functional partners to translate laboratory processes into safe, robust, and executable manufacturing operations.
• Plan, coordinate, and execute Kilo Lab manufacturing campaigns, including equipment selection and setup, raw material planning, process safety readiness, recipe preparation, batch execution, cleaning, and manufacturing documentation.
• Apply scientific and engineering principles to identify and resolve technical and operational challenges encountered during process scale-up and manufacturing.
• Review process safety information and translate identified process requirements and operating boundaries into appropriate manufacturing practices.
• Monitor and assess process performance during manufacturing and document observations, deviations, learnings, and opportunities for process improvement.
• Ensure manufacturing activities are conducted in accordance with applicable safety, GMP, environmental, and procedural requirements.
• Collaborate with development teams before and after campaigns to incorporate scale-up and manufacturing learnings into subsequent process development.
• Participate in the evaluation and implementation of new equipment, manufacturing technologies, and processing methodologies within the Kilo Lab.
• Contribute to a collaborative working environment through effective communication, knowledge sharing, and partnership across scientific and engineering disciplines.

Required Qualifications:

• BS in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related scientific or engineering discipline with 1-3 years of experience.***
• Demonstrated ability to apply scientific and technical principles to laboratory, process development, scale-up, or manufacturing activities.
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic laboratory and manufacturing environment.
• Ability and willingness to work hands-on with chemical processing equipment and perform activities associated with setup, operation, and execution of manufacturing processes.
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to work effectively across scientific and engineering disciplines in a matrix environment.
• Ability to work independently, exercise sound technical judgment, and manage assigned activities with appropriate levels of supervision.
• Commitment to safe working practices, quality, and regulatory compliance.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Advanced degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related scientific or engineering discipline.***
• Relevant industry experience in laboratory process development, chemical process scale-up, pilot-scale operations, or pharmaceutical/chemical manufacturing.***
• Familiarity with chemical processing equipment and unit operations used in synthetic chemical manufacturing.
• Knowledge of GMP manufacturing principles and process safety practices.
• Experience translating laboratory procedures into larger-scale manufacturing operations.
• Experience with emerging or intensified manufacturing technologies, including continuous or flow processing.
• Ability and interest in applying and expanding technical capabilities across process development and manufacturing, including supporting Development Engineering laboratory activities and Process Engineering activities associated with externally executed manufacturing campaigns.

*** The level of the position will be determined based on the selected candidate’s education, relevant experience, and demonstrated capabilities.

The responsibilities described above are representative of the role and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and activities associated with the position.

jobs.description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work.
